papers.title: Variable Charge State, Magnetic Excitations, and Kondo Effect of Sm/g/Ir(111)
papers.abstract: Using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy we investigate the charge state, magnetic excitations, and Kondo features of individual Sm adatoms on graphene/Ir(111). Depending on the number and distance of their neighbors, Sm atoms can be in two discrete charge states. At certain distances, a reversible transition between these two states is induced by the electric field of the STM tip leading to concentric charge rings in the images. Only atoms in one of the two charge states exhibit magnetic excitations in d$I$/d$V$ spectra. Two such excitations are located at 35~meV and 54~meV and related to transitions from the $J = 1/2$ ground state doublet to the first crystal field split $J = 3/2$ multiplet. Together with the intra-atomic exchange excitations at higher energy, these observations indicate that Sm transfers one $6s$ electron to the substrate while it retains its gas-phase $4f$ filling. New for lanthanide adatoms, we observe a Kondo resonance. The Zeeman splitting of the Kondo peak reveals that Sm retains its large gas-phase $g$-factor. Comparison of d$I$/d$V$ spectra to cotunneling theory yields the crystal field acting on the $4f$ shell and, consequently, on the $J = 3/2$ quadruplet, confirms Sm$^+$ as the ground state, and identifies Sm$^{2+}$ as being energetically close, thereby rationalizing our observation of variable charge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy”（低温扫描隧道显微镜）进行测量，并分析dI/dV谱。；研究对象：单个Sm（钐）原子吸附在石墨烯/Ir(111)表面（Sm/g/Ir(111)）上的电荷态、磁激发与近藤效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sm原子在g/Ir(111)上可处于两种离散电荷态（Sm⁺与Sm²⁺），其中仅一种电荷态（Sm⁺）表现出晶体场劈裂的磁激发（35 meV和54 meV）以及近藤共振；STM针尖电场可在特定距离下诱导两种电荷态之间的可逆转变，形成同心电荷环。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sm原子在g/Ir(111)上可处于两种离散电荷态（Sm⁺与Sm²⁺），其中仅一种电荷态（Sm⁺）表现出晶体场劈裂的磁激发（35 meV和54 meV）以及近藤共振；STM针尖电场可在特定距离下诱导两种电荷态之间的可逆转变，形成同心电荷环。；创新点：首次在镧系（稀土）单原子吸附体系中观察到近藤共振；结合电荷态可变性与磁激发谱，明确Sm⁺为基态且Sm²⁺能量上非常接近，从而解释了电荷态的可变性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 低温扫描隧道显微镜（LT-STM）及dI/dV谱学；利用针尖电场调控电荷态；将dI/dV谱与共隧穿理论（cotunneling theory）对比以提取晶体场参数；通过近藤峰的塞曼劈裂测量g因子。

papers.title: From Electronic Structure to Environmental Remediation: Adsorption of Ionized Glyphosate on COOH-Modified Carbon Nanotube
papers.abstract: Glyphosate is a widely used herbicide whose persistence and toxicity in aquatic and terrestrial environments demand efficient removal strategies. Here we employ GFN2 xTB calculations with implicit ALPB aqueous solvation and automated docking to investigate the adsorption of all five pH dependent ionized forms of glyphosate (G1-G5) on (10,0) single walled carbon nanotubes covalently functionalized with carboxyl groups at 0-25% coverage. Adsorption energies reveal a clear charge dependent trend: the dianionic (G4) and trianionic (G5) species exhibit the most negative binding energies over the entire functionalization range, while the protonated and neutral forms (G1, G2) bind weakly, approaching reversible adsorption at high COOH contents. The deprotonated form G5 strengthens from -2.17 eV on pristine CNT to about -5.7 eV at 10% and 25% functionalization, with a local minimum near 15-20% COOH due to steric and electrostatic crowding of adjacent groups. Decomposition of the solvation free energy shows dominant electrostatic stabilization complemented by increasingly favorable hydrogen bond contributions as carboxyl density grows. All complexes display very small HOMO-LUMO gaps (0.02-0.22 eV), indicating high electronic sensitivity to adsorption and functionalization. Overall, CNT+COOH systems can operate in both strong capture and regenerable regimes depending on glyphosate ionization state, offering a tunable platform for pH responsive remediation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用GFN2 xTB计算、隐式ALPB水溶剂模型及自动化对接（automated docking）。；研究对象：研究对象为（10,0）单壁碳纳米管经羧基（COOH）共价功能化后的体系，及其对五种pH依赖的离子化草甘膦形态（G1–G5）的吸附行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 草甘膦吸附能呈现明显的电荷依赖趋势：双阴离子（G4）和三阴离子（G5）形态在所有功能化覆盖率下结合能最强，而质子化/中性形态（G1、G2）结合较弱，在高COOH含量下接近可逆吸附。G5形态的结合能从原始CNT上的-2.17 eV增强至10%和25%功能化时的约-5.7 eV，且在15–20%覆盖率附近因空间位阻和静电拥挤出现局部极小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：草甘膦吸附能呈现明显的电荷依赖趋势：双阴离子（G4）和三阴离子（G5）形态在所有功能化覆盖率下结合能最强，而质子化/中性形态（G1、G2）结合较弱，在高COOH含量下接近可逆吸附。G5形态的结合能从原始CNT上的-2.17 eV增强至10%和25%功能化时的约-5.7 eV，且在15–20%覆盖率附近因空间位阻和静电拥挤出现局部极小值。；创新点：系统研究了草甘膦全部五种pH依赖离子形态在COOH功能化碳纳米管上的吸附，揭示了吸附能随电荷态和功能化密度的可调规律，并提出该体系可在强捕获与可再生两种模式间切换，作为pH响应型修复平台。摘要未突出说明与已有碳纳米管吸附研究相比的具体方法学或材料设计上的突破。
papers.method_zh: 采用GFN2 xTB半经验量子化学方法，结合隐式ALPB水溶剂化模型，并辅以自动化对接（automated docking）来研究吸附构型。功能化覆盖率为0–25%。

papers.title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
papers.abstract: Non-reciprocal interactions are ubiquitous in active, biological, and disordered systems, generically driving them out of equilibrium. Here, we introduce a hierarchy of non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (NROU) models governed by a tunable non-reciprocity parameter $g$. At a special point $g=g^*$, the drift matrix becomes non-diagonalizable, realizing exceptional points (EP's) of different orders, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors simultaneously coalesce. The hierarchy encompasses non-reciprocally coupled dimers, their disordered counterparts, and a many-body chain exactly mapping onto the paradigmatic Hatano-Nelson model in the arena of non-Hermitian quantum systems. For the disordered model, we show that the distribution of the EP location $g^*$ across disorder realizations develops a universal edge singularity precisely at the clean-system EP, and is manifestly non-self-averaging. Across all models, we find that at the EP, the usual exponential relaxation of the autocorrelation and covariance functions is dressed by a polynomial-in-time prefactor whose degree is set by the order of the EP and whose detailed structure encodes the spatial architecture of the chain. At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits ``pseudo-equilibrium'': its steady-state distribution factorizes into equilibrium-like single-particle measures despite a nonzero steady-state current. Moreover, the $N$-particle interacting system decomposes into $N/2$ independent complex OU processes. Finally, using the Harada-Sasa relation, we obtain a closed-form expression for the total steady-state heat dissipation and uncover a boundary refrigeration effect, in which the boundary particles switch from acting as a hot to a cold reservoir as the non-reciprocity is tuned.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：模型提出、理论框架（Harada-Sasa relation）、解析推导。；研究对象：非互易相互作用的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程（NROU模型）层级体系，包括非互易耦合二聚体、无序对应体，以及可精确映射到Hatano-Nelson模型的多体链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非互易参数g=g*处漂移矩阵不可对角化，实现不同阶数的例外点（EP），此时本征值和本征矢同时合并；在EP处弛豫由指数形式变为带多项式时间前因子的反常弛豫；完全不对称时多体链呈现“赝平衡”稳态，并发现边界制冷效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非互易参数g=g*处漂移矩阵不可对角化，实现不同阶数的例外点（EP），此时本征值和本征矢同时合并；在EP处弛豫由指数形式变为带多项式时间前因子的反常弛豫；完全不对称时多体链呈现“赝平衡”稳态，并发现边界制冷效应。；创新点：建立了从二聚体到无序体系再到多体链的统一NROU层级，揭示了无序模型中EP位置分布的普适边缘奇异性（非自平均行为），并首次在非互易OU过程中发现边界制冷效应（边界粒子随非互易强度调谐从热库转变为冷库）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导：构建可调非互易参数g的NROU模型层级，利用漂移矩阵对角化/非对角化分析例外点结构，结合Harada-Sasa关系推导稳态热耗散的闭式表达式。

papers.title: Customized spin spirals in ferromagnetic thin films
papers.abstract: The advancement of spintronic nanoscale devices hinges on the ability to flexibly engineer magnetic spin structures in thin-film stacks with precision and control. Meeting this demand remains a challenge for stable non-collinear spin configurations and, more specifically, vertical spin spirals in thin films. Innovative methods are required for their fabrication, stabilization and control. Here, we use oblique-incidence deposition to design and stabilize vertical spin spirals at room temperature and without an external field in magnetic thin films. We induce two crossed uniaxial magnetic anisotropies at the thin film boundaries. These anisotropies are tunable in direction and strength, thus providing control over the angular range and depth profile of the resulting spin spiral. The combination of polarized neutron reflectometry and nuclear resonant scattering enables precise and direct determination of the depth-dependent spin configurations. Our results establish a single-film design approach, in which the surface anisotropies independently serve as controllable design parameters for tailoring the vertical spin-spiral profile. Potential applications include nanoscale energy-storage devices, magnetic sensors, and ferromagnetic-resonance filters, advancing all-spin-based device engineering in general.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要提及“oblique-incidence deposition”（斜入射沉积）、“polarized neutron reflectometry”（极化中子反射）和“nuclear resonant scattering”（核共振散射）等实验手段。；研究对象：铁磁薄膜中的垂直自旋螺旋（vertical spin spirals），具体为通过斜入射沉积在薄膜边界引入交叉单轴磁各向异性来设计和稳定的非共线磁结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过斜入射沉积在铁磁薄膜中诱导两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性，可在室温、无外场条件下稳定垂直自旋螺旋，且螺旋的角度范围和深度分布可通过各向异性的方向和强度进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过斜入射沉积在铁磁薄膜中诱导两个交叉的单轴磁各向异性，可在室温、无外场条件下稳定垂直自旋螺旋，且螺旋的角度范围和深度分布可通过各向异性的方向和强度进行调控。；创新点：提出了一种单膜设计方法，将薄膜表面各向异性作为独立可控的设计参数来定制垂直自旋螺旋的轮廓，无需多层堆叠或外场辅助即可实现室温稳定。摘要未突出说明与已有垂直螺旋制备方法的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：斜入射沉积（制备薄膜）、极化中子反射（PNR）和核共振散射（NRS），两者结合用于直接精确测定随深度变化的自旋构型。

papers.title: Molecular interfacial rheology: Lipid membrane shear viscosity
papers.abstract: We develop a method to extract the shear viscosity of a lipid membrane from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. The method characterizes the rheology of general interfacial systems embedded in three-dimensional media; we term it molecular interfacial rheology. In our simulations the planar bilayer and surrounding water are confined between solid, parallel walls. Following Onsager's regression hypothesis, membrane and water fluctuations are assumed to relax according to the coupled continuum-mechanical equations governing the confined system---which predict that the membrane transverse velocity autocorrelation function (TVACF) decays exponentially, at a rate set by the membrane and water viscosities. The measured TVACF, however, exhibits damped oscillations followed by a slowly decaying tail. We reconcile these behaviors using the Mori--Zwanzig formalism, and extract the wavevector-dependent membrane viscosity from the time-integral of the TVACF. Results from theory and simulations agree over a decade of wavevectors, and extrapolating to long wavelengths yields shear viscosities ranging from 0.064 to 0.18 pN*us/nm across two representative single-component, fluid-phase bilayers. Our results are corroborated by nonequilibrium simulations where a spatially varying in-plane body force is applied to lipid molecules, thus validating the framework of molecular interfacial rheology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合型文章。判断依据：关键词为“molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）、“Mori–Zwanzig formalism”（Mori–Zwanzig形式理论）、“theory and simulations agree”（理论与模拟一致）。；研究对象：脂质双分子层膜（lipid bilayer membrane）及其周围水环境构成的界面体系，具体研究膜剪切黏度（shear viscosity）这一界面流变学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过平衡态分子动力学模拟中膜横向速度自相关函数（TVACF）的时间积分，可提取波矢依赖的膜剪切黏度；外推至长波长极限，两种代表性单组分流体相双分子层的剪切黏度范围为0.064–0.18 pN·μs/nm，且与非平衡模拟结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过平衡态分子动力学模拟中膜横向速度自相关函数（TVACF）的时间积分，可提取波矢依赖的膜剪切黏度；外推至长波长极限，两种代表性单组分流体相双分子层的剪切黏度范围为0.064–0.18 pN·μs/nm，且与非平衡模拟结果一致。；创新点：提出“分子界面流变学”（molecular interfacial rheology）这一通用框架，用于从平衡态模拟中提取三维介质中嵌入的界面体系的剪切黏度，并成功将连续介质流变学描述推广至分子尺度，理论与模拟在跨越一个量级的波矢范围内吻合。
papers.method_zh: 平衡态分子动力学模拟（平面双分子层与水被限制在平行固体壁之间）；基于Onsager回归假说，将膜与水的涨落弛豫与耦合连续介质力学方程对照；采用Mori–Zwanzig形式论解释TVACF的阻尼振荡与慢衰减尾部；辅以非平衡模拟（对脂质分子施加空间变化的面内体力）进行验证。

papers.title: Remote epitaxy beyond polarity
papers.abstract: Remote epitaxy through a monolayer two-dimensional material-covered substrate establishes a crystallographic registry across the van der Waals (vdW) surface that enables the epitaxial growth, lift-off and transfer of single-crystalline films. A central belief in remote epitaxy is that the substrate facilitating the phenomenon must be a material with strong ionicity, as the interatomic electrostatic potential fluctuation in covalent and metallic materials is substantially attenuated by two-dimensional materials. Here, we show remote epitaxy is possible when the substrate is a metallic or covalently bonded material and experimentally demonstrate non-polar remote homo- and heteroepitaxy across a wide range of material systems, including both metals and semiconductors. The achieved non-polar remote interactions are designed and engineered by harnessing substrate conductivity and vicinal surface step-edge density. These findings indicate that remote epitaxy is universal and applicable to ionic, metallic, and covalent materials, expanding its capabilities and stimulating a plethora of new fundamental scientific questions about the mechanism of remote epitaxy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we show”“experimentally demonstrate”等表述，属于实验验证性研究。；研究对象：远程外延（remote epitaxy）现象，具体研究在金属和共价键合衬底上（而非传统强离子性衬底）实现非极性远程同质/异质外延，涵盖金属与半导体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 远程外延并非仅限于强离子性衬底，在金属或共价键合衬底上同样可以实现，表明该现象具有普适性，适用于离子、金属和共价材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：远程外延并非仅限于强离子性衬底，在金属或共价键合衬底上同样可以实现，表明该现象具有普适性，适用于离子、金属和共价材料。；创新点：突破了此前认为远程外延必须依赖强离子性衬底（如离子晶体）的认知局限，首次实验证明金属和共价材料也能作为远程外延的衬底，并将远程外延的适用范围从极性体系拓展至非极性体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法，具体包括：利用单层二维材料覆盖衬底实现远程外延生长；通过调控衬底导电性和邻晶面台阶边缘密度来设计和工程化非极性远程相互作用。摘要未明确说明具体生长技术（如MBE或MOCVD）及表征手段。

papers.title: How dipolar interactions structure molecular droplets
papers.abstract: We investigate how dipolar interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules structure the self-bound droplets formed under variation of the interaction strength. We identify the transition from droplets to crystals as a finite-size first order transition. With droplet-ring states and transitional supersolid states we predict additional structure in the crystal and droplet phases, respectively. To describe this strongly correlated regime, and in particular the reconfiguration of quantum ground states, we design a variational Monte Carlo framework based on neural quantum states. It is especially suitable to describe ground states and almost degenerate states with very different configurations. Moreover, one can easily determine the superfluid fraction. Our results reveal the sequence of finite-size structures through which dipolar interactions reorganize molecular droplets into crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“variational Monte Carlo framework based on neural quantum states”（基于神经量子态的变分蒙特卡洛框架），属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：微波屏蔽的极性分子（microwave-shielded polar molecules）在相互作用强度变化下形成的自束缚液滴（self-bound droplets），以及液滴向晶体转变过程中的有限尺寸结构（droplet-ring states、supersolid states）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 极性分子液滴在相互作用强度变化下经历从液滴到晶体的有限尺寸一级相变（finite-size first order transition），并出现液滴环态和过渡性超固态等额外结构，揭示了偶极相互作用将分子液滴重组为晶体的有限尺寸结构序列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：极性分子液滴在相互作用强度变化下经历从液滴到晶体的有限尺寸一级相变（finite-size first order transition），并出现液滴环态和过渡性超固态等额外结构，揭示了偶极相互作用将分子液滴重组为晶体的有限尺寸结构序列。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于：利用神经量子态变分蒙特卡洛方法处理强关联偶极分子体系，能够描述基态与近简并态的不同构型重排，并可直接计算超流分数，从而预测液滴环态和过渡超固态等新结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于神经量子态（neural quantum states）的变分蒙特卡洛（variational Monte Carlo）框架，用于描述强关联基态及近简并态，并可计算超流分数（superfluid fraction）。

papers.title: Breakdown of Anomalous Hall Scaling in Dilute Kondo System
papers.abstract: The confluence of strong electronic correlations and Berry curvature-driven transport constitutes a largely underexplored frontier in quantum materials research, particularly in systems where electronic correlations arise from flat-band physics rather than conventional $f$-electron states. Here, we report an intrinsic Berry curvature driven anomalous Hall transport in the dilute Kondo system Ru$_2$Mn$_{0.5}$Ti$_{0.5}$Ge, a non-$f$-electron Heusler alloy hosting flat bands with van Hove singularity proximate to the Fermi level. The anomalous Hall response is strikingly non-monotonic, violating the Fermi-liquid scaling relation near the magnetic transition and is restored only at low temperature, coincident with the onset of Kondo coherence. \textit{Ab initio} calculations strongly establish that the Berry curvature originates from the Kondo hybridization induced interplay of flat bands and spin-orbit coupling mediated anticrossings at the Fermi level. Our findings demonstrate that Kondo coherence of flat bands bears a profound impact on Berry curvature associated ferroic responses, mandating a rigorous theoretical understanding of anomalous transport in the regime where reciprocal space topology and strong correlations are intrinsically intertwined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“报告……反常霍尔输运”（实验测量）与“Ab initio calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：非f电子Heusler合金 Ru₂Mn₀.₅Ti₀.₅Ge，一种稀磁近藤（dilute Kondo）体系，其费米能级附近存在具有范霍夫奇点的平带。研究聚焦于该体系中由内禀贝里曲率驱动的反常霍尔输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在该稀近藤体系中，反常霍尔响应呈显著非单调行为，在磁转变附近违反费米液体标度关系，仅在低温下（伴随近藤相干性出现）恢复标度。第一性原理计算表明，贝里曲率源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合介导的费米能级反交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在该稀近藤体系中，反常霍尔响应呈显著非单调行为，在磁转变附近违反费米液体标度关系，仅在低温下（伴随近藤相干性出现）恢复标度。第一性原理计算表明，贝里曲率源于近藤杂化诱导的平带与自旋轨道耦合介导的费米能级反交叉。；创新点：首次在非f电子平带近藤体系中揭示近藤相干性对贝里曲率关联铁性响应的深刻影响，将强关联（平带近藤物理）与倒空间拓扑输运（贝里曲率）内在关联起来，拓展了反常霍尔效应研究至平带强关联领域。（摘要未突出说明具体实验技术细节，如样品生长方法或测量装置。）
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量了反常霍尔输运（温度依赖的非单调响应及标度关系检验）；理论上采用第一性原理（Ab initio）计算，分析贝里曲率来源及能带反交叉结构。

papers.title: Fluctuations of a Photon Bose-Einstein Condensate Coupled to a Reservoir: Describing Coherence Properties in a Free-Energy Model
papers.abstract: Photons are mutually nearly noninteracting particles, so thermalized photon ensembles are commonly obtained not from direct particle-particle-interactions but rather from contact with matter, which can constitute a reservoir for the photon gas. We develop a theory model for photons in a material-filled (e.g. liquid dye) optical microcavity, with the aim to study the fluctuation properties using a free-energy description for noninteracting photons coupled to a reservoir of material electronic excitations. To begin with, we use a single mode description for the condensate. For a small relative size of the material reservoir, corresponding to the canonical regime, condensate number fluctuations are small, and the derived free energy landscape takes the usual Mexican-hat shaped form such that spontaneous symmetry breaking occurs. In contrast, for a large relative size of the reservoir, corresponding to the grand canonical regime, fluctuations become as large as the average particle number. We show that the resulting free energy landscape acquires a bowl-shaped form, with a single minimum at the origin. Thus, a macroscopic occupation of the ground state (i.e., Bose-Einstein condensation) in the absence of spontaneous symmetry breaking is expected. We also provide a model for the treatment of a photon gas trapped in a box-shaped potential with spatially distributed coupling to a reservoir. The model predicts, for example, a statistically fluctuating pattern of islands with long-range coherence, resembling transient microcondensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theory model、free-energy description、model for the treatment。；研究对象：填充材料（如液态染料）的光学微腔中的光子气体，特别是光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体与材料电子激发库耦合时的涨落与相干性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当材料库相对尺寸较小（正则系综）时，凝聚体数涨落小，自由能景观呈墨西哥帽形，自发对称破缺发生；当库相对尺寸较大（巨正则系综）时，涨落可与平均粒子数相当，自由能景观变为碗形（原点处单一极小），从而可在无自发对称破缺的情况下实现基态的宏观占据（玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。此外，盒形势阱中空间分布库耦合的光子气体会出现具有长程相干的统计涨落“岛”状图案，类似瞬态微凝聚体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当材料库相对尺寸较小（正则系综）时，凝聚体数涨落小，自由能景观呈墨西哥帽形，自发对称破缺发生；当库相对尺寸较大（巨正则系综）时，涨落可与平均粒子数相当，自由能景观变为碗形（原点处单一极小），从而可在无自发对称破缺的情况下实现基态的宏观占据（玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）。此外，盒形势阱中空间分布库耦合的光子气体会出现具有长程相干的统计涨落“岛”状图案，类似瞬态微凝聚体。；创新点：将光子凝聚体的涨落性质与材料库的相对尺寸（正则 vs 巨正则系综）直接联系起来，并指出在巨正则极限下玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚可以发生在无自发对称破缺的情况下；同时提出了空间非均匀库耦合下瞬态微凝聚体图案的理论描述。摘要未突出说明与既有理论框架（如标准光子BEC涨落理论）的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于自由能模型的理论推导：先采用单模描述处理凝聚体，再推广到盒形势阱中与库空间分布耦合的多模情形。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法或实验手段。

papers.title: Connecting heterogeneous dynamics with local entropy
papers.abstract: Establishing a robust and physically interpretable link between static structure and heterogeneous relaxation dynamics remains a fundamental challenge in glass physics. Here, we introduce a weighted pair-entropy descriptor based on the conventional two-body excess entropy. For this, we multiply the integrand used to calculate the excess entropy by a weight function that is directly related to the length scale of the pair correlation function. This multiplication does not affect the contribution of the short range order to the local excess entropy, but allows to take into account the structure present on intermediate distances, i.e., the medium-range order. For a canonical two-dimensional Lennard-Jones glass former, the resulting descriptor exhibits a strong correlation with particle-level dynamical propensity at long times (multiples of the alpha-relaxation time), with a maximum structure--dynamics correlation reaching about 0.9, substantially outperforming the predictive power of the conventional local pair excess entropy. These results demonstrate that incorporating a physically motivated structural length scale into entropy-based descriptors markedly enhances their predictive power while preserving physical interpretability. Our findings provide a simple and general framework for investigating structure--dynamics correlations in glass-forming systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“引入描述符”“计算”“相关性”等表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维 Lennard-Jones 玻璃形成体系中的结构与动力学关联，具体关注玻璃态材料中静态结构与异质弛豫动力学之间的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于加权对熵的结构描述符，其与粒子级动力学倾向性在长时间尺度（α弛豫时间的倍数）上的相关性最高可达约0.9，显著优于传统局部对超额熵的预测能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于加权对熵的结构描述符，其与粒子级动力学倾向性在长时间尺度（α弛豫时间的倍数）上的相关性最高可达约0.9，显著优于传统局部对超额熵的预测能力。；创新点：将物理上有动机的结构长度尺度纳入熵基描述符，在不牺牲物理可解释性的前提下大幅提升结构-动力学关联的预测能力，为玻璃体系中的结构-动力学关联研究提供了简单且通用的框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用加权对熵描述符方法：在传统两体超额熵的积分中引入与对关联函数长度尺度直接相关的权重函数，从而保留短程有序贡献并纳入中程有序结构信息。研究对象为二维 Lennard-Jones 玻璃模型，通过分子模拟计算动力学倾向性并评估结构-动力学相关性。

papers.title: Diffusion under competing bulk and surface stopping mechanisms
papers.abstract: We investigate reflected diffusion in a bounded domain subject to two independent, competing stopping mechanisms: an exponentially distributed bulk lifetime of rate $p$ and a surface reaction triggered when the boundary local time exceeds an independent exponential threshold of rate $q$. Denoting by $T$ the stopping time and by $L$ the acquired boundary local time at stopping, we derive their marginal distributions, joint Laplace transform, and complete hierarchy of mixed moments. These statistics are determined by the splitting probability $φ$ that surface reaction occurs before bulk decay. In particular, we establish the identity $p\expect{T}+q\expect{L}=1$ and show that the cumulative risk $pT+qL$ is exponentially distributed with unit rate. We further obtain equivalent representations of $φ$ in terms of the Robin-Laplacian and the generalized Steklov spectra. Explicit results for a three-dimensional ball reveal how competing rates $p,q$ control $φ$ and the $(T,L)$ statistics. Monte Carlo simulations test the universal cumulative-risk law.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导（边际分布、联合拉普拉斯变换、混合矩）、谱理论（Robin-Laplacian、广义Steklov谱）以及蒙特卡洛模拟验证，属于随机过程与扩散理论的建模分析。；研究对象：有界域内受反射的扩散过程，其停止机制由两种竞争过程控制：体相指数寿命（速率p）与边界局域时超过独立指数阈值（速率q）触发的表面反应。物理背景可对应粒子在体相衰变与边界反应之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了恒等式 \( p\mathbb{E}\{T\}+q\mathbb{E}\{L\}=1 \)，并证明累积风险 \( pT+qL \) 服从单位速率的指数分布（普适累积风险律）。该律通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了恒等式 \( p\mathbb{E}\{T\}+q\mathbb{E}\{L\}=1 \)，并证明累积风险 \( pT+qL \) 服从单位速率的指数分布（普适累积风险律）。该律通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到验证。；创新点：首次系统刻画了体相衰变与表面反应两种竞争停止机制下，停止时间T与边界局域时L的联合统计性质，并揭示了累积风险 \( pT+qL \) 的普适指数分布律。摘要未突出说明与具体物理体系（如胶体、活性粒子或化学反应扩散）的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 随机分析（反射扩散、边界局域时、停止时间理论）、拉普拉斯变换与矩生成函数推导、Robin-Laplacian与广义Steklov谱表示、三维球体的显式解析计算、蒙特卡洛模拟。

papers.title: Robustness of RKKY interactions across a Weyl node-annihilation transition
authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
papers.abstract: Weyl semimetals (WSMs), with their unique topological properties and distinct electronic structure, exhibit intriguing properties when either time-reversal or inversion symmetries are broken. In this work, we consider the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction between magnetic impurities in time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSMs. We derive analytical expressions for the full RKKY exchange tensor in arbitrary two-band spinful lattice systems. Our approach reveals both Heisenberg, anisotropic Ising and Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya terms, which can be calculated by energy-integrating real-space Green's functions across the entire Brillouin zone, with the band edge acting as a natural energy cutoff. We apply this framework to study a two-band tight-binding model for a time-reversal symmetry-breaking WSM that interpolates between a Weyl phase with well-separated chiral nodes and a quadratic band-touching semimetal phase. Remarkably, the spatial profile, magnitude, and anisotropic tensor structure of the exchange couplings remain persistent across the node-annihilation transition. This topological robustness reveals that short- and intermediate-range RKKY interactions are mediated by the global, Brillouin-zone-integrated quantum metric of the full valence band rather than being strictly dictated by local low-energy Berry curvature monopoles. These findings demonstrate the necessity of full-band tight-binding formulations when predicting real-space magnetic interactions, providing key insights for electric-field tuning of magnetic anisotropy and constructing realistic models of heavy-fermion and Weyl-Kondo semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“推导解析表达式”“通过能量积分实空间格林函数”“应用框架研究紧束缚模型”等理论推导与模型计算关键词。；研究对象：时间反演对称性破缺的Weyl半金属中磁性杂质之间的RKKY相互作用，以及Weyl节点湮灭相变（从具有分离手性节点的Weyl相到二次能带接触半金属相）过程中交换耦合的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RKKY交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在Weyl节点湮灭相变前后保持稳健不变，表明短程和中程RKKY相互作用由整个价带的布里渊区积分量子度量（全局能带几何性质）主导，而非局域低能Berry曲率磁单极子决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RKKY交换耦合的空间分布、大小和各向异性张量结构在Weyl节点湮灭相变前后保持稳健不变，表明短程和中程RKKY相互作用由整个价带的布里渊区积分量子度量（全局能带几何性质）主导，而非局域低能Berry曲率磁单极子决定。；创新点：揭示了RKKY相互作用在拓扑相变（Weyl节点湮灭）中的拓扑鲁棒性，并明确指出全带紧束缚描述（而非低能有效模型）对于预测真实空间磁相互作用的必要性；为电场调控磁各向异性及构建重费米子/Weyl-Kondo半金属的现实模型提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 推导了任意两带自旋晶格系统中完整RKKY交换张量的解析表达式（包含Heisenberg、各向异性Ising和Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya项），通过在整个布里渊区对实空间格林函数进行能量积分计算，以能带边缘作为自然能量截断。将该框架应用于一个两带紧束缚模型，该模型可插值描述时间反演对称性破缺的Weyl相与二次能带接触半金属相。

papers.title: Coarse-graining far-from-equilibrium dynamics using oblique projectors
papers.abstract: We generalize the Mori-Zwanzig projection operator formalism by introducing an oblique projector using biorthogonal variables to coarse-grain the dynamics of systems far from equilibrium, such as active or living matter. Improving on previously used orthogonal projectors, the oblique projector correctly decomposes the emergent interactions of the coarse-grained particles into systematic and stochastic contributions. We show that the formalism directly connects to established results in non-equilibrium linear response theory and adiabatic perturbation theory. Based on this formalism, we develop a coarse-graining algorithm which we apply to extract the emergent non-equilibrium chiral dynamics of a passive tracer in a chiral active bath. Our theory correctly predicts the odd transport properties and a confinement-induced shift of the chiral frequency of the tracer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“generalize the Mori-Zwanzig projection operator formalism”“develop a coarse-graining algorithm”，属于理论推导与算法构建，未涉及实验或具体数值模拟细节。；研究对象：远离平衡态体系的粗粒化动力学，具体应用对象为“chiral active bath”（手性活性浴）中的“passive tracer”（被动示踪粒子），属于活性物质/软物质非平衡统计物理范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用双正交变量构造的斜投影算子能正确地将粗粒化粒子间的涌现相互作用分解为系统性与随机性贡献，并成功预测了示踪粒子的奇输运性质以及由约束引起的手性频率移动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用双正交变量构造的斜投影算子能正确地将粗粒化粒子间的涌现相互作用分解为系统性与随机性贡献，并成功预测了示踪粒子的奇输运性质以及由约束引起的手性频率移动。；创新点：首次将斜投影算子（而非正交投影算子）引入 Mori-Zwanzig 形式用于远离平衡态体系的粗粒化，解决了正交投影在非平衡条件下无法正确分解系统性与随机性贡献的问题；同时建立了该形式与非平衡线性响应理论及绝热微扰理论的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为广义 Mori-Zwanzig 投影算子形式，创新性地引入基于双正交变量的斜投影算子（oblique projector）替代以往的正交投影算子；并基于该形式发展了一套粗粒化算法，应用于手性活性浴中被动示踪粒子的非平衡动力学分析。

papers.title: Dynamical Reduction of Two Series Josephson Junctions to a Synthetic High-Transparency Josephson Element
papers.abstract: Two conventional Josephson junctions connected in series can reproduce, in the static limit in which the currents through the capacitive and resistive channels are negligible, the current-phase relation of a single effective weak link with tunable transparency. Therefore, the two-junction series can be treated as a single synthetic high-transparency element. Here, we investigate to what extent this mapping remains valid under finite-frequency drive and retaining the junctions' resistive and capacitive terms. The full resistively and capacitively shunted junction equations are compared with an effective synthetic element with tunable transparency that retains the synthetic tunable-transparency current-phase relation together with effective capacitive and dissipative terms, thus reducing the two second order degree of freedom system to a single second order degree of freedom. The resulting single-element dynamics is compared with the complete two-junction system under ac excitation. The agreement is quantified through a normalized root-mean-square error between the full and effective voltage waveforms. A broad low-error region is found at low drive frequency, while pronounced deviations emerge as the drive frequency approaches the relevant plasma-frequency scale and at larger drive amplitudes. The results provide a quantitative dynamical criterion for using the reduced single-element description of a synthetic high-transparency Josephson element in superconducting circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“full resistively and capacitively shunted junction equations are compared with an effective synthetic element”，以及“normalized root-mean-square error”等数值比较，属于基于电路方程的理论建模与数值模拟。；研究对象：研究对象为两个串联的传统约瑟夫森结（two conventional Josephson junctions connected in series），在有限频率驱动下，其动力学行为是否可等效为一个具有可调透明度的合成高透明约瑟夫森元件（synthetic high-transparency Josephson element）。涉及超导电路中的弱连接动力学与等效电路约化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在静态极限下，两个串联约瑟夫森结可等效为单个可调透明度的有效弱连接；但在有限频率驱动下，该映射仅在低驱动频率和较小驱动幅度下成立，当驱动频率接近等离子体频率尺度或驱动幅度增大时，会出现显著偏差。研究给出了该约化单元件描述适用的定量动力学判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在静态极限下，两个串联约瑟夫森结可等效为单个可调透明度的有效弱连接；但在有限频率驱动下，该映射仅在低驱动频率和较小驱动幅度下成立，当驱动频率接近等离子体频率尺度或驱动幅度增大时，会出现显著偏差。研究给出了该约化单元件描述适用的定量动力学判据。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异，但明确指出其新意在于：将静态极限下已知的两结串联到单高透明元件的映射推广到有限频率动力学情形，并首次定量给出该约化描述在动态驱动下的适用范围和失效条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用电阻-电容并联分流约瑟夫森结（RCSJ）模型，写出完整的两结串联动力学方程（两个二阶自由度），并将其与一个包含有效电容、耗散项和可调透明度电流-相位关系的单元件等效方程（一个二阶自由度）进行对比。在交流激励下比较完整系统与约化系统的电压波形，用归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）量化两者一致性，扫描驱动频率与幅度以确定误差区域。

papers.title: Electrostatic splitting of an Edge Magnetoplasmon Resonator
papers.abstract: Edge-magnetoplasmon resonators have been proposed as a powerful tool to detect anyons by introducing a quantum point contact into an isolated quantum Hall system probed via radiofrequency radiation. In this paper, we study the effect of a quantum point contact embedded within an edge-magnetoplasmon resonator and how its polarization influences the propagating magnetoplasmonic mode. Combining dc and rf measurements, we unambiguously evidence the signature of both integer ($ν= 1$ and $2$) and fractional quantum Hall states ($ν= 4/3$ and $2/3$) within the radiofrequency transmission signal. Using electrostatic gating, we determine the physical parameters characterizing the electrostatic edge of an AlGaAs/GaAs based two-dimensional electron gas. We extract the dependence of the cavity perimeter with the gate voltage of the quantum point contact and fully characterize the path followed by edge magnetoplasmons in this system. Finally, we provide a geometric model in good agreement with experimental results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Combining dc and rf measurements”（结合直流与射频测量），属于实验手段。；研究对象：基于AlGaAs/GaAs二维电子气的边缘磁等离子体谐振器，其中嵌入一个量子点接触，研究其在整数（ν=1, 2）和分数量子霍尔态（ν=4/3, 2/3）下的静电调控行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过直流与射频联合测量，在射频透射信号中清晰观测到整数和分数量子霍尔态的指纹；并利用静电门控定量提取了腔体周长随量子点接触栅压的变化关系，完整表征了边缘磁等离子体的传播路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过直流与射频联合测量，在射频透射信号中清晰观测到整数和分数量子霍尔态的指纹；并利用静电门控定量提取了腔体周长随量子点接触栅压的变化关系，完整表征了边缘磁等离子体的传播路径。；创新点：首次在嵌入量子点接触的边缘磁等离子体谐振器中，同时通过射频信号明确分辨出ν=4/3和2/3等分数量子霍尔态，并系统量化了静电边缘的物理参数及腔体周长对栅压的依赖关系。摘要未突出说明与以往任何子探测方案的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 直流（dc）输运测量与射频（rf）透射测量相结合；利用静电门控（electrostatic gating）调控量子点接触，提取边缘静电参数；构建几何模型与实验数据对比。

papers.title: Ni-O hybridization as a stabilizer for $s^{\pm}$ superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$: a DFT+RPA study
authors: Luis G. G. V. Dias da Silva
papers.abstract: The superconducting gap symmetry of high-pressure bilayer nickelates remains under debate, with weak- and strong-coupling approaches yielding different pairing tendencies. In this work, we investigate how the weak-coupling treatment of electronic states away from the Fermi level influences magnetic fluctuations and superconductivity in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. We employ a full-spectrum model based on orthonormalized projections of Kohn-Sham states onto local Ni-$e_g$ orbitals, which preserves the density-functional band structure while redistributing spectral weight over a wide energy range. Compared to a low-energy description, this approach yields enhanced interlayer spin fluctuations and a commensurate magnetic instability. Within a spin-fluctuation framework, these features favor a sign-changing $s^\pm$ superconducting state, whereas low-energy models tend to stabilize $d$-wave pairing. Our results suggest that interlayer coupling in full-energy models may play an important role in shaping the predicted pairing symmetry of bilayer nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：DFT+RPA、基于Kohn-Sham态的正交投影模型、自旋涨落框架等关键词。；研究对象：高压双层镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇的超导能隙对称性，特别是远离费米面的电子态对磁涨落和配对对称性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用全谱模型（保留DFT能带结构并在宽能量范围内重新分配谱权重）时，层间自旋涨落增强并出现共度磁不稳定性，在自旋涨落机制下倾向于符号反转的s±超导态；而低能模型则倾向于d波配对。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用全谱模型（保留DFT能带结构并在宽能量范围内重新分配谱权重）时，层间自旋涨落增强并出现共度磁不稳定性，在自旋涨落机制下倾向于符号反转的s±超导态；而低能模型则倾向于d波配对。；创新点：首次系统考察了远离费米面的电子态（全谱范围）对双层镍酸盐配对对称性的影响，揭示了全能量模型中层间耦合对配对对称性预测的关键作用，为弱耦合与强耦合方法给出不同配对倾向的争议提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: DFT+RPA（密度泛函理论+随机相位近似）；基于Ni-eg局域轨道对Kohn-Sham态进行正交归一化投影构建全谱模型，并与低能有效模型对比。

papers.title: Markov chains at the onset of non-reversibility
papers.abstract: For a one-dimensional path graph and a lifted path graph constructed from a duplication of each of its sites, we study how a reversible Markov chain can be perturbed and gradually driven into non-reversibility. The reversible Markov chain has a transition matrix that is diagonalizable and features real-valued eigenvalues and eigenvectors. The left and right eigenvectors form a biorthogonal system. We discuss in concrete examples how the transition matrix of a non-reversible Markov chain may be diagonalizable or non-diagonalizable, and it may have real eigenvalues and complex-conjugate pairs. For a number of steady states (flat, square-wave, wedge, V-shape), we compute eigenvalue spectra on both graphs and discuss the speedup that can be achieved through lifting. We develop a Green's matrix formalism, which we use to compute Kemeny times and mean first-passage times, and which provides valuable information and allows us to interpret the results for the characteristic times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/数学物理文章。判断依据：摘要讨论马尔可夫链的转移矩阵性质、特征值谱、Green矩阵形式等，属于随机过程与统计物理的理论分析，无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：一维路径图及其“提升路径图”（每个位点复制一份）上的马尔可夫链，重点研究可逆马尔可夫链被微扰后逐渐进入不可逆区域的临界行为（onset of non-reversibility）。物理背景对应非平衡稳态下的随机动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非可逆性起始点附近，不可逆马尔可夫链的转移矩阵既可能可对角化也可能不可对角化，特征值可为实数或复共轭对；通过“提升”（lifting）可加速弛豫（缩短特征时间），且Green矩阵形式可统一计算Kemeny时间与平均首达时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非可逆性起始点附近，不可逆马尔可夫链的转移矩阵既可能可对角化也可能不可对角化，特征值可为实数或复共轭对；通过“提升”（lifting）可加速弛豫（缩短特征时间），且Green矩阵形式可统一计算Kemeny时间与平均首达时间。；创新点：系统刻画了可逆→不可逆马尔可夫链转变点附近的谱结构（可对角化与不可对角化、实特征值与复共轭对共存），并引入Green矩阵形式统一处理特征时间，为理解提升马尔可夫链的加速机制提供了新工具。摘要未突出说明与具体物理体系的直接对应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：转移矩阵谱分析（左/右本征矢构成双正交系统）；具体构造了平坦、方波、楔形、V形等多种稳态分布，在两种图上解析/半解析计算特征值谱；发展了Green矩阵形式，用于计算Kemeny时间与平均首达时间。

papers.title: Dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states in a spin-1 triangular antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: We present a systematic numerical study of the spin-1 antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the triangular lattice in an out-of-plane magnetic field, using Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) methods. By mapping out the quantum phase diagram as a function of the single-ion anisotropy $D_z$ and magnetic field, we identify distinct dipolar and quadrupolar spin supersolid states, characterized by spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking with finite spin superfluid stiffness coexisting with longitudinal translational symmetry breaking. At zero field, the dipolar spin supersolid with a 'Y'-type spin configuration persists down to $D_z = 0$, whereas the quadrupolar spin supersolid prevails at large $D_z$. At intermediate fields, the phase diagram is dominated by an up-up-down phase. At high fields below saturation, a quadrupolar spin superfluid emerges in the large-$D_z$ regime, whereas a dipolar spin supersolid with a 'V'-type spin configuration dominates at small $D_z$. These phases are characterized through their order parameters and spin superfluid stiffness using calculations on various system sizes. Furthermore, the dynamical spin structure factor is obtained across the phase diagram, where characteristic spectral signatures of different phases are observed, including the gapless Goldstone mode and the roton-like minima. These features are directly accessible to inelastic neutron scattering experiments. Our results provide a theoretical understanding of the interplay between frustrations, anisotropy, and Zeeman interactions in driving distinct spin supersolid phases in the spin-1 system, which are relevant to various triangular-lattice antiferromagnets such as Na$_2$BaNi(PO$_4$)$_2$ and K$_2$Ni(SeO$_3$)$_2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG)方法进行系统性数值研究。；研究对象：三角晶格自旋-1反铁磁海森伯模型，在外加垂直磁场下，考虑单离子各向异性D_z的作用。该模型与Na₂BaNi(PO₄)₂和K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂等三角晶格反铁磁材料相关。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋-1三角晶格反铁磁体的相图中，识别出不同的偶极和四极自旋超固态，其特征为自发U(1)对称性破缺（有限自旋超流刚度）与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。零场下，具有“Y”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态可一直持续到D_z=0；大D_z区域则由四极自旋超固态主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋-1三角晶格反铁磁体的相图中，识别出不同的偶极和四极自旋超固态，其特征为自发U(1)对称性破缺（有限自旋超流刚度）与纵向平移对称性破缺共存。零场下，具有“Y”型自旋构型的偶极自旋超固态可一直持续到D_z=0；大D_z区域则由四极自旋超固态主导。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该工作系统揭示了自旋-1体系中阻挫、单离子各向异性与塞曼相互作用共同驱动不同自旋超固态的物理机制，并给出了可直接与非弹性中子散射实验对照的谱学特征。
papers.method_zh: 密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）数值方法。通过在不同系统尺寸上计算序参量和自旋超流刚度来表征各相，并计算动力学自旋结构因子以获取谱学特征。

papers.title: Transparency-engineered SQUID cells for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials
papers.abstract: We introduce a transparency-engineered rf-SQUID cell for Kerr-free three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials. This design replaces the conventional tunnel-junction element with an effective Josephson element formed by two junctions in series, yielding a non-sinusoidal energy-phase relation that can be used as a tunable nonlinear design resource. We show that the asymmetry between the two series junctions and the applied flux bias provide independent control over the local expansion of the rf-SQUID potential, enabling operating points where the leading quartic Kerr term is suppressed while the cubic nonlinearity remains finite. We derive the corresponding Kerr-free condition, identify the resulting operating ridge in parameter space, and analyze the local stability and passive-matching constraints that bound its physically accessible portion. Our results provide a compact unit-cell design principle for three-wave-mixing Josephson metamaterials and suggest a route toward Kerr-suppressed Josephson traveling-wave parametric amplifiers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We introduce”“We show”“We derive”等理论推导表述，且未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：用于三波混频约瑟夫森超材料的射频超导量子干涉器（rf-SQUID）单元，具体为一种经“透明度工程”设计的无Kerr效应单元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将传统隧道结替换为两个串联结形成的有效约瑟夫森结，并利用串联结的不对称性与外加磁通偏置，可独立调控rf-SQUID势能的局域展开系数，从而在保持三次非线性（三波混频）有限的同时抑制四阶Kerr项，实现无Kerr工作点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将传统隧道结替换为两个串联结形成的有效约瑟夫森结，并利用串联结的不对称性与外加磁通偏置，可独立调控rf-SQUID势能的局域展开系数，从而在保持三次非线性（三波混频）有限的同时抑制四阶Kerr项，实现无Kerr工作点。；创新点：提出一种“透明度工程”的单元设计原理，利用非正弦能量-相位关系作为可调非线性设计资源，实现Kerr抑制与三波混频共存，为约瑟夫森行波参量放大器的Kerr抑制提供新路径。摘要未突出说明与具体已有设计的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于rf-SQUID势能的局域泰勒展开，推导Kerr-free条件；在参数空间中识别满足该条件的工作脊线（operating ridge）；对工作点进行局部稳定性分析和无源匹配约束分析。

papers.title: Neural-field design of broadband Rayleigh-wave carpet cloaks under microstructure realisability constraints
papers.abstract: Transformation elasticity provides appropriate material distributions for elastodynamic cloaks but the required stiffness tensors generally violate the minor symmetries of Cauchy elasticity and are difficult to realise using conventional materials. Existing approaches restore these symmetries by modifying the transformed tensor, producing only an approximate cloak. In this work rather than modifying the transformed tensor we seek the best performing cloak within the class of Cauchy materials. We formulate 2D Rayleigh wave carpet cloak design as an optimisation problem governed by partial differential equations. Using a coordinate based neural-field and a differentiable finite element model solver we optimise symmetric stiffness and density fields by minimising wave field distortion. Both single frequency and broadband optimisation are considered, with the broadband model trained over multiple frequencies. Physical realisability is addressed using a database of homogenised microstructures through conditional diffusion, neural-field inverse design, and nearest-neighbour selection. FEM simulations show that the optimised Cauchy design approaches the ideal transformation-based cloak. After projection onto explicit microstructures, the homogenised representation recovers approximately 97% of the defect free reference surface-displacement magnitude, while direct FEM simulation of the fully resolved microstructured geometry recovers approximately 76%
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“优化问题”“有限元模型求解器”“FEM模拟”等计算手段，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：二维瑞利波地毯隐身衣（Rayleigh-wave carpet cloak），具体为弹性波在微结构超材料表面传播时的隐身现象，材料类别为Cauchy弹性材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Cauchy材料类别内直接优化对称刚度与密度场，可获得接近理想变换弹性隐身衣的性能；投影到显式微结构后，均匀化表示恢复约97%的无缺陷参考表面位移幅值，而全分辨微结构几何的直接FEM模拟恢复约76%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Cauchy材料类别内直接优化对称刚度与密度场，可获得接近理想变换弹性隐身衣的性能；投影到显式微结构后，均匀化表示恢复约97%的无缺陷参考表面位移幅值，而全分辨微结构几何的直接FEM模拟恢复约76%。；创新点：不同于以往通过修改变换张量来恢复Cauchy对称性的近似隐身方案，本文直接在Cauchy材料类内寻找最优隐身性能，并引入微结构可实现性约束（条件扩散+逆设计+最近邻投影），实现从连续优化到真实微结构的完整设计流程。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于偏微分方程约束的优化问题；坐标型神经场（coordinate-based neural-field）参数化材料分布；可微有限元求解器用于波场模拟与梯度反传；单频与多频宽带优化；物理可实现性通过均匀化微结构数据库实现，结合条件扩散模型、神经场逆设计和最近邻选择。

papers.title: Glassy dynamics, crossover temperature and density scaling in fragile glass-formers
papers.abstract: We investigate the slowing down of dynamics in a glass-forming mixture interacting via an inverse-power-law (IPL) potential using a combination of theory and large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We measure the static pair-correlation function, configurational entropy, inherent-structure energy, and structural relaxation time. We employ a theoretical framework to calculate the structural relaxation time $τ_α$, which is found to be in very good agreement with the simulation results. The theory identifies a local structural order which defines the cooperativity of the relaxation and brings forth a fluctuation induced parameter $ψ( T )$ and a crossover temperature $T_a$ that characterize the density and temperature dependence of the glassy dynamics. Furthermore, we determine a crossover temperature using independent dynamical and thermodynamic criteria and compare with the theoretically predicted crossover temperature $T_a$. Relaxation dynamics is shown to obey density-temperature scaling, similar to thermodynamic properties, in terms of a variable $Γ$ formed by an appropriate combination of density and temperature, characteristic of IPL interactions. Finally, we show that, when the excess thermodynamic and dynamic quantities obtained at different densities are plotted as functions of the reduced temperature $T/T_a$ (or $T_a/T$), the data collapse onto master curves with excellent agreement between theory and simulation. These scaling relations provide a unified description of the thermodynamics and dynamics in IPL systems, enabling the prediction of relaxation behavior over a wide range of densities from data at a single state point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论 + 大规模分子动力学模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“using a combination of theory and large-scale molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：由逆幂律（IPL）势相互作用的玻璃形成混合物体系，重点研究其玻璃态动力学减速行为、结构弛豫时间、构型熵及密度-温度标度关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 理论计算的弛豫时间与模拟结果高度一致；玻璃态动力学满足由IPL相互作用特征变量Γ决定的密度-温度标度，且以约化温度T/Ta（或Ta/T）为变量时，不同密度下的热力学与动力学过量数据可塌缩至同一主曲线，实现从单一状态点预测宽密度范围的弛豫行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：理论计算的弛豫时间与模拟结果高度一致；玻璃态动力学满足由IPL相互作用特征变量Γ决定的密度-温度标度，且以约化温度T/Ta（或Ta/T）为变量时，不同密度下的热力学与动力学过量数据可塌缩至同一主曲线，实现从单一状态点预测宽密度范围的弛豫行为。；创新点：提出一个能同时统一描述IPL体系热力学与动力学的理论框架，并证明弛豫动力学与热力学性质遵循相同的密度-温度标度，且数据在约化温度下可塌缩为普适主曲线——这为从单一状态点预测宽密度范围的弛豫行为提供了新途径。（摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的差异点。）
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于局域结构序定义弛豫协同性，引入涨落诱导参数ψ(T)及交叉温度Ta来计算结构弛豫时间τα。模拟手段：大规模分子动力学（MD）模拟，测量静态对关联函数、构型熵、固有结构能量及结构弛豫时间。另用独立动力学与热力学判据确定交叉温度并与理论Ta比较。

papers.title: Interfacial Accommodation as a Candidate Ductility Pathway in Intermetallic-Rich Alloys
papers.abstract: Heterophase interfaces are increasingly recognized as active participants in plastic deformation, yet quantitative methods for comparing their strain-accommodation capacity remain limited. Here, we present an atomistic framework for quantifying interface-mediated strain accommodation using molecular dynamics simulations. Interface broadening, roughening, and migration are extracted from atomistic trajectories and combined into an Interface Accommodation Index, with a normalized counterpart accounting for differences in initial interface structure. A weighting sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the relative ranking of interfaces is robust to the specific form of the index. The framework is demonstrated for three experimentally motivated interfaces, Al/Al3Ti, Al/Al9M2, and Al9M2/Al3Ti (M = Fe, Co, Ni), under tensile, compressive, and shear loading. Bulk simulations show that Shockley partial dislocations dominate plastic deformation, with alloy chemistry governing the transition toward mixed-character dislocation networks. Tensile loading produces the greatest interface accommodation, while shear produces comparatively limited structural evolution. The Al9M2/Al3Ti interface exhibits both the highest yield resistance and the largest accommodation response, suggesting that intermetallic-intermetallic interfaces can simultaneously sustain load and redistribute strain. These simulations quantify structural accommodation rather than ductility or fracture directly; their connection to macroscopic ductility therefore requires experimental validation. The framework provides a transferable approach for comparing interface accommodation in multiphase alloys and identifies interface chemistry and crystallography as important design variables for damage-tolerant structural materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“atomistic framework”“molecular dynamics simulations”“atomistic trajectories”，属于原子尺度分子动力学模拟研究。；研究对象：金属间化合物富集合金中的异相界面，具体为三种实验启发的界面体系：Al/Al3Ti、Al/Al9M2 和 Al9M2/Al3Ti（M = Fe, Co, Ni），研究其在拉伸、压缩和剪切加载下的界面介导应变容纳行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个量化界面介导应变容纳的原子尺度框架（Interface Accommodation Index），发现 Al9M2/Al3Ti 金属间化合物-金属间化合物界面同时具有最高的屈服抗力和最大的应变容纳响应，表明该类界面可同时承担载荷并重新分配应变。拉伸加载产生最大的界面容纳效应，而剪切加载引起的结构演化相对有限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个量化界面介导应变容纳的原子尺度框架（Interface Accommodation Index），发现 Al9M2/Al3Ti 金属间化合物-金属间化合物界面同时具有最高的屈服抗力和最大的应变容纳响应，表明该类界面可同时承担载荷并重新分配应变。拉伸加载产生最大的界面容纳效应，而剪切加载引起的结构演化相对有限。；创新点：首次提出一个可迁移的定量框架（Interface Accommodation Index），用于在多相合金中比较不同异相界面的应变容纳能力，并系统揭示了界面化学和晶体学作为损伤容限结构材料设计变量的重要性。摘要未突出说明与以往界面塑性研究相比的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟。从原子轨迹中提取界面展宽（broadening）、粗糙化（roughening）和迁移（migration）三个指标，组合成“界面容纳指数”（Interface Accommodation Index），并引入归一化版本以消除初始界面结构差异；还进行了权重敏感性分析以检验指数形式的稳健性。此外进行了块体（bulk）模拟以对比塑性变形机制。

papers.title: Environment-assisted transport in a strongly correlated boundary-driven Fermi-Hubbard chain
papers.abstract: We study steady-state transport in a one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard chain coupled to particle reservoirs at the boundaries and to local dephasing baths at each site, using the time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) method to solve the Lindblad master equation. In the absence of dephasing, the current exhibits two well-separated maxima as a function of the boundary driving rate, reflecting the distinct charge and spin energy scales of the strongly correlated regime. Upon introducing dephasing, we find two distinct dephasing-induced transport-enhancement regimes, in contrast to the single enhancement previously reported for spinless fermions. Analysis of the non-equilibrium steady state in the Hamiltonian eigenbasis reveals that the two regimes originate from distinct dephasing-induced redistribution processes: the first involves redistribution within the uppermost Hubbard band, while the second involves transitions between Hubbard bands. Our results demonstrate how many-body correlations shape the interplay between coherent driving, dephasing, and quantum Zeno physics in strongly correlated open systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“time-evolving block decimation (TEBD) method”求解Lindblad主方程，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：一维Fermi-Hubbard链，两端耦合粒子库（边界驱动），每个格点耦合局域退相干浴（dephasing baths），研究强关联体系中的稳态输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无退相干时，电流随边界驱动率呈现两个分离的极大值，反映强关联区电荷与自旋能量尺度的差异；引入退相干后，出现两个截然不同的退相干诱导输运增强区间（不同于无自旋费米子中仅有一个增强区间），分别源于Hubbard带内重分布和带间跃迁两种不同的退相干诱导重分布过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无退相干时，电流随边界驱动率呈现两个分离的极大值，反映强关联区电荷与自旋能量尺度的差异；引入退相干后，出现两个截然不同的退相干诱导输运增强区间（不同于无自旋费米子中仅有一个增强区间），分别源于Hubbard带内重分布和带间跃迁两种不同的退相干诱导重分布过程。；创新点：首次在强关联费米体系中揭示退相干诱导输运增强存在两个不同机制区间（带内重分布 vs. 带间跃迁），并阐明多体关联如何调控相干驱动、退相干与量子Zeno效应之间的相互作用。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: TEBD（时间演化块消去）方法求解Lindblad主方程，并在哈密顿量本征基下分析非平衡稳态。

papers.title: Semiclassical thermoelectric transport in disordered Dirac electron system Ag2Te
papers.abstract: We investigated the thermoelectric effects of the Dirac electron system Ag2Te under magnetic field. Our anal-ysis based on the Boltzmann semiclassical model associated the disorder with the unconventional magnetic field responses such as linear magnetoresistance, linear Nernst effect, step-like Nernst effect, and sign change in Nernst effect. The analysis also revealed the impurity band near the Fermi energy. We simultaneously clari-fied the serious impact of the thermal Hall effect on the measurement of the Nernst effect, and we proposed the definitive solution. Our careful measurement and analysis will be the standard for the thermoelectric study under magnetic field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论分析）。判断依据：摘要提到“我们研究了……热电效应”“我们的测量和分析”，同时明确使用“基于玻尔兹曼半经典模型的分析”，属于实验测量与理论建模结合。；研究对象：狄拉克电子体系 Ag₂Te（碲化银）在磁场下的热电输运性质，具体涉及磁电阻、能斯特效应、热霍尔效应以及杂质带等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序狄拉克电子体系 Ag₂Te 中，磁场下的非常规热电输运响应（线性磁电阻、线性能斯特效应、阶梯状能斯特效应及能斯特效应符号反转）可由玻尔兹曼半经典模型结合无序效应统一解释；同时发现费米能附近存在杂质带，并指出热霍尔效应对能斯特效应测量有严重干扰，提出了解决方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序狄拉克电子体系 Ag₂Te 中，磁场下的非常规热电输运响应（线性磁电阻、线性能斯特效应、阶梯状能斯特效应及能斯特效应符号反转）可由玻尔兹曼半经典模型结合无序效应统一解释；同时发现费米能附近存在杂质带，并指出热霍尔效应对能斯特效应测量有严重干扰，提出了解决方案。；创新点：首次将无序狄拉克电子体系 Ag₂Te 的多种非常规磁场响应（线性磁电阻、线性/阶梯状/符号反转的能斯特效应）统一纳入半经典玻尔兹曼框架进行解释，并揭示杂质带在费米能附近的作用；同时明确指出热霍尔效应对能斯特效应测量的系统性干扰并给出消除方案，为磁场下热电测量建立了标准流程。
papers.method_zh: 实验上进行了磁场下的热电输运测量（具体测量手段如电极配置、温度/磁场扫描方式等摘要未明确说明）；理论上采用玻尔兹曼半经典输运模型，将无序（disorder）纳入对磁电阻和能斯特效应的分析中。

papers.title: Anharmonic Lattice Dynamics and Anisotropic Electron-Phonon Coupling in Quasi-1-Dimensional Charge Density Wave Ta2NiSe7
papers.abstract: The microscopic origin of charge density wave formation in quasi one dimensional Ta2NiSe7 remains actively debated, particularly regarding the relative contributions of Fermi surface nesting, electron phonon coupling, and lattice instabilities. Here, we combine temperature and orientation dependent polarized Raman spectroscopy with first principles calculations to uncover the anisotropic electronic and lattice interactions governing the CDW state in Ta2NiSe7. Heat capacity and electrical transport measurements identify an incommensurate CDW transition at 61 K. Raman spectroscopy reveals pronounced in plane anisotropy, with e ph coupling strength along intrachain b axis exceeding five times that along interchain c axis, whereas lattice anharmonicity is enhanced by threefold along c axis. First principles calculations identify Ta2 Se octahedral vibrations and Ta Se electronic states near the Fermi level as dominant channels mediating the anisotropic e ph interaction. Exceptionally strong and directional e ph coupling along b axis establishes lattice driven electronic instability as the primary mechanism underlying CDW modulation and highlights the dominance of intrachain interactions in strongly coupled Ta2NiSe7. Despite this strong coupling, the CDW remains incommensurate, indicating that lattice anharmonicity provides an additional degree of freedom. Enhanced anharmonicity along c axis suggests that anisotropic phonon phonon interactions reshape the free energy landscape and contribute to stabilizing incommensurate phase. These findings reveal a cooperative interplay between anisotropic e ph coupling and lattice anharmonicity in governing CDW formation in low dimensional quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：结合偏振拉曼光谱实验与第一性原理计算，并包含热容、电输运测量。；研究对象：准一维电荷密度波材料Ta₂NiSe₇，具体研究其CDW形成的微观机制，以及各向异性的电子-声子耦合与晶格非谐性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沿链内b轴的电子-声子耦合强度超过链间c轴五倍以上，表明晶格驱动的电子不稳定性是Ta₂NiSe₇中CDW调制的主要机制；而沿c轴增强三倍的晶格非谐性通过重塑自由能景观，有助于稳定非公度CDW相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沿链内b轴的电子-声子耦合强度超过链间c轴五倍以上，表明晶格驱动的电子不稳定性是Ta₂NiSe₇中CDW调制的主要机制；而沿c轴增强三倍的晶格非谐性通过重塑自由能景观，有助于稳定非公度CDW相。；创新点：揭示了各向异性电子-声子耦合与晶格非谐性之间的协同作用共同决定低维量子材料中CDW的形成，特别是提出非谐性作为额外自由度稳定非公度相的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 变温及取向依赖的偏振拉曼光谱、热容测量、电输运测量，以及第一性原理计算（用于识别振动模式和费米能级附近的电子态）。

papers.title: On the growth of operator entanglement in brickwork circuits with Yang--Baxter gates
papers.abstract: We study the operator entanglement of local operators in one-dimensional brickwork circuits whose two-site gate satisfies the braid relation; throughout this work, we call such a gate a Yang--Baxter gate. We establish upper bounds for several structured, overlapping classes of Yang--Baxter gates. We show that the operator Schmidt rank remains uniformly bounded in time for all qubit Yang--Baxter gates and, in arbitrary local dimension, for permutation gates obtained from non-degenerate Yang--Baxter maps. We also show that it grows at most polynomially for involutive dual-unitary Yang--Baxter gates and for arbitrary phase dressings of permutation gates obtained from non-degenerate Yang--Baxter maps. These results imply, respectively, constant and logarithmic upper bounds on the operator entanglement. Conversely, we construct a seven-state involutive Yang--Baxter gate without dual unitarity and a one-site operator whose exact operator Schmidt rank grows exponentially, although the corresponding operator entropies remain undetermined. Entanglement growth in the general Yang--Baxter case remains open. All proofs and selected examples were constructed by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、establish upper bounds、show、construct。；研究对象：一维砖墙（brickwork）量子电路中，满足辫子关系（braid relation）的双比特门（称为 Yang–Baxter 门）所驱动的局域算符的算符纠缠（operator entanglement）增长行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于多种结构化 Yang–Baxter 门，算符 Schmidt 秩随时间保持有界或至多多项式增长，从而给出算符纠缠的常数或对数上界；但构造了一个七态非对偶酉 Yang–Baxter 门，其单点算符的精确 Schmidt 秩呈指数增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于多种结构化 Yang–Baxter 门，算符 Schmidt 秩随时间保持有界或至多多项式增长，从而给出算符纠缠的常数或对数上界；但构造了一个七态非对偶酉 Yang–Baxter 门，其单点算符的精确 Schmidt 秩呈指数增长。；创新点：首次系统分类了 Yang–Baxter 门中算符纠缠的增长上界，并给出一个非对偶酉但 Schmidt 秩指数增长的显式反例，表明对偶酉性并非抑制纠缠增长的唯一条件。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析证明。具体包括：对量子比特 Yang–Baxter 门及由非简并 Yang–Baxter 映射得到的置换门建立 Schmidt 秩的均匀上界；对对合对偶酉 Yang–Baxter 门及置换门的相位修饰情形证明多项式上界；并通过显式构造七态反例展示指数增长。

papers.title: Symmetry-protected triplet Weyl complexes
papers.abstract: The Nielsen-Ninomiya theorem dictates that Weyl nodes must appear in pairs of opposite chirality to preserve global charge neutrality. However, in crystals, specific crystalline symmetries can stabilize multi-Weyl nodes, circumventing this pairwise constraint and enabling compensated Weyl complexes with mixed chiral charges. The minimal configuration of this type is a triplet Weyl complex (TWC), comprising exactly three Weyl nodes. Here, we systematically investigate the symmetry conditions required to realize TWCs. By screening all 1651 magnetic space groups (MSGs) in both spinless and spinful systems, we establish that: (i) Only TWCs with charge magnitudes of $\{1,1,2\}$ and $\{1,2,3\}$ are permitted; (ii) the $\{1,1,2\}$ configuration can be realized in 166 spinless MSGs and 70 spinful MSGs; and (iii) the $\{1,2,3\}$-TWCs, which has not been reported before, can occur in 10 MSGs for both spinless and spinful cases. We explicitly demonstrate the existence of $\{1,2,3\}$-TWC in a tight-binding model. Furthermore, we present the first electronic realization of $\{1,1,2\}$-TWC topological semimetal state in the chiral carbon allotrope DZQH-C$_{36}$, in which the three Weyl nodes form a collinear configuration, leading to a characteristic ``S''-shaped surface Fermi arc pattern. Our findings uncover novel topological states featuring mixed chiral charges and provide guidance for exploring their physics in concrete material systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“系统筛选1651个磁空间群”“紧束缚模型”“电子结构实现”等关键词，属于对称性分析与第一性原理/紧束缚计算研究。；研究对象：具有混合手性电荷的“三重Weyl复合体”（TWC）拓扑半金属态，具体材料为手性碳同素异形体DZQH-C₃₆。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统确定了实现三重Weyl复合体所需的磁空间群对称条件，证明仅允许电荷幅度为{1,1,2}和{1,2,3}两种TWC构型；首次在DZQH-C₃₆中实现了{1,1,2}-TWC拓扑半金属态，并预言了此前未报道的{1,2,3}-TWC。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统确定了实现三重Weyl复合体所需的磁空间群对称条件，证明仅允许电荷幅度为{1,1,2}和{1,2,3}两种TWC构型；首次在DZQH-C₃₆中实现了{1,1,2}-TWC拓扑半金属态，并预言了此前未报道的{1,2,3}-TWC。；创新点：首次系统给出TWC的完整对称性分类，发现并预言了新型{1,2,3}-TWC构型（此前未见报道）；首次在真实材料（DZQH-C₃₆）中实现{1,1,2}-TWC，并揭示其特有的“S”形表面费米弧图案。
papers.method_zh: 基于磁空间群（MSG）的对称性筛选与枚举（覆盖1651个MSG，区分无自旋与有自旋体系）；紧束缚模型构建与能带计算；电子结构计算（用于碳同素异形体DZQH-C₃₆的能带与表面态分析）。

papers.title: Cross-Layer Anomalous Hall Transport driven by Néel-Vector rotating in the Altermagnet candidate V2Te2O
papers.abstract: In van der Waals (vdW) materials, weak interlayer coupling generally suppresses vertical dispersion, reinforcing the conventional paradigm that in-plane transport dominates over cross-layer channels. Here, using first-principles calculations and magnetic symmetry analyses, we uncover a giant, symmetry-unlocked cross-layer anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in the vdW altermagnet V2Te2O. In the magnetic ground state with Neel vector N//z, horizontal mirror symmetry protects a spin-polarized nodal chain near the Fermi level and strictly enforces zero anomalous Hall response. Tilting the Neel vector explicitly breaks this mirror protection, allowing spin-orbit coupling to gap the nodal chain and activate a sharp cross-layer Hall response. When the Neel vector is rotated into the in-plane configuration (N//x), cross-layer orbital hybridization generates intensive Berry curvature hotspots, boosting the cross-layer component of AHC σ_{yz} to approximately 255 S/cm, which exceeds in-plane component σ_{xy} by nearly two orders of magnitude. Furthermore, varying the azimuthal angle systematically redistributes the anomalous Hall response, enabling full directional control of transverse transport. Our findings demonstrate a highly sensitive cross-layer anomalous Hall switch activated by low-barrier spin canting, offering promising avenues for directional tensor selection and low-power multi-axial vdW spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提及“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）和“magnetic symmetry analyses”（磁对称性分析）。；研究对象：范德华（vdW）交变磁体（altermagnet）V₂Te₂O，具体研究其Néel矢量旋转驱动的跨层（cross-layer）反常霍尔输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在vdW交变磁体V₂Te₂O中，通过旋转Néel矢量可对称性解锁巨大的跨层反常霍尔电导（AHC）：当Néel矢量沿面内方向（N//x）时，跨层分量σ_yz可达约255 S/cm，比面内分量σ_xy高出近两个数量级，实现低势垒自旋倾斜激活的高灵敏跨层反常霍尔开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在vdW交变磁体V₂Te₂O中，通过旋转Néel矢量可对称性解锁巨大的跨层反常霍尔电导（AHC）：当Néel矢量沿面内方向（N//x）时，跨层分量σ_yz可达约255 S/cm，比面内分量σ_xy高出近两个数量级，实现低势垒自旋倾斜激活的高灵敏跨层反常霍尔开关。；创新点：突破了“vdW材料中层间耦合弱、面内输运主导”的传统范式，首次在vdW交变磁体中实现跨层反常霍尔电导远超面内分量的巨大响应；并展示了通过旋转Néel矢量（改变方位角）可系统调控横向输运方向，实现全方向控制，为低功耗多轴vdW自旋电子学提供新机制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）结合磁对称性分析。具体包括：计算磁基态（Néel矢量N//z）下的电子结构，识别自旋极化节点链（nodal chain）；通过倾斜或旋转Néel矢量，分析对称性破缺对能带间隙和Berry曲率分布的影响，进而计算反常霍尔电导张量各分量。

papers.title: A locally ab initio computational framework for arbitrary incommensurate materials interfaces
papers.abstract: Incommensurate materials interfaces constitute a broad and technologically important class of systems, yet their lack of shared periodicity limits predictive and computationally efficient first-principles electronic-structure methods. Here we introduce a scalable computational framework for constructing locally ab initio electronic Hamiltonians for arbitrary materials interfaces. Our approach exploits the nearsightedness of Wannier Hamiltonian matrix elements, enabling their systematic extrapolation and interpolation across interlayer registries. This strategy yields transferable Hamiltonians that retain first-principles accuracy while bypassing the need for prohibitively large commensurate supercells or Moiré approximations. We validate the framework on quasicrystalline 30° twisted bilayer graphene, reproducing experimentally observed spectral features including mirrored Dirac cones and minigaps at avoided crossings arising from generalized interlayer scattering. We further predict quasiperiodic flat-band states in experimentally accessible doping regimes. By enabling predictive electronic-structure calculations across structurally incommensurate interfaces, this framework establishes a practical route to first-principles exploration of emergent interfacial phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“computational framework”“first-principles electronic-structure methods”“validate the framework”等关键词，属于方法开发与第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：非公度（incommensurate）材料界面体系，具体验证对象为准晶30°扭转双层石墨烯（quasicrystalline 30° twisted bilayer graphene），关注其电子结构、镜像狄拉克锥、能隙及平带态等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架能在无需构造巨大公度超胞或采用莫尔近似的条件下，对任意非公度界面实现具有第一性原理精度的可迁移电子哈密顿量构建，并在30°扭转双层石墨烯中成功复现实验观测的镜像狄拉克锥和广义层间散射导致的避交叉微隙，同时预测了实验可及掺杂区间内的准周期平带态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架能在无需构造巨大公度超胞或采用莫尔近似的条件下，对任意非公度界面实现具有第一性原理精度的可迁移电子哈密顿量构建，并在30°扭转双层石墨烯中成功复现实验观测的镜像狄拉克锥和广义层间散射导致的避交叉微隙，同时预测了实验可及掺杂区间内的准周期平带态。；创新点：首次提出一种通用的、可扩展的局域第一性原理计算框架，能够直接处理任意非公度材料界面，绕过了传统方法对超大公度超胞或莫尔近似的依赖，实现了对非公度界面电子结构的预测性第一性原理计算。（摘要未突出说明与其他方法的具体对比优势）
papers.method_zh: 基于Wannier哈密顿量矩阵元的近视性（nearsightedness），发展了一套可扩展的计算框架，对层间堆叠构型（interlayer registries）下的哈密顿量矩阵元进行系统性外推与插值，从而构建局域第一性原理电子哈密顿量。验证对象为30°扭转双层石墨烯，并与实验谱学特征进行对比。

papers.title: Engineering Giant Thermoelectric Performance through Electrode-Coupling Geometry and Magnetic Flux in Quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Rings
papers.abstract: We investigate coherent thermoelectric transport in magnetic-flux-threaded quasiperiodic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) rings with engineered multi-site electrode couplings using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism within the Landauer-Büttiker framework. We demonstrate that the electrode-coupling geometry serves as a powerful control parameter for tailoring quantum interference, thereby reshaping the transmission spectrum and thermoelectric response. In the absence of magnetic flux, the trivial dimerized phase ($t_1>t_2$) exhibits the highest thermoelectric efficiency, with asymmetric coupling producing a substantially larger figure of merit than the symmetric geometry. Magnetic flux further reconstructs the transmission spectrum through Aharonov-Bohm interference, driving a crossover of the optimal thermoelectric regime from the trivial to the topological dimerized phase. Under optimal flux conditions, the thermoelectric figure of merit reaches $ZT \approx 12$ for symmetric coupling and is dramatically enhanced to $ZT \approx 90$ for asymmetric coupling through enhanced energy filtering and suppressed electronic thermal transport. We further establish a clear correlation between the enhancement of thermoelectric efficiency and the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law. Our results demonstrate that the combined interplay of quasiperiodicity, topology, magnetic flux, and electrode-coupling geometry provides a versatile strategy for engineering high-performance coherent thermoelectric devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要明确使用非平衡格林函数方法（nonequilibrium Green's function formalism）和Landauer-Büttiker框架进行理论计算。；研究对象：准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）环，即具有准周期调制、嵌入磁通并连接多端电极的SSH环状体系，研究其相干热电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电极耦合几何构型可有效调控量子干涉，从而重塑透射谱并优化热电响应；在最优磁通条件下，对称耦合时热电优值ZT≈12，非对称耦合时ZT≈90，且热电效率增强与Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏存在明确关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电极耦合几何构型可有效调控量子干涉，从而重塑透射谱并优化热电响应；在最优磁通条件下，对称耦合时热电优值ZT≈12，非对称耦合时ZT≈90，且热电效率增强与Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏存在明确关联。；创新点：首次系统展示了电极耦合几何（对称vs非对称）与磁通（Aharonov-Bohm干涉）联合作为控制参数，可在准周期SSH环中实现从平庸到拓扑二聚化相的最优热电区间交叉，并将ZT提升至约90的极高水平。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡格林函数形式（NEGF）结合Landauer-Büttiker输运框架，计算磁通贯穿的准周期SSH环的相干热电输运系数（电导、热导、Seebeck系数及ZT值）。

papers.title: Generalized Helicity-Dependent Magnetization Switching via Substrate Phonons
papers.abstract: Coherent excitation of circularly-polarized substrate phonons can drive deterministic reversal of magnetization in an adjacent magnetic layer. However, the extent to which this substrate-mediated mechanism can be generalized across different materials remains unresolved. Here, we measure and compare the spectral dependence of helicity-dependent magnetization reversal in magnetic GdFeCo layers grown on a diverse set of diamagnetic substrates. Switching is observed for all investigated substrates, spanning six point groups and several infrared-active transverse-optical phonon symmetries. While the switching spectra broadly overlap with the Reststrahlen bands, their maxima are systematically shifted to wavelengths shorter than the corresponding transverse-optical phonon resonances. This spectral mismatch shows that substrate absorption alone does not determine the switching efficiency. Transfer-matrix calculations show that strong absorption concentrates energy deposition near the substrate interface, providing a possible source of local heating that could suppress magnetization reversal. Our results reveal the broad applicability of substrate-mediated phononic switching while showing that its efficiency is governed by the full optical response of the heterostructure rather than substrate absorption alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“我们测量并比较了……光谱依赖性”，属于实验测量工作，并辅以转移矩阵计算。；研究对象：磁性 GdFeCo 薄膜生长在多种抗磁性衬底上，研究圆偏振衬底声子相干激发驱动的螺旋度依赖磁化翻转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 衬底介导的声子驱动磁化翻转在多种衬底（涵盖六个点群和多种红外活性横光学声子对称性）上均普遍存在，但翻转光谱最大值与衬底横光学声子共振峰存在系统性蓝移，表明翻转效率由异质结构的整体光学响应决定，而非仅由衬底吸收决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：衬底介导的声子驱动磁化翻转在多种衬底（涵盖六个点群和多种红外活性横光学声子对称性）上均普遍存在，但翻转光谱最大值与衬底横光学声子共振峰存在系统性蓝移，表明翻转效率由异质结构的整体光学响应决定，而非仅由衬底吸收决定。；创新点：系统证明了衬底介导的声子驱动磁化翻转在不同晶体对称性和声子模式的衬底上具有普适性，并揭示了衬底吸收与翻转效率之间的非简单对应关系（光谱失配），指出界面附近能量沉积的局域加热可能抑制翻转。摘要未突出说明与以往单一衬底研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量不同衬底上 GdFeCo 的螺旋度依赖磁化翻转光谱，并与衬底的 Reststrahlen 带对比；理论上采用转移矩阵计算分析光吸收在异质结构中的空间分布。

papers.title: Influence of dislocation density on the tribological response in oxides: case study on SrTiO3
papers.abstract: Most ceramics suffer from brittle surface damage and cracking when small particles slide across the surface under low load. Microscratching tests are a useful technique to mimic this loading scenario while retaining the material's deformation history; however, the impact of pre-seeded dislocations, which can significantly facilitate plastic deformation, has not been explored in ceramics. Here, the influence of mechanically seeded dislocations on the microscratching response of oxides is investigated using a model perovskite, SrTiO3. First, various dislocation densities over four orders of magnitude are introduced via room-temperature cyclic Brinell indenter scratching. Subsequently, load-ramped microscratching tests are performed within the pristine and dislocation-seeded regions using a nominally 30 μm spherical diamond tip. On the reference pristine surface, we observe a clear transition from elastic to elasto-plastic deformation, followed by median/radial cracking at higher loads. In contrast, pre-seeded dislocations, accompanied by residual compressive stresses, suppress elastic deformation and lead to median/radial crack shortening and subsequent transition to a partial cone crack. The subsurface cracks are characterized by 3D Nano-CT. The changes in crack geometry, with and without dislocations, were described using the Lawn-Evans-Marshall and Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts models. These findings provide direct evidence of dislocation-regulated near-surface damage tolerance, with general applicability to other plastically deformable oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了显微划痕测试、循环布氏压痕划痕、3D Nano-CT等实验手段。；研究对象：氧化物陶瓷材料SrTiO₃（钛酸锶，钙钛矿结构），具体研究位错密度对其微划痕摩擦学响应（弹塑性变形与开裂行为）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预先机械引入的位错（伴随残余压应力）可抑制弹性变形、缩短中位/径向裂纹并促使裂纹向部分锥形裂纹转变，从而调控近表面损伤容限，为位错调控氧化物耐磨性提供了直接证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预先机械引入的位错（伴随残余压应力）可抑制弹性变形、缩短中位/径向裂纹并促使裂纹向部分锥形裂纹转变，从而调控近表面损伤容限，为位错调控氧化物耐磨性提供了直接证据。；创新点：首次在陶瓷材料中系统研究预植入位错密度对微划痕响应的影响，揭示了位错对裂纹形态转变的调控机制，并证明该效应可推广至其他可塑性变形的氧化物。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 室温循环布氏压痕划痕法引入不同密度（跨越四个数量级）的位错；随后用标称30 μm球形金刚石压头在原始区和位错预植入区进行载荷斜坡微划痕测试；利用3D Nano-CT表征亚表面裂纹；采用Lawn-Evans-Marshall和Lawn-Wiederhorn-Roberts模型描述裂纹几何变化。

papers.title: Tensor-Network Inference in a Field-Coupled XY Model for Portfolio Allocation
authors: G Subrahmanya V. R. K. Rao
papers.abstract: We apply tensor-network methods to a field-coupled XY model for long-only portfolio construction. Daily return statistics set asset-specific fields and correlation couplings. Correlation distance, four-point Gromov hyperbolicity, and Ward clustering are used to construct a sparse interaction path. A Fourier-Bessel expansion maps the continuous angular partition function to a finite-current tensor network; bottom-up and top-down contractions then give the one-site marginals and equilibrium cosine scores. A softmax map converts these scores into positive, fully invested portfolio weights. We study five equity markets over continuous ranges of inverse temperature beta and concentration gamma, and compare selected parameter pairs with long-only Markowitz frontiers and standard benchmarks. The same-sample comparisons demonstrate a tractable route from financial time series to network-adjusted allocations; predictive trading performance is outside their scope.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：tensor-network methods、Fourier-Bessel expansion、softmax map、Markowitz frontiers。；研究对象：用于长期（long-only）投资组合构建的场耦合XY模型，具体应用于五个股票市场。这是一个金融物理交叉体系，而非传统凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，但表明张量网络方法可对场耦合XY模型的配分函数进行有效收缩，从而将金融时间序列转化为网络调整后的组合权重；同样本比较显示该路径可行，但预测性交易表现不在研究范围内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，但表明张量网络方法可对场耦合XY模型的配分函数进行有效收缩，从而将金融时间序列转化为网络调整后的组合权重；同样本比较显示该路径可行，但预测性交易表现不在研究范围内。；创新点：将张量网络方法（通常用于量子多体物理）应用于金融领域的场耦合XY模型，实现从连续角度配分函数到有限流张量网络的映射，并利用网络收缩获得组合权重，提供了一条从金融时间序列到网络调整配置的可计算路径。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络推断方法：利用日收益率统计设定资产特定场与关联耦合；用相关距离、四点Gromov双曲性及Ward聚类构建稀疏相互作用路径；通过Fourier-Bessel展开将连续角度配分函数映射为有限流张量网络；采用自底向上与自顶向下收缩获得单点边缘分布与平衡余弦分数；最后用softmax映射生成正的、全额投资组合权重。研究在连续的反温度β和浓度γ范围内扫描，并与long-only Markowitz前沿及标准基准比较。

papers.title: ANT:UI: An interactive 3D tool for preparing ANT.Gaussian molecular junction geometries
papers.abstract: ANT.UI is a Python graphical interface that automates the construction of molecular-junction geometries for NEGF-DFT quantum transport calculations. Through a real-time 3D viewer, users interactively position electrodes and molecules and generate complete, ready-to-run input files for Gaussian and ANT.Gaussian without manual scripting. Dedicated Pull, Grid, and Rotation assistants further automate electrode-pulling sequences, surface scans, and step-wise rotation studies, with optional geometry-optimisation chaining across each sequence. By replacing a process that previously demanded days of custom scripting with a point-and-click workflow, ANT.UI accelerates research in theoretical molecular electronics and lowers the barrier to entry for new users. The software also exports all constructed geometries in standard XYZ format, allowing direct reuse in molecular dynamics codes or third-party visualization tools without manual reformatting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件工具开发文章。判断依据：摘要描述的是为NEGF-DFT量子输运计算构建几何结构的Python图形界面工具，属于计算方法的开发与自动化。；研究对象：分子结（molecular junctions）的几何结构，用于NEGF-DFT量子输运计算，具体涉及电极与分子的定位与组装。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未突出说明具体的物理发现，核心贡献在于将原本需要数天定制脚本的分子结几何构建过程简化为点击式交互工作流，并可直接生成Gaussian和ANT.Gaussian的输入文件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未突出说明具体的物理发现，核心贡献在于将原本需要数天定制脚本的分子结几何构建过程简化为点击式交互工作流，并可直接生成Gaussian和ANT.Gaussian的输入文件。；创新点：以交互式3D点选操作替代手工脚本编写，自动化生成可运行的量子输运计算输入文件，显著降低理论分子电子学研究的入门门槛；同时通过XYZ格式导出实现与分子动力学代码及第三方可视化工具的直接兼容。
papers.method_zh: 基于Python的图形用户界面（GUI），集成实时3D可视化；提供Pull、Grid、Rotation三种自动化助手，分别用于电极拉伸序列、表面扫描和分步旋转研究；支持跨序列的可选几何优化链；几何结构以标准XYZ格式导出。

papers.title: Local coordination, structural softening, and polarization-switching energetics in Sc-alloyed GaN
papers.abstract: Sc-alloyed wurtzite nitrides exhibit strongly tunable electromechanical and ferroelectric properties, yet the relationship between their lattice evolution and local bonding environment remains insufficiently established, particularly in Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N. Here, we investigate the structural and local bonding evolution of Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N across the dilute-to-intermediate composition range by combining X-ray diffraction, Sc K-edge X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES), extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) and first-principles calculations. Sc incorporation produces an anisotropic lattice expansion and a progressive reduction in the c/a ratio. XANES and EXAFS reveal a concurrent modification of the local environment around Sc, with the effective Sc-N coordination number increasing from 4.1(4) to 4.5(2) and the average Sc-N bond length increasing from 2.045(7) to 2.081(8)Å over x=0.06-0.26. The local response is accompanied by a reduction in the Sc K-edge pre-edge intensity, consistent with a gradual reduction of the local tetrahedral asymmetry. First-principles calculations show that these structural changes are associated with site-selective distortions around Sc and progressive flattening of the structural energy landscape. The calculated intrinsic polarization-switching barrier decreases from 24.2 to 19.0 meV/Å$^3$ with increasing Sc content, while the calculated piezoelectric stress coefficient (e$_{33}$) increases from 0.82 to 1.66~C/m$^2$ and elastic constant (C$_{33}$) decreases from 380 to 227~GPa, resulting in an increase of piezoelectric strain coefficient (d$_{33}$) from 2.99 to 12.46~pC/N. These results show that Sc incorporation progressively modifies the local coordination environment and structural energetics of ScGaN while the long-range wurtzite structure remains preserved over the investigated composition range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了X射线衍射、XANES、EXAFS等实验手段，以及第一性原理计算。；研究对象：Sc合金化纤锌矿氮化镓（Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N），具体研究其在稀至中等Sc掺杂浓度范围（x=0.06-0.26）内的晶格演化、局域键合环境、以及极化翻转和压电性能的调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sc掺入GaN后，在保持长程纤锌矿结构不变的前提下，逐步改变Sc周围的局域配位环境（有效配位数增加、键长增长、四面体不对称性降低），并使结构能量景观趋于平坦化，从而显著降低极化翻转势垒、增大压电系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sc掺入GaN后，在保持长程纤锌矿结构不变的前提下，逐步改变Sc周围的局域配位环境（有效配位数增加、键长增长、四面体不对称性降低），并使结构能量景观趋于平坦化，从而显著降低极化翻转势垒、增大压电系数。；创新点：首次将Sc K边XANES/EXAFS局域结构探针与第一性原理计算相结合，系统建立了Sc$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N从稀掺杂到中等掺杂范围内局域配位环境演变（配位数、键长、四面体不对称性）与宏观铁电压电性能（翻转势垒、压电系数）之间的定量关联。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：X射线衍射（XRD）表征晶格演化；Sc K边X射线吸收近边结构（XANES）和扩展X射线吸收精细结构（EXAFS）表征局域配位环境。计算方面：第一性原理计算（具体泛函类型摘要未明确说明），用于分析局域畸变、能量景观、极化翻转势垒、压电应力系数e$_{33}$、弹性常数C$_{33}$及压电应变系数d$_{33}$。

papers.title: Anomalous diffusion in porous fractal media
papers.abstract: We suggest a model of a diffusive process inside a fractal sponge structure, which is a generalization of the diffusion processes on a comb and fractal mesh structure. The sponge model is considered as the direct product of Cantor sets. It is shown that the corresponding one-dimensional diffusion process is governed by a generalized Fokker-Planck equation with a power-law memory kernel and a position-dependent diffusion coefficient. That is, the fractal structure of the medium induces memory effects and heterogeneity in the transport system. The considered model may be of interest to describe anomalous heat transport in porous fractal media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We suggest a model”“It is shown that”“governed by a generalized Fokker-Planck equation”等理论建模与推导表述，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：多孔分形介质（fractal sponge structure）中的反常扩散过程，具体为Cantor集直积构造的分形海绵结构内的输运现象，并关联多孔分形介质中的反常热输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分形海绵结构中的一维扩散过程由含幂律记忆核和位置依赖扩散系数的广义Fokker-Planck方程控制，表明介质的分形结构会同时引入记忆效应（非马尔可夫性）和输运异质性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分形海绵结构中的一维扩散过程由含幂律记忆核和位置依赖扩散系数的广义Fokker-Planck方程控制，表明介质的分形结构会同时引入记忆效应（非马尔可夫性）和输运异质性。；创新点：提出了一个统一描述分形海绵（Cantor集直积）中扩散的解析模型，将分形几何与记忆效应、空间异质输运联系起来，为多孔分形介质中的反常热输运提供了新的理论框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模方法：将分形海绵结构视为Cantor集的直积，推广了梳状（comb）结构和分形网格（fractal mesh）上的扩散模型，推导出对应的广义Fokker-Planck方程。

papers.title: Bias-field control of the Neel skyrmion nonlinearity in a confined nanostructure
papers.abstract: We study the nonlinear dynamics of a cylindrical skyrmion-based oscillator within the framework of a generalized Thiele model. We demonstrate the influence of an bias magnetic field applied perpendicular to the plane of the nanocylinder on the oscillation frequency and on the nonlinearity coefficient. It is shown that the field tunes the response frequency, while also producing a substantial change in the nonlinear frequency shift. We find that the nonlinearity coefficient reverses its sign as the field crosses a certain critical value. The variation of the nonlinearity coefficient with the field is clearly illustrated by the observed qualitative changes in nonlinear amplitude-frequency responses. Controlling the nonlinear properties of a skyrmion oscillator by changing the bias magnetic field opens up prospects for creating tunable computational elements for neuromorphic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“within the framework of a generalized Thiele model”，即基于广义Thiele模型的理论建模与解析/数值分析，未涉及实验或第一性原理计算。；研究对象：圆柱形纳米结构中的 Néel 型 skyrmion（斯格明子）振荡器，具体研究垂直外加偏置磁场对该振荡器非线性动力学行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 垂直偏置磁场不仅能调谐 skyrmion 振荡器的响应频率，还能显著改变其非线性频移；当磁场跨越某一临界值时，非线性系数发生符号反转，导致振幅-频率响应出现定性变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：垂直偏置磁场不仅能调谐 skyrmion 振荡器的响应频率，还能显著改变其非线性频移；当磁场跨越某一临界值时，非线性系数发生符号反转，导致振幅-频率响应出现定性变化。；创新点：首次系统展示了通过垂直偏置磁场对受限纳米结构中 Néel skyrmion 振荡器的非线性系数进行符号级调控，为基于 skyrmion 的可调谐神经形态计算元件提供了新的控制自由度。
papers.method_zh: 广义 Thiele 模型（generalized Thiele model），用于描述 skyrmion 质心运动的非线性动力学，并分析磁场对振荡频率及非线性系数的影响。

papers.title: Universal Thermodynamic Law Governing Stochastic Pendulum Clocks
papers.abstract: Clocks' performance, especially their precision, is fundamentally limited by thermodynamic laws as they are physical devices. Yet, it is known that the established thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR), which imposes an upper bound on the uncertainty product of the precision of oscillations and entropy production, is violated for underdamped systems such as stochastic pendulum clocks.
