Here, we show that for a general class of stochastic pendulum clocks described as a weakly nonlinear oscillator the uncertainty product of the phase of a pendulum clock and entropy production takes a universal and simple form that depends solely on the degree of nonlinearity. Its validity and limitations are examined using several representative models of pendulum clocks. Our framework reveals a universal thermodynamic principle governing stochastic pendulum clocks beyond the conventional TUR and provides a foundation for designing optimal pendulum clocks that operate efficiently in stochastic environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及推导普适热力学定律、建立理论框架，并“使用若干代表性模型检验”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：随机摆钟（stochastic pendulum clocks），即一类弱非线性振荡器，属于非欠阻尼（underdamped）随机动力学系统。摘要未明确说明具体材料或化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一类弱非线性随机摆钟，其相位精度与熵产生的不确定度乘积取一个仅依赖于非线性程度的普适且简单形式，从而超越了传统热力学不确定关系（TUR）的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一类弱非线性随机摆钟，其相位精度与熵产生的不确定度乘积取一个仅依赖于非线性程度的普适且简单形式，从而超越了传统热力学不确定关系（TUR）的限制。；创新点：发现并证明了超越传统TUR的普适热力学定律，该定律仅由非线性度决定，为在随机环境中设计最优摆钟提供了理论基础。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析推导，结合若干代表性摆钟模型进行数值或解析验证。摘要未明确说明具体计算工具（如模拟方法或数值算法）。

papers.title: Nuclear quantum effects in the thermal conductivity of solid hydrogen
papers.abstract: We use a combination of path integral and lattice dynamics methods to calculate the thermal conductivity of solid parahydrogen. Path integral molecular dynamics is first used to calculate a centroid potential of mean force at each temperature, on which a harmonic phonon basis is constructed using the finite displacement method. We then calculate anharmonic force constants on the centroid potential and solve the linearised phonon Boltzmann transport equation for the thermal conductivity. The resulting renormalised phonon dispersion curves, heat capacity, and thermal conductivity are all in remarkably good agreement with experimental measurements. We find that the heat transport is dominated by collective relaxon modes at low temperatures and cannot be captured by making the phonon relaxation time approximation. Indeed, quantitative agreement with the experimental thermal conductivity is only achieved when the nuclear quantum effects in the centroid potential of mean force, phonon boundary scattering, and hydrodynamic transport are all explicitly considered. This is also likely to be the case for other quantum crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“path integral molecular dynamics”“lattice dynamics methods”“phonon Boltzmann transport equation”等计算方法。；研究对象：固态对氢（solid parahydrogen）的热导率，重点研究其核量子效应对热输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在质心平均力势上构建声子并求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程，得到的声子色散、热容和热导率均与实验高度吻合；低温下热输运由集体relaxon模式主导，仅当同时考虑核量子效应、声子边界散射和水动力学输运时才能定量复现实验热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在质心平均力势上构建声子并求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程，得到的声子色散、热容和热导率均与实验高度吻合；低温下热输运由集体relaxon模式主导，仅当同时考虑核量子效应、声子边界散射和水动力学输运时才能定量复现实验热导率。；创新点：首次将核量子效应（通过质心平均力势）、声子边界散射与流体动力学输运三者显式结合，定量解释了固态氢的热导率；并指出其他量子晶体可能同样需要这种综合处理。摘要未突出说明与以往计算相比的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 路径积分分子动力学（PIMD）计算各温度下的质心平均力势；有限位移法在该势上构建谐波声子基；进一步计算非谐力常数，并求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（含relaxon模式，而非仅弛豫时间近似）。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal plasmonic response of drift-biased two-dimensional metals
papers.abstract: We develop a nonlocal electrodynamic framework for drift-biased two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs) with Dirac (linear) and parabolic (quadratic) dispersions, deriving closed-form drift-dependent conductivity tensors from the Boltzmann transport equation. We obtain the plasmon dispersion and near-field emission of a point dipole, revealing nonreciprocal propagation in both systems. At equal drift parameter, the parabolic 2DEG exhibits stronger nonreciprocity than the Dirac system, although we find that a larger drift parameter does not by itself produce stronger nonreciprocity: the response is set by the interplay of drift and plasmon nonlocality. As such, the combination of strong nonlocality and experimentally accessible drift velocities of semiconductor 2DEGs identifies parabolic systems as a promising platform for tunable, nonreciprocal plasmonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“develop a nonlocal electrodynamic framework”“deriving closed-form...from the Boltzmann transport equation”等理论推导表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：漂移偏置（drift-biased）的二维电子气（2DEGs），具体包括具有狄拉克（线性）色散和抛物线（二次）色散的两类体系，研究其等离激元响应与非互易传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相同漂移参数下，抛物线型2DEG比狄拉克型体系表现出更强的非互易性；但更大的漂移参数本身并不必然导致更强的非互易性，响应由漂移与等离激元非局域性的共同作用决定。因此，具有强非局域性和实验可及漂移速度的半导体2DEG（抛物线型）是制备可调非互易等离激元器件的理想平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相同漂移参数下，抛物线型2DEG比狄拉克型体系表现出更强的非互易性；但更大的漂移参数本身并不必然导致更强的非互易性，响应由漂移与等离激元非局域性的共同作用决定。因此，具有强非局域性和实验可及漂移速度的半导体2DEG（抛物线型）是制备可调非互易等离激元器件的理想平台。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于玻尔兹曼输运方程推导出依赖漂移的闭合形式电导率张量，建立非局域电动力学框架；随后计算等离激元色散以及点偶极子的近场辐射，用以揭示非互易传播特性。

papers.title: Cascade spin dynamics of excitons localized in indirect-band-gap (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with type-I band alignment
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin dynamics of excitons localized in type I (In,Al)As/AlAs quantum dots with an indirect in momentum space band structure. Polarized selective photoluminescence spectroscopy, i.e. fluorescence line narrowing, under magnetic fields up to 5 T applied in the Faraday geometry is employed. The experiment reveals a cascade spin evolution process of excitons in the indirect band-gap quantum dots: an initial short term spin dynamics associated with excited direct exciton states possessing a large oscillator strength is followed by electron relaxation into the X valley of the Brillouin zone and subsequent long term spin dynamics of indirect excitons. The two step mechanism manifests itself in the distinct features of the magnetic field dependences of photoluminescence: two component recovery of optical orientation, two component linear to circular polarization conversion and the presence of the linear polarization plane rotation. At the same time, suppression of the optical alignment shows one-component behavior governed by the spin dynamics of the indirect exciton states. Within the pseudospin formalism, we derive analytical expressions that quantitatively describe the observed dependences and yield estimates for the anisotropic exchange splitting: 210 μeV for direct excitons and 1.3 μeV for indirect excitons. Further analysis using the density matrix formalism agrees well with the pseudospin model calculations and shows that the finite optical orientation at zero magnetic field is due to comparable magnitudes of the anisotropic splitting of the indirect exciton states and the splitting of the X-valley electron states caused by the hyperfine interaction with nuclei.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（伴随理论建模）。判断依据：关键词“偏振选择性光致发光谱（fluorescence line narrowing）”、“磁场”、“实验揭示”。；研究对象：(In,Al)As/AlAs I型能带排列、动量空间间接带隙的量子点中局域激子的自旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在间接带隙量子点中，激子自旋演化呈现级联过程：先是具有大振子强度的直接激子态的短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫到布里渊区X谷，进入间接激子的长时自旋动力学。该两步机制在磁场依赖的光致发光中表现为光学取向的双分量恢复、线偏振到圆偏振转换的双分量行为以及线偏振面旋转；而光学对准的抑制则表现为由间接激子自旋动力学控制的单分量行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在间接带隙量子点中，激子自旋演化呈现级联过程：先是具有大振子强度的直接激子态的短时自旋动力学，随后电子弛豫到布里渊区X谷，进入间接激子的长时自旋动力学。该两步机制在磁场依赖的光致发光中表现为光学取向的双分量恢复、线偏振到圆偏振转换的双分量行为以及线偏振面旋转；而光学对准的抑制则表现为由间接激子自旋动力学控制的单分量行为。；创新点：首次在动量空间间接带隙的I型量子点中揭示激子自旋演化的两步级联机制，并通过赝自旋模型定量提取了直接激子（210 μeV）和间接激子（1.3 μeV）的各向异性交换劈裂能；密度矩阵分析表明零磁场下有限的光学取向源于间接激子态各向异性劈裂与X谷电子态超精细劈裂量级相当。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比性创新表述。
papers.method_zh: 法拉第几何构型下、磁场最高5 T的偏振选择性光致发光谱（荧光线窄化）；采用赝自旋形式推导解析表达式定量描述磁场依赖关系；使用密度矩阵形式进行进一步分析并与赝自旋模型对照。

papers.title: Liquid-liquid phase separation precedes crystallization in supercooled water-glycerol solutions
papers.abstract: Understanding the structural evolution of supercooled water-glycerol solutions is important for cryopreservation, yet distinguishing liquid-state transformations from ice crystallization remains challenging. Here, we investigate a deeply supercooled water-glycerol solution by X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) in ultra-small-angle X-ray scattering (USAXS) geometry, combined with wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS). This combination simultaneously captures the structural and dynamical evolution of the supercooled liquid upon quenching to cryogenic temperatures (172 K). We observe discontinuous changes in the liquid structure on molecular length scales and formation of microscale domains. The dynamics slow down during this stage and exhibit hyper-diffusive, ballistic-like relaxation. This transformation precedes ice crystallization, which we identify from the emergence of ice Bragg peaks in WAXS, allowing the two processes to be temporally separated. Phase-field (Cahn-Hilliard) simulations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations and show that a spinodal-decomposition scenario is consistent with the measured scattering evolution. These findings are consistent with a liquid-liquid phase separation scenario preceding ice crystallization and provide a route to disentangle the two processes in supercooled aqueous systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提及X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS）、超小角X射线散射（USAXS）、广角X射线散射（WAXS）等实验手段，并辅以相场（Cahn-Hilliard）模拟进行定性对比。；研究对象：深度过冷的水-甘油溶液（深过冷至172 K），重点关注其液态结构转变与冰结晶之间的竞争关系，以及可能的液-液相分离现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在冰结晶发生之前，过冷水-甘油溶液先经历一次不连续的液态结构转变，伴随微米尺度畴的形成和动力学减速（呈超扩散、类弹道弛豫），该过程与后续冰结晶在时间上可分离，符合旋节线分解（液-液相分离）情景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在冰结晶发生之前，过冷水-甘油溶液先经历一次不连续的液态结构转变，伴随微米尺度畴的形成和动力学减速（呈超扩散、类弹道弛豫），该过程与后续冰结晶在时间上可分离，符合旋节线分解（液-液相分离）情景。；创新点：首次在同一实验中同时追踪液态结构转变与冰结晶的时序，明确将液-液相分离与冰结晶两个过程在时间上区分开来，为理解过冷含水体系中的结晶前驱过程提供了直接实验证据。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用XPCS（USAXS几何）与WAXS联用，同时捕捉过冷液体在淬火至172 K过程中的结构演化与动力学信息；理论上采用相场（Cahn-Hilliard）模拟对散射演化进行定性再现与解释。

papers.title: Spin-Point-Group Classification of Multipoles for Nonrelativistic Collinear Magnets
papers.abstract: Multipole moments provide a unified symmetry language for describing electronic degrees of freedom and their associated physical responses. Although active multipoles have been systematically classified for crystallographic and magnetic point groups, their classification in spin point groups, which naturally describe magnetic systems in the absence of spin-orbit coupling, has remained unexplored. In this work, we present a complete classification of active orbital and spin multipoles for all 32 nonmagnetic and 122 collinear spin point groups. Treating orbital and spin degrees of freedom independently, we identify the symmetry-allowed multipoles associated with nonmagnetic and collinear magnetic orderings and clarify their hierarchy through comparisons among the corresponding spin point groups. The resulting classification provides a symmetry-based database that distinguishes structural and magnetic contributions to active multipoles and directly identifies microscopic order parameters, including those responsible for $d$-, $g$-, and $i$-wave altermagnetism. Furthermore, by classifying response tensors within the same framework, we establish a correspondence between active multipoles and symmetry-allowed physical responses. This correspondence systematically distinguishes nonrelativistic responses that survive without spin-orbit coupling from those requiring relativistic effects, providing a unified framework for understanding and predicting spin-dependent electromagnetic and transport phenomena in magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“classification”（分类）、“symmetry language”（对称语言）、“framework”（框架）等理论性关键词，未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟。；研究对象：非相对论共线磁体中的多极矩（multipole moments），具体涵盖所有32个非磁点群和122个共线自旋点群（spin point groups）下的轨道与自旋多极，以及与之对应的d波、g波、i波交变磁（altermagnetism）序参量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次完成了对所有非磁与共线自旋点群中活性轨道多极和自旋多极的完整分类，并建立了活性多极与对称性允许的物理响应张量之间的一一对应关系，从而能系统区分无需自旋轨道耦合即可存在的非相对论响应与必须依赖相对论效应的响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次完成了对所有非磁与共线自旋点群中活性轨道多极和自旋多极的完整分类，并建立了活性多极与对称性允许的物理响应张量之间的一一对应关系，从而能系统区分无需自旋轨道耦合即可存在的非相对论响应与必须依赖相对论效应的响应。；创新点：此前活性多极的分类仅局限于晶体点群和磁点群，本文首次将其推广至自旋点群——这一在无自旋轨道耦合条件下自然描述磁体系的对称群，从而为区分结构贡献与磁性贡献、直接识别微观序参量（包括交变磁序）提供了系统化数据库。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为自旋点群（spin point group）对称性分析。将轨道与自旋自由度独立处理，通过比较不同自旋点群之间的包含关系来厘清多极的层级结构；同时在同一框架内对响应张量进行分类以建立多极-响应对应。

papers.title: The elasticity of semiflexible polymers with reversible spontaneous curvature in two dimensions
papers.abstract: Many semiflexible filaments exhibit structural asymmetries that lead to a curved ground state (curvature in the absence of thermal fluctuations, external forces, or torques). This property is known as spontaneous curvature. Many semiflexible polymers can reversibly develop spontaneous curvature through internal conformational transitions or through transient interactions with their molecular environment. In this article, we show that such reversible spontaneous curvature, even in the absence of transitions in the value of the bending stiffness, provides a minimal mechanism for ensemble-dependent elasticity. We formulate an analytically tractable two-state modified wormlike-chain model in two dimensions, in which an uncurved state (without spontaneous curvature) competes with a curved state (possessing spontaneous curvature). The transition is controlled by an activation energy. Within the weak-bending approximation, we obtain the Gibbs and Helmholtz partition functions for a stretched filament with reversible constant (uniform along the backbone) or sinusoidal spontaneous curvature and for a grafted bistable filament driven either by an end torque or a bending force. Stretching or bending induces a crossover from spontaneous-curvature-dominated to entropic elasticity. We show how the elastic response differs in the two ensembles (Gibbs vs Helmholtz). In addition, we consider the case where the curved state is also characterized by a higher value of the bending stiffness. In that case, a reentrant transition is possible as we stretch the bistable filament.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytically tractable”“partition functions”“weak-bending approximation”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：二维中具有可逆自发曲率的半柔性聚合物（半柔性细丝），具体为一种两态修正蠕虫链模型，包含无曲率态与有自发曲率态之间的可逆转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 可逆自发曲率（即使弯曲刚度不变）本身即可提供依赖于系综（Gibbs vs Helmholtz）的弹性响应机制；拉伸或弯曲可使体系从自发曲率主导的弹性跨越到熵弹性主导的弹性，且当弯曲态具有更高弯曲刚度时，拉伸双稳态细丝可能出现重入转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：可逆自发曲率（即使弯曲刚度不变）本身即可提供依赖于系综（Gibbs vs Helmholtz）的弹性响应机制；拉伸或弯曲可使体系从自发曲率主导的弹性跨越到熵弹性主导的弹性，且当弯曲态具有更高弯曲刚度时，拉伸双稳态细丝可能出现重入转变。；创新点：首次证明可逆自发曲率本身（无需弯曲刚度变化）即可作为系综依赖弹性的最小机制；并揭示了弯曲态刚度更高时拉伸诱导的重入转变。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：二维修正蠕虫链模型（two-state modified wormlike-chain model），采用弱弯曲近似（weak-bending approximation），解析推导了Gibbs与Helmholtz配分函数。考虑了恒定或正弦自发曲率分布，以及受端部扭矩或弯曲力驱动的接枝双稳态细丝。

papers.title: Excitation caging in a vertex-frustrated quasiperiodic Einstein artificial spin ice
papers.abstract: Naturally occurring bulk quasicrystals are rare, and magnetic instances are rarer still, with chemical constraints typically permitting the synthesis of approximants rather than true quasicrystalline magnets. Here, we present an artificial spin ice based on a recently discovered Einstein lattice, the Hat tiling, which is built from the first known shape - the hat - that tiles the plane only aperiodically. The Einstein artificial spin ice has long-range structural order with no translational symmetry, and low-connectivity vertices with well-defined local ground states and excitations. Together, these properties provide a model two-dimensional quasicrystalline magnet, with magnetic correlations that we probe with magnetic force microscopy and parallel-tempered Monte Carlo simulations. We identify a two-stage partial ordering process, driven by the competition between two possible positions for magnetic excitations. This competition is resolved in the ground-state manifold, where exactly one magnetic excitation is caged on each antihat, yet the manifold remains macroscopically degenerate. This yields an unusual type of medium-range order, where the underlying quasiperiodic long-range order is randomly modulated by a strictly constrained disorder. Our findings establish the Einstein artificial spin ice as a blueprint for understanding quasicrystalline magnetism, demonstrating how quasiperiodic monotile geometries can be exploited to engineer unconventional magnetic phases with no direct equivalent in periodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算模拟）。依据：摘要提及“magnetic force microscopy”（实验手段）与“parallel-tempered Monte Carlo simulations”（计算方法）。；研究对象：基于Hat平铺（Einstein tile）构建的人工自旋冰——一种准周期无平移对称性的二维人工磁体，其顶点具有低连通性和明确的局域基态与激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该体系呈现两阶段部分有序化过程，源于磁激发在两个可能位置间的竞争；在基态流形中，每个antihat上恰好束缚一个磁激发，但流形仍保持宏观简并，形成一种由严格受限无序随机调制准周期长程有序的奇特中程有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该体系呈现两阶段部分有序化过程，源于磁激发在两个可能位置间的竞争；在基态流形中，每个antihat上恰好束缚一个磁激发，但流形仍保持宏观简并，形成一种由严格受限无序随机调制准周期长程有序的奇特中程有序态。；创新点：首次将Einstein单平铺（Hat tiling）几何引入人工自旋冰，构建了真正的准周期磁性模型系统，展示了如何利用准周期单调平铺几何设计在周期系统中无直接对应物的非常规磁相。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 磁力显微镜（MFM）实验探测磁关联；并行回火蒙特卡洛（parallel-tempered Monte Carlo）模拟。

papers.title: Multi-task deep-learning optimization of trade-off properties for superior-performance Fe-based soft magnetic alloys
papers.abstract: Fe-based amorphous alloys are promising soft magnetic materials for developing next-generation devices with high frequency and efficiency. However, optimization of Fe-based alloys with ultra-high saturation magnetic flux density (B_s), ultra-low coercivity (H_c), and good glass-forming ability is a notorious problem, owing to the vast composition space and complex trade-offs of these properties. Thus, conventional design methods encounter great challenges. Here we develop a generative multi-task deep learning (GMTDL) to achieve simultaneous optimization of compositions and trade-off properties. The GMTDL can sufficiently exploit and share the knowledge of datasets across different tasks, despite the limitation and imbalance of these datasets. Therefore, it exhibits superior performance in prediction of alloys with multiple targeted properties, outperforming previous machine learning-based design strategies. Moreover, the GMTDL can also tailor compositions, providing an efficient way to regulate properties and generate desired candidates for further experimental processing. The validity and reliability of GMTDL are rigorously tested by benchmarking with Fe-based alloys reported very recently. Moreover, some new alloys with ultra-high B_s and ultra-low H_c are predicted. The optimal content windows of key elements and their synergistic effects are also unraveled for practical guidance. Thus, our study establishes an effective and reliable paradigm for simultaneous prediction and optimization of high-performance materials with multiple properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动型研究。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generative multi-task deep learning (GMTDL)”“machine learning-based design strategies”，属于机器学习辅助材料设计，而非实验或传统理论推导。；研究对象：铁基非晶软磁合金（Fe-based amorphous soft magnetic alloys），重点关注其成分优化与三个关键性能——饱和磁通密度（B_s）、矫顽力（H_c）和玻璃形成能力（GFA）之间的权衡关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种生成式多任务深度学习（GMTDL）框架，能够同时优化合金成分并预测多个目标性能，成功预测出具有超高B_s和超低H_c的新型铁基合金，并揭示了关键元素的优化含量窗口及其协同效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种生成式多任务深度学习（GMTDL）框架，能够同时优化合金成分并预测多个目标性能，成功预测出具有超高B_s和超低H_c的新型铁基合金，并揭示了关键元素的优化含量窗口及其协同效应。；创新点：首次将生成式多任务深度学习应用于铁基软磁合金的多性能协同优化，能够在数据有限且不平衡的条件下跨任务共享知识，同时实现成分生成与多目标性能预测，优于以往基于机器学习的单任务设计策略。（摘要未突出说明与传统物理建模或实验筛选方法的具体对比细节。）
papers.method_zh: 生成式多任务深度学习（GMTDL）框架，利用多任务学习机制在不同任务间共享数据集知识，以克服数据集的局限性和不平衡性；通过生成式模型定制合金成分；用近期报道的铁基合金作为基准进行验证。

papers.title: On the Stability of the Polar Phase of Superfluid 3He in Nematic Aerogels
papers.abstract: We study the stability of the solution corresponding to the polar phase of superfluid 3He in nematic aerogels with respect to perturbations induced by magnetic impurity scattering. We show that when the perturbation simultaneously breaks axial and time-reversal symmetry, the polar-distorted A phase is realized with the highest transition temperature. Within the proposed model of a p-wave scattering potential, which accounts for the effective spin-orbit interaction between the orbital angular momentum of a scattering quasiparticle and the magnetic moment texture of the scatterer, we solve the eigenvalue and eigenvector problem for the Gor'kov self-consistency equation. Finally, we discuss how our results relate to the available experimental data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We show”“We solve”等表述，且涉及Gor'kov自洽方程的特征值/特征向量求解，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：超流³He在向列型气凝胶中的极性相（polar phase）及其稳定性，具体关注磁杂质散射对极性相的扰动效应，以及由此可能实现的极性畸变A相（polar-distorted A phase）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当磁杂质散射同时破坏轴向对称性和时间反演对称性时，极性畸变A相具有最高的超导转变温度，即该相在竞争中最稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当磁杂质散射同时破坏轴向对称性和时间反演对称性时，极性畸变A相具有最高的超导转变温度，即该相在竞争中最稳定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于：首次在向列型气凝胶中系统考虑同时破坏轴向与时间反演对称性的磁杂质散射效应，并引入含有效自旋-轨道耦合的p波散射势模型来分析极性相的稳定性竞争。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为弱耦合BCS型超流理论，具体采用Gor'kov自洽方程的特征值/特征向量求解方法；杂质散射势采用p波散射势模型，该模型包含散射准粒子的轨道角动量与散射体磁矩织构之间的有效自旋-轨道耦合。

papers.title: Spin-Charge Subordination in the Infinite-$U$ $SU(N)$ Hubbard Chain
papers.abstract: We obtain the exact full counting statistics of charge and flavor transport in the one-dimensional infinite-$U$ $SU(N)$ Hubbard model. The no-passing constraint freezes the ordered flavor sequence while the particle coordinates evolve as free spinless fermions. Consequently, charge transfer is governed by a free-fermion determinant, whereas flavor transfer is exactly subordinated to the number of particles crossing the observation cut. For an arbitrary traceless Cartan generator this yields an exact relation between the charge and flavor cumulants. The complete asymptotic flavor distribution is a universal non-Gaussian M-Wright law. Together, these results establish spin--charge subordination as a kinematic mechanism for anomalously slow internal-state transport in one-dimensional impenetrable quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“exact full counting statistics”“exact relation”“universal non-Gaussian law”等纯理论推导与解析结果表述，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：一维无限排斥相互作用（infinite-\(U\)）的 \(SU(N)\) Hubbard 链，具体关注电荷（charge）与味（flavor，即自旋或内部自由度）输运的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限-\(U\) \(SU(N)\) Hubbard 链中，电荷输运由自由费米子行列式决定，而味输运严格“从属”（subordinated）于穿过观测截面的粒子数；由此得到电荷与味累积量之间的精确关系，且味输运的渐近分布服从非高斯的 M-Wright 分布，揭示了自旋-电荷从属作为一维不可穿透量子气体中内部态输运异常缓慢的运动学机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限-\(U\) \(SU(N)\) Hubbard 链中，电荷输运由自由费米子行列式决定，而味输运严格“从属”（subordinated）于穿过观测截面的粒子数；由此得到电荷与味累积量之间的精确关系，且味输运的渐近分布服从非高斯的 M-Wright 分布，揭示了自旋-电荷从属作为一维不可穿透量子气体中内部态输运异常缓慢的运动学机制。；创新点：首次在无限-\(U\) \(SU(N)\) Hubbard 链中给出电荷与味输运的精确全计数统计，并建立“自旋-电荷从属”作为一维强关联气体中内部态输运慢化的普适运动学机制；味输运的渐近分布被证明为普适的非高斯 M-Wright 分布。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：利用无超越约束（no-passing constraint）将有序味序列冻结，将粒子坐标映射为自由自旋less费米子；采用全计数统计（full counting statistics）框架，推导电荷与味输运的精确生成函数与累积量关系，并分析其渐近分布（M-Wright 律）。

papers.title: Challenges in orbital current-driven domain wall motion in light metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures
papers.abstract: Recent advances in spintronics suggest that orbital Hall currents generated by charge injection in light metals can provide nonequilibrium angular momentum without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here, we examine whether such orbital currents can drive domain wall (DW) motion in an amorphous ferrimagnetic alloy, Gd$_{25}$(Fe$_{9}$Co$_{1}$)$_{75}$ (GFC), where the rare-earth sublattice offers strong SOC for orbital-to-spin conversion. We compare three representative heterostructures: Pt/GFC as a spin Hall reference, light-metal (Mn or Ti)/GFC for direct orbital-current injection, and light-metal/Pt/GFC incorporating an ultrathin Pt layer for orbital-to-spin conversion. Whereas Pt/GFC exhibits robust and reproducible spin-orbit-torque-driven DW motion, no current-driven DW motion is detected in Mn/GFC or Ti/GFC. Second-harmonic Hall measurements nevertheless reveal finite damping-like torques in both Mn/GFC and Ti/GFC, demonstrating that angular-momentum transfer into GFC does occur but is far weaker than in Pt/GFC. Inserting a 1-nm-thick Pt conversion layer strongly enhances the damping-like torque and restores DW motion. Thickness-dependent analysis further shows that DW mobility and depinning thresholds correlate with the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and domain-wall width, highlighting weak torque conversion and insufficient interfacial stabilization of chiral DWs as key challenges for orbital-driven DW motion in light-metal/ferrimagnet heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Second-harmonic Hall measurements”（二次谐波霍尔测量）等实验手段，以及“no current-driven DW motion is detected”等实验观测结果。；研究对象：轻金属（Mn或Ti）/非晶亚铁磁合金Gd₂₅(Fe₉Co₁)₇₅（GFC）异质结构中的轨道电流驱动畴壁运动现象，并与Pt/GFC自旋霍尔参考体系进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Mn/GFC和Ti/GFC中未观察到电流驱动的畴壁运动，尽管二次谐波霍尔测量显示存在有限的类阻尼力矩（远弱于Pt/GFC）；插入1 nm厚的Pt转换层可显著增强类阻尼力矩并恢复畴壁运动。弱力矩转换效率和界面手性畴壁稳定化不足是轻金属/亚铁磁异质结构中轨道驱动畴壁运动的主要挑战。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Mn/GFC和Ti/GFC中未观察到电流驱动的畴壁运动，尽管二次谐波霍尔测量显示存在有限的类阻尼力矩（远弱于Pt/GFC）；插入1 nm厚的Pt转换层可显著增强类阻尼力矩并恢复畴壁运动。弱力矩转换效率和界面手性畴壁稳定化不足是轻金属/亚铁磁异质结构中轨道驱动畴壁运动的主要挑战。；创新点：系统评估了轻金属直接注入轨道电流驱动亚铁磁畴壁运动的可行性，并揭示了轻金属/亚铁磁体系中轨道力矩转换效率不足及界面手性稳定化缺失这两个关键瓶颈；通过插入超薄Pt转换层验证了轨道-自旋转换路径的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 电流驱动畴壁运动测量（对比不同异质结构）；二次谐波霍尔测量（用于定量表征类阻尼力矩）；厚度依赖分析（研究畴壁迁移率、去钉扎阈值与界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用及畴壁宽度的关联）。

papers.title: Field-Driven Coupled Magnon--Phonon--Electron Relaxation in Magnetite Using Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamic Formalism
papers.abstract: A field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) formulation is developed for longitudinal nonequilibrium relaxation in magnetite (Fe$_3$O$_4$) with coupled electron, phonon, and magnon populations. Material-specific excitation spectra define the thermodynamic state space, while one relaxation parameter for each population sets its kinetic scale. A longitudinal magnetic field shifts the dressed magnon eigenenergies while the occupation basis remains fixed; irreversible redistribution conserves instantaneous energy and electron number while allowing the magnon population to vary. The formulation yields nonequilibrium subsystem temperatures, entropy production, magnetic-work identities, and a coupled small-signal susceptibility incorporating energy-conservation feedback among all three populations; the one-pole Debye response appears only as a limiting case. Numerical results under sinusoidal driving show a transition from nearly quasistatic behavior to frequency-dependent lag, finite-amplitude departure from the linear-response ellipse, and increasing higher-harmonic content. Relaxational work per cycle increases strongly with field amplitude and frequency, while the complex susceptibility is broader and shifted relative to a Debye reference. Entropy production remains positive, and the electron, phonon, and magnon temperatures show distinct excursions followed by secular heating when positive magnetic work is retained without heat rejection. The calculated work represents longitudinal magnon quasiparticle relaxation in a homogeneous single-domain model, not the total core loss of a finite ferrite specimen.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“formulation is developed”“numerical results”“formalism”等关键词，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：磁铁矿（Fe₃O₄）中电子、声子、磁子三种准粒子群体在纵向磁场驱动下的非平衡弛豫过程，具体为均匀单畴模型中的纵向磁子准粒子弛豫。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该SEAQT理论框架能够描述磁场驱动下磁铁矿中电子-声子-磁子耦合的非平衡弛豫，数值结果显示系统从近准静态行为过渡到频率依赖的滞后响应，并出现有限振幅非线性效应和高次谐波；弛豫功随场振幅和频率显著增加，熵产生始终为正。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该SEAQT理论框架能够描述磁场驱动下磁铁矿中电子-声子-磁子耦合的非平衡弛豫，数值结果显示系统从近准静态行为过渡到频率依赖的滞后响应，并出现有限振幅非线性效应和高次谐波；弛豫功随场振幅和频率显著增加，熵产生始终为正。；创新点：将SEAQT形式体系推广到磁场驱动的磁子-声子-电子三群体耦合非平衡弛豫问题，明确考虑了能量守恒反馈对三者耦合小信号磁化率的影响，并指出单极点德拜响应仅作为其极限情形出现。摘要未突出说明与以往SEAQT应用相比的其他新意。
papers.method_zh: 采用最陡熵升量子热力学（SEAQT）形式体系，结合材料特定的激发谱定义热力学态空间，为每种准粒子群体（电子、声子、磁子）引入一个弛豫参数设定其动力学时间尺度。通过纵向磁场移动缀饰磁子本征能量（占据基不变），在保持瞬时能量和电子数守恒的同时允许磁子数变化。数值上对正弦驱动下的响应进行了计算，包括子系统温度、熵产生、磁功恒等式及耦合小信号磁化率。

papers.title: Orientation selection and superconducting properties of epitaxial Al on ferromagnetic semiconductor (In,Fe)As
papers.abstract: Superconductor/ferromagnet heterostructures provide a versatile platform for exploring spin-dependent superconducting phenomena arising from interfacial proximity effects. In this article, we investigate the structural and superconducting properties of Al thin films grown in situ by molecular beam epitaxy on strained Fe-doped ferromagnetic semiconductor (FMS) (In,Fe)As layers. X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal the epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al layers, with the growth orientation changing from (110) to (111) as the in-plane lattice constant of (In,Fe)As increases. The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies systematically with the film surface morphology and grain size. In addition, the critical magnetic field of Al exhibits an anomalous decrease below 0.5 K, possibly reflecting magnetic coupling to the underlying FMS (In,Fe)As layer. These findings provide a guideline for material design of epitaxial Al/(In,Fe)As heterostructures, which may serve as a promising platform for investigating proximity-induced superconducting and magnetic phenomena in semiconductor-based hybrid quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy reveal...”“The superconducting critical temperature of Al varies...”“critical magnetic field...exhibits an anomalous decrease”，涉及薄膜生长、结构表征与输运测量。；研究对象：外延生长的 Al/(In,Fe)As 异质结，即超导体（Al）与铁磁半导体（(In,Fe)As）的复合体系，关注其结构取向选择、超导转变温度及临界磁场等超导性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Al 在 (In,Fe)As 上的外延取向随 (In,Fe)As 面内晶格常数增大而从 (110) 转变为 (111)，且 Al 的超导临界温度随表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统变化；此外，Al 的临界磁场在 0.5 K 以下出现反常下降，可能反映与底层铁磁半导体的磁耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Al 在 (In,Fe)As 上的外延取向随 (In,Fe)As 面内晶格常数增大而从 (110) 转变为 (111)，且 Al 的超导临界温度随表面形貌和晶粒尺寸系统变化；此外，Al 的临界磁场在 0.5 K 以下出现反常下降，可能反映与底层铁磁半导体的磁耦合。；创新点：首次系统研究了在应变 Fe 掺杂铁磁半导体 (In,Fe)As 上外延单晶 Al 的取向选择规律及其与超导性质的关联，为基于半导体异质结的混合量子器件中近邻超导与磁现象的材料设计提供指导。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）原位生长 Al 薄膜；X 射线衍射（XRD）和透射电子显微镜（TEM）用于结构表征；超导临界温度与临界磁场的输运测量。

papers.title: Thermodynamic learning
papers.abstract: We discuss the possibility to train a thermodynamic system, whose micro-variables are fully determined through the Hamiltonian by the usual statistical mechanical rules, to perform tasks such as memorization and generalization. Training is achieved by the application of suitable external fields, playing the role of {\it data}. At variance with conventional machine learning, no other logical or algorithmic rules are introduced. The system is amenable, in principle, to exact analytical calculations. We specialize this general approach to a prototypical Ising system with annealed dichotomous couplings and study its learning ability. Results indicate excellent memorization and good generalization capacity already for small systems, and a tendency to improve with system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论“训练热力学系统”的理论可能性，强调“原则上可进行精确解析计算”，未涉及实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：一种具有退火二分耦合（annealed dichotomous couplings）的伊辛（Ising）系统，作为可训练的热力学学习系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该热力学系统可通过施加外部场（作为“数据”）进行训练，实现记忆与泛化任务；对小系统已表现出优异的记忆能力和良好的泛化能力，且性能随系统尺寸增大而趋于提升。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该热力学系统可通过施加外部场（作为“数据”）进行训练，实现记忆与泛化任务；对小系统已表现出优异的记忆能力和良好的泛化能力，且性能随系统尺寸增大而趋于提升。；创新点：与传统机器学习不同，该方案不引入任何逻辑或算法规则，仅依靠热力学系统的统计力学响应实现学习；且系统原则上允许精确解析计算。摘要未突出说明与已有热力学学习或物理神经网络工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为统计力学：系统微观变量由哈密顿量按标准统计力学规则完全确定；训练通过施加合适的外部场实现，不引入任何额外的逻辑或算法规则。具体模型为具有退火二分耦合的伊辛系统，并对其学习能力进行解析分析。

papers.title: Interlayer Exciton Condensate Stiffness Is Non-Monotonic in Quantum Metric
papers.abstract: Identifying the origin of the superfluid stiffness of electron-electron and electron-hole pair condensates is an important issue in flat-band physics. Here, we study the stiffness of bilayer exciton condensates using exact diagonalization and realistic Coulomb interactions across a wide variety of flat Chern band systems, including Landau levels, mixed Landau levels, and moiré bands. We find that stiffness is non-monotonic in the trace of the quantum metric and that it develops peaks when the band wavefunctions are engineered to be similar to those of Landau levels. The stiffness predicted by mean-field theory agrees quantitatively with exact diagonalization in these optimal cases, but systematically overestimates it otherwise. Flat bands with identical quantum geometry tensors can exhibit substantial differences in stiffness. The stiffness of condensates formed between moiré flat bands, which typically have strong variations in Berry curvature and quantum metric across their Brillouin zones, tends to be larger when the bands have non-zero Chern numbers and can be larger than that of Landau levels. Our results reveal a behavior that is richer than that suggested by simple geometric bounds and provide new guiding principles for the design of robust flat-band condensates with large superfluid stiffness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：exact diagonalization（精确对角化）、mean-field theory（平均场理论）、realistic Coulomb interactions（真实库仑相互作用）。；研究对象：双层激子凝聚体（bilayer exciton condensates）的超流刚度（superfluid stiffness），具体体系涵盖朗道能级（Landau levels）、混合朗道能级（mixed Landau levels）以及莫尔平带（moiré bands）等多种平带陈带系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子凝聚体的超流刚度随量子度量迹（trace of the quantum metric）的变化呈非单调行为，并在能带波函数被设计为接近朗道能级波函数时出现峰值；平均场理论仅在最优情况下与精确对角化定量一致，否则会系统性高估刚度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子凝聚体的超流刚度随量子度量迹（trace of the quantum metric）的变化呈非单调行为，并在能带波函数被设计为接近朗道能级波函数时出现峰值；平均场理论仅在最优情况下与精确对角化定量一致，否则会系统性高估刚度。；创新点：揭示了超流刚度与量子几何量之间的关系远比简单几何界（geometric bounds）所预言的行为更丰富，指出具有相同量子几何张量的平带其刚度仍可存在显著差异，并为设计具有大超流刚度的稳健平带凝聚体提供了新的指导原则。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确对角化方法，结合真实库仑相互作用，对多种平带陈带系统（朗道能级、混合朗道能级、莫尔带）进行数值计算；同时使用平均场理论进行对比分析。

papers.title: Scaling laws and energy dissipation in the dynamics of SLE curve as a 1D turbulence model
papers.abstract: In this study, we demonstrate the characteristics of the stochastic Loewner evolution (SLE) as a one-dimensional (1D) turbulence model. First, we show that the diffusion process $x(t)$ obtained by the time coordinate change in the SLE becomes the time dependent diffusion process that satisfies Richardson's law of turbulence.Subsequently, we derive the condition on the diffusivity parameter $κ$ such that the diffusion process $x(t)$ satisfies Kolmogorov's 4/5th law, which determines the relation between the mean energy dissipation and velocity in the particles of turbulence. Further mathematical analysis showed that this condition is seen as the condition on Loewner entropy $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$, which includes the white Gaussian noise term $W_{s}$ in the Loewner driving function of the present model. In addition, the numerical simulations were performed to verify the scaling relations of this 1D turbulence model. These results suggest that the standard SLE becomes a beneficial model of 1D turbulence by introducing an appropriate time coordinate change and imposing the conditions on $κ$ and $S_{\mathrm{Loew}}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“mathematical analysis”“derive the condition”“numerical simulations were performed”。；研究对象：随机Loewner演化（SLE）曲线作为一维（1D）湍流模型的动力学行为，具体涉及SLE驱动函数中的扩散过程、能量耗散与标度律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过适当的时间坐标变换，SLE中的扩散过程x(t)满足Richardson湍流定律；进一步对扩散参数κ施加条件后，该过程可满足Kolmogorov 4/5定律，从而将SLE与一维湍流的能量耗散统计联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过适当的时间坐标变换，SLE中的扩散过程x(t)满足Richardson湍流定律；进一步对扩散参数κ施加条件后，该过程可满足Kolmogorov 4/5定律，从而将SLE与一维湍流的能量耗散统计联系起来。；创新点：首次将标准SLE框架与一维湍流的经典标度律（Richardson定律、Kolmogorov 4/5定律）建立严格数学联系，并给出κ与Loewner熵上的可检验条件，使SLE成为一维湍流的实用模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数学分析：利用SLE的时间坐标变换构造扩散过程，推导κ的约束条件；将条件与Loewner熵S_Loew（含高斯白噪声项W_s）关联；辅以数值模拟验证标度关系。

papers.title: Mean-field theory for quantum spin chains
papers.abstract: Mean-field theory is a widely used approximation for describing phase transitions, particularly effective above the upper critical dimension. Its origins can be traced back to the van der Waals theory of the liquid-gas transition and Weiss's molecular field theory of the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition. However, it was Lev D. Landau who provided a unifying and general framework applicable to a broad class of physical systems. The mean-field approach typically involves neglecting thermal fluctuations, which is a reasonable assumption in many classical contexts. However, its application to quantum phase transitions at zero temperature is less common. The aim of this short pedagogical paper is to explore and clarify the use of the mean-field approach in the less familiar domain of quantum phase transitions. We specifically consider the Ising model and the Blume-Capel model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field theory、pedagogical paper、quantum phase transitions。；研究对象：量子自旋链中的量子相变，具体以Ising模型和Blume-Capel模型为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文旨在阐明平均场理论在零温度量子相变这一较少被探索的领域中的适用性，并探讨其与经典热相变中平均场处理的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文旨在阐明平均场理论在零温度量子相变这一较少被探索的领域中的适用性，并探讨其与经典热相变中平均场处理的差异。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该文为教学性短文，其新意在于系统梳理并澄清平均场方法在量子相变（而非经典热涨落）背景下的应用逻辑与局限性。
papers.method_zh: 采用平均场理论框架，对一维量子自旋链（Ising模型和Blume-Capel模型）进行解析分析，讨论如何将平均场近似推广到量子涨落主导的零温情形。

papers.title: Breakdown of the Overdamped Approximation in Fluctuating Environments
papers.abstract: The overdamped approximation is widely used to describe Brownian motion in complex environments, but its validity becomes nontrivial when the friction coefficient itself fluctuates in time. We investigate this problem by comparing underdamped and overdamped Langevin dynamics subject to the same fluctuating friction and satisfying the fluctuation--dissipation relation at a common temperature. We show that environmental averaging and inertial elimination generally lead to different long-time transport when environmental fluctuations are fast compared with velocity relaxation. For rapidly fluctuating friction, the underdamped dynamics is governed by the arithmetic mean friction and yields $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm under}=k_{\rm B}T/\langleγ\rangle$, whereas the overdamped dynamics gives $D_{\rm eff}^{\rm over}=k_{\rm B}T\langleγ^{-1}\rangle$. For a two-state Markov friction, we derive the finite-time effective diffusion coefficient exactly and identify the full crossover between these two regimes, controlled by the competition between velocity relaxation and environmental switching. We further establish the fast-fluctuation result for general stationary friction processes and verify it for a continuous log-Ornstein--Uhlenbeck environment, for which the characteristic crossover time can also be determined independently. Our results reveal a noncommutativity between environmental averaging and inertial elimination, establish a timescale-dependent criterion for the validity of overdamped dynamics in temporally heterogeneous environments, and show that rapid environmental fluctuations can enhance, rather than suppress, the consequences of inertia.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics、理论推导、解析计算。；研究对象：布朗运动在摩擦系数随时间波动的复杂环境中的输运行为，具体比较欠阻尼（underdamped）与过阻尼（overdamped）朗之万动力学在相同涨落摩擦下的长时间扩散性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境平均与惯性消除（惯性自由度消除）这两种操作不可交换：当环境涨落快于速度弛豫时，欠阻尼动力学由摩擦系数的算术平均决定，给出 D_eff^under = k_B T/⟨γ⟩；而过阻尼动力学给出 D_eff^over = k_B T⟨γ⁻¹⟩。快速环境涨落反而会增强惯性的影响，而非抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境平均与惯性消除（惯性自由度消除）这两种操作不可交换：当环境涨落快于速度弛豫时，欠阻尼动力学由摩擦系数的算术平均决定，给出 D_eff^under = k_B T/⟨γ⟩；而过阻尼动力学给出 D_eff^over = k_B T⟨γ⁻¹⟩。快速环境涨落反而会增强惯性的影响，而非抑制。；创新点：揭示了环境平均与惯性消除之间的非对易性，建立了时间尺度依赖的过阻尼近似有效性判据，并证明快速环境涨落会放大而非压制惯性效应。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导：对比欠阻尼与过阻尼朗之万方程（满足同一温度下的涨落耗散关系）；对两态马尔可夫摩擦过程精确求解有限时间有效扩散系数；对一般平稳摩擦过程建立快速涨落极限结果；并用连续对数奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克（log-Ornstein-Uhlenbeck）环境进行验证。

papers.title: 4 MV/cm (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Heterojunction Diodes Realized by Low-Damage e-Beam NiO$_x$ Interlayers
papers.abstract: We report on the utilization of a low-damage e-beam NiO$_x$ deposition process to realize field-plated heterojunction diodes (FP-HJDs) on (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ films with high critical breakdown field strengths beyond 4 MV/cm and power figure of merits (PFOM) of >1 GW/cm$^2$. Diodes were fabricated on a 2.67 $\times$ 10$^{16}$ cm$^{-3}$ intentionally doped 6.2 $μ$m thick epitaxial layer grown by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) on a conductive Sn-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ (010) substrate using TMGa, O$_2$, Ar carrier gas, and SiH$_4$ as the silicon dopant source. The mesa etched FP-HJD devices utilized a thin 7 nm e-beam NiO$_x$ interlayer before the sputtered NiO$_x$ layers to eliminate the effects of sputter-induced ion damage on the (010) epilayers. Current-Voltage measurements resulted in a forward current density of 700 A/cm$^2$ at 4 V, HJD ideality factor of 1.29, a V$_{bi}$ of 2 V, rectification ratio of 10$^{11}$, and a differential specific on resistance (R$_{on,sp}$) value of 2.36 m$Ω$ $\times$ cm$^2$. Breakdown of the (010) FP-HJDs was 1.64 kV, leading to a parallel plane electric field at breakdown (E$_{||,max}$) of 4.02 MV/cm and a PFOM of 1.14 GW/cm$^2$, which is a state-of-the-art result for diodes on MOCVD-grown (010) drift layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述器件制备工艺（e-beam NiOₓ沉积、MOCVD外延生长）、电学测量（电流-电压测试）及击穿特性数据。；研究对象：(010)取向β-Ga₂O₃基金属氧化物半导体异质结二极管，具体为NiOₓ/β-Ga₂O₃异质结，采用Sn掺杂导电衬底上的MOCVD外延漂移层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过低损伤电子束蒸发NiOₓ中间层工艺，在(010) β-Ga₂O₃上实现了击穿场强超过4 MV/cm、功率优值（PFOM）超过1 GW/cm²的场板异质结二极管，其中平行平面击穿电场达4.02 MV/cm，PFOM为1.14 GW/cm²，为MOCVD生长的(010)漂移层二极管的最优结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过低损伤电子束蒸发NiOₓ中间层工艺，在(010) β-Ga₂O₃上实现了击穿场强超过4 MV/cm、功率优值（PFOM）超过1 GW/cm²的场板异质结二极管，其中平行平面击穿电场达4.02 MV/cm，PFOM为1.14 GW/cm²，为MOCVD生长的(010)漂移层二极管的最优结果。；创新点：采用超薄（7 nm）低损伤电子束NiOₓ中间层，有效消除溅射工艺对(010)外延层造成的离子损伤，从而在(010)晶面实现超过4 MV/cm的高击穿场强——这是该工作的核心工艺创新。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：MOCVD外延生长（TMGa、O₂、Ar载气、SiH₄硅掺杂源）制备6.2 μm厚、掺杂浓度2.67×10¹⁶ cm⁻³的n型漂移层；低损伤电子束蒸发沉积7 nm NiOₓ中间层，随后溅射NiOₓ层；台面刻蚀及场板结构制备；电流-电压（I-V）特性测量。

papers.title: Evidence of Crystal-Field-Mediated Anisotropic Orbital Rashba Effect in Epitaxial Ru/FM Heterostructure
papers.abstract: Electrical generation of orbital angular momentum provides a promising route to current-induced torques, yet effective control of orbital Rashba textures still remains challenging, particularly because the role of the interfacial crystal field remains largely unexplored. Here, we report experimental evidence for a crystal-field-mediated interfacial anisotropic orbital Rashba effect (AORE) in epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures. Total orbital torque was disentangled into an isotropic bulk contribution and an in-plane anisotropic interfacial contribution. The latter was strongly suppressed by degrading the crystallinity of either constituent and by inserting a Cu spacer, highlighting the essential roles of coherent interfacial orbital hybridization and direct Ru/ferromagnet contact. These results identify interfacial crystal-field coherency as a key ingredient in manipulating orbital Rashba textures and establish a route toward engineering the symmetry and directionality of orbital torques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“experimental evidence”“reported”“epitaxial Ru/ferromagnet heterostructures”等实验关键词，且涉及对器件结构的制备与测量。；研究对象：外延生长的 Ru/铁磁金属（FM）异质结，具体研究该界面处的轨道 Rashba 效应及其各向异性，以及界面晶体场对轨道角动量输运的调控作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Ru/FM 异质结中观测到由界面晶体场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应（AORE），其贡献表现为面内各向异性的界面项，且该效应依赖于界面轨道杂化的相干性以及 Ru 与铁磁层的直接接触。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Ru/FM 异质结中观测到由界面晶体场介导的各向异性轨道 Rashba 效应（AORE），其贡献表现为面内各向异性的界面项，且该效应依赖于界面轨道杂化的相干性以及 Ru 与铁磁层的直接接触。；创新点：首次在实验上揭示界面晶体场对外延 Ru/FM 异质结中轨道 Rashba 织构的调控作用，提出“晶体场相干性”是控制轨道 Rashba 效应各向异性的关键因素，为设计轨道力矩的对称性与方向性提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如输运测量、自旋力矩铁磁共振、谐波测量等），但涉及对异质结的轨道力矩测量，并通过改变结晶质量（降低结晶度）、插入 Cu 间隔层等方式进行对照实验，以分离体相与界面贡献。

papers.title: Enhanced Multifractality Induced by Non-Hermitian Disorder in Quantum Percolation
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between geometric dilution and non-Hermitian disorder in the two-dimensional quantum site-percolation model. Non-Hermiticity is introduced through random imaginary on-site potentials, representing spatially uncorrelated gain and loss, while the hopping amplitudes remain reciprocal. By combining complex level-spacing statistics, participation entropy, and multifractal analysis, we characterize the localization properties of the eigenstates as functions of the disorder and the non-Hermiticity strength. Our finite-size scaling results show that non-Hermitian disorder shifts the quantum percolation threshold ($p_q$) toward larger occupation probabilities. Consequently, the fully delocalized phase is progressively suppressed and disappears at sufficiently strong disorder. This suppression is not a simple consequence of adding on-site disorder of a given strength, but is specifically enhanced by its imaginary character, as an equally strong real (Hermitian) on-site potential produces a weaker shift of $p_q$. Nevertheless, the intermediate region between the classical ($p_c$) and quantum percolation thresholds presents a genuine multifractal critical phase, while the localization-length exponent $ν$ remains the same, relative to its Hermitian value. Altogether, our results demonstrate that random gain and loss enhance the multifractal regime while preserving the universality class of the quantum percolation transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“finite-size scaling results”“multifractal analysis”“complex level-spacing statistics”等数值与理论分析手段，未涉及实验测量。；研究对象：二维量子位点渗流模型（quantum site-percolation model），并引入非厄米无序（随机虚数在位势，代表空间不相关的增益与损耗），研究几何稀释与非厄米无序的相互作用对电子态局域性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米无序将量子渗流阈值（p_q）推向更大的占据概率，从而抑制并最终消除完全退局域相；这种抑制并非单纯由在位无序强度引起，而是由其虚数（非厄米）特性所增强——同等强度的实（厄米）在位势对p_q的移动更弱。在经典阈值（p_c）与量子阈值（p_q）之间的中间区域仍存在真正的多重分形临界相，且局域化长度指数ν与厄米情形相同，表明随机增益与损耗增强了多重分形区间但保持了量子渗流跃迁的普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米无序将量子渗流阈值（p_q）推向更大的占据概率，从而抑制并最终消除完全退局域相；这种抑制并非单纯由在位无序强度引起，而是由其虚数（非厄米）特性所增强——同等强度的实（厄米）在位势对p_q的移动更弱。在经典阈值（p_c）与量子阈值（p_q）之间的中间区域仍存在真正的多重分形临界相，且局域化长度指数ν与厄米情形相同，表明随机增益与损耗增强了多重分形区间但保持了量子渗流跃迁的普适类。；创新点：揭示了非厄米无序（随机增益/损耗）对量子渗流阈值的移动效应显著强于等强度厄米无序，并证明非厄米性可增强多重分形临界相而不改变跃迁普适类。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 结合复能级间距统计（complex level-spacing statistics）、参与熵（participation entropy）与多重分形分析（multifractal analysis），对特征态局域性质随无序强度和非厄米强度变化进行表征，并采用有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）分析。

papers.title: Hydrogen Storage on Transition-Metal-Decorated Nitrogen-Modified Carbon Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Recently synthesized carbon nanoribbons (CNRs) were investigated for hydrogen (H2) storage using first-principles density functional theory calculations. Pristine CNRs exhibited weak H2 adsorption; therefore, the host structure was modified by substituting carbon atoms at the C-H edges with 12 nitrogen atoms, followed by Mn and Y doping to enhance H2 binding. A maximum of five metal atoms could be accommodated on the 12N-CNRs. Electronic structure analysis revealed strong orbital hybridization between the metal atoms and the CNRs, while binding energy calculations confirmed the structural stability of the doped systems. Bader charge analysis further quantified the charge transfer between the metal atoms and the host structure. The average H2 adsorption energies were calculated to be -0.40 eV/H2 for the Mn-doped system and -0.25 eV/H2 for the Y-doped system, which are within the desirable range for reversible hydrogen storage. The maximum theoretical gravimetric storage capacities at 0 K reached 7.48 wt% for the Mn-doped system and 6.55 wt% for the Y-doped system. Under practical conditions of 30 atm and 298.15 K, the storage capacity of the Y-doped system decreased to 6.04 wt%, whereas the Mn-doped system maintained its full capacity of 7.48 wt%. Thermodynamic analysis indicated that H2 adsorption is favored at low temperatures and high pressures, while desorption becomes feasible at elevated temperatures and lower pressures. These results demonstrate that Mn- and Y-doped CNRs satisfy key U.S. Department of Energy requirements for reversible H2 storage and show promise as potential hydrogen storage materials under near-ambient conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：过渡金属（Mn、Y）修饰的氮改性碳纳米带（12N-CNRs），用于氢气（H₂）存储。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn和Y掺杂的12N-CNRs体系对H₂的平均吸附能分别为-0.40 eV/H₂和-0.25 eV/H₂，处于可逆储氢的理想范围；在0 K下，Mn掺杂体系的理论最大重量储氢容量达7.48 wt%，Y掺杂体系为6.55 wt%，且在30 atm、298.15 K条件下Mn体系仍保持满容量，满足美国能源部（DOE）可逆储氢关键指标。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn和Y掺杂的12N-CNRs体系对H₂的平均吸附能分别为-0.40 eV/H₂和-0.25 eV/H₂，处于可逆储氢的理想范围；在0 K下，Mn掺杂体系的理论最大重量储氢容量达7.48 wt%，Y掺杂体系为6.55 wt%，且在30 atm、298.15 K条件下Mn体系仍保持满容量，满足美国能源部（DOE）可逆储氢关键指标。；创新点：首次将近期实验合成的碳纳米带通过12个氮原子取代C-H边缘碳原子进行修饰，并系统比较Mn与Y两种过渡金属掺杂对H₂存储性能的增强效果，在近环境条件下（30 atm、298.15 K）实现了满足DOE要求的储氢容量。摘要未突出说明与已有储氢材料相比的具体优势机制。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；电子结构分析（轨道杂化）；结合能计算（结构稳定性）；Bader电荷分析（电荷转移定量）；热力学分析（温度、压力对吸附/脱附的影响）。

papers.title: Light alkali metal functionalized two-dimensional C5N monolayers for enhanced hydrogen storage
papers.abstract: This work presents a density functional theory (DFT) investigation of a two-dimensional (2D) C5N monolayer functionalized with Li, Na, and K for hydrogen storage. Pristine C5N exhibits weak H2 adsorption, while alkali-metal functionalization significantly enhances its storage capability. The C5N monolayer can stably accommodate up to six metal dopants, with binding energies stronger than the corresponding cohesive energies, indicating resistance to metal aggregation. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further confirm the thermal stability of the functionalized systems at 300 K. Charge transfer from the metal dopants to C5N enhances polarization and strengthens H2 adsorption. Each dopant can adsorb up to eight H2 molecules, yielding a maximum of 48 H2 molecules per unit cell and gravimetric storage capacities of 9.42, 8.61, and 7.93 wt% for Li-, Na-, and K-functionalized C5N, respectively. The average H2 adsorption energies of -0.16 to -0.17 eV/H2 indicate moderate interactions suitable for reversible storage. Thermodynamic analysis further demonstrates favourable H2 adsorption/desorption under practical operating conditions, while desorption-temperature, recovery-time, and volumetric analyses support the potential reversibility and storage performance of these systems. Overall, alkali-metal-functionalized C5N emerges as a promising 2D material for efficient and reversible H2 storage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“density functional theory (DFT) investigation”以及“ab initio molecular dynamics simulations”。；研究对象：碱金属（Li、Na、K）功能化的二维C5N单层材料，及其用于氢气存储的物理性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碱金属功能化可显著增强C5N单层的储氢能力，每个掺杂原子可吸附多达8个H2分子，对应Li、Na、K功能化体系分别达到9.42、8.61和7.93 wt%的重量储氢容量，且平均H2吸附能为-0.16至-0.17 eV/H2，适合可逆储氢。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碱金属功能化可显著增强C5N单层的储氢能力，每个掺杂原子可吸附多达8个H2分子，对应Li、Na、K功能化体系分别达到9.42、8.61和7.93 wt%的重量储氢容量，且平均H2吸附能为-0.16至-0.17 eV/H2，适合可逆储氢。；创新点：首次系统研究了轻碱金属（Li、Na、K）功能化二维C5N单层的储氢性能，发现该体系兼具高储氢容量、抗金属团聚（结合能高于内聚能）和室温热稳定性，并展示了实际工况下良好的可逆性。摘要未突出说明与已有储氢材料相比的具体性能优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟（用于300 K热稳定性验证），以及热力学分析（涉及吸附/脱附温度、恢复时间、体积分析）。

papers.title: Demonstration of room-temperature, magnetic-field-free, and ultralow-power spin-orbit torque logic device based on composition-uniform van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2
papers.abstract: Van der Waals magnets have received blooming interest in material science and spintronics for the advantages of low magnetization, flexible stacking, strong tunability, and dangling-bond-free interfaces. However, there has been no report of room-temperature magnetic-field-free spin logic device based on a van der Waals magnet. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature, field-free, low-power, scalable spin-orbit torque in-memory computing logic device utilizing a van der Waals magnet Fe3GaTe2 bit with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy and a Pt channel with strong spin Hall effect, high electrical conductivity, and electric asymmetries. Current pulse width-dependent switching measurement reveals a low intrinsic critical magnetic-field-free switching current of 1.8e7 A cm-2, a high thermal stability factor of 50, and the potential of an ultralow write power of 1.5 fJ per bit at 1 ns pulse width for a typical industrial-level device dimensions (40 times lower than the industrially optimized W/FeCoB device). These results suggest a great potential of van der Waals magnets in dense, ultralow-power, scalable in-memory computing technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we demonstrate”“switching measurement reveals”等实验性表述，涉及器件制备与电学测量。；研究对象：基于范德瓦尔斯磁性材料Fe₃GaTe₂（具有垂直磁各向异性）与Pt通道（具有强自旋霍尔效应）构成的自旋轨道矩（SOT）逻辑器件，用于存内计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该器件在室温、无外加磁场条件下实现了超低功耗的自旋轨道矩逻辑开关，其本征无场开关电流密度低至1.8×10⁷ A/cm²，热稳定性因子达50，在工业级尺寸下1 ns脉宽写入功耗仅1.5 fJ/bit，比工业优化的W/FeCoB器件低40倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该器件在室温、无外加磁场条件下实现了超低功耗的自旋轨道矩逻辑开关，其本征无场开关电流密度低至1.8×10⁷ A/cm²，热稳定性因子达50，在工业级尺寸下1 ns脉宽写入功耗仅1.5 fJ/bit，比工业优化的W/FeCoB器件低40倍。；创新点：首次在范德瓦尔斯磁性材料中实现室温、无磁场、超低功耗的自旋逻辑器件，突破了此前范德瓦尔斯磁体无法用于室温无场自旋逻辑器件的瓶颈，展示了其在密集、超低功耗、可扩展存内计算中的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了Fe₃GaTe₂/Pt异质结器件，利用Pt通道的电不对称性实现无场开关；通过改变电流脉冲宽度进行开关特性测量，提取本征临界开关电流、热稳定性因子，并基于工业级器件尺寸估算写入功耗。

papers.title: Initialization-free ultralow-power programmable spin-orbit torque logic devices enabled by chirally asymmetric switching
papers.abstract: Spin logic is of great interest for the development of high-performance, non-Von Neumann artificial intelligence chips. Of particular advantage is the programmable spin-orbit torque logic that can achieve the complete set of the 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device in an initialization-free, low-power, and scalable manner, which is, however, a challenge despite remarkable efforts over more than two decades. Here, utilizing chirally asymmetric switching, we demonstrate an initialization-free, low-power, programmable spin-orbit torque logic device that is capable of the complete set of 16 Boolean logic operations within a single device with only three inputs and ultralow power of < 1 fJ/bit. We also propose the first initialization-free, all-electrical spin-based cascading computing devices, including a half adder, a three-level full adder, a two-level full adder, and a Transfer/NOT selector. These compact and scalable computing devices are enabled by the chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching of a Ta/FeCoB bilayer with a significant perpendicular Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction field. These results pave an intriguing way for the development of next-generation high-performance large-scale in-memory computing chips based on chirally asymmetric spin-orbit torque switching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we demonstrate”“we propose”等表述，并涉及器件制备与测量（如Ta/FeCoB双层结构、自旋轨道矩开关行为）。；研究对象：基于Ta/FeCoB双层结构的自旋轨道矩（SOT）逻辑器件，具体物理现象为手性不对称磁化翻转（chirally asymmetric switching），并涉及垂直Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用手性不对称SOT翻转，实现了单器件内完整16种布尔逻辑运算，且无需初始化、功耗低于1 fJ/bit；并首次提出了全电学、免初始化的自旋级联计算器件（半加器、三级全加器、两级全加器及Transfer/NOT选择器）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用手性不对称SOT翻转，实现了单器件内完整16种布尔逻辑运算，且无需初始化、功耗低于1 fJ/bit；并首次提出了全电学、免初始化的自旋级联计算器件（半加器、三级全加器、两级全加器及Transfer/NOT选择器）。；创新点：首次在单一器件中实现免初始化、超低功耗（<1 fJ/bit）的完整16种布尔逻辑运算，仅需三个输入；并首次提出基于手性不对称SOT翻转的全电学级联计算架构，为大规模存内计算芯片提供了可扩展方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了Ta/FeCoB双层结构，利用其显著垂直DMI场实现手性不对称SOT翻转；通过电学测量表征逻辑运算功能与功耗。摘要未明确说明具体测量技术（如反常霍尔效应、磁光克尔效应等）或微纳加工细节。

papers.title: Metallic Organometallic and Semiconducting Covalent Phases of Free-Standing $γ$-Graphdiyne Molecular Wires
papers.abstract: One-dimensional carbon allotropes combining sp and sp2 hybridizations provide a versatile platform for atomically precise quantum wires with tunable electronic, vibrational, and mechanical responses. Recent on-surface synthesis has realized the $γ$-graphdiyne molecular wire on Au(100) in two interconvertible phases sharing an identical aromatic backbone but distinct linkage chemistry: an organometallic intermediate with C-Au-C bridges and a fully covalent product with diacetylenic linkages. While experimental techniques characterize the on-surface periodicity and C$\equiv$C Raman signatures, the intrinsic properties of the free-standing wires remain inaccessible. Here, we address this gap using hybrid-functional first-principles calculations. The covalent phase is a semiconductor with a direct band gap of 2.02 eV, a polyynic bond-length alternation of 0.117 Å, and a chain periodicity reproducing experiment within -0.5%. Conversely, the organometallic phase exhibits partial cumulenization and 1D metallic behavior, with spin channels crossing the Fermi level. Both isolated polymers demonstrate dynamic stability with Young's moduli of 995 nN and 861 nN, respectively, where the C-Au-C bridge acts as a soft link absorbing 9.2% of axial deformation at +6% macroscopic strain. Species-resolved vibrational analysis identifies an effective-conjugation-coordinate band at 1408 cm$^{-1}$ for the covalent phase and Au-projected modes below 400 cm$^{-1}$ for the intermediate, offering diagnostic fingerprints for phase discrimination during thermal or chemical conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid-functional first-principles calculations”（杂化泛函第一性原理计算），且全文为理论模拟，无实验新数据。；研究对象：自由站立（free-standing）的γ-石墨二炔（γ-graphdiyne）一维分子线，包括两种可相互转化的相：有机金属相（含C-Au-C桥键）和共价相（含二炔键）。研究其电子结构、振动特性与力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共价相为直接带隙2.02 eV的半导体，具有0.117 Å的聚炔型键长交替；有机金属相则呈现部分累积烯化（cumulenization）特征和金属性（自旋通道穿越费米能级）。两种相均动态稳定，杨氏模量分别为995 nN（共价相）和861 nN（有机金属相）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共价相为直接带隙2.02 eV的半导体，具有0.117 Å的聚炔型键长交替；有机金属相则呈现部分累积烯化（cumulenization）特征和金属性（自旋通道穿越费米能级）。两种相均动态稳定，杨氏模量分别为995 nN（共价相）和861 nN（有机金属相）。；创新点：首次通过理论计算揭示了实验上无法直接测量的自由站立γ-石墨二炔分子线的本征电子性质（半导体vs金属），并给出区分两种相（有机金属中间体与完全共价产物）的振动指纹峰（共价相1408 cm⁻¹有效共轭坐标带，有机金属相400 cm⁻¹以下Au投影模式）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函第一性原理计算（hybrid-functional DFT），对孤立一维聚合物进行电子结构、声子/振动模式（物种分辨振动分析）及力学应变响应（+6%宏观应变下轴向变形分配）的计算。

papers.title: A discrete crack-tip theory for nonlinear lattice networks
papers.abstract: Crack-tip fields govern deformation localization and failure initiation. Classical continuum fracture mechanics describes these fields through theories such as the Hutchinson-Rice-Rosengren (HRR) field for nonlinear power-law solids. However, continuum descriptions break down near cracks in soft and architected materials, where load is transmitted through discrete chains, fibers, or struts. Here, we develop a discrete crack-tip theory for lattice networks with nonlinear chains. The theory has two central components. First, at large deformation, the strain of a representative chain in layer $i$ depends approximately linearly on the applied macroscopic strain, $\varepsilon_i\approx k_i(λ-1)$, defining a layer-dependent strain-amplification factor $k_i$. Second, along topology-selected chain directions, termed discrete HRR lines, the layer-to-layer ratios of $k_i$ follow a two-regime scaling law. Together, for a power-law chain force-strain relation with exponent $p$, the inner discrete regime predicts $\varepsilon_i\sim i^{-1/p}$ and $f_i\sim i^{-1}$, which differs from the classical continuum HRR prediction. The theory also explains why the intrinsic fracture energy approaches a size-independent limit as the network size increases. Photoelastic hydrogel experiments further validate our theory. These results reveal a two-regime crack-tip scaling law in nonlinear lattice networks and provide a framework for predicting chain deformation and intrinsic fracture energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章，辅以实验验证。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a discrete crack-tip theory”（发展理论），并包含“Photoelastic hydrogel experiments further validate our theory”（光弹性水凝胶实验验证理论），属于理论为主、实验为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：非线性晶格网络（lattice networks）中的裂纹尖端场，具体关注由离散链、纤维或支柱传递载荷的软材料与拓扑构筑材料中的变形局部化与断裂起始行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非线性晶格网络中，裂纹尖端存在两区标度律：沿拓扑选择的离散HRR线，链应变满足 ε_i ~ i^(-1/p)、链力满足 f_i ~ i^(-1)，这与经典连续介质HRR场预测不同；同时该理论解释了为何本征断裂能随网络尺寸增大趋于与尺寸无关的极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非线性晶格网络中，裂纹尖端存在两区标度律：沿拓扑选择的离散HRR线，链应变满足 ε_i ~ i^(-1/p)、链力满足 f_i ~ i^(-1)，这与经典连续介质HRR场预测不同；同时该理论解释了为何本征断裂能随网络尺寸增大趋于与尺寸无关的极限。；创新点：首次提出针对非线性晶格网络的离散裂纹尖端理论，揭示了与经典连续介质HRR理论不同的离散标度律（ε_i ~ i^(-1/p) 与 f_i ~ i^(-1)），并建立了预测链变形与本征断裂能的理论框架。摘要未突出说明与已有离散断裂模型的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于离散链的裂纹尖端理论，包含两个核心要素——(1) 大变形下第 i 层代表性链的应变与外加宏观应变近似线性关系 ε_i ≈ k_i(λ−1)，定义层依赖的应变放大因子 k_i；(2) 沿拓扑选择的链方向（离散HRR线），k_i 的层间比值遵循两区标度律。实验手段：光弹性水凝胶实验用于验证理论预测。

papers.title: Structural tuning of reduced exciton mass in layered HOIP compounds: Causation vs. correlation
papers.abstract: Reduced exciton mass ($μ$) was recently reported to correlate strongly with a framework distortion in a series of nine single-layer (2D) metal-halide perovskite (HOIP) compounds. Specifically, $μ$ was observed to increase in tandem with an alternating PbI4 octahedral tilt about an in-plane axis. In this work, we use group representation theory to decompose the observed framework distortions into displacive symmetry modes of a common high-symmetry parent framework. We find that all nine distorted frameworks involve linear combinations of the same six symmetry modes, which have been reported to contribute to the framework distortions of a wide range of HOIP compounds. We show that these modes have highly correlated impacts on the band structure. To differentiate causation from correlation, we vary the amplitude of each mode independently and use density-functional theory to determine the resulting electronic band structures, from which $μ$ is extracted. We find that bond-transverse displacements of the equatorial halide atoms increase $μ$, while bond-transverse displacements of the apical halide atoms decrease it. Bond-axis displacements appear to have little or no effect on $μ$. Our results demonstrate three new structure-property relationships, revealing a promising new avenue for exciton engineering in layered perovskite materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“group representation theory”“density-functional theory”等理论工具，并基于DFT计算提取激子质量。；研究对象：九种单层（二维）金属卤化物钙钛矿（HOIP）化合物，具体为PbI₄八面体框架的畸变模式及其对激子质量（μ）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子质量μ并非由整体框架畸变幅度简单决定，而是取决于特定对称位移模式：赤道面卤素原子的键横向位移增大μ，顶角卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，而键轴方向位移对μ几乎无影响。这揭示了三种新的结构-性质关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子质量μ并非由整体框架畸变幅度简单决定，而是取决于特定对称位移模式：赤道面卤素原子的键横向位移增大μ，顶角卤素原子的键横向位移减小μ，而键轴方向位移对μ几乎无影响。这揭示了三种新的结构-性质关系。；创新点：将先前报道的“μ与框架畸变的相关性”提升为“因果性”分析，通过独立调控对称模式振幅区分不同位移类型对μ的相反贡献，提出基于特定原子位移的激子工程新途径。
papers.method_zh: 群表示理论分解框架畸变为高对称母相中的位移对称模式；独立改变各模式振幅，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算电子能带结构并提取激子质量μ。

papers.title: From Single-Chain Dynamics to Structure Formation: Dynamic Self-Consistent Field Theory and Molecular Dynamics of (Co)polymer Melts across Entanglement Regimes
papers.abstract: Dynamic self-consistent field theory (DSCFT) provides an efficient continuum framework for studying structure formation in inhomogeneous polymer systems, but its predictive accuracy depends on the choice of the nonlocal mobilities. Here, we construct mobility functions for moderately and strongly entangled homopolymer and diblock copolymer systems from the relaxation dynamics of single-chain structure factors, based on molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the Kremer-Grest model and analytical reptation theory. Single- chain mobilities are combined such that the resulting DSCFT accounts for the dependence of fluxes on local chain densities. The theory is then applied to the spinodal decomposition of symmetric homopolymer blends and diblock copolymer melts following a quench into the (micro)phase-separation regime. Predictions of DSCFT are systematically compared with MD simulations. Mobility functions derived from single-chain dynamics are found to reproduce the kinetics of structure formation more accurately than conventional Debye-type mobilities. We additionally investigate the influence of adding stochastic currents (noise) that are correlated according to the fluctuation-dissipation relation. At low noise levels, they enable the generation of equilibrium initial states and facilitate defect annealing. At high noise levels, however, nonolinear effects lead to discrepancies between DSCFT and MD simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“动态自洽场理论（DSCFT）”“分子动力学（MD）模拟”“解析 reptation 理论”等理论建模与模拟方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：均聚物熔体与二嵌段共聚物熔体，涵盖从弱缠结到强缠结的不同缠结区间；具体物理现象包括旋节线分解（spinodal decomposition）及微相分离动力学、结构形成过程中的单链弛豫与迁移率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于单链动力学构造的迁移率函数比传统 Debye 型迁移率能更准确地再现 DSCFT 预测的（微）相分离结构形成动力学；低噪声水平下随机流有助于生成平衡初态并促进缺陷退火，但高噪声下非线性效应导致 DSCFT 与 MD 模拟出现偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于单链动力学构造的迁移率函数比传统 Debye 型迁移率能更准确地再现 DSCFT 预测的（微）相分离结构形成动力学；低噪声水平下随机流有助于生成平衡初态并促进缺陷退火，但高噪声下非线性效应导致 DSCFT 与 MD 模拟出现偏差。；创新点：将单链弛豫动力学（来自 MD 与 reptation 理论）系统性地嵌入 DSCFT 的迁移率函数，并针对不同缠结强度（中等与强缠结）的均聚物/共聚物体系，首次系统比较了该迁移率方案与传统 Debye 型迁移率在结构形成动力学预测上的差异，同时定量考察了噪声强度对 DSCFT 有效性的影响。
papers.method_zh: ① 分子动力学（MD）模拟，采用 Kremer-Grest 模型；② 解析 reptation 理论；③ 动态自洽场理论（DSCFT），其中迁移率函数由单链结构因子的弛豫动力学构造，并组合为依赖局域链密度的通量形式；④ 在 DSCFT 中加入满足涨落-耗散关系的随机流（噪声）以考察其影响。

papers.title: Layer Architecture Shapes Electronic, Magnetic, and Lattice Interactions in Ruddlesden-Popper Nickelates
papers.abstract: The discovery of superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates has raised a central question: how does layer architecture shape the electronic, magnetic, and lattice interactions relevant to pairing? Here, we report a detailed comparative study of the two polymorphs of La3Ni2O7--the alternating monolayer-trilayer (LNO-1313) and bilayer (LNO-2222) structures--and the related trilayer compound La4Ni3O10, using both Ni L3- and O K-edge RIXS. We find that LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 share strikingly similar electronic, magnetic, and lattice excitations, whereas bilayer LNO-2222 exhibits distinct features. Compared to LNO-2222, LNO-1313 and La4Ni3O10 have weaker orbital polarization, enhanced 3d8L character, a reduced out-of-plane magnetic-exchange scale, and stronger EPC. Within an effective local-moment framework, an entangled-dimer scenario provides a natural description of the spin excitations generated by strong antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling. Its advantage over conventional spin-wave theory is clearest in bilayer LNO-2222, where the interlayer coupling dominates the intralayer interactions. These findings provide critical experimental constraints for future theoretical models for the low-energy physics relevant to superconductivity in these layered nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“RIXS”（共振非弹性X射线散射）作为实验手段，并报告了“comparative study”（对比研究）的实验结果。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）相镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇的两种多型体——交替单层-三层结构（LNO-1313）与双层结构（LNO-2222），以及相关三层化合物La₄Ni₃O₁₀。研究聚焦于这些体系中与超导配对相关的电子、磁性与晶格相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LNO-1313与La₄Ni₃O₁₀在电子、磁性和晶格激发上高度相似，而双层LNO-2222则表现出明显不同的特征；相较于LNO-2222，前两者具有更弱的轨道极化、更强的3d⁸L（配体空穴）特征、更小的面外磁交换尺度以及更强的电子-声子耦合（EPC）。在有效局域磁矩框架下，纠缠二聚体（entangled-dimer）图像能自然描述由强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发，且在层间耦合主导的LNO-2222中优势最为明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LNO-1313与La₄Ni₃O₁₀在电子、磁性和晶格激发上高度相似，而双层LNO-2222则表现出明显不同的特征；相较于LNO-2222，前两者具有更弱的轨道极化、更强的3d⁸L（配体空穴）特征、更小的面外磁交换尺度以及更强的电子-声子耦合（EPC）。在有效局域磁矩框架下，纠缠二聚体（entangled-dimer）图像能自然描述由强反铁磁层间耦合产生的自旋激发，且在层间耦合主导的LNO-2222中优势最为明显。；创新点：首次对La₃Ni₂O₇的两种多型体（1313与2222）及三层化合物La₄Ni₃O₁₀进行同一实验条件下的RIXS对比研究，揭示层状堆叠方式（层架构）如何系统性调控轨道极化、电荷转移（3d⁸L权重）、磁交换耦合与电子-声子耦合强度，并提出纠缠二聚体框架优于传统自旋波理论来描述此类强层间耦合体系的自旋动力学。
papers.method_zh: 使用Ni L₃边和O K边的共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）对三种镍氧化物体系进行系统对比测量，分析其电子激发、磁激发（自旋波/自旋激发谱）与晶格振动（声子）激发特征。

papers.title: Calculation of DFT Spin-Orbit Spillage with Quantum ESPRESSO
papers.abstract: This work describes the calculation of spin-orbit spillage from a crystal structure. Spin-orbit spillage provides a measure of the likelihood that a material has topological character. The spillage also provides the reference quantity for the machine-learning classifier of Choudhary et al., which predicts whether the spillage exceeds a specified threshold rather than the calculation of its numerical value directly. The complete computation workflow was applied to the insulating compound BaMg2Bi2, yielding a spillage of 2.094 compared with the published VASP spillage of 2.075, corresponding to a difference of 0.9%. The calculation is described in terms of two Quantum ESPRESSO (QE) calculations of spillage performed with and without spin-orbit coupling, the role of relativistic pseudopotentials, and the subsequent wavefunction-overlap analysis. The limitations of the same calculation procedure for semimetals are also examined.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“calculation of spin-orbit spillage”，涉及Quantum ESPRESSO计算与波函数重叠分析。；研究对象：绝缘化合物BaMg2Bi2，以及半金属材料（作为计算流程适用性检验对象）。物理现象为自旋-轨道 spillage 作为材料拓扑性质的度量指标。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对BaMg2Bi2计算得到的自旋-轨道 spillage 为2.094，与已发表的VASP结果2.075相差0.9%，验证了基于Quantum ESPRESSO的计算流程的准确性。同时指出该流程对半金属材料存在局限性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对BaMg2Bi2计算得到的自旋-轨道 spillage 为2.094，与已发表的VASP结果2.075相差0.9%，验证了基于Quantum ESPRESSO的计算流程的准确性。同时指出该流程对半金属材料存在局限性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作主要贡献在于将spillage计算流程具体实现于Quantum ESPRESSO平台，并与已有VASP结果进行交叉验证，同时考察了该流程对半金属体系的适用边界。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的Quantum ESPRESSO计算，分别进行含与不含自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的两组计算，使用相对论赝势，随后进行波函数重叠分析以计算spillage值。

papers.title: Triboelectrification of a dense metal-organic framework for resilient mechanical energy harvesters
papers.abstract: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) incorporating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) have largely been designed around porous architectures, based on the assumption that high internal surface area is the primary driver for triboelectric enhancement. Herein, we demonstrate that a dense, nominally nonporous MOF called ZIF-zni can instead function as an effective high-loading filler within a tribopositive polyurethane (PU) matrix, offering a design strategy for harnessing interfacial electromechanical effects. A 20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU composite delivers an output voltage of 470+/-15 V and a peak power density of 1.31+/-0.03 W m-2 against polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS). The device exhibits stable performance over ~94,000 cycles under a contact force of ~100 N, and it remains operational under higher impact beyond 500 N. This concept enables the demonstration of a proof-of-concept triboelectric floor tile. Combined experimental and theoretical studies indicate that the performance enhancement arises from favourable interfacial polarization, reduced dielectric screening, and surface accessible ZIF-zni rich domains, rather than porosity alone. These features are accompanied by reduced work of adhesion and modified surface roughness, hence improving contact electrification. These findings establish dense MOFs as an effective triboelectric filler and identify interfacial electronic structure and polarization as key design parameters for engineering mechanical energy harvesters and self-powered sensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含实验与理论结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Combined experimental and theoretical studies”，并给出了具体实验测量数据（输出电压、功率密度、循环次数等）。；研究对象：致密（名义上无孔）金属有机框架材料ZIF-zni，作为摩擦正性填料分散于聚氨酯（PU）基体中，构成ZIF-zni@PU复合摩擦电材料，用于摩擦纳米发电机（TENG）的机械能量收集。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 致密、非多孔的MOF（ZIF-zni）可作为高效高负载摩擦电填料，20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU复合物对PDMS产生470±15 V输出电压和1.31±0.03 W m⁻²峰值功率密度，性能提升源于界面极化、介电屏蔽减弱及表面可及ZIF-zni富集区域，而非孔隙率本身。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：致密、非多孔的MOF（ZIF-zni）可作为高效高负载摩擦电填料，20 wt% ZIF-zni@PU复合物对PDMS产生470±15 V输出电压和1.31±0.03 W m⁻²峰值功率密度，性能提升源于界面极化、介电屏蔽减弱及表面可及ZIF-zni富集区域，而非孔隙率本身。；创新点：突破了以往TENG中MOF设计依赖多孔结构（高内表面积）的假设，首次证明致密、名义上无孔的MOF（ZIF-zni）也能作为有效摩擦电填料，并将界面电子结构与极化确立为机械能量收集器设计的关键参数。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备ZIF-zni@PU复合摩擦电材料并组装TENG器件，测量输出电压、功率密度、循环稳定性（~94,000次，~100 N接触力）及高冲击（>500 N）下的工作性能；构建了概念验证的摩擦电地板砖。理论上结合计算研究分析界面极化、介电屏蔽、功函数（粘附功）及表面粗糙度对接触起电的影响。

papers.title: Composition-dependent nonlinear viscoelastic-viscoplastic behavior and constitutive framework for digitally mixed polymers spanning the glass transition
papers.abstract: Multi-material PolyJet printing produces voxel-scale digital mixtures of an elastomeric photopolymer (Agilus) and a glassy photopolymer (Vero), giving a material family whose room-temperature response ranges from elastomeric to glassy; a unified description spanning the family has remained challenging. Large-deformation uniaxial compression over nearly three orders of magnitude in strain rate reveals a nonlinear, rate-dependent load-unload response that evolves continuously with composition, from recoverable elastomeric hysteresis to glassy yield with post-yield softening, hardening, and substantial residual strain. Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) shows that each mixture has a single glass transition temperature ($T_g$) that shifts to higher temperature with both Vero fraction and frequency, so composition acts much as temperature or loading rate does. This time-composition equivalence motivates one constitutive structure for the whole family rather than a separate property set per mixture: an equilibrium hyperelastic network with three non-equilibrium, rate-dependent branches carrying reptational, intermolecular, and glassy resistance. Its properties are anchored at the two endpoints and interpolated by smooth composition scaling laws. The model captures the compression response of all seven calibrated compositions and predicts a withheld mixture from the scaling laws alone. Resolving the predicted stress into its branches shows the load passing from the elastomeric to the glassy mechanism, and the work from elastic storage to dissipation, as Vero content and rate rise. The glass transition that DMA maps at small strain therefore governs the large-strain deformation mechanisms. The framework gives a compact, physically based description of digitally mixed polymers and a predictive basis for designing functionally graded, architected multi-material structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Large-deformation uniaxial compression”“Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA)”等实验手段，以及“constitutive framework”“model captures”“predicts”等理论建模与预测描述。；研究对象：数字混合聚合物（digitally mixed polymers），即通过多材料PolyJet打印制备的弹性体光聚合物（Agilus）与玻璃态光聚合物（Vero）的体素级混合物，其室温响应跨越从弹性体到玻璃态的整个玻璃化转变区间。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料家族中，组分比例（Vero含量）与温度、加载速率具有时间-组分等效性，因此可用单一本构框架（而非每种组分单独建模）统一描述从可恢复弹性滞后到玻璃态屈服、后屈服软化、硬化及显著残余应变的非线性率相关力学响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料家族中，组分比例（Vero含量）与温度、加载速率具有时间-组分等效性，因此可用单一本构框架（而非每种组分单独建模）统一描述从可恢复弹性滞后到玻璃态屈服、后屈服软化、硬化及显著残余应变的非线性率相关力学响应。；创新点：提出时间-组分等效性，使整个材料家族共享一个统一本构结构，而非为每种混合物单独拟合参数；模型仅凭标度律即可预测未参与校准的混合组分响应，并可将预测应力分解到各分支以揭示载荷从弹性体机制向玻璃态机制、功从弹性存储向耗散的转移。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用大变形单轴压缩（应变率跨度近三个数量级）测量载荷-卸载响应，并用动态力学分析（DMA）测定各混合物的玻璃化转变温度。理论上构建了包含一个平衡超弹性网络和三个非平衡率相关分支（分别承载 reptational、分子间和玻璃态阻力）的本构模型，模型参数锚定于两个端点组分，并通过平滑组分标度律插值。

papers.title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
papers.abstract: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations. A unified interface automatically maps scalar, uniform-basis, and multispecies operators to compressed sparse row (CSR), block sparse row (BSR), or variable-block compressed sparse row (VBCSR). Our advanced acceleration method groups blocks of equal shape and dispatches them to optimized dense kernels. In the reported benchmarks, VBCSR outperforms the tested Python-accessible reference implementations for several block-sparse benchmarks. We further demonstrate VBCSR in an InP nanoparticle application containing more than \(10^6\) atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法开发文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于“分布式稀疏矩阵库”“线性代数加速”“基准测试”，属于面向大规模原子模拟的计算方法开发。；研究对象：大规模原子模拟中的稀疏块矩阵运算，具体应用体系为InP纳米颗粒（原子数超过10⁶）。研究对象并非特定物理现象，而是模拟中量子算符的矩阵表示与高效计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VBCSR库通过保留并利用原子块的可变尺寸结构，将相同形状的块分组并调度到优化的稠密核上，在多个块稀疏基准测试中优于所测试的Python可访问参考实现，并能处理超过10⁶原子的InP纳米颗粒模拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VBCSR库通过保留并利用原子块的可变尺寸结构，将相同形状的块分组并调度到优化的稠密核上，在多个块稀疏基准测试中优于所测试的Python可访问参考实现，并能处理超过10⁶原子的InP纳米颗粒模拟。；创新点：提出一种能保留化学物种和基组导致的“可变尺寸原子块”结构的稀疏矩阵存储格式，并利用块形状分组实现稠密核加速，突破了传统标量稀疏格式（如CSR）对局部块结构的忽视。摘要未突出说明与其他非Python库（如PETSc、SLEPc等）的对比。
papers.method_zh: 开发了分布式稀疏矩阵库VBCSR（variable-block compressed sparse row），提供统一接口自动将标量、均匀基组和多物种算符映射到CSR、BSR或VBCSR格式；加速策略为按块形状分组并调用优化的稠密线性代数核。基准测试对比了Python可访问的参考实现。

papers.title: Speed-quality tradeoff in a physical model of molecular sorting
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic cells rely on membrane-mediated processes to compartmentalize biomolecules, counteracting diffusion-driven homogenization. These processes involve the selective sorting and packing of molecules into lipid vesicles, which are then dispatched to appropriate intracellular destinations. Previous works introduced an abstract statistical physics framework for studying this molecular distillation process, where the membrane was treated as static and the focus was on molecular aggregation and extraction. Here, we extend this framework to explicitly incorporate dynamic membrane behavior, including bending, curvature generation, and changes in membrane size due to vesicle fusion and fission events. Sorting domains drive membrane curvature, leading to vesicle formation, detachment, and a molecular distillation process that alters membrane size. Using mesoscopic modeling and numerical tools, we investigate the resulting interplay between membrane mechanics and molecular sorting. We determine a well-defined parameter region where vesicle fission and efficient molecular sorting occur, controlled by membrane rigidity, spontaneous curvature, and pressure difference across the membrane. We further identify a trade-off between speed and quality of molecular distillation: parameters that accelerate vesicle formation tend to reduce the quality of distillation, and vice versa. We propose maximization of the rate of negative entropy production as a natural criterion to optimally balance these competing effects. In this context, optimal parameters emerge naturally from the coupled dynamics of molecular aggregation and membrane mechanics, suggesting a possible strategy for cellular sorting systems to strike an efficient balance between rapid vesicle formation and high sorting quality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：abstract statistical physics framework、mesoscopic modeling and numerical tools。；研究对象：真核细胞中膜介导的分子分选（molecular sorting）过程，具体为脂质囊泡形成、融合与分裂驱动的分子蒸馏，以及膜弯曲、刚性与跨膜压差对分选效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 膜力学与分子分选存在明确的耦合参数区间（由膜刚性、自发曲率和跨膜压差控制），在该区间内囊泡分裂与高效分选可同时发生；分选速度与质量之间存在权衡，最大化负熵产生速率可作为平衡两者的自然判据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：膜力学与分子分选存在明确的耦合参数区间（由膜刚性、自发曲率和跨膜压差控制），在该区间内囊泡分裂与高效分选可同时发生；分选速度与质量之间存在权衡，最大化负熵产生速率可作为平衡两者的自然判据。；创新点：将膜力学动态过程（弯曲、分裂、尺寸变化）与分子聚集/提取的统计物理框架耦合，首次揭示分选速度-质量权衡，并提出以负熵产生率最大化作为动态自洽选择最优参数的原理性判据。
