papers.title: Fukui-Kawakami chains: spectrum and hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry
papers.abstract: Fukui and Kawakami showed that the trigonometric Haldane--Shastry (HS) spin chain can be deformed by introducing twisted boundary conditions. In this work we revisit the resulting twisted HS chains, which we call Fukui--Kawakami (FK) chains. We analyse their spectra in dependence of the twist parameter, utilising a direct connection with the (untwisted) HS chain. This allows us to explain why part of the spectrum can be described by Fukui and Kawakami's twisted Bethe equations, and can be constructed from Yangian highest weight states. These states can be labelled by combinatorial data called `motifs', as in the HS chain, which cover some of the (deformed) descendants. We furthermore show that there are other descendants which do not follow from these Bethe equations, but whose energy can be described as a sum of two single-particle energies, suggesting additional hidden symmetries. We then focus on the special case of antiperiodic boundary conditions, and show that this chain coincides with the `minimally polarised' long-range model recently introduced by Basu-Mallick, Finkel, and González-López. Remarkably, this connection implies that the antiperiodic chain has a hidden $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$-symmetry, which we use to relate the HS motifs to their `supersymmetric' $\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)$ counterparts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectra分析、Bethe equations、symmetry、理论推导。；研究对象：Fukui–Kawakami（FK）链，即带扭曲边界条件的三角函数型Haldane–Shastry（HS）自旋链，属于一维长程自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FK链的谱可部分由Fukui–Kawakami扭曲Bethe方程描述并可从Yangian最高权重态构造；但存在另一类不服从这些Bethe方程的“后代”态，其能量可表示为两个单粒子能量之和，暗示额外隐藏对称性。特别地，反周期边界条件下该链等价于“最小极化”长程模型，并具有隐藏的\(\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)\)对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FK链的谱可部分由Fukui–Kawakami扭曲Bethe方程描述并可从Yangian最高权重态构造；但存在另一类不服从这些Bethe方程的“后代”态，其能量可表示为两个单粒子能量之和，暗示额外隐藏对称性。特别地，反周期边界条件下该链等价于“最小极化”长程模型，并具有隐藏的\(\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)\)对称性。；创新点：揭示了FK链谱中除Bethe方程可描述部分之外还存在其他后代态，并发现反周期FK链与已知长程模型的等价性，从而证明其隐藏\(\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)\)对称性，并将HS motif与超对称motif联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用FK链与（无扭曲）HS链的直接联系来分析谱随扭曲参数的变化；使用Yangian最高权重态与组合学“motif”标记态；针对反周期边界条件，建立与Basu-Mallick–Finkel–González-López模型的等价性，并利用\(\mathfrak{gl}(1|1)\)对称性建立HS motif与超对称motif的对应。

papers.title: Dual Charge-Density-Waves in Two-dimensional DyTe3 and Their Distinct Impacts on Magneto-Transport Properties
papers.abstract: Charge-density-waves (CDWs) are macroscopic quantum states defined by periodic modulations in electronic charge density coupled with lattice distortions. Despite significant research efforts, the evolution of electromagnetic transport properties in the presence of CDWs remains largely unexplored. Here, we report the effects of two orthogonal CDWs (CDW1 and CDW2) coexisting at low-temperature in DyTe3 on its electronic transport properties. Importantly, we find that while no clear magnetotransport anomaly is resolved across CDW1 transition under the present experimental conditions, the emergence of CDW2 drives a drastic enhancement in magnetoresistance and a multiband-governed nonlinear Hall response. These results demonstrate that CDW1 and CDW2 in DyTe3 are fundamentally different and impact its electronic transport in qualitatively distinct ways, establishing DyTe3 as a model system for understanding the transport consequences of multiple CDWs in quasi-two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report the effects... on its electronic transport properties”，并描述了磁输运测量结果（magnetoresistance、Hall response），属于实验研究。；研究对象：二维材料 DyTe₃（稀土三碲化物）中低温下共存的两个正交电荷密度波（CDW1 和 CDW2），以及它们对电子输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 DyTe₃ 中，CDW1 转变在现有实验条件下未引起明显的磁输运异常，而 CDW2 的出现导致磁电阻显著增强并产生多带主导的非线性霍尔响应。这表明 CDW1 和 CDW2 本质不同，对电子输运的影响具有定性差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 DyTe₃ 中，CDW1 转变在现有实验条件下未引起明显的磁输运异常，而 CDW2 的出现导致磁电阻显著增强并产生多带主导的非线性霍尔响应。这表明 CDW1 和 CDW2 本质不同，对电子输运的影响具有定性差异。；创新点：首次在 DyTe₃ 中区分了两种共存 CDW 对输运性质的截然不同的影响，证明 CDW1 和 CDW2 在物理本质上不同，并将 DyTe₃ 确立为研究准二维材料中多重 CDW 输运后果的模型体系。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如样品生长方法、测量设备等），仅提及进行了电子输运测量（磁输运、霍尔效应），并观察了 CDW 转变。具体技术细节（如是否使用输运测量装置、磁场方向等）摘要未说明。

papers.title: Quantum oscillations of helical edge states of periodically deformed 2D topological insulator in magnetic field
papers.abstract: We study edge-state transport in a two-dimensional topological insulator with a periodically deformed edge subjected to a uniform magnetic field. Zeeman coupling breaks time-reversal symmetry and enables elastic backscattering, producing oscillations of the forbidden-band widths. In the strong-field regime, the gaps can close completely at discrete field values. In the weak-field regime, we identify an important class of periodic deformations for which the dominant semiclassical scattering is controlled by complex infinity rather than by the nearest turning points. We develop a semiclassical treatment of this process and establish its agreement with perturbation theory and direct numerical calculations. The gap modulation should produce observable oscillations of the edge conductance. Unlike conventional magnetic quantum oscillations, which are periodic in inverse field, the predicted oscillations are periodic in the magnetic field itself, with a period determined by the Fermi velocity and effective g-factor
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：semiclassical treatment、perturbation theory、direct numerical calculations。；研究对象：二维拓扑绝缘体中周期性形变边缘态在均匀磁场下的输运行为，具体关注边缘态的量子振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁场中，塞曼耦合破坏时间反演对称性并导致弹性背散射，使禁带宽度产生振荡；在强场下禁带可在离散磁场值处完全闭合，在弱场下存在一类周期性形变，其主导半经典散射由复无穷远而非最近转向点控制。该间隙调制应导致边缘电导的可观测振荡，且振荡周期正比于磁场本身（而非传统量子振荡的1/B周期），周期由费米速度和有效g因子决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁场中，塞曼耦合破坏时间反演对称性并导致弹性背散射，使禁带宽度产生振荡；在强场下禁带可在离散磁场值处完全闭合，在弱场下存在一类周期性形变，其主导半经典散射由复无穷远而非最近转向点控制。该间隙调制应导致边缘电导的可观测振荡，且振荡周期正比于磁场本身（而非传统量子振荡的1/B周期），周期由费米速度和有效g因子决定。；创新点：预测了一种新型量子振荡——周期正比于磁场本身（而非1/B），其物理机制涉及塞曼耦合诱导的背散射和复无穷远散射鞍点，区别于传统磁量子振荡。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 半经典散射理论分析，并与微扰理论和直接数值计算进行对比验证。

papers.title: The influence of quantum geometry on the phase boundary and collective excitations of electron liquids and crystals
papers.abstract: Recent experiments on multilayer graphene systems have reinvigorated the study of electron crystallization, now with the inclusion of quantum geometry. In this work, we apply time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF) to the $λ$-jellium model to analyze the impact that quantum geometry has on the electronic liquid--crystal phase diagram and how it modifies the collective modes and responses of the liquid and crystal phases. In agreement with recent results utilizing neural quantum states, we find that quantum geometry favours electron crystallization, shifting the transition to higher densities. We also study the instabilities revealed by TDHF in the Fermi liquid ground state at low densities, providing insight into the fluctuations driving the crystallization transition. We further find that quantum geometry reduces the dispersion of the plasmon mode and suppresses Friedel oscillations deep in the liquid phase. Resolving the density response in terms of individual orbitals, we find that this suppression is caused by spectral weight transfer to an out-of-phase inter-orbital mode. Finally, we show that an analogous mode that emerges in the crystal phase corresponds to the breathing mode of an emergent real-space pseudospin skyrmion lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用time-dependent Hartree-Fock (TDHF)方法，属于解析与数值计算结合的理论研究。；研究对象：λ-jellium模型中的二维电子液体与电子晶体，重点研究量子几何（quantum geometry）对液-晶相图、等离激元模式及Friedel振荡的影响，背景为多层石墨烯体系中的电子结晶问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何倾向于促进电子结晶，使液-晶转变向更高密度移动；同时量子几何降低等离激元模式的色散，并抑制液相深处的Friedel振荡，其机制是谱权重转移至一个反相位的轨道间模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何倾向于促进电子结晶，使液-晶转变向更高密度移动；同时量子几何降低等离激元模式的色散，并抑制液相深处的Friedel振荡，其机制是谱权重转移至一个反相位的轨道间模式。；创新点：将量子几何效应纳入电子液-晶相变与集体激发的TDHF框架，并与神经量子态结果相互印证；揭示Friedel振荡抑制源于谱权重向反相位轨道间模式的转移，以及在晶体相中该模式对应实空间赝自旋斯格明子晶格的呼吸模。摘要未突出说明与以往TDHF研究在技术细节上的差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时Hartree-Fock（TDHF）理论，对λ-jellium模型进行自洽计算，分析基态不稳定性、集体激发模式及密度响应，并按单粒子轨道分解密度响应以追踪谱权重转移。

papers.title: Exact quantum spin liquids with topological order on maple-leaf and trellis lattices
papers.abstract: We construct spin models with bond-dependent anisotropic interactions on the penta-coordinated maple-leaf and trellis lattices, which yield exact $\mathbb{Z}_2$ quantum spin liquids akin to the Kitaev honeycomb model. We characterize the resulting ground states by their flux sectors, Chern numbers, and topological excitations. Using replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that the gauge fluxes are ordered at sufficiently low temperatures such that every unit triangle has $\pm π/2$-flux, where the sign is uniform across the system, and every unit hexagon (square) has $0$-flux ($π$-flux) within the parameter space of interest. We map out the topological phase diagram for each model, which reveals parameter regimes hosting $\mathbb{Z}_2$ and Ising topological orders, and we derive an analytical expression for the mass term of the Majorana fermions, the vanishing of which indicates a transition between these phases. We further establish the correspondence between individual vortices (i.e., flux excitations) and two species of anyons in the dimer limit, overcoming the obstacle faced by degenerate perturbation theory in treating odd-length elementary plaquettes. Interestingly, we find that two dimer limits of the maple-leaf model with distinct assignments of anyon species can be smoothly connected to each other in the vortex-free sector, but they are separated by fermion-gap-closing transitions in certain two-vortex sectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：construct spin models、replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo simulations、analytical expression。；研究对象：具有键依赖各向异性相互作用的自旋模型，具体为五配位的枫叶（maple-leaf）晶格和格架（trellis）晶格上的量子自旋液体，其性质类似于Kitaev蜂巢模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在枫叶和格架晶格上构造出具有精确Z₂量子自旋液体基态的模型，其规范通量在低温下有序排列（每个三角形为±π/2通量，六边形为0通量，正方形为π通量），并存在Z₂拓扑序与Ising拓扑序之间的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在枫叶和格架晶格上构造出具有精确Z₂量子自旋液体基态的模型，其规范通量在低温下有序排列（每个三角形为±π/2通量，六边形为0通量，正方形为π通量），并存在Z₂拓扑序与Ising拓扑序之间的相变。；创新点：首次在枫叶晶格和格架晶格上构造出具有精确Z₂量子自旋液体的模型，并克服了简并微扰理论在处理奇数长度基本环（三角形）时的困难；发现枫叶模型的两个二聚体极限在无涡旋扇区可平滑连接，但在双涡旋扇区被费米子能隙闭合跃迁隔开。
papers.method_zh: 解析构造自旋模型（类比Kitaev蜂巢模型的精确可解方案）；使用副本交换量子蒙特卡洛（replica exchange quantum Monte Carlo）模拟研究通量序；通过Chern数和拓扑激发表征基态；推导了Majorana费米子质量项的解析表达式；在二聚体极限下建立涡旋与任意子之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Reproducible capillary fluctuation analysis of solid-liquid interfaces for stiffness and anisotropy calculations
papers.abstract: The capillary fluctuation method (CFM) is widely used to compute solid--liquid interfacial properties from atomistic simulations, but its accuracy depends on choices in interface construction, wave-vector selection, sampling, and simulation geometry. Here, we develop a diagnostics-driven workflow for reproducible CFM calculations using pure Al as a representative system. Employing both ribbon models and thick two-dimensional references, we show that apparent linearity of the fluctuation spectrum alone does not ensure reliable stiffness or anisotropy estimates. Instead, a reliable CFM analysis requires a fitting window consistent with both temporal sampling and continuum capillary-wave assumptions, systematic sensitivity tests of the interface identification procedure, explicit propagation of replica variability, and independent verification of model-thickness convergence. We further propose a practical thickness-selection rule based on coexistence-temperature consistency, which enables finite-size effects to be controlled while retaining the substantial computational efficiency of ribbon geometries. By making the main sources of uncertainty explicit and diagnosable, the proposed workflow improves the reliability of the CFM as a quantitative tool and provides a foundation for its broader application to complex solid--liquid interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“atomistic simulations”（原子模拟），并讨论模拟几何、采样等计算细节。；研究对象：纯铝（pure Al）的固液界面（solid-liquid interfaces），具体研究其界面刚度（stiffness）和界面能各向异性（anisotropy）的计算方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭涨落谱的表观线性不足以保证毛细涨落法（CFM）结果的可靠性；作者提出了一套基于诊断的工作流程，通过拟合窗口选择、敏感性测试、副本变异性传播和厚度收敛验证，显著提高了CFM计算固液界面性质的可靠性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭涨落谱的表观线性不足以保证毛细涨落法（CFM）结果的可靠性；作者提出了一套基于诊断的工作流程，通过拟合窗口选择、敏感性测试、副本变异性传播和厚度收敛验证，显著提高了CFM计算固液界面性质的可靠性。；创新点：提出了一套系统化、可诊断的CFM工作流程，首次将多种误差来源（拟合窗口、界面识别、副本变异性、厚度效应）显式纳入分析框架，并给出实用的厚度选择规则，使CFM从经验性使用转变为可量化、可复现的工具。摘要未突出说明与以往CFM研究在具体算法上的差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用毛细涨落法（CFM）分析原子模拟数据，对比了两种界面模型：ribbon模型（带状几何）和厚二维参考模型；进行了时间采样与连续毛细波假设的一致性检验、界面识别过程的系统敏感性测试、副本（replica）变异性显式传播分析，以及模型厚度收敛性验证；提出基于共存温度一致性（coexistence-temperature consistency）的厚度选择规则。

papers.title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
papers.abstract: Advanced optical quantum technologies demands high quality quantum light generation at very high rates. Here, we report on a deterministic single-photon source that simultaneously combines high excitation rates with high system efficiency to reach over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux. The source delivers optical power of over 100 pW, as is measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter, enabling a simple and direct way of determining the single-photon source fiber efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确报告了实验测量结果（“measured with an off-the-shelf powermeter”），并描述了实际器件性能（“deterministic single-photon source”）。；研究对象：一种确定性的单光子源（deterministic single-photon source），属于光子量子光源领域，具体为光纤耦合的固态或集成光子器件（摘要未明确说明材料体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该单光子源同时实现高激发速率与高系统效率，在光纤内达到超过500 MHz的单光子通量，并输出超过100 pW的光功率，可直接用商用功率计测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该单光子源同时实现高激发速率与高系统效率，在光纤内达到超过500 MHz的单光子通量，并输出超过100 pW的光功率，可直接用商用功率计测量。；创新点：首次将单光子源的光纤内通量提升至500 MHz以上，并展示用普通功率计即可直接测量其输出功率，从而简化了单光子源效率的表征流程。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：利用高激发速率与高系统效率的集成方案构建确定性单光子源，并通过商用功率计直接测量光纤输出功率来标定单光子源的光纤效率。摘要未提及具体材料生长或制备方法（如分子束外延等）。

papers.title: Infrared Memory and Scrambling in a Dynamically Opened Coupled-SYK Majorana Junction
papers.abstract: We study a dynamically opened Majorana junction formed by two coupled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) systems. A time-dependent bilinear coupling drives the system from a nearly decoupled to a strongly hybridized regime, providing an interacting realization of a Majorana shutter. Using a low-frequency analysis of the large-$N$ Keldysh theory around the conformal $q=4$ SYK saddle, we find that the opening retains a strong infrared memory, with the associated anomalous response becoming increasingly sensitive to the infrared cutoff. Exact finite-dimensional simulations of two $N=8$ SYK clusters show enhanced inter-sector entanglement, parity transfer, and cross-sector operator scrambling after the opening. These results connect the infrared structure of conformal SYK dynamics with finite-size many-body scrambling and show how a dynamically opened interacting Majorana system can retain long-wavelength memory beyond the quadratic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：large-\(N\) Keldysh 理论分析、低频谱分析、有限维精确数值模拟。；研究对象：由两个耦合 Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev（SYK）系统构成的动力学开启的 Majorana 结（Majorana shutter），即从近退耦到强杂化随时间演化的相互作用 Majorana 体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该动力学开启过程保留强烈的红外记忆，其反常响应随红外截断变得愈发敏感；有限尺寸模拟显示开启后出现增强的扇区间纠缠、宇称转移和跨扇区算符 scrambling，表明动力学开启的相互作用 Majorana 系统在二次极限之外仍能保留长波记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该动力学开启过程保留强烈的红外记忆，其反常响应随红外截断变得愈发敏感；有限尺寸模拟显示开启后出现增强的扇区间纠缠、宇称转移和跨扇区算符 scrambling，表明动力学开启的相互作用 Majorana 系统在二次极限之外仍能保留长波记忆。；创新点：将共形 SYK 动力学的红外结构与有限尺寸多体 scrambling 联系起来，并展示动力学开启的相互作用 Majorana 系统在超越二次极限情形下仍保留长波记忆——这一记忆效应在纯二次（自由）Majorana 系统中不存在。
papers.method_zh: 围绕共形 \(q=4\) SYK 鞍点的大-\(N\) Keldysh 理论的低频分析；两个 \(N=8\) SYK 团簇的精确有限维数值模拟（用于计算纠缠、宇称转移和 scrambling 相关量）。

papers.title: Thermoelectric properties of metal-semiconductor percolation composites
papers.abstract: We analyze thermoelectric response of composite materials comprising homogeneous semiconductor hosts with randomly distributed metallic inclusions. We demonstrate that the properties of such materials are strongly affected by the percolation transition (with background conductivity). We show that in vicinity of percolation threshold, the power factor and the thermoelectric figure of merit strongly depend on both the concentration and arrangement of inclusions. Finally, we identify promising regimes for enhancing the power factor in realistic composites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要使用“analyze”“demonstrate”“show”等理论分析用语，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：金属-半导体逾渗复合材料，即均匀半导体基体中随机分布金属夹杂物的体系，重点研究其热电输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复合材料的热电响应强烈受逾渗转变（伴随背景电导率变化）影响；在逾渗阈值附近，功率因子和热电优值对夹杂物浓度及空间排列均高度敏感，并存在可提升实际复合材料功率因子的有利参数区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复合材料的热电响应强烈受逾渗转变（伴随背景电导率变化）影响；在逾渗阈值附近，功率因子和热电优值对夹杂物浓度及空间排列均高度敏感，并存在可提升实际复合材料功率因子的有利参数区间。；创新点：首次系统揭示逾渗转变对金属-半导体复合材料热电性能（尤其是功率因子与ZT值）的显著调控作用，并指出在逾渗阈值附近可通过调控夹杂物浓度与排列来优化热电性能。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或数值方法（如有效介质近似、蒙特卡洛模拟、有限元等），仅表明是对逾渗复合材料热电响应的理论分析。

papers.title: What Photocurrent Versus Effective Voltage Tells Us About Charge Generation in Organic Solar Cells
papers.abstract: The photocurrent of an organic solar cell is routinely plotted against an effective voltage and used to extract an exciton dissociation probability, and through it a free-charge generation efficiency. The photocurrent measures neither. Using a drift-diffusion model in which free-charge generation is field independent and losses occur only by bimolecular recombination, we show that the apparent dissociation probability returned by this procedure lies well below unity even for complete dissociation. Across wide variations of carrier mobility and recombination strength it is a single-valued function of the fill factor and coincides with the short-circuit charge collection efficiency, reporting neither the generation yield nor anything about collection beyond what the fill factor already shows. Even for ideal transport the normalised photocurrent saturates below unity at an intensity-independent first-order limit set by recombination of photogenerated carriers with injected equilibrium charge. Applied to four organic solar cells whose generation efficiencies are known independently, the apparent dissociation probabilities track the short-circuit collection efficiency rather than the generation yield. We therefore suggest this construction not be used, particularly in the high-efficiency non-fullerene acceptor systems that are now state of the art.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用漂移-扩散模型（drift-diffusion model）进行模拟分析，并结合实验数据验证。；研究对象：有机太阳能电池中的电荷产生与收集过程，具体关注光电流-有效电压曲线所提取的激子解离概率与自由电荷产生效率的物理含义。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光电流-有效电压曲线所提取的表观解离概率既不反映激子解离效率，也不反映自由电荷产生效率；在完全解离且仅存在双分子复合的理想条件下，该概率仍远低于1，实际上与短路电荷收集效率一致，仅重复了填充因子已包含的信息。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光电流-有效电压曲线所提取的表观解离概率既不反映激子解离效率，也不反映自由电荷产生效率；在完全解离且仅存在双分子复合的理想条件下，该概率仍远低于1，实际上与短路电荷收集效率一致，仅重复了填充因子已包含的信息。；创新点：指出光电流-有效电压曲线这一常规分析手段在物理上具有误导性，并证明其提取量实际等价于短路收集效率而非产生效率；特别针对当前主流的非富勒烯受体高效体系提出不应使用该方法的建议。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用漂移-扩散模型进行数值模拟，其中自由电荷产生与电场无关，损耗仅由双分子复合引起；系统变化载流子迁移率和复合强度；并将模型应用于四个已知产生效率的有机太阳能电池器件进行对比分析。

papers.title: Coarse-Graining Hidden Representations: Unsupervised Neuron Selection via Mapping Entropy
papers.abstract: Overparameterized neural networks carry far more hidden units than a task nominally requires, raising the question of which neurons are essential and whether that distinction is legible in the representation itself, without labels or gradients. We cast neuron selection as the problem of coarse-graining the hidden layer by retaining a subset of its neurons, and score each putative selection by the mapping entropy (ME). This quantity measures the loss of discriminatory power inherent in discarding part of the network neurons, and the selection that minimises the ME is taken as particularly informative. This criterion is fully unsupervised, in that it depends only on hidden-activation statistics. In teacher-student networks, ME optimisation recovers the minimal teacher-consistent representation and retains extra units in proportion to the hidden layer's residual variability; in a non-linear Gaussian process task, it selects coherent functional-class mappings whose preferred class shifts across training. On this task and on translation-augmented MNIST, ME-selected subnetworks outperform random subsets of equal size, most clearly under strong compression - linking configurational distinguishability to predictive performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“teacher-student networks”、“non-linear Gaussian process task”等数值模拟任务，以及“ME optimisation”等算法优化过程，属于典型的计算与理论建模研究。；研究对象：论文研究的对象是**过参数化神经网络中的隐藏层表征**。具体物理现象或体系并非传统凝聚态材料，而是将神经网络视为一个统计物理体系，研究其“隐藏单元”的冗余性与功能性，并探讨在无监督条件下如何通过粗粒化（coarse-graining）提取核心表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文提出了一种基于**映射熵（mapping entropy, ME）** 的无监督神经元选择准则。该准则能够在不依赖标签或梯度的前提下，识别出与任务最相关的神经元子集；在强压缩条件下，ME选择的子网络在预测性能上显著优于随机选择的同等规模子网络，表明**构型可区分性（configurational distinguishability）与预测性能之间存在直接关联**。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文提出了一种基于**映射熵（mapping entropy, ME）** 的无监督神经元选择准则。该准则能够在不依赖标签或梯度的前提下，识别出与任务最相关的神经元子集；在强压缩条件下，ME选择的子网络在预测性能上显著优于随机选择的同等规模子网络，表明**构型可区分性（configurational distinguishability）与预测性能之间存在直接关联**。；创新点：本工作的核心创新在于提出了一种**完全无监督**的神经元筛选判据（映射熵），该判据仅依赖于隐藏层激活统计量，无需标签或梯度信息。此外，论文揭示了在强压缩极限下，基于ME选择的子网络性能优势最为明显，这为理解过参数化网络中的信息冗余与功能模块化提供了新的统计物理视角。

papers.title: Operando imaging of intercalation memory in MXenes
papers.abstract: Ion intercalation enables reversible control of charge, structure and function in layered solids. Yet layered materials contain nanosheets with different thicknesses and stacking, whose intercalation pathways are averaged out in ensemble measurements. This becomes critical under Angstrom-scale confinement, where ion transport couples to solvent reorganization and host deformation, leaving the origins of kinetics, reversibility and activation unresolved. Here we combine operando interferometric scattering and interference reflection microscopy to resolve proton-driven dynamics in individual single- and multilayer Ti3C2Tx MXene flakes and show that even a few stacked layers introduce a significant kinetic barrier. Cycling then separates nanosheets into three persistent behaviors: reversible monolayers, restacked multilayers with incomplete recovery and delayed deintercalation, and coherently stacked multilayers that self-stabilize through reversible folding. Operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction shows this memory at electrode scale, where the interlayer structure converges towards a reproducible state. Our findings reveal cycling-induced structural memory that governs subsequent intercalation in layered MXenes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“operando interferometric scattering and interference reflection microscopy”“operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction”等实验手段。；研究对象：二维层状材料MXene（具体为Ti₃C₂Tₓ）中质子嵌入（intercalation）的动力学行为，以及循环充放电过程中由层数、堆叠方式引起的结构记忆效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使仅堆叠少数几层MXene纳米片，也会引入显著的动力学势垒；循环过程将纳米片分为三类持久行为（可逆单层、不完全恢复的再堆叠多层、通过可逆折叠自稳定的相干堆叠多层），并产生电极尺度的结构记忆，调控后续的离子嵌入过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使仅堆叠少数几层MXene纳米片，也会引入显著的动力学势垒；循环过程将纳米片分为三类持久行为（可逆单层、不完全恢复的再堆叠多层、通过可逆折叠自稳定的相干堆叠多层），并产生电极尺度的结构记忆，调控后续的离子嵌入过程。；创新点：首次在单个纳米片尺度上直接分辨不同厚度和堆叠方式的MXene薄片的离子嵌入路径，揭示了循环诱导的结构记忆效应及其对后续嵌入行为的调控作用，克服了系综测量中嵌入路径被平均化的问题。
papers.method_zh: 原位干涉散射显微镜（interferometric scattering microscopy）与干涉反射显微镜（interference reflection microscopy）结合，用于单层和多层单颗粒Ti₃C₂Tₓ薄片的质子驱动动力学成像；辅以原位同步辐射X射线衍射（operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction）在电极尺度表征层间结构演化。

papers.title: Global Fixed Point Potentials in the Abelian Higgs Model with $N$ flavors
papers.abstract: Existence of charged fixed points in the Abelian Higgs model with $N$ flavors in $d$ dimensions is studied using the functional renormalization group. We numerically solve the coupled fixed point equations for the scale dependent charge and the non-perturbative effective potential for the scalar field. We show that the $ε=4-d$ expansion, famously successful in theories with $O(N)$ symmetry, fails to produce reliable results when taking the $ε\rightarrow 1$ limit. By determining global fixed point potentials, it is shown that the critical flavor number at which charged fixed points appear, modifies significantly compared to the perturbative treatment. In $d=3$, signs of a richer fixed point structure with presumably multicritical fixed points are also found. Discussions include subtleties of the gauge fixing and the corresponding modified Ward-Takahashi identities, including the possibility of a nonzero dimensionless photon mass at the infrared fixed point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：functional renormalization group（泛函重整化群）、fixed point equations、perturbative treatment。；研究对象：d 维空间中含有 N 种标量场味（flavors）的 Abelian Higgs 模型，重点研究其带电（charged）固定点的存在性及其有效势的全局结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Abelian Higgs 模型中，ε=4−d 展开在取 ε→1（即 d=3）极限时不可靠；通过求解全局固定点势，发现带电固定点出现的临界味数 N 与微扰结果有显著偏离。在 d=3 中，还观察到可能包含多临界点的更丰富的固定点结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Abelian Higgs 模型中，ε=4−d 展开在取 ε→1（即 d=3）极限时不可靠；通过求解全局固定点势，发现带电固定点出现的临界味数 N 与微扰结果有显著偏离。在 d=3 中，还观察到可能包含多临界点的更丰富的固定点结构。；创新点：首次在 Abelian Higgs 模型中通过全局固定点势而非微扰 ε 展开来确定临界味数，揭示了 ε 展开在低维极限下的失效，并发现了 d=3 中更复杂的固定点结构（可能含多临界点）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用泛函重整化群（FRG）方法，数值求解耦合的固定点方程，包括随尺度变化的电荷以及标量场的非微扰有效势。同时讨论了规范固定及其对应的修正 Ward-Takahashi 恒等式，并考察了红外固定点处非零光子质量的可行性。

papers.title: Voltage-embedded equivariant machine learning potential for open system simulations
papers.abstract: Modeling electrochemical interfaces under operational non-equilibrium conditions is vital for energy technologies but remains bottlenecked by the expensive cost of ab initio methods. Current machine learning potentials, largely designed for closed systems under homogeneous electric fields, are limited in open quantum transport applications. To overcome this, we present an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that embeds voltage bias for open-system simulations. Our approach decouples the system energy and forces into zero-bias and bias-dependent contributions, assigning distinct vector encodings to electrode and scattering-region atoms to capture non-equilibrium conditions. Trained on limited discrete bias data, the model achieves high predictive accuracy and robust extrapolation transferability. When applied to a lithium/water interface, our model successfully captures the field-induced dynamic reorientation of water molecules and reproduces asymmetric electrochemical behavior at different electrodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要描述了一种机器学习势模型的构建与应用，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：电化学界面，具体为锂/水界面在非平衡电压偏置下的原子行为，涉及开放量子输运体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型能在有限离散偏压数据训练下，高精度预测并外推电压相关的能量与力，成功捕捉锂/水界面中电场诱导的水分子动态重取向，并再现不同电极上的不对称电化学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型能在有限离散偏压数据训练下，高精度预测并外推电压相关的能量与力，成功捕捉锂/水界面中电场诱导的水分子动态重取向，并再现不同电极上的不对称电化学行为。；创新点：首次将电压偏置直接嵌入等变机器学习势中用于开放体系模拟，突破了传统机器学习势仅适用于均匀电场下闭体系的局限，实现了对非平衡电化学界面的高效建模。
papers.method_zh: E(3)等变图神经网络机器学习势；将体系能量与力分解为零偏压项与偏压依赖项；对电极原子与散射区原子赋予不同的矢量编码以表征非平衡条件。

papers.title: Low-Dimensional Phase Diagram of Higher-Order Networked Systems
papers.abstract: Higher-order networks exhibit rich critical phenomena that cannot be captured by traditional pairwise models. Here, we develop an analytical dimension-reduction framework that maps higher-order networked dynamics onto an effective low-dimensional system, allowing accurate prediction of tipping boundaries, bistability regions, and the nature of phase transitions. We demonstrate the power of this framework across a range of dynamical processes, revealing distinct effects of higher-order interactions on transition continuity and hysteresis. Furthermore, we find that system resilience exhibits a profound dependence on the alignment between pairwise and higher-order connectivity, with assortative mixing enhancing tipping toward active states. Our findings establish a general theory for understanding the critical transitions in higher-order networks, offering new insights for anticipating and managing systemic risk in complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“analytical dimension-reduction framework”“effective low-dimensional system”“general theory”等关键词，属于解析理论与动力学建模研究。；研究对象：高阶网络（higher-order networks）上的集体动力学，具体关注其临界现象、相变性质、双稳区域与系统韧性（tipping boundaries、bistability、phase transitions、resilience）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阶相互作用会显著改变相变的连续性与滞后行为；系统韧性强烈依赖于成对连接与高阶连接之间的对齐程度，其中同配混合（assortative mixing）会促进系统向活跃态的突变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阶相互作用会显著改变相变的连续性与滞后行为；系统韧性强烈依赖于成对连接与高阶连接之间的对齐程度，其中同配混合（assortative mixing）会促进系统向活跃态的突变。；创新点：提出了一个通用的解析降维理论，能够统一刻画高阶网络中的临界转变，并首次揭示了成对与高阶连接结构对齐程度对系统韧性的决定性影响。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析降维框架：将高阶网络动力学映射为有效的低维系统，用于预测临界点、双稳区域及相变性质。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如均值场、谱方法或主稳定函数），也未提及数值模拟细节。

papers.title: Elastic turbulence in straight confined geometries
papers.abstract: Elastic turbulence (ET) in straight geometries has been extensively studied in idealised configurations such as periodic shear and planar channel flow, yet experiments are typically restricted to confined systems like ducts and pipes. While chaotic elastic fluctuations are observed in ducts, their onset in pipes is debated due to geometric constraints. Here we report sustained chaotic dynamics in both geometries and show they correspond to the same ET state identified in idealised setups. Our results establish ET as a geometry-independent attractor and point to a distinct transition mechanism in pipes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experiments、observed、reported，涉及对管道和管道几何中弹性湍流的实验观测）。；研究对象：弹性湍流（Elastic turbulence, ET），具体研究其在直管道（ducts）和直管（pipes）等受限几何结构中的混沌动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在直管道和直管两种几何结构中均观测到持续的混沌动力学，且该状态与理想化构型（周期剪切、平面通道流）中识别的弹性湍流态相同，表明弹性湍流是一种与几何无关的吸引子；同时指出管道中弹性湍流的触发机制与管道不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在直管道和直管两种几何结构中均观测到持续的混沌动力学，且该状态与理想化构型（周期剪切、平面通道流）中识别的弹性湍流态相同，表明弹性湍流是一种与几何无关的吸引子；同时指出管道中弹性湍流的触发机制与管道不同。；创新点：首次在直管（pipe）几何中确认了与理想化体系一致的弹性湍流态，并揭示其与管道（duct）中不同的转变机制，从而将弹性湍流确立为几何无关的普遍吸引子。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如流变测量、粒子图像测速等），仅提及对两种受限几何（ducts 和 pipes）中的流动进行实验观测与对比。

papers.title: Band Gaps and Localization of Surface Waves at Hyperbolic Material and Topological Insulator Interfaces
papers.abstract: We develop analytical criteria for surface electromagnetic waves at interfaces between hyperbolic materials and topological insulators. The analysis identifies propagation conditions, field penetration depths, and spectral band gaps. In the lossless model, the band edge is governed primarily by dielectric contrast, while the bulk topological coupling produces only a small shift and a weak correction to the dispersion. For structures combining hexagonal boron nitride with bismuth selenide, a thin topological insulator film on a dielectric substrate with low permittivity can substantially broaden the accessible propagation window. We also analyze a dissipative titanium and silicon hyperbolic effective medium interfaced with bismuth selenide. To make the complex branch structure visible, this lossy calculation uses an intentionally enhanced interface response and is therefore illustrative rather than a quantitative prediction for a conventional topological insulator. In the lossy case, a root of the dispersion relation represents a physical guided mode only when the fields decay away from the interface, attenuate consistently along the propagation direction, have finite penetration depths, and exhibit a consistent energy flow profile. Apparent gaps and jumps can occur when the complex quantities controlling transverse decay approach square root branch cuts. These results provide design guidelines for controlling dispersion, confinement, band gaps, and propagation loss in mid-infrared photonic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“analytical criteria”“analysis”“lossless model”“dispersion”“calculation”等关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：双曲材料（hyperbolic materials）与拓扑绝缘体（topological insulators）界面的表面电磁波。具体体系包括：六方氮化硼（hBN）与硒化铋（Bi₂Se₃）组合，以及钛/硅双曲有效介质（dissipative hyperbolic effective medium）与Bi₂Se₃的界面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无损耗模型中，表面波带边主要由介电对比度决定，体拓扑耦合仅产生微小频移和弱色散修正；在损耗情形下，只有满足场远离界面衰减、沿传播方向一致衰减、有限穿透深度及一致能流分布等条件的色散根才对应物理导模，表观带隙和跳变可能源于控制横向衰减的复量接近平方根支割线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无损耗模型中，表面波带边主要由介电对比度决定，体拓扑耦合仅产生微小频移和弱色散修正；在损耗情形下，只有满足场远离界面衰减、沿传播方向一致衰减、有限穿透深度及一致能流分布等条件的色散根才对应物理导模，表观带隙和跳变可能源于控制横向衰减的复量接近平方根支割线。；创新点：首次为双曲材料与拓扑绝缘体界面建立表面波的解析判据，并揭示损耗情形下色散根物理有效性的完整判据（衰减、穿透深度、能流一致性），指出支割线导致的表观带隙伪象。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导表面电磁波的传播条件、场穿透深度和谱带隙判据；对无损耗模型进行色散分析；对损耗情形采用“人为增强的界面响应”（intentionally enhanced interface response）使复分支结构可视化，属于说明性计算而非定量预测。

papers.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Composition-Dependent Constitutive Models for Hyperelasticity and Viscoelasticity of Digital Materials
papers.abstract: Digital materials fabricated by multi-material 3D printing are designed as controlled mixtures of stiff and compliant constituents, yielding effective responses that span more than an order of magnitude in apparent stiffness and exhibit strongly nonlinear, composition-dependent, and rate-dependent dissipative behavior. Classical finite-strain viscoelastic models represent such behavior with closed-form strain energy functions for equilibrium and non-equilibrium stresses as well as evolution of internal variables, which may limit flexibility when a single constitutive model is expected to generalize across materials and loading rates. Here, we present a data-driven multi-material constitutive modeling framework that generalizes a formulation by Bergström and Boyce. The proposed framework retains the structure of the classical model, namely multiplicative kinematics, invariant-based strain-energy functions, and a scalar dissipative evolution law directed along the normalized nonequilibrium deviatoric stress. For the equilibrium branch, the data-driven discovery framework either directly predicts closed-form model parameters as functions of composition or automatically constructs a polyconvex strain-energy function using neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs). The nonequilibrium branch kinetics are learned similarly, either by directly identifying closed-form parameters across compositions or by using appropriately constrained artificial neural networks. Using multi-rate uniaxial compression data across multiple material compositions, we show that the proposed formulation captures rate-dependent stiffness and hysteresis across compositions while preserving thermodynamic consistency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要强调“data-driven discovery framework”“neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs)”“artificial neural networks”，属于数据驱动建模与机器学习方法，结合经典本构理论。；研究对象：多材料3D打印制备的“数字材料”（digital materials），即由刚性与柔性组分按不同配比混合而成的复合材料，研究其超弹性与黏弹性力学行为，特别是与组分比例相关的非线性、率相关耗散特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架，能够仅用多速率单轴压缩数据，跨多种材料组分统一捕捉率相关刚度与滞回行为，同时保持热力学一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种数据驱动的多材料本构建模框架，能够仅用多速率单轴压缩数据，跨多种材料组分统一捕捉率相关刚度与滞回行为，同时保持热力学一致性。；创新点：将经典有限应变黏弹性模型的结构（保证热力学一致性）与数据驱动发现方法结合，使单一本构模型能够跨不同材料组分和加载速率泛化，克服了传统闭式应变能函数在组分变化时灵活性不足的限制。摘要未突出说明与纯黑箱机器学习方法的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bergström–Boyce黏弹性本构形式的推广框架：采用乘法运动学分解、不变量型应变能函数、沿归一化非平衡偏应力方向的标量耗散演化律。平衡分支通过两种方式实现：直接预测闭式模型参数作为组分的函数，或利用神经常微分方程（NODEs）自动构造多凸应变能函数；非平衡分支动力学同样通过直接识别闭式参数或使用约束人工神经网络学习。数据来源为多速率单轴压缩实验数据。

papers.title: Low electrical conductivity of dry CaSiO3 perovskite under lower mantle conditions
papers.abstract: Electrical conductivity (EC) provides important constraints on the composition and volatile distribution of Earth's deep mantle, yet the EC of davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite), a major lower-mantle phase, remains poorly constrained. We measured the EC of nominally dry CaSiO3 perovskite at pressures up to 89 GPa and temperatures up to 2200 K using impedance spectroscopy in a laser-heated diamond anvil cell. Conductivity increases with temperature but decreases systematically with pressure and it is substantially lower than previously reported, yet broadly consistent with recent theoretical predictions for oxygen-vacancy-mediated ionic transport. A distinct change in the temperature dependence coincides with the tetragonal-to-cubic phase boundary, revealing a modest enhancement of ionic transport across the structural transition. Along a normal lower-mantle geotherm, dry davemaoite is comparable in conductivity to bridgmanite near the top of the lower mantle but becomes progressively less conductive with depth. Under cold-slab conditions, dry davemaoite is substantially less conductive than dry subducted MORB and cannot account for the observed high-conductivity anomalies. Dry davemaoite therefore contributes little to bulk lower-mantle conductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：measured、impedance spectroscopy、laser-heated diamond anvil cell。；研究对象：名义干燥的CaSiO₃钙钛矿（davemaoite，下地幔主要矿物之一）在高压高温下的电导率及其输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 干燥CaSiO₃钙钛矿的电导率随温度升高而增大、随压力增大而系统性降低，且显著低于此前报道值；沿正常下地幔地温线其电导率与布里奇曼石在上地幔顶部相当，但随深度增加逐渐变得更不导电，对下地幔整体电导率贡献很小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：干燥CaSiO₃钙钛矿的电导率随温度升高而增大、随压力增大而系统性降低，且显著低于此前报道值；沿正常下地幔地温线其电导率与布里奇曼石在上地幔顶部相当，但随深度增加逐渐变得更不导电，对下地幔整体电导率贡献很小。；创新点：首次在如此宽的压力-温度范围内对名义干燥CaSiO₃钙钛矿进行电导率直接测量，发现其电导率远低于此前报道值，并与氧空位介导的离子输运理论预测一致；同时揭示了四方-立方结构相变对离子输运的温和增强效应。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 在激光加热金刚石压砧（laser-heated diamond anvil cell）中，利用阻抗谱（impedance spectroscopy）测量电导率，实验压力最高89 GPa、温度最高2200 K。

papers.title: Two-phase Temperature Reconstruction in Ice-Water Systems
papers.abstract: What controls heat transport when liquid water interacts with ice? Answering this question is essential for understanding water bodies undergoing phase change. Yet experimental progress remains limited by the lack of a minimally invasive methodology for simultaneously resolving temperature fields in coupled liquid water and non-isothermal ice systems. Here, we introduce a physics-based data-assimilation method for reconstructing temperature fields in buoyancy-driven flows interacting with non-isothermal ice. Particle tracking velocimetry provides the liquid velocity field, while thermal and kinematic boundary conditions constrain the inverse problem. The method couples advection--diffusion in liquid water with conduction in ice to reconstruct simultaneous mean temperature fields and quantify heat transport across the water--ice interface, while remaining minimally invasive and compatible with free-surface systems. We demonstrate the method in laboratory experiments in which the temperature range across the liquid water in contact with ice drives cabbeling-induced convection. This framework enables investigation of coupled thermo-fluid dynamics in cryospheric aquatic systems, including heat exchange at the ice-water interface and liquid-phase energetics, with broader applications to phase-change processes in food and energy industries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数据同化方法结合）。判断依据关键词：laboratory experiments、physics-based data-assimilation method、Particle tracking velocimetry。；研究对象：冰-水两相系统中的热输运与温度场重构，具体涉及浮力驱动流动与非等温冰的相互作用，以及由cabbeling效应（温度-密度非线性耦合）引发的对流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于物理约束的数据同化方法，能够在不侵入系统的情况下同时重构液相水与冰中的平均温度场，并定量计算冰-水界面的热通量，从而揭示cabbeling驱动对流中的热输运机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于物理约束的数据同化方法，能够在不侵入系统的情况下同时重构液相水与冰中的平均温度场，并定量计算冰-水界面的热通量，从而揭示cabbeling驱动对流中的热输运机制。；创新点：该方法具有最小侵入性且兼容自由表面系统，首次实现了对耦合冰-水体系中温度场与界面热输运的同时定量测量，突破了以往实验手段难以同时解析液相与冰相温度场的局限。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用粒子跟踪测速（PTV）获取液相速度场；数值/理论方面，将液相中的平流-扩散方程与冰中的热传导方程耦合，并利用热学与运动学边界条件约束逆问题，实现温度场的联合重构。

papers.title: Stability of Collective Neutrino Oscillations -- A Distributional Approach
papers.abstract: We study the stability of collective neutrino oscillations using a distributional approach motivated by the statistical mechanics of Kuramoto synchronization. Treating the ensemble of neutrino flavor polarization vectors in the thermodynamic limit $N\to\infty$, we derive an exact nonlinear Fokker--Planck (continuity) equation for the one-body distribution $F(\vec{\mathbf{S}},ω,t)$ on the flavor sphere. This equation admits a two-parameter family of azimuthally symmetric stationary solutions, whose stability we analyze by linearizing around them. The resulting eigenvalue condition determines the growth or decay rate of small perturbations from \emph{any} initial distribution -- not merely from a state close to full flavor coherence -- thereby going significantly beyond the conventional linear stability analysis of collective modes. In special limits the condition reproduces known synchronization thresholds in the two-beam model, providing a non-trivial check of the framework. We present analytical results for the eigenvalue equation and explore stability phase diagrams for physically relevant frequency distributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“distributional approach”、“derive an exact nonlinear Fokker--Planck equation”、“linearizing”、“analytical results”等关键词，属于解析理论推导与稳定性分析。；研究对象：集体中微子振荡（collective neutrino oscillations）的稳定性问题，具体为热力学极限下（N→∞）中微子系综在味球（flavor sphere）上的分布函数演化及其稳态稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个精确的非线性Fokker–Planck（连续性）方程来描述中微子味极化矢量的单粒子分布，并通过对任意初始分布（而非仅接近全味相干态）线性化，得到了决定小扰动增长或衰减的本征值条件，从而将集体中微子振荡的稳定性分析推广到远超传统线性稳定性分析的适用范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个精确的非线性Fokker–Planck（连续性）方程来描述中微子味极化矢量的单粒子分布，并通过对任意初始分布（而非仅接近全味相干态）线性化，得到了决定小扰动增长或衰减的本征值条件，从而将集体中微子振荡的稳定性分析推广到远超传统线性稳定性分析的适用范围。；创新点：该工作的主要新意在于：其稳定性分析不局限于接近全味相干的初始态，而是适用于任意初始分布，显著超越了传统的集体模式线性稳定性分析框架；同时，推导出的本征值条件在特殊极限下能复现已知的双束模型同步阈值，为理论框架提供了非平凡检验。
papers.method_zh: 采用受Kuramoto同步统计力学启发的分布函数方法（distributional approach）。具体包括：在热力学极限下对中微子味极化矢量系综取连续分布，推导精确的非线性Fokker–Planck方程；寻找方位角对称的稳态解族；围绕这些稳态解进行线性化，得到本征值方程；在特殊极限下与双束模型（two-beam model）的已知同步阈值进行对比验证；并针对物理相关的频率分布绘制稳定性相图。

papers.title: Recovering molecules from coarse-grained beads: free-energy-conditioned generative backmapping across chemical space
papers.abstract: Transferable coarse-grained (CG) force fields compress chemical space: by aggregating atoms into a reduced set of interaction beads, models such as MARTINI reduce the number of distinguishable compounds by roughly three orders of magnitude, making high-throughput screening of thermodynamic properties tractable across soft matter, with drug--membrane permeability as a well-developed example. The compression is lossy and, so far, one-way: a screen returns a combination of beads, with no established route back to the compounds it stands for. Recovering those compounds--compositional backmapping--is a one-to-many inverse map, distinct from the better-studied conformational problem of rebuilding atomic coordinates from a known mapping. Here we formulate compositional backmapping as conditional graph generation by introducing juniper, a discrete denoising diffusion model over molecular graphs conditioned on the octanol--water partition free energy $ΔG_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$, the principal driver of MARTINI bead type assignment and hence a proxy for bead identity. Trained on molecules of up to 9 heavy atoms mapped onto one or two beads, juniper generates molecules that are 93\% valid and 92\% unique for two-bead targets, and whose $ΔG_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$ distributions track the target $ΔG^{\mathrm{CG}}_{\mathrm{W} \mapsto \mathrm{O}}$ linearly ($r^{2} \geq 0.96$), departing only in the hydrophobic and hydrophilic tails. Although the model receives no chemical information beyond a single scalar, the functional groups shift systematically with the imposed free energy, from branched hydrocarbons at the apolar end to amides, imides, and isocyanates at the polar end. A bead combination flagged by a CG screen can therefore be turned into candidate molecules for atomistic study or synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法学文章。关键词：coarse-grained force fields、generative backmapping、discrete denoising diffusion model、conditional graph generation。；研究对象：软物质体系中的粗粒化（CG）模型，具体为MARTINI力场中由珠子组合代表的化合物分子；研究的是从CG珠子组合逆向恢复具体化学分子（即“组成性反向映射”）这一物理/化学信息学问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为juniper的离散去噪扩散模型，能够以辛醇-水分配自由能ΔG为条件，从一至两个CG珠子生成有效的候选分子；生成分子的ΔG分布与目标CG值呈线性相关（r²≥0.96），且官能团随目标自由能系统性地从疏水端（支链烃）过渡到亲水端（酰胺、酰亚胺、异氰酸酯）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为juniper的离散去噪扩散模型，能够以辛醇-水分配自由能ΔG为条件，从一至两个CG珠子生成有效的候选分子；生成分子的ΔG分布与目标CG值呈线性相关（r²≥0.96），且官能团随目标自由能系统性地从疏水端（支链烃）过渡到亲水端（酰胺、酰亚胺、异氰酸酯）。；创新点：将“组成性反向映射”（compositional backmapping）首次形式化为条件图生成问题，区别于已有的“构象性反向映射”（从已知映射重建原子坐标）；模型仅凭单一标量自由能条件即可生成化学上有效且多样的分子，无需额外化学信息，实现了从CG筛选结果到可合成候选分子的逆向通道。
papers.method_zh: 采用条件图生成框架：在分子图上训练离散去噪扩散模型（discrete denoising diffusion model），以单个标量——辛醇-水分配自由能ΔG_W→O为条件输入；训练数据为映射到一或两个珠子的、最多含9个重原子的分子。该自由能是MARTINI珠子类型分配的主要驱动量，因此作为珠子身份的代理。

papers.title: Strong-Drive Floquet Engineering of Interacting Qudits: From Finite-Duration Controls to Emergent Symmetry
papers.abstract: Floquet driving uses periodic controls to tailor the behavior of quantum systems, with applications in quantum analogue simulation, sensing, and the protection of quantum information. Most approaches are designed using idealized, instantaneous pulses, even though experiments necessarily use pulses with finite duration and shape. This mismatch becomes especially challenging for interacting $d$-level systems, or qudits, because the number of possible controls grows rapidly with the number of levels. We develop a strong-drive Floquet theory that incorporates experimentally realizable pulse waveforms directly into the design of the effective interactions. The pulse duration, amplitude, and shape therefore become useful control parameters rather than sources of error. We show that systems with more than two levels offer capabilities unavailable in qubit systems: finite-duration driving can create new interactions that are absent from the original system and can substantially change its symmetries. We demonstrate these capabilities for interacting three-level systems. A single pulse transforms a diagonal interaction into a quantum spin-1 model dominated by nematic interactions, while pulse protocols motivated by trapped ultracold polar molecules produce models with enlarged $SU(2)\times U(1)$ and $SU(3)$ symmetries. Numerical tests of both short-time evolution and many-body dynamics confirm the accuracy of the resulting description. Our results provide a scalable analytical framework for designing finite-duration controls in interacting qudit platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“我们发展了一种强驱动Floquet理论”“提供可扩展的分析框架”等表述，属于理论框架构建与数值验证，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：相互作用的d能级量子系统（qudit），具体聚焦于相互作用的三能级系统（qutrit），并涉及由超冷极性分子实验方案启发的脉冲协议。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限持续时间的强驱动脉冲可将对角相互作用转化为以向列相互作用为主的量子自旋-1模型，并能产生原系统不存在的相互作用，显著改变系统对称性，例如产生放大的SU(2)×U(1)和SU(3)对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限持续时间的强驱动脉冲可将对角相互作用转化为以向列相互作用为主的量子自旋-1模型，并能产生原系统不存在的相互作用，显著改变系统对称性，例如产生放大的SU(2)×U(1)和SU(3)对称性。；创新点：将脉冲持续时间、幅度和形状从误差来源转变为可控参数，并证明多能级（qudit）系统在有限持续时间驱动下能产生qubit系统无法实现的新相互作用与对称性变化。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 强驱动Floquet理论分析，将实验上可实现的有限持续时间脉冲波形直接纳入有效相互作用的解析设计中；数值测试包括短时演化与多体动力学模拟，用于验证理论描述的准确性。

papers.title: Eye-opening bounds on cusps
papers.abstract: We derive new nonperturbative inequalities on the cusp anomalous dimensions of conformal line defects. We impose reflection positivity, locality, and conformal invariance on a pair of cusps forming an ``eye'' geometry, deriving a novel condition on the cusp anomalous dimension which we refer to as conformal concavity. The resulting constraint is much stronger than the known angular concavity, and our derivation applies also to cusps involving distinct line defects. Remarkably, it directly links the smooth and fusion limits, yielding bounds on defect-changing operator dimensions, Casimir energies, and subleading fusion data. We thus uncover a new quantitative bridge between aspects of the local operator data and the fusion rules of line operators in conformal field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：nonperturbative inequalities、conformal invariance、derivation。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中的共形线缺陷（conformal line defects），具体研究由一对“眼睛”几何构型的尖角（cusps）构成的缺陷系统，以及其尖角反常维度（cusp anomalous dimension）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出共形线缺陷尖角反常维度满足新的非微扰不等式——“共形凹性”（conformal concavity），该约束远强于已知的角向凹性，并直接联系了光滑极限与融合极限，从而给出缺陷改变算符维度、Casimir能量及次领头融合数据的界限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出共形线缺陷尖角反常维度满足新的非微扰不等式——“共形凹性”（conformal concavity），该约束远强于已知的角向凹性，并直接联系了光滑极限与融合极限，从而给出缺陷改变算符维度、Casimir能量及次领头融合数据的界限。；创新点：首次提出并证明“共形凹性”这一新型约束，其强度远超已知的角向凹性；推导适用于包含不同线缺陷的尖角情形；建立了局域算符数据与线算符融合规则之间新的定量桥梁。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的关联。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于反射正定性（reflection positivity）、局域性（locality）与共形不变性，对“眼睛”几何中一对尖角施加约束，推导出关于尖角反常维度的新不等式条件。

papers.title: Three-Electrode TiO2 + rGO Cells: Classical Controls and Interpretation within a Quantum-Discord Framework
papers.abstract: In three-electrode electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), the impedance/capacitance response of the working electrode (WE) is measured relative to the reference electrode (RE), whereas the current required by potentiostatic control flows between the WE and the counter electrode (CE). Under classical three-electrode operation, the measured WE-RE response should therefore be independent of the properties of the electrode used as the CE, provided that conventional electrochemical and instrumental artifacts are negligible. Here, we test this expectation in cells containing nanostructured electrodes TiO2 + rGO and examine the results within a framework motivated by quantum discord to describe effective interelectrode correlations. We used dummy-cell measurements, a two-electrode bar-bar control, comparisons between Pt and bar CEs, a dummy circuit introduced into the CE branch, and CE ensemble comparisons to distinguish additive circuit behavior from CE-dependent behavior specific to the three-electrode configuration. In these experiments, the measured three-electrode capacitance response depends on CE, an effect that is not reproduced by the dummy-circuit controls examined. These findings identify a macroscopic CE-dependent capacitance response that departs from the tested classical expectation and is compatible with an effective interelectrode-correlation framework motivated by quantum discord, although the capacitance evidence alone does not constitute a direct measurement of quantum discord.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实际的三电极电化学阻抗谱（EIS）测量、dummy-cell 测量、两电极 bar-bar 对照、不同对电极（Pt 与 bar）比较等实验操作。；研究对象：含纳米结构电极 TiO2 + rGO（二氧化钛+还原氧化石墨烯）的三电极电化学电池，具体研究其工作电极与对电极之间的有效关联对电容响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 TiO2 + rGO 三电极电池中，测得的工作电极电容响应依赖于对电极（CE）的性质，这一现象无法由经典电路叠加行为或常规仪器伪影解释，偏离了经典三电极操作的预期，但与基于量子失协（quantum discord）的有效电极间关联框架相容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 TiO2 + rGO 三电极电池中，测得的工作电极电容响应依赖于对电极（CE）的性质，这一现象无法由经典电路叠加行为或常规仪器伪影解释，偏离了经典三电极操作的预期，但与基于量子失协（quantum discord）的有效电极间关联框架相容。；创新点：首次在宏观电化学三电极配置中报告了对电极依赖的电容响应，并尝试用量子失协框架解释这种偏离经典预期的电极间有效关联效应。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 三电极电化学阻抗谱（EIS）；dummy-cell 测量；两电极 bar-bar 对照实验；Pt 与 bar 对电极对比；在对电极支路中插入 dummy 电路；对电极集合（ensemble）比较实验。理论框架为量子失协启发的有效电极间关联描述。

papers.title: Surprises of Klein paradox
papers.abstract: We consider second quantized $1+1$ dimensional Dirac fermions with mass $m$ in background electric fields. This theory mimics the following situations. We consider two parallel capacitors with opposite directions of the electric field $E$ in them. The potential energy difference in one of them is equal to $V_0 > 2m$ and in the other to $V+V_0$, with $0<V<2m$. According to general physical understanding of the Schwinger effect, each capacitor separately will create pairs and there will be oppositely directed currents, which will not be equal to each other. The total current will not vanish. In this paper we show that this is too naive an observation: the limiting expectation value of the current operator, as $t\to +\infty$, is actually zero, if the above form of the potential with $0<V<2m$ is instantaneously turned on. The non-vanishing current is obtained only if $V>2m$. We also consider the same theory in the presence of the infinite wall and a deep well $V_0>2m$. We show that in such a potential the limiting expectation value of the current is zero in the Gaussian approximation. We discuss the relation of these observations to the Schwinger effet and to the decay of supercritical nuclei.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：second quantized、Dirac fermions、expectation value、Gaussian approximation。；研究对象：1+1维有质量狄拉克费米子在背景电场中的量子电动力学（QED）系统，具体模拟两个反向平行电容器构成的势垒结构，并涉及Schwinger效应与超临界核衰变问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当势垒形式为瞬时开启且其中一个电容器的势能差满足0<V<2m时，电流算符在t→+∞的极限期望值为零，而非直觉预期的非零总电流；只有当V>2m时才能得到非零电流。此外，在存在无限墙和深阱（V0>2m）的势场中，高斯近似下电流的极限期望值也为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当势垒形式为瞬时开启且其中一个电容器的势能差满足0<V<2m时，电流算符在t→+∞的极限期望值为零，而非直觉预期的非零总电流；只有当V>2m时才能得到非零电流。此外，在存在无限墙和深阱（V0>2m）的势场中，高斯近似下电流的极限期望值也为零。；创新点：揭示了Schwinger效应中关于“每个电容器独立产生粒子对并形成非零总电流”的朴素预期在特定参数区间（0<V<2m）下的失效，表明瞬时开启的势场会导致总电流在长时间极限下严格为零，这一结论与超临界核衰变图像的关系是新的理论洞察。
papers.method_zh: 采用二次量子化框架下的解析理论分析，具体为1+1维狄拉克方程在分段常数背景电场中的求解，并计算电流算符的长时间极限期望值；对含无限墙与深阱的情形使用了高斯近似。

papers.title: Wavefunctions for Anyon Superconductors
papers.abstract: Anyon superconductivity arises from the condensation of mobile anyons rather than from a conventional Cooper instability, yet a systematic wavefunction description remains lacking. We develop a hierarchy-wavefunction construction for superconducting states derived from parent topological orders and identify their off-diagonal long-range order, condensate charge, chiral central charge, and residual topological order through the plasma analogy and topological field theories. We construct Abelian and non-Abelian examples descending from the semion state, a $ν=2/3$ hierarchy state, the $ν=1/3$ Laughlin state, $ν=1$ integer quantum Hall state, and Pfaffian state. Remarkably, for the semion case, the superconducting many-semion wavefunction is equivalent to a state of fermionized anyons filling two effective Landau levels, recovering Laughlin's original construction of semion superconductor. Finally, we show that hierarchy wavefunctions emerge naturally in the dilute, long-distance limit of the anyon-Hilbert-space formulation, which applies to ideal Chern bands and moiré bands of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$. Our results establish a unified wavefunction-level framework linking anyon condensation, superconducting order, and topological field theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“wavefunction construction”“topological field theories”“plasma analogy”等理论概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：任意子超导体（anyon superconductors），具体包括由半子态（semion）、ν=2/3层级态、ν=1/3 Laughlin态、ν=1整数量子霍尔态及Pfaffian态等母体拓扑序衍生出的超导态，并涉及理想Chern带和扭曲双层MoTe₂的moiré带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了任意子超导态的层级波函数构造方案，证明该波函数可统一描述任意子凝聚导致的超导序，并揭示其与离域长程有序、凝聚电荷、手性中心荷及残余拓扑序的对应关系；特别地，半子超导多体波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效朗道能级的态，重现了Laughlin的原始构造。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了任意子超导态的层级波函数构造方案，证明该波函数可统一描述任意子凝聚导致的超导序，并揭示其与离域长程有序、凝聚电荷、手性中心荷及残余拓扑序的对应关系；特别地，半子超导多体波函数等价于费米化任意子填充两个有效朗道能级的态，重现了Laughlin的原始构造。；创新点：首次为任意子超导态提供了系统的波函数级描述，将任意子凝聚、超导序与拓扑场论统一在同一框架下，并建立了与Laughlin原始半子超导构造的等价性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：层级波函数构造（hierarchy-wavefunction construction）、等离子体类比（plasma analogy）、拓扑场论（topological field theories），以及任意子希尔伯特空间表述（anyon-Hilbert-space formulation）的稀薄长距离极限分析。

papers.title: Reciprocity can halve what a mechanical network can learn
papers.abstract: Tunable mechanical networks are being built as materials that learn in place. Capacity is estimated by counting parameters against target constraints, ignoring Maxwell-Betti reciprocity, the symmetry every passive, linear elastic network obeys. When p degrees of freedom are both driven and read out, every reachable response block lies in a subspace of codimension p(p-1)/2, whatever the size, topology and stiffnesses; at full overlap the unreachable fraction is (p-1)/2p, approaching one half. The consequence for training is a number: any learning rule leaves an error at least the norm of the target's antisymmetric part on the shared block, computable before training, and positive definiteness adds an orthogonal second term. A second-order optimiser with the exact Jacobian reaches that floor within 1% in 143 of 144 runs across 36 configurations, a contrastive rule with a bond-local update direction within 0.1% in 22 of 24 runs at a fixed step budget; the forbidden directions are the antisymmetric ones, which no tuning reaches and an odd coupling does: we prove that a rank-revealing selection of p(p-1)/2 odd bonds spans them whenever the passive network's wedge vectors span the relevant exterior square, and then realises every sufficiently small antisymmetric shared block exactly in projection. At a fixed number of accessed degrees of freedom, each of which may be both driven and read, the layout rule inverts: where the bond count does not bind, overlapping sensors onto actuators buys about twice the ceiling on reachable dimension; at a fixed count of sensors plus actuators it does not. Prescribed-displacement drives obey a companion law. The symmetry is classical; its fixed-graph consequence at partial overlap is new. For a published robotic metamaterial, no symmetric positive-definite stiffness matrix meets both targets in the linear model they deposit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中大量使用数学推导（如“codimension p(p-1)/2”、“rank-revealing selection”）、定理证明（“we prove that...”）以及对学习规则性能的数值验证，属于理论分析与计算验证相结合的工作。；研究对象：可调机械网络（tunable mechanical networks），即一类通过调节局部刚度或连接方式来实现原位学习（learn in place）的弹性超材料。论文聚焦于这类网络的线性弹性响应及其可学习性（learnability）的物理极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于无源线性弹性网络必须满足Maxwell-Betti互易定理，当p个自由度同时被驱动和读出时，所有可达的响应矩阵被限制在一个余维数为p(p-1)/2的子空间内；在完全重叠情形下，不可达的响应部分占比为(p-1)/2p，趋近于1/2。这意味着任何学习规则都无法消除目标响应中反对称部分带来的误差，该误差下界可在训练前计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于无源线性弹性网络必须满足Maxwell-Betti互易定理，当p个自由度同时被驱动和读出时，所有可达的响应矩阵被限制在一个余维数为p(p-1)/2的子空间内；在完全重叠情形下，不可达的响应部分占比为(p-1)/2p，趋近于1/2。这意味着任何学习规则都无法消除目标响应中反对称部分带来的误差，该误差下界可在训练前计算。；创新点：Maxwell-Betti互易定理是经典对称性，但将其对固定图（fixed-graph）在部分重叠（partial overlap）情形下的学习容量后果进行量化是全新的。此外，论文揭示了在固定访问自由度数量时，将传感器与致动器重叠可使可达维度上限翻倍，而固定传感器加致动器总数时则无此增益——这一布局规则的翻转是此前未知的。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合数值模拟。具体包括：利用线性代数与图论分析被动网络的互易对称性对响应空间的约束；证明通过选取p(p-1)/2个奇数耦合键（odd bonds）可张成反对称子空间；使用精确雅可比矩阵的二阶优化器和键局域更新方向的对比学习规则（contrastive rule）进行数值训练测试，统计达到误差下界的成功率。

papers.title: A Superconducting Peierls Instability
papers.abstract: The Peierls instability is a foundational mechanism in condensed matter physics, showing how the electron--phonon interaction can transform a simple metal into an insulating state with a new lattice periodicity. In a one-dimensional (1D) metal the Peierls instability follows from the enhanced electronic response at wavevector $Q=2k_F$ (connecting the Fermi points) producing a Kohn anomaly: a softening of the phonon mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates the tell-tale Peierls periodic lattice distortion and charge-density wave (CDW) that gaps the electronic spectrum. Here we show an analogous instability at the edge of a two-dimensional (2D) superconductor, where a dispersing Andreev bound state (ABS) hosts Bogoliubov Fermi points at $\pm k_c$. The enhanced quasiparticle response at the connecting wavevector $Q=2k_c$ couples directly to pairing-fluctuations and produces a superconducting Kohn anomaly: a softening of a pairing mode at the same wavevector. Condensation of this mode then generates an edge pair-density wave (PDW) that gaps the ABS. We refer to this as a superconducting Peierls instability and identify the boundary quasiparticle structure that enables it. As a concrete realization, we consider a square-lattice extended Hubbard model whose mixed-symmetry $s+d+ip$ state hosts a dispersing ABS with zero-energy crossings at finite edge momenta. Using self-consistent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) calculations we show that the order parameter develops an edge PDW, with the wavevector set by the superconducting Kohn anomaly, that gaps the ABS crossings. Our results identify a novel mechanism for spontaneous translation-symmetry breaking in a superconductor. As this superconducting Peierls mechanism does not require an extensive zero-energy flat band or topologically protected edge states, it may apply broadly to unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“self-consistent Bogoliubov–de Gennes (BdG) calculations”，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：二维超导体边缘的准粒子态，具体为一种混合对称性（s+d+ip）的扩展Hubbard模型中的色散Andreev束缚态（ABS），以及与之相关的超导Peierls不稳定性、边缘配对密度波（PDW）和Bogoliubov费米点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维超导体边缘，色散Andreev束缚态中的Bogoliubov费米点可引发一种“超导Peierls不稳定性”：配对模式在波矢Q=2k_c处软化并凝聚，自发产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），从而打开ABS的能隙。这是一种不依赖零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态的新型自发平移对称性破缺机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维超导体边缘，色散Andreev束缚态中的Bogoliubov费米点可引发一种“超导Peierls不稳定性”：配对模式在波矢Q=2k_c处软化并凝聚，自发产生边缘配对密度波（PDW），从而打开ABS的能隙。这是一种不依赖零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态的新型自发平移对称性破缺机制。；创新点：首次提出“超导Peierls不稳定性”这一概念，将传统Peierls机制从一维金属中的电荷序推广到二维超导体边缘的配对序。该机制不要求零能平带或拓扑保护边缘态，因此可能广泛适用于非常规超导体。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与自洽Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）数值计算。摘要未提及实验手段或其他计算方法（如DFT、DMRG等）。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Concentration Inequalities: Controlling Uncertainty in Finite-Time and Small-Sample Thermodynamic Inference
papers.abstract: We derive nonasymptotic upper bounds on the probability that a generalized current of a geometrically ergodic diffusion observed for any amount of time, or its sample mean over any arbitrary sample size, deviates from the stationary mean by more than any given amount. The concentration-of-measure behavior of generalized currents is universally governed by the relaxation time of the underlying dynamics, the locally observed dissipation rate, and the intrinsic local fluctuations of the observable. We uncover stark qualitative and quantitative differences in fluctuations in and out of thermodynamic equilibrium. We further obtain refined inverse thermodynamic uncertainty relations, bounding the variance of generalized currents from above. We construct nonasymptotic confidence intervals for controlling uncertainty in thermodynamic inference from small data, i.e., from short trajectories and small samples, and provide the first quantitative answer to when a trajectory is sufficiently long and a sample is sufficiently large. As an illustration, we apply our results to currents observed on a two-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process in and out of equilibrium and show how they can be used to rigorously detect broken detailed balance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“derive nonasymptotic upper bounds”“theoretical framework”“inverse thermodynamic uncertainty relations”等理论推导与不等式证明关键词。；研究对象：广义电流（generalized current）在有限时间与小样本条件下的热力学推断问题，具体应用于二维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程在平衡与非平衡态下的电流涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义电流偏离其稳态均值的概率可由动力学弛豫时间、局域耗散率及可观测量固有局域涨落统一控制；非平衡态与平衡态下的涨落行为存在显著定性与定量差异。此外，作者获得了改进的逆热力学不确定关系，并首次定量回答了“轨迹多长、样本多大才足够”的问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：广义电流偏离其稳态均值的概率可由动力学弛豫时间、局域耗散率及可观测量固有局域涨落统一控制；非平衡态与平衡态下的涨落行为存在显著定性与定量差异。此外，作者获得了改进的逆热力学不确定关系，并首次定量回答了“轨迹多长、样本多大才足够”的问题。；创新点：首次给出广义电流涨落的非渐近（有限时间、有限样本）上界，并建立逆热力学不确定关系对方差的上界约束；提供了从短轨迹和小样本进行严格热力学推断的定量判据。摘要未突出说明与已有热力学不确定关系文献相比的具体理论改进路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于几何遍历扩散过程的概率测度集中不等式推导，结合非渐近置信区间构造；具体示例采用二维Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的解析与数值分析，用于检测细致平衡破缺。

papers.title: Non-uniform quantum geometry stabilizes generalized Wigner crystals
papers.abstract: Moiré materials host fractional Chern insulators and electron crystals in close proximity, but the mechanism selecting between them remains an open question. We address this competition in Chern bands with ideal but momentum-dependent quantum geometry -- Aharonov-Casher bands. We present an ansatz wave function for generalized Wigner crystals and, by comparing its energy to that of the competing Laughlin-like state, map out the phase diagram at filling fraction $ν=1/m$ as a function of the degree of geometric non-uniformity. Our work identifies quantum geometry-controlled zero point fluctuations of the charge density of the generalized Wigner crystal as the mechanism controlling its relative stability, implying a kind of quantum Lindemann criterion for the crystal-liquid phase boundary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“ansatz wave function”“comparing its energy”“phase diagram”等理论建模与能量比较关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：摩尔材料中的Chern能带，具体为具有理想但动量依赖的量子几何（Aharonov-Casher能带）的体系，研究广义维格纳晶体与分数量子霍尔（Laughlin型）态之间的竞争，填充因子为ν=1/m。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子几何的非均匀性（而非均匀性程度）通过控制广义维格纳晶体电荷密度的零点涨落来稳定该晶体相，从而决定其与Laughlin型态的相对稳定性；该机制可表述为一种“量子林德曼判据”，用于刻画晶体-液体相边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子几何的非均匀性（而非均匀性程度）通过控制广义维格纳晶体电荷密度的零点涨落来稳定该晶体相，从而决定其与Laughlin型态的相对稳定性；该机制可表述为一种“量子林德曼判据”，用于刻画晶体-液体相边界。；创新点：首次将量子几何的动量依赖性（非均匀性）作为调控参数，系统研究其对广义维格纳晶体稳定性的影响，并提出量子几何控制的零点涨落作为晶体-液体相变的量子林德曼判据。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：构造广义维格纳晶体的变分试探波函数（ansatz），将其能量与竞争的Laughlin型态能量进行比较，在ν=1/m填充下绘制以几何非均匀程度为变量的相图。摘要未提及具体数值计算方法（如DMRG、精确对角化等）。

papers.title: HyperDet Wavefunction: A Phase-Agnostic Ansatz for Strongly Correlated Systems
papers.abstract: Describing competing phases of strongly correlated systems often requires trial wave functions built from phase-specific assumptions. We propose the \emph{hyperdeterminant (HyperDet) wavefunction} as a phase-agnostic ansatz for both bosonic and fermionic quantum many-body systems exhibiting spontaneous symmetry-breaking order, fractionalization, and/or topological order with anyonic excitations. The HyperDet structure emerges naturally by fusing auxiliary fermionic parton Slater determinants into physical orbitals through a fully learnable \emph{fusion tensor} $\mathcal F$. Optimized using variational Monte Carlo, a single HyperDet architecture can achieve exceptionally high overlaps $\geq 99.9\%$ with exact-diagonalization ground states throughout the entire fractional Chern insulator phase in both bosonic and fermionic models, and across their nearby competing phases. We introduce the singular-value spectrum of the \emph{bipartite fusion matrix} as a structural diagnostic of fusion tensor, and find that its redistribution tracks many-body phase transitions without computing phase-specific observables. The optimized fusion tensor also encodes the parton-level topological data: it reproduces the parton Chern numbers expected for the bosonic and fermionic FCI states, completing their field-theory descriptions and the resulting topological order. Its intrinsic gauge structure further determines whether physical symmetries admit virtual lifts and, when faithful lifts exist, extracts their projective class; for the bosonic FCI, this recovers the expected parton translation fractionalization. We thus anticipate the HyperDet wavefunction to be a promising variational platform for both accurate ground-state searches and phase-diagram explorations across strongly correlated phases, and for providing interpretable theoretical insights from parton-level microscopics to field-theory descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：variational Monte Carlo、ansatz、exact-diagonalization。；研究对象：强关联量子多体系统，包括玻色子和费米子体系中的分数量子霍尔（FCI）相、自发对称破缺序、分数化以及具有任意子激发的拓扑序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种与具体相无关的变分波函数——超行列式（HyperDet）波函数，单一架构即可在玻色子和费米子FCI相及其邻近竞争相中与精确对角化基态达到≥99.9%的重叠，并能通过融合张量的奇异值谱重分布和拓扑数据来诊断相变及刻画拓扑序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种与具体相无关的变分波函数——超行列式（HyperDet）波函数，单一架构即可在玻色子和费米子FCI相及其邻近竞争相中与精确对角化基态达到≥99.9%的重叠，并能通过融合张量的奇异值谱重分布和拓扑数据来诊断相变及刻画拓扑序。；创新点：HyperDet波函数是相无关（phase-agnostic）的变分ansatz，无需预先假设特定序；其优化的融合张量不仅能重现部分子陈数（完成场论描述），还能通过其内在规范结构提取物理对称性的虚拟提升及其射影类（如玻色子FCI中的部分子平移分数化），从而将微观部分子图像与场论描述联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）优化；波函数构造上采用辅助费米子部分子（parton）Slater行列式，通过一个完全可学习的“融合张量”$\mathcal F$将其融合为物理轨道。结构诊断工具为二分融合矩阵的奇异值谱。

papers.title: Strengthened Silicate Glasses by Residual Stress: Depth of Compression and Surface Flaws Stability Conditions
papers.abstract: The application of silicate glasses in severe service environments requires a precise evaluation of structural strength under mechanical loads and surface tribological conditions. Because glass strength is governed by surface flaws and microcracks rather than being an intrinsic material property, residual surface compression fields, balanced by interior tensile zones, are widely implemented to inhibit flaw opening. Rather than relying on conventional allowable stress criteria to establish product acceptance, this study adopts a fracture mechanics framework based on the stress intensity factor KI and fundamental material limits: the critical stress intensity factor KIC for rapid fracture and the threshold stress intensity factor KIth for time-delayed static fatigue failure. Using the Weight Function Method (WFM), KI is evaluated across generic surface flaw depths for two-dimensional continuous (2D-Continuous) surface cracks subjected to non-uniform internal residual stress fields and external loads. Flaw stability criteria are established for both zero-risk and moderate-risk design methodologies. Finally, the interaction and superposition of externally applied mechanical and thermal stresses with internal residual stress fields are evaluated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：采用断裂力学框架、应力强度因子KI、权函数法（WFM）进行理论分析与计算。；研究对象：受残余应力强化的硅酸盐玻璃，具体关注表面裂纹/微裂纹在非均匀残余应力场及外加载荷下的断裂行为与稳定性条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于应力强度因子KI与材料固有极限（KIC和KIth），建立了表面裂纹在残余压应力场中的稳定性判据，并给出了零风险与中等风险两种设计方法下的裂纹深度与稳定性条件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于应力强度因子KI与材料固有极限（KIC和KIth），建立了表面裂纹在残余压应力场中的稳定性判据，并给出了零风险与中等风险两种设计方法下的裂纹深度与稳定性条件。；创新点：摒弃传统许用应力准则，改用断裂力学框架（KI与KIC/KIth）来建立玻璃产品验收标准，并系统区分零风险与中等风险两种设计方法下的裂纹稳定性条件。摘要未突出说明与以往断裂力学玻璃强度研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用权函数法（Weight Function Method, WFM）计算二维连续表面裂纹在非均匀内部残余应力场及外部载荷作用下的应力强度因子KI；基于临界应力强度因子KIC（快速断裂）和阈值应力强度因子KIth（延迟静疲劳失效）建立裂纹稳定性判据；分析外加载荷（机械应力与热应力）与内部残余应力场的叠加效应。

papers.title: Hydrodynamics of two-dimensional electrons due to scattering by disorder
papers.abstract: The hydrodynamic regime of electron transport, induced by fast inter-electron collisions, was discovered in high-quality nanostructures in recent ten years. However, signs of hydrodynamic transport, primarily, the giant negative magnetoresistance, were observed even at very low temperatures, when electron-electron scattering is too weak to affect the transport. To address this puzzle, here we develop a theory of mixed, hydrodynamic and non-Markovian, magnetotransport of two-dimensional electrons at zero temperature in samples with weak but still important disorder. Namely, we account for both the memory effects at electron scattering by localized defects in magnetic field and an unconventional viscosity effect due to electron scattering by defects in bulk and by rough sample edges. Solution of the model yields a strong negative magnetoresistance, which exhibits at zero magnetic field a sharp maximum in narrower samples or a blunt maximum in wider samples. This and other our results explain various properties of the giant negative magnetoresistance observed on ultra-high-quality GaAs quantum wells, thereby we apparently reveal the nature of low-temperature magnetotransport in these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“develop a theory”，并基于模型求解（“Solution of the model yields...”），属于理论分析。；研究对象：二维电子气（2D electron gas）在弱无序（杂质散射）下的磁输运性质，具体针对超高质量GaAs量子阱中观测到的巨负磁阻现象。体系处于零温、弱无序但不可忽略的杂质环境中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温下，同时考虑电子被局域缺陷散射时的记忆效应（非马尔可夫过程）以及由体缺陷和粗糙边缘引起的非常规黏滞效应，模型可产生强负磁阻。该负磁阻在零磁场下呈现尖锐极大值（窄样品）或平缓极大值（宽样品），可解释超高质量GaAs量子阱中巨负磁阻的多种特征，揭示其低温磁输运本质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温下，同时考虑电子被局域缺陷散射时的记忆效应（非马尔可夫过程）以及由体缺陷和粗糙边缘引起的非常规黏滞效应，模型可产生强负磁阻。该负磁阻在零磁场下呈现尖锐极大值（窄样品）或平缓极大值（宽样品），可解释超高质量GaAs量子阱中巨负磁阻的多种特征，揭示其低温磁输运本质。；创新点：首次在零温、弱电子-电子散射条件下建立混合流体力学与非马尔可夫磁输运理论，将记忆效应与非常规黏滞效应统一处理，从而解释了此前被认为矛盾的现象——极低温下电子-电子散射太弱却仍出现流体力学特征的巨负磁阻。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析/数值求解。具体框架为混合流体力学与非马尔可夫输运理论：同时纳入（1）磁场中电子被局域缺陷散射的记忆效应；（2）由体缺陷和粗糙边缘散射导致的非常规黏滞（viscosity）效应。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如蒙特卡洛或玻尔兹曼方程求解细节）。

papers.title: Extrinsic orbital Edelstein effect from asymmetric scattering
papers.abstract: The generation and manipulation of orbital angular momentum (OAM) by an external electric field constitute one of the central themes of orbitronics. In particular, the electrically induced nonequilibrium OAM polarization, known as the orbital Edelstein effect (OEE), has attracted considerable attention in recent years. While the intrinsic band-geometric mechanism and the role of conventional symmetric impurity scattering in the OEE are well understood, the contribution from disorder-induced asymmetric scattering remains unclear. Here, we develop a semiclassical theory that separates the OEE into intrinsic, Drude, side-jump, and third- and fourth-order skew-scattering channels. Unlike the Drude channel, the intrinsic, side-jump, and skew-scattering responses survive only in systems with broken time-reversal symmetry. We find that in a magnetized Rashba two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), these disorder-induced mechanisms can substantially exceed the intrinsic contribution. Remarkably, we find that for a system with Rashba coupling of $1$ $eV Å$, the orbital magnetization is about one order of magnitude larger than the spin magnetization for the chosen parameters, highlighting the crucial role of orbital degrees of freedom in the Edelstein effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a semiclassical theory”，属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：轨道电子学（orbitronics）中的轨道Edelstein效应（OEE），具体体系为磁化Rashba二维电子气（2DEG），关注无序诱导的不对称散射对电场诱导非平衡轨道角动量极化的贡献。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁化Rashba 2DEG中，由无序诱导的side-jump和skew-scattering等外在机制对OEE的贡献可显著超过本征（intrinsic）贡献；在Rashba耦合强度为1 eV Å时，轨道磁化比自旋磁化大约一个数量级，表明轨道自由度在Edelstein效应中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁化Rashba 2DEG中，由无序诱导的side-jump和skew-scattering等外在机制对OEE的贡献可显著超过本征（intrinsic）贡献；在Rashba耦合强度为1 eV Å时，轨道磁化比自旋磁化大约一个数量级，表明轨道自由度在Edelstein效应中起关键作用。；创新点：首次系统区分并量化了无序诱导的不对称散射（side-jump和skew-scattering）对OEE的贡献，揭示了这些外在机制在磁化Rashba体系中可超越本征贡献，而此前研究仅关注本征带几何机制和对称杂质散射的作用。
papers.method_zh: 半经典理论（semiclassical theory），将OEE分解为intrinsic、Drude、side-jump以及三阶和四阶skew-scattering通道，并分别分析各通道对时间反演对称性破缺的依赖。

papers.title: Effective Hamiltonian description on monitored Majorana chains: correlated power-law hoppings and unconventional entanglement scaling
papers.abstract: We investigate the structures of effective Hamiltonians governing monitored dynamics of a one-dimensional Majorana chain through the Lyapunov spectral analysis. We focus on a gapless phase characterized by finite-size scalings different from those in conventional critical and/or frustration-free systems; the spectral gap closing faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$ and the entanglement entropy growing as $[\ln(L)]^2$ with $L$ being the system size. We find that the corresponding effective Hamiltonians have random long-range power-law hoppings with nontrivial magnitude correlations, rather than being independently and identically distributed. To elucidate the role of these non-Gaussian correlations, we construct random power-law hopping models that capture the essential features of the effective Hamiltonians. The spectral gaps of the constructed models decay faster than $1/L$ but slower than $1/L^2$. We find that, in the absence of hopping correlations, the ground-state entanglement exhibits $\ln(L)$ scaling. In the presence of correlations, by contrast, the entanglement entropy is enhanced and its system-size dependence is consistent with $[\ln(L)]^2$ scaling over the system sizes studied. These results suggest that correlations among long-range hopping magnitudes are responsible for the entanglement scaling that seldom appears in ground states of conventional isolated quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Lyapunov spectral analysis”（李雅普诺夫谱分析）、“construct random power-law hopping models”（构建随机幂律跳跃模型）等理论建模与数值分析方法。；研究对象：一维Majorana（马约拉纳）链的受监测动力学（monitored dynamics）所对应的有效哈密顿量，特别是其无间隙相（gapless phase）中的非传统标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有效哈密顿量具有带非平凡幅度关联的随机长程幂律跳跃，而非独立同分布。正是这些跳跃幅度间的关联导致了纠缠熵随系统尺寸呈[ln(L)]²增长，而非无关联时的ln(L)标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有效哈密顿量具有带非平凡幅度关联的随机长程幂律跳跃，而非独立同分布。正是这些跳跃幅度间的关联导致了纠缠熵随系统尺寸呈[ln(L)]²增长，而非无关联时的ln(L)标度。；创新点：揭示了受监测动力学产生的有效哈密顿量中长程跳跃幅度之间存在非高斯关联，并证明这种关联是导致非常规纠缠标度（[ln(L)]²）的关键机制——这种标度在传统孤立量子系统的基态中极为罕见。
papers.method_zh: 采用李雅普诺夫谱分析（Lyapunov spectral analysis）研究受监测Majorana链的有效哈密顿量结构；构建具有随机幂律跳跃的模型，通过对比有无跳跃关联两种情况下的谱隙和基态纠缠熵标度来阐明关联的作用。

papers.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Compositionally Complex (Gd/Ho/Er/Dy)2Zr2O7 Thin Film Combinatorial Library
papers.abstract: High-throughput synthesis and characterization of novel ceramic materials with improved thermomechanical properties and phase stability are needed to accelerate the discovery of next-generation thermal barrier materials. A combinatorial thin film material library of (GdDyHoEr)2Zr2O7 were created via combinatorial magnetron reactive sputtering with rare-earth/zirconium alloy targets. Structural, chemical, and thermal property characterization mapping across the four component composition space was performed and correlated with thermal transport measurements. Steady state thermoreflectance mapping identifies a pronounced minimum in thermal conductivity within the Dy/Gd-rich quadrant. This minimum does not coincide with either the equiatomic composition or the region predicted to exhibit maximum cation size disorder. Instead, it corresponds to the largest experimentally observed lattice parameter, despite deviating from Vegard-like chemical averaging, and is independent of grain size and whole-pattern microstrain. These observations suggest that the way the fluorite lattice accommodates compositional complexity, rather than cation size disorder alone, provides a more informative descriptor of thermal transport. Overall, this work establishes a high-throughput workflow for combinatorial thin-film synthesis and multimodal characterization, enabling the rapid identification of previously inaccessible structure-property relationships in compositionally complex ceramics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“high-throughput synthesis”“combinatorial magnetron reactive sputtering”“steady state thermoreflectance mapping”等实验合成与表征手段。；研究对象：成分复杂的稀土锆酸盐陶瓷薄膜（Gd/Dy/Ho/Er）₂Zr₂O₇，属于烧绿石/萤石结构体系，关注其热导率与结构-性能关系，面向热障涂层材料应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Dy/Gd富集象限中观测到热导率的显著最小值，该最小值既不在等原子成分处，也不在最大阳离子尺寸无序预测区域，而是对应实验观测到的最大晶格常数，且与晶粒尺寸和微应变无关。这表明萤石晶格对成分复杂性的“容纳方式”比单纯的阳离子尺寸无序更能描述热输运行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Dy/Gd富集象限中观测到热导率的显著最小值，该最小值既不在等原子成分处，也不在最大阳离子尺寸无序预测区域，而是对应实验观测到的最大晶格常数，且与晶粒尺寸和微应变无关。这表明萤石晶格对成分复杂性的“容纳方式”比单纯的阳离子尺寸无序更能描述热输运行为。；创新点：建立了组合薄膜合成与多模态表征的高通量工作流，能够在四组分成分空间中快速识别此前难以获取的结构-性能关联，并提出“晶格对成分复杂性的结构容纳方式”作为热输运的新描述符。摘要未突出说明与传统单组分或低组分体系研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 组合磁控反应溅射（使用稀土/锆合金靶材）制备薄膜组合材料库；结构、化学与热性能的多模态表征映射；稳态热反射法（steady state thermoreflectance）进行热输运测量；结合X射线衍射等结构分析获取晶格常数、晶粒尺寸与微应变信息。

papers.title: Topological Mixing and Braiding Universality in Polar Active Matter
papers.abstract: Connecting the autonomous kinematics of active matter to its emergent macroscopic transport is constrained by the requirement for high-resolution Eulerian velocity fields. Here, we use confined bacterial suspensions as a model active fluid, mapping the sparse Lagrangian trajectories of fluorescent spy cells into (2+1)-dimensional geometric braids that directly encode the spatiotemporal entanglement of the flow. We use the finite-time braiding exponent (FTBE) as a proxy to quantify the topological entropy and chaotic mixing of confined bacterial suspensions. In moderately confined wet systems, we find that hydrodynamic coupling drives a structural transition from a dilute active gas to coherent vortices, and ultimately to active turbulence, revealing three distinct density-dependent regimes of topological mixing. Conversely, truncating the hydrodynamic screening length via extreme confinement drives the system toward a dry active matter limit. In this limit, dense in-plane steric collisions suppress irreducible entanglement and substantially reduce the FTBE at high particle densities. By evaluating the topological complexity generated per encounter, we reveal a transition from a discrete geometric encounter regime to an areal escape mechanism. Finally, we establish a square-root scaling between the FTBE and the effective diffusivity, placing the self-sustained mixing of active fluids into the pathline braiding universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论/数据分析）。判断依据：使用“confined bacterial suspensions”实验体系，结合“mapping trajectories into geometric braids”“finite-time braiding exponent (FTBE)”等拓扑数据分析与理论框架。；研究对象：受限细菌悬浮液作为模型活性流体，研究其拓扑混合、混沌输运及活性湍流中的纠缠结构，涵盖从湿活性物质到干活性物质极限的转变。
