papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等受限湿体系中，流体动力学耦合驱动活性气体→相干涡旋→活性湍流的结构转变，呈现三个密度依赖的拓扑混合区；在极端受限（干活性极限）下，面内密集碰撞抑制不可约纠缠并显著降低高密度下的FTBE。FTBE与有效扩散系数满足平方根标度关系，表明活性流体自维持混合属于路径线编织普适类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等受限湿体系中，流体动力学耦合驱动活性气体→相干涡旋→活性湍流的结构转变，呈现三个密度依赖的拓扑混合区；在极端受限（干活性极限）下，面内密集碰撞抑制不可约纠缠并显著降低高密度下的FTBE。FTBE与有效扩散系数满足平方根标度关系，表明活性流体自维持混合属于路径线编织普适类。；创新点：首次将编织拓扑方法（FTBE）应用于活性物质实验数据，建立从离散几何碰撞到面逃逸机制的转变判据，并将活性流体混合归入路径线编织普适类（摘要未突出说明与已有编织方法在活性体系中的具体差异）。
papers.method_zh: 利用荧光示踪细胞获取稀疏拉格朗日轨迹，将其映射为(2+1)维几何编织（braids）；以有限时间编织指数（FTBE）量化拓扑熵与混沌混合；通过改变受限程度调节流体动力学屏蔽长度，对比湿/干活性极限。

papers.title: Mechanistic Framework for Multicomponent Nanoparticle Assembly: Predicting RNA-lipid and PEI-DNA nanoparticle assembly
papers.abstract: The assembly of multicomponent nanoparticles is often kinetically controlled and exhibits strong pathway dependence. Transport, solvent exchange, nucleation/growth, and collision-driven coalescence together determine not only ensemble-averaged properties but also particle-to-particle compositional heterogeneity. Here, we present a computational modeling framework for predicting nanoparticle property distributions by coupling processing conditions, early-stage self-assembly physics, and molecular chemical details with kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations. The framework combines (i) mixing conditions with solvent-exchange-mediated particle initialization and growth, and (ii) kMC simulations that resolve stochastic collision histories, electrostatics-controlled coalescence, and composition at the level of individual particles. Applied to mRNA lipid nanoparticles, the model predicts size-loading correlations and provides insight into how processing-dependent assembly pathways lead to heterogeneous payload distributions. The kMC simulations further provide merging lineage histories, which explain the emergence of log-normal volume and payload distributions through multiplicative particle-growth pathways. The same framework is also applied to PEI-DNA polyelectrolytic complexation, yielding single-particle-resolved DNA-PEI stoichiometry distributions. The framework and its open-source implementation, FormLNP, provide a process-aware route to predicting and controlling single-particle property distributions across a broad range of multicomponent nanoparticle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“computational modeling framework”“kinetic Monte Carlo (kMC) simulations”“open-source implementation”。；研究对象：多组分纳米颗粒的自组装过程，具体体系为mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒（RNA-lipid nanoparticles）以及PEI-DNA聚电解质复合物（polyelectrolytic complexation）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架通过耦合加工条件、早期自组装物理与分子化学细节，能够预测多组分纳米颗粒的粒径-载荷相关性及单颗粒级别的组成异质性；kMC模拟揭示了对数正态体积与载荷分布源于乘性颗粒生长路径（碰撞驱动的合并历史）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架通过耦合加工条件、早期自组装物理与分子化学细节，能够预测多组分纳米颗粒的粒径-载荷相关性及单颗粒级别的组成异质性；kMC模拟揭示了对数正态体积与载荷分布源于乘性颗粒生长路径（碰撞驱动的合并历史）。；创新点：提出了一个统一的、过程感知（process-aware）的计算框架，将加工条件与单颗粒分辨的随机碰撞/合并历史直接关联，可同时预测粒径分布、载荷分布及颗粒间组成异质性，并适用于不同化学体系（RNA-脂质与PEI-DNA）。摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学蒙特卡洛（kMC）模拟，耦合（i）混合条件与溶剂交换介导的颗粒初始化及生长，以及（ii）解析随机碰撞历史、静电控制的合并过程及单颗粒组成。框架以开源软件FormLNP形式实现。

papers.title: Hierarchical automation of scanning probe microscopy through agentic orchestration and algorithmic control
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in agentic artificial intelligence enable scientific systems to interpret open-ended objectives, combine heterogeneous information, invoke specialized tools, and revise experimental strategies as evidence accumulates. However, physical experimentation also contains many tasks for which agentic reasoning provides little advantage and can reduce reliability. Quantitative analysis, optimization, spatial targeting, validation, and instrument execution are often better posed as deterministic or algorithmic operations with explicit objectives and verifiable outputs. Here, we introduce a hierarchical architecture for autonomous experimentation that separates these roles. Agentic components interpret scientific intent, construct task-dependent experimental representations, evaluate accumulated evidence, and select high-level actions, whereas deterministic algorithms perform numerical analysis, coordinate selection, validation, and physical execution. We implement this architecture in piezoresponse force microscopy. Starting from a broad scientific question concerning the relation between local domain structure and polarization switching, the system constructs spatial descriptors from multichannel imaging, selects and analyzes local hysteresis measurements, adapts the spectroscopy waveform, and terminates the experiment when additional measurements cease to provide new evidence. The autonomous trajectory also identifies a confounding relationship between polarization state and domain-wall proximity and recognizes that the requested contrast is not independently represented within the available field of view. These results demonstrate a route toward scientific autonomy in which agents determine what evidence is required while algorithms determine how that evidence is acquired reproducibly and within validated physical constraints.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+算法/架构设计）。判断依据关键词：agentic artificial intelligence、hierarchical architecture、autonomous experimentation、implemented in piezoresponse force microscopy。；研究对象：扫描探针显微镜（具体为压电力显微镜，piezoresponse force microscopy）中的自主实验系统，以及铁电材料中局部畴结构与极化翻转之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并实现了一种分层自主实验架构：由智能体（agentic）组件负责科学意图解读与高层决策，由确定性算法负责定量分析与物理执行，从而在压电力显微镜上实现了从宽泛科学问题出发的全自主实验闭环，并自主识别出极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混淆关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并实现了一种分层自主实验架构：由智能体（agentic）组件负责科学意图解读与高层决策，由确定性算法负责定量分析与物理执行，从而在压电力显微镜上实现了从宽泛科学问题出发的全自主实验闭环，并自主识别出极化态与畴壁邻近度之间的混淆关系。；创新点：将智能体推理与确定性算法分离并分层协同，而非用端到端智能体控制全部实验流程；系统能自主判断何时停止实验（当额外测量不再提供新证据时），并能识别出实验请求的对比度在视场中并非独立表征这一物理限制。摘要未突出说明与已有自主实验框架（如基于贝叶斯优化的方法）的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 分层自主实验架构：智能体组件（解释科学意图、构建任务相关实验表征、评估累积证据、选择高层动作）与确定性算法（数值分析、坐标选择、验证、物理执行）相结合；具体实验手段为压电力显微镜的多通道成像、局部滞回线测量与光谱波形自适应调整。

papers.title: Quenched complexity of marginal states in the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin glass
papers.abstract: In the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model the exponentially many metastable states are marginal, so counting them requires breaking the BRST supersymmetry or a two-group replica Ansatz. For four decades this complexity was known only in the annealed approximation, which is unstable at low free energy and predicts states below the Parisi equilibrium free energy. We compute it quenched, with one step of replica symmetry breaking. It leaves the annealed curve where it becomes unstable and vanishes next to the full-RSB equilibrium free energy: the lowest marginal states are thus plausibly the equilibrium states themselves.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及模型理论计算（Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型）、复本对称破缺（replica symmetry breaking）、BRST超对称等理论概念，无实验关键词。；研究对象：Sherrington–Kirkpatrick（SK）自旋玻璃模型中的亚稳态（metastable states），特别是其边缘态（marginal states）的计数（复杂性，complexity）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者在一步复本对称破缺（1-RSB）框架下完成了对边缘态复杂性的淬火（quenched）计算。结果表明，淬火复杂性曲线在退火（annealed）近似失稳处与之分离，并在全复本对称破缺（full-RSB）平衡自由能附近趋于零，暗示最低边缘态很可能就是平衡态本身。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者在一步复本对称破缺（1-RSB）框架下完成了对边缘态复杂性的淬火（quenched）计算。结果表明，淬火复杂性曲线在退火（annealed）近似失稳处与之分离，并在全复本对称破缺（full-RSB）平衡自由能附近趋于零，暗示最低边缘态很可能就是平衡态本身。；创新点：解决了SK模型中边缘态复杂性长达四十年的淬火计算难题——此前仅在退火近似下已知（该近似在低自由能区不稳定且会预言低于Parisi平衡自由能的态），本文首次给出稳定的淬火结果，并建立了边缘态与平衡态之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：复本方法（replica method），具体采用一步复本对称破缺（1-RSB）Ansatz进行淬火平均计算；同时涉及对BRST超对称破缺或两组复本Ansatz的讨论，并与退火近似结果及Parisi full-RSB平衡自由能进行比较。

papers.title: Designing corrugated surfaces to guide colloidal self-assembly
papers.abstract: The self-assembly of colloidal particles enables the creation of structured materials with programmable functionalities; however, controlling interaction specificity and aggregate morphology in a reversible and scalable manner remains a major challenge. Here, we investigate the selective depletion-induced self-assembly of 3D-printed flat polygonal colloids, where nanoscale surface topography is engineered through precise modeling in two-photon polymerization. By designing anisotropic lateral surfaces, we direct specific interactions that govern aggregate morphology, yielding dimers, chains, zigzag, and honeycomb structures depending on the surface configuration. The specificity of interaction is tuned by varying the length scale of the topographic surfaces, the depletant concentration and the ionic strength of the solution, revealing a transition from selective to non-selective aggregation regimes. The relative placement of lateral interacting surfaces on the colloids enables assembly into aggregates spanning a broad range of sizes, while tuning the interaction strength selectively stabilizes distinct structural motifs. We demonstrate this interplay between geometric arrangement and interaction energy experimentally and corroborate through both theory and simulations for specifically hexagonal shaped colloids. This study establishes a versatile framework for programming colloidal interactions via micro-architectural design, offering new routes for fabricating reconfigurable and functional soft materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论/模拟结合的混合类型。判断依据：摘要提及“experimentally”“theory and simulations”。；研究对象：3D 打印的扁平多边形胶体颗粒，重点研究其表面纳米级拓扑结构（通过双光子聚合精确设计）对耗散力诱导自组装行为的影响，具体体系为六边形胶体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计胶体颗粒的各向异性侧表面形貌，可定向调控颗粒间的特异性相互作用，从而控制自组装产物的形貌（二聚体、链、之字形、蜂窝结构），并可通过调节表面特征尺度、耗散剂浓度和离子强度实现从选择性到非选择性聚集的转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计胶体颗粒的各向异性侧表面形貌，可定向调控颗粒间的特异性相互作用，从而控制自组装产物的形貌（二聚体、链、之字形、蜂窝结构），并可通过调节表面特征尺度、耗散剂浓度和离子强度实现从选择性到非选择性聚集的转变。；创新点：提出通过微米级几何结构设计（而非传统化学修饰）来编程胶体相互作用特异性的通用框架，实现可逆、可扩展的自组装路径调控，为可重构软材料制备提供新思路。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用双光子聚合 3D 打印制备具有精确表面拓扑的扁平多边形胶体，结合耗散力诱导自组装实验；理论上辅以理论分析和模拟（摘要未明确具体模拟方法，如布朗动力学或蒙特卡洛，仅称“theory and simulations”），针对六边形胶体进行验证。

papers.title: Evolution of electron spin resonance through a metallic quantum critical phase diagram
papers.abstract: In the heavy-fermion metal YbRh2Si2, quantum criticality at a suppressed antiferromagnetic order is governed by the interplay of local magnetic moments and itinerant conduction electrons. We demonstrate how this can be investigated by a new experimental approach that enables the observation of electron spin resonance (ESR) across a broad range of frequencies and fields at very low temperatures. This allowed us to cover a large part of the phase diagram from the paramagnetic Fermi-liquid phase to the phase with antiferromagnetic order and including the quantum-critical regime. Both the ESR g-factor and the linewidth present distinct behaviors in these three regimes, providing further insight into the physics across a quantum critical point. Notably, when cooling down at a field directly towards the quantum critical point, both g-factor and linewidth continuously decrease. Furthermore, we observe a very good matching of the g-factor behavior upon field-tuning and temperature-tuning towards the quantum-critical point. We analyze and discuss the results in the context of present theories on ESR in strongly correlated electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“new experimental approach”“observation of electron spin resonance (ESR)”“we observe”等实验性表述。；研究对象：重费米子金属YbRh2Si2，具体研究其被抑制的反铁磁序附近的量子临界性，以及局域磁矩与巡游传导电子之间的相互作用。物理现象涵盖顺磁费米液体、反铁磁有序和量子临界区三个相区。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过宽频、低温和强磁场下的电子自旋共振（ESR）测量，发现YbRh2Si2的ESR g因子和线宽在顺磁费米液体、反铁磁有序和量子临界三个区域呈现截然不同的行为；在直接冷却趋向量子临界点时，g因子和线宽均连续减小，且场调谐与温度调谐趋向量子临界点时g因子行为高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过宽频、低温和强磁场下的电子自旋共振（ESR）测量，发现YbRh2Si2的ESR g因子和线宽在顺磁费米液体、反铁磁有序和量子临界三个区域呈现截然不同的行为；在直接冷却趋向量子临界点时，g因子和线宽均连续减小，且场调谐与温度调谐趋向量子临界点时g因子行为高度一致。；创新点：首次实现了在极低温下跨越整个量子临界相图（从顺磁费米液体到反铁磁有序并包含量子临界区）的ESR观测，揭示了g因子和线宽在三个不同相区的区分性行为，并发现了场调谐与温度调谐两种路径下g因子演化的普适匹配关系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了一种新型ESR测量方案，能够在极低温度下覆盖宽频率和宽磁场范围，从而系统扫描量子临界相图。分析方面，结合了现有关于强关联电子系统ESR的理论框架进行讨论。

papers.title: Boundary- and Screening-Induced Bubbly Phases in Autophoretic Active Matter
papers.abstract: Spatial confinement and chemical screening fundamentally reshape the non-equilibrium phase behavior of autophoretic active particles. Here, we present a systematic study mapping the collective dynamics of self-propelled particles governed by chemo-attractive translational forces ($μ_t < 0$) and chemo-repulsive rotational torques ($μ_r > 0$) across varying screening parameters $κ$, torque magnitudes $μ_r$, and boundary condition coefficients $Λ^c$. Beyond standard chemotactic macro-phase separation and dynamic clustering, we report the emergence of novel boundary- and screening-induced bubbly phases, classified into boiling and bursting bubbles. Using a metric triad of steady-state cluster fraction $\langle S \rangle$, temporal fluctuation magnitude $σ_S$, and coordination number $\langle Q \rangle$, we draw phase diagrams to demarcate phases for no-flux boundaries ($Λ^c = 1$) and chemically permeable interfaces ($Λ^c = 0$) . Increasing chemical screening ($κ$) systematically suppresses long-range attraction, driving sequential phase transitions from macro-scale collapse toward bubbly states, dynamic micro-clusters, and homogeneous gas phases, while simultaneously inducing aggregate shape anisotropy. These findings provide predictive design rules for controlling active assembly and transport in microfluidic environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“systematic study mapping the collective dynamics”“phase diagrams”“metric triad”等数值模拟与理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：自泳活性粒子（autophoretic active particles）体系，具体为受化学吸引平移力（μ_t < 0）与化学排斥旋转力矩（μ_r > 0）驱动的自推进粒子，在空间受限与化学筛选作用下的非平衡集体相行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在标准趋化宏观相分离与动态团簇之外，发现了由边界条件与化学筛选诱导的新型“气泡相”（bubbly phases），分为沸腾气泡（boiling）与爆裂气泡（bursting）两类；增大化学筛选强度κ会系统抑制长程吸引，驱动从宏观塌缩到气泡态、动态微团簇、均匀气相的连续相变，并同时诱导聚集体形状各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在标准趋化宏观相分离与动态团簇之外，发现了由边界条件与化学筛选诱导的新型“气泡相”（bubbly phases），分为沸腾气泡（boiling）与爆裂气泡（bursting）两类；增大化学筛选强度κ会系统抑制长程吸引，驱动从宏观塌缩到气泡态、动态微团簇、均匀气相的连续相变，并同时诱导聚集体形状各向异性。；创新点：首次系统报道了由边界效应与化学筛选共同诱导的“气泡相”（沸腾与爆裂两类），并建立了基于三度量指标的完整相图，为微流控环境中活性组装与输运提供了预测性设计规则。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟与相图分析。具体采用稳态团簇分数⟨S⟩、时间涨落幅度σ_S、配位数⟨Q⟩构成的三元度量指标，绘制不同边界条件（无通量边界Λ^c = 1与化学可渗透界面Λ^c = 0）下的相图，扫描筛选参数κ、力矩强度μ_r及边界系数Λ^c。

papers.title: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers electron spin as a quantum coherence probe of angular fluctuations
papers.abstract: Strongly anisotropic non-Kramers rare-earth ions combine giant longitudinal g-factors with a vanishing transverse component imposed by time-reversal symmetry, a combination that makes their spin transitions exquisitely sensitive to the orientation of the applied magnetic field. We show that this sensitivity carries a dual identity: it is simultaneously an overlooked decoherence channel and the basis for a spin-coherence-based angular probe. Using pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance at X-band, we report the first measurements of the quantum coherence of Tb$^{3+}$ in a native-doped CaWO$_4$ crystal (15 ppb) and map the Hahn-echo coherence time $T_2$ as a function of temperature (2 to 10 K) and resonant field ($10^3$ to $10^4$ G). A parameter-free model combining spin-lattice relaxation, instantaneous diffusion and spectral diffusion from all independently quantified impurities overestimates $T_2$ by an order of magnitude at low temperature and wrongly predicts the field dependence of $T_2$, inconsistent with the observed monotonic decrease of $T_2$ with $B_r$. A two-parameter extension, including dynamical angular fluctuations of the crystal axis, reproduces the full dataset across multiple setups and laboratories. Two controlled experiments nominally identical except for different mechanical configuration of the setup establish the mechanical origin of the dominant contribution. The two-parameter extension corresponds to an angular amplitude noise spectral density of overall order 36 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ from global external vibrations (ranging from 10 to 66 n°/$\sqrt{Hz}$ depending on the exact setup mechanical configuration) estimated at $\sim$ 2.5 kHz plus a temperature-dependent contribution assumed to come from local phonon-driven angular jitter. It identifies and highlights a decoherence pathway of practical relevance to any anisotropic solid-state spin system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用X波段脉冲电子顺磁共振”“报告首次测量”“两个受控实验”等实验关键词，并包含与理论模型的对比。；研究对象：天然掺杂CaWO₄晶体中的Tb³⁺离子（非Kramers稀土离子，浓度15 ppb），以及其自旋相干性对晶体轴角度涨落的敏感性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tb³⁺自旋的Hahn回波相干时间T₂在低温下被晶体轴的角度涨落所主导，而非仅由自旋-晶格弛豫和杂质谱扩散决定；这种角度涨落既是一种此前被忽视的退相干通道，也可用作探测角涨落的量子相干探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tb³⁺自旋的Hahn回波相干时间T₂在低温下被晶体轴的角度涨落所主导，而非仅由自旋-晶格弛豫和杂质谱扩散决定；这种角度涨落既是一种此前被忽视的退相干通道，也可用作探测角涨落的量子相干探针。；创新点：首次测量了CaWO₄中Tb³⁺的量子相干性，并揭示强各向异性非Kramers离子中晶体轴角度涨落作为退相干通道的普适重要性；提出利用这种角度敏感性作为自旋相干性角度探针的新思路。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: X波段脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR），测量Hahn回波相干时间T₂随温度（2–10 K）和谐振场（10³–10⁴ G）的变化；结合无参数模型（含自旋-晶格弛豫、瞬时扩散和谱扩散）与两参数扩展模型（引入动力学角度涨落）进行对比分析；并开展两个仅机械构型不同的受控实验以验证机械起源。

papers.title: Three-observable measurement of the critical velocity in a paraxial superfluid of light flowing past a mobile impurity
papers.abstract: We report the measurement of the critical velocity of a paraxial superfluid of light flowing past a mobile impurity, realized using a dual-wavelength optical scheme in a warm vapor of $^{87}\text{Rb}$. The superflow is two-dimensional by nature, while the impurity features a highly repulsive potential, a large tunable radius, and a finite mass. The critical velocity is evaluated by simultaneously monitoring three complementary observables: the number of vortices nucleated in the wake of the impurity, the hydrodynamic force exerted on it, and its displacement velocity relative to the flow. These independent methods yield consistent values for the critical velocity, which remain systematically below the Landau criterion and decrease with the impurity radius, in qualitative agreement with theoretical expectations. Our results demonstrate the reliability of these combined diagnostics, establishing paraxial superfluids of light as a versatile platform for exploring the impurity problem in quantum hydrodynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We report the measurement”“realized using”“evaluated by simultaneously monitoring”等表述，属于实验测量工作。；研究对象：二维傍轴光超流体（paraxial superfluid of light）流经一个可移动杂质（mobile impurity）时的临界速度问题。实验体系为温热的⁸⁷Rb原子蒸气中的双波长光学方案，杂质具有强排斥势、大且可调的半径及有限质量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三种互补观测量（杂质尾迹中产生的涡旋数、作用在杂质上的流体动力学力、杂质相对流动的位移速度）同时测量临界速度，三种独立方法得到一致的结果，且该临界速度系统低于Landau判据，并随杂质半径增大而减小，与理论预期定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三种互补观测量（杂质尾迹中产生的涡旋数、作用在杂质上的流体动力学力、杂质相对流动的位移速度）同时测量临界速度，三种独立方法得到一致的结果，且该临界速度系统低于Landau判据，并随杂质半径增大而减小，与理论预期定性一致。；创新点：首次在傍轴光超流体中利用三种互补观测量联合诊断临界速度，验证了这些组合诊断的可靠性，并将该体系确立为研究量子流体力学中杂质问题的多功能平台。摘要未突出说明与已有光超流体实验相比的具体新意。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用双波长光学方案在温热⁸⁷Rb蒸气中实现二维傍轴光超流体；临界速度通过同时监测三个观测量获得：涡旋计数、流体动力学力测量、杂质位移速度测量。摘要未提及具体数值模拟或理论计算方法。

papers.title: Electromechanical Domain Wall Propagation in Dielectric Elastomers: An Exact Geometric Resolution via Conformal Mapping
papers.abstract: The localized electromechanical phase transition in dielectric elastomers involves complex moving boundaries and severe electrostatic fringe fields driven by high-curvature interfaces. Traditional phenomenological models fundamentally underestimate the configurational forces by completely ignoring the in-plane electric field components and geometric singularities. Here, we present a asymptotically exact geometric framework to resolve the domain wall propagation. By mapping the highly deformed current configuration to a regular parametric strip via conformal mapping, the field singularities are algebraically eliminated. An exact integration by parts directly translates the higher-order geometric metric into a rigorous topological mass term, projecting the global conformal electrostatics into a non-linear $σ$-model Lagrangian density. Incorporating the Gent strain-stiffening model, the continuous translation symmetry yields a Hamiltonian first integral. Eigenvalue analysis and Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) bound calculations prove that the domain wall emerges strictly as an asymmetric heteroclinic orbit connecting two saddle points. This geometric resolution provides exact analytical scalings for the localized interface energy, domain wall thickness, and asymptotic decay lengths, eliminating all phenomenological parameters and offering a deterministic paradigm for geometric instabilities in active soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“asymptotically exact geometric framework”“conformal mapping”“Lagrangian density”“eigenvalue analysis”“BPS bound calculations”等纯理论推导与数学分析关键词，无实验或数值模拟描述。；研究对象：介电弹性体（dielectric elastomers）中的局域机电相变及畴壁（domain wall）传播问题，具体涉及高曲率界面驱动的电场边缘效应与移动边界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共形映射将高度变形的当前构型映射为规则参数条带，可代数消除场奇异性，并证明畴壁严格表现为连接两个鞍点的不对称异宿轨道（heteroclinic orbit）。该几何框架给出了界面能、畴壁厚度及渐近衰减长度的精确解析标度，完全消除了唯象参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共形映射将高度变形的当前构型映射为规则参数条带，可代数消除场奇异性，并证明畴壁严格表现为连接两个鞍点的不对称异宿轨道（heteroclinic orbit）。该几何框架给出了界面能、畴壁厚度及渐近衰减长度的精确解析标度，完全消除了唯象参数。；创新点：传统唯象模型完全忽略面内电场分量与几何奇异性，从而从根本上低估构型力；本工作首次提供渐近精确的几何框架，以解析方式消除场奇异性，并给出无任何唯象参数的确定性解析标度律，为活性软物质中的几何不稳定性提供了确定性范式。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为共形映射几何方法，结合分部积分将高阶几何度量转化为拓扑质量项，投影出非线性σ模型拉格朗日密度；引入Gent应变硬化本构模型，利用连续平移对称性得到哈密顿首次积分；通过本征值分析与Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfield（BPS）界计算验证畴壁解的拓扑性质。

papers.title: Hierarchy of topological superconductivity generated via heterostructures of unconventional $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: A theoretical framework is proposed to engineer both first and second-order topological superconducting phases in a two-dimensional (2D) heterostructure, consisting of a quantum spin Hall insulator (QSHI) and an unconventional $p$-wave magnet in presence of proximity-induced $s$-wave superconducting pairing. Our analysis establishes that the transitions between the trivial and topological superconducting (TSC) phases can be regulated though the parameters of $p$-wave magnet. Presence of chiral symmetry leads to the characterization of both types of TSC phases by the respective invariants, one-dimensional winding number and quadrupolar winding number. These results are supplemented by an analytical effective low-energy edge theory that yields a deeper insight into the emergence of the different topological phases of the system. Bulk pairing analysis reveals the competition between the effective $(p_x+p_y)$ and $(p_x+ip_y)$ type pairings that are governed by the intrinsic spin-orbit coupling inherited to the QSHI and spin-split bands of the $p$-wave magnet, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“theoretical framework”“analytical effective low-energy edge theory”“analysis”等关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：二维异质结体系，由量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（QSHI）与非传统p波磁体构成，并引入近邻诱导的s波超导配对。研究聚焦于该体系中一阶与二阶拓扑超导相的调控与表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该异质结可在二维体系中同时实现一阶和二阶拓扑超导相，且平庸态与拓扑超导态之间的转变可通过p波磁体的参数进行调控；体系中的有效配对为(p_x+p_y)型与(p_x+ip_y)型之间的竞争，分别由QSHI固有的自旋轨道耦合和p波磁体的自旋劈裂能带所主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该异质结可在二维体系中同时实现一阶和二阶拓扑超导相，且平庸态与拓扑超导态之间的转变可通过p波磁体的参数进行调控；体系中的有效配对为(p_x+p_y)型与(p_x+ip_y)型之间的竞争，分别由QSHI固有的自旋轨道耦合和p波磁体的自旋劈裂能带所主导。；创新点：提出利用非传统p波磁体与QSHI的异质结构筑拓扑超导相的理论方案，并系统建立了从一阶到二阶拓扑超导相的统一调控框架，同时通过边缘理论给出了对拓扑相涌现的物理图像。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架分析：利用手征对称性定义拓扑不变量（一维绕数及四极绕数）来分别表征两类拓扑超导相；辅以解析的有效低能边缘理论，深入理解不同拓扑相的涌现机制；并进行体态配对分析以揭示有效配对通道的竞争关系。

papers.title: Experimentally constrained modeling of the Pockels response of KNbO3 and KTaNbO3
papers.abstract: The soft-mode of electro-optic (EO) metal-oxide perovskites plays a critical role in determining their Pockels responses. This is the case of potassium tantalate niobate (KTN), which exhibits an intrinsic Pockels response 2.5 times larger than that of state-of-the-art barium titanate (BTO), highlighting its potential for high-performance EO applications. By combining ab initio calculations at the density-functional theory level and far-IR measurements, we reveal that the harmonic approximation combined with semi-local exchange-correlation functionals fails to accurately capture the soft transverse optical (TO) Slater mode of both potassium niobate and KTN, which dominates the technologically relevant r51 Pockels coefficient. Replacing the calculated mode frequency with its measured value provides an experimentally constrained approach that substantially improves the predicted Pockels response. For that purpose, the previously unreported TO Slater-mode frequency of KTN is extracted from far-IR reflectivity measurements. The results emphasize the potential of KTN-based EO modulators as an alternative to standard lithium niobate and BTO technologies, with a potentially lower energy consumption and device footprint.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时出现“ab initio calculations at the density-functional theory level”和“far-IR measurements/reflectivity measurements”。；研究对象：电光氧化物钙钛矿材料：铌酸钾（KNbO₃）和钽铌酸钾（KTN, KTaNbO₃），具体关注其Pockels电光响应及主导该响应的软横光学（TO）Slater模。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谐波近似结合半局域交换关联泛函无法准确描述KNbO₃和KTN中主导r₅₁ Pockels系数的软TO Slater模频率；用实验测量的模频率替换计算值可显著改善Pockels响应的预测精度。KTN的本征Pockels响应比最优钛酸钡（BTO）大2.5倍，有望成为低能耗、小尺寸的电光调制器候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谐波近似结合半局域交换关联泛函无法准确描述KNbO₃和KTN中主导r₅₁ Pockels系数的软TO Slater模频率；用实验测量的模频率替换计算值可显著改善Pockels响应的预测精度。KTN的本征Pockels响应比最优钛酸钡（BTO）大2.5倍，有望成为低能耗、小尺寸的电光调制器候选材料。；创新点：提出“实验约束”（experimentally constrained）的计算策略——用实测软模频率替代DFT计算值来修正Pockels响应预测；首次报道了KTN的TO Slater模频率（此前未见文献报道）。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）水平的从头计算（采用谐波近似和半局域交换关联泛函）；远红外（far-IR）反射率测量，用于提取KTN此前未报道的TO Slater模频率，并将实验频率代入计算框架进行修正。

papers.title: Performance of Nanoring-based Transparent Conductors: a Computational Investigation
papers.abstract: Metallic nanoring networks can serve as promising flexible transparent electrodes. These materials are crucial components in a wide range of applications, including solar cells, touchscreens and displays. In this work, a computational investigation considers in detail (i) the electrical conductance and optical performance of nanoring networks and (ii) the breakdown of these networks due to electrical damage. The electrical resistance of both the nanorings and the contacts between the rings (junctions) is taken into account. In part (i), the effects of 5 parameters on the electrical sheet resistance and optical transparency are presented. It is shown that several parameter combinations achieve better performance in comparison to indium tin oxide, currently the most widely used transparent electrode. In part (ii), due to electrical damage, the nanoring systems display the formation of a crack, running parallel to the vertical terminals, where a voltage difference is applied. The network degradation is measured by its sheet resistance, and a universal effect is observed: networks with varying filling factors exhibit the same degradation profile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“computational investigation”。；研究对象：金属纳米环网络（metallic nanoring networks），用作柔性透明电极材料，并研究其电学输运、光学透过性及电损伤下的断裂行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米环网络在多种参数组合下，其电学薄层电阻与光学透明性可优于目前最广泛使用的透明电极材料氧化铟锡（ITO）；在电损伤过程中，不同填充因子的网络表现出普适的退化曲线（相同的电阻退化剖面）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米环网络在多种参数组合下，其电学薄层电阻与光学透明性可优于目前最广泛使用的透明电极材料氧化铟锡（ITO）；在电损伤过程中，不同填充因子的网络表现出普适的退化曲线（相同的电阻退化剖面）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其创新在于系统计算了纳米环网络的电学/光学综合性能，并首次报道了电损伤下不同填充因子网络的普适退化行为。
papers.method_zh: 计算模拟方法，具体手段摘要未明确说明（如是否采用有限元、蒙特卡洛或渗流模型等均未提及）。研究中考虑了纳米环自身电阻与环间接触（结）电阻，并系统考察了5个参数对薄层电阻和光学透明性的影响。

papers.title: Tunable Chern superconductivity of PtBi$_2$ in slab geometry
papers.abstract: Recent experiments indicate that PtBi$_2$ is a Weyl semimetal whose surfaces become topological superconductors with i-wave gap symmetry at low temperature. The bulk hosts 12 Weyl cones while in the superconducting state each of the two surfaces hosts in addition 6 Majorana cones. We study a simplified model in a slab geometry, where the finite thickness gaps out the bulk Weyl cones and leaves the surface Majorana cones as the low-energy degrees of freedom. We identify two competing mechanisms that gap these cones: inter-cone hybridization opens a trivial gap, whereas a Zeeman field opens a nontrivial one. In the nontrivial regime, chiral Majorana edge modes connect the gapped cones. We determine their wavefunction profile and relate it to the momentum-space distribution of the cones. Mapping out the phase diagram, we find both trivial and nontrivial regions in the quasi-two-dimensional limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We study a simplified model”“We identify”“We determine”“Mapping out the phase diagram”等理论建模与分析表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：PtBi₂ 在有限厚度（slab）几何结构中的超导态，具体关注其表面拓扑超导性与 Majorana 锥的能隙机制及陈数超导相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 slab 几何中，有限厚度使体 Weyl 锥打开能隙，仅剩表面 Majorana 锥作为低能自由度；这些锥可被两种竞争机制打开能隙——锥间杂化产生平庸能隙，而 Zeeman 场产生非平庸能隙，后者对应手性 Majorana 边缘模连接被打开的锥，并在准二维极限下形成包含平庸与非平庸区域的相图。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 slab 几何中，有限厚度使体 Weyl 锥打开能隙，仅剩表面 Majorana 锥作为低能自由度；这些锥可被两种竞争机制打开能隙——锥间杂化产生平庸能隙，而 Zeeman 场产生非平庸能隙，后者对应手性 Majorana 边缘模连接被打开的锥，并在准二维极限下形成包含平庸与非平庸区域的相图。；创新点：首次在 slab 几何中系统研究 PtBi₂ 表面 Majorana 锥的能隙竞争机制，揭示 Zeeman 场可诱导非平庸陈数超导态，并将边缘模波函数与锥的动量空间分布建立联系。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析/数值分析：采用简化的 slab 几何模型，通过有限厚度效应消除体 Weyl 锥，分析表面 Majorana 锥的杂化与 Zeeman 场效应，计算边缘模波函数分布，并绘制相图。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型、BdG 方程等）。

papers.title: Equivalence classes of finite-time transitions in optimal control and non-equilibrium relaxation
papers.abstract: We present a theory for the optimal control of stochastic systems in structured environments, represented by penalty terms in the cost functional. We show that such control problems generically feature sharp finite-time transitions associated with a qualitative change in the control strategy at a critical time. Starting from an overdamped Langevin equation and a quadratic cost functional, we show that all resulting problems fall into three canonical equivalence classes (parabolic, hyperbolic, and elliptic), distinguished by the sign of the determinant of the control Hamiltonian. For each class, we obtain the optimal protocol, the cost function, and the critical time in closed form, and show that the transition exhibits features of a continuous phase transition at mean-field level. We then establish a mapping between the optimal control cost and the large-deviation rate function governing non-equilibrium relaxation after a potential quench. The mapping covers the parabolic and hyperbolic classes, while the elliptic class has no simple relaxation counterpart. This correspondence implies that recently discovered finite-time dynamical phase transitions, which are exponentially costly to sample directly, are accessible through ordinary averages over optimally controlled trajectories. To validate our theoretical findings, we report three experiments with optically trapped colloidal particles: a control transition for the mean stochastic work, and the finite-time dynamical phase transitions in free diffusion and in harmonic relaxation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确给出“We present a theory”“We show that”“We obtain…in closed form”等理论推导表述，同时末尾报告了“three experiments with optically trapped colloidal particles”，属于理论为主、实验为辅的混合类型。；研究对象：随机系统的有限时间最优控制问题，具体涉及过阻尼Langevin动力学、含惩罚项的成本泛函，以及非平衡弛豫中的有限时间动力学相变。实验体系为光镊束缚的胶体粒子（自由扩散和谐波势弛豫）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有此类最优控制问题可归入三类规范等价类（抛物型、双曲型、椭圆型），由控制Hamiltonian行列式的符号区分；每类均在临界时间处出现尖锐的有限时间转变，且该转变具有平均场连续相变特征。此外，抛物型和双曲型的最优控制成本可映射为势阱淬火后非平衡弛豫的大偏差速率函数，而椭圆型无对应弛豫映射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有此类最优控制问题可归入三类规范等价类（抛物型、双曲型、椭圆型），由控制Hamiltonian行列式的符号区分；每类均在临界时间处出现尖锐的有限时间转变，且该转变具有平均场连续相变特征。此外，抛物型和双曲型的最优控制成本可映射为势阱淬火后非平衡弛豫的大偏差速率函数，而椭圆型无对应弛豫映射。；创新点：首次将有限时间最优控制问题系统分类为三种规范等价类，并揭示控制成本与非平衡弛豫大偏差速率函数之间的精确映射，使得原本指数级难以直接采样的有限时间动力学相变可通过最优控制轨迹的普通平均来观测。摘要未突出说明与已有最优控制或相变理论的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：过阻尼Langevin方程 + 二次成本泛函的最优控制理论，利用控制Hamiltonian行列式符号进行分类，并对每类闭式求解最优协议、成本函数和临界时间；建立最优控制成本与大偏差速率函数之间的映射关系。实验手段：光镊捕获胶体粒子，测量平均随机功的控制转变，以及自由扩散和谐波弛豫中的有限时间动力学相变。

papers.title: Universal Driven Critical Dynamics of Entanglement Entropy
papers.abstract: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) and finite-time scaling (FTS) provide a foundational framework for driven critical dynamics, yet their predictive power has been largely confined to local observables. Here, we establish a universal finite-time scaling theory for the nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum entanglement. Using unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the corner entanglement entropy of (2+1)-dimensional interacting Dirac fermions driven from ordered phases toward a quantum critical point. We find that the corner entanglement accurately obeys a universal driven scaling governed by the driving rate and system size, persisting whether the initial ordered state is fully gapped or hosts gapless Goldstone modes. Crucially, this dynamical entanglement exhibits a logarithmic dependence on the driving rate, from which the universal corner coefficient of the underlying conformal field theory can be robustly extracted far from equilibrium. These results generalize the KZM from local observables to the intrinsic nonlocal quantum information measures, offering a practical blueprint for characterizing quantum criticality and entanglement on programmable quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations”（无偏量子蒙特卡洛模拟），并建立“finite-time scaling theory”（有限时间标度理论）。；研究对象：(2+1)维相互作用狄拉克费米子体系，具体研究其从有序相被驱动至量子临界点过程中的量子纠缠熵（角纠缠熵）的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠熵（角纠缠熵）在驱动临界动力学中服从普适的有限时间标度，且对驱动率呈对数依赖，由此可在远离平衡态时稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数。该结果将Kibble-Zurek机制从局域观测量推广到非局域的量子信息度量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠熵（角纠缠熵）在驱动临界动力学中服从普适的有限时间标度，且对驱动率呈对数依赖，由此可在远离平衡态时稳健提取底层共形场论的普适角系数。该结果将Kibble-Zurek机制从局域观测量推广到非局域的量子信息度量。；创新点：首次将Kibble-Zurek机制和有限时间标度理论系统性地推广到量子纠缠熵这一非局域量子信息观测量，并证明即使在初始态含无能隙Goldstone模或完全有能隙的情况下，驱动动力学中的纠缠熵仍满足普适标度，且可从非平衡动力学中提取平衡态共形场论信息。
papers.method_zh: 无偏量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）模拟，结合有限时间标度（FTS）理论框架，研究驱动率与系统尺寸对纠缠熵的标度行为。

papers.title: Design Principles for Reproducible Networks
papers.abstract: From protein complexes to electronic circuits, many natural and engineered systems function only if assembled in an exact, reproducible fashion. The structure of each of these systems can be understood as a network, yet network science lacks the mechanisms to consistently reproduce exact topologies, focusing instead on generating network ensembles. We introduce the framework of network design where we encode the local constraints obeyed by a system's building blocks in a design set, and derive the Unigraphical Design Theorem, which determines when these constraints guarantee reproducible assembly into a unique structure, a process we call unigraphical assembly. For systems whose design sets do not specify a unique outcome, we identify guided assembly as a second route to reproducibility, in which temporal ordering decomposes construction into unigraphical steps. Applying these results to 3,618 reproducible systems, including protein complexes, molecules, and robots, we classify those that undergo unigraphical assembly and those that require guided assembly. We further identify a diversity-redundancy boundary that explains how systems trade component variety for structurally interchangeable parts while retaining unique assembly. Finally, we experimentally test the theory using 3D-printed components to re-engineer generative construction sets into systems that assemble unigraphically into prescribed topologies. Network design thus reframes reproducibility as a mathematically testable property of real networks, opening a route to the rational engineering of complex systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中提出“Unigraphical Design Theorem”理论框架，并包含“experimentally test the theory using 3D-printed components”的实验验证，属于理论+实验的混合类型。；研究对象：网络系统的可重复组装问题，具体涵盖蛋白质复合物、分子、电子电路、机器人等自然与人工系统，以及3D打印的物理构件。属于网络科学/复杂系统范畴，而非传统凝聚态物理中的特定材料或量子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“网络设计”框架，证明当系统构建模块的局部约束（设计集）满足Unigraphical Design Theorem时，系统可唯一地组装成确定拓扑结构；对于不满足该条件的系统，时间有序的“引导组装”可提供第二条可重复性路径。此外，识别出多样性-冗余边界，解释了系统如何在保持唯一组装的同时权衡组件多样性与结构可互换性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“网络设计”框架，证明当系统构建模块的局部约束（设计集）满足Unigraphical Design Theorem时，系统可唯一地组装成确定拓扑结构；对于不满足该条件的系统，时间有序的“引导组装”可提供第二条可重复性路径。此外，识别出多样性-冗余边界，解释了系统如何在保持唯一组装的同时权衡组件多样性与结构可互换性。；创新点：将网络科学从“生成系综”转向“精确拓扑的可重复生成”，首次将可重复性定义为网络的可数学检验性质，并提供了从局部约束判定全局唯一组装的理论判据，同时引入“引导组装”作为补充机制，开辟了复杂系统理性工程化的新路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（Unigraphical Design Theorem，基于图论与组合约束分析）；大规模数据分类（对3,618个可重复系统进行组装类型归类）；实验验证（使用3D打印组件重新设计生成性构建集，测试单向图组装到指定拓扑）。

papers.title: The Casimir free energy of peptide films on a silicon substrate: Impact of dielectric-to-metal transition in silicon and nanoparticles in peptide
papers.abstract: Using the Lifshitz theory of the van der Waals and Casimir forces, we calculate the Casimir free energy of thin peptide films deposited on silicon substrates. The Casimir free energy is found as a function of film thickness for different fractions of water in the film, in the presence of either nonmagnetic or magnetic nanoparticles, and under the impact of irradiation of a silicon substrate with laser pulses or dopants resulting in the dielectric-to-metal phase transition. It is shown that for a dielectric silicon there is the borderline value of the film thickness, such that the Casimir free energy is negative and contributes to the film stability for thicker films, but is positive and makes the film less stable for thinner ones. According to our results, the borderline value of peptide film thickness decreases with increasing volume fractions of water and in the film. This decrease is more pronounced for the magnetic nanoparticles and becomes stronger with increasing their radius. The borderline value of peptide film thickness is found as a function of the fraction of water in the film. If the silicon substrate is in metallic state, the Casimir free energy of peptide coating is always positive, which makes it less stable. Possible applications of the obtained results in organic electronics and biomedicine are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Lifshitz theory”进行理论计算，无实验数据或实验方法描述。；研究对象：沉积在硅衬底上的肽薄膜体系，具体研究其Casimir自由能随膜厚、膜内水含量、纳米颗粒（非磁性/磁性）以及硅衬底介电-金属相变（由激光脉冲或掺杂诱导）的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当硅衬底处于介电态时，存在一个临界膜厚：膜厚大于该值时Casimir自由能为负（利于膜稳定），小于该值时自由能为正（不利于膜稳定）；该临界膜厚随膜内水体积分数增加而减小，且磁性纳米颗粒（尤其半径较大时）使这种减小更显著。当硅衬底变为金属态时，肽膜的Casimir自由能始终为正，导致膜稳定性降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当硅衬底处于介电态时，存在一个临界膜厚：膜厚大于该值时Casimir自由能为负（利于膜稳定），小于该值时自由能为正（不利于膜稳定）；该临界膜厚随膜内水体积分数增加而减小，且磁性纳米颗粒（尤其半径较大时）使这种减小更显著。当硅衬底变为金属态时，肽膜的Casimir自由能始终为正，导致膜稳定性降低。；创新点：首次系统研究了硅衬底介电-金属相变对肽膜Casimir自由能的影响，并揭示了膜内水含量和磁性纳米颗粒对临界膜厚的调控规律。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lifshitz理论计算van der Waals和Casimir力，进而求Casimir自由能；考虑了膜内不同水体积分数、非磁性/磁性纳米颗粒的存在，以及硅衬底由介电态到金属态的相变（通过激光脉冲或掺杂实现）。

papers.title: Tailoring Mechanical and Acoustic Properties of Liquid-Filled Elastomers as Reusable Ultrasound Couplants
papers.abstract: Couplants are indispensable for ultrasound-based applications to ensure seamless propagation of the acoustic waves between the transducer and targets. Existing hydro/oil-based gel couplants provide excellent acoustic coupling but are single-use and therefore not suitable for emerging applications such as wearable health monitoring, ultrasound-based biometric devices, and prolonged sonodynamic therapy. Alternatively, polymer-based solid couplants have been explored as reusable solutions but generally fail to simultaneously provide effective mechanical conformability and efficient acoustic transmission. Here, we propose an innovative composite material design based on a silicone elastomer matrix, in which mechanical and acoustic properties are tailored independently through the microencapsulation of diols and triols. An emulsion-based material formulation strategy is employed to produce a family of high-liquid droplet content elastomeric composites containing up to 75 volume fraction (%) of liquid. A robust material formulation strategy is established that enables independent parametric control over the resulting mechanical and acoustic properties. A specific composition containing 70 % glycerol has been identified and explored for biomedical applications, exhibiting mechanical softness comparable to that of skin and acoustic properties matching those of soft tissues. The material has been integrated into a functional ultrasound characterization device, demonstrating structural homogeneity and applicability of the proposed couplant. Furthermore, the composites exhibit mechanical conformability to stiff substrates with surface irregularities, making them also promising candidates for industrial applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及材料制备（“emulsion-based material formulation strategy”）、性能表征（“mechanical softness”、“acoustic properties”）及器件集成（“integrated into a functional ultrasound characterization device”），均为实验性描述。；研究对象：液滴填充的硅酮弹性体复合材料（liquid-filled elastomers），具体为微胶囊化的二醇/三醇（diols/triols）液滴分散于硅酮弹性体基质中，作为可重复使用的超声耦合剂（ultrasound couplant）。重点研究其力学与声学性能的协同调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微胶囊化液体（如甘油）填充硅酮弹性体，可在保持高液体含量（最高75 vol%）的同时，独立调控材料的力学柔顺性与声学传输性能。含70%甘油的特定组分兼具类皮肤的力学柔软度和与软组织匹配的声学特性，可作为可重复使用的超声耦合剂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微胶囊化液体（如甘油）填充硅酮弹性体，可在保持高液体含量（最高75 vol%）的同时，独立调控材料的力学柔顺性与声学传输性能。含70%甘油的特定组分兼具类皮肤的力学柔软度和与软组织匹配的声学特性，可作为可重复使用的超声耦合剂。；创新点：提出一种“力学与声学性能可独立裁剪”的复合材料设计思路，克服了传统聚合物固体耦合剂无法同时兼顾机械适形性与高效声传输的瓶颈；且材料为可重复使用型，区别于一次性水/油基凝胶耦合剂。摘要未明确说明微胶囊化工艺的具体细节或与传统耦合剂的定量对比数据。
papers.method_zh: 乳液基材料配方策略（emulsion-based material formulation），通过改变液体种类（二醇/三醇）与含量实现力学和声学参数的独立控制；对优选组分进行了力学（柔软度）与声学（阻抗/声速匹配）表征，并集成到超声表征装置中验证结构均匀性与实用性。

papers.title: Unravelling the Li-Haldane Conjecture with the Projected Ensemble
papers.abstract: The entanglement spectra of fractional quantum Hall states contain universal fingerprints of their underlying topological order, as posited by the Li-Haldane conjecture. In this work, we uncover a finer universal structure within the entanglement spectra unravelled by projective measurements. Concretely, we study the projected ensemble of fractional quantum Hall states, defined as the collection of quantum states on a subsystem conditioned on measurement outcomes of its complement. We find that this ensemble exhibits a hidden hierarchy inside the Li-Haldane edge manifold: by conditioning on measurement outcomes, the entanglement spectrum's support is split into measurement-dependent sectors whose ranks we demonstrate are fixed by conformal field theory counting, an observation we dub the measurement-resolved Li-Haldane conjecture. For the non-Abelian Moore-Read state, this hierarchy is particularly rich: each parity-resolved edge manifold contains internal subspaces whose dimensions reproduce the conformal field theory counting of the opposite-parity sector. This structure persists even in realistic Coulomb-interacting ground states, establishing the projected ensemble as a sharp new probe of topological order beyond what the entanglement spectrum alone can detect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“conjecture”（猜想）、“conformal field theory counting”（共形场论计数）等理论概念，且未提及实验或数值模拟的具体手段。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔态（fractional quantum Hall states），特别是非阿贝尔Moore-Read态，以及其纠缠谱在投影测量下的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过投影测量，纠缠谱的支撑被分裂为依赖于测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数固定，揭示了Li-Haldane边流形内部隐藏的层级结构（测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想）。对于Moore-Read态，每个宇称分辨的边流形内部子空间的维度重现了相反宇称扇区的共形场论计数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过投影测量，纠缠谱的支撑被分裂为依赖于测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数固定，揭示了Li-Haldane边流形内部隐藏的层级结构（测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想）。对于Moore-Read态，每个宇称分辨的边流形内部子空间的维度重现了相反宇称扇区的共形场论计数。；创新点：首次将投影系综引入分数量子霍尔态研究，提出“测量分辨的Li-Haldane猜想”，揭示了纠缠谱本身无法探测的、由投影测量揭示的拓扑序的精细内部结构。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为投影系综（projected ensemble）方法，结合纠缠谱分析、共形场论（CFT）计数，并考察了库仑相互作用基态下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Peeling threshold for removal of an adhered elastic sheet by a shear flow
papers.abstract: Fluid shear can induce detachment of a thin elastic sheet adhered to a flat substrate. This peeling process is important in a variety of environmental and technological systems. The condition for peeling depends on: the shear rate $\dotγ$, the fluid viscosity $η$, the length of the detached portion of the sheet $L$, the bending rigidity $B$ and the adhesion energy $Γ$. What are the laws governing the detachment? We address this question experimentally in the regime of intermediate adhesion, using macroscopic sheets bonded to a substrate and immersed in a shear cell containing a viscous fluid. The experiments indicate a critical shear rate for peeling of the order of $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$. This threshold is, unexpectedly, independent of adhesion. We rationalise this result by applying Griffith's fracture theory to optical measurement data of the shape of the sheet, under conditions of freely moving peeling front or clamped boundary. The results indicate that the large curvature of the sheet for $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$ yields a nearly diverging strain energy release rate at this threshold. This approximate divergence in turn yields a peeling threshold that depends at most weakly on $Γ$, confirming a theory that was proposed recently (Salussolia et al., J. Mech. Phys. Solids, 2020, 134). Among other applications, our work provides a quantitative formula that can aid the production at scale of 2D materials such as graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“We address this question experimentally”，并涉及宏观薄片、剪切流装置等实验要素。；研究对象：粘附在平坦基底上的薄弹性片，在流体剪切作用下发生剥离（peeling）的物理现象。体系涉及剪切率、流体黏度、弯曲刚度、黏附能等参数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验测得剥离的临界剪切率约为 $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$，且该阈值出乎意料地与黏附能无关。通过Griffith断裂理论分析，发现该剪切率下薄片的大曲率导致应变能释放率近似发散，从而使剥离阈值对黏附能仅有极弱依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验测得剥离的临界剪切率约为 $\dotγ \sim B/(ηL^3)$，且该阈值出乎意料地与黏附能无关。通过Griffith断裂理论分析，发现该剪切率下薄片的大曲率导致应变能释放率近似发散，从而使剥离阈值对黏附能仅有极弱依赖。；创新点：实验上首次在中等黏附区间系统验证了临界剪切率与黏附能无关这一反直觉结论，并定量支持了Salussolia等人2020年提出的理论；同时提供了可用于二维材料（如石墨烯）规模化生产的定量公式。
papers.method_zh: 宏观弹性薄片粘附于基底并浸入含黏性流体的剪切池中，在中等黏附区间进行实验测量；结合光学测量获取薄片形状数据，并应用Griffith断裂理论进行分析，比较了剥离前沿自由移动与夹持边界两种条件。

papers.title: Exciton multipolarity controls coherent and squeezed phonons in van der Waals heterostructures
papers.abstract: Photoexcitation-driven changes in the electronic distribution displace atoms, generating coherent phonons on ultrafast timescales. Two-dimensional (2D) materials and their heterostructures offer a powerful platform for engineering these phonons. Yet, despite the widespread observation of photoexcited coherent phonons, a design principle for controlling their character remains elusive. Here, using detailed atomistic simulations of multilayers of alternating MoSe$_2$ and WSe$_2$, we reveal exciton multipolarity as a design principle for tuning photoinduced phonons from coherent to squeezed. These phonons are interlayer breathing modes, with dipolar excitons coupling linearly to generate coherent states and quadrupolar excitons coupling quadratically to produce squeezed states. Moreover, an out-of-plane electric field enables switch-like control, converting quadrupolar excitons into dipolar excitons and switching the phonon state from squeezed to coherent. For example, in trilayer WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$, the photoexcited 1.04-THz breathing mode switches from a squeezed state at zero field to a coherent state under an applied vertical field. Experimentally, these phonon states can be directly probed by ultrafast X-ray or electron diffraction and indirectly through transient reflectivity. Our results open new avenues for ultrafast control of lattice and electronic dynamics on picosecond timescales, with implications for THz quantum phononics, nanophotonic technologies, and quantum-noise-limited sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要提及“detailed atomistic simulations”（详细的原子模拟），属于理论/计算模拟研究。；研究对象：MoSe₂/WSe₂ 交替堆叠的范德华多层异质结（如三层 WSe₂/MoSe₂/WSe₂），以及光激发下产生的层间呼吸型相干声子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子的多极性（偶极 vs 四极）可作为调控光致声子态的设计原则：偶极激子线性耦合产生相干声子态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩声子态；外加垂直电场可实现压缩态与相干态之间的开关式切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子的多极性（偶极 vs 四极）可作为调控光致声子态的设计原则：偶极激子线性耦合产生相干声子态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩声子态；外加垂直电场可实现压缩态与相干态之间的开关式切换。；创新点：首次提出“激子多极性”作为控制光致声子从相干态到压缩态的设计原则，并展示电场可逆切换声子量子态，为太赫兹量子声子学与量子噪声极限传感提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法细节（如是否采用含时密度泛函理论、非绝热分子动力学等）摘要未明确说明。声子态通过超快X射线/电子衍射或瞬态反射率可被实验探测。

papers.title: Simultaneous measurements of enzyme propagation and biopolymer mobility elucidate the directional degradation of a dense biopolymer matrix
papers.abstract: Enzymatic degradation of biopolymers underpins critical processes in biotechnological applications and natural processes, such as food digestion and cancer development, yet the interplay between enzyme propagation in a dense substrate and substrate degradation remains unresolved. It remains especially unclear whether degradation of a dense matrix facilitates or impedes enzyme propagation. We simultaneously track with spatiotemporal resolution unidirectional enzyme diffusion and biopolymer degradation in a model system. We demonstrate that enzyme diffusion is decoupled from catalytic activity, while the degradation front progression is dictated by enzyme diffusion, reaction kinetics and slow enzyme deactivation. These findings establish a quantitative framework to optimize enzymatic processes for applications in biomedicine, biomass valorization, and nanotechnology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“simultaneously track with spatiotemporal resolution”（同时以时空分辨率追踪），属于直接测量实验。；研究对象：致密生物聚合物基质中的酶促降解过程，具体关注酶在致密底物中的单向扩散（unidirectional enzyme diffusion）与生物聚合物降解前沿的推进之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 酶在致密基质中的扩散与其催化活性是解耦的；降解前沿的推进速率由酶扩散、反应动力学以及酶的缓慢失活共同决定，而非单纯由酶活性控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：酶在致密基质中的扩散与其催化活性是解耦的；降解前沿的推进速率由酶扩散、反应动力学以及酶的缓慢失活共同决定，而非单纯由酶活性控制。；创新点：首次在同一模型体系中同时、实时地测量酶扩散与基质降解的空间分布，从而直接揭示致密基质降解对酶传播究竟是促进还是阻碍这一此前悬而未决的问题。摘要未突出说明与已有定量模型的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用具有时空分辨率的同步测量手段，同时追踪酶的单向扩散过程与生物聚合物的降解过程。摘要未明确说明具体的光学/显微技术名称（如荧光显微术、共聚焦等）。

papers.title: Heesch Nodal Lines in Inadmissible Achiral Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Recently, a new class of Weyl semimetals in antiferromagnets named Heesch Weyl semimetals was discovered, which have inadmissible chiral magnetic point group symmetries (inadmissible magnetic point groups are incompatible with ferromagnetic order) and distinctive surface Fermi arcs. In Heesch Weyl semimetals, the Weyl points are pinned at high symmetry momenta with two-dimensional irreducible corepresentations in the Brillouin zone. As the Weyl points are pinned, the Weyl points with opposite topological charges cannot emerge or be brought together for creation and annihilation as in conventional Weyl semimetals. In this work, we show that when mirror or rotoinversion symmetries are restored so that the point group becomes achiral, long doubly degenerate lines connecting Weyl points with opposite topological charges emerge. We call these lines the Heesch nodal lines (HNLs) and their host materials the Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets. HNLs result in a large number of two-dimensional massless Dirac cones for planes intercepting the HNLs in the Brillouin zone. Moreover, a large subset of the HNL antiferromagnets has the special property that the lowest nonvanishing order of the nonlinear anomalous Hall effect starts with the third order. First-principles calculations on representative collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnets, such as MnTe, CrSb, and Mn$_3$GaN, confirm our predictions on the presence of HNLs. When the inadmissible symmetry is broken by strain, the double degeneracy of the HNLs is lifted and the associated massless Dirac cones are gapped out, providing a route to realizing sizable anomalous Hall effects in antiferromagnetic crystals. We conclude that all inadmissible antiferromagnets without parity-time symmetry are topological. They are either Heesch Weyl antiferromagnets or Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that”“First-principles calculations”等理论推导与计算关键词。；研究对象：反铁磁材料中的拓扑电子结构，具体涉及Heesch nodal line（HNL）这一新型节线态，以及代表性材料MnTe、CrSb、Mn₃GaN（包括共线与非共线反铁磁体）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当镜面或旋转反演对称性恢复使磁点群变为非手性时，在不可容许（inadmissible）反铁磁体中会形成连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并节线（Heesch nodal lines），这些节线在布里渊区中产生大量二维无质量Dirac锥，且部分体系的最低阶非线性反常霍尔效应从三阶开始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当镜面或旋转反演对称性恢复使磁点群变为非手性时，在不可容许（inadmissible）反铁磁体中会形成连接相反拓扑荷Weyl点的长双重简并节线（Heesch nodal lines），这些节线在布里渊区中产生大量二维无质量Dirac锥，且部分体系的最低阶非线性反常霍尔效应从三阶开始。；创新点：首次提出“Heesch nodal line antiferromagnets”这一新物相类别，并证明所有无PT对称性的不可容许反铁磁体均为拓扑材料（要么是Heesch Weyl反铁磁体，要么是Heesch nodal line反铁磁体）。摘要未突出说明与已有节线分类工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论对称性分析（基于磁点群与不可约共表示分类）结合第一性原理计算（对MnTe、CrSb、Mn₃GaN进行电子结构计算验证HNL的存在）。

papers.title: Ground-State Phase Diagram, Higher-Winding Topology, and Lifshitz Criticality in an Anisotropic Four-Spin XX Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate the quantum critical and topological properties of a spin-$1/2$ XX chain with anisotropic four-spin cluster interactions in a transverse magnetic field. The interplay of exchange anisotropy, cluster interactions, and the external field produces a rich phase diagram with multiple gapped topological phases and distinct quantum critical boundaries. We identify several Lifshitz-type transitions arising from reconstructions of the low-energy Fermi-point structure, including an unconventional multicritical point where distinct critical branches intersect and the momentum-space topology undergoes a singular reorganization. In the isotropic limit, a conventional Lifshitz transition emerges through the merging and annihilation of Fermi points, revealing distinct mechanisms of Fermi-point reconstruction within the same model. The gapped phases are characterized by quantized winding numbers $ν=0,\pm1,-2,$ and $\pm3$, with the higher-winding phases induced by the extended cluster interactions. The $ν=\pm3$ phases exhibit a richer topological structure than conventional short-range Kitaev-type chains and are separated from other sectors by field- and interaction-driven gap closings. These topological distinctions are further reflected in characteristic degeneracy patterns of the lowest levels of the bulk entanglement spectrum. Our results demonstrate that anisotropic multispin interactions provide a versatile route to realizing higher-winding topological phases and unconventional multicriticality in one-dimensional quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”（我们研究）、“We identify”（我们识别）等表述，并涉及“winding numbers”（绕数）、“entanglement spectrum”（纠缠谱）等理论概念，未提及任何实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：一维自旋-1/2 XX链，该体系具有各向异性的四自旋团簇相互作用，并置于横向磁场中。具体研究的是该模型的量子临界性质、拓扑相图以及费米点重构机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型展现出丰富的相图，包含多个有能隙的拓扑相（绕数ν=0, ±1, -2, ±3）和不同的量子临界边界。研究发现了几类由低能费米点结构重构引起的Lifshitz型相变，其中包括一个非常规的多临界点，在该点不同的临界分支相交且动量空间拓扑发生奇异重组。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型展现出丰富的相图，包含多个有能隙的拓扑相（绕数ν=0, ±1, -2, ±3）和不同的量子临界边界。研究发现了几类由低能费米点结构重构引起的Lifshitz型相变，其中包括一个非常规的多临界点，在该点不同的临界分支相交且动量空间拓扑发生奇异重组。；创新点：该工作揭示了各向异性多自旋相互作用是实现在一维量子系统中产生高绕数（ν=±3）拓扑相和非常规多临界性的有效途径。特别是，ν=±3相具有比传统短程Kitaev型链更丰富的拓扑结构，且在同一模型内发现了两种不同的费米点重构机制（各向异性情况下的多临界点与各向同性情况下的常规Lifshitz转变）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。摘要未明确说明具体的理论框架（如玻色化、费米化、精确对角化等），但通过“Fermi-point structure”（费米点结构）和“winding numbers”（绕数）等术语推断，其方法可能涉及将自旋模型映射到无自旋费米子体系，并利用拓扑不变量和纠缠谱（entanglement spectrum）进行表征。具体技术细节摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Coherent interaction of WS$_2$ and quasi-2D perovskite excitons over micrometer distances via a cavity field
papers.abstract: The coherent coupling of cavity-confined photons and excitonic matter resonances leads to the formation of cavity polaritons, hybrid light-matter quasi-particles. If multiple exciton resonances couple to the same photonic mode, the resulting polariton constitutes a coherent interaction between matter resonances that can be spatially separated without any direct electronic coupling. In this work, we demonstrate the formation of such a coherent coupling at room temperature using an open optical cavity containing two distinct van der Waals materials - monolayer WS2 and layered quasi-2D halide perovskites (HaPs) - separated by $1.5 μ\rm m$. The system forms three polariton branches, with the middle branch possessing nearly equal fractions of both excitons and the photonic mode. White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements are in good agreement with simulations using a coupled harmonic oscillator and a microscopic Wannier-Hopfield framework. Our results lay the foundation to combine highly complementary degrees of freedom in 2D materials in an in-situ tunable fashion to enable new polaritonic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the formation”“White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements”，属于实验测量与模拟结合的工作。；研究对象：由单层WS₂与准二维卤化物钙钛矿（HaPs）两种范德华材料构成的开放光学微腔体系，研究其激子与腔光子之间的相干耦合，以及两种空间分离的激子共振通过腔场产生的间接相干相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，两种空间上相距1.5 μm的不同激子材料通过共享同一腔光子模式形成相干耦合，产生三个极化激元分支，其中中间分支同时具有两种激子和光子的显著比例，实现了无需直接电子耦合的长距离激子-激子相干相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，两种空间上相距1.5 μm的不同激子材料通过共享同一腔光子模式形成相干耦合，产生三个极化激元分支，其中中间分支同时具有两种激子和光子的显著比例，实现了无需直接电子耦合的长距离激子-激子相干相互作用。；创新点：在室温下利用开放腔实现两种不同范德华材料（WS₂与钙钛矿）激子间微米级距离的相干耦合，且系统具有原位可调性，为在二维材料中组合互补自由度、实现新型极化激元功能提供了平台。摘要未突出说明其他更具体的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用开放光学微腔，通过白光反射谱和发光谱测量极化激元色散；理论上采用耦合谐振子模型和微观Wannier-Hopfield框架进行模拟，并与实验数据对比验证。

papers.title: Ion-Engineered Insulator-to-Semiconductor Transition in Natural 2D Biotite
papers.abstract: Naturally occurring layered silicates offer an abundant yet unexplored class of 2D materials, but their insulating nature limits their functional utility. Here, we demonstrate a chemical strategy that transforms liquid-phase-exfoliated biotite nanosheets into a tunable 2D semiconductor through controlled NaOH treatment. The resulting insulator-to-semiconductor transition originates from Na incorporation, defect generation, and local structural reconstruction while largely preserving the layered framework. Structural and chemical analyses reveal lattice distortion, interlayer reorganization, hydroxylation, and partial Na+-K+ exchange, establishing the origin of the electronic restructuring. This transformation broadens the optical response, shifting the approximately 221 nm absorption toward approximately 280 and 975 nm, reducing the optical bandgap from approximately 5.2 to 3.2-3.5 eV, and introducing low-energy transitions at approximately 1.12-1.17 eV. Electrical measurements reveal nonlinear transport with currents reaching close to 10 microA, demonstrating activated carrier conduction. Ultrafast transient absorption reveals pronounced excited-state absorption, with carrier cooling (0.16-0.38 ps) followed by fast (35-60 ps) and long-lived (336-491 ps) relaxation associated with trap-mediated recombination. Fluence-dependent dynamics reveal a hot-phonon bottleneck at elevated carrier densities. Together with density functional theory calculations, these results establish chemical defect and ion engineering as a powerful route for converting naturally abundant layered minerals into electronically tunable 2D materials for emerging optoelectronic and ultrafast photonic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含密度泛函理论计算辅助）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述化学处理、结构/化学分析、电学测量、超快瞬态吸收等实验手段，并提及“together with density functional theory calculations”。；研究对象：天然二维矿物黑云母（biotite）纳米片，具体研究其通过NaOH处理实现的绝缘体-半导体转变，以及相关的缺陷工程、离子嵌入与电子结构重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过可控NaOH处理，液相剥离的黑云母纳米片可实现绝缘体到半导体的转变，该转变源于Na⁺嵌入、缺陷产生与局部结构重构，使光学带隙从约5.2 eV降至3.2–3.5 eV，并引入约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁，同时表现出非线性电输运（电流接近10 μA）和超快载流子动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过可控NaOH处理，液相剥离的黑云母纳米片可实现绝缘体到半导体的转变，该转变源于Na⁺嵌入、缺陷产生与局部结构重构，使光学带隙从约5.2 eV降至3.2–3.5 eV，并引入约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁，同时表现出非线性电输运（电流接近10 μA）和超快载流子动力学特征。；创新点：首次将天然丰富的层状硅酸盐矿物（黑云母）通过化学缺陷与离子工程转化为电子性质可调的2D半导体，为天然矿物在光电子和超快光子技术中的应用开辟了新途径。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 液相剥离制备黑云母纳米片；NaOH化学处理；结构/化学分析（揭示晶格畸变、层间重组、羟基化、Na⁺-K⁺部分交换）；光学吸收光谱（带隙与跃迁表征）；电学输运测量（非线性I-V，激活导电）；超快瞬态吸收光谱（载流子冷却0.16–0.38 ps，快弛豫35–60 ps，长寿命336–491 ps，以及高载流子密度下的热声子瓶颈效应）；密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Real-space Floquet topology written by the orbital angular momentum of light
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering usually treats light as a uniform control field that changes the topology of an entire driven material. Here we show that structured light carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) enables a different regime, in which topology is written directly in real space. For ultrathin topological insulator films, circularly polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beams generate a radial Floquet mass whose sign changes define a topological annulus bounded by two concentric chiral ring modes. The transition is helicity selective: below a thickness-dependent critical frequency, left-circularly polarized light drives mass inversion, whereas right-circularly polarized light increases the gap and leaves the film trivial. Independently, the OAM quantum number shifts and reshapes the annulus without changing the frequency, intensity, or helicity. In the decoupled-surfaces limit, the same mechanism produces a purely Floquet-induced topological mass and a vortex-core zero mode. These results identify photon OAM as a control parameter for nonequilibrium topology and provide a route to programmable topological landscapes in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论Floquet工程、质量反转、拓扑相变等概念，未提及实验或数值计算方法，属于理论分析。；研究对象：超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜在携带轨道角动量（OAM）的圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束照射下的非平衡拓扑性质，具体关注实空间拓扑结构的写入与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带OAM的结构光可在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中直接写入实空间拓扑结构：产生由两个同心手性环模界定的拓扑环带，且该环带的几何形状可由光子OAM量子数独立调控，无需改变频率、强度或偏振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带OAM的结构光可在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中直接写入实空间拓扑结构：产生由两个同心手性环模界定的拓扑环带，且该环带的几何形状可由光子OAM量子数独立调控，无需改变频率、强度或偏振。；创新点：将光子OAM确立为控制非平衡拓扑的新参数，实现了从“均匀全场调控拓扑”到“实空间局域写入拓扑”的范式转变，为可编程拓扑景观提供了理论路径。摘要未突出说明与其他具体理论方案的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于Floquet工程，考虑圆偏振拉盖尔-高斯光束与超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜的耦合，分析径向Floquet质量分布、厚度依赖的临界频率、螺旋性选择性以及解耦表面极限下的拓扑质量与涡旋零模。

papers.title: Generalized s-d model for Wannier-Mott excitons in layered magnetic semiconductors
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of excitons coupled to the magnetic order, and the consequent strong magneto-optic responses, in some van der Waals magnetic semiconductors has triggered intense activity at the interface of magnetism and semiconductor optics. Here, we present an analytically tractable minimal model that describes magnetic order, electrons, holes, and excitons within a unified framework, thereby capturing a wide range of phenomena. It treats the magnetic order and itinerant carriers to be comprised by distinct electronic orbitals that are mutually coupled via orbital-dependent onsite exchange, similar to the treatment of metallic magnets using an s-d model. Investigating CrSBr bilayer as a case study, we benchmark our model and its predictions against recent experimental and ab-initio results finding good agreement as well as new insights enabled by the model's simplicity. Examining the optical selection rules, we find the conservation of a quantum number formed from a combination of spin and layer pseudospin to be a useful guiding principle, even in noncollinear magnetic configurations. Our analysis finds a series of bright and dark excitonic states in such layered A-type antiferromagnets. The presented framework should be valuable in achieving intuitive understanding of recently discovered excitonic phenomena and guiding the discovery of other excitonic states in layered magnetic semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically tractable minimal model”（解析可处理的最小模型）、“theoretical framework”等关键词，属于理论建模研究。；研究对象：层状磁性半导体中的Wannier-Mott激子，具体以CrSBr双层作为案例研究，涉及磁有序、电子、空穴与激子之间的耦合，以及非共线磁构型下的光学选择定则。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型统一描述了磁有序与巡游载流子（电子/空穴）及其束缚态激子，在CrSBr双层中成功复现了近期实验与第一性原理结果，并揭示了一个由自旋与层赝自旋组合而成的守恒量子数，可用于理解非共线磁构型下的光学选择定则，进而预言了一系列亮态与暗态激子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型统一描述了磁有序与巡游载流子（电子/空穴）及其束缚态激子，在CrSBr双层中成功复现了近期实验与第一性原理结果，并揭示了一个由自旋与层赝自旋组合而成的守恒量子数，可用于理解非共线磁构型下的光学选择定则，进而预言了一系列亮态与暗态激子。；创新点：提出了一个解析可处理的最小模型，将磁有序、电子、空穴和激子纳入统一框架，能够直观理解层状磁性半导体中激子-磁序耦合现象；并首次指出自旋与层赝自旋组合量子数的守恒可作为非共线磁构型下光学选择定则的指导原则。（摘要未突出说明与已有s-d模型相比的具体理论改进细节。）
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个推广的s-d模型：将磁有序与巡游载流子视为由不同电子轨道构成，通过轨道依赖的局域在位交换相互作用耦合（类比金属磁体中s-d模型的处理方式）。以CrSBr双层为基准体系，将模型预测与近期实验及从头计算（ab-initio）结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Multimodal and Multiscale Interrogation of a Mechanically Tough Glass Forming Copper-Based Metal-Organic Framework
papers.abstract: A copper-based metal-organic framework, Cu(Im)2, was synthesized using a sol-gel process and subsequently melt-quenched into glass upon heating above 240 °C. In this paper, we present a multimodal, multiscale interrogation of the MOF nanocrystals and the resulting glasses. Structural characterization using X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and electron microscopy was performed to understand the morphology and size of the synthesized nanocrystals and glasses. Thermogravimetric analysis and differential scanning calorimetry were employed to understand the melting process of the crystals to form the glass. Synchrotron pair distribution function analysis was performed to verify that the framework structure is maintained upon melting, and nearfield infrared nanospectroscopy provided insight into the local chemical structure of the materials. The mechanical characterization via nanoindentation revealed that the resulting glasses exhibit an appreciably high elastic modulus (~10 GPa) and the highest fracture toughness (K_1c ~ 0.5 MPa m^1/2) yet reported for MOF glasses. This development is central to the emerging field of MOF-based materials processing and shaping, while upholding mechanical robustness and resistance to cracking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized”“structural characterization”“mechanical characterization via nanoindentation”等实验关键词。；研究对象：铜基MOF玻璃材料Cu(Im)₂，具体研究其纳米晶体经熔融淬火形成玻璃后的结构、热学与力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cu(Im)₂熔融淬火形成的MOF玻璃具有约10 GPa的高弹性模量，以及迄今报道的MOF玻璃中最高的断裂韧性（K₁c ≈ 0.5 MPa·m^1/2），兼具机械坚固性和抗开裂能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cu(Im)₂熔融淬火形成的MOF玻璃具有约10 GPa的高弹性模量，以及迄今报道的MOF玻璃中最高的断裂韧性（K₁c ≈ 0.5 MPa·m^1/2），兼具机械坚固性和抗开裂能力。；创新点：首次对MOF玻璃实现多模态、多尺度的综合表征，并报道了迄今最高的MOF玻璃断裂韧性，为MOF基材料加工成型中兼顾机械鲁棒性与抗裂性能提供了关键进展。
papers.method_zh: 溶胶-凝胶法合成Cu(Im)₂纳米晶体，加热至240 °C以上熔融淬火成玻璃；X射线衍射、原子力显微镜、电子显微镜表征形貌与尺寸；热重分析和差示扫描量热法研究熔化过程；同步辐射对分布函数分析验证熔融后框架结构保持；近场红外纳米光谱研究局域化学结构；纳米压痕进行力学表征。

papers.title: Gd-4f Exchange Splitting and Mo-4d Crystal-Field Redistribution in Gd/W Co-doped La2Mo2O9: A DFT+U Study
papers.abstract: La2Mo2O9 (LAMOX) is a promising oxide-ion conductor for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cells, but its practical application is limited by a first-order monoclinic-to-cubic (alpha to beta) phase transition. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of pristine La2Mo2O9 and the Gd/W co-doped composition La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9 using spin-polarized density functional theory with an on-site Hubbard correction for the localized Gd-4f states. The projected density of states reveals that pristine La2Mo2O9 is an O-2p/Mo-4d charge-transfer oxide in which La contributes negligibly near the band edges. Gd/W co-doping introduces a strongly exchange-split Gd-4f manifold with a majority-minority separation of approximately 1011 eV, substantially redistributes the Mo-4d electronic states through a threefold increase in crystal-field splitting, and reduces the O-2p contribution near the valence-band maximum from 78% to 66%. These electronic signatures are consistent with the experimentally observed lattice contraction, MoO Raman-mode softening, and the non-monotonic evolution of oxide-ion conductivity across the co-doped series. In particular, the pronounced crystal-field splitting and localized Gd magnetism at the highest doping level provide a microscopic electronic explanation for the observed suppression of ionic conductivity. The present results establish an atomistic electronic-structure framework for understanding dopant-induced phase stabilization and oxide- ion transport in Gd/W co-doped LAMOX electrolytes, providing design principles for improved solid oxide fuel cell materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及使用“spin-polarized density functional theory with an on-site Hubbard correction”（自旋极化密度泛函理论+ onsite Hubbard 修正，即 DFT+U）作为研究方法，且核心结论均基于电子结构计算得出。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料为 La2Mo2O9 (LAMOX) 氧化物离子导体及其 Gd/W 共掺杂衍生物 La1.6Gd0.4Mo1.7W0.3O9。研究的物理现象包括掺杂诱导的电子结构重排、晶体场劈裂变化、Gd-4f 交换劈裂，以及这些效应对相稳定性和离子电导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Gd/W 共掺杂在 La2Mo2O9 中引入了强交换劈裂的 Gd-4f 能级（多数/少数自旋态分离约 10-11 eV），并通过将 Mo-4d 晶体场劈裂增强三倍来显著重排 Mo-4d 电子态。这些电子结构变化为实验观察到的晶格收缩、MoO 拉曼模式软化以及最高掺杂水平下离子电导率被抑制提供了微观电子学解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Gd/W 共掺杂在 La2Mo2O9 中引入了强交换劈裂的 Gd-4f 能级（多数/少数自旋态分离约 10-11 eV），并通过将 Mo-4d 晶体场劈裂增强三倍来显著重排 Mo-4d 电子态。这些电子结构变化为实验观察到的晶格收缩、MoO 拉曼模式软化以及最高掺杂水平下离子电导率被抑制提供了微观电子学解释。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于首次从原子级电子结构层面（而非仅宏观晶格或声子层面）建立了掺杂剂（Gd/W）与 LAMOX 基体中 Mo-4d 晶体场重分布及 Gd-4f 局域磁性之间的直接联系，为理解掺杂诱导的相稳定和氧离子输运提供了微观框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用了自旋极化的密度泛函理论（DFT）加上对局域 Gd-4f 态的 onsite Hubbard 修正（即 DFT+U 方法）。具体分析手段为投影态密度（projected density of states），用于解析各元素轨道对能带边缘的贡献及劈裂行为。

papers.title: Fermi-Point Topology Determines Emergent Conformal Criticality in Extended Quantum Spin Chains
papers.abstract: Quantum criticality in one-dimensional quantum systems is characterized by emergent conformal field theories (CFTs), whose central charge counts independent gapless degrees of freedom. Establishing a microscopic connection between this universal conformal structure and the momentum-space topology of the underlying quasiparticle spectrum remains challenging. Here, we uncover a direct correspondence between Fermi-point topology, conformal criticality, and quantum entanglement in an extended quantum spin chain with competing cluster interactions, exchange anisotropy, and a transverse magnetic field. We show that interaction- and field-driven Lifshitz transitions generate conformal critical phases with effective central charges $c_{\rm eff}=1/2$, $1$, $3/2$, $2$, and $3$, including a multicritical point where Ising and Luttinger-liquid sectors coexist. Importantly, the central charge is not determined simply by the number of lattice gap closings or Fermi points, but by the number and conformal content of independent low-energy continuum sectors after accounting for lattice symmetries, reciprocal-lattice identifications, and mode equivalences. Thus, Lifshitz transitions may leave the conformal anomaly unchanged or modify the central charge depending on whether spectral reconstruction generates new independent continuum sectors. Real- and momentum-space entanglement spectra provide complementary microscopic signatures, revealing both the conformal content and momentum-space organization of critical modes. Our results establish a microscopic framework linking Fermi-point topology to emergent CFTs and show how interaction-driven spectral reconstruction can generate higher-central-charge criticality and unconventional multicritical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“establishing a microscopic connection”“uncover a direct correspondence”“show that”等理论推导性表述，以及“entanglement spectra”等数值计算特征，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维扩展量子自旋链，包含竞争性cluster相互作用、交换各向异性以及横向磁场。具体物理现象包括Lifshitz转变、共形临界相、多临界点以及量子纠缠结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该自旋链中Fermi点拓扑直接决定涌现共形场论的有效中心荷，可产生c_eff = 1/2、1、3/2、2、3的共形临界相，并存在Ising与Luttinger液体扇区共存的多临界点。中心荷并非由晶格能隙闭合数或Fermi点数简单决定，而是由独立低能连续扇区的数目与共形内容决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该自旋链中Fermi点拓扑直接决定涌现共形场论的有效中心荷，可产生c_eff = 1/2、1、3/2、2、3的共形临界相，并存在Ising与Luttinger液体扇区共存的多临界点。中心荷并非由晶格能隙闭合数或Fermi点数简单决定，而是由独立低能连续扇区的数目与共形内容决定。；创新点：建立了Fermi点拓扑与涌现共形场论之间的微观对应框架，揭示了Lifshitz转变对中心荷的影响取决于谱重构是否产生新的独立连续扇区（而非简单的能隙闭合计数），并展示了相互作用驱动的谱重构可产生更高中心荷的临界性与非常规多临界行为。摘要未突出说明与具体已有模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值计算：利用动量空间拓扑分析（Fermi点拓扑与Lifshitz转变分类），结合实空间与动量空间的纠缠谱计算，用于提取共形内容与临界模的动量空间组织。摘要未明确提及具体数值算法（如DMRG或精确对角化），但“entanglement spectra”暗示使用了张量网络或精确对角化类方法。

papers.title: Hidden Magnetic Octupolar Order driven by Spin-Orbit coupling in KFeF$_3$
papers.abstract: Phase transitions are typically driven by symmetry-breaking structural distortions that lift electronic degeneracies, yet in some cases, these transitions may be driven by a hidden order without conventional structural signatures. Here, we demonstrate that the 3$d$ perovskite, KFeF$_3$, hosts such a hidden instability. Using a combination of high-resolution powder diffraction, magnetometry, symmetry-based analysis and first principles calculations, we reveal that while the 90 K cubic to rhombohedral transition arises from conventional magnetostriction accompanying antiferromagnetic order, a second transition at 40 K lowers the symmetry to monoclinic without any detectable Jahn-Teller distortion or translational symmetry-breaking. Symmetry-based Landau analysis supports a hidden zone centered magnetic octupole order parameter, whose improper coupling accounts for the weak ferromagnetism and pronounced symmetry-breaking strain. Density functional calculations show that spin-orbit coupling suppresses the competing Jahn-Teller instability, and thereby favors higher rank magnetic multipolar degrees of freedom. These findings establish KFeF$_3$ as a model system in which the competing energy scales between spin-orbit coupling and orbital degeneracy result in the emergence of hidden, multipolar order. We show that the control of such magnetic, multipolar order could, in principle, provide a route to induce altermagnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“高分辨粉末衍射、磁测量”等实验手段，同时包含“对称性分析、第一性原理计算”等理论与计算方法。；研究对象：3d 钙钛矿材料 KFeF₃，具体研究其 90 K 与 40 K 两次结构相变背后的磁性序与多极序物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: KFeF₃ 在 40 K 发生无常规结构畸变（无 Jahn-Teller 畸变、无平移对称性破缺）的隐藏相变，其序参量为以布里渊区中心为特征的磁八极序；自旋-轨道耦合抑制了竞争的 Jahn-Teller 不稳定性，从而促成高秩磁多极自由度的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：KFeF₃ 在 40 K 发生无常规结构畸变（无 Jahn-Teller 畸变、无平移对称性破缺）的隐藏相变，其序参量为以布里渊区中心为特征的磁八极序；自旋-轨道耦合抑制了竞争的 Jahn-Teller 不稳定性，从而促成高秩磁多极自由度的出现。；创新点：首次在 3d 钙钛矿体系中揭示由自旋-轨道耦合与轨道简并竞争所驱动的隐藏磁八极序，并指出该类多极序原则上可作为诱导交错磁性（altermagnetism）的调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨粉末衍射、磁化率/磁测量、基于对称性的 Landau 理论分析、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Weak-coupling theory of half-metals and other fractional metallic phases in biased doped Bernal bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: The paper presents a theoretical study of many-body electronic phases in doped and electrically biased Bernal-stacked (AB) bilayer graphene. We develop a variational mean-field theory with no fitted parameters. For the electron-electron interaction, we employ a parameter-free random-phase approximation to model the short-range screened Coulomb repulsion. The remaining long-range Coulomb potential energy is dictated by the geometry of the sample, behaving as a parallel-plate capacitor. We formulate the theory directly in terms of the experimentally controlled displacement field $\frak D$ rather than the interaction-renormalized interlayer potential difference. It makes our theory better suited for direct comparison with experiment. The resulting phase diagram is quite rich. It hosts several fractional-metal states connected by first- and second-order transitions. At higher bias and doping, three distinct fractional metallic states emerge. We classify these phases by the number of doped sectors and the symmetry of the order parameters. Our results - obtained without any parameter fitting - reproduce key qualitative and quantitative features of recent experiments. This includes the energy scale associated with the loss of fractional metallic order. At lower bias and doping, the model stabilizes a broad spectrum of fractional-metal phases with more exotic symmetry-breaking patterns. This suggests that further experimental exploration of the latter regime is warranted.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretical study”“variational mean-field theory”“no fitted parameters”。；研究对象：掺杂且施加垂直电场（偏置）的Bernal堆叠（AB）双层石墨烯中的多体电子相，特别是分数金属态（fractional metallic phases）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在偏置和掺杂的双层石墨烯中，理论预言存在多种分数金属态，由一级和二级相变连接；在高偏置和高掺杂区出现三种不同的分数金属态，其能量尺度与近期实验定性定量吻合；在低偏置和低掺杂区则稳定了更多具有奇异对称性破缺模式的分数金属相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在偏置和掺杂的双层石墨烯中，理论预言存在多种分数金属态，由一级和二级相变连接；在高偏置和高掺杂区出现三种不同的分数金属态，其能量尺度与近期实验定性定量吻合；在低偏置和低掺杂区则稳定了更多具有奇异对称性破缺模式的分数金属相。；创新点：理论完全无拟合参数，且直接以实验可控的位移场 \(\frak D\) 表述，便于与实验直接对比；预言了低偏置低掺杂区存在更丰富的分数金属相，提示该区域值得进一步实验探索。（摘要未突出说明与已有理论工作的其他差异。）
papers.method_zh: 无拟合参数的变分平均场理论；电子-电子相互作用采用无参数随机相位近似（RPA）描述短程屏蔽库仑排斥，长程库仑势由样品几何（平行板电容器模型）决定；理论直接以实验可控的位移场 \(\frak D\) 为变量，而非相互作用重整化后的层间势差。

papers.title: Finite-temperature mass gap and quench dynamics of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas
papers.abstract: Recently, a mass-gap description of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas was introduced, which connects Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe for static impurities to the quasiparticle picture of Fermi polarons through a recoil-induced energy gap in the fermionic dispersion. That description, however, was restricted to zero temperature and did not address dynamics. Here we generalize the mass-gap model to finite temperature by combining the Lee--Low--Pines transformation with a self-consistent Hartree--Fock decoupling of the recoil-induced interaction, and we study the quench dynamics within this framework using the functional-determinant approach. At finite temperature the effective mass gap obeys the self-consistency equation $Δ(T)=2U_F\tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]$, with $U_F=k_F^2/2M$ and $M$ the impurity mass. This equation admits a nonzero solution below the characteristic temperature $T^*=U_F/(2k_B)$ and closes as $(T^*-T)^{1/2}$. We identify this closing as the mean-field signature of the thermal melting of the polaron and molecule quasiparticles. Computing the Ramsey response $S(t)$ after a sudden quench of the impurity--fermion interaction, we find that its long-time oscillations---quantum beats between the bound and in-gap states---disappear precisely above $T^*$. Our work ties the thermodynamic and dynamical fingerprints of polaron formation to a single temperature-dependent mean-field parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalize the mass-gap model、self-consistent Hartree–Fock decoupling、functional-determinant approach。；研究对象：费米气体中的移动杂质（Fermi polarons），具体研究其有限温度下的质量间隙（mass gap）以及淬火动力学（quench dynamics）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限温度下有效质量间隙满足自洽方程 Δ(T)=2U_F tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]，在特征温度 T*=U_F/(2k_B) 以下存在非零解，并以 (T*−T)^{1/2} 方式闭合；该闭合被识别为极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的平均场标志。Ramsey 响应 S(t) 的长时振荡（束缚态与带隙态之间的量子拍）恰好在此温度以上消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限温度下有效质量间隙满足自洽方程 Δ(T)=2U_F tanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T]，在特征温度 T*=U_F/(2k_B) 以下存在非零解，并以 (T*−T)^{1/2} 方式闭合；该闭合被识别为极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的平均场标志。Ramsey 响应 S(t) 的长时振荡（束缚态与带隙态之间的量子拍）恰好在此温度以上消失。；创新点：将此前仅限于零温且不涉及动力学的质量间隙描述推广到有限温度，并首次在该框架内研究淬火动力学，将极化子形成的热力学与动力学特征统一到一个温度依赖的平均场参数上。
papers.method_zh: 将 Lee–Low–Pines 变换与自洽 Hartree–Fock 退耦相结合，推广质量间隙模型至有限温度；利用泛函行列式方法（functional-determinant approach）研究淬火动力学。

papers.title: Low-Frequency Charge Noise in Bilayer Graphene Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Bilayer graphene (BLG) quantum dots (QDs) are a promising platform for semiconductor qubits. However, the low-frequency charge noise that may ultimately limit coherence has remained largely unexplored. Here, we systematically characterize charge noise in gate-defined BLG QDs using transport-based noise spectroscopy. We extract a median amplitude of $ S_μ^{1/2} (1~\text{Hz}) = 1.16~μ\text{eV}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$, placing BLG well within the range reported for established semiconductor quantum-dot platforms. Across variations in charge occupation, confinement, source-drain bias, and charge-sensor operating conditions, neither the noise amplitude nor the spectral dependence shows a reproducible trend in electrostatic tuning, indicating that we extracted the intrinsic semiconductor noise. Consistent noise levels are further observed in double QDs and confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout. Extending the study to BLG devices incorporating transition metal dichalcogenide layers reveals no measurable charge noise increase in weakly proximitized QDs. These results validate BLG as a viable platform for coherent quantum information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“systematically characterize”（系统表征）、“transport-based noise spectroscopy”（基于输运的噪声谱学）以及“confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout”（使用独立的超导谐振腔色散读出进行确认），均为实验手段。；研究对象：双层石墨烯（BLG）量子点（QDs）中的低频电荷噪声。具体研究了门定义的双层石墨烯量子点在不同静电调控条件下的电荷噪声特性，并延伸至包含过渡金属硫族化物（TMDC）层的器件。
