papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双层石墨烯量子点的电荷噪声幅度中位数为 $ S_μ^{1/2} (1~\text{Hz}) = 1.16~μ\text{eV}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$，与已成熟半导体量子点平台相当。该噪声幅度和频谱依赖在多种静电调控参数下均无显著变化，表明其反映的是本征半导体噪声，验证了双层石墨烯作为相干量子信息处理平台的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双层石墨烯量子点的电荷噪声幅度中位数为 $ S_μ^{1/2} (1~\text{Hz}) = 1.16~μ\text{eV}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$，与已成熟半导体量子点平台相当。该噪声幅度和频谱依赖在多种静电调控参数下均无显著变化，表明其反映的是本征半导体噪声，验证了双层石墨烯作为相干量子信息处理平台的可行性。；创新点：首次对门定义双层石墨烯量子点的低频电荷噪声进行系统性表征，并证明其噪声水平与成熟平台相当且不随静电调控变化（即提取到本征噪声）。此外，研究还扩展到弱近邻化（weakly proximitized）的TMDC-石墨烯混合器件，发现未引入可测量的额外电荷噪声。
papers.method_zh: 基于输运的噪声谱学（transport-based noise spectroscopy）进行系统表征；使用超导谐振腔色散读出（superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout）作为独立验证手段。实验变量包括电荷占据数、限制势、源漏偏压和电荷传感器工作条件。

papers.title: Pseudospectral Methods and Critical Phenomena
papers.abstract: We employ pseudospectral methods to solve the homogeneous Ornstein-Zernike (OZ) equation for a model fluid in the vicinity of the critical point. Focusing on the Mean-Spherical Approximation (MSA) as a closure to the OZ equation, we obtain numerical estimates for the critical exponents $η$, $δ$ and $γ$ for a system of hard-core Yukawa particles both in two and three dimensions. The three-dimensional MSA exponents are already well-known from an analytic solution and are recovered by our numerical methods. The two-dimensional exponents are a new output of this work. The pseudospectral method allows for rapid and highly accurate solution of liquid-state integral equation theories, and enables calculations on truely infinite domains, as needed for highly correlated states. In addition, we analyse the standard Picard iteration scheme and propose a variation of it which provides increased stability and speed of convergence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“pseudospectral methods”（赝谱方法）、“solve the homogeneous Ornstein-Zernike equation”（求解OZ方程）、“numerical estimates”（数值估计）。；研究对象：硬核Yukawa粒子流体在临界点附近的临界现象，具体研究二维和三维体系中的临界指数η、δ和γ。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用赝谱方法求解OZ方程并结合MSA闭合关系，成功恢复了三维体系已知的MSA临界指数，并首次给出了二维体系的MSA临界指数数值估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用赝谱方法求解OZ方程并结合MSA闭合关系，成功恢复了三维体系已知的MSA临界指数，并首次给出了二维体系的MSA临界指数数值估计。；创新点：将赝谱方法应用于液态积分方程理论，能够在真正无限域上进行计算（适用于强关联态），并首次获得二维硬核Yukawa体系在MSA闭合下的临界指数。此外，提出了对Picard迭代的改进方案。
papers.method_zh: 赝谱方法（pseudospectral methods）求解均匀Ornstein-Zernike积分方程，采用平均球近似（MSA）作为闭合关系；同时分析了标准Picard迭代方案，并提出了一种改进的迭代变体以提高稳定性和收敛速度。

papers.title: Spectral properties of deterministic matrices multiplied by rotationally invariant random non-Hermitian ensembles
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study spectral properties of multiplicative deformations of non-Hermitian random matrices. We consider matrices of the form $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}$, where $\mathbf{A}$ is a deterministic $N\times N$ matrix (not necessarily Hermitian) and $\mathbf{B}$ is a rotationally invariant random matrix. We show that, as $N\to\infty$, the boundary of the complex eigenvalue distribution of $\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}$ is governed by simple equations involving the $\mathcal{R}_1$ and $\mathcal{R}_2$ transforms of $\mathbf{B}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用数学证明与渐近分析（“as \(N\to\infty\)”），属于随机矩阵理论的形式化推导。；研究对象：非厄米随机矩阵的乘法变形，具体为确定性矩阵 \(\mathbf{A}\) 与旋转不变随机矩阵 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的乘积 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复平面本征值分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当矩阵维度 \(N\to\infty\) 时，乘积矩阵 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复本征值分布边界由仅涉及 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换的简单方程决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当矩阵维度 \(N\to\infty\) 时，乘积矩阵 \(\mathbf{A}\mathbf{B}\) 的复本征值分布边界由仅涉及 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换的简单方程决定。；创新点：将确定性矩阵与非厄米旋转不变随机矩阵的乘法变形谱问题，归结为仅依赖随机部分 \(\mathbf{B}\) 的变换的简洁边界方程，推广了此前对厄米或单一随机矩阵谱的研究。摘要未突出说明与具体物理体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 随机矩阵理论中的自由概率/自由卷积框架，利用 \(\mathcal{R}_1\) 与 \(\mathcal{R}_2\) 变换（非厄米版本的 \(R\)-变换）进行大 \(N\) 极限下的谱边界分析。摘要未提及具体数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Frenkel line of Yukawa fluids within the self-consistent relaxation theory
papers.abstract: For a simple model fluid, the Yukawa fluid, the condition for dynamic crossover, known as the Frenkel line, is defined. The condition is related to the fact that the roton minimum in the dispersion relation of longitudinal acoustic-like excitations exists only when the collective vibrational dynamics of particles dominates in the liquid. Based on the self-consistent relaxation theory for the Yukawa fluid, thermodynamic states are determined in which the roton minimum disappears. The obtained values of the state parameters for the Frenkel line are consistent with the results of studies in which the position of this line on the phase diagram of the Yukawa fluid was determined using molecular dynamics simulations. It is shown that the Frenkel line in this system can be determined directly from the structural characteristic -- the static structure factor. A physical interpretation of the roton minimum frequency for the simple liquids near the Frenkel line is proposed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“基于自洽弛豫理论”（self-consistent relaxation theory）来定义和确定热力学状态，属于理论推导与分析。；研究对象：Yukawa流体（简单模型流体）中的Frenkel线（动力学交叉线），具体关注纵声学类激发的色散关系中roton极小值的存在与消失条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Yukawa流体的相图中，Frenkel线对应roton极小值消失的热力学状态边界；该线的位置可由静态结构因子这一结构特征直接确定，且与分子动力学模拟结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Yukawa流体的相图中，Frenkel线对应roton极小值消失的热力学状态边界；该线的位置可由静态结构因子这一结构特征直接确定，且与分子动力学模拟结果一致。；创新点：首次在自洽弛豫理论框架下为Yukawa流体定义Frenkel线条件，并证明该线可直接从静态结构因子（而非仅依赖动力学量）确定；此外，对Frenkel线附近简单液体的roton极小频率给出了物理诠释。
papers.method_zh: 自洽弛豫理论（self-consistent relaxation theory），用于分析纵声学类激发的色散关系；同时结合静态结构因子（static structure factor）作为结构判据，并与已有分子动力学模拟结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: Patterned Substrates Unlock Self-Electrophoretic Phenomenon in Active Janus Microswimmers
papers.abstract: Inert colloids half-coated with platinum (Pt) are a standard model of chemically powered active particles, yet the microscopic origins of their propulsion in hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) remain difficult to dissect experimentally. Whereas self-diffusiophoresis was the prevailing theory, self-electrophoresis has been more recently suggested as the main mechanism of propulsion. According to the latter mechanism, the pole-to-equator Pt-thickness gradient produced by directional metal deposition is sufficient to create anodic and cathodic regions on the metal cap and thereby generate an electric field sustained by H2O2 decomposition. Enhancing self-propulsion performance of such particles thus requires precise control over the Pt thickness distribution, which is currently not achievable with standard methods (e.g. evaporation or sputtering). Here, we propose a method to fabricate Janus active particles by assembling silica microspheres on patterned substrates containing spherical grooves whose depth and spacing set the degree of particle coating while simultaneously suppressing proximity-led defects (Pt bridges). The resulting particles exhibit a tunable platinum-thickness contrast, as verified by Focused-Ion-Beam cross-sections. In 2.5% H2O2, our results suggest that this control can significantly increase propulsion efficiency, while providing evidence indirectly supporting the hypothesis that self-electrophoresis is the dominant mechanism. These results demonstrate that our patterned-substrate route can enhance control over the catalyst deposition and enable novel Janus morphologies, allowing for more precise engineering of active colloids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“我们提出一种制造方法”“通过聚焦离子束截面验证”“在2.5% H2O2中测试”，属于实验研究。；研究对象：半包覆铂（Pt）的二氧化硅（SiO2）胶体微球构成的Janus活性微泳者，在过氧化氢（H2O2）燃料中的自泳推进现象，重点关注自电泳（self-electrophoresis）机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在具有球形凹槽的图案化基底上组装二氧化硅微球，可实现铂镀层厚度对比度的可调控制，从而显著提高Janus微泳者在2.5% H2O2中的推进效率；该结果间接支持自电泳是主导推进机制的假说。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在具有球形凹槽的图案化基底上组装二氧化硅微球，可实现铂镀层厚度对比度的可调控制，从而显著提高Janus微泳者在2.5% H2O2中的推进效率；该结果间接支持自电泳是主导推进机制的假说。；创新点：提出了一种利用图案化基底（含球形凹槽）替代传统蒸发或溅射方法的新颖制备路线，首次实现对铂厚度分布（极-赤道梯度）的精确控制，从而能够系统调控自电泳驱动力，并抑制邻近效应导致的铂桥缺陷。摘要未突出说明与传统方法在具体推进效率数值上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 图案化基底辅助组装法（利用球形凹槽的深度和间距控制颗粒包覆程度并抑制铂桥缺陷）；聚焦离子束（FIB）截面表征铂厚度分布；在2.5% H2O2溶液中进行活性运动观测以评估推进效率。

papers.title: Charge Regulated conformational properties of polyelectrolyte near an oppositely charged nanoparticle
papers.abstract: Customizing the surface characteristics and stimuli-responsive behavior of nanoparticles with polyelectrolytes ushers in a new era across many aspects of our lives, ranging from advanced diagnostics to practical applications. Here, using hybrid CR Monte Carlo/ molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate how charge regulation can play a crucial role in shaping the adsorption dynamics of polyelectrolyte (PE) on oppositely charged nanoparticle (NP). We systematically investigate the influence of salt density, and polymer chain length on the PE-NP interaction. To complement CR results, we also perform molecular simulations under constant charge conditions. At high salt concentrations, CR enhances the adsorption of PE onto the NP surface, leading to a rapid decrease in the radius of gyration of PE; conversely, CC promotes the extended conformation of PE. No clear effect of PE length is observed at either low or high salt concentrations, whereas in CC simulations, the PE relaxes faster on the NP in the case of short chains. Furthermore, By comparing these results, we demonstrate that the MSD of PE follows a more direct path during adsorption implying a ballistic motion, whereas in the CC case, it exhibits subdiffusive behavior and delayed adsorption in both low and high salt density. Our findings indicates that 'tunable CR' is a robust strategy for controlling nanoparticle stability and interaction within a complex biochemical cues.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid CR Monte Carlo/ molecular dynamics simulations”（混合电荷调节蒙特卡洛/分子动力学模拟），以及“molecular simulations under constant charge conditions”（恒电荷条件下的分子模拟）。；研究对象：聚电解质（PE）与带相反电荷的纳米颗粒（NP）之间的吸附动力学，具体关注电荷调节（charge regulation, CR）效应、盐浓度和聚合物链长对二者相互作用及构象行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高盐浓度下，电荷调节（CR）效应增强聚电解质在纳米颗粒表面的吸附，并使其回旋半径快速减小；而恒电荷（CC）条件则促进聚电解质采取伸展构象。CR条件下聚电解质的均方位移（MSD）呈弹道运动特征，而CC条件下呈亚扩散行为并延迟吸附。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高盐浓度下，电荷调节（CR）效应增强聚电解质在纳米颗粒表面的吸附，并使其回旋半径快速减小；而恒电荷（CC）条件则促进聚电解质采取伸展构象。CR条件下聚电解质的均方位移（MSD）呈弹道运动特征，而CC条件下呈亚扩散行为并延迟吸附。；创新点：首次将电荷调节（CR）机制引入聚电解质-纳米颗粒吸附动力学研究，揭示了CR与CC条件下截然不同的吸附路径（弹道vs亚扩散）和构象演化，提出“可调CR”可作为控制纳米颗粒稳定性和相互作用的策略。摘要未突出说明与以往CR模拟工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合电荷调节蒙特卡洛/分子动力学（CR Monte Carlo/MD）模拟，并与恒电荷（CC）条件下的分子模拟进行对照；系统扫描盐浓度和聚合物链长两个参数。

papers.title: High-Throughput Computational Discovery of Inverted Resistive Switching in Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: Atomristors, non-volatile resistive switching devices based on two-dimensional (2D) monolayers, are promising building blocks for energy-efficient memory and neuromorphic computing. However, their design remains restricted to a few materials such as MoS2 and h-BN, limiting functional diversity and design flexibility. Here, a high-throughput computational framework combining density functional theory, machine-learning molecular dynamics, and quantum transport simulations screens about 2,900 exfoliable monolayers for vacancy-mediated resistive switching, identifying 17 thermally stable candidates in two mechanistically distinct classes. In Class 1 monolayers, such as GaS, Au adsorption at the native vacancy introduces conducting states, switching the insulating monolayer from a high- to a low-resistance state (HRS-to-LRS). Class 2 monolayers, comprising ionically bonded metal oxyhalides and nitrohalides such as BiOCl, exhibit previously unreported inverted switching. Vacancy-released electrons delocalize and push the Fermi level into the conduction band, placing the device natively in the LRS; Au adsorption re-localizes these carriers and returns the Fermi level to the gap, driving LRS-to-HRS switching. Quantum transport simulations confirm both mechanisms, while migration-barrier calculations identify the electrode-2D separation as a key parameter governing Au migration and the resistance window. These findings expand the atomristor landscape and establish complementary switching as a design paradigm for multifunctional memory and neuromorphic hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“high-throughput computational framework”“density functional theory”“machine-learning molecular dynamics”“quantum transport simulations”。；研究对象：二维单层材料中的原子级阻变器件（atomristors），具体涉及约2,900种可剥离单层材料中由空位介导的阻变行为，包括GaS、BiOCl等候选材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量筛选发现17种热力学稳定的阻变候选材料，分为两类机制：传统的高阻到低阻（HRS-to-LRS）切换（如GaS），以及此前未报道的“反向切换”（LRS-to-HRS，如BiOCl），后者源于空位释放电子使费米能级进入导带，而Au吸附使载流子重新局域化并恢复带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量筛选发现17种热力学稳定的阻变候选材料，分为两类机制：传统的高阻到低阻（HRS-to-LRS）切换（如GaS），以及此前未报道的“反向切换”（LRS-to-HRS，如BiOCl），后者源于空位释放电子使费米能级进入导带，而Au吸附使载流子重新局域化并恢复带隙。；创新点：首次提出并验证了“反向阻变”（inverted resistive switching）机制，将阻变行为从传统HRS→LRS扩展到LRS→HRS方向，并建立了基于离子键合金属氧卤化物/氮卤化物的新候选材料家族，显著扩展了atomristor的材料空间和功能多样性。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）、机器学习分子动力学（ML-MD）、量子输运模拟、迁移势垒计算（用于评估Au迁移与电极-二维材料间距的关系）。

papers.title: SALTED: a symmetry-adapted machine-learning program for predicting electron-densities in molecules and materials
papers.abstract: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, $n(\mathbf{r})$, in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structure programs based on atomic orbitals, namely CP2K, FHI-aims, and PySCF, from which reference electron-density data can be generated and used to train a model. The learning algorithm is based on a symmetry-adapted extension of Gaussian process regression, making SALTED especially efficient in small-data regimes. Thanks to the implementation of vector-field kernel functions, SALTED can also learn the first-order response of the electron density to applied electric fields, $\partial n(\mathbf{r})/\partial \mathbf{E}$. The application of SALTED within computational workflows has already shown its utility in a wide variety of contexts, including the calculation of polarization vectors and polarizability tensors, the accurate evaluation of Coulomb forces in QM/MM molecular-dynamics simulations, and electronic-structure studies of large-scale 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning”“Gaussian process regression”“open-source Python package”，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：分子和凝聚态体系（材料）中的量子力学电子密度 n(r)，以及其对电场的线性响应 ∂n(r)/∂E。摘要未明确限定具体材料种类，但提及应用场景包括二维材料、QM/MM 体系等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出具体物理体系的新物理结论，核心贡献在于提供了一个基于对称自适应高斯过程回归的、可迁移的电子密度机器学习预测程序包 SALTED，并展示了其在极化、QM/MM 力及二维材料电子结构计算中的实用性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出具体物理体系的新物理结论，核心贡献在于提供了一个基于对称自适应高斯过程回归的、可迁移的电子密度机器学习预测程序包 SALTED，并展示了其在极化、QM/MM 力及二维材料电子结构计算中的实用性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对已有工作的具体新意，但可归纳为：将对称自适应高斯过程回归扩展到电子密度及其电场响应预测，并提供了与主流原子轨道基组电子结构程序无缝对接的开源实现，特别适合小数据 regime 下的训练。
papers.method_zh: 对称自适应高斯过程回归（symmetry-adapted Gaussian process regression），采用线性原子中心分解表示电子密度；与基于原子轨道的电子结构程序（CP2K、FHI-aims、PySCF）接口生成参考数据；实现了矢量场核函数以学习密度对电场的响应。

papers.title: Heterogeneous collapse in thermoresponsive copolymer microgels varying molar composition
papers.abstract: Understanding the internal architecture of copolymer microgels is crucial for establishing how nanoscale polymer organization controls their stimuli-responsive behavior. Here we focus on thermoresponsive P(N-isopropylacrylamide-co-N-isopropyl-methacrylamide), P(NIPAM-co-NIPMAM), microgels with varying mole fraction of the components, synthesized via radical precipitation polymerization, and we demonstrate that changes in their volume phase transition and equilibrium swelling are governed by composition-dependent internal heterogeneity. Comparison between small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) with isotopic labeling and monomer-resolved simulations show a block-like monomer distribution of the two components. SANS analysis reveals a universal maximum in the polymer mesh correlation length near the transition, evidencing coexistence of collapsed NIPAM-rich and swollen domains. The correlation length increases with increasing NIPMAM content, with a maximum for 75 mol \% NIPMAM, implying sparse collapsed regions within the network and thus a large degree of heterogeneity induced by the presence of an increasingly large fraction of intercalated, non-collapsing PNIPMAM. The maximum heterogeneity correlates with the equilibrium swelling ratio, indicating that collapsed microgels retain a structural memory of the transition and present a less-compliant structure in response to temperature variations. Overall, these insights highlight a complex effect of the block-like monomer distribution on the responsive properties of copolymer microgels with different compositions, thus providing a design rule for tailoring responsive colloids for functional soft materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与模拟混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时涉及“small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) with isotopic labeling”实验手段和“monomer-resolved simulations”计算方法。；研究对象：热响应共聚物微凝胶，具体为P(NIPAM-co-NIPMAM)（N-异丙基丙烯酰胺与N-异丙基甲基丙烯酰胺共聚物），研究其不同单体摩尔组成下的体积相变行为与内部异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 共聚物微凝胶的体积相变和平衡溶胀行为由其组成依赖的内部异质性控制：两种单体呈类嵌段分布，相变时NIPAM富集区塌缩而NIPMAM富集区保持溶胀，形成塌缩与溶胀域共存；异质性程度随NIPMAM含量增加而增大，在75 mol% NIPMAM时达到最大，且最大异质性与平衡溶胀比相关，表明塌缩后的微凝胶保留了相变的结构记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：共聚物微凝胶的体积相变和平衡溶胀行为由其组成依赖的内部异质性控制：两种单体呈类嵌段分布，相变时NIPAM富集区塌缩而NIPMAM富集区保持溶胀，形成塌缩与溶胀域共存；异质性程度随NIPMAM含量增加而增大，在75 mol% NIPMAM时达到最大，且最大异质性与平衡溶胀比相关，表明塌缩后的微凝胶保留了相变的结构记忆。；创新点：揭示了共聚物微凝胶中类嵌段单体分布对响应性能的复杂影响，建立了组成依赖的内部异质性与宏观溶胀行为之间的定量关联，为设计功能软材料中的响应性胶体提供了组分调控的设计规则。摘要未突出说明与以往仅关注均聚物或均匀共聚物微凝胶研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 自由基沉淀聚合合成不同组成的共聚物微凝胶；小角中子散射（SANS）结合同位素标记（氘代标记）表征内部结构；单体分辨模拟（monomer-resolved simulations）用于对比验证单体分布；通过SANS提取聚合物网格关联长度（mesh correlation length）随温度的变化。

papers.title: Sample-specific rectification-like response in a boundary-driven exclusion process
papers.abstract: We investigate the current response of a boundary-driven symmetric exclusion process with quenched site disorder. Hard-core particles hop symmetrically on a one-dimensional lattice with site-dependent rates and are injected and removed at the boundaries by two reservoirs of different densities. We approximate the steady-state density profile using a Galerkin projection at linear order and a mean-field closure at higher orders, and thereby obtain the current as a nonlinear function of the reservoir density difference. At linear order in the reservoir density difference, the current-response coefficient depends on the mean reservoir density $ρ$, in contrast to the homogeneous case. Through the linear-response relation, this dependence leads to an equilibrium current-fluctuation coefficient that is asymmetric under $ρ\rightarrow 1-ρ$. Beyond linear response, nonzero even-order current contributions break the antisymmetry of the current under reversal of the reservoir density difference, producing rectification-like behavior in individual disorder realizations. We further show that spatial-reflection symmetry of the equilibrium density profile rules out such behavior, so broken spatial-reflection symmetry of the profile is a necessary condition for rectification-like behavior. Within the present approximation, we further find that, for continuously distributed site disorder, rectification-like behavior occurs arbitrarily close to equilibrium for almost every disorder realization. At the ensemble level, however, the disorder-averaged current remains antisymmetric because the disorder ensemble is invariant under spatial reflection. These results provide a mechanism for rectification-like transport arising from sample-specific spatial heterogeneity rather than from an explicitly imposed directional asymmetry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中涉及模型构建（Galerkin投影、平均场闭合）、稳态近似推导与解析分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维边界驱动对称排斥过程（symmetric exclusion process）中的淬火无序位点体系，即具有位点依赖跳跃率的硬核粒子输运系统，重点研究其电流响应与整流类行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单个无序实现中，电流对储库密度差的反转不再保持反对称，出现整流类响应；该行为源于平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺，而非外加方向性不对称。在系综平均层面，由于无序系综具有空间反射不变性，平均电流仍保持反对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单个无序实现中，电流对储库密度差的反转不再保持反对称，出现整流类响应；该行为源于平衡密度剖面的空间反射对称性破缺，而非外加方向性不对称。在系综平均层面，由于无序系综具有空间反射不变性，平均电流仍保持反对称。；创新点：揭示了样品特异的空间无序（而非显式方向不对称）即可在近平衡区产生整流类输运的机制，并指出空间反射对称性破缺是必要条件；同时阐明单样品与系综平均行为之间的差异。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Galerkin投影在储库密度差的一阶线性阶近似稳态密度剖面，并在高阶用平均场闭合；通过线性响应关系推导平衡电流涨落系数，并分析非线性阶电流贡献。

papers.title: Spectral Function Method and Janus Quantum Numbers in Quasiperiodic Systems
papers.abstract: The absence of translational symmetry in quasiperiodic systems invalidates conventional band theory, posing the central challenge in the field. Building upon the incommensurate energy band (IEB) concept, we establish a unified spectral theory for quasiperiodic systems by introducing two key advances. First, we develop an efficient spectral function method that calculates $A(k,ω)$ using a small truncated Hamiltonian matrix, bypassing full diagonalization. It converges via a distinctive successive locking of energy moments, yielding exact thermodynamic-limit results without finite-size scaling. Second, we introduce that quasiperiodic eigenstates possess Janus quantum numbers: a single eigenstate, continuously tracked across localization transitions, carries dual labels in momentum and real space, which naturally reduce to the familiar Bloch momentum and band index in the commensurate limit. Together with IEB, these advances constitute a ``band theory'' for quasiperiodic systems, enabling us to define, compute, and label states with the same facility as in periodic ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“建立统一谱理论”“引入概念”“发展方法”等理论推导与框架构建关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：准周期系统（quasiperiodic systems），即缺乏平移对称性、不能用传统能带理论描述的凝聚态体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入高效的谱函数方法和“Janus量子数”概念，为准周期系统建立了一套等效的“能带理论”，使其能像周期系统一样方便地定义、计算和标记电子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入高效的谱函数方法和“Janus量子数”概念，为准周期系统建立了一套等效的“能带理论”，使其能像周期系统一样方便地定义、计算和标记电子态。；创新点：摘要明确突出的创新有两点：一是提出高效的谱函数计算方法，绕开全对角化并免于有限尺寸标度；二是首次提出准周期本征态具有“Janus量子数”，即单个本征态同时携带动量空间与实空间的双重标签，并在公度极限下自然退化为布洛赫动量与能带指标。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架基于非公度能带（IEB）概念；具体方法包括：(1) 利用小型截断哈密顿矩阵直接计算谱函数 A(k,ω)，避免全对角化；(2) 通过能量矩的逐级锁定实现收敛，无需有限尺寸标度即可获得热力学极限精确结果；(3) 引入Janus量子数对跨越局域化转变的单个本征态进行双空间（动量空间与实空间）标记。

papers.title: Magnetic Couplings in Half-Filled Bipartite Graphs
papers.abstract: We break from perturbative frameworks to establish a non-perturbative generalization of magnetic exchange rules in half-filled bipartite networks. While historical models remain strictly tied to the debatable perturbation approach in the dilute limit and require the absence of zero-energy modes, our universal mechanism governs exchange interactions across arbitrary bipartite graphs. By bypassing traditional expansion bottlenecks, this framework provides an analytical predictive tool for magnetism in complex lattices, offering key design principles to engineer stable, long-range order in next-generation 2D spintronic devices
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要强调“非微扰推广”“解析预测工具”“理论框架”，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：半填充二分图（half-filled bipartite graphs）中的磁交换相互作用，以及由此产生的磁性有序，目标是为二维自旋电子学器件设计提供原理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了一个非微扰的普适机制，可统一描述任意二分图上的交换相互作用，无需依赖传统微扰展开，也无需排除零能模，从而为复杂晶格中的磁性提供了解析预测工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了一个非微扰的普适机制，可统一描述任意二分图上的交换相互作用，无需依赖传统微扰展开，也无需排除零能模，从而为复杂晶格中的磁性提供了解析预测工具。；创新点：突破了历史模型对“稀极限”和“无零能模”条件的严格限制，将磁交换规则推广到任意二分图，提供了可工程化设计稳定长程磁序的解析工具。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰理论框架，绕开传统微扰展开的瓶颈（摘要未明确说明具体数学形式，如是否使用图论、格林函数或变分方法）。

papers.title: Near-surface colloidal dynamics in jammed and slipping microgel suspensions
papers.abstract: Jammed suspensions of soft microgel particles may exhibit slippage along smooth boundaries. Owing to their expected sub-micrometric dimensions, direct observations of dynamics within the near-surface layers supposed to be responsible for this slippage have been difficult to achieve. Here, we use total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy (TIRFM) to observe nanoparticle dynamics near glass/microgel-suspension interfaces. Indicating near-wall dynamic heterogeneity, velocity profiles for suspensions are nonlinear. These profiles tend to a constant slippage velocity at submicrometric distances from the wall, consistent with macroscopic wall slip measurements. Furthermore, nanoscale particle altitude distributions are strongly dependent on the slip velocity, revealing a dynamically-mediated and nanoscale particle-organisation effect. The collected observations give support for the existence of near-wall heterogeneity as a dominant mechanism contributing to microgel wall slip. Our work also opens new perspectives for the study of particle dynamics and organisation in complex interfacial environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用TIRFM进行直接观测，涉及宏观壁滑移测量。；研究对象：微凝胶（软颗粒）堵塞悬浮体在光滑玻璃界面附近的近表面动力学，特别是壁滑移现象及近壁颗粒组织。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 近壁速度分布呈非线性，在亚微米尺度趋于恒定滑移速度，与宏观壁滑移一致；颗粒高度分布强烈依赖滑移速度，表明存在动态介导的纳米尺度颗粒组织效应，支持近壁异质性作为微凝胶壁滑移主导机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：近壁速度分布呈非线性，在亚微米尺度趋于恒定滑移速度，与宏观壁滑移一致；颗粒高度分布强烈依赖滑移速度，表明存在动态介导的纳米尺度颗粒组织效应，支持近壁异质性作为微凝胶壁滑移主导机制。；创新点：首次实现对近表面层（亚微米尺度）微凝胶颗粒动力学的直接光学观测，揭示了近壁动态异质性与纳米尺度颗粒组织随滑移速度的耦合关系。摘要未突出说明与以往间接测量或模拟的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 全内反射荧光显微镜（TIRFM）观测玻璃/微凝胶悬浮体界面附近的纳米颗粒动力学；结合宏观壁滑移测量；分析颗粒高度分布与速度剖面。

papers.title: Non-Resonant Impulsively Stimulated Raman Scattering by a Terahertz Field: a Case Study of 1T-TaS2
papers.abstract: Time-domain ultrafast and nonlinear terahertz spectroscopy techniques are recently applied to many condensed matter systems for investigating their collective excitations. In centrosymmetric systems, these collective modes are typically Raman-active and therefore do not couple directly to the terahertz electric field. The mechanism by which light-matter interaction realizes in these studies has not been explicitly discussed in detail. In this work, we perform terahertz pump - optical probe and terahertz third harmonic generation investigations on 1T-TaS2, a material exhibiting a rich charge-density-wave (CDW) phase diagram including the commensurate, nearly-commensurate and incommensurate CDW phases. The transition between these distinct states leaves a clear signature on the dynamical Raman response. We investigate how the Raman-active phonons couple to a broadband monocycle terahertz field as well as a narrowband multicycle terahertz field. Our results indicate that a modified impulsively stimulated Raman scattering mechanism involving two-photon absorption, also known as non-resonant Raman scattering, underlies the coherent excitation and observation of the lattice modes. These results are relevant for future spectroscopy investigation and coherent control of collective modes using low-energy terahertz field as well as cavity electrodynamical dressing of solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“terahertz pump - optical probe”和“terahertz third harmonic generation investigations”，属于时间域超快与非线性太赫兹光谱实验。；研究对象：1T-TaS2，一种具有丰富电荷密度波（CDW）相图（公度、近公度、非公度CDW相）的层状材料。研究聚焦于其拉曼活性声子模式与太赫兹场的耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在1T-TaS2中，宽带单周期和窄带多周期太赫兹场激发拉曼活性声子模式的机制是一种修正的受激拉曼散射过程，涉及双光子吸收（即非共振拉曼散射），而非直接的电偶极耦合。CDW相变在动力学拉曼响应上留下清晰特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在1T-TaS2中，宽带单周期和窄带多周期太赫兹场激发拉曼活性声子模式的机制是一种修正的受激拉曼散射过程，涉及双光子吸收（即非共振拉曼散射），而非直接的电偶极耦合。CDW相变在动力学拉曼响应上留下清晰特征。；创新点：首次明确阐述了中心对称体系中拉曼活性集体模式与太赫兹电场耦合的微观机制——即非共振受激拉曼散射（经双光子吸收实现），为以往太赫兹-拉曼活性模式相互作用研究提供了缺失的理论解释。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：太赫兹泵浦-光学探测（terahertz pump - optical probe）光谱，以及太赫兹三次谐波产生（terahertz third harmonic generation）测量。对比了宽带单周期与窄带多周期太赫兹脉冲的激发效果。

papers.title: Orbital-Free DFT-Assisted Machine-Learned Molecular Dynamics for Electric-Field-Driven Ionic Transport
papers.abstract: We propose an orbital-free density functional theory (OFDFT)-assisted machine-learned molecular dynamics method in which field-independent interatomic forces are evaluated using a machine-learned potential and atomic charges that depend on the local environment are obtained from OFDFT calculations. The atomic charges obtained by Bader partitioning of the OFDFT electron density are multiplied by the electric-field vector and added to the forces from the machine-learned potential. This approach enables molecular dynamics simulations under an electric field at a lower computational cost than Kohn-Sham DFT (KSDFT)-based molecular dynamics. As a proof of concept, the method was applied to beta-Li3PS4 bulk and an S8/Li3PS4 heterostructure under periodic boundary conditions. For Li3PS4 bulk, OFDFT yielded Li charges and a total charge of the PS4 unit consistent with those obtained using KSDFT. In the heterostructure, Li ions migrated from the Li3PS4 region into the S-rich region within a simulation time of approximately 170 ps. Accompanying this migration, the mean Bader charge of the S atoms that initially formed S8 rings changed from nearly neutral to negative. A comparison with KSDFT for a representative interfacial structure also confirmed that the negative charging of the S atoms upon the arrival of Li and the magnitude of the Li charges were qualitatively reproduced. These results demonstrate the possibility of treating field-driven ionic transport and changes in interfacial charge states using a universal machine-learned potential without training an additional material-specific charge-prediction model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“machine-learned molecular dynamics”“OFDFT calculations”“molecular dynamics simulations”等计算方法关键词。；研究对象：电场驱动下的离子输运现象，具体材料体系为β-Li₃PS₄体相以及S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构（固态电解质/硫界面体系）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无轨道密度泛函理论（OFDFT）辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法，能够在比KSDFT更低的计算成本下模拟电场驱动的离子迁移。在S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构中，Li离子在约170 ps内从Li₃PS₄区域迁移至富S区域，同时伴随S原子Bader电荷由近中性变为负值，表明该方法可捕捉界面电荷态的动态变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无轨道密度泛函理论（OFDFT）辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法，能够在比KSDFT更低的计算成本下模拟电场驱动的离子迁移。在S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构中，Li离子在约170 ps内从Li₃PS₄区域迁移至富S区域，同时伴随S原子Bader电荷由近中性变为负值，表明该方法可捕捉界面电荷态的动态变化。；创新点：无需针对特定材料额外训练电荷预测模型，即可利用通用机器学习势处理电场驱动的离子输运及界面电荷态变化，显著降低了电场下分子动力学模拟的计算成本。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用OFDFT辅助的机器学习分子动力学方法：场无关的原子间作用力由机器学习势（universal machine-learned potential）计算；依赖局域环境的原子电荷由OFDFT计算得到，通过对OFDFT电子密度进行Bader划分获得原子电荷，再将电荷乘以电场矢量叠加到机器学习势给出的力上。在周期性边界条件下对β-Li₃PS₄体相和S₈/Li₃PS₄异质结构进行了验证，并与KSDFT结果进行了对比。

papers.title: Electron-phonon coupled hydrodynamics in semimetal TaAs_2
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic corrections to diffusive transport can arise when momentum-conserving collisions between quasiparticles become prominent, and they have been documented for both electrons and phonons. An emerging frontier topic is coupled electron-phonon (e-ph) hydrodynamics. Here, through electrical and thermal transport measurements on TaAs2 crystals with different impurity levels, we document the emergence of an e-ph bifluid in the temperature window of 5 to 15 K. Within this range, the lattice thermal conductivity exhibits a faster-than-T^3 temperature dependence, as a consequence of non-monotonic and purity-dependent phonon mean free paths, a signature of phonon Poiseuille flow. However, strong e-ph coupling impedes the emergence of a ballistic regime. This is corroborated by the observation of quantum oscillations in the lattice thermal conductivity. Prominent phonon-mediated momentum exchange between electrons amplifies the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law and yields a two-order-of-magnitude discrepancy between quantum and transport lifetimes, a signature of electron hydrodynamics in semimetals. Our results imply that in semimetals with optimized e-ph coupling, thanks to matching between the cryogenic phonon wave?length and the Fermi wavelength, momentum and energy flow between the electron and phonon reservoirs as frequently as within each reservoir.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“通过电学和热输运测量”（electrical and thermal transport measurements），并报道了实验观测到的现象（如量子振荡）。；研究对象：半金属二砷化钽（TaAs₂）晶体，具体研究其在不同杂质浓度下的电子-声子耦合流体动力学（coupled electron-phonon hydrodynamics）行为，以及5至15 K温区内的电学和热输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在5至15 K温区内，TaAs₂中出现了电子-声子双流体（e-ph bifluid）行为：声子表现出泊肃叶流（Poiseuille flow）特征（晶格热导率呈快于T³的温度依赖），而强电子-声子耦合抑制了弹道输运，同时增强了Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏，并在半金属中产生了量子寿命与输运寿命两个数量级的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在5至15 K温区内，TaAs₂中出现了电子-声子双流体（e-ph bifluid）行为：声子表现出泊肃叶流（Poiseuille flow）特征（晶格热导率呈快于T³的温度依赖），而强电子-声子耦合抑制了弹道输运，同时增强了Wiedemann-Franz定律的破坏，并在半金属中产生了量子寿命与输运寿命两个数量级的差异。；创新点：该工作首次在半金属TaAs₂中实验证实了电子-声子耦合双流体（bifluid）行为的存在，并指出在低温下声子波长与费米波长匹配时，电子与声子储库之间的动量/能量交换频率可与各自储库内部的交换频率相当。这一发现将电子流体动力学与声子流体动力学联系起来，拓展了耦合流体动力学的研究范畴。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为电输运测量和热输运测量（electrical and thermal transport measurements），研究对象为具有不同杂质水平的TaAs₂单晶样品。摘要中未提及第一性原理计算或理论建模等非实验方法。

papers.title: Competing lattice structures induced by Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: Understanding the effect of chemical substitution on competing phases of kagome metals is crucial for disentangling the interplay between local structural distortions and electronic instabilities. In \cvs, Sn substitution strongly modifies the electronic phase diagram, yet the microscopic mechanism driving this remains unclear. Here, we combine $^{121}$Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements and density functional theory calculations to investigate the atomic-scale effects of Sn substitution in CsV$_3$Sb$_{5-x}$Sn$_x$. At low Sn concentrations, the observed satellite NQR peaks exhibit signatures of local structural distortion induced by Sn substitution, qualitatively consistent with our computational analysis. These impurity-induced features persist across the entire experimentally investigated doping range, up to $x$ = 0.65, and remain observable up to room temperature. For $x=1$, the fully doped idealized case, the estimated dynamical instabilities of the kagome lattice suggest the stabilization of two nearly energy-degenerate equilibrium structures characterized by V-trimers, distinguished by a zero- or $π$-phase shift between adjacent layers along the $c$-axis. Together, these results show that Sn substitution drives a complex interplay between local impurity-induced distortions and competing structural instabilities in vanadium-based kagome compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combine \(^{121}\)Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements and density functional theory calculations”，即实验测量与第一性原理计算相结合。；研究对象：笼目（kagome）金属 CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_5\) 及其 Sn 取代体系 CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_{5-x}\)Sn\(_x\)，重点关注化学取代对竞争相、局部结构畸变与电子不稳定性之间相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Sn 取代在低浓度下诱导局域结构畸变（由 NQR 卫星峰表征），该畸变在高达 \(x=0.65\) 的掺杂范围内及室温下均持续存在；在完全掺杂的理想情形（\(x=1\)）下，笼目晶格存在两种能量近简并的平衡结构（均由 V 三聚体构成），其区别在于相邻层沿 \(c\) 轴的相移为 0 或 \(\pi\)。这表明 Sn 取代驱动了局域杂质诱导畸变与竞争性结构不稳定性之间的复杂相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Sn 取代在低浓度下诱导局域结构畸变（由 NQR 卫星峰表征），该畸变在高达 \(x=0.65\) 的掺杂范围内及室温下均持续存在；在完全掺杂的理想情形（\(x=1\)）下，笼目晶格存在两种能量近简并的平衡结构（均由 V 三聚体构成），其区别在于相邻层沿 \(c\) 轴的相移为 0 或 \(\pi\)。这表明 Sn 取代驱动了局域杂质诱导畸变与竞争性结构不稳定性之间的复杂相互作用。；创新点：首次从原子尺度揭示了 Sn 取代在 CsV\(_3\)Sb\(_5\) 中诱导的局域结构畸变特征，并指出完全掺杂极限下两种近简并的 V 三聚体结构（层间 0 或 \(\pi\) 相移）作为竞争性结构不稳定的可能结局。摘要未突出说明其与以往取代研究在方法或结论上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用 \(^{121}\)Sb 核四极共振（NQR）测量；理论上采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于分析局域结构畸变及估计笼目晶格的动力学不稳定性。

papers.title: Interplay of B-Site Off-Centering and Molecular Orientations in the Mixed Hybrid Perovskite MAGe1xSnxI3
papers.abstract: B-site mixing is a common strategy for tuning properties of halide perovskites. In the lead-free system MAGe1-xSn_xI3, it brings tilting and off-centering into competition. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential, we map the structural behavior across the full composition range. MAGeI3 exhibits strong polar B-site off-centering that remains nearly constant up to the cubic transition, together with methylammonium (MA) orientational order that weakens progressively on heating. By contrast, MASnI3 combines octahedral tilting with weaker, predominantly antipolar off-centering. Ge-like behavior persists upon alloying and gives way to Sn-like behavior only beyond roughly 65 % Sn. In the high-temperature phases, the B-site cations remain locally off-centered but directionally disordered. On the Ge-rich side, the distorted inorganic framework biases the soft MA orientational landscape toward a restricted set of preferred directions. This coupling shows how the composition of the inorganic sublattice can tune molecular ordering in lead-free hybrid perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential”（机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：无铅混合卤化物钙钛矿 MAGe₁₋ₓSnₓI₃（MA = 甲基铵），重点关注B位（Ge/Sn）偏心位移与MA分子取向之间的耦合，以及全组分范围内的结构行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MAGeI₃具有强极性B位偏心且几乎不随升温衰减，而MASnI₃表现为八面体倾斜与较弱反极性偏心共存；Ge类行为在合金中持续存在，直到Sn含量超过约65%才转变为Sn类行为。高温相中B位阳离子仍局域偏心但方向无序，且Ge-rich侧畸变无机框架会将软MA取向景观限制在少数优选方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MAGeI₃具有强极性B位偏心且几乎不随升温衰减，而MASnI₃表现为八面体倾斜与较弱反极性偏心共存；Ge类行为在合金中持续存在，直到Sn含量超过约65%才转变为Sn类行为。高温相中B位阳离子仍局域偏心但方向无序，且Ge-rich侧畸变无机框架会将软MA取向景观限制在少数优选方向。；创新点：揭示了B位混合（Ge/Sn）体系中偏心位移与八面体倾斜之间的竞争如何随组分演化，并首次展示了无机亚晶格组成可通过结构畸变调控有机MA分子的取向有序性——即无机框架对分子取向景观的“偏置”作用。摘要未突出说明与实验或其他计算方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习原子间势（machine-learned interatomic potential）驱动的大规模分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，覆盖全组分范围（x = 0 到 1）。

papers.title: Exact Scaling Laws and Non-Hermitian Topological Phase Transitions of Active Continuum on Hyperbolic Manifolds
papers.abstract: The macroscopic collective motion of active continuum on curved manifolds is conventionally addressed through perturbative dynamic renormalization or finite-element simulations, often obscuring the underlying geometric mechanisms. Here, an exact algebraic framework is established to reformulate the active phase transition on hyperbolic spaces $\mathbb{H}^2$. By rigorously expanding the covariant Navier-Stokes-like equations and applying the Weitzenböck identity, we derive the exact critical threshold $α_c = \frac{5}{4}Dκ^2$ for macroscopic polarization, which is dictated by the geometric mass gap of the Hodge-de Rham Laplacian. We strictly define the parameter subspace $α= 2Dκ^2$ where the topological free energy reaches the Bogomolny-Prasad-Sommerfield (BPS) limit. This enables the reduction of the complex velocity field to Blaschke products via Möbius gauge symmetry. The flat-space limit ($κ\to 0$) exactly degenerates to the topological phase of the classical O(2) model, demonstrating that the constant negative curvature acts as an un-perturbative infrared regularization for non-linear amplitude saturation. Furthermore, mapping the non-variational active convective modes onto the defect translational zero-modes yields an intrinsically non-reciprocal interaction matrix. By analytically extending the singular integral operator of the dynamically condensed defect ring, we identify a macroscopic second-order exceptional point (EP2) characterized by a strictly algebraic dynamic scaling law $τ\sim |Δν|^{-1/2}$. This closed-form theoretical paradigm provides exact solutions for geometric frustration and non-Hermitian topology in soft mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“exact algebraic framework”“rigorously expanding”“derive the exact critical threshold”等纯理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：双曲流形（$\mathbb{H}^2$，常负曲率空间）上的活性连续介质（active continuum）的宏观集体运动与相变，以及由此衍生的非厄米拓扑相变与几何阻挫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双曲空间上精确推导出宏观极化序的临界阈值 $\alpha_c = \frac{5}{4}D\kappa^2$，该阈值由 Hodge-de Rham Laplacian 的几何质量隙决定；并发现一个由动力学凝聚缺陷环产生的宏观二阶奇异点（EP2），其动力学标度律为 $\tau \sim |\Delta\nu|^{-1/2}$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双曲空间上精确推导出宏观极化序的临界阈值 $\alpha_c = \frac{5}{4}D\kappa^2$，该阈值由 Hodge-de Rham Laplacian 的几何质量隙决定；并发现一个由动力学凝聚缺陷环产生的宏观二阶奇异点（EP2），其动力学标度律为 $\tau \sim |\Delta\nu|^{-1/2}$。；创新点：建立了双曲流形上活性相变的精确代数框架（非微扰方法），取代了传统的微扰动态重整化或有限元模拟；揭示了常负曲率作为非线性振幅饱和的“非微扰红外正则化”机制；将非变分活性对流模式映射为缺陷平移零模，从而自然导出非互易相互作用矩阵，并首次在软物质活性体系中识别出宏观 EP2 及其严格的代数标度律。
papers.method_zh: 采用协变 Navier-Stokes 类方程的严格展开，结合 Weitzenböck 恒等式；利用 Hodge-de Rham Laplacian 的谱性质确定临界条件；通过 Möbius 规范对称性将复速度场约化为 Blaschke 乘积；对凝聚缺陷环的奇异积分算子做解析延拓以识别非厄米奇异点结构。

papers.title: Such stuff as magic is made on: compact operator algebra, stabilizer polytope and the structure of reduced density matrices in a Kitaev spin liquid
papers.abstract: Quantum many-body systems exhibit rich and complex behaviour. Magic has recently emerged as a powerful new diagnostic for probing such systems, complementing other key features such as many-body entanglement. Here, starting from an investigation of the onset of magic within subsystems of a larger many-body quantum system, we show that intricate structures emerge which shed important light on the underlying many-body physics. Focusing on the Kitaev honeycomb model, we first identify the temperature below which local subsystems acquire magic. Remarkably, we find that the optimal magic witnesses active at the onset of magic reveal compact operator spaces that continue to capture the local thermal states throughout their subsequent evolution. For the six-site hexagonal marginal, this connection can be made stronger: the same operator space emerges independently from the symmetries of the local marginal and forms the symmetry-resolved plaquette algebra. When these symmetries are realized exactly, the local state lies entirely within this algebra and the reduced robustness of magic is equal to the full robustness of magic. The same reduced description can also be applied to other local quantum resources, which we illustrate using genuine multipartite entanglement. Furthermore, the operator spaces possess a rich algebraic structure in the form of finite-dimensional Euclidean Jordan algebras, with a natural interpretation in terms of bond and bond-cycle operators. Our general methodology therefore show how the onset of local magic can reveal a compact, physically meaningful operator structure underlying the finite-temperature Kitaev spin liquid, and opens up a new avenue towards reduced descriptions of quantum resources in many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“operator algebra”“stabilizer polytope”“reduced density matrices”等理论概念，以及“we show”“we identify”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：Kitaev蜂巢模型（Kitaev honeycomb model）中的量子多体系统，具体关注其有限温度下局域子系统的“magic”（量子非稳定子资源）及其背后的算符代数结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Kitaev自旋液体中，局域子系统开始获得magic的温度以下，最优magic witness所揭示的紧致算符空间能持续描述后续局域热态演化；对于六位六边形边缘态，该算符空间与由局域边缘对称性独立导出的对称分辨plaquette代数一致，且当对称性精确实现时，局域态的约化magic鲁棒性等于完整magic鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Kitaev自旋液体中，局域子系统开始获得magic的温度以下，最优magic witness所揭示的紧致算符空间能持续描述后续局域热态演化；对于六位六边形边缘态，该算符空间与由局域边缘对称性独立导出的对称分辨plaquette代数一致，且当对称性精确实现时，局域态的约化magic鲁棒性等于完整magic鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将magic作为诊断工具用于Kitaev自旋液体的局域子系统，揭示magic onset处的最优witness能自然涌现出紧致算符空间，并将其与对称分辨plaquette代数及Jordan代数结构联系起来，为多体系统中量子资源的约化描述开辟了新途径。摘要未突出说明与以往magic研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于magic（量子资源理论）分析，结合约化密度矩阵、stabilizer polytope、算符代数（有限维欧几里得Jordan代数）以及对称性分析；具体涉及Kitaev蜂巢模型的局域热态、六位六边形边缘态的对称性分解，以及magic witness的构造与优化。

papers.title: Built-In Electric Field Modulation of Spontaneous Magnetism and Thermospin Transport in Boron-Nitrogen Doped Zigzag Graphene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Zigzag-edged graphene nanoribbons (ZGNRs) host large magnetic moments at two zigzag edges due to spontaneous magnetism, whose ground state is antiferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (AF state). In this paper, the spontaneous magnetism and thermoelectricity of ZGNRs with periodic substituted doping of boron and nitrogen atoms along the axial direction are investigated by first principle calculation. The doping induces an internal electric field, which modulates the magnetic moments at the two zigzag edges and the band structure with spin splitting. For varying doping configuration, the ground state could be AF state, ferromagnetically coupled spin-order edge state (FM state), or degenerated pair of AF and FM states. External transversal static electric field can further modulate the magnetic moments and the band structure. By designing the doping configuration and the external field, pure thermal spin current with the absence of thermal charge current can be generated at room temperature, which can be switched on and off by flipping the magnetic configuration between AF and FM states. Thus, the doped ZGNRs can be applied as prototype devices for spin-caloritronic.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first principle calculation”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：硼氮周期性替代掺杂的锯齿型石墨烯纳米带（ZGNRs），具体研究其自发磁性、内建电场效应以及热自旋输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼氮掺杂在ZGNRs中引入内建电场，可调控两条锯齿边缘的磁矩和自旋劈裂的能带结构；通过设计掺杂构型与外电场，可在室温下实现纯热自旋电流（无热电荷电流），并可通过翻转磁构型（AF↔FM）实现该电流的开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼氮掺杂在ZGNRs中引入内建电场，可调控两条锯齿边缘的磁矩和自旋劈裂的能带结构；通过设计掺杂构型与外电场，可在室温下实现纯热自旋电流（无热电荷电流），并可通过翻转磁构型（AF↔FM）实现该电流的开关。；创新点：首次提出利用轴向周期性硼氮共掺杂在ZGNRs中构建内建电场，以此调控自发磁序（AF/FM）和热自旋输运，并实现基于磁构型翻转的热自旋电流开关功能，为自旋-热电子学器件提供原型设计。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first principle calculation），具体方法摘要未明确说明（未提及泛函类型如DFT+U或杂化泛函等）。

papers.title: Granular Rods Fall Faster in Denser Obstacle Fields
papers.abstract: How particle shape affects transport through obstacle fields under external driving is a fundamental question in nonequilibrium physics. We simulate a dissipative rod falling under gravity through randomly placed fixed obstacles. As the obstacle density increases, the mean descent speed decreases, increases, and then decreases again before trapping. The rod can therefore fall faster in a denser obstacle field. Scaling arguments based on collision rates and rod geometry explain all three regimes, their crossovers, and the mean fall distance before trapping. These results reveal nonmonotonic driven transport arising from particle anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“simulate”（模拟）、“scaling arguments”（标度论证）等关键词，属于数值模拟结合理论分析。；研究对象：受重力驱动、在随机固定障碍物场中下落的耗散性颗粒杆（granular rods）。研究的是颗粒各向异性（形状）对障碍物场中输运行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着障碍物密度增加，杆的平均下落速度呈现“减小—增大—再减小”的非单调变化，直至最终被捕获。即在更密集的障碍物场中，杆反而可能下落得更快。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着障碍物密度增加，杆的平均下落速度呈现“减小—增大—再减小”的非单调变化，直至最终被捕获。即在更密集的障碍物场中，杆反而可能下落得更快。；创新点：揭示了由颗粒各向异性导致的非单调驱动输运行为——障碍物密度增大反而可能加速下落，这一反直觉现象此前未被系统报道。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散元/颗粒动力学类数值模拟，模拟耗散性杆状颗粒在重力作用下穿过随机放置的固定障碍物；并结合基于碰撞频率和杆几何形状的标度论证（scaling arguments）来解释三个速度区间、交叉行为及捕获前的平均下落距离。

papers.title: Studying line defect at Deconfined Quantum Criticality via fuzzy sphere regularization
papers.abstract: The interplay between bulk critical fluctuations and nontrivial topology can enrich defect physics and give rise to novel defect universality classes. Understanding the fate of such defects therefore constitutes an important open problem. In this work, we studied a particularly simple setting: a (0+1)-dimensional pinning-field defect coupled to a (2+1)-dimensional deconfined quantum critical bulk. Using the fuzzy-sphere regularization, we numerically investigated the defect operator spectrum and extracted several universal quantities characterizing the defect conformal fixed point, including the scaling dimensions of defect-changing(creating) operators and the defect \(g\)-function. These results establish the first numerical characterization of line-defect conformal data at deconfined quantum criticality and may stimulate further investigations of defect critical phenomena in topological quantum critical matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值研究文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“fuzzy-sphere regularization”进行数值模拟，属于大规模数值计算方法。；研究对象：(2+1)维去禁闭量子临界（Deconfined Quantum Criticality, DQC）体态中的(0+1)维钉扎场缺陷（即线缺陷）。具体物理现象为体临界涨落与缺陷拓扑之间的相互作用，以及缺陷共形不动点的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过模糊球正则化数值方法，首次获得了去禁闭量子临界点处线缺陷的共形数据，包括缺陷改变（产生）算符的标度维数和缺陷g函数，从而建立了对DQC线缺陷共形场论性质的首次数值表征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过模糊球正则化数值方法，首次获得了去禁闭量子临界点处线缺陷的共形数据，包括缺陷改变（产生）算符的标度维数和缺陷g函数，从而建立了对DQC线缺陷共形场论性质的首次数值表征。；创新点：首次在去禁闭量子临界背景下对线缺陷共形数据（缺陷改变算符标度维数、缺陷g函数）进行数值确定，填补了拓扑量子临界物质中缺陷临界现象研究的空白。摘要未突出说明与已有缺陷普适类分类工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 模糊球正则化（fuzzy-sphere regularization）数值方法。具体为将(2+1)维DQC体态映射到模糊球上，通过数值对角化或张量网络技术提取缺陷算符谱，并计算标度维数与g函数等普适量。

papers.title: Universal scaling of fluctuations and correlations across the superfluid transition
papers.abstract: The critical behavior of a system near a continuous phase transition is commonly characterized by power laws and a set of universal critical exponents. Yet universality at phase transitions has even more fundamental manifestations. It dictates that all observables follow universal scaling functions, which may extend beyond simple power laws. Furthermore, microscopic details are captured entirely by only two system-specific scale factors, that rescale any measured quantity onto its universal form. In this work, we report the experimental validation of this prediction in ultracold lattice Bose gases undergoing the superfluid transition. We extract the scale factors by collapsing the order-parameter cumulants measured at varying entropies. We show that these factors specify scaling functions governing both the order-parameter distribution and two-point correlations. By measuring these scaling functions, we also determine three critical exponents $β$, $γ$ and $ν$. Our results provide an experimental demonstration that universal scaling is simultaneously obeyed by multiple observables in a quantum many-body system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental validation”“ultracold lattice Bose gases”“we extract the scale factors by collapsing the order-parameter cumulants measured at varying entropies”等实验测量表述。；研究对象：超冷晶格玻色气体（ultracold lattice Bose gases）中的超流相变（superfluid transition），属于量子多体系统的临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验验证了超流相变附近多个可观测量（序参量分布与两点关联函数）同时遵循普适标度行为，且微观细节完全由两个系统特定的尺度因子所吸收；通过测量标度函数确定了三个临界指数β、γ和ν。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验验证了超流相变附近多个可观测量（序参量分布与两点关联函数）同时遵循普适标度行为，且微观细节完全由两个系统特定的尺度因子所吸收；通过测量标度函数确定了三个临界指数β、γ和ν。；创新点：首次在量子多体系统中实验演示了多个不同可观测量（序参量分布与关联函数）同时满足普适标度关系，而不仅仅是单一幂律临界行为；通过标度函数同时确定多个临界指数，验证了普适标度理论超越简单幂律的更深层预言。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过改变熵（varying entropies）测量序参量累积量（order-parameter cumulants），利用数据坍缩（collapsing）提取尺度因子，进而测量序参量分布和两点关联函数的普适标度函数，并从中提取临界指数。摘要未明确说明具体实验技术（如量子气体显微镜、飞行时间吸收成像等）。

papers.title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
papers.abstract: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. A warmup penalty mitigates the spectral bias of neural networks toward smooth, nonlayered fields, enabling robust recovery of oscillatory smectic states. Comparisons with a neural-network baseline and finite-difference relaxation demonstrate the essential role of this penalty and the numerical stability of the resulting layered states. The DVF reproduces experimentally established smectic-A defect structures and layer morphologies across diverse confinement geometries and further predicts a chevron-like smectic-C state in a tangent-anchored sphere. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of the DVF to computing stable smectic configurations across experimentally relevant confinement geometries and anchoring conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：deep variational framework、computing、modeled using continuum theories、finite-difference relaxation。；研究对象：受限几何中的近晶相液晶（smectic liquid crystals），具体包括近晶A相（smectic-A）缺陷结构与层形貌，以及切向锚定球体中的近晶C相（smectic-C）类人字形（chevron-like）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种深度变分框架（DVF），通过引入“预热惩罚”（warmup penalty）克服神经网络对光滑非层状场的频谱偏好，从而稳定地计算出受限近晶液晶的振荡层状构型，并复现实验已知的近晶A缺陷结构，同时预测了切向锚定球体中类人字形近晶C态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种深度变分框架（DVF），通过引入“预热惩罚”（warmup penalty）克服神经网络对光滑非层状场的频谱偏好，从而稳定地计算出受限近晶液晶的振荡层状构型，并复现实验已知的近晶A缺陷结构，同时预测了切向锚定球体中类人字形近晶C态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可推断：首次将深度变分框架与坐标映射结合用于受限近晶相液晶的稳定构型计算，并通过预热惩罚解决神经网络对高频层状结构的频谱偏差问题——此点摘要中已明确，故创新点可概括为：提出预热惩罚机制使神经网络能够稳定恢复振荡近晶态，并成功应用于多种实验相关受限几何与锚定条件）。
papers.method_zh: 基于修正的Landau–de Gennes模型，将耦合的取向序参量与位置序参量定义在规则参考域上，通过坐标映射引入物理受限几何；采用深度变分框架（DVF）求解，并加入预热惩罚项；与神经网络基线和有限差分弛豫方法进行对比验证。

papers.title: Doping dependence of local moments in infinite layer nickelates
papers.abstract: The infinite layer nickelates are notable for their lack of long-range antiferromagnetic ordering, in contrast to the parent compounds of the superconducting cuprates. Instead, the nickelates show evidence of short-range glassy behavior in both the undoped and optimally-doped regimes, implying that local electronic moments exist independent of superconductivity. However, the systematic doping-dependent magnetic behavior is not yet fully resolved, and characterizing it could uncover the relationship between local moments and the superconducting dome. In this work, we use muon spin rotation ($μ$SR) on a (La,Sr)NiO$_2$ doping series from the undoped parent compound, through the superconducting dome, to the over-doped normal state (Sr substitution 0% $\leq$ x $\leq$ 25%) to probe the magnetic ground state and the temperature-dependent static and dynamic behavior. We find that local moments experience spin freezing into a glassy state at temperatures on the order of a few tens of kelvin regardless of the doping level. We also observe a subtle destabilization of the glassy state with increased hole doping. These observations suggest that magnetism and superconductivity are largely decoupled phenomena with indirect interactions described in a multi-orbital framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用 muon spin rotation（μSR）实验技术对掺杂系列样品进行测量。；研究对象：无限层镍氧化物（La,Sr）NiO₂ 掺杂系列，涵盖从未掺杂母体、超导穹顶区到过掺杂正常态（Sr 替代 0% ≤ x ≤ 25%），研究其局域磁矩的掺杂依赖行为及磁基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局域磁矩在所有掺杂水平下均在几十开尔文量级的温度进入玻璃态自旋冻结，且随空穴掺杂增加，玻璃态被轻微去稳定化。这表明镍氧化物中的磁性与超导性在很大程度上是退耦的，二者通过多轨道框架中的间接相互作用关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局域磁矩在所有掺杂水平下均在几十开尔文量级的温度进入玻璃态自旋冻结，且随空穴掺杂增加，玻璃态被轻微去稳定化。这表明镍氧化物中的磁性与超导性在很大程度上是退耦的，二者通过多轨道框架中的间接相互作用关联。；创新点：首次系统性地对无限层镍酸盐从母体到过掺杂的完整掺杂系列进行 μSR 研究，揭示了局域磁矩玻璃态冻结温度几乎不随掺杂变化，并定量刻画了玻璃态随掺杂的轻微失稳，为理解磁性与超导穹顶的关系提供了实验约束。摘要未突出说明与以往单点掺杂研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 零场/弱场 μSR（muon spin rotation/relaxation）实验，用于探测磁基态以及随温度变化的静态与动态磁行为。

papers.title: Polaron Self-Trapping Rates from First Principles
papers.abstract: Polaron formation, also known as self-trapping, is a process akin to nonradiative carrier capture at point defects or impurities. In this work, we develop the formalism to determine how long it takes to form a small hole or electron polaron from first principles. We employ an accurate, fully first-principles approach based on a Koopmans compliant hybrid functional. The self-trapping rate is the product of two components: the nonradiative capture coefficient, which we evaluate using a one-dimensional approximation, and the maximum density of polaron sites, whose physics we elucidate based on finite-size interactions present in supercells. We apply our methodology to several technologically relevant materials known to host hole polarons, Ga$_2$O$_3$, Al$_2$O$_3$, BeO, KBr, MgO, NaCl, SiO$_2$, SnO$_2$, TiO$_2$, and ZnO, and to an electron polaron in rutile TiO$_2$. We also study an emerging semiconductor, rutile GeO$_2$, where we find that polaron formation could hamper $p$-type conductivity. The calculated self-trapping lifetimes span 7 orders of magnitude, from $10^{-1}$ to $10^6$~ps, in agreement with experiments where available, and providing detailed insight into the dynamics of carrier localization and relaxation in solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“from first principles”“fully first-principles approach”“formalism”“evaluate”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算与理论方法开发。；研究对象：多种材料中的极化子（小极化子）自陷（self-trapping）过程，具体包括空穴极化子材料 Ga₂O₃、Al₂O₃、BeO、KBr、MgO、NaCl、SiO₂、SnO₂、TiO₂、ZnO，以及金红石 TiO₂ 中的电子极化子，并额外研究了新兴半导体金红石 GeO₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了从第一性原理计算极化子自陷速率（即形成时间）的完整框架，发现自陷寿命跨越 7 个数量级（10⁻¹ 至 10⁶ ps），与已有实验吻合；并预测 GeO₂ 中极化子形成可能阻碍其 p 型导电。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了从第一性原理计算极化子自陷速率（即形成时间）的完整框架，发现自陷寿命跨越 7 个数量级（10⁻¹ 至 10⁶ ps），与已有实验吻合；并预测 GeO₂ 中极化子形成可能阻碍其 p 型导电。；创新点：首次从第一性原理系统性地计算极化子自陷的时间尺度（速率），而非仅判断极化子是否稳定存在；将自陷速率分解为俘获系数与位点密度两个物理可解释的因子，并应用于多种技术相关材料进行统一对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Koopmans 相容的杂化泛函（Koopmans compliant hybrid functional）进行第一性原理计算；自陷速率分解为两部分：非辐射俘获系数（用一维近似评估）和极化子位点最大密度（基于超胞中的有限尺寸相互作用阐明其物理机制）。

papers.title: Grain boundary evolution in nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Grain boundary evolution is a key dynamical process that enables structural rearrangements in nanoparticles and drives them towards low energy configurations. Grain boundaries can also enhance catalytic properties, making it important to understand the elementary processes underlying their evolution for grain boundary engineering in nanoparticles. Compared with bulk materials, nanoparticles have additional rotational and translational degrees of freedom, can accommodate structural changes through shape relaxation, and grain boundaries terminate at free surfaces. However, the atomic-scale mechanisms of GB evolution under these less constrained conditions remain comparatively less understood than in bulk materials. Here, using atomistic simulations, we focus on low energy $\Sigma3$ (coherent twin boundary) and $\Sigma11$ grain boundaries, which are among the persistent compact GB structures that emerge during nanoparticle structural evolution. We identify two fundamental atomic displacements, column shift (C) and screw shift (S), that recur during the evolution of these grain boundaries and their junctions. These displacements occur through different atomic pathways and combine in different ways to generate grain boundary migration, structural transformations, and junction evolution. In particular, the same initial and final grain boundary configurations can be connected through different atomic pathways, and a column shift can occur either as a full shift or through disconnection kinks. C and S remain identifiable even when the grain boundary character changes, for example during a $\Sigma11$ to $\Sigma3$ transformation. An understanding of these elementary GB processes can help identify strategies to control grain boundary evolution and thereby engineer GB structures in nanoparticles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using atomistic simulations”（原子级模拟）。；研究对象：纳米颗粒中的晶界演化，具体聚焦于低能Σ3（共格孪晶界）和Σ11晶界及其交汇结构，以及它们在纳米颗粒受限较少条件下的原子尺度运动机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 识别出两种反复出现的基本原子位移模式——柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S），它们通过不同原子路径组合，驱动晶界迁移、结构转变和交汇点演化；同一初末晶界构型可通过不同路径连接，且C和S在晶界类型改变（如Σ11→Σ3转变）时仍保持可辨识性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：识别出两种反复出现的基本原子位移模式——柱位移（C）和螺旋位移（S），它们通过不同原子路径组合，驱动晶界迁移、结构转变和交汇点演化；同一初末晶界构型可通过不同路径连接，且C和S在晶界类型改变（如Σ11→Σ3转变）时仍保持可辨识性。；创新点：在纳米颗粒这一具有额外旋转/平动自由度、可通过形状弛豫适应结构变化、且晶界终止于自由表面的受限较少条件下，系统揭示了晶界演化的基本原子位移单元（C和S），并展示了这些单元在不同晶界类型和转变过程中的普适性，为纳米颗粒晶界工程提供了原子尺度的控制策略基础。摘要未突出说明与块体材料晶界演化研究的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 原子级模拟（atomistic simulations），摘要未具体说明势函数类型或模拟软件（如LAMMPS、DFT等），仅提及“atomistic simulations”。

papers.title: Symmetry-breaking line defects embedded to a 3D $O(N)$ critical bulk
papers.abstract: While spontaneous breaking of a discrete symmetry in one-dimensional classical systems with short-range interactions is absent, it is expected that a line defect embedded in a bulk criticality exhibits a stable discrete symmetry spontaneous breaking. Here, we investigate the behavior of a pinning-field line defect immersed in a 3D bulk that remains tuned to the $O(N)$ Wilson-Fisher critical point. Employing the fuzzy sphere technique, we provide convincing evidence of the existence of stable defect conformal fixed points, and we demonstrate their renormalization group stability by showing no relevant operator and less effective degrees of freedom than that at bulk fixed point via $g$-function. Moreover, we investigate the defect domain wall operator for various $N$, and we identify that it becomes irrelevance for $N\gtrsim 3$ but it is relevant for $N<3$.These evidence indicate that a one-dimensional defect coupled to a critical bulk cannot support a stable symmetry spontaneously broken defect fixed point due to domain wall proliferation for $N<3$ Wilson-Fisher universality, while in the case of $N \gtrsim 3$ a symmetry broken defect is possible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用“fuzzy sphere technique”（模糊球技术）进行数值计算，并讨论重整化群（renormalization group）稳定性。；研究对象：嵌入三维 $O(N)$ Wilson-Fisher 临界体中的一维线缺陷（line defect），具体为钉扎场（pinning-field）线缺陷，并研究其对称性自发破缺行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于 $N<3$ 的 Wilson-Fisher 普适类，由于畴壁（domain wall）增殖，一维缺陷无法支撑稳定的对称性自发破缺缺陷固定点；而对于 $N \gtrsim 3$，对称性破缺的缺陷固定点可能存在且稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于 $N<3$ 的 Wilson-Fisher 普适类，由于畴壁（domain wall）增殖，一维缺陷无法支撑稳定的对称性自发破缺缺陷固定点；而对于 $N \gtrsim 3$，对称性破缺的缺陷固定点可能存在且稳定。；创新点：首次在三维临界体中系统研究线缺陷的离散对称性自发破缺，并明确给出 $N=3$ 作为缺陷畴壁算符相关/无关的临界分界，揭示了缺陷自由度少于体固定点时仍可保持稳定的非微扰证据。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用模糊球（fuzzy sphere）技术进行数值模拟，通过计算 $g$-函数（$g$-function）判断重整化群稳定性，并分析缺陷畴壁算符（defect domain wall operator）的标度维度（相关/无关性）。

papers.title: Resolving the Magnetic Ground-State Controversy in RuO2 through A Flat Magnetic Energy Landscape
papers.abstract: Rutile RuO2 is a prominent candidate for altermagnetism, yet its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial, with experiments reporting either a nonmagnetic state or altermagnetic order. Here, we develop a generalized environment-dependent spin-lattice framework that unifies localized Heisenberg exchange, itinerant Stoner magnetism via Landau spin fluctuations, and spin-orbit-coupling-mediated spin-lattice interactions. Parameterized from a high-throughput first-principles database using machine-learning and solved by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations, the framework reveals an exceptionally flat magnetic energy landscape in RuO2, where the nonmagnetic state lies nearly degenerate with multiple altermagnetic configurations. We find that material perturbations, exemplified by intrinsic defects, select distinct magnetic ground states primarily by modifying the localized Heisenberg exchange, with perturbation-induced itinerant Stoner polarization provides an essential secondary contribution. Spin-orbit coupling controls the orientation and stability of the Néel vector, but does not determine the emergence of long-range magnetic order. These results provide a unified explanation for the conflicting experimental observations and establish a general microscopic framework for understanding how material perturbations select competing magnetic ground states in systems with nearly flat magnetic energy landscapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“first-principles database”“machine-learning”“large-scale Monte Carlo simulations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算与模拟研究。；研究对象：金红石结构 RuO₂（rutile RuO₂）的磁性基态争议，具体涉及非磁态与交变磁（altermagnetic）态之间的竞争，以及缺陷、自旋-轨道耦合等扰动对磁性基态选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RuO₂ 具有异常平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多种交变磁构型近乎简并；材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过改变局域 Heisenberg 交换作用来选择不同的磁性基态，而自旋-轨道耦合仅控制 Néel 矢量的取向与稳定性，并不决定长程磁有序的出现。该框架统一解释了实验中相互矛盾的观测结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RuO₂ 具有异常平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多种交变磁构型近乎简并；材料扰动（如本征缺陷）主要通过改变局域 Heisenberg 交换作用来选择不同的磁性基态，而自旋-轨道耦合仅控制 Néel 矢量的取向与稳定性，并不决定长程磁有序的出现。该框架统一解释了实验中相互矛盾的观测结果。；创新点：提出了一个统一的微观理论框架，能够同时涵盖局域与巡游磁性通道以及自旋-轨道耦合效应，并首次揭示了 RuO₂ 磁性能量景观的“平坦性”是实验争议的根源——即不同实验中的扰动（如缺陷）会选择不同的近简并磁性态。摘要未突出说明该方法是否可推广至其他候选交变磁材料。
papers.method_zh: 构建了广义的、依赖环境的自旋-晶格（spin-lattice）理论框架，统一描述局域 Heisenberg 交换、通过 Landau 自旋涨落实现的巡游 Stoner 磁性，以及自旋-轨道耦合介导的自旋-晶格相互作用。模型参数通过机器学习从高通量第一性原理数据库拟合获得，并采用大规模 Monte Carlo 模拟求解。

papers.title: Moiré-induced altermagnetism from nonmagnetic constituents
papers.abstract: We propose a mechanism for nonmagnetic materials to develop altermagnetic order by moiré interference with nonmagnetic substrate, which is driven by structural relaxation and spontaneous twirls in moiré domain walls of lattice-mismatched moiré square lattices. When doped with one electron per moiré domain, a correlated insulating gap is opened by electron interaction. Depending on the location of the moiré potential minima, the moiré bands can show d-wave or g-wave altermagnetic splitting. The former can be enhanced by a finite twist angle; the latter is sensitive to strains that drive a transition to d-wave.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We propose a mechanism”“can show”“is driven by”等理论建模与预言性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：非磁性材料在晶格失配的莫尔超晶格（moiré square lattices）中，由结构弛豫和畴壁自发扭转诱导产生的交错磁（altermagnetic）有序。具体体系为“非磁性组分 + 非磁性衬底”构成的莫尔异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非磁性材料可通过与无磁衬底的莫尔干涉产生交错磁序；当每个莫尔畴掺杂一个电子时，电子相互作用打开关联绝缘能隙，且根据莫尔势能最小值的位置，莫尔能带可呈现d波或g波交错磁劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非磁性材料可通过与无磁衬底的莫尔干涉产生交错磁序；当每个莫尔畴掺杂一个电子时，电子相互作用打开关联绝缘能隙，且根据莫尔势能最小值的位置，莫尔能带可呈现d波或g波交错磁劈裂。；创新点：提出一种全新的交错磁产生机制——仅由非磁性组分通过莫尔干涉与结构效应实现，无需任何磁性元素或磁序前驱体；并预言了可调控的d波/g波交错磁对称性及其对转角与应变的响应。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如模型哈密顿量、平均场或数值方法），仅提及“结构弛豫”“自发扭转”“电子相互作用”等物理机制。摘要未给出具体计算方法。

papers.title: A Strategy Toward Room Temperature Topological Hall Effect via Local Moment Magnetism
papers.abstract: Topological spin textures in local moment systems hold great promise for technological applications due to their large magnetic moments, strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC), and high tunability. Finding new spin textures that are stable near room temperature is paramount to maximizing their potential for applications. Here, we provide a strategy for realizing topological spin textures at high temperatures by identifying rare earth ($R$) magnets ordering at or near room temperature. We demonstrate the feasibility of this strategy in one of these magnets, hexagonal Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, which orders at $T_C$ = 285 K. The indication for topological spin textures comes from topological Hall effect (THE), which, in Gd$_5$Pb$_3$, occurs between $T$ = 100 - 200 K, an order of magnitude higher temperature than in other reported $R$-based systems. Our results present an opportunity to explore the role of SOC, anisotropic exchange, geometric frustration, and magnetic interactions in stabilizing topological spin textures, and provide a pathway toward realizing them near room temperature in $R$-based magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了在具体材料中观测到拓扑霍尔效应（THE），并给出了温度区间等实验现象。；研究对象：稀土（R）基局域磁矩磁体，具体为六方结构 Gd₅Pb₃ 化合物，其磁有序温度 T_C = 285 K。研究聚焦于该体系中拓扑自旋织构及其伴随的拓扑霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Gd₅Pb₃ 中观测到拓扑霍尔效应，其出现温度区间为 100–200 K，比此前报道的其他稀土基体系高出一个数量级，表明该策略有望在近室温实现拓扑自旋织构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Gd₅Pb₃ 中观测到拓扑霍尔效应，其出现温度区间为 100–200 K，比此前报道的其他稀土基体系高出一个数量级，表明该策略有望在近室温实现拓扑自旋织构。；创新点：提出了一种通用策略：在居里温度接近或处于室温的稀土磁体中寻找高温稳定的拓扑自旋织构，并在 Gd₅Pb₃ 中验证了该策略的可行性，将稀土基体系中拓扑霍尔效应的出现温度大幅提升至 100–200 K。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如输运测量、中子散射、磁力显微镜等），仅提及通过拓扑霍尔效应（THE）作为拓扑自旋织构的指示信号。摘要未给出更详细的测量技术细节。

papers.title: Optimal Control of Periodic Nonequilibrium Mechanochemical Systems via Automatic Differentiation
papers.abstract: Biological molecular machines are mesoscopic systems that act repeatedly and periodically to perform important cellular tasks while contending with strong fluctuations and operating in an overdamped regime. Optimal control theory is a tool that can be used to understand the design principles behind efficient operation of these machines; however, most studies on optimal control of classical mesoscopic systems have focused on control problems that do not repeat periodically. Here, we automatically differentiate Fokker-Planck simulations to design efficient nonequilibrium control strategies for simple models of periodic molecular machines with and without explicit changes in the machine's chemical state. The designed protocols and theoretical analysis provide insight into the design principles governing efficient driving in these nonequilibrium systems. Designed control protocols should seek to reduce mechanical heat by rotating the entire angular probability distribution at a constant speed without changing its shape, and should reduce chemical heat by reducing the proportion of chemical transitions with large heat.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“自动微分Fokker-Planck模拟”“设计控制策略”“理论分析”。；研究对象：周期性非平衡机械化学系统，具体为生物分子机器的简化模型（含或不含化学态显式变化），工作在过阻尼、强涨落环境下的介观尺度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高效驱动周期性分子机器的设计原则是：通过以恒定角速度整体旋转角概率分布（不改变其形状）来减少机械热；通过降低具有大热量的化学跃迁比例来减少化学热。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高效驱动周期性分子机器的设计原则是：通过以恒定角速度整体旋转角概率分布（不改变其形状）来减少机械热；通过降低具有大热量的化学跃迁比例来减少化学热。；创新点：将最优控制方法从非周期性经典介观系统拓展到周期性重复工作的分子机器，并同时考虑机械与化学自由度（含化学态变化）的控制优化。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对照。
papers.method_zh: 采用自动微分（automatic differentiation）对Fokker-Planck方程的数值模拟进行梯度计算，从而优化设计非平衡控制协议（最优控制方法）。

papers.title: Thermal history controls the optoelectronic response of lead halide perovskites through structure and dynamics
papers.abstract: Lead halide perovskites are promising optoelectronic materials for photovoltaics, light emission and detection. Their efficiencies in PV now approach the detailed-balance limit, leaving stability as the principal barrier. The intrinsic instabilities studied to date centre on ionic motion within a fixed, homogeneous lattice. Here we identify a further source of intrinsic structural instability, hidden in the lattice dynamics. Mapping caesium, methylammonium and formamidinium-based compositions with Cl, Br, I and mixed X-sites through all accessible phases, using single crystal X-ray and neutron diffuse scattering, machine-learning-assisted molecular dynamics, a phenomenological octahedral tilt model and hyperspectral photoluminescence, we find that nearly every composition hosts equilibrium local structural fluctuations: dynamic nanodomains of correlated octahedral tilts, a few nanometres in size, that locally break the crystallographic symmetry. Three complementary levers control them. The A-site cation sets their symmetry, shape and anisotropy, from sparse, isotropic and tetragonal in formamidinium-based compositions to dense, anisotropic and orthorhombic in nominally cubic caesium-based ones, the most locally disordered we studied. The halide controls the dynamic disorder and the phase-transition sequence. Thermal history is the third: different ramp rates drive nominally identical compositions into distinct crystallographic phases, each with its own hidden local order. In MAPbI3, the heating rate alone changes the photoluminescence quantum efficiency across the phase transition. Because these transitions lie within device operating ranges, from terrestrial thermal cycling to the extremes of space, thermal history may shape the local structure, and hence the optoelectronic response, throughout fabrication and operation, establishing it as a design variable alongside composition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“single crystal X-ray and neutron diffuse scattering”（实验）、“machine-learning-assisted molecular dynamics”（计算模拟）、“phenomenological octahedral tilt model”（理论建模）以及“hyperspectral photoluminescence”（实验）。；研究对象：铅卤钙钛矿（lead halide perovskites），涵盖Cs、MA、FA三种A位阳离子与Cl、Br、I及混合卤素X位组合，研究其局域结构涨落（动态纳米畴）与光电响应之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 几乎所有铅卤钙钛矿组分中都存在平衡态局域结构涨落——由关联八面体倾斜构成的、尺寸为数纳米的动态纳米畴，它们局部破坏晶体对称性；热历史（升温速率）可驱动名义相同组分进入不同晶相，从而改变其局域有序性和光电性质（如MAPbI₃的光致发光量子效率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：几乎所有铅卤钙钛矿组分中都存在平衡态局域结构涨落——由关联八面体倾斜构成的、尺寸为数纳米的动态纳米畴，它们局部破坏晶体对称性；热历史（升温速率）可驱动名义相同组分进入不同晶相，从而改变其局域有序性和光电性质（如MAPbI₃的光致发光量子效率）。；创新点：首次揭示“热历史”作为独立于化学组分的第三调控杠杆，可通过控制隐藏的局域结构涨落来影响器件工作温度范围内的光电响应，将热历史确立为与组分并列的设计变量。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线与中子漫散射实验、机器学习辅助分子动力学模拟、唯象八面体倾斜模型、高光谱光致发光（hyperspectral photoluminescence）测量。

papers.title: Generative Nested Sampling of Atomistic Thermodynamic Landscapes
papers.abstract: Nested sampling (NS) resolves the thermodynamics of an atomistic system from a single simulation, but its practical reach is limited by the Markov-chain updates needed to decorrelate walkers within each likelihood-constrained ensemble. Flow-based NS has removed this bottleneck for gravitational-wave (GW) inference, yet its transfer to atomistic systems is not merely a change of application. Comparing a GW150914-like binary-black-hole likelihood with an eight-particle two-dimensional Lennard-Jones (LJ) system of comparable dimensionality, we show that the two landscapes differ fundamentally: atomistic multimodality is discrete and combinatorial, generated by particle permutations separated by hard collision walls, and its coordinate coupling is dense and collective, whereas the GW posterior exhibits smooth degeneracies and localized parameter coupling. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce NS-Flows: a single conditional normalizing flow, conditioned on the NS energy bound and trained on a sliding window of recent live sets, that replaces MCMC by direct parallel draws corrected by importance-weighted rejection resampling. Live sets supply data self-consistently, allowing flow training without structured priors or a pre-existing dataset. For LJ disks in PBC, the algorithm reduces energy evaluations by over two orders of magnitude and wall-clock time by roughly one third, an advantage that becomes increasingly favorable as the cost of the potential grows. The flow's generation efficiency further acts as a physical diagnostic: it varies non-monotonically along the annealing trajectory, is lowest in the dense disordered regime, and is quantitatively captured by the constrained ensemble's internal mode complexity together with target drift across the training window, identifying liquid-like ensembles, rather than prior-target separation, as the hard case for current flow architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：nested sampling、normalizing flow、算法、模拟。；研究对象：原子系统的热力学景观，具体以二维Lennard-Jones（LJ）盘状粒子体系（含八粒子周期边界条件）为测试对象，并与引力波（GW）推断（GW150914-like双黑洞）进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原子体系的热力学多模态是离散且组合性的（由粒子置换与硬碰撞墙产生），其坐标耦合密集且集体性，与引力波后验的平滑简并和局域耦合本质不同。作者提出NS-Flows算法，用条件归一化流替代马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC），在LJ体系中能量评估减少两个数量级以上，墙钟时间减少约三分之一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原子体系的热力学多模态是离散且组合性的（由粒子置换与硬碰撞墙产生），其坐标耦合密集且集体性，与引力波后验的平滑简并和局域耦合本质不同。作者提出NS-Flows算法，用条件归一化流替代马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC），在LJ体系中能量评估减少两个数量级以上，墙钟时间减少约三分之一。；创新点：将流式嵌套采样从引力波推断推广到原子体系，并诊断出两类景观的根本差异；提出无需结构化先验或预存在数据集的自我一致训练方案；流生成效率可作为物理诊断工具，定量关联约束系综的内部模式复杂度与目标漂移。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 嵌套采样（NS）结合条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flow），流模型以NS能量界为条件，在滑动窗口的近期live sets上训练，通过重要性加权拒绝重采样进行直接并行采样。对比分析采用GW150914-like似然与八粒子二维LJ系统。

papers.title: Accelerating stochastic processes through nonequilibrium driving: Thermodynamic constraints on the maximum speed-up
papers.abstract: We derive a new set of bounds controlling the speed-up of the survival rate of trajectory-dependent observables induced by the application of a perturbation. Via the study of survival probabilities in two different contexts, continuous-time Markov jump processes and overdamped diffusions, we obtain different fashions of the bound on the achievable boost. These bounds, obtained by a nonlinear response theory of constrained path probabilities, are explicitly linked to thermodynamics. For arbitrary time-dependent survival rates, we find a linear bound that depends on both the perturbation strength and the entropy production rate prior to the perturbation. For rare processes characterized by a constant survival rate, the bound is exponential and is determined by the excess heat generated by the perturbation. We exemplify the inequalities on two prototypical model systems, namely, a unicyclic network and forced diffusion in a bistable potential.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive bounds、nonlinear response theory、thermodynamic constraints。；研究对象：非平衡驱动对随机过程（连续时间马尔可夫跳跃过程与过阻尼扩散）中轨迹依赖可观测量存活率加速的物理限制，以及其与热力学量的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出一组新的不等式，约束了微扰引起的轨迹依赖可观测量存活率提升的上界：对于任意含时存活率，该上界为线性形式，依赖于微扰强度与微扰前的熵产生率；对于恒定存活率的稀有过程，该上界为指数形式，由微扰产生的过量热决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出一组新的不等式，约束了微扰引起的轨迹依赖可观测量存活率提升的上界：对于任意含时存活率，该上界为线性形式，依赖于微扰强度与微扰前的熵产生率；对于恒定存活率的稀有过程，该上界为指数形式，由微扰产生的过量热决定。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于将存活率加速的界限与微扰前的熵产生率及微扰产生的过量热直接建立显式热力学联系，并区分了线性与指数两种不同形式的界限。
papers.method_zh: 基于约束路径概率的非线性响应理论，推导存活率加速的通用热力学界限；并在单环网络（unicyclic network）与双稳态势阱中的受迫扩散两个原型模型上验证所得不等式。

papers.title: An Ultrathin Laterally Conductive Mesh Interphase Enables Spatially Extended Zinc Deposition for Aqueous Zinc Batteries
papers.abstract: Zn metal anodes often suffer from nonuniform interfacial reactions during cycling, resulting in uneven deposition and dendrite growth. Existing artificial interphases can mitigate side reactions or regulate nucleation, but rarely achieve regulation of the interfacial electron/field distribution to sustain uniform deposition at the evolving Zn/electrolyte interface. Here, we develop an Au mesh interphase (AuMI), an ultrathin two-dimensional Au aerogel network that couples lateral electron redistribution with open pathways for ions. During Zn plating/stripping, the conductive AuMI distributes electron transport across the Zn surface, while its porous mesh preserves Zn$^{2+}$ access, enabling more uniform interfacial reactions. Experiments and simulations show that AuMI homogenizes the interfacial electric field and current distribution, promotes more uniform Zn plating/stripping, and limits dendrite growth. As a result, this regulated interfacial reaction mode enables AuMI Zn symmetric cells to operate stably for 3000 h at 1 mA cm$^{-2}$/1 mAh cm$^{-2}$ and for 1100 h at 10 mA cm$^{-2}$/10 mAh cm$^{-2}$, while AuMI Zn||NVO (NaV$_3$O$_8$\cdot$1.5H$_2$O) full cells retain 80.8 % capacity after over 5000 cycles at 1 A g$^{-1}$. These findings highlight the importance of combining ultrathin architecture, lateral electron transport, and open Zn2+ access in artificial interphases for stable aqueous Zn metal anodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含模拟辅助验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“Experiments and simulations show...”，涉及材料制备、电化学测试及电场/电流分布模拟。；研究对象：水系锌离子电池中的锌金属负极，具体为一种超薄二维Au气凝胶网络构成的横向导电网格界面层（AuMI），以及其调控的Zn/电解液界面沉积行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AuMI通过将电子横向输运与开放离子通道耦合，均匀化了Zn表面的界面电场和电流分布，从而实现了空间延展的均匀锌沉积，显著抑制枝晶生长并大幅提升循环寿命。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AuMI通过将电子横向输运与开放离子通道耦合，均匀化了Zn表面的界面电场和电流分布，从而实现了空间延展的均匀锌沉积，显著抑制枝晶生长并大幅提升循环寿命。；创新点：不同于以往人工界面层仅抑制副反应或调控成核，本工作首次强调并实现了在动态演化的Zn/电解液界面上，通过超薄导电网格同时实现横向电子再分布与开放Zn²⁺通道，从而持续调控界面反应均匀性。摘要未突出说明与其他界面层设计的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上制备了超薄Au气凝胶网格界面层（AuMI），并组装Zn对称电池和Zn||NVO全电池进行电化学循环测试；同时结合数值模拟分析界面电场与电流分布均匀性。摘要未明确说明具体模拟方法（如有限元等）或详细表征手段（如SEM、XRD等）。

papers.title: Topological Boundary States and the Edge Chain in Semi-Infinite Two-Dimensional Insulators
papers.abstract: We show that it is possible to compute the adiabatically protected edge and corner states of semi-infinite, two-dimensional, topological insulators by considering the first layer of lattice sites, what we call the "edge chain," independently from the bulk. We start by accepting this claim as an ansatz, then, using the Shemesh theorem, we show that the edge states one finds using our procedure are adiabatically protected, provided we restrict ourselves to adiabatic evolutions that do not break chiral symmetry. We show explicit examples of our method in a 2D extension of the SSH model, the SSH3 model, the Haldane model and the Breathing Kagome Lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show that it is possible to compute…”、“using the Shemesh theorem”、“adiabatically protected”等理论推导与证明性表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：半无限二维拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑边界态（边缘态与角态），具体体系包括二维SSH模型的扩展、SSH3模型、Haldane模型以及呼吸Kagome晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过仅考虑半无限二维拓扑绝缘体的第一层晶格位点（即“边缘链”）并将其与体态分离处理，可以计算出受绝热保护的边缘态和角态；在保持手征对称性的绝热演化下，该方法得到的边缘态是绝热受保护的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过仅考虑半无限二维拓扑绝缘体的第一层晶格位点（即“边缘链”）并将其与体态分离处理，可以计算出受绝热保护的边缘态和角态；在保持手征对称性的绝热演化下，该方法得到的边缘态是绝热受保护的。；创新点：提出了一种将半无限二维拓扑绝缘体的边界态计算简化为仅处理第一层晶格位点（边缘链）的新方法，并利用Shemesh定理严格证明了在手征对称性约束下该方法的绝热保护性。摘要未突出说明与已有边界态计算方法（如缠绕数、体边对应等）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：以“边缘链独立于体态”为ansatz（假设），利用Shemesh定理证明所得边缘态的绝热保护性，并在多个具体模型（二维SSH扩展、SSH3、Haldane、呼吸Kagome）中给出显式示例。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetism-altered plasmon dynamics
papers.abstract: The interaction between plasmons and magnons is a long-sought phenomenon with implications for fundamental physics and spintronics applications.
