In three-dimensional systems, this coupling is suppressed by the large mismatch in energy scales, but two-dimensional (2D) plasmons with gapless dispersion can overlap with magnons over a broad spectral range. Despite numerous theoretical predictions, experimental observation of magnon-plasmon interaction has remained elusive. In this work, we study a first-of-its-kind hybrid plasmon-magnon platform based on 2D materials. By deploying scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM) with terahertz radiation, we image propagating plasmon wavepackets at a graphene/NiPS$_3$ interface and track their dynamics across the antiferromagnetic transition of NiPS$_3$. We observe a clear renormalization of the plasmon-polariton dispersion concurrent with the onset of antiferromagnetic order. With complementary Raman scattering and nano-terahertz spectroscopy, we unveil spectral weight redistribution and dielectric screening changes, potentially associated with the multi-magnon continuum, as the underlying mechanism. These results provide solid evidence of coupling between plasmon and antiferromagnetic order, marking a cornerstone for a potential platform for hybrid magnon-plasmon interactions in 2D materials, opening avenues for coherent spin-plasmon devices and tunable terahertz spintronic components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM)”“Raman scattering”“nano-terahertz spectroscopy”等实验手段，并描述了对实际界面的成像与光谱测量。；研究对象：石墨烯/NiPS₃ 异质界面上的二维等离激元（plasmon-polariton）传播及其与 NiPS₃ 反铁磁序的相互作用；具体物理现象为等离激元-磁振子耦合及其随反铁磁相变的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 NiPS₃ 进入反铁磁有序态的同时，石墨烯/NiPS₃ 界面处的等离激元-极化激元色散发生明显重整化，表明等离激元与反铁磁序之间存在耦合；光谱权重再分布与介电屏蔽变化（可能与多磁振子连续谱相关）被认为是潜在机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 NiPS₃ 进入反铁磁有序态的同时，石墨烯/NiPS₃ 界面处的等离激元-极化激元色散发生明显重整化，表明等离激元与反铁磁序之间存在耦合；光谱权重再分布与介电屏蔽变化（可能与多磁振子连续谱相关）被认为是潜在机制。；创新点：首次构建并实验研究了基于二维材料的混合等离激元-磁振子平台，在实验上观测到等离激元与反铁磁序耦合的直接证据（此前仅有理论预言，实验观测长期缺失）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹辐射激发的散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）用于成像传播中的等离激元波包并追踪其跨反铁磁相变的动力学；辅以互补的拉曼散射（Raman scattering）和纳米太赫兹光谱（nano-terahertz spectroscopy）研究光谱权重与介电响应变化。

papers.title: Death by mutants: unusual multicritical dynamics in a two-species model for absorbing state transitions
papers.abstract: We explore the phases and active-to-absorbing state phase transitions (AAPT) in a two-species model, where the species A and its mutant B are {\em asymmetrically} or {\em nonreciprocally} coupled. We identify a multicritical point that connects the global absorbing state of both the species and its mutant, with a uniform active state. The critical dynamics at this multicritical point is studied within the lowest order perturbation theory. This asymmetric coupling between species A and mutant B leads to unequal and distinct upper critical dimensions $d_c^A$ and $d_c^B$ respectively for A and B dynamics. We show that the multicritical point in this model is characterised by an unusual breakdown of scale-invariance by fluctuation-induced logarithmic modulations with power law behaviour of the order parameter and correlation lengths of the species A at all dimensions $d<d_c^A$. Above $d_c^A$, conventional scale-invariance is restored. The dynamics of the mutant species B belongs to the DP universality class with an upper critical dimension of $d_c^B=4$
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“最低阶微扰理论”“上临界维度”等理论物理术语，且未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：两物种（物种A及其突变体B）非互易/不对称耦合的活性-吸收态相变（AAPT）模型，重点研究多临界点处的临界动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型的多临界点处出现一种反常的标度不变性破缺：在维度d < d_c^A时，物种A的序参量和关联长度呈现由涨落诱导的对数调制叠加幂律行为；仅在d > d_c^A时恢复常规标度不变性。突变体B的动力学属于DP普适类，其上临界维度为d_c^B = 4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型的多临界点处出现一种反常的标度不变性破缺：在维度d < d_c^A时，物种A的序参量和关联长度呈现由涨落诱导的对数调制叠加幂律行为；仅在d > d_c^A时恢复常规标度不变性。突变体B的动力学属于DP普适类，其上临界维度为d_c^B = 4。；创新点：发现不对称耦合导致A、B两物种具有不同的上临界维度，并在多临界点处揭示了一种由对数调制引起的标度不变性破缺机制（“死亡由突变体引起”的非常规多临界动力学）。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 解析微扰理论（最低阶），结合上临界维度分析（d_c^A与d_c^B不等且不同），研究多临界点处的临界动力学与标度行为。

papers.title: Large deviations for linear regressions
papers.abstract: Linear regression is one of the simplest and most widely used tools to learn patterns from data: it fits a set of coefficients so that a linear combination of predictors best matches observed responses. The quality of the fit is measured by the residual sum of squares, the total squared mismatch between predictions and data, whose minimum defines the training loss. We consider Gaussian design and noise, with teacher coefficients independently drawn from a general distribution $p(β)$, and a general class of separable regularizers, including Ridge and Lasso. Using the zero-temperature replica method, we compute analytically the large-deviation statistics of the minimum training loss for large numbers $P$ of predictors and $N$ of observations, with $r=P/N$ fixed. The rate function we compute governs rare sample-to-sample fluctuations of the optimal loss. Extensive numerical simulations are in excellent agreement with our theory and clearly show a pronounced deviation from the Gaussian regime of typical fluctuations in the tails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“zero-temperature replica method”“compute analytically”“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：线性回归模型中的训练损失（最小残差平方和）的统计物理性质，具体为在高斯设计矩阵与高斯噪声下、教师系数服从一般分布、正则化项为可分形式（含Ridge与Lasso）的回归问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在预测变量数P与观测数N同阶（r=P/N固定）的大规模极限下，最小训练损失的稀有样本间涨落服从大偏差原理，其速率函数可解析计算；数值模拟显示尾部涨落显著偏离典型涨落的高斯行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在预测变量数P与观测数N同阶（r=P/N固定）的大规模极限下，最小训练损失的稀有样本间涨落服从大偏差原理，其速率函数可解析计算；数值模拟显示尾部涨落显著偏离典型涨落的高斯行为。；创新点：将大偏差统计（而非仅典型涨落）推广到一般教师分布与一般可分正则化器（含Ridge与Lasso）的线性回归问题，揭示了损失尾部涨落对高斯典型行为的明显偏离。
papers.method_zh: 零温复制方法（zero-temperature replica method），用于解析计算最小训练损失的大偏差速率函数；辅以大规模数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Critical scaling and soft granular rheology of frictionless non-Brownian suspensions across jamming
papers.abstract: We carry out 3D computer simulations to study suspension rheology across the jamming transition for deformable non-Brownian frictionless particles. The simulations are carried out at constant shear rates and suspension densities ($\dotγ , φ$), for polydisperse spherical particles. The suspension is probed at densities in the neighbourhood of the jamming point $φ_c$ , as well as across much wider density ranges. We carry out critical scaling analysis of our close-to-jamming data and confirm that shear-driven jamming is a second-order critical phenomenon requiring strong corrections on shear. We build maps of the local strain rate exponent to classify flow regimes and examine the effect of the corrections on the suspension rheology. Further, using the critical scaling jamming density, we carry out soft granular rheological scaling over the wider density range, demonstrating an excellent data collapse. The soft granular rheology relations are able to predict our data over almost the entire dynamical and density range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“3D computer simulations”。；研究对象：无摩擦非布朗可变形球形颗粒悬浮液，重点研究其在堵塞转变（jamming transition）附近的流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切驱动的堵塞是一个需要强剪切修正的二阶临界现象；基于临界标度得到的堵塞密度，软颗粒流变学标度关系能在几乎整个动力学和密度范围内实现优异的数据塌缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切驱动的堵塞是一个需要强剪切修正的二阶临界现象；基于临界标度得到的堵塞密度，软颗粒流变学标度关系能在几乎整个动力学和密度范围内实现优异的数据塌缩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 三维计算机模拟，采用恒定剪切速率和恒定悬浮密度（$\dot\gamma, \phi$）条件，模拟多分散球形颗粒；对近堵塞数据做临界标度分析，并构建局部应变率指数图以划分流动区域。

papers.title: Deterministic nanofabrication for engineering nanowire quantum dot devices
papers.abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are a leading platform for realising bright, wavelength-tunable sources of single and entangled photon pairs for photonic quantum technologies. Site-selected nanowire quantum dots (NWQDs) are a promising platform for fabricating such photonic devices in a scalable manner. However, implementing additional structures around the photonic nanowire while maintaining its vertical growth geometry has remained a challenge. In this work, we develop a deterministic pick-and-place technique to conduct a vertical-to-vertical transfer of NWQDs from the growth substrate to arbitrary templates. Using this transfer technique, we enhance the photon extraction efficiency to 75% by implementing a bottom gold mirror and tune the emission wavelength by 3.6 GHz via implementing electrostatic gates around the QD. Importantly, we measure low-multiphoton probability (g^(2)(0) = 0.002) and high indistinguishability (>80% for +/-100 ps) of the QD emission after the transfer process, yielding high-quality devices. These results demonstrate the repeatability and versatility of the developed transfer technique, which is an enabling step towards scalable single and entangled photon sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验流程（pick-and-place转移技术、静电门控、光学测量）及实验数据（g^(2)(0)=0.002、不可区分性>80%）。；研究对象：半导体纳米线量子点（NWQDs）及其单光子/纠缠光子源器件，具体涉及砷化镓（GaAs）类半导体量子点（摘要未明确具体材料体系，仅称“半导体量子点”）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种确定性“拾取-放置”垂直-垂直转移技术，可将纳米线量子点从生长衬底转移到任意模板上，并在转移后实现75%的光子提取效率、3.6 GHz的发射波长调谐，同时保持高质量单光子发射（g^(2)(0)=0.002，不可区分性>80%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种确定性“拾取-放置”垂直-垂直转移技术，可将纳米线量子点从生长衬底转移到任意模板上，并在转移后实现75%的光子提取效率、3.6 GHz的发射波长调谐，同时保持高质量单光子发射（g^(2)(0)=0.002，不可区分性>80%）。；创新点：实现了纳米线量子点从生长衬底到任意模板的垂直-垂直转移，克服了在保持垂直生长几何的同时在光子纳米线周围集成附加结构（如金镜、静电门）的挑战，且转移后器件性能保持高质量，展示了该技术的可重复性和通用性。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：确定性pick-and-place纳米转移技术（垂直-垂直转移）、底部金镜（bottom gold mirror）集成、静电门控（electrostatic gates）实现波长调谐、光子提取效率测量、二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)测量（用于多光子概率）、Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉测量（用于光子不可区分性）。

papers.title: Orbital current rectifier and linear magnon Edelstein effect in $p$-wave antialtermagnets
papers.abstract: We show that $p$-wave magnets efficiently generate magnetization via a linear thermal Edelstein effect arising from the orbital magnetic moments of their magnons. Furthermore, they can generate perfectly nonreciprocal orbital currents through a purely even-order nonlinear response. This makes them promising candidates for orbital-current rectification. Because these transport phenomena originate from the orbital magnetic moment of magnons, they connect magnonics and orbitronics. More generally, we find that odd-parity-wave magnets with coplanar ground states host magnons with zero spin magnetic moment. Instead the magnons carry a collinear, out-of-plane orbital magnetic moment, realizing an orbital version of antialtermagnetism. We establish these general results using symmetry arguments and demonstrate them explicitly for a coplanar ground state with the minimal number of sublattices, inspired by the ground state of CeNiAsO. Our conclusions hold both in absence and presence of spin-orbit coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“We show”“We establish these general results using symmetry arguments and demonstrate them explicitly”，属于对称性分析与模型论证，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：p波反交变磁体（p-wave antialtermagnets）中的磁振子（magnon）及其轨道磁矩驱动的输运现象，具体以具有共面基态、最小子晶格数目的体系为模型（受CeNiAsO基态启发），涉及磁振子学与轨道电子学（orbitronics）的交叉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: p波磁体可通过磁振子的轨道磁矩产生线性的热Edelstein效应，从而高效产生磁化；同时可通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，实现轨道电流整流。此外，具有共面基态的奇宇称波磁体中的磁振子携带零自旋磁矩，而携带共线、面外方向的轨道磁矩，实现轨道版本的反交变磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：p波磁体可通过磁振子的轨道磁矩产生线性的热Edelstein效应，从而高效产生磁化；同时可通过纯偶数阶非线性响应产生完全非互易的轨道电流，实现轨道电流整流。此外，具有共面基态的奇宇称波磁体中的磁振子携带零自旋磁矩，而携带共线、面外方向的轨道磁矩，实现轨道版本的反交变磁性。；创新点：首次将磁振子的轨道磁矩与反交变磁性（antialtermagnetism）联系起来，提出“轨道反交变磁性”概念，并揭示p波磁体可作为轨道电流整流器，同时建立了磁振子学与轨道电子学之间的桥梁。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 对称性论证（symmetry arguments）结合显式模型演示：针对具有最小子晶格数的共面基态（受CeNiAsO基态启发）构建模型，分别在有和无自旋-轨道耦合两种情况下进行分析。

papers.title: Flux noise without flux tunability in superconducting qubits
papers.abstract: Flux noise is unanimously recognised as a leading dephasing mechanism for flux-tunable superconducting qubits. However, our microscopic understanding remains incomplete, and basic effects like Faraday's law of induction have only very recently come into focus. Based on a quantum geometric description of the Faraday effect, we provide an in-depth derivation of the coupling of generic magnetic sources to thin film superconducting structures, under appropriate consideration of the device geometry. We apply the resulting framework to time-varying magnetic dipoles, describing surface or substrate spins, as well as current-carrying flux lines. We show that flux noise not only affects dephasing, but also provides a fundamental limit for the qubit quality factor - notably, even when the qubit contains no loops and is thus nominally not flux-tunable. Assuming surface spins as the origin for universal flux noise, we expect that this quality factor limit might be reached in the near term. For flux lines, we formulate a minimal safety distance to conserve the qubit performance, potentially constraining the scale-up of quantum hardware. This distance is boosted in the presence of large capacitor wings typical for transmons, due to a lensing of the electromotive field which is largely independent of Meissner screening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum geometric description、in-depth derivation、framework。；研究对象：超导量子比特中的磁通噪声（flux noise），特别是薄膜超导结构（如transmon）与磁性源（表面/衬底自旋、载流磁通线）的耦合机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁通噪声不仅导致退相干，还会对量子比特的品质因子（quality factor）构成根本性限制——即使量子比特不含回路、名义上不可磁通调谐（non-flux-tunable）也是如此。若表面自旋是普适磁通噪声的来源，该品质因子极限可能在近期被达到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁通噪声不仅导致退相干，还会对量子比特的品质因子（quality factor）构成根本性限制——即使量子比特不含回路、名义上不可磁通调谐（non-flux-tunable）也是如此。若表面自旋是普适磁通噪声的来源，该品质因子极限可能在近期被达到。；创新点：首次系统论证了磁通噪声对不可磁通调谐的超导量子比特品质因子的限制作用；发现transmon的大电容翼板会对电动势场产生“透镜”效应（lensing），从而增大载流磁通线所需的最小安全距离，且该效应基本独立于迈斯纳屏蔽。摘要未突出说明与以往微观模型的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于法拉第效应的量子几何描述，推导了通用磁性源与薄膜超导结构的耦合哈密顿量/相互作用形式，并显式考虑器件几何结构。将该框架应用于两类磁性源：时变磁偶极子（模拟表面/衬底自旋）和载流磁通线。

papers.title: Interplay between Isomerization and Spin Crossover in 1D Fe-Indigo Coordination Polymers on Ag substrates
papers.abstract: Spin-crossover (SCO) compounds offer a route to switchable molecular functionality in reduced dimensions. However, one-dimensional (1D) SCO chains, which offer the possibility to study ligand fields other than the paradigmatic octahedral field, remain comparatively little studied. Here, we use first-principles density functional theory (DFT+$U$) to investigate Fe-indigo coordination-polymer chains synthesized experimentally on Ag(111) and Ag(100) substrates. These display a rich interplay between changes in ligand field (isomerization) and spin crossover. On-surface isomerization on Ag(111) interconverts (N,O)-chelated \textit{trans} configuration and (N,N)-/(O,O)-chelated \textit{cis} configurations at the Fe centers. The lowest-energy \textit{trans} and \textit{cis} solutions on Ag(111) have different spin configurations over the interval $0.66<U<3.00$~eV. At the reference value $U=1$~eV, the preferred \textit{trans} solution is the mixed LS--LS--HS configuration, whereas the preferred \textit{cis} solution is LS--LS--LS. The experimentally observed preference for \textit{cis} chains on Ag(111) and \textit{trans} chains on Ag(100) is reproduced for the range $0.88<U<3.75$~eV. To interpret these results, toy models and spin-resolved Fe $3d$ projected densities of states are used, while freestanding-chain calculations reveal a strain-sensitive LS--HS competition. These results provide a microscopic explanation for isomerization-controlled spin-state switching in a 1D coordination polymer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“first-principles density functional theory (DFT+$U$)”，并提及“toy models”和“projected densities of states”等理论分析工具，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：在Ag(111)和Ag(100)衬底上合成的Fe-靛蓝一维配位聚合物链，重点研究其配体场异构化（trans/cis构型转变）与自旋交叉（SCO）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Ag(111)上，Fe中心的(N,O)-螯合trans构型与(N,N)-/(O,O)-螯合cis构型可通过表面异构化相互转换，且两种构型在$0.66<U<3.00$ eV区间内具有不同的自旋基态（trans为混合LS–LS–HS，cis为LS–LS–LS）；在$0.88<U<3.75$ eV范围内，理论计算重现了实验观察到的Ag(111)偏好cis链、Ag(100)偏好trans链的构型选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Ag(111)上，Fe中心的(N,O)-螯合trans构型与(N,N)-/(O,O)-螯合cis构型可通过表面异构化相互转换，且两种构型在$0.66<U<3.00$ eV区间内具有不同的自旋基态（trans为混合LS–LS–HS，cis为LS–LS–LS）；在$0.88<U<3.75$ eV范围内，理论计算重现了实验观察到的Ag(111)偏好cis链、Ag(100)偏好trans链的构型选择性。；创新点：揭示了在一维配位聚合物中，配体场异构化可作为控制自旋态切换的微观机制，突破了传统八面体配位场下SCO研究的范式；并首次从理论上解释了衬底依赖的构型选择性（Ag(111) vs Ag(100)）与自旋态之间的耦合关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用DFT+$U$第一性原理计算（U为Hubbard参数，参考值取1 eV），辅以自旋分辨的Fe $3d$投影态密度分析，并构建toy models进行机理解释；同时通过自由站立链（freestanding-chain）计算研究应变对LS–HS竞争的影响。

papers.title: Tuning Andreev reflection and conductance in proximitized nanowires through the spin-orbit field direction
papers.abstract: We investigate the Andreev reflection (AR) and the nonlinear conductance in a normal-superconductor junction realized with a proximitized semiconductor nanowire exposed to a magnetic field along its axis. We show that, while at zero energy the AR coefficient is determined by the topological phase of the superconducting side of the junction, at finite energy the AR is strongly affected by the directions of the Rashba spin-orbit field characterizing the normal and the proximitized sides. The tunability of the AR and the nonlinear conductance as a function of the spin-orbit misalignment angle is particularly pronounced when the proximitized side is in the topologically trivial phase. The spin-orbit field direction is revealed to be an efficient knob to control the electron transport through the hybrid junction, realizing an electrically widely tunable device. The implementation in realistic setups is discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We investigate”“We show”等理论表述，讨论模型化体系（normal-superconductor junction）中的输运系数，未提及实验手段或样品制备。；研究对象：由半导体纳米线构成的正常-超导（N-S）结，其中纳米线被邻近效应诱导超导（proximitized），并沿轴向施加磁场。核心物理现象为Andreev反射（AR）和非线性电导，以及Rashba自旋-轨道场方向对这些输运性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零能量下，AR系数由超导侧的拓扑相决定；而在有限能量下，AR强烈依赖于正常侧和邻近超导侧Rashba自旋-轨道场的相对方向。当邻近侧处于拓扑平庸相时，AR和非线性电导对自旋-轨道失配角度的可调性尤为显著，表明自旋-轨道场方向可作为控制混合结电子输运的有效旋钮。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零能量下，AR系数由超导侧的拓扑相决定；而在有限能量下，AR强烈依赖于正常侧和邻近超导侧Rashba自旋-轨道场的相对方向。当邻近侧处于拓扑平庸相时，AR和非线性电导对自旋-轨道失配角度的可调性尤为显著，表明自旋-轨道场方向可作为控制混合结电子输运的有效旋钮。；创新点：揭示自旋-轨道场方向（而非仅其强度）作为调控N-S结中AR和非线性电导的新自由度，特别是在拓扑平庸相中实现电学可调器件。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算框架（如散射矩阵方法、Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程或Green函数等），仅提及对AR系数和非线性电导的理论分析，并讨论了在现实实验装置中的可实现性。具体方法细节摘要未给出。

papers.title: Microscopically exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model
papers.abstract: We derive an exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model, i.e. inverse-square interacting bosons on a line, from microscopic first principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“从微观第一性原理推导”（derive from microscopic first principles），属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：量子 Calogero 模型，即一维直线上具有反平方（1/r²）相互作用的玻色子体系。该模型是一维可积多体系统的典型代表。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者从微观第一性原理出发，推导出了该量子 Calogero 模型的精确输运方程（exact transport equation）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：作者从微观第一性原理出发，推导出了该量子 Calogero 模型的精确输运方程（exact transport equation）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于“精确”（exact）且“微观第一性原理”的输运方程——以往对该类可积模型的输运描述多为近似或唯象的，而本文给出了严格形式。具体对比对象摘要未明确说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如是否采用量子动力学、泛函积分、或可积系统方法），仅说明是从微观第一性原理出发进行严格推导。

papers.title: Direct Validation of Superconductivity through Contact-Free Detection of Persistent Supercurrents Using Room-Temperature Quantum Magnetometry
papers.abstract: The accelerated emergence of new materials is driving the search for high temperature superconductors, but rapid experimental validation remains a critical bottleneck, particularly for microscopic samples under high pressure. Here, we demonstrate one-step direct superconductivity validation through room-temperature, contact-free detection of remnant supercurrents. The technique utilizes a cryogen-free optically pumped atomic magnetometer to detect the temperature-dependent magnetic field produced by supercurrents of a superconductor. The superconducting transition is directly identified by the abrupt disappearance of magnetic field from the remnant supercurrent above the transition temperature and the reversal of the supercurrent direction upon reversing the applied magnetic field. Validated on YBCO microcrystals and REBCO tape, this technique detects pico-Tesla magnetic fields from supercurrents induced by the ambient Earth's magnetic field in a millimeter-sized REBCO square disk, as well as from sub-100 micrometer YBCO microcrystals compatible with high-pressure diamond anvil cells. The use of a ferrite flux guide enables sensitive detection from centimeter-scale distances. Requiring no electrical contacts, magnetic coils, or integrated magnetic sensors, this non-invasive, room-temperature platform offers a scalable approach for high-throughput screening and validation of superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“demonstrate”（演示）、“detect”（探测）、“Validated on”（在……上验证）等实验操作和验证过程。；研究对象：超导材料，具体包括YBCO（钇钡铜氧）微晶、REBCO（稀土钡铜氧）带材及毫米尺寸的REBCO方形薄片。研究的核心物理现象是超导转变及超导体的剩余超电流（persistent supercurrents）产生的磁场。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作实现了一种无需电接触、在室温下即可直接验证超导电性的方法。该方法通过探测超导转变温度以上剩余超电流磁场的突然消失，以及反转外加磁场时超电流方向的逆转，来直接识别超导转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作实现了一种无需电接触、在室温下即可直接验证超导电性的方法。该方法通过探测超导转变温度以上剩余超电流磁场的突然消失，以及反转外加磁场时超电流方向的逆转，来直接识别超导转变。；创新点：该技术实现了对超导电性的“一步式”直接验证，全程在室温下进行且无需任何电接触、磁线圈或集成磁传感器。其非侵入式、可扩展的平台设计，特别适用于高压金刚石压砧等极端条件下的微小样品，为超导材料的高通量筛选和验证提供了一种可规模化方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验采用无低温制冷的光泵浦原子磁力计（cryogen-free optically pumped atomic magnetometer），对超导体中剩余超电流产生的温度依赖磁场进行非接触式探测。该技术利用环境地磁场在超导体中感应超电流，并借助铁氧体磁通导引器（ferrite flux guide）实现厘米级距离的灵敏探测。

papers.title: IDMate: Finite-temperature error bounds for window-resolved self-consistent-field screening
papers.abstract: We formulate a finite-temperature residual test in IDMate that bounds window-resolved electronic errors without a spectral-gap assumption. For a fixed Hamiltonian and exact electron number, strong convexity of the matrix Fermi entropy bounds the density-matrix distance and free-energy error within a selected window. The bound remains finite at spectral crossings and extends to weighted k points with a shared chemical potential. We also derive a distance correction for particle-number mismatch. Across $3{,}586$ stress trials in $70$ seeded perturbation ladders, $1{,}942$ proposals satisfy the screen with no observed violation of the $0.05$ window-distance criterion plus its numerical allowance. This criterion differs from the uncorrected exact-trace bound, which six of ten historical in-loop candidates exceed at the numerical-error scale. An accept-or-recover loop replaces ten reference-map evaluations while meeting terminal comparison criteria in three configurations that include oracle-subspace controls. Additional candidates built only from preceding-iteration orbitals yield two acceptances and one abstention. The silicon candidate has a window distance of $1.891\times10^{-13}$ but a normalized real-space density error of $3.754\%$. Analytic examples separate errors from complement occupations and interblock coupling. Window-level accuracy therefore does not imply full-state accuracy; the screen tests compressed proposal quality, independently of nonlinear SCF convergence or net acceleration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学不等式推导、误差界、算法流程（accept-or-recover loop）与数值测试，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：凝聚态电子结构计算中的自洽场（SCF）筛选问题，具体为IDMate方法中窗口分辨（window-resolved）的电子密度矩阵与自由能误差控制，不针对特定材料，但包含硅（silicon）候选体系的数值算例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无谱隙假设下，利用矩阵费米熵的强凸性可给出窗口内密度矩阵距离与自由能误差的有限上界；窗口级精度（如硅候选的窗口距离1.891×10⁻¹³）并不保证全态精度（其归一化实空间密度误差达3.754%），即窗口筛选只检验压缩提议质量，与非线性SCF收敛或净加速无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无谱隙假设下，利用矩阵费米熵的强凸性可给出窗口内密度矩阵距离与自由能误差的有限上界；窗口级精度（如硅候选的窗口距离1.891×10⁻¹³）并不保证全态精度（其归一化实空间密度误差达3.754%），即窗口筛选只检验压缩提议质量，与非线性SCF收敛或净加速无关。；创新点：首次在无谱隙假设下为窗口分辨SCF筛选建立有限温度误差界，该界在谱交叉处仍保持有限；明确区分了窗口级误差与全态误差，指出传统未修正的精确迹界在数值误差尺度上会被历史候选超出（十个历史候选中有六个），而新准则在测试中无违反0.05窗口距离判据（含数值容差）的记录。摘要未突出说明与其他SCF加速方法的直接对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合数值测试：推导有限温度残差检验的误差界（基于矩阵费米熵强凸性、固定哈密顿量与精确电子数条件）；处理权重k点与共享化学势情形；给出粒子数失配的距离修正。数值上进行了3,586次应力试验（70条种子微扰阶梯），并采用accept-or-recover循环替代十次参考映射评估，包含oracle子空间控制与仅用前次迭代轨道的候选构建。

papers.title: Valley polarization dependence of candidate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in monolayer graphene
papers.abstract: We investigate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states in monolayer graphene, focusing on the experimentally observed filling fractions $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Owing to the approximate SU(4) symmetry arising from spin and valley degrees of freedom, graphene hosts a rich variety of multi-component fractional quantum Hall states with different polarization configurations. Using the Chern-Simons composite fermion framework for SU(4) systems, we construct candidate variational wave functions corresponding to distinct spin, valley, and mixed polarization states. The ground-state energies of these states are evaluated numerically using the Coulomb interaction in spherical geometry. By comparing energies across different polarization sectors, we identify the energetically favored configurations at $ν= 1/2$ and $ν= 1/4$. Our variational energy comparison suggests that the energetically favored candidate states correspond to multi-component correlated quantum Hall liquids. Within the restricted family of trial states considered here, these states differ from a simple composite-fermion Fermi-sea description. These findings provide insight into the role of valley polarization and SU(4) symmetry in stabilizing even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：使用Chern-Simons复合费米子框架构建变分波函数，并进行数值能量计算。；研究对象：单层石墨烯中的偶分母分数量子霍尔态，具体聚焦于实验观测到的填充因子ν=1/2和ν=1/4，以及自旋与谷自由度导致的SU(4)对称性对多分量量子霍尔态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν=1/2和ν=1/4处，能量上有利的候选态对应于多分量关联量子霍尔液体；在所考虑的受限试探波函数族内，这些态不同于简单的复合费米子费米海描述，表明谷极化在稳定偶分母分数量子霍尔态中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν=1/2和ν=1/4处，能量上有利的候选态对应于多分量关联量子霍尔液体；在所考虑的受限试探波函数族内，这些态不同于简单的复合费米子费米海描述，表明谷极化在稳定偶分母分数量子霍尔态中起关键作用。；创新点：系统比较了不同自旋/谷极化构型下ν=1/2和ν=1/4候选态的变分能量，明确了谷极化与SU(4)对称性在稳定这些偶分母态中的具体作用，并指出其偏离简单复合费米子费米海描述的本质。
papers.method_zh: 采用SU(4)系统的Chern-Simons复合费米子理论框架，构造对应不同自旋、谷及混合极化构型的候选变分波函数；在球面几何下利用库仑相互作用数值评估各态基态能量，并通过跨极化扇区的能量比较确定能量有利构型。

papers.title: Battery open-circuit voltage is not purely chemical
papers.abstract: Open-circuit-voltage (OCV) curves are commonly treated as intrinsic chemical properties of electrode materials. However, this view is incomplete. In ion-insertion batteries, OCV also depends on mechanical state and microstructure. Using finite-element simulations and asymptotic analysis, we show that particle swelling and external loads promote particle--particle contact that generates compressive stresses, shifting the inserted-ion chemical potential. The OCV correction is nonlinear, follows Hertzian contact scaling, and depends on particle arrangement. Identical materials can therefore exhibit different OCV curves in different electrode microstructures. Furthermore, in full cells, electrodes are mechanically coupled through the common stack stress. Thus, cell OCV is a chemo-mechanical property of the entire battery architecture, not chemistry alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及使用了“有限元模拟”（finite-element simulations）和“渐近分析”（asymptotic analysis）。；研究对象：离子嵌入型电池（ion-insertion batteries）中的电极材料。具体研究其开路电压（OCV）与力学状态（颗粒溶胀、外部载荷）及微观结构（颗粒排列）之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电池的开路电压并非纯粹的电化学属性，而是依赖于电极的力学状态和微观结构。颗粒间的接触应力会改变嵌入离子的化学势，导致OCV产生非线性修正，因此相同材料在不同电极微结构或全电池堆叠应力下会表现出不同的OCV曲线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电池的开路电压并非纯粹的电化学属性，而是依赖于电极的力学状态和微观结构。颗粒间的接触应力会改变嵌入离子的化学势，导致OCV产生非线性修正，因此相同材料在不同电极微结构或全电池堆叠应力下会表现出不同的OCV曲线。；创新点：该工作突破了将OCV视为材料固有化学性质的常规观点，首次系统性地揭示了OCV作为整个电池架构的“化学-力学”耦合属性，并指出电极间的机械耦合（通过共同堆叠应力）会影响全电池的OCV。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元模拟（finite-element simulations）和渐近分析（asymptotic analysis）方法，对颗粒溶胀和外部载荷引起的颗粒间接触行为及其对离子化学势的影响进行了建模与理论推导。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate for Oxygen Vacancy Dynamics in epitaxial $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$ on Si memristors via Dynamic Spectral Optimization
papers.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for modeling semiconductor devices, yet standard architectures struggle with severe numerical stiffness and multiscale spatial discrepancies inherent to oxide heterostructures. Here, we demonstrate a cascaded PINN architecture coupled with a custom second-order Chebyshev second kind polynomial spectral optimizer (DSO V2 Hybrid) to model ion-electronic drift-diffusion transport in Pt/SrTiO$_3$/Si memristive heterostructures across a 20 nm STO film on a 380 $μ$m Si substrate. By isolating potential, carrier density, and vacancy transport into four sequentially trained sub-neural-networks, our model circumvents condition numbers exceeding $10^{16}$ without operator splitting. The trained surrogate reproduces experimental conductive-AFM current-voltage hysteresis ($R^2 > 0.96$) while ensuring strict Poisson consistency across continuous space. Compared to conventional finite-element solvers (e.g., COMSOL), the PINN surrogate enables differentiable inverse parameter estimation and linear time inference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)、modeling、simulation、surrogate。；研究对象：外延 Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的氧空位动力学与离子-电子漂移-扩散输运现象，具体为 20 nm SrTiO₃ 薄膜生长于 380 μm Si 衬底上的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用级联 PINN 架构配合自定义 Chebyshev 谱优化器，可有效模拟 Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子输运，绕过条件数超过 10¹⁶ 的数值刚性难题，且复现实验导电 AFM 电流-电压滞回曲线的 R² > 0.96，并严格满足 Poisson 方程一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用级联 PINN 架构配合自定义 Chebyshev 谱优化器，可有效模拟 Pt/SrTiO₃/Si 忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子输运，绕过条件数超过 10¹⁶ 的数值刚性难题，且复现实验导电 AFM 电流-电压滞回曲线的 R² > 0.96，并严格满足 Poisson 方程一致性。；创新点：提出级联子网络架构以规避氧化物异质结构中极端条件数（>10¹⁶）带来的数值刚性，无需算子分裂即可实现稳定训练；同时 PINN 代理模型支持可微逆参数估计与线性时间推理，优于传统有限元方法。摘要未突出说明其他方面创新。
papers.method_zh: 级联物理信息神经网络（cascaded PINN），将电势、载流子密度与氧空位输运分别交由四个顺序训练的子神经网络处理；配合自定义二阶 Chebyshev 第二类多项式谱优化器（DSO V2 Hybrid）。未使用算子分裂方法。对比基准为传统有限元求解器（如 COMSOL）。

papers.title: Constituent-Tagged Transfer Linking Cluster Dynamics to Static Scaling
papers.abstract: Clusters that merge and split have no unique genealogy. Tracking the host size of a conserved constituent defines $q_*$ by $\langle(S_{t+τ}/S_t)^{q_*}\rangle=1$, with $q_*\ne0$. Across coupled map networks, coagulation-fragmentation dynamics, and Vicsek systems, $q_*\simeqα-2$ without fitting, where $c(s)\propto s^{-α}$ on the same size window. Radius scans locate the known Vicsek interaction radius and recover an independently specified clustering scale in experimental active rods. Local scale covariance yields the relation, while a tent map counterexample shows when reducing the stationary balance at each parent size to one moment fails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“coupled map networks”“coagulation-fragmentation dynamics”“Vicsek systems”“tent map counterexample”等数值模拟与理论模型关键词，未涉及实验测量手段。；研究对象：合并与分裂的团簇体系，包括耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂动力学、Vicsek 活性粒子系统，以及实验活性杆体系中的团簇尺度标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过追踪守恒组分的宿主尺寸，定义了一个无拟合参数的标度指数 q*，发现其满足 q* ≃ α − 2，其中 α 是同一尺寸窗口内团簇尺寸分布 c(s) ∝ s^(−α) 的幂律指数。该关系在多种团簇动力学体系中普适成立，并可用于定位相互作用半径或标度尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过追踪守恒组分的宿主尺寸，定义了一个无拟合参数的标度指数 q*，发现其满足 q* ≃ α − 2，其中 α 是同一尺寸窗口内团簇尺寸分布 c(s) ∝ s^(−α) 的幂律指数。该关系在多种团簇动力学体系中普适成立，并可用于定位相互作用半径或标度尺度。；创新点：提出了一种不依赖团簇谱系（genealogy）的普适标度关系，将团簇的静态尺寸分布指数 α 与动态转移矩 q* 直接关联，且无需拟合参数；同时通过反例明确了该关系成立的条件（即静态平衡在每个母体尺寸上可约化为单一矩）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟结合：利用“组分标记转移”（constituent-tagged transfer）方法定义 q*，通过局域尺度协变性（local scale covariance）推导关系式；在耦合映射网络、凝聚-碎裂模型、Vicsek 模型及实验活性杆数据上进行验证；并用 tent map 反例检验方法的适用边界。

papers.title: Decoherence-controlled collective criticality in a two-dimensional quantum Stag Hunt
papers.abstract: Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality condition of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (\textit{EWL}) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice. For the restricted strategies $\mathsf{Q}=i\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathsf{D}=i\mathbb{Y}$, noisy two-player payoff matrices are determined for phase damping, depolarization, and amplitude damping and mapped exactly to channel dependent Ising parameters $\mathfrak{J}(Γ,p)$ and $\mathfrak{H}(Γ,p)$. Phase damping and depolarization show the clearest contrast: they share the same microscopic neutrality branch $\mathfrak{H}=0$, while only depolarization suppresses the interaction as $(1-p)^2$. At $β=1$, this produces an exact depolarization-driven square-lattice critical point at $p_{*}\approx 0.233460\ldots$, whereas phase damping remains in the ordered coexistence regime along the same neutrality branch. Monte Carlo finite size scaling is consistent with two-dimensional Ising criticality and distinguishes field driven coexistence below $p_{*}$ from a smooth crossover above it. Amplitude damping additionally reveals a strong dependence on channel placement: the post-strategy neutrality branch reaches $Γ=0$ at $p=1/3$ and then disappears. Resource negativity further shows that microscopic two-qubit entanglement and collective interaction strength are distinct quantities. The resulting extended lattice remains an ordinary classical Ising system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：mapped exactly、Monte Carlo finite size scaling、理论分析。；研究对象：二维方格上嵌入的EWL量子Stag Hunt博弈，作为独立最近邻相互作用的多体统计系统；重点研究退相干（相位阻尼、退极化、振幅阻尼）对该量子博弈对应热力学临界行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 退极化噪声可在β=1时驱动二维方格出现精确的临界点（p*≈0.233460），而相位阻尼沿同一中性分支仍保持有序共存区；振幅阻尼则强烈依赖信道位置，且微观纠缠与集体相互作用强度是两种不同物理量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：退极化噪声可在β=1时驱动二维方格出现精确的临界点（p*≈0.233460），而相位阻尼沿同一中性分支仍保持有序共存区；振幅阻尼则强烈依赖信道位置，且微观纠缠与集体相互作用强度是两种不同物理量。；创新点：首次证明物理退相干可以在保持量子博弈微观策略中性条件的同时，改变对应相互作用群体的热力学相变类型（从有序共存到临界点），并系统区分了不同退相干信道（相位阻尼vs退极化）对临界行为的截然不同影响。摘要未突出说明与以往量子博弈热力学研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 将带噪声的两体收益矩阵精确映射为依赖于信道的Ising参数𝔍(Γ,p)和𝔇(Γ,p)；采用蒙特卡洛有限尺寸标度分析验证二维Ising临界性；利用资源负性（resource negativity）量化微观两量子比特纠缠。

papers.title: FrOGS: Discrete Neural Sampler for Independent Alloy Configurations Across Chemical Conditions
papers.abstract: Predicting the thermodynamic properties of an alloy requires sampling its configurations across many chemical conditions and recovering free energies on a common absolute scale. Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is the standard tool, but it requires separate simulations at different conditions, and auxiliary free-energy methods such as thermodynamic integration are used to place results on a common absolute scale. Modern discrete neural samplers typically use reverse KL divergence as the objective and can be mode-seeking or biased. We present Free energy Offering Generative Sampler (FrOGS), a hybrid discrete neural sampler that couples an autoregressive model to a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) to be trained jointly under a single shared loss. FrOGS draws i.i.d. configurations, returns an unbiased estimate of the partition function, and gives consistent estimates of thermodynamic observables. We train a single model across a wide range of chemical conditions to produce estimates on a common absolute free-energy scale. FrOGS matches exact finite-size results on the 2D Ising model and reference phase diagrams for AgPd and CuAu, without mode collapse. We additionally compare to SEGAL, a published autoregressive baseline, and find that only FrOGS recovers the stability range of the CuAu$_3$ phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及离散神经采样器、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛、自由能估计等计算方法，无实验手段描述。；研究对象：合金体系的热力学性质，具体包括二维Ising模型、AgPd和CuAu合金（含CuAu₃相）的相图与自由能计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种混合离散神经采样器FrOGS，可在多种化学条件下训练单一模型，给出同一绝对自由能标度上的无偏配分函数估计和一致的热力学观测量，且能恢复CuAu₃相的稳定区间，而基线方法SEGAL无法做到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种混合离散神经采样器FrOGS，可在多种化学条件下训练单一模型，给出同一绝对自由能标度上的无偏配分函数估计和一致的热力学观测量，且能恢复CuAu₃相的稳定区间，而基线方法SEGAL无法做到。；创新点：FrOGS是首个将自回归模型与CTMC耦合的混合离散神经采样器，能在单一共享损失下联合训练，同时实现无偏配分函数估计和跨化学条件的绝对自由能标度统一，且避免了模式坍缩问题。相比已发表的SEGAL基线，FrOGS是唯一能恢复CuAu₃相稳定范围的方法。
papers.method_zh: 将自回归模型与连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）耦合，在单一共享损失函数下联合训练；采用逆向KL散度以外的训练目标以避免模式坍缩；通过i.i.d.采样获得配分函数的无偏估计。验证基准为二维Ising模型的精确有限尺寸结果及AgPd、CuAu的参考相图。

papers.title: A Unified Description of Dirac-Cone Anisotropies in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: Anisotropies in two-dimensional materials are responsible for a variety of effects that significantly modify their physical properties. In this paper, we present a covariant modification of the Dirac equation that incorporates anisotropies into the effective low-energy description around the Dirac point. The model is constructed by analogy with a Lorentz-violating extension of the Standard Model of elementary particles and yields a (2+1)-dimensional framework describing physical effects such as shifted, tilted, and distorted Dirac cones through its free parameters. The proposed model thus provides a general and unified framework in which distinct anisotropy-induced modifications of the Dirac spectrum and their combinations can be systematically characterized. We further apply the model to strained graphene and show that its effective parameters can be quantitatively extracted from first-principles electronic band structures while retaining a direct geometrical interpretation. These results establish a connection between the microscopic electronic structure and a material-independent effective description of anisotropic two-dimensional Dirac systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“covariant modification”“theoretical framework”“model”等关键词，属于理论建模研究。；研究对象：二维材料中围绕狄拉克点的各向异性电子结构，具体包括倾斜、平移和畸变的狄拉克锥，并以应变石墨烯作为应用实例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一个（2+1）维协变修正的狄拉克方程，通过自由参数统一描述二维狄拉克锥的各类各向异性（平移、倾斜、畸变及其组合），并证明该模型可定量提取应变石墨烯的有效参数，建立微观电子结构与材料无关的有效描述之间的联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一个（2+1）维协变修正的狄拉克方程，通过自由参数统一描述二维狄拉克锥的各类各向异性（平移、倾斜、畸变及其组合），并证明该模型可定量提取应变石墨烯的有效参数，建立微观电子结构与材料无关的有效描述之间的联系。；创新点：首次将洛伦兹破缺扩展的形式体系系统引入二维狄拉克锥各向异性的统一描述，提供了一个可同时表征多种各向异性效应及其组合的普适框架，并实现了与第一性原理计算的定量对接。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：类比粒子物理标准模型的洛伦兹对称性破缺扩展，构造协变形式的狄拉克方程修正；结合第一性原理电子能带结构计算，定量提取模型有效参数。

papers.title: Dipolar order across Bravais lattice space: classification, spin waves, and a four-attractor phase diagram
papers.abstract: Every crystal is a Bravais lattice decorated by a basis, so the dipolar ordering of the fourteen Bravais lattices is the natural starting point for any systematic theory of dipolar magnetism in three dimensions. We determine it here in a single common framework: the interaction tensor is Ewald-summed, the classical ground state is obtained by minimising the lowest Luttinger--Tisza band over the entire Brillouin zone, and the linear spin-wave spectrum with its zero-point corrections is computed for every lattice whose order is collinear. Three results emerge that are not properties of individual lattices but of the landscape. First, two structural principles --- the exact tracelessness of the dipolar tensor in three dimensions, and its identical vanishing at $\mathbf k=0$ for every cubic-symmetric lattice --- explain the ordering type, the absence of first-order cubic anisotropy, and the systematics of the zero-point moment reduction. Second, exactly one lattice defeats the Luttinger--Tisza construction: for face-centred orthorhombic the optimal eigenvector is not circular, the single-$\mathbf k$ state is a spin-density wave of non-constant length, and the tabulated energy is a strict lower bound; direct supercell minimisation gives the true ground state. Third, optimising each family over its free metric parameters collapses the whole of Bravais space onto only \emph{four} attractors, with body-centred tetragonal the global optimum and a single interior optimum at rhombohedral $α=62.42^\circ$ lying below face-centred cubic. Three independent published benchmarks are reproduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Ewald-summed”（Ewald求和）、“Luttinger--Tisza band”（Luttinger-Tisza能带）、“linear spin-wave spectrum”（线性自旋波谱）、“supercell minimisation”（超胞最小化）等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：三维空间中十四种Bravais晶格上的偶极（dipolar）磁有序问题，即研究不同晶格几何下偶极相互作用的经典基态、自旋波谱及磁有序类型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 整个Bravais晶格空间在优化自由度量参数后仅坍缩为四个吸引子（attractors），其中体心四方（body-centred tetragonal）为全局最优，菱面体（rhombohedral）α=62.42°处存在一个低于面心立方（fcc）的单一内部最优。此外，面心正交（face-centred orthorhombic）晶格是唯一使Luttinger-Tisza构造失效的晶格，其真实基态需通过直接超胞最小化获得。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：整个Bravais晶格空间在优化自由度量参数后仅坍缩为四个吸引子（attractors），其中体心四方（body-centred tetragonal）为全局最优，菱面体（rhombohedral）α=62.42°处存在一个低于面心立方（fcc）的单一内部最优。此外，面心正交（face-centred orthorhombic）晶格是唯一使Luttinger-Tisza构造失效的晶格，其真实基态需通过直接超胞最小化获得。；创新点：首次在单一统一框架下系统分类全部十四种Bravais晶格的偶极有序；揭示两个普适结构原理（三维偶极张量的严格无迹性，以及所有立方对称晶格在k=0处张量恒为零）来解释有序类型、一阶立方各向异性缺失及零点矩缩减的系统性；发现整个Bravais空间仅存在四个吸引子的相图结构。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用统一的理论框架：对相互作用张量进行Ewald求和；通过在整个布里渊区最小化最低Luttinger-Tisza能带获得经典基态；对所有具有共线磁序的晶格计算线性自旋波谱及零点修正；对每个晶格族在自由度量参数空间进行优化以寻找吸引子；对Luttinger-Tisza失效的晶格采用直接超胞最小化。

papers.title: Classical dipolar Heisenberg models on the Archimedean and Laves lattices
papers.abstract: We study classical Heisenberg spins interacting through the dipole--dipole interaction on the eleven Archimedean and eight Laves planar lattices at canonical geometry, which reduce to fifteen distinct vertex sets. For each lattice we compute the Fourier-space interaction matrix $\Am(\bk)$, extract the Luttinger--Tisza ordering wave vector $\bk_{0}$, determine the classical ground state by unconstrained minimization on the commensurate magnetic cell, and evaluate the linearized spin-wave dispersion $\varepsilon_{i}(\bk)$ along the high-symmetry path of the (magnetic) Brillouin zone together with the Holstein--Primakoff moment reduction. The ground states fall into three classes: five are collinear, two are non-collinear at angles commensurate with the lattice symmetry, and eight cant at transcendental angles, which we determine to thirty digits. Across the family, failure of the Luttinger--Tisza strong condition coincides exactly with the appearance of incommensurate canting, with no exceptions in either direction. Truncating the interaction range shows that whether a lattice cants is fixed by the local coordination geometry, whereas the value of the canting angle is set by the long-range tail. The quantum corrections are governed by the magnon spectrum through the size of the magnetic basis and are uncorrelated with frustration, so that the frustration and fluctuation classifications are independent; the corner-sharing lattices host the narrowest low-energy branches. The results constitute a spectral atlas of dipolar Heisenberg systems on the full family of $1$-uniform planar tilings and their duals, and provide predictions for inelastic neutron scattering in materials whose magnetic ions occupy Archimedean or Laves lattices, and for artificial arrays of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“计算傅里叶空间相互作用矩阵”“通过无约束最小化确定经典基态”“评估线性化自旋波色散”等理论计算关键词。；研究对象：研究的是经典偶极海森伯自旋系统，具体体系为十一种阿基米德平面晶格和八种Laves平面晶格（共简化为十五种不同的顶点集）上的偶极相互作用经典海森伯模型，属于二维平面磁体/人工纳米磁体阵列范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有考虑的晶格中，基态分为三类：五种共线、两种非共线但角度与晶格对称性相称、八种以超越角度倾斜（计算至三十位精度）。Luttinger–Tisza强条件的失效与不可公度倾斜的出现完全一一对应，无任何例外；倾斜与否由局域配位几何决定，而倾斜角大小由长程尾部决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有考虑的晶格中，基态分为三类：五种共线、两种非共线但角度与晶格对称性相称、八种以超越角度倾斜（计算至三十位精度）。Luttinger–Tisza强条件的失效与不可公度倾斜的出现完全一一对应，无任何例外；倾斜与否由局域配位几何决定，而倾斜角大小由长程尾部决定。；创新点：首次系统性地构建了完整1-均匀平面铺砌及其对偶晶格上偶极海森伯系统的“谱图集”（spectral atlas），揭示了倾斜与否与Luttinger–Tisza强条件失效之间的严格对应关系，并指出量子修正由磁基胞大小决定而与阻挫无关，即阻挫与涨落的分类相互独立。
papers.method_zh: 采用 Luttinger–Tisza 方法提取有序波矢；在相称磁胞上进行无约束最小化确定经典基态；沿（磁）布里渊区高对称路径计算线性化自旋波色散；使用 Holstein–Primakoff 变换评估量子磁矩缩减；通过截断相互作用范围分析局域与长程贡献。

papers.title: Graphene-enabled dynamic H-J switching of dipole-dipole coupling
papers.abstract: Environmental modification of dipole interactions has long been explored in energy transport. Here we consider the effects of a tunable graphene monolayer upon nearly H-type or J-type molecular aggregates, concentrating on the inversion of one type of coupling to the other. Modelling the graphene as being deposited on a metallic substrate, we find that as the surface conductivity of the graphene is varied, there is a corresponding change in the parameter region over which coupling inversion is predicted. This provides a route towards observing the predicted coupling inversion in a real system by dynamically changing the surface conductivity during a single run of an experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“Modelling”“we find”“predicted”等表述，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：石墨烯单层调控的分子聚集体（近H型或近J型）中偶极-偶极相互作用的耦合类型反转现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当石墨烯沉积在金属衬底上时，通过调节石墨烯的表面电导率，可以改变偶极耦合从H型到J型（或反之）发生反转的参数区域，从而为在单次实验过程中动态实现耦合反转提供了可行途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当石墨烯沉积在金属衬底上时，通过调节石墨烯的表面电导率，可以改变偶极耦合从H型到J型（或反之）发生反转的参数区域，从而为在单次实验过程中动态实现耦合反转提供了可行途径。；创新点：提出利用可调石墨烯表面电导率作为动态控制手段，在真实实验的单次运行中实现H-J耦合反转的观测，而非仅停留在静态理论预测。摘要未突出说明与以往环境修饰偶极相互作用研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：将石墨烯视为沉积在金属衬底上的可调导电层，计算其表面电导率变化对分子间偶极相互作用的影响，并分析耦合反转发生的参数区域。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如量子主方程、格林函数或电磁场理论等）。

papers.title: Quantum thermalization achieves optimal approximate quantum error correction
papers.abstract: Quantum thermalization explains how an isolated many-body system naturally evolves towards a thermal state, rendering information about the initial conditions inaccessible to local measurements. This is precisely the mechanism utilized in quantum error correction, where information is protected by design through a nonlocal encoding. In this work, we leverage this connection to port the rigorous framework of (approximate) quantum error correction to the study of quantum thermalization. Treating typical late-time states as codewords, we characterize the error-correcting properties of generic thermalizing dynamics. We numerically uncover a universal relationship between the encoding rate, distance, and thermal entropy density of the emergent code. At infinite temperature, this universal curve saturates the quantum Singleton bound, achieving the same optimal limit as Haar-random codes. At finite temperature, we introduce a code family based on the Scrooge ensemble, the natural thermal analogue of the Haar ensemble, and prove it saturates the entropic quantum Singleton bound, establishing this family as optimal within entropic constraints. Our extracted universal curve independently saturates this same bound, revealing that finite-temperature thermalization is itself optimal. Finally, we show how conserved quantities limit the error-correcting behavior of thermalization: codewords with differing energies, or other conserved charges, leak only classical information, and correctability persists until the difference reaches the scale of thermal fluctuations. Our results reveal a universal optimal coding structure in thermalizing dynamics, while introducing new optimal codes that achieve fundamental limits of approximate quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“rigorous framework”“prove”“numerically uncover”等表述，属于理论分析与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：量子多体系统的热化动力学与近似量子纠错码之间的对应关系，具体涉及无限温度与有限温度下的热化过程、Scrooge系综编码，以及守恒量对纠错行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 典型热化动力学在晚期态上自然形成一种近似量子纠错码，其编码率、距离与热熵密度之间存在普适关系；该关系在无限温度下饱和量子Singleton界，在有限温度下也饱和熵量子Singleton界，表明热化本身即达到最优纠错极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：典型热化动力学在晚期态上自然形成一种近似量子纠错码，其编码率、距离与热熵密度之间存在普适关系；该关系在无限温度下饱和量子Singleton界，在有限温度下也饱和熵量子Singleton界，表明热化本身即达到最优纠错极限。；创新点：首次将近似量子纠错的严格框架系统移植到量子热化研究中，揭示热化动力学本身具有最优编码结构；引入Scrooge系综作为有限温度下的最优码族，并证明其达到熵约束下的基本极限；同时阐明了守恒量（如能量）如何限制热化纠错能力——不同守恒荷的码字仅泄漏经典信息，纠错能力持续到热涨落尺度。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架上借用（近似）量子纠错的形式化工具来分析热化；数值上通过模拟典型热化动力学提取编码率-距离-熵密度的普适曲线；解析上引入基于Scrooge系综（热化版本的Haar系综）的码族，并证明其满足熵量子Singleton界。

papers.title: Non-Abelian string melting and thermalization in an open lattice gauge theory
papers.abstract: Open-system lattice gauge theory (LGT) has so far been developed predominantly in Abelian settings, leaving open how genuinely non-Abelian gauge structure reshapes dissipative real-time dynamics. Here, we study a $1+1$D SU(2) Yang--Mills LGT with dynamical matter coupled to a thermal scalar environment through a gauge-preserving Lindblad evolution, which we solve using tensor networks. Starting from a quark--antiquark pair connected by a chromoelectric flux string, we find that the thermal medium melts the string by delocalizing the color charges and screening the flux; on resonance, this dissipative melting competes with and delays coherent string breaking. The thermalization time is non-monotonic in the environment coupling, decreasing through environment-assisted transport at weak dissipation before increasing in a quantum-Zeno regime. In the strong-dephasing limit, a Schrieffer--Wolff expansion maps the dynamics to a classical exclusion process and yields the Liouvillian thermalization time analytically. Beyond these generic open-system effects, the non-Abelian matter structure produces a systematic mesonic bias in the steady state, while the thermalization time decreases with temperature, in contrast to the Abelian Schwinger model trend and in qualitative agreement with pNRQCD studies of the quark--gluon plasma. These results establish a gauge-preserving framework for thermalization and string dynamics in open non-Abelian lattice gauge theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Lindblad evolution、tensor networks、Schrieffer–Wolff expansion、analytically。；研究对象：1+1维 SU(2) Yang–Mills 晶格规范理论（非阿贝尔开放量子系统），包含动态物质场，并与热标量环境耦合。物理现象为色通量弦的耗散熔化、热化及非平衡实时动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热环境通过色荷离域和通量屏蔽使通量弦熔化；在共振条件下，耗散熔化与相干弦断裂竞争并延缓后者。热化时间随环境耦合呈非单调变化（弱耗散区先减小，量子芝诺区后增大），且随温度升高而减小——与阿贝尔 Schwinger 模型的趋势相反，但与 pNRQCD 对夸克-胶子等离子体的研究定性一致。稳态中非阿贝尔物质结构产生系统的介子偏向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热环境通过色荷离域和通量屏蔽使通量弦熔化；在共振条件下，耗散熔化与相干弦断裂竞争并延缓后者。热化时间随环境耦合呈非单调变化（弱耗散区先减小，量子芝诺区后增大），且随温度升高而减小——与阿贝尔 Schwinger 模型的趋势相反，但与 pNRQCD 对夸克-胶子等离子体的研究定性一致。稳态中非阿贝尔物质结构产生系统的介子偏向。；创新点：首次在非阿贝尔（SU(2)）开放晶格规范理论中建立规范保持的耗散热化与弦动力学框架，揭示了非阿贝尔规范结构对耗散实时动力学的独特重塑作用（如介子偏向、温度依赖趋势与阿贝尔模型的差异）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用规范保持的 Lindblad 主方程描述开放系统演化，用张量网络（tensor networks）数值求解；在强退相极限下使用 Schrieffer–Wolff 展开将动力学映射为经典排斥过程，并解析求得 Liouvillian 热化时间。

papers.title: Real-Time String Dynamics in $3+1$D Lattice Quantum Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Understanding real-time string dynamics in three spatial dimensions is essential for connecting quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories (LGTs) to the physical dimensionality of QED and QCD, where transverse fluctuations and competing local processes proliferate. We present the first real-time simulations of string breaking in $3+1$D lattice quantum electrodynamics. Using tree tensor networks, we simulate the quench dynamics of electric flux strings in a $3\!+\!1$D U(1) LGT with dynamical matter. At strong coupling, the string breaks resonantly at a sharp resonance condition of mass and gauge couplings, converting electric energy into matter--antimatter pairs that screen the static charges. Off resonance, we classify all competing channels---pair production, string deformations and extensions, and flux loops---whose multiplicity, extensive for pair production and flux loops, depletes the string sector even far from resonance. A channel-resolved perturbation theory quantitatively reproduces these dynamics and their Fourier spectrum. Our results establish diagnostics and benchmarks for upcoming quantum simulators of higher-dimensional LGTs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用树张量网络进行实时模拟”，属于数值计算方法。；研究对象：3+1维（三维空间+一维时间）格点量子电动力学（U(1) LGT）中的电通量弦（electric flux string）及其断裂动力学，包含动态物质场（dynamical matter）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合条件下，弦在质量与规范耦合满足尖锐共振条件时发生共振断裂，将电能转化为屏蔽静态电荷的物质—反物质对；远离共振时，多种竞争通道（粒子对产生、弦形变与延伸、磁通环）会耗尽弦扇区，即使远离共振也不例外。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合条件下，弦在质量与规范耦合满足尖锐共振条件时发生共振断裂，将电能转化为屏蔽静态电荷的物质—反物质对；远离共振时，多种竞争通道（粒子对产生、弦形变与延伸、磁通环）会耗尽弦扇区，即使远离共振也不例外。；创新点：首次在3+1维格点QED中实现弦断裂的实时模拟，此前相关工作多限于低维（如1+1D或2+1D）；建立了面向高维格点规范理论量子模拟器的诊断工具与基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 树张量网络（tree tensor networks）实时模拟；通道分辨的微扰理论（channel-resolved perturbation theory）用于定量复现动力学及其傅里叶谱。

papers.title: A simple derivation of the zero-temperature BCS functional from the reduced BCS Hamiltonian
papers.abstract: We consider a grand-canonical reduced BCS Hamiltonian on the full fermionic Fock space with an attractive pairing interaction supported in an energy shell around the Fermi surface. For fixed chemical potential, we prove that the exact finite-volume ground-state energy differs from the minimum of the corresponding finite-volume BCS functional by a volume-independent error. As a consequence, the BCS variational principle is exact for the ground-state energy density in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”“exact”“functional”“thermodynamic limit”等数学严格证明与理论分析关键词。；研究对象：约化BCS哈密顿量（reduced BCS Hamiltonian）描述的超导配对体系，具体为费米面附近能量壳层内具有吸引配对相互作用的费米子系统，研究其基态能量与BCS泛函的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在固定化学势下，有限体积的精确基态能量与相应有限体积BCS泛函的最小值之差为与体积无关的常数误差；因此，在热力学极限下，BCS变分原理对基态能量密度是精确的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在固定化学势下，有限体积的精确基态能量与相应有限体积BCS泛函的最小值之差为与体积无关的常数误差；因此，在热力学极限下，BCS变分原理对基态能量密度是精确的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用全费米子Fock空间上的巨正则系综约化BCS哈密顿量，通过数学严格证明（估计有限体积基态能量与BCS泛函极小值之间的误差界）来建立结论，属于解析理论推导。

papers.title: Cutting corners: exciting and magical bounds from the cusp bootstrap
papers.abstract: An illuminating probe of the dynamics of a line defect is the global geometry of its worldline. For a conformal line defect in a conformal field theory, sharp corners in the worldline, i.e. cusps, host dynamical degrees of freedom characterized in part by a spectrum of scaling dimensions, called cusp anomalous dimensions. We present various general bounds on cusp anomalous dimensions following from unitarity and cutting-and-gluing consistency of different defect geometries. We first establish, for cusps involving conjugate defects, that level crossings upon varying the cusp angle are forbidden between the lightest singlet cusp and any non-singlet cusp, proving that singlet cusps are the lightest. Then, we study line defects arranged in a rectangular geometry, which are subject to bootstrap constraints reminiscent of the spinless modular bootstrap. We find an analytic ``magic" functional that produces an optimal and universal lower bound on the dimension of a right angle bare cusp in terms of the universal defect Casimir energy between the corresponding defect and its conjugate in flat space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：bootstrap、unitarity、cutting-and-gluing consistency、analytic functional。；研究对象：共形场论（CFT）中的共形线缺陷，特别是其世界线上的尖角（cusp）所承载的动力学自由度，以及由尖角反常维度（cusp anomalous dimensions）刻画的谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了在共轭缺陷构成的尖角中，最轻的单态尖角与任何非单态尖角之间在改变尖角角度时禁止能级交叉，从而单态尖角始终是最轻的；并利用“魔法”泛函给出了直角裸尖角维数的最优普适下界，该下界由对应缺陷与其共轭在平直空间中的普适缺陷Casimir能量决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了在共轭缺陷构成的尖角中，最轻的单态尖角与任何非单态尖角之间在改变尖角角度时禁止能级交叉，从而单态尖角始终是最轻的；并利用“魔法”泛函给出了直角裸尖角维数的最优普适下界，该下界由对应缺陷与其共轭在平直空间中的普适缺陷Casimir能量决定。；创新点：首次在尖角bootstrap框架下严格证明单态尖角为最轻，并引入解析“魔法”泛函将直角裸尖角维度与缺陷Casimir能量建立普适定量联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用共形bootstrap方法，结合unitarity约束与不同缺陷几何构型的cutting-and-gluing一致性条件；对矩形排列的线缺陷施加类似于无自旋模bootstrap的约束，并构造解析的“魔法”泛函（magic functional）来推导最优下界。

papers.title: Discrete time crystals in disordered anisotropic Heisenberg chains
papers.abstract: A discrete time crystal is an out-of-equilibrium phase of matter characterized by the spontaneous breaking of discrete time-translation symmetry. Using extensive numerical simulations based on matrix-product-state methods, we provide evidence for discrete time-crystalline behavior in strongly disordered spin chains with Heisenberg interactions, including the isotropic point, subject to periodic driving. Starting from a many-body localized regime, we observe that rotations induced by delta kicks produce a pronounced subharmonic response at half the drive frequency in spin observables. We investigate the stability of this response against rotation-angle errors through entanglement entropy, quantum Fisher information, short-range spin correlations, and restricted-control ergotropy. Increasing the rotation error reveals an intermediate dynamical regime separating the time-crystalline and Floquet-localized responses. In this regime, most observables exhibit signatures of weakly correlated dynamics reminiscent of Anderson localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“extensive numerical simulations based on matrix-product-state methods”（基于矩阵乘积态的大规模数值模拟）。；研究对象：强无序海森堡自旋链（含各向同性点）在周期性驱动下的离散时间晶体（discrete time crystal）行为，属于非平衡量子多体物态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强无序海森堡自旋链中，δ-kick旋转驱动可在多体局域化（MBL）背景下产生半频次谐波响应，即离散时间晶体行为；增大旋转角误差后，系统进入一个介于时间晶体与Floquet局域化之间的中间动力学区域，该区域表现出类似Anderson局域化的弱关联动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强无序海森堡自旋链中，δ-kick旋转驱动可在多体局域化（MBL）背景下产生半频次谐波响应，即离散时间晶体行为；增大旋转角误差后，系统进入一个介于时间晶体与Floquet局域化之间的中间动力学区域，该区域表现出类似Anderson局域化的弱关联动力学特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断：该工作将离散时间晶体的研究拓展到强无序海森堡各向异性链（包括各向同性点），并系统刻画了旋转误差增大时从时间晶体到Floquet局域化的中间过渡区域的动力学特征。
papers.method_zh: 矩阵乘积态（MPS）方法的大规模数值模拟，具体涉及：纠缠熵、量子Fisher信息、短程自旋关联、受限控制ergotropy（restricted-control ergotropy）等可观测量分析。

papers.title: Cusped Defects: Cusp Operator Expansion, Conformal Properties and Bootstrap Applications
papers.abstract: We analyze general properties of cusped defect lines embedded in generic conformal field theories (CFTs). We prove that suitably defined cusp scaling operators transform like primary operators under general conformal transformations. We show that, via the cusp operator expansion (COE), defects of general shape can be expanded in a basis of cusped defects. These findings are checked and exemplified in the case of the localized magnetic field defect. Finally, we derive analytic constraints on dynamical cusp data by making use of a crossing equation, and discuss possible numerical bootstrap applications of our results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“conformal field theories (CFTs)”、“operator expansion”、“crossing equation”、“bootstrap”等理论物理关键词，且无实验或数值计算描述。；研究对象：嵌入一般共形场论（CFT）中的带尖角缺陷线（cusped defect lines），以及由尖角缺陷定义的标度算符（cusp scaling operators）和缺陷算符展开（COE）。具体实例为局域磁场缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了适当定义的尖角标度算符在一般共形变换下具有初级算符（primary operator）的变换性质；并表明任意形状的缺陷可通过尖角缺陷算符展开（COE）在尖角缺陷基中展开。此外，利用穿越方程推导了动力学尖角数据的解析约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了适当定义的尖角标度算符在一般共形变换下具有初级算符（primary operator）的变换性质；并表明任意形状的缺陷可通过尖角缺陷算符展开（COE）在尖角缺陷基中展开。此外，利用穿越方程推导了动力学尖角数据的解析约束。；创新点：首次系统建立了尖角缺陷的共形算符展开（COE）框架，并证明尖角标度算符具有初级算符性质，从而将任意形状缺陷的展开问题归结为尖角基的共形数据；同时给出了穿越方程对尖角数据的解析约束，为数值自举提供了新方向。摘要未突出说明与已有缺陷OPE研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为共形场论中的缺陷算符形式体系。具体包括：证明尖角标度算符的共形协变性质；建立尖角缺陷算符展开（COE）；以局域磁场缺陷为例进行验证；通过穿越方程（crossing equation）推导解析约束，并讨论数值共形自举（bootstrap）应用的可能性。

papers.title: Spin-to-polarization mapping with a coherent quantum dot-cavity receiver
papers.abstract: Coherent light-matter interfaces controllably modifying the state of a photon upon interaction with a stationary qubit are a key resource for implementing deterministic entangling gates for optical quantum technologies. This requires a one-to-one mapping between the state of the scattered photon and that of the embedded qubit. Here, we present an experimental signature of such a bijection by leveraging the spin-induced Kerr rotation present in a low-noise charged quantum dot-micropillar cavity device. Through time-resolved polarization measurements, we project the electron spin to one of its eigenstates with $95\pm2\%$ fidelity with a single reflected photon detection, and follow the subsequent spin relaxation through the detection of a second reflected photon. We demonstrate that, after a transient regime governed by the trion radiative lifetime, two orthogonal polarization states can be produced, each associated to a given spin eigenstate. While the current results are limited by a timescale competition between electron spin relaxation and trion radiative lifetime, they could be improved using hole spins displaying increased relaxation times. Our work paves the way towards deterministic logic gates exploiting this one-to-one mapping between a spin and the polarization of a scattered photon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here, we present an experimental signature...”，并描述了具体的测量手段（“time-resolved polarization measurements”）和实验器件（“charged quantum dot-micropillar cavity device”）。；研究对象：一种低噪声的带电量子点-微柱微腔器件。具体物理现象是：电子自旋与反射光子偏振态之间的一一映射关系（即自旋诱导的Kerr旋转效应），以及电子自旋弛豫与trion辐射寿命之间的动力学竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实了单个反射光子探测可将电子自旋投影到其本征态，保真度为95±2%；并证明在trion辐射寿命决定的瞬态过程之后，两个正交的偏振态可以分别对应两个自旋本征态，实现了自旋到光子偏振的双射映射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实了单个反射光子探测可将电子自旋投影到其本征态，保真度为95±2%；并证明在trion辐射寿命决定的瞬态过程之后，两个正交的偏振态可以分别对应两个自旋本征态，实现了自旋到光子偏振的双射映射。；创新点：首次在实验上展示了基于单个带电量子点-微腔器件中自旋与散射光子偏振态之间的一一对应（双射）关系，并给出了定量保真度。摘要未突出说明该工作与已有自旋-光子接口研究相比在器件设计或物理机制上的其他独特新意。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段为时间分辨的偏振光学测量。具体而言，利用带电量子点-微柱腔中的自旋诱导Kerr旋转，通过探测单个反射光子来投影电子自旋态，并通过探测第二个反射光子来跟踪随后的自旋弛豫过程。

papers.title: The conductivity matrix at the topological phase transition
papers.abstract: For a general class of two-dimensional non-interacting semi-metallic electron systems on a lattice, we derive an explicit formula for the whole conductivity matrix, by using Euclidean many-body formalism. The semi-metallic phase takes place whenever two Bloch bands touch at the Fermi energy with conical intersections and generally occurs at the transition between distinct integer quantum Hall phases. Unlike the longitudinal conductivity (which depends solely on the shape of the cones at the Fermi level), the transverse conductivity is remarkably determined both by the conical structures of the bands and by the nature of the two nearby topological phases. Generically, in the semi-metallic state, neither the longitudinal nor the transverse conductivities are quantized in integer multiples of a universal conductivity quantum; however, universality of the conductivity matrix is restored under the assumption of emergent rotational symmetry of the linearized Hamiltonian at the Fermi points. Using our formula, we compute the conductivity matrix for several physically relevant models of quantum Hall fluids at the topological phase transition, exhibiting cases where the transverse conductivity is quantized in half-integer multiples of $e^2/h$ and cases where it depends continuously on an external strain parameter, thus shedding light on its universality or non-universality features.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：derive an explicit formula、Euclidean many-body formalism、non-interacting semi-metallic electron systems。；研究对象：二维无相互作用半金属电子晶格系统，特别是拓扑相变点（两个布洛赫带在费米能处锥形相交）处的电导率矩阵行为，以及量子霍尔流体在拓扑相变处的输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出半金属态下完整电导率矩阵的显式公式，发现纵向电导率仅取决于费米能处锥形结构，而横向电导率同时由锥形结构和邻近两个拓扑相的性质决定；在一般半金属态中电导率不量子化，但在费米点处线性化哈密顿量具有涌现旋转对称性时，电导率矩阵恢复普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出半金属态下完整电导率矩阵的显式公式，发现纵向电导率仅取决于费米能处锥形结构，而横向电导率同时由锥形结构和邻近两个拓扑相的性质决定；在一般半金属态中电导率不量子化，但在费米点处线性化哈密顿量具有涌现旋转对称性时，电导率矩阵恢复普适性。；创新点：首次给出了拓扑相变点处完整电导率矩阵（而非仅纵向或仅横向分量）的通用解析公式，并系统揭示了横向电导率在相变点的量子化行为——既存在半整数倍e²/h量子化的情形，也存在连续依赖外部应变参数的非普适情形，阐明了其普适性与非普适性特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用欧几里得多体形式体系（Euclidean many-body formalism），对一般类二维无相互作用晶格半金属电子系统进行解析推导，得到完整电导率矩阵的显式表达式，并应用于多个量子霍尔流体拓扑相变模型进行计算。

papers.title: Fractalizing spacetime: Floquet codes with fractonic excitations that are immobile in space and time
papers.abstract: We generalize fractalization, a procedure for the construction of fracton models, from space to spacetime. We apply spacetime fractalization to construct fracton floquet codes with syndrome excitations that have limited mobility in space and time. This extends the notion of fracton order to intrinsically dynamical quantum phases of matter that are inequivalent to static fracton phases. We find spacetime type-II fracton floquet codes which have no topological excitations that are mobile in space or time. These codes exhibit an extreme form of quantum discrete time crystal order with response periods that scale exponentially in their linear system sizes. In this context, the no-strings rule that characterizes type-II fractons leads to a superlinear scaling of the floquet code fault-distance with time, potentially lowering the time overhead required for quantum error correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“generalize fractalization”“construct fracton floquet codes”等理论构造性描述，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：分形（fracton）激发体系中的Floquet码，具体为具有空间和时间双重受限激发（syndrome excitations）的量子纠错码，以及与之相关的离散时间晶体（discrete time crystal）量子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将“fractalization”从空间推广到时空，构造出具有时空双重不可移动激发的type-II fracton Floquet码，其响应周期随系统尺寸呈指数增长，且码的容错距离随时间呈超线性增长，可降低量子纠错的时间开销。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将“fractalization”从空间推广到时空，构造出具有时空双重不可移动激发的type-II fracton Floquet码，其响应周期随系统尺寸呈指数增长，且码的容错距离随时间呈超线性增长，可降低量子纠错的时间开销。；创新点：首次将fracton序的概念扩展到本质上动态的量子物相，证明存在与静态fracton相不等价的动力学fracton相；并发现type-II fracton的“无弦规则”可带来Floquet码容错距离的超线性时间增长，从而降低纠错时间开销。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为“spacetime fractalization”——一种将静态fracton模型的构造过程推广到时空维度的形式化方法，用于设计具有受限激发迁移率的Floquet码。

papers.title: Modeling Tissue Detachment and Rupture Using an Extended Vertex Model with T2-inverse Transitions
papers.abstract: The vertex model is widely used to describe the mechanics of epithelial tissues, but its conventional formulation assumes that all cells remain tightly packed and always share edges with their neighbors, making it difficult to represent local detachment or gap formation. Here, we propose a minimal extension of the vertex model that enables cell detachment by introducing a new topological transformation, T2-inverse, which acts as the inverse of the classical T2 transition. When the imbalance of forces acting on a vertex, quantified by a tension metric $T$, exceeds a threshold, the T2-inverse splits the vertex into multiple vertices and creates a closed polygon that is incorporated as a pseudo-cell. This operation allows the model to represent the emergence and propagation of local detachment events. Using this framework, we simulate the stretching of a cell sheet and show that force-induced local detachments can accumulate to produce macroscopic tissue rupture. These results demonstrate that the proposed model extends the capability of the vertex model to describe tissue-level breakdown processes, including detachment and tearing, and provides a foundation for studying a broader class of epithelial mechanical phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“vertex model”“simulate”“topological transformation”等建模与模拟关键词。；研究对象：上皮组织的力学行为，具体为细胞片层在拉伸过程中的局部脱离（detachment）与宏观撕裂（rupture）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在顶点模型中引入T2-inverse拓扑变换，使细胞能够脱离并形成间隙（伪细胞），模拟显示力诱导的局部脱离事件可累积并导致组织宏观破裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在顶点模型中引入T2-inverse拓扑变换，使细胞能够脱离并形成间隙（伪细胞），模拟显示力诱导的局部脱离事件可累积并导致组织宏观破裂。；创新点：突破了传统顶点模型中细胞始终紧密排列、共享边的限制，首次通过T2-inverse变换在顶点模型框架内显式描述细胞脱离与间隙形成，从而将顶点模型的应用范围扩展到组织层面的破坏过程（如撕裂）。
papers.method_zh: 扩展的顶点模型（Extended Vertex Model），引入新的拓扑变换T2-inverse（经典T2变换的逆过程），以张力度量T作为判定阈值，将顶点分裂为多个顶点并形成闭合多边形（伪细胞），用于模拟细胞片的单轴拉伸过程。

papers.title: BU-MBAR: A hybrid solution strategy for the MBAR equations
papers.abstract: The multi-state Bennett acceptance ratio (MBAR) equations combine the data collected under different thermodynamic conditions in a statistically optimal way. Due to their practical importance, several solution strategies have been devised to optimize the convergence of the resulting set of coupled equations. However, even with graphics processing unit (GPU) acceleration, the convergence of these methods can still be either unstable or slow. We propose a new approach where the equations are interpreted as the limit of infinitesimal bin width of the respective weighted histogram analysis method (WHAM). In the proposed binned-to-unbinned MBAR (BU-MBAR) method, the bin width is adapted dynamically to ensure a stable and efficient convergence to the asymptotic solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于求解MBAR方程的数值算法，属于计算物理方法研究。；研究对象：多态Bennett接受比（MBAR）方程——一种用于统计最优地合并不同热力学条件下采集数据的自由能计算方法，属于统计力学/自由能计算领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种将MBAR方程视为加权直方图分析法（WHAM）在无穷小bin宽度极限下的新解释，并据此发展出BU-MBAR方法，通过动态自适应调整bin宽度，实现稳定且高效的收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种将MBAR方程视为加权直方图分析法（WHAM）在无穷小bin宽度极限下的新解释，并据此发展出BU-MBAR方法，通过动态自适应调整bin宽度，实现稳定且高效的收敛。；创新点：不同于现有依赖GPU加速但仍可能不稳定或收敛慢的求解策略，BU-MBAR通过动态调整bin宽度这一全新途径，在保证收敛稳定性的同时提升效率。摘要未突出说明与传统方法在具体数值性能上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值算法设计：将MBAR方程重新表述为WHAM的连续极限，并引入动态bin宽度策略（binned-to-unbinned）来求解耦合方程组。摘要未提及具体测试体系或基准算例。

papers.title: Internal geometries regulate the symmetry of defect configurations in cell populations confined to domains with a negative Euler characteristic
papers.abstract: Nematic order of confined cell populations plays an important role in determining cell alignment and stable configurations of topological defects, which are related to various biomechanical phenomena. Topological charges (or winding numbers) of topological defects strictly depend on the Euler characteristic of the confining domain, which has typically been non-negative in studies focused on domains without internal obstacles. However, biological tissues often surround two or more internal obstacles or holes, which inherently generate defects with negative charges. To understand the mechanical interaction between cellular tissue and obstacles, it is necessary to elucidate the geometrical effects of obstacles on cell alignment and defects with negative charges. Here, we investigate how cell populations achieve stable defect configurations of two -1/2 defects in a triply connected domain. First, we present experimental observations of C2C12 myoblasts confined by two circular obstacles of varying diameter, demonstrating that two $-1/2$ defects are the most frequent configuration when the obstacles are sufficiently large. Second, to theoretically validate these experimental observations, we perform systematic stability analyses of defect configurations using an explicit expression of cell alignment and numerical minimization of the Frank elastic energy. Our numerical calculations reveal that the most stable configuration shifts continuously from a horizontal, through off-axis, to a vertical configuration as the obstacle size increases. In addition, the experimentally observed defect positions agreed with these theoretical predictions to within 60 $μ$m. These findings suggest that obstacle sizes control the symmetry of cell alignment, providing insights into how geometric and topological constraints can generate complex force patterns during morphogenesis or organ movements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“experimental observations of C2C12 myoblasts”和“numerical minimization of the Frank elastic energy”等关键词。；研究对象：受限在负欧拉示性数（三连通）域内的细胞群体（C2C12成肌细胞），具体研究其向列序排列及拓扑缺陷（两个-1/2缺陷）的稳定构型，以及内部圆形障碍物尺寸对缺陷对称性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个内部圆形障碍物足够大时，细胞群体中最常见的缺陷构型为两个-1/2缺陷；随着障碍物尺寸增大，最稳定缺陷构型从水平、经离轴、连续过渡到垂直排列，即障碍物尺寸控制细胞排列的对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个内部圆形障碍物足够大时，细胞群体中最常见的缺陷构型为两个-1/2缺陷；随着障碍物尺寸增大，最稳定缺陷构型从水平、经离轴、连续过渡到垂直排列，即障碍物尺寸控制细胞排列的对称性。；创新点：以往研究多关注无内部障碍（欧拉示性数非负）的域，本工作首次系统研究具有负欧拉示性数（含两个内部孔洞）的域中细胞向列序与负电荷缺陷的几何调控机制，揭示了障碍物尺寸作为连续控制参数可调节缺陷构型的对称性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：将C2C12成肌细胞限制在两个不同直径的圆形障碍物构成的域内进行培养观察，统计缺陷构型频率。理论上：利用细胞排列的显式表达式进行系统稳定性分析，并对Frank弹性能进行数值最小化计算，预测缺陷位置并与实验对比（误差在60 μm以内）。

papers.title: Revealing Many-Body Phases at finite temperatures through Quantum Coherence Distribution
papers.abstract: We introduce a diagnostic framework based on the full probability distribution of quantum coherence to probe single-particle and many-body phases at finite temperature. We first apply this approach to the localization transition in the non-interacting Aubry-André model and then extend the analysis to its interacting counterpart, whose phase diagram is substantially richer. We show that the moments of the coherence distribution provide clear signatures of quantum phase transitions and capture the emergence of many-body phases. More importantly, we find that the entropy of the coherence distribution emerges as an even more powerful indicator, retaining clear signatures of the underlying quantum phases while remaining remarkably robust against increasing thermal fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“diagnostic framework”（诊断框架），并应用于模型（Aubry-André model及其相互作用版本），属于理论分析与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：有限温度下非相互作用与相互作用的Aubry-André模型中的单粒子及多体相，特别是局域化转变与多体量子相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子相干性的全概率分布的矩（moments）能清晰标记量子相变并捕捉多体相的出现；更重要的是，相干性分布的熵（entropy）是更强有力的指示器，能在热涨落增强时依然保留底层量子相的清晰特征，具有显著鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子相干性的全概率分布的矩（moments）能清晰标记量子相变并捕捉多体相的出现；更重要的是，相干性分布的熵（entropy）是更强有力的指示器，能在热涨落增强时依然保留底层量子相的清晰特征，具有显著鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将量子相干性的全概率分布（而非仅平均值）作为有限温度下探测单粒子与多体相的诊断工具，并发现分布熵对热涨落具有特殊鲁棒性。摘要未突出说明与已有相干性诊断方法的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子相干性全概率分布的诊断框架，分析其各阶矩与分布熵在有限温度下的行为，用于探测局域化转变及多体相图。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如精确对角化、DMRG等）。

papers.title: Relativistic transformation of temperature for exotic cosmological fluids
papers.abstract: We study the relativistic transformation of temperature for effective cosmological fluids with negative pressure within a covariant thermodynamic framework. The Lorentz transformation of temperature is derived for barotropic fluids with $p=wρ$ and for the (generalized) Chaplygin gas with $p=-A/ρ^α$. For barotropic fluids with constant negative equation-of-state parameter, we show that negative pressure suppresses the growth of temperature under relativistic boosts. In contrast, the Chaplygin gas exhibits a qualitatively different behavior due to its density-dependent pressure, leading to a monotonic increase of the transformed temperature with velocity. The dependence of the relativistic temperature on the relative velocity and background energy density is illustrated through representative examples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“covariant thermodynamic framework”（协变热力学框架）进行推导，属于理论分析。；研究对象：有效宇宙学流体（effective cosmological fluids）的相对论性温度变换，具体包括具有负压的barotropic流体（p=wρ）和（广义）Chaplygin气体（p=-A/ρ^α）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于具有恒定负状态参数的barotropic流体，负压抑制了相对论性boost下温度的增长率；而Chaplygin气体因其密度依赖的压力，表现出定性不同的行为——变换后的温度随速度单调增加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于具有恒定负状态参数的barotropic流体，负压抑制了相对论性boost下温度的增长率；而Chaplygin气体因其密度依赖的压力，表现出定性不同的行为——变换后的温度随速度单调增加。；创新点：首次在协变热力学框架下系统比较了负压宇宙学流体（barotropic vs. Chaplygin）的温度Lorentz变换行为，揭示了负压对温度相对论增长的抑制效应以及Chaplygin气体因压力依赖密度而产生的独特温度-速度关系。
papers.method_zh: 在协变热力学框架内，推导了Lorentz变换下的温度表达式，针对两类具体物态方程（barotropic p=wρ 和广义Chaplygin p=-A/ρ^α）进行解析求解，并通过代表性算例展示温度对相对速度和背景能量密度的依赖关系。

papers.title: The stealthiest particle configurations in 8 and 24 dimensions
papers.abstract: We show that the $E_8$ and Leech lattices generate the stealthiest isometry-invariant, locally square-integrable point processes of intensity $1$ in $\mathbb{R}^8$ and $\mathbb{R}^{24}$, respectively, and that they are the unique stealthiest processes. We also apply the proof technique to sphere packing and energy minimization, and we construct a $20$-dimensional periodic configuration that is stealthier than any known $20$-dimensional lattice with the same particle density. This periodic configuration is a formal dual of Vardy's $20$-dimensional sphere packing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学证明（“We show that...”）、构造（“we construct...”）以及形式对偶（“formal dual”）等理论概念，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：高维空间（8维和24维）中的点过程与粒子构型，具体涉及E₈格与Leech格，以及20维的周期构型。属于数学物理与凝聚态理论交叉领域，关注粒子排列的“隐身性”（stealthiness）与相关优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: E₈格和Leech格分别是8维和24维中强度为1的等距不变、局部平方可积点过程中“最隐身”（stealthiest）的构型，且是唯一的最隐身过程。此外，构造了一个20维周期构型，其隐身性优于任何已知的相同粒子密度的20维格点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：E₈格和Leech格分别是8维和24维中强度为1的等距不变、局部平方可积点过程中“最隐身”（stealthiest）的构型，且是唯一的最隐身过程。此外，构造了一个20维周期构型，其隐身性优于任何已知的相同粒子密度的20维格点。；创新点：首次证明了E₈格和Leech格在特定点过程类别中的唯一最优隐身性，并将证明技术推广到球堆积与能量最小化领域；构造了20维周期构型，作为Vardy 20维球堆积的形式对偶，且隐身性优于已知格点。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体技术细节，但涉及数学证明技术（“proof technique”），并将其应用于球堆积（sphere packing）和能量最小化问题。未提及具体数值算法或实验手段。

papers.title: Optimal control theory for measured quantum Schrödinger bridges
papers.abstract: Schrödinger bridges and entropic optimal transport are usually formulated as stochastic interpolation problems between initial and final probability distributions. In their computational form, the bridge potentials are obtained by Sinkhorn or iterative proportional fitting, and are often regarded as auxiliary scaling functions. We show that for continuously monitored quantum systems, these potentials acquire a direct measurement-theoretic meaning. The mathematical structure of conditional quantum trajectory theory induces a Fokker--Planck equation on quantum state space. Conditioning this diffusion on a terminal distribution or a terminal measurement effect produces a Doob/Sinkhorn potential whose directional derivative along a unitary control vector field is the imaginary part of a generalized weak value. The same construction connects the Schrödinger-bridge viewpoint to the optimal-path framework for continuously monitored trajectories: the backward bridge potential plays the role of an effect-like costate, and its weak-value directional derivative gives the local control signal. By specifying the desired endpoint distribution, the induced drift produced by the Schrödinger bridge solution is the control solution that minimizes the quadratic cost feedback law, guiding the distribution to its desired endpoint. We quantify the control score of the available control Hamiltonian as a logarithmic directional derivative of the bridge potential, or an imaginary weak value. Three explicit examples identify weak measurement as a natural entropic regularization mechanism for quantum state transport and gives a route from Sinkhorn scaling to quantum feedback and Hamiltonian control synthesis for practical optimal control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中大量使用数学结构描述（如“Fokker--Planck equation”“Doob/Sinkhorn potential”“weak value”），未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：连续监测的量子系统，具体为量子态空间上的条件量子轨迹扩散过程，以及其与Schrödinger桥、熵最优输运问题的联系。涉及物理现象包括量子反馈控制、弱测量、量子态输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在连续监测量子系统中，Schrödinger桥势函数具有直接的测量理论含义：其沿酉控制矢量场的方向导数等于广义弱值的虚部，从而将Sinkhorn缩放与量子反馈控制、哈密顿量控制合成联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在连续监测量子系统中，Schrödinger桥势函数具有直接的测量理论含义：其沿酉控制矢量场的方向导数等于广义弱值的虚部，从而将Sinkhorn缩放与量子反馈控制、哈密顿量控制合成联系起来。；创新点：首次将Schrödinger桥势函数从辅助缩放函数提升为具有直接测量意义的物理量（弱值虚部），并建立从熵最优输运到量子反馈控制的统一路径。摘要还指出弱测量可作为量子态输运的天然熵正则化机制，但未与已有具体工作对比，故创新点的相对程度摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：条件量子轨迹理论、Schrödinger桥/熵最优输运、Doob h-变换、Sinkhorn/迭代比例拟合、弱测量理论。通过Fokker--Planck方程在量子态空间上的扩散模型，推导桥势与弱值的关系，并分析二次代价反馈控制的最优性。

papers.title: Non-Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Quantum Sensors for Quantum Parameter Estimation
papers.abstract: Non-KAM (Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser) systems, when subjected to weak time-dependent perturbations, exhibit an abrupt transition to classical chaos through the breakdown of invariant phase-space tori. We showcase the utilization of non-KAM systems in the quantum regime as quantum sensors, leveraging their sensitivity at \textit{resonances}. Quantum Fisher information (QFI) is a central quantity in quantum parameter estimation theory that measures how much information a quantum state contains about an unknown parameter that is encoded into it. In other words, it quantifies the sensitivity of a quantum state to small changes in that parameter. In this work, through numerical analysis in conjunction with analytical results, we study the performance of the non-KAM systems for quantum sensing applications by computing the QFI. We find that the growth of the QFI is remarkably enhanced when the resonance condition is satisfied. For frequency estimation under Floquet unitary encodings, we derive a transport bound: if the mean excitation number grows as $\langle\hat n(t)\rangle\sim t^α$, the QFI obeys $I(t)\lesssim t^{2α+2}$. The quantum kicked harmonic oscillator, a paradigmatic non-KAM system, realizes the full hierarchy: localized dynamics ($α=0$) yield quadratic growth, delocalized diffusion along stochastic webs ($α=1$) yields quartic growth, and translationally invariant resonances ($α=2$) saturate the bound with anomalous hexic growth, $I(t)\sim t^{6}$, established analytically at resonance $R=2$ and numerically at $R=4$. The enhancement stems from resonance-induced translational symmetry rather than exponential instability, identifying non-KAM resonances as a metrological resource distinct from chaos-assisted and criticality-based sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“通过数值分析结合解析结果”（numerical analysis in conjunction with analytical results），并推导了理论边界（transport bound）。；研究对象：非KAM（Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser）量子系统，具体包括量子 kicked harmonic oscillator（量子 kicked 谐振子）这一典型模型。研究其在量子参数估计（特别是频率估计）中的计量学性能。
