papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非KAM系统在满足共振条件时，其量子Fisher信息（QFI）的增长会被显著增强，可实现超越常规的标度增长（最高可达 $I(t)\sim t^6$）。这种增强源于共振诱导的平移对称性，而非混沌或临界性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非KAM系统在满足共振条件时，其量子Fisher信息（QFI）的增长会被显著增强，可实现超越常规的标度增长（最高可达 $I(t)\sim t^6$）。这种增强源于共振诱导的平移对称性，而非混沌或临界性。；创新点：首次将非KAM系统（而非传统的KAM或混沌系统）作为量子传感器资源，明确指出非KAM共振是一种区别于“混沌辅助传感”和“临界性传感”的独立计量学资源，其增强机制是共振诱导的平移对称性，而非指数不稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟相结合。具体包括：计算量子Fisher信息（QFI）以量化参数估计灵敏度；推导了在Floquet幺正编码下QFI关于平均激发数标度指数 $\alpha$ 的输运上界 $I(t)\lesssim t^{2\alpha+2}$；对量子 kicked 谐振子在共振 $R=2$ 处进行了解析推导，并在 $R=4$ 处进行了数值验证。

papers.title: Robust Hamiltonian engineering with subensemble control
papers.abstract: We present a robust protocol to reshape interactions in a spin ensemble based on global control pulse sequences applied to multiple subensembles in parallel. This setting arises naturally from ensembles of solid-state defects or multi-species atomic arrays. We show that it is provably computationally hard to find pulse sequences that simultaneously engineer interactions both within and between subensembles. Despite its formal hardness, we identify a set of necessary or sufficient conditions under which one can synthesize a target Hamiltonian from the native one. Moreover, we introduce efficient numerical strategies for designing pulse sequences that engineer target Hamiltonians robust against common control imperfections. As a specific application, we discuss the robust generation of two-mode spin squeezing in dual-species atomic ensembles, which is a challenging task without subensemble control. Our results provide a practical toolbox to design novel quantum simulation and sensing experiments with minimal control overhead.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：protocol、provably computationally hard、numerical strategies、synthesize a target Hamiltonian。；研究对象：自旋系综中的相互作用重塑，具体涉及固态缺陷系综或多物种原子阵列（如双物种原子系综）中的子系综并行控制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于全局控制脉冲序列的鲁棒协议，可在多个子系综并行作用下重塑自旋系综内的相互作用；尽管同时调控子系综内与子系综间的相互作用在计算上被证明是困难的，但作者找到了可合成目标哈密顿量的必要或充分条件，并展示了该方案可鲁棒地生成双物种原子系综中的双模自旋压缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于全局控制脉冲序列的鲁棒协议，可在多个子系综并行作用下重塑自旋系综内的相互作用；尽管同时调控子系综内与子系综间的相互作用在计算上被证明是困难的，但作者找到了可合成目标哈密顿量的必要或充分条件，并展示了该方案可鲁棒地生成双物种原子系综中的双模自旋压缩。；创新点：首次在子系综并行控制的框架下系统研究哈密顿量工程的复杂性与可合成条件，并展示了无需子系综控制时难以实现的双模自旋压缩可被鲁棒生成；摘要未突出说明与已有哈密顿量工程方案的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值优化相结合：形式化证明了脉冲序列搜索的计算复杂性（hardness），推导了目标哈密顿量可合成的必要/充分条件，并设计了高效的数值策略来生成对常见控制误差具有鲁棒性的脉冲序列。

papers.title: Reactive calcium carbonate precipitation from an atomic cluster expansion potential and enhanced sampling
papers.abstract: Calcium carbonate formation from aqueous solution is central to biomineralization and to carbon sequestration through mineral carbonation. At near-neutral pH, the process is highly reactive, with proton transfer mediating the interconversion between carbonate species. Most atomistic simulations to date either treat carbonate speciation as fixed or consider proton transfer only in small clusters. Here, we combine an ab initio trained atomic cluster expansion (ACE) machine-learning potential for molecular dynamics with enhanced sampling to enable reactive simulations of the early stages of calcium carbonate precipitation at previously inaccessible length and time scales. We study proton transfer and carbonate speciation in ion pairs and triplets, as well as in the collective aggregation of many ions. Our simulations with few ions show that ion association provides a favorable pathway for proton transfer, facilitating interconversion between carbonate, bicarbonate, and carbonic acid. In many-ion systems, proton transfer occurs spontaneously alongside aggregation, and we observe significant changes in the coordination environments as species evolve during the simulations. These results show that ion aggregation and chemical reactivity can be strongly coupled during the early stages of nucleation from solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：atomic cluster expansion (ACE) machine-learning potential、molecular dynamics、enhanced sampling、ab initio trained。；研究对象：水溶液中碳酸钙（calcium carbonate）的早期成核过程，具体包括离子对、离子三聚体及多离子聚集体系中的质子转移与碳酸盐物种（碳酸根、碳酸氢根、碳酸）之间的相互转化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利路径，促进碳酸盐物种间的相互转化；在多离子体系中，质子转移与离子聚集自发耦合发生，表明溶液成核早期阶段离子聚集与化学反应性可强烈关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子缔合为质子转移提供了有利路径，促进碳酸盐物种间的相互转化；在多离子体系中，质子转移与离子聚集自发耦合发生，表明溶液成核早期阶段离子聚集与化学反应性可强烈关联。；创新点：首次将ACE机器学习势与增强采样结合，使含质子转移的碳酸钙反应性模拟能够达到此前无法触及的长度与时间尺度，突破了以往模拟中要么固定碳酸盐物种、要么仅在极小团簇中考虑质子转移的限制。
papers.method_zh: 采用从头算（ab initio）训练的原子团簇展开（ACE）机器学习势进行分子动力学模拟，并结合增强采样（enhanced sampling）技术，实现对碳酸钙沉淀早期阶段的可反应模拟。

papers.title: Nanoscale magnetometry via collective many-body dynamics in diamond
papers.abstract: Many-body dynamics constitutes a promising approach for creating correlations between quantum particles which can be used for applications in sensing and metrology. However, utilizing this potential for substantial gains in practical settings is a challenging task with only a very few applications realized to date. Here, we demonstrate an approach to nanoscale magnetic sensing enabled by strongly interacting electronic spins in a room temperature solid. By coherently controlling collective many-body dynamics of a dipolar ensemble of $\sim 10^4$ nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond with pulsed magnetic field gradients, we demonstrate practical metrological gain up to $7.9(2)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic signal detection and $8.8(3)\,\mathrm{dB}$ for magnetic noise sensing, fully accounting for experimental overheads. Finally, we combine these methods to demonstrate a momentum-space-resolved sensing modality that enables detection of spatially correlated magnetic noise at continuously tunable length scales down to 50 nanometers. These observations open the door toward practical applications of interaction-enhanced quantum sensors for nanoscale biological imaging and material characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“pulsed magnetic field gradients”“measurement”等实验性表述，且给出了具体实验数据（如7.9(2) dB）。；研究对象：室温固体中由约10^4个金刚石氮-空位（NV）色心组成的偶极相互作用电子自旋系综，以及基于其多体动力学实现的纳米尺度磁传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过相干控制强相互作用的NV自旋系综的多体动力学，在磁信号检测和磁噪声传感中分别实现了高达7.9(2) dB和8.8(3) dB的实际计量增益（已计入全部实验开销），并展示了可连续调谐至50纳米长度尺度的动量空间分辨传感模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过相干控制强相互作用的NV自旋系综的多体动力学，在磁信号检测和磁噪声传感中分别实现了高达7.9(2) dB和8.8(3) dB的实际计量增益（已计入全部实验开销），并展示了可连续调谐至50纳米长度尺度的动量空间分辨传感模式。；创新点：首次在室温固态体系中利用强相互作用多体动力学实现具有实际计量增益（扣除实验开销后）的纳米尺度磁传感，并展示了可调谐至50纳米长度尺度的空间关联磁噪声检测能力，为相互作用增强量子传感器在生物成像和材料表征中的实际应用开辟了道路。
papers.method_zh: 利用脉冲磁场梯度对金刚石中NV色心偶极系综的集体多体动力学进行相干控制；采用多体动力学增强的磁测量方案，分别针对直流磁信号检测和磁噪声传感进行计量增益表征；结合两种方法实现动量空间分辨的磁噪声传感。

papers.title: Estimating the asymptotics of integer partitions in intermediate dimensions ($d = 3,4,5,6$)
papers.abstract: It was recently shown by Yeliussizov \cite{Yeliussizov} that integer partitions in dimensions $d \geq 7$ asymptotically grow strictly faster than MacMahon numbers. As MacMahon numbers match with integer partitions in dimensions $d = 1,2$, the comparison of asymptotics of integer partitions with MacMahon numbers in intermediate dimensions ($d = 3,4,5,6$) is an open question. In this work, we perform Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations till $N=15000$ by using adaptive weight learning followed by conventional MCMC steps to numerically estimate the asymptotics of integer partitions in these intermediate dimensions. We numerically establish that in these intermediate dimensions, partitions asymptotically grow faster than MacMahon numbers. More specifically, assuming that the limits exist, we show: $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-3/4}\log p_3(n) = 1.8196 \pm 0.0019$, $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-4/5}\log p_4(n) = 1.7215 \pm 0.0045$, $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-5/6}\log p_5(n) = 1.6521 \pm 0.0059$, and $\lim_{n\to\infty}\log n^{-6/7}p_6(n) = 1.652 \pm 0.021$ for partitions in dimensions $d=3,4,5,$ and $6$ respectively. These numbers are all larger than MacMahon leading order asymptotic coefficients of $1.7898, 1.6614, 1.5737,$ and $1.509$ respectively. Additionally, we also find estimates for some of the sub-leading asymptotic terms in $\log p_d(n)$ in each of the dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations”以及“numerically estimate”。；研究对象：数学物理中的整数分拆（integer partitions）问题，具体研究其在中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）下的渐近增长行为。这是一个组合数学与统计力学交叉的抽象数学物理问题，而非具体的凝聚态材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数值模拟，作者发现在中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）下，整数分拆的渐近增长率均严格快于对应的MacMahon数（即MacMahon渐近领头阶系数）。例如，对于d=3，作者给出 $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-3/4}\log p_3(n) = 1.8196 \pm 0.0019$，该值大于MacMahon系数1.7898。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数值模拟，作者发现在中间维度（d = 3, 4, 5, 6）下，整数分拆的渐近增长率均严格快于对应的MacMahon数（即MacMahon渐近领头阶系数）。例如，对于d=3，作者给出 $\lim_{n\to\infty}n^{-3/4}\log p_3(n) = 1.8196 \pm 0.0019$，该值大于MacMahon系数1.7898。；创新点：该工作填补了维度d=3,4,5,6（即中间维度）下整数分拆渐近行为与MacMahon数比较的空白。此前已知d≥7时增长率严格快于MacMahon数，而d=1,2时两者匹配，中间维度的问题此前是开放问题。本工作首次通过数值手段给出了这些维度下增长率快于MacMahon数的证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用自适应权重学习（adaptive weight learning）结合传统马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）步骤进行数值模拟，模拟规模达到N=15000。通过该数值方法估计各维度下 $\log p_d(n)$ 的渐近领头阶系数及部分次领头阶项。

papers.title: Holographic zeros and poles from apparent singularities
papers.abstract: We study general holographic fluctuation equations with apparent singularities, and the associated spectral functions. We consider the regime where an apparent singularity approaches the boundary, for which the near-boundary behavior of solutions can be determined via an inner/outer matching type of calculation. Depending on properties of the equation, we find that the merging of an apparent singularity with the boundary may generate either a zero or a pole for the corresponding spectral function. Our results also indicate that the recently introduced holographic product formula still applies in the presence of apparent singularities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“holographic fluctuation equations”“spectral functions”“inner/outer matching type of calculation”等理论推导与解析分析关键词。；研究对象：全息对偶框架下的涨落方程及其谱函数，具体关注具有“表观奇点”（apparent singularities）的方程在边界附近的解析行为。摘要未明确指定具体凝聚态体系或材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当表观奇点与边界合并时，根据方程性质的不同，对应的谱函数可能产生零点（zero）或极点（pole）；此外，近期提出的全息乘积公式在存在表观奇点的情况下仍然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当表观奇点与边界合并时，根据方程性质的不同，对应的谱函数可能产生零点（zero）或极点（pole）；此外，近期提出的全息乘积公式在存在表观奇点的情况下仍然成立。；创新点：首次系统研究了表观奇点与边界合并对谱函数零点/极点结构的影响，并验证了全息乘积公式在含表观奇点情形下的适用性。摘要未突出说明与其他具体工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用全息对偶（AdS/CFT）理论框架，通过内/外匹配（inner/outer matching）方法分析近边界行为，研究表观奇点趋近边界时谱函数的解析结构。

papers.title: Computing with qLDPC Codes by Climbing the Chain Map Hierarchy
papers.abstract: We develop a framework for logical computation with qLDPC codes that places logical Pauli, Clifford, and non-Clifford operations on the same footing. This brings the simple homological description of Pauli logicals to the patchwork landscape of logical Clifford and non-Clifford operations, providing a tool for the discovery of new logical gates. In particular, we define the chain map hierarchy: a family of chain complexes whose homology classes encode logical unitary and code surgery operations at any level of the Clifford hierarchy, precisely analogous to the chain complex description of Pauli logicals. Consequently, intuition for Pauli logicals can be leveraged to discover new logical operations on qLDPC codes. For instance, the familiar ability to deform Pauli logicals with stabilizers---i.e. boundaries of the chain complex---becomes a way to search for constant-depth unitary implementations of (non-)Clifford logical gates. Using this strategy, we discover constant-depth unitary implementations of the full logical Clifford group on any number of blocks of the 2D toric code, including within a single block, and addressable logical CCZ gates on any triple of logical qubits on any number of blocks of the 3D toric code. Beyond manifold codes, we find addressable non-Clifford gates on codes with many encoded qubits. The chain map hierarchy naturally encompasses and extends other constructions of logical gadgets, for instance providing a universal parameterization of cup products. As such, our work provides a unified, useful, and intuitive language for computing with qLDPC codes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“framework”“define”“discover”等理论建构与推导性词汇，未提及任何实验手段或数值模拟。；研究对象：量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码上的逻辑计算，具体涉及2D与3D环面码（toric code）以及具有多个编码量子比特的qLDPC码。摘要未明确说明具体物理体系（如超导、离子阱等）或凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义“链映射层级”（chain map hierarchy），将逻辑Pauli、Clifford和非Clifford操作统一到同一同调描述框架中，从而发现：在任意数量的2D环面码块上（包括单块内）可实现完整逻辑Clifford群的常深度幺正实现，以及在任意数量的3D环面码块上可实现可寻址的逻辑CCZ门。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义“链映射层级”（chain map hierarchy），将逻辑Pauli、Clifford和非Clifford操作统一到同一同调描述框架中，从而发现：在任意数量的2D环面码块上（包括单块内）可实现完整逻辑Clifford群的常深度幺正实现，以及在任意数量的3D环面码块上可实现可寻址的逻辑CCZ门。；创新点：将Pauli逻辑算符的简单同调描述推广到Clifford与非Clifford逻辑操作的“拼布”（patchwork）景观中，为发现新逻辑门提供统一工具；该框架自然涵盖并推广了杯积（cup products）等逻辑器件构造，为qLDPC码上的逻辑计算提供了统一、实用且直观的语言。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于链复形与同调代数的拓扑量子纠错码方法。具体定义了链映射层级——一族链复形，其同调类编码任意Clifford层级上的逻辑幺正与码手术（code surgery）操作。利用稳定子（即链复形边界）对逻辑Pauli算符的形变能力，搜索常深度幺正逻辑门实现。

papers.title: Buckling Prediction for Nonlinear Elastic Beams with Soft Inclusions
papers.abstract: We develop an efficient and accurate multiscale computational framework for predicting the buckling and post-buckling behaviour of elastic beams containing periodically distributed soft inclusions. The framework extends our previous multiscale, patch, computational homogenisation for linear elasticity by incorporating nonlinearity, and thus enables accurate prediction of both the buckling onset and the subsequent post-buckling response. Microscale computations are performed only within a sparse set of small subdomains (patches), while the macroscale behaviour is recovered through a proven patch-coupling algorithm. The scheme is assessed through quarter- and half-domain patch computations for beams with inclusion-to-matrix Young's modulus ratios ranging from 0.001 to 1. The results show that reducing the inclusion stiffness lowers both the critical buckling strain and the critical buckling stress, indicating an increased susceptibility to instability, while producing a milder post-buckling response with smaller transverse deflections and stress drops. Eigenvalue analysis of the Jacobian matrix accurately predicts the onset of instability and the corresponding critical strain and stress. Bifurcation diagrams of the nonlinear buckled configurations under compressive loading, and a quantitative analysis of the effect of the interpolation order on the predicted buckling and post-buckling responses, are also presented. Comparisons with full-domain simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework accurately predicts both the buckling threshold and the post-buckling behaviour while substantially reducing the computational cost. The methodology is readily extendable to heterogeneous beams, plates, shells, and other engineering structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“multiscale computational framework”“computational homogenisation”“eigenvalue analysis”等计算与数值方法关键词。；研究对象：含有周期性分布软夹杂物的非线性弹性梁，具体研究其在压缩载荷下的屈曲（buckling）与后屈曲（post-buckling）行为。夹杂物与基体的杨氏模量比在0.001至1之间变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 降低夹杂物刚度会同时降低临界屈曲应变和临界屈曲应力，即体系更易失稳；同时后屈曲响应变得更平缓，表现为更小的横向挠度和应力降。所提出的多尺度框架能准确预测屈曲阈值及后屈曲行为，同时大幅降低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：降低夹杂物刚度会同时降低临界屈曲应变和临界屈曲应力，即体系更易失稳；同时后屈曲响应变得更平缓，表现为更小的横向挠度和应力降。所提出的多尺度框架能准确预测屈曲阈值及后屈曲行为，同时大幅降低计算成本。；创新点：将多尺度补丁均匀化方法从线弹性扩展至非线性领域，使其能够同时预测屈曲起始与后屈曲路径，且仅需在稀疏补丁内进行微观计算即可获得全尺度精度，显著降低计算成本。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 采用多尺度补丁（patch）计算均匀化框架，将非线性引入先前针对线弹性发展的方法中。微观计算仅在稀疏分布的小子域（补丁）内进行，宏观行为通过补丁耦合算法恢复。使用四分之一域和半域补丁计算进行评估，并对Jacobian矩阵进行特征值分析以预测失稳起始点。还绘制了分岔图并分析了插值阶数的影响。

papers.title: Unraveling the PFAS helix: A statistical approach
papers.abstract: The extreme persistence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the environment is rooted in their three-dimensional molecular conformation. The helical twist adopted by perfluoroalkyl chains due to hyperconjugation involving their recalcitrant C-F bonds governs their resistance to degradation, yet a quantitative, continuous metric for helicity has remained absent. Here we introduce a data-driven framework that quantifies backbone helicity using three statistical descriptors: void-state (binary occupancy) spatial autocorrelations, local backbone principal component analysis, and persistent homology. We further validate each statistical descriptor against geometric dihedral benchmarks and DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra. The framework is initially established on a homologous series of perfluorocarboxylic acids (FC2 through FC16) and their hydrogenated analogues, then extended across perfluorosulfonic acids, fluorotelomer alcohols, polyfluoroalkyl hexanoic acid analogues, and longer-chain PFOA and PFOS analogues. Agreement between statistical, geometric, and spectroscopic definitions of helicity is established for PFCAs and extended to structurally distinct subfamilies, including PFOA analogues of varying fluorine content and perfluorosulfonic acids, demonstrating that the descriptors are robust to changes in headgroup chemistry and fluorine substitution pattern. The framework provides a chemistry-agnostic toolset for incorporating backbone conformation into predictive models of PFAS environmental fate and degradation reactivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“data-driven framework”“DFT-calculated Vibrational Circular Dichroism (VCD) spectra”“statistical descriptors”，未涉及实验合成或测量。；研究对象：全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的分子骨架螺旋构象，具体包括全氟羧酸（FC2–FC16）及其氢化类似物、全氟磺酸、氟调聚醇、多氟己酸类似物，以及长链PFOA和PFOS类似物。物理现象为全氟烷基链因C–F键超共轭效应产生的螺旋扭转及其与降解抗性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一套基于三个统计描述符（空态空间自相关、局部主成分分析、持续同调）的量化框架，能够连续、定量地描述PFAS骨架螺旋度，且该描述符与几何二面角基准和DFT计算的VCD光谱一致，对头基化学和氟取代模式变化具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一套基于三个统计描述符（空态空间自相关、局部主成分分析、持续同调）的量化框架，能够连续、定量地描述PFAS骨架螺旋度，且该描述符与几何二面角基准和DFT计算的VCD光谱一致，对头基化学和氟取代模式变化具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次为PFAS螺旋性提供了定量、连续、化学无关（chemistry-agnostic）的统计度量框架，填补了此前缺乏连续螺旋度指标的空白，并将骨架构象与PFAS环境归趋和降解反应性的预测模型联系起来。摘要未突出说明与已有螺旋度定义方法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 1）统计描述符：void-state（二元占据）空间自相关、局部骨架主成分分析（PCA）、持续同调（persistent homology）；2）验证手段：几何二面角基准对比、DFT计算的振动圆二色（VCD）光谱；3）体系建立：先在同系全氟羧酸及其氢化类似物上建立，再扩展到其他PFAS亚家族。

papers.title: Repairing PBE-Spurious Metallicity for HSE06-Level Screening of 2D Photocatalysts for Green Hydrogen Production
papers.abstract: Semilocal PBE calculations can remove viable photocatalysts before screening by labeling narrow-gap semiconductors as metals. We address this failure mode in the Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB) by combining leakage-aware repair of PBE-spurious metallicity with HSE06--PBE $Δ$-learning. Stage~I classifies HSE06-unknown PBE metals using structural, chemical, magnetic, and stability descriptors, while excluding HSE06/GW quantities and PBE electronic shortcuts. Stage~II learns $E_g^{HSE} - E_g^{PBE}$ for the corrected insulating population. The curated XGBoost regressor reconstructs HSE06 gaps with a mean absolute error of 0.108~eV ($R^2=0.989$), compared with 1.036~eV for raw PBE. The Stage~I classifier is used only for triage because the labeled true-metal class contains 29 materials; its best holdout performance gives 87.5\% accuracy, 0.286 true-metal recall, and 0.643 balanced accuracy. The corrected pH~0 electronic screen yields 10 strict and 29 initial relaxed green-hydrogen photocatalyst candidates. Four strict and 18 relaxed candidates would fail the same 1.6--2.8~eV gap window at the PBE level. Targeted VASP HSE06 calculations for six ML-predicted compounds give material-level MAEs of 0.417, 0.182, and 0.110~eV for the C2DB-native, Magpie+structural, and curated models, respectively; \feat{1AgBr-1} shifts above the upper gap cutoff, leaving 28 retained relaxed candidates. The workflow shows that high-fidelity correction must be evaluated by candidate membership, not only by global regression error.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数据库（C2DB）、机器学习模型（XGBoost）、DFT/HSE06计算、VASP计算等，均为计算与数据驱动方法。；研究对象：二维光催化材料（用于绿色制氢），具体针对C2DB数据库中因PBE半局域泛函误差而被误判为金属的窄带隙半导体材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过“泄漏感知修复”结合HSE06–PBE Δ-learning，可有效修复PBE对二维光催化剂的虚假金属性误判，使带隙预测误差从1.036 eV降至0.108 eV，并筛选出28个保留的宽松绿色制氢光催化剂候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过“泄漏感知修复”结合HSE06–PBE Δ-learning，可有效修复PBE对二维光催化剂的虚假金属性误判，使带隙预测误差从1.036 eV降至0.108 eV，并筛选出28个保留的宽松绿色制氢光催化剂候选材料。；创新点：提出“泄漏感知修复”策略，将PBE虚假金属性分类修复与HSE06–PBE带隙Δ-learning结合，并强调以候选材料成员资格（而非全局回归误差）作为高保真修正效果的评估标准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 两阶段机器学习工作流：Stage I使用结构、化学、磁性及稳定性描述符（排除HSE06/GW量和PBE电子结构捷径）训练XGBoost分类器，用于识别PBE误判金属；Stage II用XGBoost回归器学习HSE06与PBE带隙差（Δ-learning）。另用VASP进行HSE06验证计算，并比较三种模型（C2DB-native、Magpie+structural、curated）的材料级误差。

papers.title: Relaxation effects on Hartree-Fock ground states in twisted bilayer graphene at even integer fillings
papers.abstract: A standard approach for studying magic angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG)'s correlated electronic phase diagram is to project the Coulomb interaction down to effective models only involving electrons in single-particle flat bands and some nearby remote bands. We provide a novel systematic derivation of a single-particle continuum model of MATBG's single-particle properties which incorporates structural relaxation while remaining in the Lagrangian frame. We project the Coulomb interactions down to electrons occupying the flat bands of this model and compute the Hartree-Fock many-body ground states at fillings $ν= \pm 2$. We find that incorporating relaxation effects drives the model into a semi-metallic phase at $- 2$ because of particle-hole asymmetry in the relaxed model's single-particle dispersion and because the flat band wavefunctions become more concentrated leading to an enhanced Hartree potential. Our results corroborate recent ab initio density functional theory studies which also found semi-metallic phases at $-2$. We discuss potential explanations for why such phases have not been seen in experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Hartree-Fock计算、系统推导、投影库仑相互作用。；研究对象：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）在偶数整数填充（ν = ±2）下的关联电子基态，特别关注结构弛豫对单粒子性质及多体基态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在ν = -2填充下，考虑结构弛豫效应后，模型驱动系统进入半金属相，而非绝缘相。原因是弛豫模型的单粒子色散存在粒子-空穴不对称性，且平带波函数更集中导致Hartree势增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在ν = -2填充下，考虑结构弛豫效应后，模型驱动系统进入半金属相，而非绝缘相。原因是弛豫模型的单粒子色散存在粒子-空穴不对称性，且平带波函数更集中导致Hartree势增强。；创新点：提供了一种新颖的、在拉格朗日框架内系统纳入结构弛豫的单粒子连续模型推导方法，并首次在该弛豫模型基础上进行Hartree-Fock计算，发现ν = -2处半金属相，与近期ab initio DFT结果一致。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 在拉格朗日坐标系中系统推导了包含结构弛豫的MATBG单粒子连续模型；将库仑相互作用投影到该模型的平带子空间；对ν = ±2填充执行Hartree-Fock多体基态计算。

papers.title: First Principle Analysis of the Magnetism and Electronic Structure of Fe2XSi (X=Ti, V)
papers.abstract: The electronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Fe2XSi, where X is titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V), are investigated using computational methods. Volume optimization reveals that the ground state of Fe2TiSi is a nonmagnetic narrow-band gap semiconductor, and that of Fe2VSi is a ferrimagnetic metal. The negative formation energies of both materials confirm the stability of their crystal structures. Mechanical properties confirm the static stability of the crystal structure and suggest that the titanium compound is ductile; however, the vanadium material is brittle. Density of states and band structure studies confirm the nonmagnetic semiconducting nature with an indirect band gap at Γ and X for the titanium material and the ferrimagnetic-metallic nature of the vanadium material. Electronic and magnetic properties of the materials were investigated with applied tension (negative pressure) and compression (positive pressure) to the crystal structure. The pressure study on Fe2TiSi shows a tunable band gap and a possible semiconductor-metal transition, and Fe2VSi shows a tunable magnetic moment and a possible low-spin/high-spin magnetic transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“computational methods”“First Principle Analysis”“Density of states and band structure studies”等关键词。；研究对象：Heusler合金Fe₂XSi（X=Ti, V）的电子结构、磁性与力学性质，以及外加压力（拉伸与压缩）对其电子和磁性的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fe₂TiSi是非磁性窄带隙半导体（Γ-X间接带隙），Fe₂VSi是亚铁磁金属；压力可分别实现Fe₂TiSi的带隙调控与半导体-金属转变，以及Fe₂VSi的磁矩调控与低自旋/高自旋磁转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fe₂TiSi是非磁性窄带隙半导体（Γ-X间接带隙），Fe₂VSi是亚铁磁金属；压力可分别实现Fe₂TiSi的带隙调控与半导体-金属转变，以及Fe₂VSi的磁矩调控与低自旋/高自旋磁转变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论），包括体积优化、态密度与能带结构分析、形成能计算、力学性质（弹性常数）计算，以及对晶体结构施加负压（拉伸）和正压（压缩）的模拟研究。

papers.title: AlterSeeK-Path: Systematic construction of generalized band-structure paths for displaying altermagnetic spin splitting
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic materials exhibit spin splitting in their electronic band structures while maintaining zero net magnetization. However, conventional high-symmetry k-paths generally hide this splitting because they follow symmetry lines that in most cases enforce spin degeneracy. We present AlterSeeK-Path, an open-source Python tool that systematically constructs generalized band-structure paths for collinear altermagnets. The method selects the centroid of the conventional irreducible wedge used in routine band-structure calculations as the representative general k-point, maps it to a spin-flip-related partner, and inserts paired segments through these points into the standard high-symmetry path; these segments systematically sample the interior of the irreducible wedge. We demonstrate the construction for all 54 three-dimensional combinations of extended Bravais lattice type and spin Laue group across the six crystal systems that support collinear altermagnetism, and for the 12 two-dimensional cases spanning the four compatible two-dimensional Bravais lattices. Representative band structures are shown for the distinct lattice/path cases. With AlterSeeK-Path, these band structures can be constructed with essentially the same effort as conventional band structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要描述了一个开源Python工具（AlterSeeK-Path）的构建方法，并展示了能带结构计算结果，属于计算方法开发与验证。；研究对象：交替磁体（altermagnets）的电子能带结构，具体关注其自旋劈裂在常规高对称k路径上被隐藏的问题，研究对象涵盖三维54种（扩展布拉伐格子类型×自旋Laue群组合）和二维12种（四种二维布拉伐格子）交替磁体体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种系统构建广义能带路径的方法，通过选取常规不可约布里渊区楔形内部的代表性一般k点及其自旋翻转伙伴点，将配对线段插入标准高对称路径中，从而在能带计算中显式展示交替磁体的自旋劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种系统构建广义能带路径的方法，通过选取常规不可约布里渊区楔形内部的代表性一般k点及其自旋翻转伙伴点，将配对线段插入标准高对称路径中，从而在能带计算中显式展示交替磁体的自旋劈裂。；创新点：首次实现了对交替磁体自旋劈裂的系统性、自动化能带路径构建，使得展示交替磁自旋劈裂的能带计算工作量与常规能带计算基本相当，解决了传统高对称路径因对称性约束而隐藏自旋劈裂的问题。
papers.method_zh: 开发了开源Python工具AlterSeeK-Path，采用几何方法：选取常规能带计算所用不可约楔形的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到自旋翻转相关的伙伴点，并将这些配对线段插入标准高对称路径中，以系统采样不可约楔形内部。该方法覆盖所有支持共线交替磁性的六方晶系（三维54种组合）及四种兼容的二维布拉伐格子（12种情况）。

papers.title: Emergence of the magnetic octupole Rashba-Edelstein effect from spin-orbit entanglement
papers.abstract: Magnetic multipoles have attracted growing interest as order parameters and dynamical degrees of freedom in unconventional magnets, yet it remains unclear how broadly they can emerge as active electronic degrees of freedom. Here, we show that spin-orbit-entangled multiorbital states can host magnetic octupole (MO) degrees of freedom. In Rashba systems, this gives rise to an MO Rashba texture accompanying the J-Rashba texture. Remarkably, spin-orbital entanglement can realize a pure-MO limit in which the spin and orbital-angular-momentum textures vanish while the MO texture remains finite. An applied electric field converts this texture into a nonequilibrium MO polarization through an MO Rashba-Edelstein effect. Around the pure-MO regime, the MO Edelstein response dominates over the conventional spin response, showing that multipolar responses need not be small corrections to dipolar spin physics. Our results establish an interface-based route for electrically generating nonequilibrium multipolar magnetic polarization in spin-orbit-coupled systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“we show that”“can realize”“our results establish”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算方法。；研究对象：自旋-轨道耦合的多轨道电子体系，具体聚焦于Rashba系统中的磁八极（MO）自由度及其电场响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态可承载磁八极自由度，在Rashba系统中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的MO Rashba纹理；在纯MO极限下，自旋与轨道角动量纹理消失而MO纹理仍有限，电场可通过MO Rashba-Edelstein效应产生非平衡MO极化，且该响应可超越传统自旋响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态可承载磁八极自由度，在Rashba系统中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的MO Rashba纹理；在纯MO极限下，自旋与轨道角动量纹理消失而MO纹理仍有限，电场可通过MO Rashba-Edelstein效应产生非平衡MO极化，且该响应可超越传统自旋响应。；创新点：首次提出磁八极可作为Rashba系统中活跃的电子自由度，并预言了纯MO极限下的MO Rashba-Edelstein效应，表明多极响应不必是偶极自旋物理的小修正。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道模型，研究Rashba系统中的磁多极自由度及其电场诱导的非平衡响应（Edelstein效应）。摘要未明确说明具体形式（如k·p微扰论、群论分析或紧束缚模型）。

papers.title: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
papers.abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“band structure and symmetry analysis”（能带结构与对称性分析），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：多种共线交错磁（altermagnetic）晶体材料，包括MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO₃、ScCrO₃、LaMnO₃、TlCrO₃、HoFeO₃、InCrO₃和DyFeO₃。物理现象为共线交错磁体中特有的自旋劈裂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种在布里渊区一般k点路径上绘制能带结构的新方法，可系统展示共线交错磁体的自旋劈裂；而传统沿高对称点/线绘制的能带图在许多情况下完全无法显示这种劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种在布里渊区一般k点路径上绘制能带结构的新方法，可系统展示共线交错磁体的自旋劈裂；而传统沿高对称点/线绘制的能带图在许多情况下完全无法显示这种劈裂。；创新点：针对传统能带绘图方法在展示交错磁自旋劈裂时的失效问题，提出一种新的能带展示策略——沿一般k点路径绘图以反映布里渊区平均特征，并在九种材料中系统验证了该方法的优势。
papers.method_zh: 能带结构计算与对称性分析。具体采用在采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带图，并与传统高对称路径能带图进行对比。摘要未明确说明所用具体计算框架（如DFT+U等）。

papers.title: Relating solute interactions to interfacial properties
papers.abstract: Liquid interfaces are both ubiquitous and also critically important for many commercial products, modern technologies, biological processes, and environmental phenomena. The properties of these interfaces can depend quite sensitively upon the composition of the bulk liquid phase. In this work, we develop a dilute solution theory (DST) for the influence of dilute cosolutes upon the interface between coexisting liquid and vapor phases. We employ a grand canonical perturbation theory to rigorously relate the interfacial free energy to the concentration of the liquid solution. We leverage a corresponding Gibbs ensemble to treat liquid-vapor coexistence and to eliminate the contribution of the bulk phases from this free energy. We express the coefficients of the resulting expansion in terms of microscopic partition functions. By treating solute-solute interactions to lowest order, we distinguish between the intrinsic and effective interfacial preferences of solutes. While the former reflects only solute-solvent interactions, the latter depends upon the solution composition and reflects the influence of solute-solute interactions. We assess this DST with molecular dynamics simulations of binary and ternary mixtures of Lennard-Jones spheres. These simulations demonstrate that DST accurately models the interfacial properties of these systems up to relatively high concentrations. Moreover, the simulations illustrate the impact of attractive solute-solute interactions in converting weak intrinsic surfactants into weak effective depletants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a dilute solution theory (DST)”“employ a grand canonical perturbation theory”，属于理论推导；同时“assess this DST with molecular dynamics simulations”，包含计算模拟验证，因此为理论+计算的混合类型。；研究对象：液-汽共存界面的性质，具体研究稀溶质（cosolutes）对液体-蒸气界面自由能及界面偏好（表面活性或耗尽剂行为）的影响，模型体系为Lennard-Jones球的二元和三元混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该稀溶液理论（DST）能够准确描述液-汽界面性质直至较高溶质浓度；溶质-溶质间的吸引相互作用可将弱的内在表面活性剂转变为弱的有效耗尽剂（depletant）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该稀溶液理论（DST）能够准确描述液-汽界面性质直至较高溶质浓度；溶质-溶质间的吸引相互作用可将弱的内在表面活性剂转变为弱的有效耗尽剂（depletant）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的对比，但明确的新意在于：通过将溶质-溶质相互作用处理到最低阶，区分了溶质的“内在”界面偏好（仅由溶质-溶剂相互作用决定）与“有效”界面偏好（依赖溶液组成并反映溶质-溶质相互作用），并揭示了吸引性溶质-溶质相互作用如何改变溶质的表观界面行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为巨正则系综微扰理论（grand canonical perturbation theory），结合对应的Gibbs系综处理液-汽共存，以消除体相贡献；将界面自由能展开系数表达为微观配分函数形式。验证手段为Lennard-Jones球体系的分子动力学（MD）模拟。

papers.title: Magnetoelectric Phase Transition and Axion Dynamics
papers.abstract: Magnetoelectric phase transitions have been experimentally studied, but no macroscopic theory has been proposed to explain their dynamical origin. In this work, we assume that the axion quasiparticle with frequency undergoes a condensation like process. We show that these magnetoelectric phase transitions can be described within a Ginzbur Landau framework by introducing a coupled dynamic parameter, the axion angle, which is proportional to the magnetoelectric coeffcient. We derive relations between the static axion angle, the axion frequency, and the phase transition temperature for different magnetoelectric materials, respectively, and compare these calculations with existing experimental results. We also connect the artificially designed Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction with the axion condensate like process, so that the relation between the static axion angle and the experimentally measured frequency shift can be obtained.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“no macroscopic theory has been proposed”，并构建了Ginzburg-Landau框架，属于宏观唯象理论建模。；研究对象：磁电相变及其动力学起源，具体涉及磁电材料中的轴子准粒子凝聚过程，以及人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 磁电相变可被描述为轴子准粒子（频率为ω）的凝聚过程，在Ginzburg-Landau框架下引入与磁电系数成正比的动态轴子角作为耦合序参量，可统一描述此类相变；并建立了静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度之间的关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：磁电相变可被描述为轴子准粒子（频率为ω）的凝聚过程，在Ginzburg-Landau框架下引入与磁电系数成正比的动态轴子角作为耦合序参量，可统一描述此类相变；并建立了静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度之间的关系。；创新点：首次为磁电相变提供了宏观动力学理论解释（此前仅有实验研究而无宏观理论），将轴子凝聚机制引入磁电相变的Ginzburg-Landau描述，并建立了与实验可测频移的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 采用Ginzburg-Landau唯象理论框架，引入轴子角作为动态耦合序参量，推导静态轴子角、轴子频率与相变温度间的解析关系，并与已有实验结果进行对比；同时将人工Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与轴子凝聚过程建立联系，以获得静态轴子角与实验可测频移的关系。

papers.title: Understanding Graphene-Perovskite Interactions: From Flake Chemistry to Crystallisation and Solar Cell Performance
papers.abstract: Graphene-derivatives are widely employed materials to improve bulk and interface properties of metal-halide perovskite devices. Yet the implications of their flake chemistry and interactions with the perovskite precursors remain unclear. Here, we show that pristine graphene flakes (GF) and more conventional graphene oxide flakes (GOF) are not interchangeable. Density functional theory calculations reveal that GOF interacts more strongly with the perovskite lattice but induces larger structural distortions, stronger interfacial polarisation, and localised gap states. In contrast, GF forms comparatively non-disruptive contacts, a response retained across a wide compositional range. Machine-learning atomistic simulations further show that GF contacts both Pb- and I-containing regions of solvated perovskite nanocrystals, with a strong solvent dependency. Solution spectroscopic characterization indicates that GF additives serve as scaffold for preorganised Pb/I-containing precursors, favouring film crystallisation. In this sense, GF enhances solar cell performance across perovskite compositions, but particularly those facing a more challenging crystallisation. In mixed Sn-Pb perovskite solar cells, GF raises the champion power-conversion efficiency from 21.5\% to 23.7\% with improved storage stability. These results establish pristine GF as a chemically defined additive and connect its atomic-scale interactions with precursor organisation, crystallisation, device performance, and stability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“密度泛函理论计算”“机器学习原子模拟”等计算方法，同时包含“溶液光谱表征”“太阳能电池性能测试”等实验手段。；研究对象：石墨烯衍生物（原始石墨烯薄片 GF 与氧化石墨烯薄片 GOF）与金属卤化物钙钛矿（含混合 Sn-Pb 钙钛矿）之间的界面相互作用，及其对钙钛矿前驱体组织、薄膜结晶和太阳能电池性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中不可互换：GOF 与钙钛矿晶格作用更强但引起更大结构畸变和局域隙态，而 GF 形成非破坏性接触，可作为 Pb/I 前驱体的预组织支架促进结晶，从而提升钙钛矿太阳能电池效率（混合 Sn-Pb 体系中冠军效率从 21.5% 提升至 23.7%）并改善存储稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中不可互换：GOF 与钙钛矿晶格作用更强但引起更大结构畸变和局域隙态，而 GF 形成非破坏性接触，可作为 Pb/I 前驱体的预组织支架促进结晶，从而提升钙钛矿太阳能电池效率（混合 Sn-Pb 体系中冠军效率从 21.5% 提升至 23.7%）并改善存储稳定性。；创新点：首次系统对比原始石墨烯薄片（GF）与氧化石墨烯薄片（GOF）在钙钛矿体系中的不可互换性，将 GF 的原子尺度相互作用与其对前驱体组织、结晶过程、器件效率和稳定性的影响建立关联，确立 GF 作为一种化学定义明确的添加剂。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（用于评估 GF/GOF 与钙钛矿晶格的相互作用、结构畸变、界面极化和隙态）；机器学习原子模拟（用于研究 GF 与溶剂化钙钛矿纳米晶中 Pb/I 区域的接触及溶剂依赖性）；溶液光谱表征（用于分析 GF 添加剂对 Pb/I 前驱体预组织的作用）；钙钛矿太阳能电池器件制备与效率/稳定性测试。

papers.title: QArray+: A physics-informed GPU-accelerated simulator for quantum dot arrays
papers.abstract: Semiconductor quantum-dot arrays are a compelling platform for scalable quantum technologies, yet their practical operation is hindered by the complexity of tuning large-scale devices. Existing automation tools rely on simplified physical models---such as constant-capacitance approximations and equilibrium Hubbard models---which assume instantaneous relaxation to a steady state. These frameworks fail in experimentally critical regimes where measurement rates exceed tunneling dynamics, necessitating more sophisticated non-equilibrium control strategies. To bridge this gap, we introduce QArray+, an extension of the QArray framework that incorporates gate-dependent tunnel coupling and a quantum open-system description of dissipative processes. This approach enables the unified simulation of coherent interdot charge-state hybridization and the non-equilibrium latching dynamics essential for training robust machine-learning models for automated device operation. Implemented in JAX with GPU acceleration, QArray+ scales across GPUs and multi-node systems. For example, a charge stability diagram for a 100X100 grid of gate voltages over 64 dots can be computed in $\sim0.17\,\mathrm{s}$ on multiple GPUs. Since interdot interactions are short-ranged and the corresponding tuning corrections are local, simulations at these scales capture the physics relevant to even larger devices. These capabilities support high-throughput dataset generation for automated device tuning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。关键词：GPU-accelerated simulator、physics-informed、simulation、implemented in JAX。；研究对象：半导体量子点阵列（semiconductor quantum-dot arrays），具体关注其电荷态调控、相干隧穿耦合与非平衡动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: QArray+ 模拟器通过引入栅极依赖的隧穿耦合和量子开放系统耗散描述，能够统一模拟相干电荷态杂化与非平衡锁存（latching）动力学，从而覆盖现有简化模型（如恒电容近似、平衡Hubbard模型）失效的实验关键区间（测量速率超过隧穿动力学时）。在100×100栅压网格、64个量子点的规模下，多GPU计算仅需约0.17秒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：QArray+ 模拟器通过引入栅极依赖的隧穿耦合和量子开放系统耗散描述，能够统一模拟相干电荷态杂化与非平衡锁存（latching）动力学，从而覆盖现有简化模型（如恒电容近似、平衡Hubbard模型）失效的实验关键区间（测量速率超过隧穿动力学时）。在100×100栅压网格、64个量子点的规模下，多GPU计算仅需约0.17秒。；创新点：突破了现有自动化调控工具依赖的平衡态/恒电容近似，首次在量子点阵列模拟中同时纳入栅极依赖隧穿耦合与开放系统耗散，实现对非平衡锁存动力学的统一模拟，为训练鲁棒的机器学习自动调控模型提供高保真数据生成能力。摘要未明确说明与QArray原版相比的具体算法改进细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于JAX的GPU加速数值模拟框架，扩展自QArray框架。物理模型包含：栅极依赖的隧穿耦合（gate-dependent tunnel coupling）、量子开放系统描述（quantum open-system description of dissipative processes），用于模拟耗散过程和非平衡动力学。支持多GPU及多节点并行。

papers.title: Twist as a Mechanical Switch for Reconfigurable Stacking in h-BN
papers.abstract: Twistronics of layered materials has emerged as a highly active field due to its profound implications for quantum electronics and materials engineering. However, the controllable manipulation of interlayer stacking remains a significant experimental challenge. Here, the homogeneous contact between hexagonal boron nitride layers is shown to be reproducibly switched between two distinct stable stacking configurations via an externally applied torque. Combining experiments and computational modelling, we identify the stacking order of these stable states as the commensurate AA and AB modes. These two states are associated with different rotational torque maxima, exhibiting an asymmetry ratio of 0.7, and distinct dynamics as a function of the twist angle. Moreover, the peak torque values scale linearly with contact area, highlighting the dominant role of edge elasticity in the twisting process. Given that the AA and AB stacking modes correspond to different out-of-plane electric polarization states, our findings offer a pathway for reconfigurable nano- and micro-electromechanical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算建模）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Combining experiments and computational modelling”。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（h-BN）同质层间接触的堆叠构型，具体为通过外加扭矩在AA与AB两种稳定堆叠模式之间进行可逆切换的力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过外加扭矩，h-BN层间接触可在AA与AB两种稳定堆叠构型之间可重复切换；两种构型对应不同的旋转扭矩极大值（不对称比0.7）及随扭转角变化的动力学行为，且峰值扭矩与接触面积呈线性关系，表明边缘弹性主导扭转过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过外加扭矩，h-BN层间接触可在AA与AB两种稳定堆叠构型之间可重复切换；两种构型对应不同的旋转扭矩极大值（不对称比0.7）及随扭转角变化的动力学行为，且峰值扭矩与接触面积呈线性关系，表明边缘弹性主导扭转过程。；创新点：首次展示利用扭转作为“机械开关”实现h-BN层间堆叠构型的可重构切换，且AA/AB两种模式对应不同的面外电极化态，为可重构纳/微机电系统提供了新路径。摘要未突出说明与以往扭转电子学研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上施加外部扭矩实现层间堆叠切换；计算上采用建模方法（摘要未具体说明方法名称，如DFT或分子动力学等细节）识别稳定态的堆叠序为AA与AB模式，并分析扭矩-角度关系及接触面积依赖性。

papers.title: Optimal-work feedback on particles with activity --- gliding on active fluctuations using positional information
papers.abstract: We study the minimum-work feedback control of particles subject to active fluctuations. Considering an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle confined by a moving harmonic trap, we derive exact optimal protocols following an initial position measurement. Our results show that nonequilibrium correlations between position and active fluctuations allow work extraction from the activity based on positional information only, i.e., without directly measuring the active degree of freedom, which was the focus of earlier literature. We find that depending on the persistence time, activity can either facilitate or impede transport relative to passive systems. Surprisingly, unlike feedback schemes based on direct measurements of the active fluctuations, positional feedback remains energetically advantageous even in the limit of infinitely persistent activity. Our results provide design principles for information engines and optimal control strategies operating in active environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive exact optimal protocols、theoretical framework（基于随机热力学与最优控制理论推导）。；研究对象：受活性噪声驱动的粒子（活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子），被移动谐振子势阱约束，处于非平衡活性环境中的信息反馈控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅基于初始位置测量即可从活性涨落中提取功，无需直接测量活性自由度；且当活性持久时间趋于无穷时，位置反馈在能量上仍优于直接测量活性涨落的反馈方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅基于初始位置测量即可从活性涨落中提取功，无需直接测量活性自由度；且当活性持久时间趋于无穷时，位置反馈在能量上仍优于直接测量活性涨落的反馈方案。；创新点：突破了以往文献中必须直接测量活性自由度的限制，证明位置信息与活性涨落之间的非平衡关联足以实现功提取；并揭示了持久时间对输运促进/阻碍的非单调影响，以及无限持久活性极限下位置反馈的持续优势。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：对活性 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 粒子在移动谐振子势阱中的动力学，求解最小功反馈控制的最优协议（基于初始位置测量的条件最优控制）。

papers.title: From Goldene to Noblene: exhaustive enumeration of the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional metals became a laboratory reality with the isolation of Goldene, a gold sheet one atom thick released by chemical exfoliation, which raises the question of what alloying can achieve on the same close-packed lattice. Here we combine an exhaustive enumeration of derivative superstructures with density functional theory to map the ordered Au-Ag-Cu monolayer alloys, relaxing every symmetry-inequivalent arrangement up to four atoms per cell and extending the set with larger cells selected by a fitted model. We find that the arrangement of the atoms, and not their proportion, controls the mixing energy, since the spread among the orderings of a single composition is several times the step between neighboring compositions, one composition spans more than 50~meV/atom between two arrangements of the same three atoms, and at two compositions the arrangement decides the sign. The energetics is carried by a competition between Au-Cu contacts, which bind, and Ag-Cu contacts, which do not, and bulk enthalpies computed under the same protocol show that this chemistry is not uniformly rescaled in two dimensions, since Au-Cu orders more strongly in the monolayer than in the crystal while the other two weaken. A pair model completed by an elastic size-mismatch term reproduces the computed energies to a few meV/atom and returns a composition landscape whose convex hull no balanced ternary composition reaches. One equimolar ordering, which we name Noblene, is the only structure in which every atom is surrounded exclusively by unlike species, and it is dynamically stable and metallic, and carries a Poisson's ratio above one half, higher than that of any of the three pure monolayers. Since Noblene sits on the lattice that Goldene already realizes, the route that produced Goldene is a plausible starting point for its synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“结合穷举枚举与密度泛函理论（density functional theory）”，并涉及“拟合模型”与“计算能量”，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维有序 Au-Ag-Cu 单层合金（monolayer alloys），即基于 Goldene（单原子厚金片）的密排晶格上的三元合金体系，重点关注不同原子排列的有序超结构及其能量学、力学与电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 合金中原子排列方式（而非组分比例）主导混合能：同一组分的不同有序排列能量差异可达相邻组分间能量台阶的数倍，甚至可改变混合能的符号；其中一种等摩尔有序结构（命名为 Noblene）是唯一每个原子仅被异种原子包围的结构，具有动态稳定性、金属性，且泊松比高于 0.5，超过三种纯金属单层。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：合金中原子排列方式（而非组分比例）主导混合能：同一组分的不同有序排列能量差异可达相邻组分间能量台阶的数倍，甚至可改变混合能的符号；其中一种等摩尔有序结构（命名为 Noblene）是唯一每个原子仅被异种原子包围的结构，具有动态稳定性、金属性，且泊松比高于 0.5，超过三种纯金属单层。；创新点：首次系统性地穷举映射 Au-Ag-Cu 单层合金的有序相图，揭示了二维与体相中化学键合强度并非均匀缩放（Au-Cu 在单层中比在晶体中更强，而另两种相互作用减弱）；并发现具有超高泊松比（>0.5）的稳定金属性单层结构 Noblene，其合成路径可借鉴 Goldene 的化学剥离法。
papers.method_zh: 采用“穷举枚举衍生物超结构”方法，结合密度泛函理论（DFT）对所有对称不等价的、每原胞最多四个原子的排列进行结构弛豫；对更大原胞结构，用拟合模型筛选后扩展计算。此外，构建了“配对模型 + 弹性尺寸失配项”来复现能量，并计算了体相焓作为对比。

papers.title: Response of a Model Glass to Athermal Quasistatic Pinching
papers.abstract: We numerically investigate the mechanical response of amorphous solids to localized force dipoles, referred to as pinching, using athermal quasistatic simulations of model glasses with varying degrees of stability. We employ a control parameter, the imposed extension, corresponding to the increase in rest length between the two pinched particles relative to their initial separation. Increasing this extension allows us to continuously tune the system from the elastic to the plastic regime. For small extensions, the response remains elastic. In this regime, the displacement field induced by pinching is well described by linear elasticity and exhibits a long-range power-law decay consistent with dipolar forcing. Averaged responses display anisotropic, quadrupolar-like patterns, with quantitative agreement between simulations and analytical predictions. This continuum description remains valid down to particle-scale distances. As the imposed extension increases, the response becomes plastic. Pinching can then trigger either localized or system-spanning rearrangements, depending on glass stability. Well-annealed glasses exhibit localized plastic events, whereas poorly annealed systems display delocalized cascades. We introduce a method to extract the principal axis of plastic deformation and analyze the associated displacement fields and plastic activity. Overall, our results demonstrate that pinching provides a minimal local probe of amorphous solids. The resulting response, governed by both glass stability and imposed extension, offers insight into the interplay between elasticity, elementary rearrangements, and the emergence of collective plasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically investigate”“athermal quasistatic simulations of model glasses”。；研究对象：非晶固体（模型玻璃）在局域力偶（pinching，即对两个粒子施加可控的拉伸）作用下的力学响应，涵盖从弹性到塑性变形、以及不同玻璃稳定性（退火程度）下的塑性重排行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 小拉伸下玻璃对局域力偶的响应为弹性，位移场符合线性弹性理论的偶极长程幂律衰减，且该连续介质描述在粒子尺度仍成立；大拉伸下响应变为塑性，退火良好的玻璃发生局域塑性事件，而退火不良的玻璃则出现系统尺度的级联重排。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：小拉伸下玻璃对局域力偶的响应为弹性，位移场符合线性弹性理论的偶极长程幂律衰减，且该连续介质描述在粒子尺度仍成立；大拉伸下响应变为塑性，退火良好的玻璃发生局域塑性事件，而退火不良的玻璃则出现系统尺度的级联重排。；创新点：首次系统性地将局域力偶（pinching）作为非晶固体的最小局域探针，揭示了响应从弹性到塑性的连续转变，并展示了玻璃稳定性如何决定塑性事件是局域还是系统尺度级联——这为理解弹性、单元重排与集体塑性之间的相互作用提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡准静态（athermal quasistatic）剪切/加载模拟，通过控制“施加伸长量”（两被夹持粒子间静止长度相对初始间距的增加）作为控制参数，连续调节系统从弹性到塑性区；并引入方法提取塑性变形主轴，分析位移场与塑性活动。玻璃稳定性通过不同退火程度来调节。

papers.title: Topological Lithography via External Field: Creating Topological States Anywhere Beyond the Edge
papers.abstract: Topological insulators (TIs), recognized for their robust boundary states and unconventional phase transitions, have emerged as one of the most impactful discoveries in recent decades, attracting considerable interest across diverse fields. However, conventional TIs require topological contrasts between adjacent bulk regions, typically achieved by distinct symmetries, which limits their flexibility and broader applicability. In this work, we introduce a "lithography" approach to inducing topological states by applying external fields in time-reversal-symmetric systems. These states transcend the conventional bulk topology design paradigm and offer exceptional tunability: they can exist at geometric edges, within the bulk, or even be induced remotely. Because the external field is highly controllable, the induced states are programmable, reconfigurable, and can be easily tailored into desirable patterns. Theoretically, we demonstrate that the external field modifies the Jackiw-Rebbi mechanism, inducing a real-space topological transition characterized by a local topological marker (LTM). We further establish an extended valley bulk-edge correspondence, which explains both the conventional scenario and our findings. Our results, validated across mechanical, electronic, and acoustic platforms, highlight the broad applicability of this approach to various systems. This work not only advances the theory of topology but also enhances the diversity, tunability, and practical implementation of topological states and materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，兼有跨平台验证的混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“Theoretically, we demonstrate...”，以及“validated across mechanical, electronic, and acoustic platforms”。；研究对象：时间反演对称系统中由外部场诱导的拓扑态，涵盖力学、电子和声学三类平台中的拓扑边界态与体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加外部场，可在时间反演对称系统中任意位置（几何边界、体内部乃至远程区域）诱导出可编程、可重构的拓扑态，突破了传统拓扑绝缘体依赖相邻体区域间对称性差异的设计范式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加外部场，可在时间反演对称系统中任意位置（几何边界、体内部乃至远程区域）诱导出可编程、可重构的拓扑态，突破了传统拓扑绝缘体依赖相邻体区域间对称性差异的设计范式。；创新点：提出“拓扑光刻”（topological lithography）概念，利用高度可控的外部场在任意空间位置“写入”拓扑态，实现拓扑态的空间图案化与远程诱导，显著提升拓扑态的可调性与实用性；并建立了统一解释传统与新型拓扑现象的扩展谷体-边界对应。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Jackiw-Rebbi机制的修正与推广，引入实空间拓扑转变及局域拓扑标记（LTM）进行表征；建立了扩展的谷体-边界对应关系（extended valley bulk-edge correspondence）。验证平台涵盖力学、电子与声学系统（摘要未明确说明具体实验或数值手段，如是否使用有限元模拟或输运计算）。

papers.title: Electronic Structure and Superconductivity in La$_{1.55}$Sr$_{0.45}$CuO$_4$/La$_2$CuO$_4$ Artificial High-$T_c$ Superlattices Probed by Hard and Soft X-ray Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In La$_{1.55}$Sr$_{0.45}$CuO$_4$/La$_2$CuO$_4$ (LSCO/LCO) artificial high-$T_c$ superlattices (AHTS), grown by quantum material design, the superconducting dome can be tuned by varying the geometric ratio $L/d$, where $L$ is the LCO layer thickness and $d$ is the superlattice nanoscale period. Here, we combine hard X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (HAXPES) and polarization-dependent soft X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) to probe how the electronic structure evolves across the $L/d$-tuned superconducting dome. We observe systematic chemical-potential evolution across the series, together with enhanced spectral weight near the Fermi level, enhanced local and non-local screening signatures, and increased in-plane orbital polarization near the top of the dome. Together, these spectroscopic signatures provide insight into the emergence of Fano-Feshbach resonant superconductivity in the LSCO/LCO AHTS series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）和偏振依赖软X射线吸收谱（XAS）进行测量。；研究对象：人工设计的高温超导超晶格La₁.₅₅Sr₀.₄₅CuO₄/La₂CuO₄（LSCO/LCO），具体研究其电子结构随几何参数L/d（L为LCO层厚度，d为超晶格纳米周期）调制的超导穹顶的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在LSCO/LCO人工高温超导超晶格中，随着L/d调制的超导穹顶接近顶部，体系出现费米能级附近谱权重增强、局域与非局域屏蔽特征增强以及面内轨道极化增大等系统性电子结构变化，这些光谱特征为理解该体系中涌现的Fano-Feshbach共振超导机制提供了线索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在LSCO/LCO人工高温超导超晶格中，随着L/d调制的超导穹顶接近顶部，体系出现费米能级附近谱权重增强、局域与非局域屏蔽特征增强以及面内轨道极化增大等系统性电子结构变化，这些光谱特征为理解该体系中涌现的Fano-Feshbach共振超导机制提供了线索。；创新点：首次将HAXPES与偏振依赖XAS相结合，系统追踪了L/d调制的超导穹顶跨越过程中电子结构（化学势、谱权重、屏蔽效应、轨道极化）的连续演化，并将这些光谱特征与Fano-Feshbach共振超导机制建立联系。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：硬X射线光电子能谱（HAXPES）用于探测化学势和费米能级附近谱权重；偏振依赖软X射线吸收谱（XAS）用于探测局域/非局域屏蔽特征和面内轨道极化。样品通过量子材料设计方法生长。

papers.title: Liquid-liquid phase transitions in dipolar liquids. Insights into Supercooled Water
papers.abstract: Dipolar liquids combine two coupled degrees of freedom, translational and dipolar. Intriguingly, these two sectors can reside in distinct thermodynamic states, with the state of one sector possibly favoring a specific state of the other. The onset of ferroelectric order in dipolar liquids is an example of this mutual stabilization. Since this coupling is often encoded in interaction potentials, projecting out one sector to derive an effective interaction for the other can uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying this phenomenon. A coarse-grained theory in which the distance between nearest-neighbor particles depends on their dipolar interaction through a density-dependent mechanical compliance shows that a ferroelectric transition can trigger a liquid-liquid transition. It also predicts a first-order liquid-liquid transition in the paraelectric phase that can in turn induce ferroelectric ordering. The anisotropic dipolar-dependent soft-core interaction is shown to lead to an effective Jagla-like isotropic two-length-scale interaction, known to support liquid-liquid phase transitions. Here, however, the two-length-scale pattern depends on density and dipolar configuration, becoming sensitive to dipolar order. Analysis of supercooled TIP4P/Ice water numerical simulations shows that first-coordination-shell features of pair correlation functions are sensitive to dipolar interaction, supporting the coarse-grained theory foundations. Comparison of low- and high-density liquid water reveals enhanced spatial anisotropy of the first coordination shell in the low-density liquid, with increased effective excluded volume, showing that the liquid-liquid transition involves structural changes within the first shell, beyond reorganization of the interstitial region and tetrahedral order. These findings point to a role for dipolar interactions in supercooled water liquid-liquid phase transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含粗粒化理论建模与数值模拟分析）。判断依据：coarse-grained theory、numerical simulations。；研究对象：偶极液体中的液-液相变，以及该相变与铁电序的耦合；并以过冷水（TIP4P/Ice 模型）为具体分析对象，探讨偶极相互作用在过冷水液-液相变中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偶极液体的铁电转变可以触发液-液相变，反之顺电相中的一级液-液相变也可诱导铁电有序；在过冷水中，液-液相变伴随第一配位壳层内结构变化（空间各向异性增强、有效排除体积增大），表明偶极相互作用在过冷水液-液相变中扮演重要角色。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偶极液体的铁电转变可以触发液-液相变，反之顺电相中的一级液-液相变也可诱导铁电有序；在过冷水中，液-液相变伴随第一配位壳层内结构变化（空间各向异性增强、有效排除体积增大），表明偶极相互作用在过冷水液-液相变中扮演重要角色。；创新点：提出偶极自由度与平动自由度通过密度依赖的力学柔量相互耦合的粗粒化框架，揭示了偶极序与液-液相变之间的双向触发机制；并首次指出过冷水液-液相变涉及第一配位壳层内部的结构各向异性变化，而非仅局限于间隙区重组和四面体序的改变。
papers.method_zh: 构建粗粒化理论，其中最近邻粒子间距通过密度依赖的力学柔量（mechanical compliance）与偶极相互作用耦合；推导出有效的各向同性 Jagla 型双尺度相互作用势；并对 TIP4P/Ice 过冷水分子动力学模拟数据进行分析，考察第一配位壳层的对关联函数特征。

papers.title: Survival in a partially reactive wedge
papers.abstract: We investigate the power-law decay of the survival probability of a Brownian particle diffusing in an infinite planar wedge whose two sides are partially reactive and described by Robin boundary conditions. We employ matched asymptotic analysis to relate the long-time asymptotics to a stationary harmonic Robin problem near the apex. This approach determines the persistence exponent for arbitrary opening angles and yields the prefactor explicitly for the family of wedges with $α=π/n$ ($n=1,2,\ldots$). A simple extension of the apex prefactor to arbitrary angles is conjectured and supported numerically. This asymptotic behavior describes the crossover to the well-known result for perfectly absorbing wedges. As immediate applications, we also deduce the long-time behavior of the probability density function of the boundary local time on wedge sides, as well as the probability density function of the associated first-crossing time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“matched asymptotic analysis”（匹配渐近分析）、“stationary harmonic Robin problem”（稳态调和Robin问题）、“persistence exponent”（持续指数）等理论推导关键词，且无实验或数值模拟手段描述。；研究对象：在无限平面楔形区域（wedge）内扩散的布朗粒子，楔形两侧为部分反应边界（由Robin边界条件描述），研究其生存概率的幂律衰减行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过匹配渐近分析，将长时间极限下的生存概率与楔尖附近的稳态调和Robin问题联系起来，确定了任意张角下的持续指数，并对α=π/n（n=1,2,…）的楔形族显式给出了前因子；该渐近行为描述了向完全吸收楔形已知结果的交叉过渡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过匹配渐近分析，将长时间极限下的生存概率与楔尖附近的稳态调和Robin问题联系起来，确定了任意张角下的持续指数，并对α=π/n（n=1,2,…）的楔形族显式给出了前因子；该渐近行为描述了向完全吸收楔形已知结果的交叉过渡。；创新点：首次将部分反应（Robin）边界条件下的楔形扩散生存概率问题与楔尖稳态调和问题建立严格渐近联系，给出了任意张角的持续指数及特定角度族的前因子显式表达式，并提出了推广到任意角度的前因子猜想。摘要未突出说明与以往部分反应楔形研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 匹配渐近分析（matched asymptotic analysis），结合稳态调和Robin问题的求解；对任意角度提出了前因子的简单外推猜想，并用数值方法支持该猜想。

papers.title: XPCS-Echo and broad relaxation measurements using a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme
papers.abstract: Echoes observed in the intensity-intensity autocorrelation functions [$g_2(q, τ)$] is a powerful method for probing nonaffine deformations and yielding behavior of soft viscoelastic materials subjected to an oscillatory shear. Multispeckle X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS) measurements of large number of echoes with high time resolution impose severe constraints in terms of the computational hardware and potential degradation of the sample. These issues are alleviated by implementing a bunch-mode data acquisition scheme in which the highest resolution frames or bunches centered at the echo peaks. In addition, by placing the bunches in an aperiodic Fibonacci sequence, $g_2(q, τ)$ over a long time span can be measured with orders of magnitude lesser number of frames. The performance of these XPCS acquisition schemes is demonstrated using slowly relaxing model colloidal suspensions. Furthermore, an analytical expression is provided for the quantitative description of full $g_2(q, τ)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验测量方案（XPCS测量）、数据采集实现及对模型胶体悬浮液的实验演示。；研究对象：软粘弹性材料在振荡剪切下的非仿射形变与屈服行为，具体测量体系为缓慢弛豫的模型胶体悬浮液。物理现象为强度-强度自相关函数中的“回声”（echoes）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将数据采集帧（bunches）集中在回声峰附近，并采用非周期斐波那契序列放置bunches，可在大幅减少采集帧数的同时，实现高时间分辨率的多次回声测量，并给出完整$g_2(q, τ)$的解析表达式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将数据采集帧（bunches）集中在回声峰附近，并采用非周期斐波那契序列放置bunches，可在大幅减少采集帧数的同时，实现高时间分辨率的多次回声测量，并给出完整$g_2(q, τ)$的解析表达式。；创新点：提出束团模式XPCS采集方案，将最高时间分辨率帧仅置于回声峰附近，并利用斐波那契序列实现长时间跨度测量，使所需帧数降低数个数量级，同时缓解计算硬件压力和样品损伤问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 多散斑X射线光子相关光谱（XPCS），结合束团模式（bunch-mode）数据采集方案；采用斐波那契序列非周期放置高时间分辨率帧；对模型胶体悬浮液进行实验验证；提供解析表达式定量描述完整$g_2(q, τ)$。

papers.title: Dynamical stabilisation of a quantum fluid using a single topological defect
papers.abstract: The size and shape of a quantum fluid in equilibrium is strongly influenced by the inter-particle interactions. In the attractive interaction regime, atomic quantum fluids ultimately collapse in a violent process that expels most of the particles from the macroscopically occupied state. Here, we use a quantum fluid of light in propagating geometry as an analogue to a two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) with large attractive interactions to show that non-trivial topology significantly alters the dynamical behaviour of the collapse, enhancing the BEC stability and delaying the collapse time by an order of magnitude. We measure direct experimental signatures of topology affecting quantum hydrodynamics, unveiling the inherent competition between attractive nonlinearities, that lead to the collapse, and the preservation of topological charge from a multi-charged vortex. We fully characterise the collapse process in coordinate space and the eventual `solitonification' of the system and connect it to the mode structure of the excitation spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：We measure direct experimental signatures，使用量子流体实验平台，结合理论分析）。；研究对象：传播几何中的光子量子流体，作为具有大吸引相互作用的二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的类比体系；核心物理现象为吸引相互作用诱导的坍缩动力学与多电荷涡旋拓扑荷之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非平庸拓扑（多电荷涡旋）显著改变吸引BEC的坍缩动力学行为，将坍缩时间延迟约一个数量级，从而增强凝聚体稳定性；系统最终经历“孤子化”（solitonification）过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非平庸拓扑（多电荷涡旋）显著改变吸引BEC的坍缩动力学行为，将坍缩时间延迟约一个数量级，从而增强凝聚体稳定性；系统最终经历“孤子化”（solitonification）过程。；创新点：首次直接实验观测到拓扑荷对量子流体动力学（坍缩过程）的调控作用，揭示了吸引非线性（驱动坍缩）与多电荷涡旋拓扑荷保持之间的内在竞争，并将坍缩后的“孤子化”现象与激发谱模结构建立联系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用传播几何中的光子量子流体（量子流体光）模拟二维吸引BEC；通过坐标空间成像完整表征坍缩过程，并结合激发谱的模结构分析连接坍缩动力学与拓扑荷守恒。

papers.title: Spin Hall Magnetoresistance in Antiferromagnetic Insulators
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnetic materials promise improved performance for spintronic applications, as they are robust against external magnetic field perturbations and allow for faster magnetization dynamics compared to ferromagnets. The direct observation of the antiferromagnetic state, however, is challenging due to the absence of a macroscopic magnetization. We show that the spin Hall magnetoresistance (SMR) is a versatile tool to probe the antiferromagnetic spin structure via simple electrical transport experiments by investigating the easy-plane antiferromagnetic insulators alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite) and NiO in bilayer heterostructures with a Pt heavy-metal top electrode. While rotating an external magnetic field in three orthogonal planes, we record the longitudinal and the transverse resistivities of Pt and observe characteristic resistivity modulations consistent with the SMR effect. We analyze both their amplitude and phase and compare the data to the results from a prototypical collinear ferrimagnetic Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayer. The observed magnetic field dependence is explained in a comprehensive model, based on two magnetic sublattices and taking into account magnetic field-induced modifications of the domain structure. Our results show that the SMR effect allows to readout the spin configuration and to investigate magnetoelastic effects in antiferromagnetic multi-domain materials. We demonstrate that the SMR amplitude scales with the sum of the absolute sublattice magnetizations in ferrimagnetic and antiferromagnetic materials. In alpha-Fe2O3/Pt bilayers, we find an unexpectedly large SMR amplitude of 2.5E-3, twice as high as for prototype Y3Fe5O12/Pt bilayers, making the system particularly interesting for room-temperature antiferromagnetic spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对双层异质结的输运测量实验（“electrical transport experiments”），并记录了电阻率数据。；研究对象：易面型反铁磁绝缘体 α-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）和 NiO 与重金属 Pt 构成的双层异质结，以及作为对比的亚铁磁 Y3Fe5O12/Pt 双层结构。研究物理现象为自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）及其对反铁磁自旋结构的探测能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）可通过简单电输运实验有效读出反铁磁绝缘体的自旋结构；在 α-Fe2O3/Pt 双层中观察到异常大的 SMR 振幅（2.5×10⁻³），是原型 Y3Fe5O12/Pt 双层体系的两倍，表明该体系在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中具有应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋霍尔磁电阻（SMR）可通过简单电输运实验有效读出反铁磁绝缘体的自旋结构；在 α-Fe2O3/Pt 双层中观察到异常大的 SMR 振幅（2.5×10⁻³），是原型 Y3Fe5O12/Pt 双层体系的两倍，表明该体系在室温反铁磁自旋电子学中具有应用潜力。；创新点：将 SMR 效应推广应用于反铁磁绝缘体（α-Fe2O3 和 NiO），证明其可作为探测反铁磁自旋结构及磁弹效应的通用工具；发现 SMR 振幅与铁磁/反铁磁材料中绝对子晶格磁化强度之和成比例，并在 α-Fe2O3/Pt 中观察到远超传统体系的 SMR 振幅。
papers.method_zh: 实验上，在三个正交平面内旋转外磁场，同时测量 Pt 层的纵向和横向电阻率，分析 SMR 效应的振幅与相位；理论上，基于两个磁子晶格模型，并考虑磁场对磁畴结构的修正，对磁场依赖关系进行了综合建模解释。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Magnon Hanle Effect in Antiferromagnetic $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$
papers.abstract: The precession of the magnon pseudospin about the equilibrium pseudofield, the latter capturing the nature of magnonic eigenexcitations in an antiferromagnet, gives rise to the magnon Hanle effect. Its realization via electrically injected and detected spin transport in an antiferromagnetic insulator demonstrates its high potential for devices and as a convenient probe for magnon eigenmodes and the underlying spin interactions in the antiferromagnet. Here, we observe a non-reciprocity in the Hanle signal measured in alpha-Fe2O3 using two spatially separated Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector. Interchanging their roles alters the detected magnon spin signal. The recorded difference depends on the applied magnetic field and reverses sign when the signal passes its nominal maximum at the so-called compensation field. Our findings unlock the high potential of antiferromagnetic magnonics towards the realization of electronics-inspired phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we observe”“measured”“Pt electrodes as spin injector and detector”等实验描述。；研究对象：反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe₂O₃（赤铁矿）中的磁振子（magnon）自旋输运，具体为磁振子赝自旋在赝有效场中的进动所导致的磁振子Hanle效应，以及该效应的非互易性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在α-Fe₂O₃中利用两个空间分离的Pt电极分别作为自旋注入器和探测器时，观察到Hanle信号的非互易性——互换两个电极的角色会改变探测到的磁振子自旋信号。该差异依赖于外加磁场，并在信号经过标称最大值（即补偿场）时发生符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在α-Fe₂O₃中利用两个空间分离的Pt电极分别作为自旋注入器和探测器时，观察到Hanle信号的非互易性——互换两个电极的角色会改变探测到的磁振子自旋信号。该差异依赖于外加磁场，并在信号经过标称最大值（即补偿场）时发生符号反转。；创新点：首次在反铁磁磁振子系统中观察到Hanle信号的非互易性，并发现该非互易性与补偿场相关，展示了反铁磁磁振子学中实现类电子学（electronics-inspired）非互易现象的潜力。摘要未明确说明与已有反铁磁Hanle实验相比的具体理论机制差异。
papers.method_zh: 电注入/电探测的自旋输运实验：使用两个空间分离的Pt电极（一个作为自旋注入器，一个作为探测器）在反铁磁绝缘体α-Fe₂O₃中进行非局域自旋输运测量，通过互换电极角色并扫描外加磁场来记录Hanle信号。

papers.title: Colossal reversible conductivity switching by room-temperature oxygen-vacancy ordering in Aurivillius oxide films
papers.abstract: Oxygen vacancies are central to the functionality of oxides, yet they typically exist as randomly distributed point defects, limiting the ability to precisely manipulate their collective behavior. Here, we report the room-temperature formation of a long-range-ordered oxygen-vacancy superstructure in single-crystalline Aurivillius-phase Bi2WO6 thin films via a mild nitrogen-plasma treatment. This structural transformation unlocks a colossal, reversible modulation of electrical conductivity by more than nine orders of magnitude, accompanied by a striking optical transition from transparent to black. Atomic-resolution imaging and spectroscopy reveal that the vacancies selectively order within the perovskite-like tungsten oxide layers, forming a coherent defect lattice that is absent in the pristine film. Oxygen-plasma treatment removes the vacancy superstructure and restores the initial state, whereas subsequent nitrogen-plasma treatment reconstructs it, enabling repeatable room-temperature switching between distinct structural, electronic and optical states. The phenomenon is also observed in another Aurivillius member, Bi2MoO6, suggesting its generality across the Aurivillius family. These findings establish a new paradigm for atomic-scale defect engineering - using gentle plasma chemistry to construct ordered defect lattices, opening avenues for reversible property modulation in complex oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“氮等离子体处理”“氧等离子体处理”“原子级成像与光谱”“电导率测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：Aurivillius相单晶Bi2WO6薄膜，以及同族Bi2MoO6薄膜中的氧空位有序化现象及其对电学、光学性质的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过室温氮等离子体处理，可在Bi2WO6薄膜中形成长程有序的氧空位超结构，实现超过九个数量级的可逆电导率开关，并伴随透明—黑色的光学转变；该现象在Bi2MoO6中同样存在，具有Aurivillius家族普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过室温氮等离子体处理，可在Bi2WO6薄膜中形成长程有序的氧空位超结构，实现超过九个数量级的可逆电导率开关，并伴随透明—黑色的光学转变；该现象在Bi2MoO6中同样存在，具有Aurivillius家族普适性。；创新点：首次在室温下利用温和等离子体化学在Aurivillius氧化物中构建长程有序的氧空位超结构（而非随机点缺陷），实现可逆、巨幅（>10^9）的电导率开关，为复杂氧化物中原子级缺陷工程提供了新范式。摘要未突出说明与以往氧空位调控工作的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 温和氮等离子体处理（室温）诱导氧空位有序化；氧等离子体处理用于消除有序结构并恢复初始态；原子级分辨成像与光谱（如STEM/EDS/EELS类技术，摘要未给出具体名称）用于表征空位选择性有序排列；电导率测量与光学透射/吸收观测用于追踪状态切换。

papers.title: Pure FENE Bond Potential for Soft Matter and Biological Simulations: Theory, HOOMD-blue Implementation, and Applications to Polymer, Colloidal, and Membrane Systems
papers.abstract: The finitely extensible nonlinear elastic (FENE) potential is widely used as a bonded interaction in coarse-grained simulations of polymers, soft matter, colloids, and biological systems. In the classical Kremer--Grest framework, FENE bonding is combined with a short-range Weeks--Chandler--Andersen (WCA) interaction to provide finite bond extensibility together with excluded-volume repulsion. Although this combination is highly successful, it intrinsically couples bonded elasticity to the nonbonded interaction, limiting the ability to independently control these two contributions. Here, we introduce a standalone FENE bond potential in HOOMD-blue in which finite bond extensibility is implemented independently of the choice of nonbonded interaction. This formulation allows the same FENE bond potential to be combined with WCA, Lennard--Jones, or other pair interactions without modifying the bonded interaction itself. We demonstrate the utility of the standalone formulation in coarse-grained polymer chains, colloidal networks, and mesh-based biological membrane models. Across these systems, Pure FENE bonding without short-range excluded-volume stabilization produces pronounced structural contraction, whereas the addition of WCA repulsion suppresses this collapse and preserves finite, spatially extended structures. These results demonstrate that separating finite bond extensibility from steric interactions provides independent control over local bond mechanics and collective structural organization. The standalone FENE formulation therefore provides a modular framework for coarse-grained simulations in which molecular connectivity and nonbonded interactions represent distinct physical mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“HOOMD-blue implementation”（模拟代码实现）、“coarse-grained simulations”（粗粒化模拟），属于典型的分子模拟方法学研究。；研究对象：软物质与生物体系中的粗粒化模型，具体包括聚合物链（polymer chains）、胶体网络（colloidal networks）和基于网格的生物膜模型（mesh-based biological membrane models）。核心物理对象是FENE键合势（finitely extensible nonlinear elastic potential）及其与空间排斥相互作用的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将有限键伸缩性（FENE势）与非键合空间排斥（WCA势）解耦后，纯FENE键合（无短程排斥稳定化）会导致体系发生显著的结构收缩；而加入WCA排斥后，这种塌缩被抑制，体系保持有限、空间延展的结构。这表明键合弹性与空间排斥的独立控制是可行的，且对集体结构组织有决定性影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将有限键伸缩性（FENE势）与非键合空间排斥（WCA势）解耦后，纯FENE键合（无短程排斥稳定化）会导致体系发生显著的结构收缩；而加入WCA排斥后，这种塌缩被抑制，体系保持有限、空间延展的结构。这表明键合弹性与空间排斥的独立控制是可行的，且对集体结构组织有决定性影响。；创新点：打破了经典Kremer-Grest框架中FENE键合必须与WCA排斥耦合使用的惯例，首次在HOOMD-blue中实现了可独立于非键合相互作用的纯FENE键合势，为粗粒化模拟提供了模块化的键合-非键合分离框架。摘要未突出说明该实现的具体算法细节或性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合分子动力学模拟。具体为：在HOOMD-blue模拟软件中实现独立的（standalone）FENE键合势，使其不依赖于非键合相互作用的选择；将该势分别与WCA、Lennard-Jones等对势组合，在粗粒化聚合物链、胶体网络和膜模型中进行对比模拟测试。

papers.title: Thermodynamic optimization of thermal landscapes and energy barriers in a Brownian heat engine
papers.abstract: Spatial temperature fields in Brownian heat engines are commonly prescribed \emph{a priori}, and the resulting transport and thermodynamic properties are then calculated. Here we formulate the complementary inverse-design problem: determining the temperature profile and barrier height that optimize a chosen thermodynamic objective. We consider an overdamped Brownian particle in a symmetric triangular periodic potential under a constant opposing load and derive the exact stationary current and probability density for an arbitrary bounded temperature field, $\Tc\le T(x)\le\Th$. In the quasistatic limit, the efficiency becomes an exact functional of two inverse-temperature integrals over the uphill and downhill branches. Its rigorous global maximum under the pointwise temperature bounds is $η_{\max}=1-\Tc/\Th$, attained uniquely, up to sets of measure zero, by the hot-uphill/cold-downhill piecewise-constant profile. At finite current, however, the optimization changes qualitatively because the current is determined jointly by the cycle affinity and a nonlocal transport resistance. We derive the exact functional gradient and the corresponding box-constrained optimality conditions, showing that the current- or power-maximizing profile generally differs from the quasistatic efficiency optimum. For any prescribed temperature field, the current-maximizing barrier satisfies an exact balance between the marginal gain in thermal rectification and the marginal increase in transport resistance, with the characteristic estimate $U_0^*\simeq T_{\rm act}$, where $T_{\rm act}^{-1}=(2/L)\int_0^{L/2}\dd x/T(x)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“formulate the complementary inverse-design problem”“derive the exact stationary current”“rigorous global maximum”等理论推导与优化分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：布朗热机中的过阻尼布朗粒子，处于对称三角周期势中，并施加恒定反向负载；研究空间温度场（温度分布）与势垒高度对热机性能的优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准静态极限下，效率的全局最大值严格为 η_max = 1 − T_c/T_h，唯一（除零测集外）由“热端上坡/冷端下坡”的分段常数温度分布实现；但在有限电流下，电流或功率最优的温度分布与准静态效率最优不同，且电流最大化的势垒高度满足 U_0^* ≈ T_act（T_act 为沿上坡分支的逆温度平均）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准静态极限下，效率的全局最大值严格为 η_max = 1 − T_c/T_h，唯一（除零测集外）由“热端上坡/冷端下坡”的分段常数温度分布实现；但在有限电流下，电流或功率最优的温度分布与准静态效率最优不同，且电流最大化的势垒高度满足 U_0^* ≈ T_act（T_act 为沿上坡分支的逆温度平均）。；创新点：将布朗热机研究中常见的“给定温度场→计算输运性质”的正问题，反转为“给定热力学目标→优化温度场与势垒”的逆设计问题；揭示了准静态效率最优与有限电流功率最优在温度分布上的本质差异，并给出电流最大化势垒的精确标度估计。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：对任意有界温度场 T_c ≤ T(x) ≤ T_h，精确求解过阻尼 Langevin 动力学对应的稳态电流与概率密度；在准静态极限下将效率写成两个逆温度积分的泛函；对有限电流情形，推导精确的泛函梯度及箱约束最优性条件，并建立势垒高度的最优平衡条件。

papers.title: The Universal Role of Fragility on the Yielding Transition of Active Glass under Oscillatory Shear
papers.abstract: The yielding transition marks the onset of irreversible plastic deformation in amorphous solids and plays a central role in determining the mechanical stability and failure of metallic glasses, colloidal suspensions, and biological assemblies. Despite extensive research, the microscopic factors governing the nature of yielding, particularly the transition between brittle and ductile mechanical responses, remain poorly understood. Recent studies have identified kinetic fragility as a key parameter governing yielding in passive glasses; whether this connection persists in active glasses remains open. Here, using molecular dynamics simulations of a Kob-Andersen glass former doped with Run-and-Tumble (RTP) active particles under oscillatory shear, we show that activity systematically reduces kinetic fragility and consequently alters the mechanical response. The common yield point $γ_c$ decreases monotonically with activity and exhibits a power-law dependence on the Arrhenius activation barrier. Increasing activity suppresses the dependence of the yield strain on thermal history and transforms the response from brittle-like to increasingly ductile, with smoother stress relaxation and reduced stress discontinuities. The timescale to reach steady state near yielding retains a critical power-law divergence, indicating that activity does not alter the underlying critical character of the transition. Active glasses also develop broader, more diffuse shear bands. Our results establish kinetic fragility as a unifying parameter governing yielding in both passive and active glasses and demonstrate that activity offers a powerful route to tune the mechanical response of amorphous materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：主动玻璃（active glass）在振荡剪切下的屈服转变（yielding transition），具体体系为掺杂了Run-and-Tumble（RTP）活性粒子的Kob-Andersen玻璃形成体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性（activity）系统地降低了玻璃的动力学脆度（kinetic fragility），从而将屈服响应从脆性转变为延性；屈服点γ_c随活性单调下降，并与Arrhenius活化势垒呈幂律关系。动力学脆度被确立为统一描述被动与主动玻璃屈服行为的核心参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性（activity）系统地降低了玻璃的动力学脆度（kinetic fragility），从而将屈服响应从脆性转变为延性；屈服点γ_c随活性单调下降，并与Arrhenius活化势垒呈幂律关系。动力学脆度被确立为统一描述被动与主动玻璃屈服行为的核心参数。；创新点：首次将动力学脆度（fragility）这一概念从被动玻璃推广到主动玻璃体系，证明活性可作为调控非晶材料力学响应（脆-韧转变）的有效手段，且不改变屈服转变的临界本质。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，具体为对Kob-Andersen玻璃形成体掺杂Run-and-Tumble（RTP）活性粒子，施加振荡剪切（oscillatory shear），分析屈服应变、应力松弛、剪切带形貌及接近屈服时的弛豫时间标度。

papers.title: Multivariate hyperdensity functional theory for inhomogeneous equilibrium fluids: From first principles to simulation-based machine learning
papers.abstract: Hyperdensity functional theory facilitates the investigation of the equilibrium behavior of a general order parameter or statistical mechanical observable in spatially inhomogeneous classical many-body systems. The approach is based on applying the exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping to an extended ensemble. Here we present the multivariate generalization for investigating simultaneously the properties and interrelations of several different hyperobservables of choice. The resulting framework gives rise to a systematic characterization and prediction scheme for general many-body phenomena. All pertinent equilibrium averages, variances, and covariances constitute universal density functionals, as we demonstrate explicitly. Associated one-body hyperfluctuation profiles quantify the degree of correlation of the local density with first- and second-order combinations of hyperobservables. These multivariate hyperfluctuation profiles are accessible in many-body simulations and they satisfy exact hyper-Ornstein-Zernike equations, which we derive from the minimization principle in the extended multivariate ensemble. The formal structure of the theory integrates naturally with supervised machine learning, which renders all hyperdensity functionals accessible in practice via training of neural networks on simulation data. We demonstrate all salient techniques using the illustrative case of clustering in confined hard rod fluids, thereby choosing the total number of particles and the largest cluster size as the representative hyperobservables of interest. Our numerical methodology enables the efficient and successful prediction of all statistical quantities induced by the chosen hyperobservables, which we verify via comparison to test data and which we attribute to the tight interplay of first-principles and machine-learning concepts that our general approach combines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算/机器学习方法）。判断依据：摘要强调“exact Mermin-Evans classical density functional mapping”“minimization principle”“derive”“formal structure”，以及“training of neural networks on simulation data”。；研究对象：非均匀经典多体系统（inhomogeneous classical many-body systems）中的平衡态性质，具体演示体系为受限硬棒流体（confined hard rod fluids）中的团簇化（clustering）现象，选取的总粒子数和最大团簇尺寸为超观测量（hyperobservables）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了多变量超密度泛函理论（multivariate hyperdensity functional theory），证明所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差均为普适密度泛函，并推导出精确的超Ornstein-Zernike方程；通过神经网络训练，该理论可高效预测由所选超观测量诱导的全部统计量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了多变量超密度泛函理论（multivariate hyperdensity functional theory），证明所有相关的平衡平均值、方差和协方差均为普适密度泛函，并推导出精确的超Ornstein-Zernike方程；通过神经网络训练，该理论可高效预测由所选超观测量诱导的全部统计量。；创新点：将密度泛函理论从单一超观测量推广到多个超观测量同时处理，并系统引入多变量超涨落分布（multivariate hyperfluctuation profiles）；将第一性原理形式与机器学习自然结合，使所有超密度泛函在实际中可通过模拟数据训练神经网络获得。摘要未突出说明与已有单变量超密度泛函理论相比的具体技术突破细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为经典密度泛函理论的精确映射（Mermin-Evans映射）在扩展系综中的多变量推广；数值方法为基于多体模拟数据的监督式机器学习（神经网络训练），用于获取超密度泛函；同时从扩展多变量系综的极小化原理出发推导了超Ornstein-Zernike方程。

papers.title: Memory-driven Topological Defects and Unconventional Long-Range Order
papers.abstract: We investigate many-body systems with time-delayed self-interactions mediated by a memory-feedback mechanism. We show that such temporal interactions generate non-equilibrium orders and unique topological defects absent in equilibrium-specifically, helical vortices wherein opposite vorticities propagate in reverse directions along domain walls. In one dimension, memory feedback stabilizes true long-range order against weak noise, thereby circumventing the Mermin-Wagner theorem and resulting in an unconventional finite-temperature phase transition with a dynamical exponent $z = 4$. Physical realizations of these memory-driven non-equilibrium systems using active mechatronic metamaterials has also been proposed. These results demonstrate engineered temporal interactions as a powerful paradigm for non-equilibrium many-body physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟与实验提案）。判断依据：摘要关键词为“We investigate”、“We show”、“has also been proposed”，主要基于理论分析与模型构建，并提出了实验实现方案。；研究对象：具有时间延迟自相互作用（memory-feedback mechanism）的多体系统，即由记忆反馈驱动的非平衡系统。具体物理现象包括非平衡序、拓扑缺陷（螺旋涡旋）以及一维系统中的长程有序和有限温度相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 记忆反馈机制能产生平衡态中不存在的拓扑缺陷——螺旋涡旋，其中相反涡度沿畴壁反向传播；在一维系统中，该机制可抵抗弱噪声稳定真正的长程有序，从而规避Mermin-Wagner定理，并导致具有动力学指数 z = 4 的非常规有限温度相变。
