papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：记忆反馈机制能产生平衡态中不存在的拓扑缺陷——螺旋涡旋，其中相反涡度沿畴壁反向传播；在一维系统中，该机制可抵抗弱噪声稳定真正的长程有序，从而规避Mermin-Wagner定理，并导致具有动力学指数 z = 4 的非常规有限温度相变。；创新点：首次提出“时间延迟相互作用”或“记忆反馈”作为调控多体系统的新范式，展示了其能产生平衡态中不存在的拓扑激发（螺旋涡旋），并能在低维系统中规避Mermin-Wagner定理实现真正的长程有序。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建，具体包括：对一维系统进行噪声影响下的稳定性分析（推导出动力学指数 z = 4），以及对拓扑缺陷结构的理论描述。摘要未明确提及具体的数值模拟方法（如蒙特卡洛或分子动力学），也未给出具体的实验测量手段，但提出了利用主动机电超材料（active mechatronic metamaterials）进行物理实现的方案。

papers.title: Magnetic-Field-Calibration-Free Determination of the Hyperfine Constant $A$ in Ultracold Fermi gases of $^{40}$K
papers.abstract: Hyperfine constant $A$ is a key parameter of the hyperfine structure and underpins precision spectroscopy and metrology. In this Letter, we develop a magnetic-field-calibration-free method for determining the ground-state hyperfine constant $A$ in an ultracold $^{40}$K Fermi gas by utilizing a pair of magnetically insensitive ("clock") transitions. This overcomes the stringent magnetic-field calibration requirements of conventional methods. We measure the transition frequency between these two magnetically insensitive transitions with Hz-level resolution over a range of magnetic fields, and obtain the ground-state hyperfine constant $A = -h\times 285.730536(2)\,\mathrm{MHz}$, corresponding to an absolute uncertainty of about $2\,\mathrm{Hz}$. Our value reduces the uncertainty by nearly three orders of magnitude compared with previous determinations, providing a substantially improved reference for high-precision spectroscopy and metrology with $^{40}$K.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对超冷⁴⁰K费米气体的测量，给出了实验测量频率和不确定度（“Hz-level resolution”“absolute uncertainty”）。；研究对象：超冷⁴⁰K费米气体中的基态超精细结构，具体为超精细常数A的精确测定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用一对磁不敏感（“clock”）跃迁，在无需磁场标定的条件下测得⁴⁰K基态超精细常数A = −h × 285.730536(2) MHz，绝对不确定度约2 Hz，比此前测定值降低了近三个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用一对磁不敏感（“clock”）跃迁，在无需磁场标定的条件下测得⁴⁰K基态超精细常数A = −h × 285.730536(2) MHz，绝对不确定度约2 Hz，比此前测定值降低了近三个数量级。；创新点：提出并实现了无需磁场标定的超精细常数测定方法，克服了传统方法对磁场标定精度的严格要求，并将⁴⁰K基态超精细常数的测量不确定度降低了约三个数量级。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用一对磁不敏感的“clock”跃迁进行频率测量，在一定的磁场范围内以Hz级分辨率测量这两个跃迁之间的频率差，从而消除对磁场标定的依赖。

papers.title: Direct Observation of the Zigzag Edge States of a Supramolecular Diatomic Kagome Lattice
papers.abstract: Lattice geometry plays a fundamental role in the behavior of Bloch electrons in a crystal. The diatomic Kagome lattice, an extension of the honeycomb and Kagome lattices, is predicted to give rise to emergent and topological phenomena, but its experimental investigation has been limited thus far. Here, we fabricate a diatomic Kagome lattice through self-assembly of a triptycene derivative with phenazine moieties (Trip-Phz)---a $\mathrm{C_3}$-symmetric, non-planar $π$-conjugated molecule. Our scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) observations show that Trip-Phz forms a highly ordered diatomic Kagome lattice terminated by zigzag-type edges on the Pb(111) surface. Combined STM measurements and tight-binding calculations provide direct evidence for the existence of the edge states that correspond to those of graphene. These states are topological edge states dictated by the quantization of the Zak phase and the bulk-edge correspondence.This work reveals an ideal platform for exploring quantum materials with unique lattice geometries using supramolecular technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合紧束缚计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) observations”“combined STM measurements and tight-binding calculations”。；研究对象：由三蝶烯衍生物（Trip-Phz，含吩嗪基团的C₃对称非平面π共轭分子）在Pb(111)表面自组装形成的双原子Kagome晶格，及其锯齿型边界态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Pb(111)表面上成功构筑了具有锯齿型边界的高度有序双原子Kagome晶格，并通过STM与紧束缚计算直接证实了对应石墨烯类型的边界态存在；这些边界态是由Zak相位量子化与体-边对应原理决定的拓扑边界态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Pb(111)表面上成功构筑了具有锯齿型边界的高度有序双原子Kagome晶格，并通过STM与紧束缚计算直接证实了对应石墨烯类型的边界态存在；这些边界态是由Zak相位量子化与体-边对应原理决定的拓扑边界态。；创新点：首次在实验上实现了双原子Kagome晶格（此前仅停留在理论预测），并直接观测到其锯齿型边界态，展示了利用超分子自组装技术构筑具有独特晶格几何的量子材料平台的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）用于表面形貌与边界态的直接观测；紧束缚模型计算用于解释实验谱并验证边界态的拓扑起源。

papers.title: All-dry processing of 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators for extreme aspect ratios and high intrinsic quality factor
papers.abstract: Conventional fabrication of suspended nanomechanical resonators typically relies on wet-chemical process steps and critical point drying, which can compromise sample yield and cleanliness. Here, we present an all-dry fabrication process for strongly stressed 3C-SiC nanomechanical string resonators that entirely avoids wet-chemical etching and cleaning. Using a negative-tone electron-beam resist as an etch mask and a three-step reactive-ion etching process for both structuring and release, we achieve high fabrication yield, clean suspended structures, and extreme aspect ratios of 8.500. We perform full mechanical characterization of the resulting doubly-clamped nanostring resonators, and establish a benchmark intrinsic quality factor for dissipation-diluted 3C-SiC of Qintr = 4.200.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述具体制备工艺（电子束光刻、反应离子刻蚀）和机械表征，属于实验研究。；研究对象：3C-SiC（立方碳化硅）纳米机械弦谐振器，具体关注其悬空结构的高深宽比与内禀品质因子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全干法工艺成功制备了强应力3C-SiC纳米弦谐振器，实现高达8,500的极端深宽比，并测得耗散稀释后的内禀品质因子Q_intr = 4,200，为3C-SiC材料体系树立了基准值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全干法工艺成功制备了强应力3C-SiC纳米弦谐振器，实现高达8,500的极端深宽比，并测得耗散稀释后的内禀品质因子Q_intr = 4,200，为3C-SiC材料体系树立了基准值。；创新点：首次实现3C-SiC纳米机械谐振器的全干法制备，彻底规避湿化学工艺带来的产率损失与表面污染问题，同时获得创纪录的深宽比（8,500）和高内禀品质因子（4,200）。
papers.method_zh: 全干法微纳加工：采用负性电子束光刻胶作为刻蚀掩模，结合三步反应离子刻蚀（RIE）完成结构定义与释放，完全避免湿化学刻蚀和临界点干燥；随后对双端固支纳米弦进行完整机械表征以提取品质因子。

papers.title: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
papers.abstract: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B \textbf{35}, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted $\mathrm{{-}C{\equiv}C{-}}$ and $\mathrm{{-}Li{-}F{-}}$ chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“real-space formulation of DFT”“variational set”“calculations”等表述，属于第一性原理计算方法开发与验证。；研究对象：扩展手性体系（extended chiral systems），具体包括线性与扭转的 −C≡C− 链、−Li−F− 链、石墨烯，以及 AA 堆垛石墨和螺旋堆垛 AA 石墨结构。核心物理对象是含有限扭转角的手性/螺旋体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种“Wannier-first”实空间 DFT 方法，可在不自洽循环中显式构造布洛赫态的情况下直接构建局域 Wannier 类函数，并能在与纯平移对称体系几乎相同的计算成本下处理含平移-旋转（螺旋）对称性的手性体系；总能量和能带与参考周期计算高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种“Wannier-first”实空间 DFT 方法，可在不自洽循环中显式构造布洛赫态的情况下直接构建局域 Wannier 类函数，并能在与纯平移对称体系几乎相同的计算成本下处理含平移-旋转（螺旋）对称性的手性体系；总能量和能带与参考周期计算高度一致。；创新点：提出“Wannier-first”策略——直接从局域高斯基函数构造 Wannier 类函数，绕开自洽循环中显式 Bloch 态的计算；方法天然支持平移-旋转（螺旋）对称性，使有限扭转角手性体系的计算成本与纯平移体系相当。此外，该框架为轨道依赖泛函（如 Perdew–Zunger 自相互作用修正）的实现提供了自然基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Pederson 和 Lin 的 formalism（Phys. Rev. B 35, 2273 (1987)），在有限 Wannier 域内自洽生成变分 Wannier 类函数，用于构建电荷密度、静电势和每胞总能；占据空间完全由 Wannier 类函数确定。能带结构通过后处理步骤，在高斯轨道构造的 Bloch 类基中求解完整哈密顿量获得。验证计算对象包括一维链、石墨烯和三维 AA 石墨及其螺旋堆垛结构。

papers.title: Branching stochastic mechanics. II. Relative localization and collective poles from Bohm/Fisher feedback
papers.abstract: Paper I introduced branching stochastic mechanics (BSM) by lifting the Schrödinger-Nagasawa pair to reciprocal forward and backward branching fields. Their centered connected kernel $C_{\rm FB}=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_Fψ_B]$ carries the organized reciprocal sector, where $\mathbb E_ω$ denotes expectation over branching-noise realizations, with $ρ_{\rm BSM}=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)$ on the anticorrelated branch. Here we develop the stochastic field theory of the Bohm/Fisher feedback that acts on this connected sector. Starting from the multiplicative branching covariance of BSM, a Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) formulation and a causal two-loop two-particle-irreducible (2PI) closure are used to determine response and correlation functions self-consistently. The free connected theory exhibits secular growth and ultraviolet accumulation, whereas the dressed theory develops a finite relative screening length. A reduced numerical evolution shows bounded formation of this localized sector, and a self-similar Fisher construction defines the saturated information velocity $c_\star$. A Born-Oppenheimer separation then distinguishes internal relative organization from collective propagation. Restoring the complete frequency structure gives two fixed-$q$ pole families: a gapless difference branch and a gapped sum branch. The infrared velocity of the difference branch approaches $c_\star$ at saturation. The common cone and the projected sum-sector gap are then formulated as additional fixed-point matching conditions for the collective theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“stochastic field theory”“MSRJD formulation”“2PI closure”等理论推导与形式化方法，未提及实验或具体计算材料。；研究对象：分支随机力学（BSM）中的相对局域化与集体极点结构，具体为Bohm/Fisher反馈作用下的连通扇区（connected sector）的随机场理论，属于量子力学基础与随机过程交叉领域，非特定材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BSM的连通扇区中，自由连通理论存在长期增长与紫外累积，而经过自洽“穿衣”（dressed）处理后形成有限相对屏蔽长度；恢复完整频率结构后，固定动量q下出现两支极点——无隙的差分支和有隙的和支，其中差分支的红外速度在饱和时趋近信息速度c*。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BSM的连通扇区中，自由连通理论存在长期增长与紫外累积，而经过自洽“穿衣”（dressed）处理后形成有限相对屏蔽长度；恢复完整频率结构后，固定动量q下出现两支极点——无隙的差分支和有隙的和支，其中差分支的红外速度在饱和时趋近信息速度c*。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比，但可看出其新意在于将Bohm/Fisher反馈纳入BSM的连通扇区，建立自洽的随机场理论，并揭示相对局域化与集体极点（差分/和支）的涌现机制，以及将公共锥与和扇区能隙作为集体理论的附加不动点匹配条件。
papers.method_zh: 采用Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de Dominicis（MSRJD）形式化表述，结合因果双圈二粒子不可约（2PI）闭包方案，自洽求解响应函数与关联函数；辅以约化数值演化验证局域扇区的有界形成，并利用自相似Fisher构造定义饱和信息速度c*；最后通过Born-Oppenheimer分离区分内部相对组织与集体传播。

papers.title: Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
papers.abstract: In this combined experimental and theoretical study, we investigate the role of disorder in governing the magnetic ground state of the quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe. In the FeRuMnZ (Z = Ga, Si) series, chemical substitution modifies atomic ordering and electronic structure, resulting in distinct magnetic ground states. Motivated by this, we extend the series to FeRuMnGe. X-ray diffraction reveals B2-type antisite disorder, where Fe--Ru and Mn--Ge intermix. Theoretical calculations show that such disorder modifies exchange interactions, leading to competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, and drives the system from half-metallic to metallic. Magnetic measurements reveal competing interactions, giving rise to a cluster-glass state coexisting with long-range magnetic order. The absence of a thermodynamic signature at $T_f$, together with ac susceptibility and relaxation measurements, supports the presence of short-range magnetic interactions and a glassy magnetic state. The compound exhibits an enhanced magnetic response below $\sim 161$ K and a maximum magnetization of $\sim 1.64~μ_B$/f.u. at 5 T. Overall, this work establishes a direct correlation between antisite disorder, competing exchange interactions, and glassy magnetism in quaternary Heusler alloys. Combined experimental results and theoretical calculations reveal that disorder drives the system from an AFM-dominated state in FeRuMnSi to an FM-dominated state in FeRuMnGe, providing deeper insight into the role of the extent of disorder in governing the magnetic properties of QHAs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and theoretical study”，包含X射线衍射、磁性测量等实验手段，以及理论计算。；研究对象：四元Heusler合金FeRuMnGe，具体关注B2型反位无序（Fe–Ru和Mn–Ge互混）对其磁基态的影响，以及无序驱动的竞争磁相互作用与玻璃态磁性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FeRuMnGe中的B2型反位无序会改变交换相互作用，导致铁磁与反铁磁耦合竞争，使体系从半金属转变为金属，并形成与长程磁序共存的团簇玻璃态。无序将体系从FeRuMnSi的反铁磁主导态驱动至FeRuMnGe的铁磁主导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FeRuMnGe中的B2型反位无序会改变交换相互作用，导致铁磁与反铁磁耦合竞争，使体系从半金属转变为金属，并形成与长程磁序共存的团簇玻璃态。无序将体系从FeRuMnSi的反铁磁主导态驱动至FeRuMnGe的铁磁主导态。；创新点：建立了四元Heusler合金中反位无序、竞争交换相互作用与玻璃态磁性之间的直接关联，并通过对比FeRuMnSi与FeRuMnGe揭示了无序程度对磁性质（反铁磁主导→铁磁主导）的调控作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：X射线衍射（确定B2型反位无序）、磁性测量（包括磁化曲线、交流磁化率、弛豫测量，用于表征竞争相互作用和玻璃态行为）。理论方面：电子结构计算（用于分析无序对交换相互作用和电子结构的影响，判断半金属到金属的转变）。

papers.title: 'pySNOW': a Python Suite for the NanO-World
papers.abstract: In computational materials science, numerical simulations are indispensable tools for revealing atomic-scale processes. For building blocks of the nanoworld, such as nanoparticles and nanoalloys, atomistic simulations provide detailed insight into their behaviour under diverse conditions. These simulations enable the study of formation and growth mechanisms, transport phenomena, chemophysical stability, and chemical reactions, including catalytic processes. To unravel the complex structure--property relationships that characterise nanoobjects, it is crucial to develop robust and insightful representations of their atomistic structure at global and local scales. Such descriptions enhance our understanding of nanoparticle behaviour and play a key role in guiding their rational design in silico for targeted applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件方法文章。判断依据：摘要中强调“numerical simulations”“atomistic simulations”，且标题明确为“Python Suite”（软件套件），属于计算工具开发类工作。；研究对象：纳米世界的基本构筑单元，包括纳米颗粒（nanoparticles）和纳米合金（nanoalloys）。研究其形成与生长机制、输运现象、化学物理稳定性以及化学反应（含催化过程）中的原子尺度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体的物理结论或数值发现，核心内容在于提出一套用于纳米体系原子级模拟的Python软件套件，旨在通过全局和局部的原子结构表征来揭示纳米物体的结构-性能关系，并支持其理性设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体的物理结论或数值发现，核心内容在于提出一套用于纳米体系原子级模拟的Python软件套件，旨在通过全局和局部的原子结构表征来揭示纳米物体的结构-性能关系，并支持其理性设计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但可推断其新意在于提供一套专门面向纳米颗粒/纳米合金的、整合了多尺度结构表征功能的Python工具套件，以弥补现有模拟分析工具在纳米物体结构-性能关联描述上的不足。
papers.method_zh: 原子级计算模拟（atomistic simulations），具体方法类型（如DFT、分子动力学、蒙特卡洛等）摘要未明确说明。软件以Python编写，功能聚焦于对纳米结构进行全局和局部尺度的结构表征与描述。

papers.title: Spin wave freezing in Re/Co/Pt multilayers
papers.abstract: The phenomenon of spin wave (SW) freezing occurs in the Damon-Eshbach mode in thin film magnetic systems, when SW phase and group velocities both go to zero, and the wave ceases to oscillate and move, preserving its shape as a domain structure pattern. This effect is related to the spin reorientation transition, where the magnetization configuration changes between the homogeneous in-plane state and domain structure with the out-of-plane magnetization component state. Here, we study the SW freezing effect in [Re/Co/Pt]$_{20}$ magnetic multilayers, induced by varying the in-plane external magnetic field. The studies were performed on nanostructures with the quality factor $Q$ (ratio of uniaxial anisotropy to demagnetization energies) greater and smaller than one. Domain structures with an out-of-plane magnetization component were observed in these multilayers. The critical field, visible as the saturation field $H_s^{||}$ in the parallel static magnetization curve measured by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID), is also manifested in the field-dependent vector-network-analyzer ferromagnetic resonance (VNA-FMR) experiment, which measures the homogeneous magnetization oscillations. Brillouin Light Scattering (BLS) spectra, recorded for several values of wave vectors and several field values, probed the field-evolution of the dispersion relation. Micromagnetic simulations allow one to obtain a full dispersion, in good agreement with VNA-FMR and BLS results. Around $H_s^{||}$ the simulated dispersion relations approach the conditions for SW freezing. Below $H_s^{||}$ low and high frequency VNA-FMR modes are related to magnetization oscillations inside domain walls and within domains, respectively. The experimental results of static and dynamic behavior, together with micromagnetic simulations, create an overall consistent picture of the investigated multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“VNA-FMR实验”“BLS光谱”“SQUID测量”等实验手段，同时包含“微磁模拟”（micromagnetic simulations）用于获得完整色散关系并与实验对比。；研究对象：[Re/Co/Pt]₂₀ 磁性多层膜中的自旋波冻结现象（spin wave freezing），具体涉及Damon-Eshbach模式在自旋重取向转变附近的行为，以及外加面内磁场调控下的磁化构型（均匀面内态与含面外分量的磁畴结构）演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在[Re/Co/Pt]₂₀多层膜中，通过调节面内磁场，色散关系在饱和场H_s^||附近趋近自旋波冻结条件（相速度与群速度同时为零）；低于该场时，VNA-FMR的高低频模式分别对应畴壁内和畴内部的磁化振荡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在[Re/Co/Pt]₂₀多层膜中，通过调节面内磁场，色散关系在饱和场H_s^||附近趋近自旋波冻结条件（相速度与群速度同时为零）；低于该场时，VNA-FMR的高低频模式分别对应畴壁内和畴内部的磁化振荡。；创新点：在具有品质因子Q大于和小于1两种情形的Re/Co/Pt多层膜纳米结构中，系统研究了由面内磁场诱导的自旋波冻结效应，并将静态（SQUID）、动态（VNA-FMR、BLS）与微磁模拟结果统一为自洽的物理图像。摘要未突出说明与以往自旋波冻结研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：SQUID测量平行静态磁化曲线（确定饱和场H_s^||）、矢量网络分析仪铁磁共振（VNA-FMR，探测均匀磁化振荡）、布里渊光散射（BLS，测量不同波矢和磁场下的色散关系）。计算方法为微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），用于获得完整色散并与实验对照。

papers.title: Prominent Dimensional Effects on High-order Harmonic Generation in Strongly Correlated Electron Systems
papers.abstract: Dimensionality strongly affects elementary excitations in correlated quantum materials, yet its impact on extreme nonlinear optical responses remains largely unexplored. Here, we combine high-harmonic generation (HHG) experiments on quasi-one-dimensional SrCuO$_2$ and quasi-two-dimensional Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ with nonequilibrium simulations of Hubbard models. We find a pronounced dimensional contrast: SrCuO$_2$ exhibits a robust plateau-like high-harmonic spectrum with weak temperature dependence, whereas Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ shows a monotonic decrease in harmonic yield and strong thermal suppression, especially at higher harmonics. The simulations qualitatively reproduce these trends and identify dimensionality-dependent doublon--holon dephasing, governed by spin--charge coupling, as their microscopic origin. These results establish dimensionality and spin--charge coupling as key control parameters for extreme nonlinear optical responses in correlated insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及“HHG experiments on…”（实验）与“nonequilibrium simulations of Hubbard models”（非平衡 Hubbard 模型模拟）。；研究对象：准一维强关联铜氧化物 SrCuO₂ 与准二维强关联铜氧化物 Pr₂CuO₄ 中的高次谐波产生（HHG）现象，重点关注维度效应对极端非线性光学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 维度强烈影响强关联电子体系的高次谐波产生：准一维 SrCuO₂ 呈现平台状谐波谱且对温度不敏感，而准二维 Pr₂CuO₄ 的谐波产率随谐波阶次单调下降且受温度强烈抑制。模拟表明其微观机制为维度依赖的、由自旋-电荷耦合主导的双子-空穴（doublon-holon）退相干过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：维度强烈影响强关联电子体系的高次谐波产生：准一维 SrCuO₂ 呈现平台状谐波谱且对温度不敏感，而准二维 Pr₂CuO₄ 的谐波产率随谐波阶次单调下降且受温度强烈抑制。模拟表明其微观机制为维度依赖的、由自旋-电荷耦合主导的双子-空穴（doublon-holon）退相干过程。；创新点：首次将维度效应与自旋-电荷耦合确立为强关联绝缘体中极端非线性光学响应的关键调控参数，揭示了维度对 HHG 谱形及温度依赖性的显著影响。摘要未突出说明与以往 HHG 研究在具体机制上的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高次谐波产生（HHG）光谱测量；理论上对 Hubbard 模型进行非平衡态数值模拟（摘要未明确具体数值方法，如 t-DMRG 或 Krylov 等）。

papers.title: Impedance in Periodically Driven Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: We study the time-dependent currents arising in periodically driven stochastic systems. In the linear regime of small driving, a closed expression is obtained for the impedance/admittance associated with these currents. This expression leads directly to an interpretation in terms of an equivalent electrical circuit. For a stochastic system with $N$ states, the electrical circuit consists of precisely $N$ parallel branches, with each branch comprising a resistor and a capacitor in series. The low- and high-frequency limits of these currents are calculated, and the results are generalized to more general current expressions. We demonstrate our findings across several archetypal settings, illustrating the potential to detect specific broken symmetries or the graph topology associated with the stochastic process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“closed expression is obtained”“we study”“we demonstrate”等理论推导与模型分析表述，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：周期驱动随机系统中的时间相关电流，即非平衡统计物理中由周期性外场驱动的随机过程（如马尔可夫跳变系统）的线性响应与阻抗特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱驱动线性响应区，周期驱动随机系统的电流可严格映射为一个等效电路：对N态随机系统，该电路恰由N条并联支路构成，每条支路为一个电阻与电容的串联；该阻抗表达式可直接用于探测随机过程中的特定对称性破缺或图拓扑结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱驱动线性响应区，周期驱动随机系统的电流可严格映射为一个等效电路：对N态随机系统，该电路恰由N条并联支路构成，每条支路为一个电阻与电容的串联；该阻抗表达式可直接用于探测随机过程中的特定对称性破缺或图拓扑结构。；创新点：首次将周期驱动随机系统的线性响应电流严格映射为具有明确拓扑结构的等效电路（N条并联RC串联支路），并指出该阻抗谱可作为探测随机过程对称性与图拓扑的工具。摘要未突出说明与以往阻抗理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导：基于线性响应理论（小驱动极限），推导电流的阻抗/导纳闭合表达式；计算低频率与高频率极限下的电流行为；并将结果推广至更一般的电流表达式。未使用数值模拟或具体实验技术。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Electric Toroidal Dipole and Intrinsic Longitudinal Spin Transport
papers.abstract: Electric toroidal dipoles (ETDs) characterize ferroaxial order, yet their bulk definition in periodic crystals has remained elusive because conventional multipole operators involve the ill-defined position operator. Here we formulate a thermodynamic ETD by coupling a spatially varying electric field to the relativistic spin-induced electric polarization. The resulting expression is gauge invariant and provides a bulk order parameter for ferroaxial phases. We further establish a direct relation between the chemical-potential derivative of the ETD and the intrinsic longitudinal spin conductivity in insulating systems. To demonstrate the formulation, we construct a minimal ferroaxial extension of the Kane--Mele model. The ETD becomes finite exclusively in the ferroaxial phase and is strongly enhanced near a small band gap, accompanied by a sizable longitudinal spin current. Our results establish a thermodynamic theory of ETDs in crystalline solids and identify the longitudinal spin conductivity as a direct transport manifestation of ferroaxial order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“formulate”“gauge invariant”“model”等理论推导与模型构建关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：凝聚态晶体中的电极化涡旋偶极（Electric Toroidal Dipole, ETD）——即铁环（ferroaxial）序的体态序参量，以及与之关联的绝缘体中的本征纵向自旋输运现象。具体模型体系为Kane–Mele模型的铁环扩展版本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的热力学体态定义（规范不变），并证明该ETD对化学势的导数与绝缘体的本征纵向自旋电导率直接相关。在最小铁环Kane–Mele模型中，ETD仅在铁环相非零，且在小带隙附近显著增强，同时伴随可观的纵向自旋流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的热力学体态定义（规范不变），并证明该ETD对化学势的导数与绝缘体的本征纵向自旋电导率直接相关。在最小铁环Kane–Mele模型中，ETD仅在铁环相非零，且在小带隙附近显著增强，同时伴随可观的纵向自旋流。；创新点：首次给出了周期晶体中电极化涡旋偶极的规范不变体态定义（此前因位置算符病态而缺失），并建立了铁环序与纵向自旋电导率之间的直接输运对应关系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过将空间变化的电场与相对论自旋诱导电极化耦合来构造热力学ETD；模型计算：构建Kane–Mele模型的铁环扩展最小模型，数值计算ETD与自旋电导率。

papers.title: Chemical pressure and vacancies in crystals under nonhydrostatic stress
papers.abstract: Inhomogeneous stress is a driving force for diffusion of vacancies in crystals. The other way around a non-uniform distribution of vacancies induces stress. The accepted theory of composition-stress coupling in crystals is Larché-Cahn (LC) theory. Composition is defined in terms of the population of lattice sites with a limit of one-particle per site. Coupling is modelled by adding a compositional strain term to the elastic strain in the constitutive relation for stress. An alternative mechanism, proposed here, is letting the site binding energy vary with spatial (deformed) density. This generates a chemical pressure adding to the elastic stress. The governing equations for this model are derived using non-equilibrium continuum thermodynamic methods. The gradient of the chemical pressure has a dual function acting both as the drift force for migration and as an effective internal one body force in the Cauchy equation for the elastic stress. The practical evaluation presented in the paper is restricted to equilibrium properties. We examine the effect of externally applied non-hydrostatic stress, either in the form of surface tractions or a one-body force density (gravitation). The model system is a one component crystal with a fixed number of lattice sites. The number of particles can be variable but is always smaller than the number of lattice sites. The linear elastic response is modelled by the standard Lamé stress tensor. The results for systems deformed by surface tractions are in qualitative agreement with LC theory allowing for differences in the expression for the elastic moduli. Deviations are more serious for the crystal deformed by gravitation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“非平衡连续介质热力学方法”“推导控制方程”“理论框架”等表述，属于理论建模研究。；研究对象：晶体中空位（vacancies）在非静水应力（nonhydrostatic stress）下的扩散与应力耦合问题，具体涉及化学压力（chemical pressure）与弹性应力的相互作用。体系为单组分晶体，晶格位点数固定，粒子数可变但少于位点数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种替代Larché-Cahn（LC）理论的组分-应力耦合机制：让位点结合能随空间（变形）密度变化，从而产生一个叠加在弹性应力之上的化学压力。该化学压力的梯度同时充当空位迁移的漂移力和Cauchy方程中的有效内体力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种替代Larché-Cahn（LC）理论的组分-应力耦合机制：让位点结合能随空间（变形）密度变化，从而产生一个叠加在弹性应力之上的化学压力。该化学压力的梯度同时充当空位迁移的漂移力和Cauchy方程中的有效内体力。；创新点：提出了一种新的组分-应力耦合机制（位点结合能随空间密度变化产生化学压力），与LC理论中通过组分应变耦合弹性应变的传统做法不同。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用非平衡连续介质热力学方法推导模型控制方程；线性弹性响应用标准Lamé应力张量描述；实际计算限于平衡性质，考察了表面牵引力和单体力密度（引力）两种外加载荷形式。

papers.title: Rank-Selective Optical Tomography of Higher-Wave Altermagnetism
papers.abstract: Identifying the spatial rank of higher-wave altermagnetic order optically is challenging because local electric-dipole response does not uniquely resolve distinct continuum harmonics. We show that finite photon momentum turns one-photon spin-resolved absorption into a rank-selective tomography. For the planar $|m|=\ell$ sector of an even-parity $\ell$-wave component, a joint Fourier projection in polarization and momentum angle isolates $\mathcal T_\ell\proptoη_\ell q^{\ell-2}$, yielding the hierarchy $d:q^0$, $g:q^2$, and $i:q^4$; phase changes track rotations of the selected magnetic harmonic. A Ward-consistent finite-$q$ microscopic calculation reproduces these powers without imposing them. Although discrete crystal symmetry can generate lower-order local aliases, they are orthogonal to the selected momentum harmonic and cannot contaminate it below $q^{\ell-2}$. In MnTe, whose nonrelativistic parent order is three-dimensional $g$ wave while spin--orbit coupling lowers the exact relativistic spin-momentum-locking symmetry, first-principles calculations show that more than $99.9\%$ of the Fourier power of the Néel-projected $A$-region spin-energy contrast remains in the parent $g$-wave-derived $m=3$ harmonic. Structured near fields place the required momentum window within experimental reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Ward-consistent finite-$q$ microscopic calculation”“first-principles calculations”等理论计算关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：高波（higher-wave）交替磁体（altermagnetism）的光学探测，具体以MnTe为实例，研究其三维$g$波交替磁有序及其自旋-轨道耦合修正下的光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 有限光子动量可使单光子自旋分辨吸收成为“秩选择性断层扫描”，从而在光学上区分高波交替磁序的不同空间秩（rank）。在MnTe中，超过99.9%的Néel投影自旋-能量对比的傅里叶功率仍保留在母体$g$波衍生的$m=3$谐波中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：有限光子动量可使单光子自旋分辨吸收成为“秩选择性断层扫描”，从而在光学上区分高波交替磁序的不同空间秩（rank）。在MnTe中，超过99.9%的Néel投影自旋-能量对比的傅里叶功率仍保留在母体$g$波衍生的$m=3$谐波中。；创新点：提出利用有限光子动量将光学吸收的秩选择性从局域电偶极响应中解放出来，实现对高波交替磁序谐波（$d$、$g$、$i$波）的层级分辨（$q^0$、$q^2$、$q^4$），并证明晶体对称性产生的低阶局域混叠与所选动量谐波正交，不会污染目标信号。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有限光子动量$q$下的微观光学响应计算（满足Ward恒等式），结合第一性原理计算（针对MnTe的电子结构）；还使用了极化与动量角的联合傅里叶投影分析，以及结构近场（structured near fields）的场形设计讨论。

papers.title: Direct observation of flat bands in near-magic-angle twisted bilayer CVD graphene
papers.abstract: Advances in chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth have driven graphene crystal quality to unprecedented levels, yet it is still unknown whether this route can realize the fragile flat-band and correlated states of the magic-angle (MA) twisted bilayer graphene (TBG). Here, we report on the experimental observation by room-temperature nano-angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) of flat bands in a TBG sample close to the MA, assembled via a grow-and-stack protocol based on low-pressure CVD of graphene on copper. Our study indicates electronic bands fully comparable to those measured in exfoliation-based samples and determines the size of the largest near-MA domain to be compatible with electronic transport experiments, motivating further experiments on flat band physics in CVD-graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimental observation”“nano-ARPES”等实验手段。；研究对象：近魔角（near-magic-angle）扭转双层CVD石墨烯（twisted bilayer CVD graphene），具体关注其平带（flat bands）电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过室温纳米角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES）在近魔角扭转双层CVD石墨烯中直接观测到了平带，且其电子能带与基于机械剥离法制备的样品完全可比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过室温纳米角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES）在近魔角扭转双层CVD石墨烯中直接观测到了平带，且其电子能带与基于机械剥离法制备的样品完全可比。；创新点：首次在CVD生长的扭转双层石墨烯中直接观测到近魔角平带，证明CVD路线也能实现魔角体系中的脆弱平带态；同时确定了最大近魔角畴的尺寸与电子输运实验兼容，为后续在CVD石墨烯中研究平带物理提供了实验基础。
papers.method_zh: 室温nano-ARPES（纳米角分辨光电子能谱）；样品制备采用“生长-堆叠”（grow-and-stack）工艺，基于铜上低压CVD生长石墨烯。

papers.title: Molecular-dynamics-based modal analysis of heat transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems from a symmetry-adapted perspective
papers.abstract: Detailed analysis of thermal conductivity results obtained from molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories conventionally relies on knowledge of the harmonic vibrational modes of the system. Such is the case in methods like Green--Kubo modal analysis (GKMA) and homogeneous nonequilibrium modal analysis (HNEMA). This approach faces several shortcomings that become especially important when dealing with nanostructures. Chief among them is scalability, followed by the ambiguity associated to the degeneracy of the large vibrational subspaces defined by a common translational wave number k. We propose an alternative for quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) systems: we construct the modal basis for the decomposition of the thermal conductivity from line-group projection operators, so that every projected component carries well-defined symmetry labels (including rotational information and parities) and the decomposition is unique at the level of irreducible representations (irreps). Applying the idea to a (10,0)-(20,0) WS2-MoS2 double-walled nanotube (DWNT) described by a neuroevolution potential (NEP), we find that at 300 K both HNEMA and GKMA yield statistically consistent total conductivities and allow the identification of several prominent symmetry-adapted conduction channels. The GKMA pair matrix shows that within-block and same-channel cross-k terms account for 75.6% of the total conductivity, while cross-channel correlations contribute 24.4%.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到基于分子动力学（MD）轨迹的分析，以及使用神经进化势（NEP）进行模拟。；研究对象：准一维（quasi-1D）系统中的热输运，具体材料为(10,0)-(20,0) WS₂-MoS₂双壁纳米管（DWNT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在300 K下，采用对称性适配的模态分解方法，HNEMA和GKMA两种方法给出的总热导率在统计上一致，并识别出多个显著的对称性适配导热通道。GKMA配对矩阵显示，块内和同通道交叉k项贡献了总热导率的75.6%，而跨通道关联贡献了24.4%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在300 K下，采用对称性适配的模态分解方法，HNEMA和GKMA两种方法给出的总热导率在统计上一致，并识别出多个显著的对称性适配导热通道。GKMA配对矩阵显示，块内和同通道交叉k项贡献了总热导率的75.6%，而跨通道关联贡献了24.4%。；创新点：提出了一种针对准一维系统的替代性模态分解框架：利用线群投影算子构造模态基，使每个投影分量携带明确的对称性标签（包括旋转信息和宇称），并在不可约表示（irreps）层面实现唯一分解。这解决了传统方法在处理纳米结构时的可扩展性问题以及大简并振动子空间（由共同平移波数k定义）带来的模糊性。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（使用神经进化势NEP描述原子间相互作用），结合Green-Kubo模态分析（GKMA）和均匀非平衡模态分析（HNEMA）。创新性地使用线群（line-group）投影算子构造模态基，替代传统的基于谐波振动模式的方法。

papers.title: Magneto-Structural Coupling Enables Cryogenic Cation Redistribution in a Spinel Oxide
papers.abstract: Ionic transport in oxides is generally frozen at cryogenic temperatures, where thermal energy lies far below typical cation-migration barriers. Neutron powder diffraction reveals progressive Fe/Mg redistribution between tetrahedral (A) and octahedral (B) sites in the spinel Mg0.5Fe0.5TiFeO4 upon cooling from 200 K to 5 K. A-site Fe occupancy increases toward near completion at 5 K within Rietveld resolution, while Ti remains on the B site. This exchange coincides with complex magnetic correlations rather than a classical thermally activated window. Low-temperature magnetostrictive volume changes indicate strong spin-lattice coupling, but do not identify magnetostriction as the sole thermodynamic driver. Room-temperature high-pressure X-ray diffraction produces the opposite occupancy trend, showing that volume contraction alone cannot explain the cryogenic site exchange. These results point to magneto-structural free-energy minimization as a plausible mechanism for unlocking cryogenic cation mobility in a correlated spinel oxide.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Neutron powder diffraction、X-ray diffraction、Rietveld refinement。；研究对象：尖晶石氧化物 Mg₀.₅Fe₀.₅TiFeO₄ 中四面体（A）与八面体（B）位点之间的 Fe/Mg 阳离子再分布，以及该过程与低温磁有序和磁致伸缩的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在从 200 K 冷却至 5 K 的过程中，该尖晶石氧化物中发生了渐进式的 Fe/Mg 位点交换（A 位 Fe 占据率趋于饱和），该低温离子迁移并非由热激活主导，而是与磁结构自由能最小化相关；单纯的体积收缩（高压实验）无法解释这一现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在从 200 K 冷却至 5 K 的过程中，该尖晶石氧化物中发生了渐进式的 Fe/Mg 位点交换（A 位 Fe 占据率趋于饱和），该低温离子迁移并非由热激活主导，而是与磁结构自由能最小化相关；单纯的体积收缩（高压实验）无法解释这一现象。；创新点：首次在低温（5 K）下观察到尖晶石氧化物中显著的阳离子再分布，并指出磁结构耦合（而非热激活或单纯体积效应）是解锁低温阳离子迁移的可能机制。摘要未突出说明该工作与具体理论模型或计算预测的对比。
papers.method_zh: 变温中子粉末衍射（200 K–5 K）结合 Rietveld 精修确定阳离子占位；低温磁致伸缩体积变化分析以表征自旋-晶格耦合；室温高压 X 射线衍射用于对比体积效应对阳离子分布的影响。

papers.title: Collective Cell Fluidity Controls Active Prestress Transmission in Cell-Extracellular-Matrix Tissues
papers.abstract: Tissues are active composites in which multicellular collectives and extracellular matrices mechanically reorganize one another. We develop a three-dimensional micromechanical model that couples deformable, rearranging cell clusters to a disordered network of semiflexible fibers through a dynamic, force-generating interface. Cell clusters are represented as solid-like or fluid-like vertex-model spheroids and coupled to the matrix by passive or contractile linkers renewed as the cluster boundary reorganizes. Matched intact, voided, and passive-linker controls separate cavity formation, interfacial tethering, and active loading. At small strain, passive tethering provides modest reinforcement, whereas active contraction prestresses and strongly stiffens the matrix. Solid-like clusters preserve coherent force transmission and exhibit an excess modulus scaling approximately as $|σ|^{1.4}$ across changes in activity, cluster size, and cluster number. Fluid-like clusters undergo greater interfacial renewal, producing weaker and nonmonotonic coupling between prestress and stiffness. Increasing cluster number produces collective stiffening when prestressed regions become connected through sufficiently persistent interfaces. At large strain, both solid-like and fluid-like systems approach the corresponding voided-network response as the residual fiber backbone becomes mechanically dominant. Thus, cell-generated prestress controls macroscopic stiffness only together with the organization and persistence of its transmission across the cell-matrix interface.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：micromechanical model（微力学模型）、vertex-model（顶点模型）、simulation（模拟）。；研究对象：细胞-细胞外基质（ECM）组织这一活性复合材料体系，具体研究细胞团簇（固态或液态）与半柔性纤维网络之间的力学耦合与预应力传递行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 细胞产生的主动预应力对组织宏观刚度的调控并非独立发生，而是取决于预应力在细胞-基质界面上传递的组织方式与持续性：固态细胞团簇可保持连贯的力传递并产生约 |σ|^1.4 的超额模量标度，而液态团簇因界面更新更频繁导致预应力-刚度耦合更弱且非单调。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：细胞产生的主动预应力对组织宏观刚度的调控并非独立发生，而是取决于预应力在细胞-基质界面上传递的组织方式与持续性：固态细胞团簇可保持连贯的力传递并产生约 |σ|^1.4 的超额模量标度，而液态团簇因界面更新更频繁导致预应力-刚度耦合更弱且非单调。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作将细胞团簇的固态/液态力学状态与界面连接子的动态更新相结合，系统揭示了界面持久性对预应力传递和集体刚度增强的关键作用，并给出了固态团簇下超额模量随预应力变化的明确标度律。
papers.method_zh: 三维微力学计算模型：将可变形、可重排的细胞团簇建模为固态或液态顶点模型球体，与无序半柔性纤维网络通过动态、可产生力的连接子（被动或收缩型）耦合；通过完整、空洞及被动连接子对照实验分离空腔形成、界面锚定与主动加载三种效应。

papers.title: Effect of reactive targets on diffusive transport with intermittent restarts
papers.abstract: We study search processes in a complex environment using the strategy of stochastic resetting. A common occurrence in these environments is targets with finite reactivity. Stochastic resetting has emerged as a powerful mechanism for optimizing search processes by curtailing long, unproductive excursions inherent to diffusive dynamics. Most theoretical studies, however, assume perfectly absorbing targets -- an idealization that overlooks the finite reactivity commonly encountered in realistic chemical and biological systems. In this work, we investigate the interplay between stochastic resetting and finite-target reactivity in reaction - diffusion processes. Considering a one-dimensional system with multiple reactive targets, we demonstrated that the target reactivity modifies the optimization landscape. We uncover distinct regimes in which resetting enhances transport efficiency towards specific targets based on their chemical kinetics. As a consequence, the optimal resetting rate becomes intrinsically reactivity dependent. Our results identify target reactivity as a crucial control parameter governing stochastic transport and provide insights into reaction-diffusion processes in complex media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We investigate”“We demonstrate”等理论推导性表述，且未提及实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：一维反应-扩散系统中的随机搜索过程，具体为具有多个有限反应性（finite reactivity）靶点的输运现象，以及随机重置（stochastic resetting）策略与靶点化学动力学之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 靶点的有限反应性会改变随机重置优化搜索的“优化景观”，使得最优重置率 intrinsically 依赖于靶点的化学反应动力学；存在不同参数区间，其中重置对不同化学动力学靶点的输运效率增强效果不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：靶点的有限反应性会改变随机重置优化搜索的“优化景观”，使得最优重置率 intrinsically 依赖于靶点的化学反应动力学；存在不同参数区间，其中重置对不同化学动力学靶点的输运效率增强效果不同。；创新点：以往随机重置研究大多假设靶点为完全吸收（perfectly absorbing），忽略了实际化学和生物体系中常见的有限反应性。本工作首次系统揭示有限靶点反应性如何作为关键控制参数调节随机重置下的输运优化行为，并指出最优重置率与靶点化学动力学的耦合关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于随机重置策略下的反应-扩散方程，在一维系统中考虑多个具有有限反应性的靶点，解析或半解析地研究重置率与靶点反应性对输运效率的联合影响。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如Fokker-Planck方程、路径积分等）。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium corrections to conserved Ising criticality in scalar active matter: Ward identities, spectrum, and long crossovers
papers.abstract: Active scalar field theories break detailed balance in two physically distinct ways: through a field-dependent noise-to-mobility ratio $Θ(φ)=D(φ)/M(φ)$, and through the gradient activity of Active Model~B+. We classify the resulting perturbations of the conserved Wilson-Fisher fixed point in three dimensions. Working from the Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De~Dominicis (MSRJD) action, a functional renormalization-group (FRG) calculation shows that the transport sector has a block-triangular stability matrix whose leading odd mode has $y_{Θ_1}=-Δ_φ$, while quotienting the gradient sector by its detailed-balance-preserving tangent leaves a chemical and a current-like mode. Two smooth regulators give $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.52$, $y_J\simeq-0.56$ and $y_{\rm ch}\simeq-0.89$. The translation Ward identity represents the current operator by a stress-tensor divergence modulo chemical gradients; conservation and causality then make the active stability matrix triangular to all loop orders, and an explicit two-loop calculation in $d=4-ε$ finds no additional contact counterterm. The two slowest modes are separated only by the Ising anomalous dimension, $y_J-y_{Θ_1}=-η$. This relation is a dimension count that holds provided neither operator acquires a further contact anomaly, a condition we establish within the present truncation for $\mathcal O_Θ$ and verify through two loops for $\mathcal O_J$; under it the $d=3$ reference Ising value gives $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.5181$ and $y_J\simeq-0.5544$. We derive the parity-resolved finite-size scaling of this near degeneracy, identify block observables that separate the two modes, and show that when the current amplitude dominates the crossover scale lies far beyond any accessible system size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“MSRJD action”“functional renormalization-group (FRG) calculation”“two-loop calculation in d=4-ε”等理论/解析计算关键词。；研究对象：三维标量活性物质（scalar active matter）中的守恒Ising临界性，具体研究活性标量场理论中两类破坏细致平衡（detailed balance）的微扰——场依赖的噪声-迁移率比Θ(φ)=D(φ)/M(φ)以及Active Model B+的梯度活性——对守恒Wilson-Fisher不动点的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性微扰使守恒Ising不动点的输运扇区稳定性矩阵呈块三角结构，两个最慢模式（电流型模式与Θ₁模式）的本征值仅相差Ising反常维度（y_J - y_Θ₁ = -η），在d=3参考Ising值下分别约为-0.5181和-0.5544；当电流振幅占主导时，交叉（crossover）尺度远超任何可及系统尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性微扰使守恒Ising不动点的输运扇区稳定性矩阵呈块三角结构，两个最慢模式（电流型模式与Θ₁模式）的本征值仅相差Ising反常维度（y_J - y_Θ₁ = -η），在d=3参考Ising值下分别约为-0.5181和-0.5544；当电流振幅占主导时，交叉（crossover）尺度远超任何可及系统尺寸。；创新点：首次对活性标量场理论中两类破坏细致平衡的微扰进行统一分类，证明输运扇区稳定性矩阵的块三角结构及两最慢模式间精确的-η分离关系，并指出该近简并导致的超长交叉行为；摘要未突出说明与更早活性物质临界性工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De Dominicis（MSRJD）作用量，采用泛函重整化群（FRG）计算稳定性矩阵本征值；利用平移Ward恒等式证明活性稳定性矩阵在全圈图阶下呈三角结构；在d=4-ε下进行显式两圈计算检验接触抵消项；推导近简并态的宇称分辨有限尺寸标度并构造分块可观测量。

papers.title: Room-temperature local strain control of moiré excitons in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers
papers.abstract: Moiré superlattices in heterobilayers of atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a versatile platform for exploring quantum many-body physics as they can trap excitons, leading to the formation of quantized moiré exciton states. However, such moiré excitons have been predominantly studied at cryogenic temperatures, which severely limits their practical applications. Here, we demonstrate room-temperature activation and control of moiré excitons in MoS$_2$/WSe$_2$ heterobilayers using local strain engineering. Applying mechanical strain with a modified atomic force microscopy tip, we observe a series of resonances attributed to interlayer exciton states confined in the moiré potential. Power-dependent photoluminescence measurements elucidate the population dynamics of the moiré exciton states, while controlled local strain enables continuous tuning of their emission wavelength to the center of the second telecom window. We provide a theoretical model that captures all experimentally observed features, including the unconventional spectral shape of the moiré exciton emission. Our findings establish local tip-induced strain as a powerful tool for the on-demand manipulation of moiré excitons, paving the way for room-temperature quantum excitonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论建模）。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、applying mechanical strain、photoluminescence measurements、theoretical model。；研究对象：MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子（moiré excitons），具体为室温下通过局域应变调控的层间激子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变，可在室温下激活并调控 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子，实现其发射波长连续调谐至第二电信窗口中心，并建立了能解释所有实验特征（包括非常规光谱线形）的理论模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变，可在室温下激活并调控 MoS₂/WSe₂ 异质双层中的莫尔激子，实现其发射波长连续调谐至第二电信窗口中心，并建立了能解释所有实验特征（包括非常规光谱线形）的理论模型。；创新点：首次在室温下实现莫尔激子的激活与局域应变调控，突破了此前莫尔激子研究局限于低温的限制；提出针尖诱导局域应变作为按需操控莫尔激子的通用工具，为室温量子激子器件铺路。摘要未突出说明与低温研究相比在物理机制上的其他新意。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用改性原子力显微镜针尖施加局域机械应变；通过功率依赖的光致发光（photoluminescence）谱测量研究莫尔激子态的布居动力学；理论上构建了捕捉实验观测特征的模型（摘要未给出具体理论框架名称，如紧束缚或连续模型等）。

papers.title: In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
papers.abstract: Analogue black-hole systems have been proposed in various physical platforms, including magnetic materials, offering rich physics and promising applications such as wave lasing. However, their practical realization and characterization remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an in silico study of magnonic black-hole phenomena in constricted ferromagnetic waveguides driven by spin-polarized currents. Using micromagnetic simulations with a two-dimensional Poisson solver to obtain realistic current-density profiles, we demonstrate the formation of a double-hole cavity bounded by analogue event horizons, enabling resonant spin-wave amplification. We characterize the resonances as a function of magnetic and geometric parameters and identify the corresponding spin-wave modes. We further show that gradual tapers enhance transmission by suppressing spin-wave reflections, while interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction can mimic the current-induced Doppler shift, substantially reducing the critical current density required for applications and, consequently, Joule heating. Finally, we demonstrate a spin-wave laser in which thermally excited spin waves undergo selective amplification and coherent emission at well-defined resonance frequencies. These results provide design principles for magnonic analogues of gravitational systems and point toward their potential for advanced spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“in silico study”（计算机模拟研究）、“micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：受限铁磁波导（constricted ferromagnetic waveguides）中的磁子（自旋波）黑洞现象，以及由自旋极化电流驱动的磁子激射（magnonic lasing）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在受限铁磁波导中，自旋极化电流可形成由模拟事件视界（analogue event horizons）包围的双黑洞腔（double-hole cavity），实现自旋波的共振放大；通过优化几何结构和利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，可显著降低临界电流密度，最终实现热激发自旋波的选择性放大和相干发射，即自旋波激光器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在受限铁磁波导中，自旋极化电流可形成由模拟事件视界（analogue event horizons）包围的双黑洞腔（double-hole cavity），实现自旋波的共振放大；通过优化几何结构和利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，可显著降低临界电流密度，最终实现热激发自旋波的选择性放大和相干发射，即自旋波激光器。；创新点：首次在受限铁磁波导中通过计算机模拟系统展示了磁子黑洞现象及其双腔共振放大机制，并提出了利用渐变锥形结构（gradual tapers）抑制反射、以及利用界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用模拟电流诱导多普勒频移来降低临界电流密度的设计原则，最终实现了磁子激射（自旋波激光）。摘要未明确说明与已有磁子黑洞研究相比的具体差异，但整体上提供了面向应用的器件设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），并结合二维泊松方程求解器（two-dimensional Poisson solver）以获得真实的电流密度分布。研究了共振随磁参数和几何参数的变化，并分析了界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的影响。

papers.title: Ferroelastic domain switching by ultrafast photoinduced strain
papers.abstract: The crystal lattice underpins the fundamental properties of condensed matter, with ferroic order emerging sensitively from atomic coordination. Manipulating the lattic therefore promises a direct way to switch ferroics between their states. Infrared excitation provides an efficient pathway to drive lattice motion and generate transient crystal deformations and strains. Ferroelastics constitute a uniquely direct platform for such control, their order parameter being strain itself. However, whether ultrafast laser-induced lattice distortions can switch ferroelastic order remains unknown. Here we use ultrafast pump-probe microscopy to demonstrate that a single high-amplitude infrared pulse induces strain within the first nanosecond, followed by ferroelastic domain switching several nanoseconds later. The spatial distribution follows that expected from the photoinduced strain field, while their temporal evolution is closely coupled to the strain dynamics. Our observations identify transient strain as the driving field for ferroelastic switching and suggest a general lattice-mediated pathway for controlling ferroic order using infrared light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“ultrafast pump-probe microscopy”（超快泵浦-探测显微术）作为主要研究手段。；研究对象：铁弹体（ferroelastic）材料中的铁弹畴（ferroelastic domain）及其在超快光致应变下的切换行为。具体材料成分摘要未明确说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个高幅度红外脉冲可在第一个纳秒内诱导晶格应变，并在数纳秒后引发铁弹畴切换；该切换的空间分布与光致应变场一致，时间演化与应变动力学紧密耦合，表明瞬态应变是驱动铁弹切换的场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个高幅度红外脉冲可在第一个纳秒内诱导晶格应变，并在数纳秒后引发铁弹畴切换；该切换的空间分布与光致应变场一致，时间演化与应变动力学紧密耦合，表明瞬态应变是驱动铁弹切换的场。；创新点：首次证明超快激光诱导的瞬态晶格应变能够驱动铁弹序的切换，提出了一种通过红外光调控铁性序的普适晶格介导路径。摘要未突出说明与以往光致铁弹切换研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 超快泵浦-探测显微镜（ultrafast pump-probe microscopy），结合红外脉冲激发与时间分辨的空间成像，用于同时追踪应变场和畴结构的时空演化。

papers.title: Quantum Structural Renormalization and Anharmonic Stabilization of Superconductivity in P4/mmm YScH8
papers.abstract: The recent synthesis of P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ at 191.7 GPa with a superconducting critical temperature Tc of 113 K has attracted considerable interest in the study of ternary superhydrides. Here we systematically evaluate the effects of quantum and anharmonic motion of ions in P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ using the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA). We find that these effects renormalize the crystal structure and lower the dynamical stability threshold pressure from $\sim$140 GPa to $\sim$84 GPa, a reduction of about 40%. Furthermore, neglecting these effects causes a significant overestimation of the $T_{c}$, for instance by $\sim$20 K at 190 GPa. Our prediction of $T_{c}$ at 190 GPa is 113 K ($μ^{*}$= 0.13), close to the experimental observation. Analysis of the phonon density of states and Eliashberg spectral function further reveals site-dependent contributions to superconductivity. These results establish that a consistent treatment of nuclear quantum motion and anharmonicity is essential for accurately predicting superconductivity in compressed ternary hydrides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA)”这一理论计算方法，并系统评估量子与非谐效应，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：三元超氢化物 P4/mmm-YScH₈，具体关注其在高压下的晶体结构、动力学稳定性以及超导电性（Tc）的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 离子量子运动与非谐效应会显著重正化晶体结构，将动力学稳定压力阈值从约140 GPa降低至约84 GPa（降幅约40%）；忽略这些效应会高估Tc约20 K（在190 GPa下），而考虑后预测Tc为113 K（μ*=0.13），与实验观测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：离子量子运动与非谐效应会显著重正化晶体结构，将动力学稳定压力阈值从约140 GPa降低至约84 GPa（降幅约40%）；忽略这些效应会高估Tc约20 K（在190 GPa下），而考虑后预测Tc为113 K（μ*=0.13），与实验观测一致。；创新点：首次在P4/mmm-YScH₈中系统证明，必须同时考虑核量子运动与非谐效应才能准确预测压缩三元氢化物的超导电性，并定量给出其对结构稳定压力阈值和Tc的修正幅度。
papers.method_zh: 随机自洽谐近似（SSCHA）方法，用于处理核量子运动与非谐效应；结合声子态密度和Eliashberg谱函数分析，进行超导临界温度（Tc）的预测（采用μ*=0.13）。

papers.title: Vitrification-Devitrification Enables Tunable Photonic and Gas Sorption Properties of Zeolitic Imidazolate Frameworks
papers.abstract: Zeolitic imidazolate framework (ZIF) glasses represent an emerging family of melt-quenched glasses, which exhibit immense potential for applications in gas separation, energy storage, and optics. However, their intrinsic porosity remains elusive due to the inherent challenges in resolving their disordered atomistic structures. Here, we systematically investigate the porosity of ZIF-4 and ZIF-62 crystals and their corresponding glasses. CO2 sorption at 195 K enables quantitative assessment of microporosity in both crystalline and glassy states, allowing the accessible micropore volume of the ZIF glasses to be determined. Moreover, establishing a direct relationship between photonic properties and structural porosity in Zn-based ZIF glasses remains challenging. Here we demonstrate striking broadband blue-light emission from ZIF-4 glass annealed under optimized conditions. A pronounced red shift is observed when increasing the annealing temperature above the glass transition temperature. By correlating the evolution of photoluminescence with structural porosity, we reveal the interplay between the photonic and gas sorption properties of ZIF glasses. These findings provide new insights into the structure-property relationships of ZIF glasses and offer a pathway toward the rational design of multifunctional MOF glasses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要中提及CO₂吸附实验、光致发光测量以及玻璃退火处理等实验手段。；研究对象：沸石咪唑酯骨架（ZIF）材料，具体为ZIF-4和ZIF-62的晶体及其对应的熔融淬冷玻璃，关注其微孔性、气体吸附性能与光子（发光）性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过CO₂吸附定量测定了ZIF玻璃的微孔体积，并发现ZIF-4玻璃在优化退火条件下表现出宽带蓝光发射，且随退火温度升高（超过玻璃化转变温度）出现显著红移，揭示了ZIF玻璃的光子性质与结构孔隙率之间的关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过CO₂吸附定量测定了ZIF玻璃的微孔体积，并发现ZIF-4玻璃在优化退火条件下表现出宽带蓝光发射，且随退火温度升高（超过玻璃化转变温度）出现显著红移，揭示了ZIF玻璃的光子性质与结构孔隙率之间的关联。；创新点：首次将ZIF玻璃的气体吸附（孔隙率）与光子（发光）性质直接关联，建立了结构孔隙率与发光行为之间的定量联系，为多功能MOF玻璃的理性设计提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: CO₂吸附实验（195 K）用于定量评估晶体和玻璃态的微孔性；对ZIF-4玻璃进行不同温度（高于玻璃化转变温度）的退火处理；光致发光（PL）光谱用于表征发光性质；将发光演化与结构孔隙率变化进行关联分析。

papers.title: Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
papers.abstract: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. Due to anisotropic gapless superconductivity, altermagnetic superconductors with an out-of-plane Zeeman field display an anisotropic paramagnetic Meissner effect. The effect is strongest for parallel altermagnetic and Zeeman exchange field vectors and in the clean sample. The presence of nonmagnetic impurities leads to isotropisation and, consequently, weakens the effect; however, the paramagnetic response sustains intermediate amounts of impurities in the system. As demonstrated in recent experiments, microwave superfluid stiffness measurements can serve as a sensitive probe of gapless superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：report on the emergence、theoretical framework（摘要中未明确提及具体计算方法，但以理论分析为主）。；研究对象：交错磁超导体（altermagnetic superconductors），特别是具有面外塞曼场（out-of-plane Zeeman field）的各向异性无隙超导态中的超流体响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交错磁超导体在任意杂质浓度下都会出现反常的顺磁超流体响应（即顺磁迈斯纳效应），该效应在交错磁与塞曼交换场方向平行且样品纯净时最强，非磁杂质会使其各向同性化并削弱该效应，但中等杂质浓度下顺磁响应仍然存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交错磁超导体在任意杂质浓度下都会出现反常的顺磁超流体响应（即顺磁迈斯纳效应），该效应在交错磁与塞曼交换场方向平行且样品纯净时最强，非磁杂质会使其各向同性化并削弱该效应，但中等杂质浓度下顺磁响应仍然存在。；创新点：首次指出交错磁超导体中顺磁迈斯纳效应的普适性（不受杂质浓度限制），并揭示其与各向异性无隙超导的直接关联，同时提出微波超流体刚度测量可作为探测无隙超导的灵敏手段。摘要未突出说明与其他理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架或计算方法，但涉及对杂质散射效应的分析（任意杂质浓度、非磁杂质影响），以及超流体刚度（superfluid stiffness）的微波测量理论分析。具体技术细节摘要未展开。

papers.title: Vortex-core Majorana coupling to a chiral edge in a $p_x+ip_y$ superconductor: Nonmonotonic spectral reorganization and coherent fermion-parity dynamics
papers.abstract: We study how vortex--edge coupling reorganizes the low-energy sector of a finite two-dimensional \(p_x+ip_y\) superconducting disk as a function of the vortex--boundary separation \(d\) and examine what this reorganization implies for the parity memory associated with a prescribed vortex-core Majorana wave packet, a resource relevant to Majorana-based quantum operations. Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations reveal nonmonotonic core--edge reorganization of the lowest positive-energy finite-disk eigenstate, with particularly rapid variation near \(d\simeq7ξ\), where \(ξ\) is the coherence length. To separate this eigenstate reorganization from the spectral representation of a prescribed state, we rigidly translate a centered-vortex core-reference packet to each fixed vortex position, restrict it to the target disk, and project it, without intermediate normalization, onto the particle-hole-complete low-energy subspace. For \(Δ_0/E_F=0.36\) and disk radius \(R=30ξ\), the resulting retained norm exceeds \(0.98\) at all six sampled separations, \(4.25\leq d/ξ\leq8.25\), while, depending on \(d\), the spectral measure is concentrated near zero energy, fragmented over several low-energy levels, or dominated by finite-energy weight. Correspondingly, the signed parity correlator displays slow temporal variation, rapid coherent dephasing, or sign-changing oscillations, with possible finite-size recurrences at later times. Thus a large retained norm does not by itself imply spectral concentration or persistent parity memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Bogoliubov–de Gennes calculations”，且全程为数值计算与理论分析，无实验手段。；研究对象：有限二维 \(p_x+ip_y\) 超导圆盘中的涡旋—手性边界耦合体系，具体关注涡旋芯马约拉纳波函数与边界之间的耦合及其对费米子宇称记忆的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 涡旋—边界分离距离 \(d\) 的变化会导致最低正能有限盘本征态发生非单调的芯—边界重组，尤其在 \(d\simeq 7\xi\) 附近变化剧烈；即使投影保留范数很高（>0.98），谱权重仍可能集中在零能、分散于多个低能级或由有限能权重主导，因此高保留范数并不保证谱集中或持久的宇称记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：涡旋—边界分离距离 \(d\) 的变化会导致最低正能有限盘本征态发生非单调的芯—边界重组，尤其在 \(d\simeq 7\xi\) 附近变化剧烈；即使投影保留范数很高（>0.98），谱权重仍可能集中在零能、分散于多个低能级或由有限能权重主导，因此高保留范数并不保证谱集中或持久的宇称记忆。；创新点：将本征态重组与预设态的谱表示分离，系统展示了涡旋—边界耦合导致的非单调谱重组及其对宇称记忆动力学的复杂影响，明确指出高保留范数不等于谱集中或宇称记忆持久这一反直觉结论。摘要未突出说明与具体量子计算方案的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: Bogoliubov–de Gennes（BdG）数值计算；采用将中心涡旋参考波函数刚性平移到固定涡旋位置、限制到目标圆盘并无中间归一化地投影到粒子—空穴完备低能子空间的方法；计算了保留范数、谱测度分布及带符号宇称关联器的时间演化。

papers.title: Linker Functionalization and pH Tuning Enhance Solar-Driven Catalytic CO$_2$ Reduction in MOF-5
papers.abstract: The wide band gap of metal-organic framework (MOF) 5 constrains its use in photocatalytic carbon dioxide (CO$_2$) reduction despite its high porosity and favorable mass-transport properties. Adopting a state-of-the-art first-principles approach, we systematically investigate the effects of volumetric strain, metal-node substitution, linker functionalization, and pH control as knobs to improve the CO$_2$ photocatalytic ability of MOF-5. Strain and metal-node substitution negligibly affect the gap, whereas linker functionalization narrows it into the visible range via in-gap states while preserving reduction-side alignment at pH = 0. The resulting reduction energetics are strongly sensitive to both linker functionalization and pH. Halogenated and hydroxylated frameworks provide access primarily to HCOOH, CO, and HCHO under alkaline conditions, principally with the Mg and Zn nodes, whereas COOH functionalization offers the broadest thermodynamic accessibility across the full CO$_2$ reduction sequence. NH$_2$ retains thermodynamic feasibility for all target reduction pathways but with larger overpotentials, while NO$_2$ generally yields unfavorable reduction energetics. Crucially, within the COOH series, the choice of the metal node tunes the fundamental gap by over 1 eV with only minor changes in the reduction overpotentials, placing Sr- and Ba-based architectures as the most favorable ones for broad product selectivity with visible-light excitation. Linker functionalization substantially reduces the spatial overlap of the frontier states, promoting photoinduced charge separation. Taken together, these results establish linker functionalization and solution pH as complementary design levers for independently tuning light absorption and CO$_2$-reduction energetics in MOF-5, establishing a rational and viable route for designing efficient MOF-based photocatalysts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles approach”（第一性原理方法），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：MOF-5（金属有机框架材料）及其光催化CO₂还原性能。具体研究体系包括：MOF-5在体积应变、金属节点取代（Mg、Zn、Sr、Ba等）、连接基官能化（卤化、羟基化、COOH、NH₂、NO₂等）以及不同pH条件下的光催化CO₂还原行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 连接基官能化可将MOF-5的带隙从宽禁带窄化至可见光范围（通过带隙内态实现），同时保持pH=0下还原侧的能带对齐；而应变和金属节点取代对带隙影响甚微。CO₂还原热力学对连接基官能化和pH均高度敏感，其中COOH官能化系列在Sr和Ba节点下展现出最宽的产物选择性和可见光激发可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：连接基官能化可将MOF-5的带隙从宽禁带窄化至可见光范围（通过带隙内态实现），同时保持pH=0下还原侧的能带对齐；而应变和金属节点取代对带隙影响甚微。CO₂还原热力学对连接基官能化和pH均高度敏感，其中COOH官能化系列在Sr和Ba节点下展现出最宽的产物选择性和可见光激发可行性。；创新点：提出连接基官能化与溶液pH作为互补的设计杠杆，可独立调控MOF-5的光吸收和CO₂还原能学，为MOF基光催化剂的设计提供了理性路径。摘要未突出说明与已有计算研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算方法（摘要未具体指明泛函类型，如DFT或杂化泛函等细节未明确说明），系统考察了体积应变、金属节点取代、连接基官能化和pH调控对MOF-5电子结构及CO₂还原能学的影响。

papers.title: Decoding Oxygen K-edge Fingerprints of NCM-811 Degradation via Ab Initio Many-Body Theory and High-Throughput Screening of Crystal Proxies
papers.abstract: The degradation of LiNi$_{0.8}$Co$_{0.1}$Mn$_{0.1}$O$_2$ (NCM-811) in Li-ion batteries produces complex transition-metal oxides and binary phases that fundamentally limit cathode performance. While identifying these degradation products via X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is essential for mitigating electrochemical performance loss, interpretation remains challenging due to the structural complexity of real-world samples. In this work, we present an integrated theoretical-experimental framework combining high-resolution oxygen K-edge XAS with \textit{ab initio} simulations based on many-body perturbation theory and high-throughput screening from density functional theory. We first evaluate the spectroscopic fingerprints of eight layered, spinel, and nominal rock-salt reference oxides, identifying discrepancies between the idealized single-crystal bulk phase and experimental spectra. Using high-throughput screening to analyze the oxygen $p$-projected density of states of 38 distinct polymorphs of NiO, CoO, and MnO, we propose that the spectral differences can emerge, among other factors, from a structural ensemble of local variations represented here by simplified structural proxies. Our work establishes a viable and rigorous computational pathway to interpret the complex landscape of degraded battery materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“high-resolution oxygen K-edge XAS”（实验手段）与“ab initio simulations based on many-body perturbation theory and high-throughput screening from density functional theory”（理论计算）。；研究对象：锂离子电池正极材料LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂（NCM-811）的退化产物，具体包括八种层状、尖晶石和名义岩盐结构的参考氧化物，以及NiO、CoO、MnO的38种多晶型物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NCM-811退化产物的氧K边X射线吸收谱与理想单晶体相之间存在光谱差异，这种差异可能源于由多种局部结构变化组成的结构系综（以简化结构代理物表示），而非单一晶体相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NCM-811退化产物的氧K边X射线吸收谱与理想单晶体相之间存在光谱差异，这种差异可能源于由多种局部结构变化组成的结构系综（以简化结构代理物表示），而非单一晶体相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出其新意在于将高通量结构筛选与多体理论光谱模拟相结合，用“结构代理物”概念来解释真实退化样品中复杂的光谱指纹，而非依赖理想单晶模型。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨率氧K边X射线吸收谱（XAS）；基于多体微扰理论的从头算模拟（如GW/BSE类方法）；基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的高通量筛选，用于分析氧p投影态密度。

papers.title: The Locality Cost of Fully Flat Hopf Insulators
papers.abstract: Hopf topology permits a strictly finite-range Hamiltonian with one exactly flat topological band. We prove, however, that extending flatness to the complete two-band spectrum necessarily sacrifices strict locality or the gap: any gapped, Hermitian, translationally invariant two-band Hamiltonian with strictly finite-range hopping and two exactly flat bands has vanishing Hopf invariant. Equivalently, within this two-band setting, a Hopf band admits no compactly supported, translation-covariant, orthonormal Wannier generator. For factorized one-flat-band Hopf parents, the unavoidable partner dispersion equals the Gram symbol of translated compact localized states and encodes their nonorthogonality. Full flattening converts this dispersion into exponentially decaying but infinitely supported hopping. Model-independent bounds provide a sufficient criterion for finite-range approximants to retain the Hopf phase. An explicit model yields the axial decay length $ξ_z/a=1/\ln 2$, parameter-free hopping tails, and residual bandwidths testable in circuit and photonic lattices. Hopf topology therefore does not prohibit a flat band but forces the locality--flatness cost to appear as either partner-band dispersion or nonlocal hopping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We prove”“model-independent bounds”“explicit model”等理论推导与模型构造关键词。；研究对象：Hopf绝缘体中的完全平坦能带问题，具体为具有Hopf拓扑的两带平移不变紧致哈密顿量，以及其Wannier生成元、局域性与能带平坦性之间的约束关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在严格有限程跃迁且两带均完全平坦的gapped两带哈密顿量中，Hopf不变量必然为零；即Hopf能带无法同时拥有紧致支持的Wannier基与完全平坦的伙伴能带，局域性与平坦性之间存在不可避免的代价——要么伙伴带有色散，要么跃迁非局域（指数衰减但无限延伸）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在严格有限程跃迁且两带均完全平坦的gapped两带哈密顿量中，Hopf不变量必然为零；即Hopf能带无法同时拥有紧致支持的Wannier基与完全平坦的伙伴能带，局域性与平坦性之间存在不可避免的代价——要么伙伴带有色散，要么跃迁非局域（指数衰减但无限延伸）。；创新点：首次严格证明在完整两带谱中“全平坦”与“严格局域”不可兼得，并量化了Hopf拓扑导致的局域性-平坦性代价；提供了无参数的跃迁尾巴形式及可实验检验的残余带宽预测。摘要未突出说明与以往Hopf绝缘体构造工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明（基于平移不变两带哈密顿量的拓扑不变量与Wannier可表示性论证）；对因子化单平坦带Hopf母模型进行解析分析，将伙伴带色散与Gram符号（平移紧致局域态的非正交性）关联；给出模型无关的界，并构造显式模型计算轴向衰减长度、跃迁尾巴及残余带宽。

papers.title: Charge-Transfer Electronic Structure of NiX$_2$ (X = S, Se)
papers.abstract: We investigate the electronic structures of NiS$_2$ and NiSe$_2$ using density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT). A realistic electronic structure within DFT+DMFT was determined by optimizing the double-counting correction to reproduce experimental valence-band photoemission spectra. The validity of the present model is further confirmed by its successful description of the Ni 2$p$ core-level photoemission and Ni $L$-edge x-ray absorption spectra of NiS$_2$. Our results reveal a smaller charge-transfer energy than previously assumed, resulting in substantial ligand-to-Ni charge transfer and a reduced Ni local moment. We clarify how the relative position and interaction between the Ni upper Hubbard band and the antibonding chalcogen-dimer states shape the evolution of the low-energy electronic structure across the NiS$_{2-x}$Se$_x$ series.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT)”，属于第一性原理多体计算方法。；研究对象：NiS₂和NiSe₂（以及NiS₂₋ₓSeₓ系列）的电荷转移电子结构，重点关注Ni 3d与硫族元素二聚体态之间的杂化与电荷转移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DFT+DMFT计算表明，NiX₂（X = S, Se）的实际电荷转移能比此前认为的更小，导致显著的配体→Ni电荷转移和减小的Ni局域磁矩；Ni上Hubbard带与反键硫族二聚体态的相对位置和相互作用决定了该系列低能电子结构的演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DFT+DMFT计算表明，NiX₂（X = S, Se）的实际电荷转移能比此前认为的更小，导致显著的配体→Ni电荷转移和减小的Ni局域磁矩；Ni上Hubbard带与反键硫族二聚体态的相对位置和相互作用决定了该系列低能电子结构的演化。；创新点：通过系统优化双计数修正获得与多种光谱实验定量一致的现实电子结构，并修正了此前对电荷转移能的过高估计，揭示了配体→Ni电荷转移程度及局域磁矩减小的新图像。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: DFT+DMFT（密度泛函理论+动力学平均场理论），通过优化双计数修正（double-counting correction）以复现实验价带光电子谱；并用Ni 2p芯级光电子谱和Ni L边X射线吸收谱进一步验证模型有效性。

papers.title: EuIn2Sb2: epitaxially stabilized axion insulator candidate with strong spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Eu triangular lattice layer compounds described by the general formula EuA2X2 have attracted growing attention due to a wide range of layered crystal structures and corresponding magnetic topological phases, arising from the coexistence of large Eu magnetic moments and energetically inverted A and X bands. Among the EuA2X2 family, EuIn2Sb2 has been predicted to host robust axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator states by stronger spin-orbit coupling but has not been experimentally realized, including the structural identification. Here we report the epitaxial stabilization of EuIn2Sb2 by adopting the molecular beam epitaxy technique. Structural characterization reveals that EuIn2Sb2 films are based on a unique In-on-In stacking, forming a new trilayer structure distinct from previously predicted structures in the EuA2X2 family. In addition to the in-plane antiferromagnetic ordering at TN=10.5K, the stronger spin-orbit coupling and enhanced In-In hybridization in EuIn2Sb2 make it an ideal candidate of axion insulator and higher-order topological insulator phases. These results establish EuIn2Sb2 as a new member of the EuA2X2 family and offer an advanced platform for exploring these magnetic topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“molecular beam epitaxy technique”（分子束外延技术）、“Structural characterization”（结构表征）等实验手段。；研究对象：EuIn2Sb2薄膜——EuA2X2家族中的一种Eu三角格子层状化合物，具体关注其作为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体候选材料的磁性拓扑物态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过分子束外延技术成功外延稳定生长了此前未被实验实现的EuIn2Sb2薄膜，其具有独特的In-on-In堆垛新三层结构；该材料在TN=10.5K发生面内反铁磁有序，且因更强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化，成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体的理想候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过分子束外延技术成功外延稳定生长了此前未被实验实现的EuIn2Sb2薄膜，其具有独特的In-on-In堆垛新三层结构；该材料在TN=10.5K发生面内反铁磁有序，且因更强的自旋轨道耦合和增强的In-In杂化，成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体的理想候选材料。；创新点：首次实验实现并结构鉴定EuIn2Sb2，发现其具有与EuA2X2家族此前预测结构不同的新型三层结构（In-on-In堆垛），并指出其强自旋轨道耦合使其成为轴子绝缘体和高阶拓扑绝缘体的理想平台。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长；结构表征（具体手段摘要未明确说明，如X射线衍射/反射高能电子衍射等未提及）；磁性测量（确定TN=10.5K的面内反铁磁有序）。

papers.title: Persistence and emergence of quantum defects through pressure-induced phase changes
papers.abstract: Extreme pressures can transform materials and their properties, but probing these in-situ is made challenging by the small sample volumes and access requirements demanded by diamond anvil cells. Quantum defects offer a route to local measurements under such conditions, yet their sensing performance can be dictated by pressure-induced changes in their own host material. On the other hand, pressure may also be harnessed as a tool to engineer and stabilize new quantum defects with emergent functionalities. Here, we demonstrate both aspects within a unified platform based on optically active spin-pair defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). As robust quantum sensors under pressure, these spin-1/2 systems retain pressure-independent spin resonances up to 20 GPa while maintaining or even enhancing their optical emission, in stark contrast to the spin-1 boron-vacancy centre in the same material. Simultaneously, we show that compression acts as a means of quantum defect engineering: the starting hBN undergoes an irreversible transformation into wurtzite boron nitride (wBN), during which the defect landscape is reconfigured. Spin-pair sensors are seen to persist across this structural transition, however, depending on the starting material we also observe new, highly fluorescent defects in the wBN phase. These results establish spin-pair defects in boron nitride as pressure-resilient quantum sensors while highlighting high pressure itself as a versatile pathway for creating and tuning quantum emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“demonstrate”“observed”“probe”“measurements”等实验性关键词，且涉及金刚石对顶砧（diamond anvil cells）等实验装置。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的光学活性自旋对（spin-pair）量子缺陷，以及高压诱导的结构相变（hBN→纤锌矿氮化硼 wBN）过程中缺陷的演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋对缺陷在高达 20 GPa 的压力下保持压力无关的自旋共振且光学发射不衰减甚至增强，是优异的耐压量子传感器；同时，压力可诱导 hBN 不可逆转变为 wBN，在此过程中缺陷景观被重构——自旋对缺陷跨相变存续，而特定起始材料中还会涌现出新型高荧光缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋对缺陷在高达 20 GPa 的压力下保持压力无关的自旋共振且光学发射不衰减甚至增强，是优异的耐压量子传感器；同时，压力可诱导 hBN 不可逆转变为 wBN，在此过程中缺陷景观被重构——自旋对缺陷跨相变存续，而特定起始材料中还会涌现出新型高荧光缺陷。；创新点：首次在同一平台上同时展示量子缺陷的“耐压传感”与“压力工程”双重功能：一方面证明自旋对缺陷比同材料中的自旋-1 硼空位中心（V_B）具有更强的压力鲁棒性；另一方面将高压本身作为创造和调控新型量子发射体的手段，在结构相变中实现缺陷物种的涌现与重构。
papers.method_zh: 高压原位光学与自旋测量：使用金刚石对顶砧（DAC）施加压力，结合光学发射谱和自旋共振（如 ODMR 类技术）表征缺陷的传感性能与结构相变行为。摘要未明确说明具体光谱技术细节（如是否使用共聚焦荧光显微镜、拉曼等）。

papers.title: Complete Topological Classification with P and T Symmetries: Revealing a Topological Invariant Invisible to K-Theory
papers.abstract: The K-theoretic framework provides a complete topological classification of the tenfold symmetry classes and has been generalized to incorporate crystalline symmetries. Here, we show that this classification is incomplete even in the elementary case of spinless systems possessing both P and T symmetries. We obtain the complete classification through a first-principles analysis of the topological classes of P- and T-symmetric bands, namely, by classifying the corresponding symmetric clutching data. We identify a topological invariant that is invisible from the K-theoretic perspective when the occupied states at each inversion-invariant momentum have uniformly positive or uniformly negative parity. In special cases, such as when all inversion-invariant momenta have uniformly positive parity, this invariant can be interpreted as the second Stiefel--Whitney class or the Euler number defined over an inversion fundamental domain, namely, half of the Brillouin zone. Our work not only reveals a new topological invariant that cannot be determined from the parity spectra at inversion-invariant momenta under P and T symmetries, but also demonstrates the existence of crystalline topological phases that are absent from the K-theoretic classification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“first-principles analysis”“classifying”“K-theoretic framework”等理论分类与数学结构分析词汇，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：具有P（空间反演）和T（时间反演）对称性的无自旋（spinless）电子能带系统，具体关注其拓扑分类问题，尤其是与K-理论分类的差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋体系中，K-理论框架给出的拓扑分类是不完整的；作者通过对称clutching data的完整分类，发现了一个K-理论视角下不可见的拓扑不变量，该不变量无法由反演不变动量点处的宇称谱确定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋体系中，K-理论框架给出的拓扑分类是不完整的；作者通过对称clutching data的完整分类，发现了一个K-理论视角下不可见的拓扑不变量，该不变量无法由反演不变动量点处的宇称谱确定。；创新点：揭示了K-理论分类遗漏的新型拓扑不变量，并证明了存在K-理论分类中缺失的晶体拓扑相；该不变量在占据态宇称均匀为正或均匀为负时无法从反演不变动量点的宇称谱中读出。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为拓扑能带分类的数学方法：对P-和T-对称能带进行第一性原理拓扑分类，即对相应的对称clutching data进行分类；在特殊情形下将该不变量解释为定义在反演基本域（半个布里渊区）上的第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数。

papers.title: Bell inequality violation with momentum-entangled massive particles
papers.abstract: Bell's theorem revealed the fundamental incompatibility between the predictions of quantum mechanics and local realism. Bell inequality violations have since demonstrated quantum nonlocality using photons and internal states of massive particles, but never using their motional states. Here we report the first Bell inequality violation in the motional states of massive particles. Using momentum-entangled pairs of metastable helium atoms manipulated by matter-wave interferometry, we measure a Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) Bell parameter of $S = 2.52 \pm 0.17$, violating the CHSH-Bell inequality ($S \le 2$). Our work completes a long-standing objective in quantum atom optics by extending Bell tests from internal quantum variables to the external degrees of freedom of massive particles, opening a new regime for exploring quantum nonlocality in matter waves and for investigating the interplay between quantum mechanics and gravity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确报告了实验测量结果（“we measure a CHSH-Bell parameter of S = 2.52 ± 0.17”），并描述了实验操控手段（“manipulated by matter-wave interferometry”）。；研究对象：动量纠缠的亚稳态氦原子对（massive particles，即大质量粒子）的质心运动（motional）自由度，具体为外部运动状态中的量子非局域性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在大质量粒子的运动状态（而非内部态）中实现了贝尔不等式违背，测得CHSH参数 S = 2.52 ± 0.17，明确违反局域实在论界限（S ≤ 2）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在大质量粒子的运动状态（而非内部态）中实现了贝尔不等式违背，测得CHSH参数 S = 2.52 ± 0.17，明确违反局域实在论界限（S ≤ 2）。；创新点：将贝尔不等式检验从光子和内部量子变量（如自旋、偏振）首次拓展到大质量粒子的外部运动自由度（动量），完成了量子原子光学中长期追求的目标，并为探索物质波中的量子非局域性及量子力学与引力相互作用开辟了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有实验在技术实现上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 利用物质波干涉仪（matter-wave interferometry）操控动量纠缠的亚稳态氦原子对，测量其CHSH型贝尔参数。摘要未明确说明具体干涉仪构型（如是否采用双缝或布拉格衍射等），也未提及探测效率或符合计数细节。

papers.title: Symmetry-enforced third-order nonlinear thermal Hall effects in altermagnets
papers.abstract: Thermal Hall effect (THE) is a powerful probe of material properties, even in insulators. Here we investigate the thermal response of altermagnets by developing a theory on Berry curvature driven nonlinear THE from both electrons and magnons. We identify symmetry conditions under which the third-order THE dominates while linear and second-order contributions vanish. Notably, d-wave and i-wave altermagnets with out-of-plane Neel order satisfy these conditions, whereas in-plane order yields a dominant linear THE. Using KV2Se2O (a d-wave altermagnetic metal) and MnF2 (an altermagnetic insulator) as concrete examples, we show nonzero third-order nonlinear THE from electrons and magnons, respectively, both exhibiting a pi-periodic dependence on the direction of temperature gradient. These symmetry-guaranteed Berry curvature phenomena provide a diagnostic for altermagnetism in candidate materials and enable determination of the Neel vector orientation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“developing a theory”“symmetry conditions”“symmetry-guaranteed”等理论推导关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：交变磁体（altermagnets）中的非线性热霍尔效应，具体涉及d波交变磁金属KV₂Se₂O和交变磁绝缘体MnF₂，以及电子和磁振子两种载流子贡献的热输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有面外Néel序的d波和i波交变磁体中，三阶非线性热霍尔效应占主导，而线性和二阶贡献为零；该效应随温度梯度方向呈π周期性变化，可用于诊断交变磁性并确定Néel矢量取向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有面外Néel序的d波和i波交变磁体中，三阶非线性热霍尔效应占主导，而线性和二阶贡献为零；该效应随温度梯度方向呈π周期性变化，可用于诊断交变磁性并确定Néel矢量取向。；创新点：首次从对称性角度系统论证了交变磁体中三阶非线性热霍尔效应可在线性和二阶贡献消失的条件下占主导，并指出该效应可作为确定Néel矢量取向的对称性判据。摘要未突出说明与已有非线性输运理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于Berry曲率驱动的非线性热霍尔效应理论框架，分别对电子和磁振子两种准粒子建立输运理论；通过对称性分析确定三阶效应占主导的对称条件，并以KV₂Se₂O和MnF₂作为具体材料示例进行验证。

papers.title: Machine-learning screening and first-principles lattice dynamics resolve the most stable structure of NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ from a data-driven candidate search
papers.abstract: Equimolar NaCa(BH$_4$)$_3$ offers a theoretical hydrogen capacity of 11.24 wt.% and a decomposition enthalpy expected to fall between those of NaBH$_4$ and Ca(BH$_4$)$_2$, but it has never been prepared and no crystal structure has been reported. Predictions for it have so far been built within the perovskite family that its heavier homologues adopt. Here that assumption is removed. Six candidate frameworks were assembled from three independent sources --- experimentally determined ABX$_3$ borohydrides, a distorted perovskite from data-driven structure prediction, and an unbiased search over a structural database in which all 2238 generated candidates were relaxed with none excluded --- and at fixed charge-neutral composition the cation arrangement of every framework was enumerated exhaustively, 420 decorations reducing to 118 symmetry-inequivalent configurations, screened with a machine-learning potential and settled from first principles. The most stable structure is not a perovskite. It is a monoclinic framework of space group Cm, reached only by the unrestricted search, at $-$4.185640 eV/atom, 7.67 meV/atom below the best framework available beforehand; two chemically unrelated donor prototypes converge on it to 0.076 meV/atom, and its ordered cation arrangement is the ground state of its own series. Its phonon spectrum carries no imaginary mode at any wavevector the supercell resolves exactly and its relaxed-ion elastic tensor is positive definite, whereas the orthorhombic perovskite candidate is unstable to $-$2.401 THz. That contrast supplies a physical reason for the reported failure to obtain this composition in perovskite form, and the simulated diffraction pattern reported here identifies the predicted framework by seven reflections that neither parent phase nor the competing framework produces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learning screening、first-principles lattice dynamics、data-driven candidate search、DFT（隐含于first-principles）、phonon spectrum、elastic tensor。；研究对象：NaCa(BH₄)₃ 这一等摩尔碱金属/碱土金属硼氢化物，一种理论储氢材料（理论氢容量11.24 wt.%），此前从未被合成，也无晶体结构报道。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NaCa(BH₄)₃ 最稳定的晶体结构并非其重同系物所采用的钙钛矿结构，而是一种单斜 Cm 空间群框架，能量比此前最佳候选结构低 7.67 meV/atom；该结构无虚声子模式且弹性张量正定，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在 −2.401 THz 的虚频，解释了为何该组成难以以钙钛矿形式合成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NaCa(BH₄)₃ 最稳定的晶体结构并非其重同系物所采用的钙钛矿结构，而是一种单斜 Cm 空间群框架，能量比此前最佳候选结构低 7.67 meV/atom；该结构无虚声子模式且弹性张量正定，而正交钙钛矿候选结构存在 −2.401 THz 的虚频，解释了为何该组成难以以钙钛矿形式合成。；创新点：突破了此前仅限钙钛矿家族的结构假设，采用无偏数据库搜索并穷举阳离子排列，发现最稳定结构是非钙钛矿的单斜 Cm 框架；该结构由两个化学上无关的供体原型收敛至同一结构（能量差仅0.076 meV/atom），并通过声子与弹性稳定性对比给出了该组成无法以钙钛矿形式合成的物理原因。
papers.method_zh: 从三个独立来源构建六种候选框架（实验已知ABX₃硼氢化物、数据驱动结构预测得到的畸变钙钛矿、对结构数据库的无偏搜索——2238个候选全部弛豫无一排除）；在固定电荷中性组成下穷举所有阳离子排列（420种装饰简并为118种对称不等价构型）；用机器学习势进行筛选，再用第一性原理（DFT）方法最终确定能量；计算声子谱和弛豫离子弹性张量判断动力学与力学稳定性；模拟X射线衍射图谱用于实验识别。

papers.title: Observation of g-wave altermagnetic multipole
papers.abstract: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a $g$-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in $g$-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the $g$-wave multipole and the $g$-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“direct visualization”“high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction”“polarized neutron diffraction”等实验手段，并结合了微观模型分析，属于实验为主、辅以理论建模的混合类型。；研究对象：g波交错磁（altermagnet）多极子，具体材料为典型交错磁体CrSb（铬锑）。研究聚焦于其价电子密度分布的各向异性及隐藏的多极序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高能同步辐射X射线衍射与价电子密度分析，直接观测到CrSb中g波交错磁电十六极（electric hexadecapole）的反铁磁序排列，并证明其与反铁磁磁偶极共存，诱导出铁磁多极序。该工作为交错磁提供了实空间指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高能同步辐射X射线衍射与价电子密度分析，直接观测到CrSb中g波交错磁电十六极（electric hexadecapole）的反铁磁序排列，并证明其与反铁磁磁偶极共存，诱导出铁磁多极序。该工作为交错磁提供了实空间指纹。；创新点：首次直接可视化并定量表征了g波交错磁多极（电十六极）的实空间分布，建立了通过多极观测探测量子材料中隐藏多极序的通用方法。摘要未突出说明与以往交错磁实验（如自旋分辨光电子谱等）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 高能同步辐射X射线衍射（用于价电子密度VED分析）、极化中子衍射（用于探测磁多极），并结合微观模型将g波多极与g波自旋劈裂直接关联。

papers.title: Non-Additivity of Microwave-Shielded Interactions between Dipolar Molecules
papers.abstract: Theoretical models of the effective interactions between microwave-shielded polar molecules typically rely on the assumption of pairwise additivity. In this work, we test the validity of this pairwise approximation by evaluating the exact many-body potential energy for configurations of three and four molecules.
