We demonstrate that this approximation fails for molecule configurations in the plane of the circularly polarized microwave field. In these planar geometries, many-body effects significantly increase the depth of the attractive potential well and shift the position of the repulsive barrier. Although out-of-plane interactions in three-dimensional arrangements weaken this non-additivity, the effective interactions between microwave-shielded dipoles are not a simple sum of pair interactions. In particular, their attractive well, crucial for self-bound clusters, can only be described by the full many-body potential energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Theoretical models”“evaluating the exact many-body potential energy”，属于理论计算与分析。；研究对象：微波屏蔽（microwave-shielded）的极性分子体系，具体研究三分子和四分子构型中的有效相互作用，以及该相互作用是否满足两两可加性（pairwise additivity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微波屏蔽偶极分子之间的有效相互作用不满足两两可加性假设。在圆偏振微波场平面内的构型中，多体效应显著加深了吸引势阱深度并移动了排斥势垒位置；即使在三维排列中，非可加性虽被削弱，但有效相互作用仍不能简单视为两两相互作用之和，自束缚团簇所依赖的吸引势阱只能由完整多体势能描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微波屏蔽偶极分子之间的有效相互作用不满足两两可加性假设。在圆偏振微波场平面内的构型中，多体效应显著加深了吸引势阱深度并移动了排斥势垒位置；即使在三维排列中，非可加性虽被削弱，但有效相互作用仍不能简单视为两两相互作用之和，自束缚团簇所依赖的吸引势阱只能由完整多体势能描述。；创新点：首次系统检验了微波屏蔽极性分子有效相互作用中两两可加性近似的适用性，明确指出该近似在平面构型中失效，并揭示多体效应对吸引势阱和排斥势垒位置的关键修正。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 通过精确计算三分子和四分子构型的完整多体势能面（exact many-body potential energy），并与基于两两可加性假设的理论模型结果进行对比，检验该近似的有效性。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如是否采用量子化学计算或变分法等）。

papers.title: Interaction effects on Andreev states from an electromagnetic environment
papers.abstract: Here we present a detailed theoretical investigation of the environment-induced interaction correction to the ground states and addition energies in a short superconducting junction. We derive general formulas for these corrections linking them to the frequency-dependent admittance of the junction and the environment impedance. We specify two environmental models: that of an external impedance and the Mattis-Bardeen model. In both cases we assume $G_Q Z \ll 1$, where $G_Q$ is the conductance quantum and $Z$ the typical environmental resistance. While an expectation is that the typical scale of the relative correction is of the order $G_Q Z$, we have found that in many cases the dimensionless scale $L G_Q Δ$ provides a better estimation, where $Δ$ is the superconducting energy gap and $L$ an external inductance. We discuss the logarithmic renormalizations of the energies by low- and high-frequency phase fluctuations and single out a non-superconducting contribution related to the renormalization of transmission eigenvalues. We investigate in detail the peculiarities of the corrections at: i. small phases, where the interaction causes a current jump, ii. Andreev bound state energies close to the gap edge, iii. Andreev bound state energies close to Fermi level. In all these cases the correction may become comparable with the unperturbed energy, even for $G_Q Z \ll 1$, and we briefly sketch non-perturbative models relevant for the situations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretical investigation”“derive general formulas”“non-perturbative models”等表述，属于解析/半解析理论推导。；研究对象：短超导结（short superconducting junction）中的Andreev态，以及电磁环境（external impedance、Mattis-Bardeen模型）引起的相互作用修正对基态能量和附加能（addition energies）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境诱导的相互作用修正并不总是由小参数G_Q Z决定，在许多情况下无量纲尺度L G_Q Δ（L为外部电感，Δ为超导能隙）能更好地估计修正大小；在特定极限下（小相位、Andreev能级接近能隙边缘或费米能级），即使G_Q Z ≪ 1，修正也可能与未微扰能量相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境诱导的相互作用修正并不总是由小参数G_Q Z决定，在许多情况下无量纲尺度L G_Q Δ（L为外部电感，Δ为超导能隙）能更好地估计修正大小；在特定极限下（小相位、Andreev能级接近能隙边缘或费米能级），即使G_Q Z ≪ 1，修正也可能与未微扰能量相当。；创新点：揭示了修正强度的主导尺度并非传统预期的G_Q Z，而是L G_Q Δ；并识别出与透射本征值重整化相关的非超导贡献；系统分析了三个特殊参数区域中微扰失效、修正可与未微扰能量相比的情形。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于频率相关的结导纳（frequency-dependent admittance）和环境阻抗建立一般修正公式；针对两种环境模型（外部阻抗模型和Mattis-Bardeen模型）在G_Q Z ≪ 1条件下进行微扰分析；讨论低/高频相位涨落导致的能量对数重整化；对特殊参数区域（小相位、能隙边缘、费米能级附近）给出非微扰模型的简要框架。

papers.title: Microscopic dynamics of contagion using active Brownian particles: universal scaling and propagation controlled by protection
papers.abstract: Understanding how individual protection and population density influence epidemic spreading remains a central challenge in epidemiology. While classical compartmental models successfully describe the temporal evolution of epidemics, they do not explicitly account for the microscopic motion and spatial organisation of individuals. Here, we investigate contagion dynamics using an agent-based model of Active Brownian Particles (ABPs), where self-propelled agents interact through local contact and a prescribed fraction of the population is protected. By systematically varying the protected-agent fraction and the population density, we identify two distinct contagion regimes separated by a crossover protection of approximately $30\%$. Below this threshold, the maximum contagion rate follows the universal scaling $ν_{\mathrm{max}}\proptoφ^{1/2}$, indicating that disease transmission is governed primarily by frequency of encounters. Above the threshold, universal scaling is lost and protection becomes the dominant mechanism controlling epidemic spreading, with the strongest suppression occurring in low-density populations. These results demonstrate that microscopic active-matter models provide a powerful framework for investigating epidemic dynamics beyond the assumptions of well-mixed population models and reveal how spatial organisation and individual protection jointly determine contagion dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“agent-based model”（基于个体的模型）和“Active Brownian Particles (ABPs)”进行模拟研究。；研究对象：传染病传播的微观动力学，具体为活性布朗粒子（ABPs）体系中个体保护比例与种群密度对疫情传播的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保护比例约30%以下，最大传染率满足普适标度 ν_max ∝ φ^(1/2)，传播由相遇频率主导；超过该阈值后普适标度失效，保护机制成为控制传播的主导因素，且在低密度群体中抑制效果最强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保护比例约30%以下，最大传染率满足普适标度 ν_max ∝ φ^(1/2)，传播由相遇频率主导；超过该阈值后普适标度失效，保护机制成为控制传播的主导因素，且在低密度群体中抑制效果最强。；创新点：将活性物质（active matter）微观模型引入流行病传播研究，突破了经典房室模型（compartmental models）中“充分混合”（well-mixed）假设的局限，揭示了空间组织与个体保护共同决定传播动力学的机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于活性布朗粒子的个体模型（agent-based ABP simulation），自驱动粒子通过局域接触相互作用，并设定一定比例的保护个体，系统改变保护比例与种群密度进行参数扫描。

papers.title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
papers.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained within the established VASP/PHELEL framework. Using targeted grid-point sampling and feature-diversity selection for efficient model training, we validate MLLocP for elemental Cu, polar BAs, and chemically disordered Cu3Au. The learned potentials and their resulting displacement derivatives closely reproduce direct density functional theory calculations, yielding transport coefficients within approximately 3.5% for BAs mobility, 8% for Cu conductivity, and 11% for Cu3Au conductivity. For the 32-atom Cu3Au special quasirandom structure, using 40 sampled configurations reduces the number of self-consistent calculations by about fivefold relative to the 192 displaced structures required directly; using 20 or 10 configurations increases the acceleration to approximately 10- and 20-fold, with conductivity errors of 14.3% and 18.6%, respectively. MLLocP thus provides a scalable route to PAW electron-phonon calculations in complex materials while preserving the underlying all-electron formalism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning strategy、density functional theory calculations、self-consistent supercell calculations。；研究对象：电子-声子相互作用及其对载流子输运的影响，具体材料包括元素Cu、极性半导体BAs以及化学无序合金Cu3Au。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为MLLocP的机器学习策略，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，可在投影缀加波（PAW）框架内高效且准确地计算电子-声子矩阵元，使输运系数误差控制在约3.5%（BAs迁移率）、8%（Cu电导率）和11%（Cu3Au电导率）以内，同时大幅减少自洽超胞计算次数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为MLLocP的机器学习策略，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，可在投影缀加波（PAW）框架内高效且准确地计算电子-声子矩阵元，使输运系数误差控制在约3.5%（BAs迁移率）、8%（Cu电导率）和11%（Cu3Au电导率）以内，同时大幅减少自洽超胞计算次数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习方法学习PAW框架中的局域势部分，结合定向网格点采样和特征多样性选择进行高效模型训练；其余PAW量保留在VASP/PHELEL框架内。通过有限位移法评估位移导数，并与直接DFT计算结果对比验证。

papers.title: Morphology and Dynamics of Self-interstitial Clusters in Irradiated Nickel
papers.abstract: Self-interstitial atom (SIA) clustering is a key early step in radiation damage evolution in face-centered cubic (FCC) metals, governing defect transport, recombination, and the long-term microstructural response of irradiated alloys. We combine molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and high-speed (>1000 frames/s) in situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM) to investigate the structure, energetics, and migration dynamics of SIA clusters in FCC Ni. MD simulations show that interstitials initially form disordered dumbbell clusters that evolve into either sessile Frank loops or glissile perfect (prismatic) loops; the latter progressively reorganize into compact ordered configurations with increasing mobility. Direct construction of both loop types over a wide size range, validated against MD-relaxed structures, shows that perfect loops are thermodynamically favored over Frank loops for cluster sizes N greater than or equal to 14, where N is the number of SIAs, with the energetic advantage increasing with cluster size. Nevertheless, substantial kinetic barriers allow Frank loops to persist as metastable defects. For perfect loops, diffusion coefficients computed over N = 16 to 400 reveal a nearly size-independent migration barrier of approximately 0.02 eV, while the diffusion prefactor decreases approximately as N^(-0.54). Trajectory analysis reveals a non-rigid, row-wise relay mechanism in which the number of participating atoms increases systematically with loop size, accounting for much of the observed prefactor scaling. Sub-millisecond in situ TEM observations reveal intermittent loop motion at velocities higher than previously observed but still several orders of magnitude below the intrinsic mobilities predicted by MD, indicating migration through a heterogeneous energy landscape of mobile and pinned states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算+实验）。判断依据关键词：molecular dynamics (MD) simulations、in situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM)。；研究对象：面心立方（FCC）金属镍（Ni）中辐照产生的自间隙原子（SIA）团簇的结构、能量学与迁移动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MD模拟表明，间隙原子先形成无序哑铃团簇，随后演化为非本征Frank环或可滑移的完美（棱柱）环；当团簇尺寸N≥14时完美环在热力学上更稳定，但其扩散迁移势垒几乎与尺寸无关（约0.02 eV），而扩散前因子随尺寸近似按N^(-0.54)下降。原位TEM观测到亚毫秒尺度的间歇性环运动，其速度远低于MD预测的本征迁移率，表明实际迁移受异质能量景观（移动态与钉扎态）调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MD模拟表明，间隙原子先形成无序哑铃团簇，随后演化为非本征Frank环或可滑移的完美（棱柱）环；当团簇尺寸N≥14时完美环在热力学上更稳定，但其扩散迁移势垒几乎与尺寸无关（约0.02 eV），而扩散前因子随尺寸近似按N^(-0.54)下降。原位TEM观测到亚毫秒尺度的间歇性环运动，其速度远低于MD预测的本征迁移率，表明实际迁移受异质能量景观（移动态与钉扎态）调控。；创新点：将MD模拟与高速原位TEM相结合，首次在亚毫秒时间尺度上直接观测到SIA环的间歇性运动，并揭示了完美环扩散前因子随尺寸的幂律标度（N^(-0.54)）及其背后的非刚性、逐行中继（row-wise relay）迁移机制。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的其他对比性创新。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟（用于结构、能量学与扩散系数计算，尺寸范围N=16–400）；高速原位透射电子显微镜（>1000帧/秒，用于亚毫秒时间分辨的环运动观测）；直接构建两种环类型并对照MD弛豫结构进行验证。

papers.title: Molecular spin qubits in a van der Waals bottle
papers.abstract: Advancing quantum information technologies requires qubits whose coherence can be precisely engineered. Among the qubit platforms in development, molecular spin qubits (MSQs) stand out for their atomic scale tunability and chemical specificity, making them powerful candidates for sensing, simulation, and information processing. However, integrating MSQs into solid-state architectures without degrading their coherence remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce van der Waals (vdW) confinement within two-dimensional materials as a strategy for stabilizing quantum states in MSQs by engineering their local electronic, vibrational, and symmetry environments. Using cobaltocene as a model system, we show that confinement within vdW SnS2 and CdPS3 single crystals reorganizes the single-ion energy landscape and slows spin-lattice relaxation by over two orders of magnitude relative to unconfined cobaltocene. The confined MSQs adopt deterministic orientations and self-assemble into ordered, atomically precise superlattices, establishing vdW confinement as a pathway for integrating MSQs into functional quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we introduce”“we show that”“confinement within vdW SnS2 and CdPS3 single crystals reorganizes…”等表述，描述了对实际材料体系的观测结果（如自旋-晶格弛豫减慢两个数量级），属于实验研究。；研究对象：分子自旋量子比特（MSQs）在二维范德华（vdW）材料中的限域体系。具体材料为：钴茂（cobaltocene）分子被嵌入SnS₂和CdPS₃单晶的范德华层间，形成有序超晶格。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将钴茂分子限域在vdW材料层间，可重构其单离子能级景观，并使自旋-晶格弛豫速率比未限域的钴茂减慢两个数量级以上；限域后的MSQs具有确定取向并自组装成原子级精确的有序超晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将钴茂分子限域在vdW材料层间，可重构其单离子能级景观，并使自旋-晶格弛豫速率比未限域的钴茂减慢两个数量级以上；限域后的MSQs具有确定取向并自组装成原子级精确的有序超晶格。；创新点：首次提出将二维材料中的vdW限域作为稳定分子自旋量子比特量子态的通用策略，通过工程化局域电子、振动和对称性环境来保护量子相干性，并实现MSQs在固态架构中的有序集成——解决了MSQs集成到固态器件时相干性退化这一核心挑战。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如EPR、磁测量、光学光谱等），仅提及通过vdW限域策略实现稳定化，并观测了自旋-晶格弛豫动力学和结构有序性。具体表征技术（如X射线衍射、电子顺磁共振、拉曼光谱等）摘要未给出。

papers.title: Magnons in Metallic Altermagnetic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin excitation in altermagnetic vanadium oxyselenides, focusing on the metallic quasi-two-dimensional compound $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$. Using a fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations, we compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation and extract the magnon dispersion relation. We show that the altermagnetic symmetry leads to characteristic degeneracies and directional splittings in both the electronic bands and the magnon spectra along high-symmetry paths of the Brillouin zone. The metallic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$ exhibits finite magnon linewidths arising from the coupling to the particle-hole continuum. Furthermore, by fixing the magnitude of the wave vector and varying its in-plane direction, we uncover a pronounced angular dependence of the magnon energies and lifetimes, with complementary damping behavior between the two magnon branches. Upon including spin-orbit coupling, the system exhibits an out-of-plane easy c-axis anisotropy, which opens a magnon gap of approximately 6 meV at the $Γ$-point, possibly rendering the magnetic order stable at room temperature. Our results demonstrate that altermagnetism controls not only the dispersion but also the anisotropic decay of spin excitations, highlighting altermagnetic metals as promising platforms for directionally selective magnon transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations”“compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation”，属于第一性原理结合模型计算的理论研究。；研究对象：金属准二维交变磁（altermagnetic）钒氧硒化合物 KV₂Se₂O，具体研究其自旋激发（磁振子）行为、电子能带与磁振子谱的各向异性，以及自旋-轨道耦合对磁各向异性和磁振子能隙的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交变磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱沿高对称路径出现特征性的简并和方向性劈裂；金属性 KV₂Se₂O 中磁振子因与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合而具有有限线宽，且磁振子能量和寿命随波矢面内方向呈显著角度依赖，两支磁振子分支表现出互补的阻尼行为。加入自旋-轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，可能使磁有序在室温下稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交变磁对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱沿高对称路径出现特征性的简并和方向性劈裂；金属性 KV₂Se₂O 中磁振子因与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合而具有有限线宽，且磁振子能量和寿命随波矢面内方向呈显著角度依赖，两支磁振子分支表现出互补的阻尼行为。加入自旋-轨道耦合后，体系呈现面外易 c 轴各向异性，在 Γ 点打开约 6 meV 的磁振子能隙，可能使磁有序在室温下稳定。；创新点：首次在金属交变磁体中系统揭示交变磁对称性不仅控制磁振子色散，还控制自旋激发的各向异性衰减（方向选择性阻尼），提出交变磁金属可作为方向选择性磁振子输运的候选平台。摘要未突出说明与具体实验对比或与其他交变磁材料体系的定量比较。
papers.method_zh: 基于从头计算（ab initio）导出的费米子哈密顿量，在随机相位近似（RPA）框架内计算横向自旋磁化率，并提取磁振子色散关系；通过固定波矢大小、改变面内方向研究磁振子能量与寿命的角度依赖；通过加入自旋-轨道耦合考察磁各向异性及磁振子能隙。

papers.title: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
papers.abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of $Γ$-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS$_3$, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an $s$-wave spin-split state with $Δ(Γ)\neq0$, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a $d$-wave altermagnetic state with $Δ(Γ)=0$. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），并基于对称性分析提出理论机制。；研究对象：共线反铁磁材料中的非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS），具体材料为MnPS₃，物理现象为相干声子驱动的动态自旋劈裂及其对称性选择性调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共线反铁磁体中，激发Γ点红外活性相干声子可动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂；不同对称性的声子模式分别产生s波自旋劈裂态（Δ(Γ)≠0）和d波交错磁（altermagnetic）态（Δ(Γ)=0），且劈裂大小随声子振幅线性变化，位移反转时自旋极化方向随之反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共线反铁磁体中，激发Γ点红外活性相干声子可动态诱导并控制非相对论自旋劈裂；不同对称性的声子模式分别产生s波自旋劈裂态（Δ(Γ)≠0）和d波交错磁（altermagnetic）态（Δ(Γ)=0），且劈裂大小随声子振幅线性变化，位移反转时自旋极化方向随之反转。；创新点：首次提出利用相干声子作为直接、偏振与模式选择性的手段，在反铁磁体中动态诱导不同对称性类型的NRSS相（s波与d波），实现无需磁化的超快自旋劈裂调控。摘要未突出说明与已有静态或磁控方案的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论，具体泛函形式摘要未明确说明）；对称性分析（基于剩余亚晶格连接对称性对动量空间劈裂形式的分类）；Γ点红外活性声子模式激发模拟，并考虑光偏振与声子模式的耦合选择性。

papers.title: Kelvin-Helmholtz instability in annular superfluids across the UFG-BCS crossover
papers.abstract: We investigate the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability of counter-rotating annular Fermi superfluids using time-dependent superfluid density functional theory. When the two initially separated superflows merge, a necklace of quantized vortices forms at their interface and subsequently becomes unstable. We extract mode-resolved instability growth rates and study their dependence on relative flow velocity, interaction strength, and temperature across the strongly interacting unitary regime and the weakly attractive BCS regime. In the unitary gas and moderate BCS regimes, the growth rates remain qualitatively consistent with the point-vortex model, though systematically at or above its predictions, with no significant dependence on interaction strength or temperature up to approximately $0.3 T_c$. Deeper in the BCS regime, the dynamics change qualitatively: boundary-generated antivortices proliferate faster than the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability itself, destroying the initial vortex necklace before the instability can fully develop. These results provide a microscopic benchmark for Kelvin-Helmholtz dynamics in fermionic superfluids and help constrain possible explanations of the existing experiment-theory discrepancy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“time-dependent superfluid density functional theory”（含时超流体密度泛函理论）进行数值模拟研究。；研究对象：环形费米超流体中的Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性，具体覆盖从强相互作用的幺正（unitary）区到弱吸引的BCS区的交叉区域，涉及反向旋转的两股超流合并时界面涡旋动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在幺正气体和中等BCS区，Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性增长率与点涡模型定性一致但系统性偏高，且对相互作用强度和温度（至约0.3 Tc）不敏感；深入BCS区后，边界产生的反涡旋增殖快于不稳定性本身，在涡旋项链完全形成前即将其破坏，动力学行为发生质变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在幺正气体和中等BCS区，Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性增长率与点涡模型定性一致但系统性偏高，且对相互作用强度和温度（至约0.3 Tc）不敏感；深入BCS区后，边界产生的反涡旋增殖快于不稳定性本身，在涡旋项链完全形成前即将其破坏，动力学行为发生质变。；创新点：首次对费米超流体中Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性提供微观尺度的基准计算结果，覆盖从幺正到BCS的完整交叉区域，并系统考察了相对流速、相互作用强度和温度的影响，可用于约束现有实验与理论之间差异的可能解释。
papers.method_zh: 含时超流体密度泛函理论（time-dependent superfluid density functional theory），用于模拟环形费米超流体中反向旋转超流的合并过程，并提取模式分辨的不稳定性增长率。

papers.title: Tuning Boron-Vacancy Qubit Coherence through Layer Number in hBN
papers.abstract:
The negatively charged boron vacancy ($\VB$) in hexagonal boron nitride (\hBN{}) was the first optically addressable spin qubit identified inside a van der Waals crystal, allowing atomically defined placement relative to a target. Its coherence in bulk \hBN{} is limited by the boron nuclei of the layers flanking the defect plane, which a thin flake removes. Here, we use a generalized cluster-correlation expansion with an extended central-spin block to calculate the Hahn-echo coherence time of $\VB$ in h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N as a function of layer number. Our results show that $T_2$ rises from $199
s$ in the bulk limit to $653
s$ in a monolayer, a factor of $3.3$ that is already saturated at three layers and that a sublattice decomposition attributes entirely to boron. The enhancement is confined to low field, is insensitive to stacking registry and twist angle, and requires alignment to within about two degrees, an onset we reproduce with no free parameters. Under dynamical decoupling, a $1/e$ threshold returns $206
s$ for every thickness, but this is a zero of the first-shell modulation rather than a decay: measured without a threshold, the layer contrast survives and reaches a factor of $170$. Layer number thus emerges as a design parameter for $\VB$-based sensing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“calculate”“generalized cluster-correlation expansion”“sublattice decomposition”等理论计算方法关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB⁻）自旋缺陷，具体研究其Hahn-echo相干时间（T₂）随hBN层数（从体相到单层）的变化规律。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: VB⁻的T₂随层数减少而显著提升：从体相极限的199 ns增至单层的653 ns（提升3.3倍），且该增强在3层时已饱和；层数对比的增强仅局限于低磁场区域，且对堆叠方式不敏感，但要求层间对准偏差在约2°以内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：VB⁻的T₂随层数减少而显著提升：从体相极限的199 ns增至单层的653 ns（提升3.3倍），且该增强在3层时已饱和；层数对比的增强仅局限于低磁场区域，且对堆叠方式不敏感，但要求层间对准偏差在约2°以内。；创新点：首次将层数作为VB⁻自旋量子比特相干性的设计参数，揭示了薄层（≤3层）即可完全消除体相中相邻层硼核导致的退相干限制，且该增强机制无需自由参数即可复现角度对准阈值。摘要未突出说明与以往理论计算在方法上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义团簇关联展开（generalized cluster-correlation expansion）方法，并扩展中心自旋块（extended central-spin block），计算h¹¹B¹⁵N中VB⁻的Hahn-echo相干时间随层数的函数关系；同时使用子晶格分解（sublattice decomposition）分析不同核自旋的贡献；动态去耦（dynamical decoupling）下的1/e阈值分析用于区分真实衰减与调制零点。

papers.title: Evolution from Kitaev to XXZ spin chains via distortion: Application to BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$
papers.abstract: BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ is a prototypical spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain antiferromagnet that provides a unique platform for studying field-induced quantum magnetism. Under a transverse magnetic field, it exhibits unusual magnetic properties, including an anomalous staggered magnetization and a pronounced anisotropy of the critical field with respect to the in-plane field direction. While these phenomena have been attributed phenomenologically to a site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor, a recent microscopic theory has shown that spin-orbit coupling naturally generates bond-dependent Heisenberg, Kitaev, and $Γ$ exchange interactions. Here, we unify these two pictures by extending the microscopic theory to incorporate distortions of the CoO$_6$ octahedra. We show that the distortions not only generate the site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor but also renormalize the staggered exchange interactions through a distortion-induced contribution that partially compensates the Kitaev-derived staggered term. Using point-charge calculations to estimate the $g$-tensor of BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$, we demonstrate that the strong anisotropy of the critical field originates from the combined effects of the modified exchange interactions and the anisotropic $g$-tensor. Our work provides a unified microscopic framework for understanding the magnetic anisotropy of spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“微观理论”“点电荷计算”“统一微观框架”，属于理论建模与计算分析，无实验数据。；研究对象：准一维自旋-轨道耦合 Ising 链反铁磁体 BaCo₂V₂O₈，具体关注其在外加横向磁场下的量子磁性行为，包括异常的交错磁化强度和临界场的面内方向各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将微观理论扩展到包含 CoO₆ 八面体畸变，作者统一了“位点依赖各向异性 g 张量”与“键依赖 Kitaev/Γ 交换”两种图像，证明畸变不仅产生各向异性 g 张量，还通过畸变诱导的贡献部分补偿 Kitaev 来源的交错交换项，从而解释了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 临界场的强各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将微观理论扩展到包含 CoO₆ 八面体畸变，作者统一了“位点依赖各向异性 g 张量”与“键依赖 Kitaev/Γ 交换”两种图像，证明畸变不仅产生各向异性 g 张量，还通过畸变诱导的贡献部分补偿 Kitaev 来源的交错交换项，从而解释了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 临界场的强各向异性。；创新点：首次将位点依赖 g 张量的唯象描述与键依赖交换作用的微观理论统一起来，并揭示畸变对交错交换项的补偿机制，为自旋-轨道耦合 Ising 链材料的磁各向异性提供了统一的微观解释框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为自旋-轨道耦合微观模型，扩展至包含 CoO₆ 八面体畸变；采用点电荷模型计算 g 张量，并结合修正后的交换相互作用与各向异性 g 张量分析临界场各向异性。摘要未提及具体数值方法（如 DFT、DMRG 等）。

papers.title: Piston-Like Information Engine II: Boundary-Controlled Optimum in Active Matter
papers.abstract: Information engines convert information into extractable work through measurements and feedback. We realize an engine that employs information to compress a gas of self-propelled bristle bots. Its work per measurement, $\bar{W}$, is controlled by the size of the detection region $Δx$ and the probability $p_1$ that this region is vacant. In thermal systems, $\bar{W}$ follows the universal form $-p_1 \ln p_1$, whereas the active engine shows a qualitatively modified relation. As particle density increases, the maximum of $\bar{W}(Δx)$ switches between two distinct operating regimes. Notably, this transition is also found in the solutions that maximize power output for finite-time cycles with dynamics affected by dry friction. We attribute this nonequilibrium feature to the accumulation of active particles near the boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：We realize an engine，实验构建了由自驱动 bristle bots 组成的气体系统）。；研究对象：活性物质（self-propelled bristle bots 气体）中的信息引擎，具体研究其每次测量可提取功 $\bar{W}$ 与探测区域尺寸 $\Delta x$ 及空置概率 $p_1$ 的关系，以及粒子密度对最优工作点的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性信息引擎的 $\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 关系偏离热系统的普适形式 $-p_1 \ln p_1$；随着粒子密度增加，$\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 的最大值在两种不同工作模式之间切换，该转变源于活性粒子在边界附近的累积。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性信息引擎的 $\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 关系偏离热系统的普适形式 $-p_1 \ln p_1$；随着粒子密度增加，$\bar{W}(\Delta x)$ 的最大值在两种不同工作模式之间切换，该转变源于活性粒子在边界附近的累积。；创新点：揭示了活性信息引擎中因边界粒子累积导致的非平衡特征，即最优工作模式随密度发生切换，且该切换在含干摩擦的有限时间循环功率最大化解中同样出现，表明其具有动力学普适性。摘要未突出说明与已有活性信息引擎工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用自驱动 bristle bots 构建活性气体，通过测量与反馈循环实现信息压缩；结合有限时间循环动力学（含干摩擦效应）的功率最大化求解进行理论分析。

papers.title: Phase synchronization of fish schools through spatial gaps
papers.abstract: We investigate how sensory coupling mediates phase coherence between spatially separated, confined active systems. Using two fish schools separated by a water-filled transparent gap, we isolate vision as the primary interaction channel. Under boundary confinement, each school's center-of-mass heading exhibits noisy bistable dynamics, spontaneously switching between two antiparallel directions along the partition wall. Turning events in one school bias the orientation of the other, driving distance-dependent phase synchronization. We model this behavior using two coupled stochastic bistable oscillators whose exact solution quantitatively reproduces the empirical results. Our work establishes a precise connection between nonequilibrium active systems and coupled stochastic oscillators, offering insight into boundary-spanning information transfer in living collectives.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论建模结合的混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“empirical results”（实验观测）与“model this behavior”（理论建模），并给出“exact solution”（精确求解）。；研究对象：两条被透明水间隙隔开、处于边界约束下的鱼群。物理现象为鱼群质心朝向的噪声双稳态动力学，以及通过视觉通道介导的跨空间相位同步。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两个空间分离的受限鱼群通过视觉耦合实现距离依赖的相位同步：一鱼群的转向事件会偏置另一鱼群的朝向选择，其行为可由两个耦合随机双稳态振子的精确解定量复现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两个空间分离的受限鱼群通过视觉耦合实现距离依赖的相位同步：一鱼群的转向事件会偏置另一鱼群的朝向选择，其行为可由两个耦合随机双稳态振子的精确解定量复现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但明确建立了非平衡活性系统与耦合随机振子之间的精确对应关系，为跨边界信息传递提供了定量框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：将两鱼群置于由透明间隙分隔的受限区域，隔离视觉作为唯一交互通道，记录鱼群质心朝向随时间的变化。理论上：构建两个耦合随机双稳态振子模型，并求得其精确解，与实验数据定量对比。

papers.title: A Spatial Localizer for Constituent-Resolved Exciton Wannier Functions
papers.abstract: The internal electron-hole structure of excitons influences optical and electric-field responses. Exciton Wannier functions have recently provided a local real-space representation of exciton bands. Because excitons are composite quasiparticles, these Wannier functions can be characterized by both their center-of-mass location and the internal electron-hole dipole. Resolving this internal structure in real space requires simultaneously locating the constituent electron and hole coordinates. However, the projected electron and hole position operators generally do not commute, so simultaneous diagonalization of these positions is impossible: their noncommutativity precludes a common eigenbasis and imposes a state-dependent lower bound on the joint spread. Existing approaches localize a single average coordinate or a specific constituent coordinate, but generally do not construct a common exciton Wannier basis that maximally localizes both constituent coordinates. Here, we construct an ``exciton spatial localizer'': a single Hermitian operator that embeds the constituent position operators within a Clifford-algebra structure and returns exciton Wannier functions, maximally localized in their electron and hole coordinates simultaneously. Our formulation is ansatz-free, gauge-invariant, and applies to the generic multiband case. In an interacting bilayer model with an isolated group of exciton bands, we show that reflection and time-reversal symmetries, or other nonsymmorphic symmetries detailed herein, enforce a pointwise traceless but nonzero quantum geometric dipole matrix, which manifests in symmetry-related pairs of exciton Wannier functions with equal and opposite internal electron-hole dipoles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct、formulation、gauge-invariant、理论框架推导。；研究对象：激子（exciton）的实空间波函数，具体为“激子Wannier函数”的内部电子-空穴结构，以及一个相互作用的双层模型（interacting bilayer model）中孤立激子能带组。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了一个“激子空间局域化算符”（exciton spatial localizer），可同时最大化局域化电子与空穴坐标，从而得到组分分辨的激子Wannier函数；并发现反射、时间反演或非辛（nonsymmorphic）对称性会强制产生逐点无迹但非零的量子几何偶极矩阵，表现为对称关联的激子Wannier函数对具有等大反向的内部电子-空穴偶极。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了一个“激子空间局域化算符”（exciton spatial localizer），可同时最大化局域化电子与空穴坐标，从而得到组分分辨的激子Wannier函数；并发现反射、时间反演或非辛（nonsymmorphic）对称性会强制产生逐点无迹但非零的量子几何偶极矩阵，表现为对称关联的激子Wannier函数对具有等大反向的内部电子-空穴偶极。；创新点：现有方法只能局域化单一平均坐标或单一组分坐标，本文首次构造了一个能同时最大化局域化电子和空穴两个组分坐标的公共激子Wannier基，且方法无拟设、规范不变、适用于多带体系。摘要未突出说明与具体数值算法（如Wannier90）的衔接细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造方法：将组分位置算符嵌入Clifford代数结构，构建单一厄米算符（空间局域化算符），通过其谱分解得到激子Wannier函数。该方法无拟设（ansatz-free）、规范不变，适用于一般多带情形。具体模型为相互作用的双层模型。

papers.title: Low-Temperature Transport in Li-Ion Battery EC/EMC/FEC Electrolytes: Molecular Dynamics and Machine-Learning Modeling
papers.abstract: Low-temperature operation imposes severe limitations on lithium-ion transport in battery electrolytes, yet the coupled effects of solvent composition and fluorinated additives in the cold-temperature regime remain insufficiently resolved. Here, we combine classical molecular dynamics (MD) and machine learning (ML) to investigate 1 M LiPF$_6$ electrolytes containing ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and EC/EMC (3:7), with 0-10 mol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), from 298 to 233 K. MD simulations quantify Li$^+$ self-diffusion, Nernst-Einstein (NE) and Green-Kubo (GK) conductivities and local coordination, while Gaussian-process surrogates model conductivity across composition and temperature. Cooling produces a pronounced transport penalty, particularly in EMC-containing electrolytes, whose GK conductivity decreases by more than 98% at 233 K, compared with approximately 90% in EC-rich systems. Li$^+$ self-diffusion activation energies are 0.49-0.54 eV for EMC-containing systems and 0.27-0.29 eV for EC-based systems. Within the EC family, 0-2 mol% FEC gives comparable cold-temperature transport, whereas 5-10 mol% FEC shows lower conductivity retention at the coldest simulated temperature. The analyzed coordination channels remain solvent dominated, while direct Li$^+$-FEC coordination is not quantified in the present RDF set.The Gaussian-process surrogates achieve composition-disjoint cross-validated RMSE values of 0.56 and 0.57 mS cm$^{-1}$ for NE and GK conductivity. Within the simulated liquid-state trajectories, temperature and host-solvent composition dominate the bulk-transport response, with FEC acting as a secondary modifier.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：classical molecular dynamics (MD)、machine learning (ML)、Gaussian-process surrogates、simulations。；研究对象：锂离子电池电解液体系：1 M LiPF₆ 溶于碳酸乙烯酯（EC）、碳酸甲乙酯（EMC）及 EC/EMC（3:7）混合溶剂，并添加 0–10 mol% 氟代碳酸乙烯酯（FEC），研究温度范围 298–233 K 下的低温锂离子输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 降温对含 EMC 电解质的离子电导率造成显著惩罚（233 K 时 Green-Kubo 电导率下降超过 98%，而富 EC 体系约下降 90%）；含 EMC 体系的 Li⁺ 自扩散活化能（0.49–0.54 eV）明显高于 EC 基体系（0.27–0.29 eV）。在 EC 基体系中，低 FEC 含量（0–2 mol%）低温输运性能相当，而高 FEC 含量（5–10 mol%）在最低模拟温度下电导率保持率更低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：降温对含 EMC 电解质的离子电导率造成显著惩罚（233 K 时 Green-Kubo 电导率下降超过 98%，而富 EC 体系约下降 90%）；含 EMC 体系的 Li⁺ 自扩散活化能（0.49–0.54 eV）明显高于 EC 基体系（0.27–0.29 eV）。在 EC 基体系中，低 FEC 含量（0–2 mol%）低温输运性能相当，而高 FEC 含量（5–10 mol%）在最低模拟温度下电导率保持率更低。；创新点：将分子动力学与机器学习代理模型相结合，系统解耦了溶剂组成、氟化添加剂（FEC）和温度对低温锂离子输运的耦合影响，并实现了对 NE 和 GK 电导率的组分分离交叉验证预测（RMSE 分别为 0.56 和 0.57 mS cm⁻¹）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于量化 Li⁺ 自扩散系数、Nernst-Einstein（NE）和 Green-Kubo（GK）电导率以及局域配位结构；高斯过程（Gaussian-process）代理模型用于跨组分和温度的电导率建模；机器学习（ML）方法辅助输运性质预测。

papers.title: HiPoly: a hierarchical polymer-native AI framework for property prediction and generative design
papers.abstract: Polymeric materials are central to modern technologies, with applications ranging from energy to health and transportation. Although AI has made significant advances in materials discovery, the hierarchical structure of polymers across multiple length scales makes them inherently difficult to represent in a unified and physically meaningful way. Here we introduce HiPoly, a polymer-native AI framework that processes complete polymer descriptions through a three-level hierarchical graph architecture built on the G2RINS representation. HiPoly encodes stochastic inter-monomer connectivity, composition, and molecular weight directly within its architecture, using physically motivated design principles that mirror the multi-scale nature of polymeric systems. The framework establishes an end-to-end AI-driven workflow from experimental formulation data to property prediction, generative molecular design, and physics-based validation through molecular simulations, all unified by a single polymer representation. We demonstrate state-of-the-art prediction accuracy for thermophysical properties of multi-component polymer systems, with ablation studies confirming that each hierarchical design choice contributes independently to model performance. As an example, the generative design pathway is applied here to the discovery of sustainable alternatives to persistent fluorinated polymers, where it is possible to identify and independently validate PFAS-free candidates with target surface-energy properties. This work demonstrates how polymer-native AI can accelerate discovery by linking representation, prediction, and design across complex polymer chemistries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/人工智能方法文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“AI framework”“graph architecture”“molecular simulations”“generative design”等关键词，属于计算与机器学习驱动的材料设计研究。；研究对象：高分子（聚合物）材料，特别是多组分聚合物体系的热物理性质预测，以及含氟聚合物的可持续替代品（PFAS-free候选材料）的生成设计。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HiPoly框架通过三级层次图架构（基于G2RINS表示）实现了对聚合物多尺度层级结构的统一编码，在多组分聚合物体系热物理性质预测上达到当前最优精度，并能生成和独立验证具有目标表面能性质的无PFAS候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HiPoly框架通过三级层次图架构（基于G2RINS表示）实现了对聚合物多尺度层级结构的统一编码，在多组分聚合物体系热物理性质预测上达到当前最优精度，并能生成和独立验证具有目标表面能性质的无PFAS候选材料。；创新点：提出“聚合物原生”（polymer-native）AI框架，首次在单一表示下统一处理聚合物的多尺度层级结构（链间连接、组成、分子量），并实现从实验数据到性质预测再到生成设计及模拟验证的完整闭环流程。摘要未突出说明与已有聚合物表示方法（如SMILES、指纹等）的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于G2RINS表示的三级层次图神经网络架构，将随机链间连接性、组成和分子量直接编码入模型；结合实验配方数据建立端到端AI工作流，涵盖性质预测、生成式分子设计，并通过分子模拟进行物理验证。消融实验用于检验各层级设计贡献。

papers.title: Effective quasiparticle conserving Lindbladians in the thermodynamic limit
papers.abstract: Open quantum many-body systems are commonly described by Lindblad master equations, yet the treatment of Lindbladian operators in the thermodynamic limit remains a major challenge. We develop a framework for constructing effective quasiparticle-conserving Lindbladian operators directly in the thermodynamic limit. Our approach extends continuous similarity transformations to non-Hermitian open quantum systems and enables the systematic block diagonalization of Lindbladians with respect to the quasiparticle (qp) number. We formulate two complementary methods. The first, projective continuous similarity transformations (pcst++), generalizes perturbative continuous unitary transformations to Lindblad operators so that a linked-cluster expansion allows us to obtain high-order series expansions of the infinite system. The second, deepCST, extends directly evaluated enhanced perturbative continuous unitary transformations by combining the same qp-conserving generator with a perturbative truncation scheme that yields non-perturbative effective Lindbladian operators directly in thermodynamic limit. We apply pcst++ and deepCST to the dissipative transverse-field Ising chain with local dissipation. We focus on the low-Ising regime. We purify the Lindbladian by splitting each spin into two sites. A spin flip then corresponds to two qps. We derive and analyze the effective, qp-conserving Lindbladian in the sectors with zero to two qps. We show how the Ising interaction renormalizes the decay rates of elementary spin-flip excitations and provides the microscopic mechanism for a competition between coherent interactions and dissipation. Our work establishes perturbative and non-perturbative continuous similarity transformations as a versatile tool for deriving effective qp pictures of open quantum many-body systems in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“Lindblad主方程”“连续相似变换”“级数展开”等理论方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：开放量子多体系统，具体为具有局域耗散的耗散横场Ising链（dissipative transverse-field Ising chain），关注其在热力学极限下的准粒子图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子数守恒的有效Lindblad算符的框架，并揭示了Ising相互作用会重整化自旋翻转激发的衰减率，从而提供相干相互作用与耗散之间竞争的微观机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子数守恒的有效Lindblad算符的框架，并揭示了Ising相互作用会重整化自旋翻转激发的衰减率，从而提供相干相互作用与耗散之间竞争的微观机制。；创新点：首次将连续相似变换方法系统性地推广到非厄米Lindbladian，使其能够在热力学极限下直接构造准粒子守恒的有效开放量子系统描述，同时提供微扰（pcst++）与非微扰（deepCST）两种互补途径。摘要未突出说明与已有开放系统方法（如数值张量网络或局域Lindblad近似）的具体对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将连续相似变换（continuous similarity transformations）推广至非厄米开放量子系统，实现Lindbladian按准粒子数的系统分块对角化。具体提出两种互补方法：(1) pcst++（projective continuous similarity transformations），推广微扰连续幺正变换并结合链式簇展开获得高阶级数；(2) deepCST，结合准粒子守恒生成元与微扰截断方案，直接得到热力学极限下的非微扰有效Lindbladian。应用对象为耗散横场Ising链，通过将每个自旋劈裂为两个格点来纯化Lindbladian，使自旋翻转对应两个准粒子，并分析零至两个准粒子扇区。

papers.title: A viscoelastic theory for ultrasound-induced intracellular streaming
papers.abstract: Ultrasound is increasingly used to control biological cells, but its multiple physical effects, including radiation force, streaming, heating, and cavitation, require theoretical frameworks that can quantify their relative strengths. Here we develop a semi-analytical model to predict flow patterns and energy distributions of ultrasound-induced intracellular streaming. Cells are modeled as viscoelastic droplets immersed in a fluid with different viscoelastic properties. For this geometry, the momentum equation with an Oldroyd-B constitutive law is solved using a perturbation expansion commonly applied in acoustofluidics. The resulting equations for the different orders of the expansion are solved using partial wave expansion and explicit integration. We investigate our model for a range of parameters which is relevant both for synthetic polymer and for protein solutions. We find a series of flow reversals that we can connect to the distribution of energy into the different modes. We also consider density and compressibility contrasts, which shift these transitions and introduce new ones. Finally, we discuss the potential biological relevance of our mathematical results for cellular sensing and signaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：semi-analytical model、perturbation expansion、partial wave expansion、explicit integration。；研究对象：超声诱导的细胞内流（intracellular streaming），具体为浸没在具有不同黏弹性流体中的黏弹性液滴（细胞模型），涵盖合成聚合物与蛋白质溶液参数范围。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模型预测了细胞内流场出现一系列流动反转（flow reversals），这些反转与能量在不同模式间的分布直接相关；密度和可压缩性对比度会移动这些反转点并引入新的反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模型预测了细胞内流场出现一系列流动反转（flow reversals），这些反转与能量在不同模式间的分布直接相关；密度和可压缩性对比度会移动这些反转点并引入新的反转。；创新点：首次针对超声诱导的细胞内流建立半解析黏弹性理论框架，可量化辐射力、流、热和空化等物理效应的相对强度，并系统揭示流动反转与模式能量分布的联系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验对比的细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用Oldroyd-B本构方程的动量方程，结合声流控中常用的微扰展开（各阶方程分别用分波展开和显式积分求解），构建半解析模型。

papers.title: Exceptional Topological Signatures of Non-Hermitian Photonic Hopf-Link Braids
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian physics endows the non-Abelian systems with exceptional topology characterized by non-commutative braid patterns. Interplay of distinct competing sources of non-Hermiticity may induce novel topological effects. Here, we provide a generalized Hatano-Nelson model with higher-order nonreciprocal hoppings, non-Abelian gauge fields, and staggered gain-loss processes showing the exceptional topological structure of the Hopf-link braids that undergoes a EP-mediated topological phase transition. We demonstrate that mixing multiple nonreciprocal channels drives the system into highly intricate, nested complex energy Hopf-link braids and expands the topological landscape up to higher-order braiding sectors. Furthermore, utilizing biorthogonal eigenvector tracking, we map the structural evolution of the exceptional phase boundaries via the maximum Petermann factor in the phase angle parameter planes. We show that the gain-loss non-Hermiticity drives a topological crossover where the extended exceptional contours constrict into isolated regimes. The demonstration of EP-mediated topological phase transition of Hopf-link braids and the associated rich exceptional phase portraits may offer new physical insights with promising applications in robust, fault-tolerant communication channels and quantum computing platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及模型构建（generalized Hatano-Nelson model）、理论分析（exceptional topology, topological phase transition）以及数值追踪（biorthogonal eigenvector tracking），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米光子体系中的Hopf-link辫带（Hopf-link braids）结构，具体为具有高阶非互易跳跃、非阿贝尔规范场和交错增益-损耗过程的广义Hatano-Nelson模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合多个非互易通道可使系统呈现高度嵌套的复能量Hopf-link辫带结构，并经历由奇异点（EP）介导的拓扑相变；增益-损耗非厄米性驱动拓扑交叉，使扩展的奇异轮廓收缩为孤立区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合多个非互易通道可使系统呈现高度嵌套的复能量Hopf-link辫带结构，并经历由奇异点（EP）介导的拓扑相变；增益-损耗非厄米性驱动拓扑交叉，使扩展的奇异轮廓收缩为孤立区域。；创新点：首次在非厄米Hopf-link辫带体系中展示EP介导的拓扑相变，并将拓扑景观扩展至高阶辫带扇区；揭示了增益-损耗与互易性竞争导致的奇异轮廓拓扑交叉行为。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为广义Hatano-Nelson模型（含高阶非互易跳跃与非阿贝尔规范场）；分析手段包括双正交本征矢量追踪（biorthogonal eigenvector tracking）以及最大Petermann因子在相位角参数平面上的映射。

papers.title: Universal fingerprint of topological defect cores
papers.abstract: Topological defects are ubiquitous in physics, arising from condensed matter physics to the early universe. Although there exist many universal scaling laws for correlations between topological defects, such as Porod scaling, the fingerprint of topological defect cores has remained largely unexplored. Here, we discover a universal scaling law in the region $k>1/ξ$, where $ξ$ is the healing length of the topological defects, taking the scaling of the form factor $S_f \propto k^{-(d+p+2)}$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension and $p$ is the defect codimension. We analytically prove that this exponent originates from a universal V-shaped cusp at the defect core and is independent of the underlying system and dynamics. Numerical simulations verify this scaling law in four typical frameworks: the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau and Gross-Pitaevskii equations in the weak-coupling regime, the gauge/gravity duality model in the strong-coupling regime, and the Klein-Gordon equation in the Friedmann-Robertson-Walker background in cosmology. Our work provides a new probe for studying topological defects in systems ranging from superconductors to cosmological phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically prove”（解析证明）以及“Numerical simulations verify”（数值模拟验证），属于理论推导结合数值计算的研究。；研究对象：拓扑缺陷（topological defects）的普适标度行为，涵盖从凝聚态物理（超导体、玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚）到宇宙学相变（Friedmann-Robertson-Walker背景）中的缺陷体系。具体体系包括：时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau方程、Gross-Pitaevskii方程（弱耦合区）、规范/引力对偶模型（强耦合区）、以及宇宙学中的Klein-Gordon方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在波数区域 k > 1/ξ（ξ为缺陷愈合长度）内，拓扑缺陷的形状因子（form factor）满足普适标度律 S_f ∝ k^{-(d+p+2)}，其中 d 为空间维度，p 为缺陷余维数。该指数源于缺陷核心处普适的V形尖点结构，与具体体系和动力学无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在波数区域 k > 1/ξ（ξ为缺陷愈合长度）内，拓扑缺陷的形状因子（form factor）满足普适标度律 S_f ∝ k^{-(d+p+2)}，其中 d 为空间维度，p 为缺陷余维数。该指数源于缺陷核心处普适的V形尖点结构，与具体体系和动力学无关。；创新点：首次发现并证明了拓扑缺陷核心区域（而非缺陷间关联）的普适标度指纹。此前已有Porod标度等描述缺陷间关联的普适律，但缺陷核心本身的标度行为此前基本未被探索（“has remained largely unexplored”）。该工作填补了这一空白，并证明该标度律跨越凝聚态到宇宙学的不同体系均成立。
papers.method_zh: 解析证明（推导标度指数与缺陷核心V形尖点的联系）+ 数值模拟验证。数值模拟覆盖四种框架：① 弱耦合区的TDGL方程和Gross-Pitaevskii方程；② 强耦合区的规范/引力对偶（全息）模型；③ 宇宙学背景（FRW度规）下的Klein-Gordon方程。

papers.title: Generalised Random Parking for Trapeziums on a Strip
papers.abstract: In this article, we study a generalisation of Rényi's car-parking problem in which isosceles trapeziums are sequentially deposited on a strip. We derive an explicit formula for the parking constant in terms of the lengths of the two bases, recovering the classical rectangular and triangular models as special cases. We further obtain quantitative finite-size asymptotics for both the expected number and the variance of deposited trapeziums, with convergence rates that depend explicitly on the geometry of the deposited particle. In particular, although the recursive construction involves two different substrate geometries, their variances have the same leading asymptotic density. Finally, we show that the parking constant depends non-monotonically on the ratio of the two base lengths and possesses a unique minimiser, so that the least efficient shape is a genuine trapezium rather than a triangle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“derive an explicit formula”“recursive construction”“asymptotics”等数学推导与理论分析关键词。；研究对象：Rényi 随机停车问题的推广——在一条有限宽条带（strip）上顺序随机沉积等腰梯形（isosceles trapeziums）的几何概率模型。属于统计物理中的随机填充/沉积问题，而非具体凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出梯形沉积的“停车常数”（parking constant）关于两底边长度比的显式公式，并证明该常数随底边比非单调变化，存在唯一极小值，即填充效率最低的形状是真正的梯形而非三角形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出梯形沉积的“停车常数”（parking constant）关于两底边长度比的显式公式，并证明该常数随底边比非单调变化，存在唯一极小值，即填充效率最低的形状是真正的梯形而非三角形。；创新点：将经典 Rényi 问题（矩形）与三角形模型统一为梯形的一般情形；发现尽管递归构造涉及两种不同的基底几何，其方差具有相同的领头渐近密度；揭示停车常数对几何参数的非单调依赖及唯一极小值的存在，表明三角形并非最不高效的填充形状。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：基于递归构造（recursive construction）对随机顺序沉积过程进行精确求解，推导停车常数的闭式表达式，并利用渐近分析获得沉积梯形期望数与方差的有限尺寸修正项及其收敛速率。

papers.title: Precise spectral asymptotics, exponential localization, and spectral gap estimates for the three-boson lattice Schrödinger operator
papers.abstract: We study the three-boson Schrodinger operator on the two-dimensional integer lattice with pairwise contact interactions. First, we obtain precise asymptotics of the two bound states below the essential spectrum at zero total quasimomentum in the strong-coupling limit mu to infinity: the ground state energy is -3 mu + 6 + O(1/mu), and the first excited state energy is - mu + C + O(1/mu), where C = 4 - delta approximately 3.96458, with delta determined by the transcendental equation b0(delta) = 1/(1+delta) involving the lattice Green's function. The associated spectral gap is 2 mu + O(1). Second, using the discrete Agmon comparison method and the Paley-Wiener theorem, we establish exponential localization of the ground-state wavefunction with a logarithmic upper bound on the decay rate alpha(mu) at most ln(3 mu) + O(1/mu), reflecting the bounded nature of the lattice dispersion; the sharp asymptotic rate is conjectured. Third, at quasimomentum pi, the parity symmetry is preserved, but the odd quadratic form becomes positive definite with a unique eigenvalue of order 1/mu that never reaches the Birman-Schwinger threshold, so the odd subspace yields only a virtual level. The even subspace supports exactly one bound state with energy -2 mu + 6 + 8/mu + O(1/mu^2), and the spectral gap to the essential spectrum is mu - 2 - 8/mu + O(1/mu^2). The reduction from two bound states at zero to one at pi preserves the total spectral flow and is a lattice-specific phenomenon. Our approach uses an invariant subspace decomposition of the Birman-Schwinger operator and the Krein-Rutman theorem to guarantee uniqueness and strict positivity of the ground state. These results have direct implications for quantum simulation of few-boson systems in optical lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及数学推导（渐近展开、Agmon比较方法、Paley-Wiener定理）、算子谱分析（Birman-Schwinger算子、Krein-Rutman定理），无实验或数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：二维整数格点上的三玻色子薛定谔算子，具有成对接触相互作用，对应光晶格中少玻色子量子模拟体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强耦合极限下精确给出了零总准动量处两个束缚态能量及谱隙的渐近展开；在准动量π处仅存在一个束缚态，奇子空间只产生虚能级，且从零到π的束缚态数目减少保持了总谱流不变，这是晶格特有的现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强耦合极限下精确给出了零总准动量处两个束缚态能量及谱隙的渐近展开；在准动量π处仅存在一个束缚态，奇子空间只产生虚能级，且从零到π的束缚态数目减少保持了总谱流不变，这是晶格特有的现象。；创新点：首次给出三玻色子晶格算子在强耦合极限下束缚态能量的精确渐近（含O(1/μ)修正项），并揭示零准动量处两个束缚态到π处一个束缚态的约化是晶格特有的谱流守恒现象；摘要未突出说明与连续模型或已有晶格少体研究的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为谱分析与泛函分析：利用Birschman-Schwinger（Birman-Schwinger）算子的不变子空间分解、Krein-Rutman定理证明基态唯一性与严格正性；采用离散Agmon比较方法与Paley-Wiener定理建立波函数指数局域化上界；通过格点格林函数与超越方程确定能量常数。

papers.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), which is known to steer deep neural networks toward invariant sets that correspond to simpler subnetworks. How this steering unfolds over time remains poorly understood. We answer this by modeling the stochastic gradient flow (SGF) as a percolation process, in which architectural symmetries force subnetworks to merge in discrete simultaneous blocks rather than one at a time. These structural transitions register as variance spikes in a macroscopic order parameter, echoing physical phase transitions. We further show this trapping mechanism and its associated scaling cascade extend to Adam and AdamW under an explicit heavy-tailed noise model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：modeling、stochastic gradient flow、percolation process、scaling cascade。；研究对象：深度神经网络中随机梯度下降（SGD）的动力学过程，具体为优化过程中子网络合并的渗流（percolation）相变现象，以及该现象与凝聚态物理中相变和离散尺度不变性的类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SGD的随机梯度流可被建模为渗流过程，其中架构对称性迫使子网络以离散同步块而非逐个方式合并，这些结构转变在宏观序参量上表现为方差尖峰，类似于物理相变；该捕获机制及其标度级联在显式重尾噪声模型下同样适用于Adam和AdamW优化器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SGD的随机梯度流可被建模为渗流过程，其中架构对称性迫使子网络以离散同步块而非逐个方式合并，这些结构转变在宏观序参量上表现为方差尖峰，类似于物理相变；该捕获机制及其标度级联在显式重尾噪声模型下同样适用于Adam和AdamW优化器。；创新点：首次将优化动力学中的子网络合并过程与渗流相变及离散尺度不变性建立定量联系，揭示了SGD诱导的隐式正则化在时间维度上的分形级联结构，并统一了不同优化器（SGD、Adam、AdamW）在该框架下的行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与动力学分析：将随机梯度流映射为渗流过程，通过序参量的方差涨落刻画结构转变，并推广至Adam/AdamW在重尾噪声下的动力学。

papers.title: Implementation of quantum gates by Floquet analysis of kicked quantum system
papers.abstract: Precise control of multi-qubit architectures remains a critical bottleneck in superconducting quantum processors. In this work, we investigate the synthesis of high-fidelity quantum operations and state transfer protocols within an extended superconducting linear chain, scaling from three to seven sites. Using Floquet theory, we model the periodic drive as a train of delta-like pulses, mapping the quantum control problem onto quasi-energy resonance conditions. Combining the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff expansion with Floquet spectral decomposition, we analytically identify optimal driving parameters, refined via the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES). In the three-qubit architecture, this enables high-fidelity synthesis of the iSWAP gate. Extending to a seven-site chain, we implement periodic trains of finite-width Gaussian pulses to activate distinct double-excitation transport channels with ultra-short gate durations t_gate (~170 ns). This achieves a clear scale separation from energy-relaxation times (T1) typical of fixed-frequency transmon devices with tunable couplers, such as IBM Quantum hardware. Finally, we benchmark stability under realistic imperfections, revealing a heightened sensitivity to static parameter disorder at the sub-percent level (eta ~ 10^-3) driven by spectral crowding, and discuss how closed-loop topologies could mitigate this constraint. This framework bridges time-periodic control theory and practical quantum gate engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Floquet理论”“Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff展开”“CMA-ES优化”等理论分析与数值优化方法，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：超导量子处理器中的多量子比特线性链（从3个到7个站点），具体为固定频率transmon器件与可调耦合器构成的体系，研究其周期性驱动下的量子门合成与态转移协议。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Floquet分析将周期驱动映射为准能量共振条件，在3比特体系中实现了高保真iSWAP门合成；在7站点链中利用有限宽度高斯脉冲序列激活不同的双激发输运通道，实现了超短门时间（约170 ns），与典型能量弛豫时间T1形成清晰的时间尺度分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Floquet分析将周期驱动映射为准能量共振条件，在3比特体系中实现了高保真iSWAP门合成；在7站点链中利用有限宽度高斯脉冲序列激活不同的双激发输运通道，实现了超短门时间（约170 ns），与典型能量弛豫时间T1形成清晰的时间尺度分离。；创新点：将时间周期控制理论（Floquet分析）与实用量子门工程直接对接，在扩展超导链（最多7站点）中实现了超短门时间（~170 ns）的双激发输运通道选择性激活，并系统评估了亚百分之一静态参数无序（η~10⁻³）下的稳定性，提出闭环拓扑作为缓解光谱拥挤导致的敏感性问题的方案。摘要未突出说明与已有Floquet控制方案相比的具体优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Floquet谱分解结合Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff展开，用于解析识别最优驱动参数；随后采用协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）进行数值精细化优化。脉冲模型为δ函数型脉冲序列及有限宽度高斯脉冲。

papers.title: Heat transfer problem of a dense gas described by the Enskog equation with a modification of the Enskog factor
papers.abstract: Heat transfer in a dense gas between two parallel plates is studied for assessing the quantitative difference of two variants of the Enskog equation, i.e., the original Enskog equation and the Enskog equation with a modified Enskog factor recently proposed in Phys. Rev. E \textbf{111}, 065108 (2025). The main advantage of the latter is that the H theorem, which is lacking in the former, has been established. The influence of the modification is assessed by comparing the macroscopic quantities in details. It is found that the influence of this modification is quite limited in the density, temperature, and heat flow vector. However, the influence on the stress tensor is visible in some severe setting of parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及Enskog方程的两种变体比较，属于动理学理论分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：稠密气体在平行平板间的热传导问题，具体比较原始Enskog方程与修正Enskog因子（Phys. Rev. E 111, 065108 (2025)提出）的Enskog方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 修正Enskog因子对密度、温度和热流矢量的影响非常有限，但在某些严苛参数条件下，对应力张量的影响是可见的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：修正Enskog因子对密度、温度和热流矢量的影响非常有限，但在某些严苛参数条件下，对应力张量的影响是可见的。；创新点：评估了最近提出的修正Enskog因子（该修正的主要优势是建立了原始Enskog方程所缺乏的H定理）对实际热传导问题中宏观量的定量影响，检验该修正的物理后果是否可忽略。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Enskog方程（原始版本与修正Enskog因子版本）的动理学理论求解，对两平行平板间稠密气体的热传导问题进行数值或解析求解，并逐项比较宏观量（密度、温度、热流矢量、应力张量）。

papers.title: Trypanosome motility in blood and particle suspensions
papers.abstract: Motile microorganisms often navigate crowded and structurally complex environments, where surrounding obstacles can strongly influence locomotion. The bloodstream form of the flagellate parasite Trypanosoma brucei circulates in blood, a dense suspension of red blood cells (RBCs), yet the physical mechanisms governing its locomotion under such conditions remain poorly understood because direct experimental observations are challenging. Here, we combine numerical simulations with in vitro experiments to investigate trypanosome motility in concentrated RBC suspensions and in suspensions of spherical colloidal particles. Simulations reveal that the parasite swimming speed increases by up to $50\%$ at RBC volume fractions comparable to those in blood. To identify the origin of this enhancement, we perform controlled studies in colloidal suspensions with particles of different sizes. We find that suspended particles substantially increase the anisotropy between the perpendicular and parallel friction coefficients acting on the beating flagellum, thereby enhancing propulsion. This effect is most pronounced when the suspended particles are comparable to or smaller than the characteristic wavelength of the flagellar beat. Experiments with microparticle suspensions confirm an increase in trypanosome propulsion with increasing particle concentration, in qualitative agreement with the simulations. Our results uncover a general physical mechanism by which concentrated particle suspensions can enhance flagellar-beat-driven locomotion and suggest that the densely crowded, particulate environment of blood may facilitate trypanosome propulsion. These findings provide new insight into trypanosome motility in the bloodstream and may apply broadly to other flagellated microswimmers in complex suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（数值模拟 + 体外实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combine numerical simulations with in vitro experiments”。；研究对象：布氏锥虫（Trypanosoma brucei）血流形态在浓密红细胞悬浮液及球形胶体颗粒悬浮液中的游动行为，聚焦鞭毛驱动 locomotion 在颗粒介质中的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在红细胞体积分数接近血液生理水平时，寄生虫游动速度可提升高达50%；该增强源于悬浮颗粒显著增大鞭毛垂直与平行摩擦系数的各向异性，从而增强推进力，且当颗粒尺寸与鞭毛拍击特征波长相当或更小时效应最明显。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在红细胞体积分数接近血液生理水平时，寄生虫游动速度可提升高达50%；该增强源于悬浮颗粒显著增大鞭毛垂直与平行摩擦系数的各向异性，从而增强推进力，且当颗粒尺寸与鞭毛拍击特征波长相当或更小时效应最明显。；创新点：揭示了一个普适物理机制——浓密颗粒悬浮液可通过改变鞭毛摩擦各向异性来增强鞭毛驱动的游动，并首次提出血液的颗粒拥挤环境可能实际上有利于锥虫推进，而非阻碍。摘要未突出说明与以往锥虫运动研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（模拟锥虫在浓密红细胞悬浮液及不同尺寸胶体颗粒悬浮液中的游动）；体外实验（使用微粒悬浮液测量锥虫推进速度随颗粒浓度的变化，与模拟定性对照）。

papers.title: Memory as an Energy Landscape---Hopfield
papers.abstract: This chapter reconstructs the Hopfield network as a physical theory of memory rather than merely an early neural-network algorithm. It begins with the problem as it stood before 1982-threshold logic, Hebbian association, correlation memories, and recurrent binary networks-and isolates what Hopfield's synthesis added: a dynamical definition of content-addressable memory, a symmetric recurrent architecture with a Lyapunov function, a Hebbian embedding of patterns in its couplings, and a physical account of basins, robustness, and graceful degradation. The binary and graded-response energy functions are derived in full, together with the signal-crosstalk decomposition governing pattern stability, the mean-field theory of retrieval at extensive load, and the zero-temperature retrieval spinodal at (alpha 0.138) established by Amit, Gutfreund, and Sompolinsky. The energy-based program is then followed through analog optimization networks, polynomial dense associative memories, exponential interactions, and modern continuous Hopfield updates, including the precise conditions under which the update becomes scaled dot-product attention. Throughout, capacity claims are tied to their disorder ensemble, scaling limit, and success criterion, showing why numerically different storage limits need not conflict. A closing assessment distinguishes established results from surviving principles, assumption-bound limitations, and open problems, treating the Hopfield network as an effective theory whose symmetry, locality, and point-neuron assumptions delimit its biological reach. Fixed-seed numerical experiments expose the mechanisms discussed but do not substitute for analytical results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：摘要关键词为“重构为物理理论”、“推导”、“平均场理论”、“数值实验”，属于对既有模型的理论梳理与物理机制分析，而非实验或新计算方法开发。；研究对象：Hopfield网络，将其作为记忆的物理理论（能量景观）来研究。具体涉及内容寻址记忆、对称循环网络、模式存储与检索的相变行为（如零温检索旋节线）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Hopfield网络的核心贡献在于将记忆定义为动力学吸引子，并提供了基于能量函数的物理描述。该理论框架可推广至现代连续Hopfield更新，并在特定条件下与缩放点积注意力机制精确对应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Hopfield网络的核心贡献在于将记忆定义为动力学吸引子，并提供了基于能量函数的物理描述。该理论框架可推广至现代连续Hopfield更新，并在特定条件下与缩放点积注意力机制精确对应。；创新点：将Hopfield网络从早期神经网络算法提升为一种有效的物理理论，系统梳理了其能量景观纲领的演变（从二元到连续、从多项式到指数型密集关联记忆），并厘清了不同容量声称之间的适用条件（无序系综、标度极限、成功标准），指出其作为有效理论的适用边界（对称性、局域性、点神经元假设）。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值实验结合。具体包括：完整推导二元和分级响应能量函数；信号-串扰分解分析模式稳定性；使用平均场理论分析模式在有限负载（extensive load）下的检索行为；通过固定种子（fixed-seed）数值实验展示机制，但不替代解析结果。

papers.title: Neural Logic, Invariance, and the Retina---McCulloch and Pitts
papers.abstract: This chapter reconstructs the McCulloch-Pitts program as a physics of neural computation rather than the familiar cartoon of a binary neuron. The 1943 logical calculus is developed in both directions: given a net, characterize the propositions realized by its activity; given an admissible logical expression, construct a net that realizes it. We recover the original distinction between thresholded excitatory summation and absolute inhibitory veto-one the weighted-threshold form cannot preserve for arbitrarily large excitatory inputs-and read unit-time delay as the physical realization of logical depth. Recurrence is treated exactly: an autonomous, deterministic network of finitely many binary units has a finite state space, so every trajectory eventually enters a periodic orbit-a fact about finite-state dynamics, not unbounded Turing computation. A single threshold element realizes only linearly separable Boolean functions, whereas finite feedforward networks of them synthesize any Boolean function on a finite domain. We then follows McCulloch and Pitts beyond threshold logic. The 1945 heterarchy paper turns cyclic preference into an obstruction to representation by a scalar utility. The 1947 work on universals asks how a physical network can identify inputs related by nuisance transformations, developed here via group averaging and feedback canonicalization. The 1959 frog-retina study makes the adequate-stimulus question experimental, revealing parallel invariant operations before the brain proper. Spike-triggered analysis shows how a nonlinearly driven neuron can have a vanishing first-order average while second-order statistics recover its hidden selectivity: methodological failure can masquerade as physiological absence. Modern mathematical tools are used without projecting their notation onto the historical papers, and limitations of the idealization are stated explicitly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/历史重构文章。关键词：reconstructs、physics of neural computation、mathematical tools。；研究对象：McCulloch-Pitts 神经网络理论的历史与物理内涵，涵盖视网膜神经计算、有限状态动力学、线性可分性、群平均与反馈规范化等概念，不涉及具体凝聚态材料或量子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: McCulloch-Pitts 纲领应被理解为神经计算的物理学：有限二值网络的动力学必然进入周期轨道；单个阈值单元只能实现线性可分布尔函数，而有限前馈网络可综合任意有限域布尔函数；非线性驱动的神经元可具有零一阶平均响应，但二阶统计量仍可恢复其隐藏选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：McCulloch-Pitts 纲领应被理解为神经计算的物理学：有限二值网络的动力学必然进入周期轨道；单个阈值单元只能实现线性可分布尔函数，而有限前馈网络可综合任意有限域布尔函数；非线性驱动的神经元可具有零一阶平均响应，但二阶统计量仍可恢复其隐藏选择性。；创新点：将 McCulloch-Pitts 工作从“二元神经元”的简化卡通形象还原为神经计算的物理纲领，明确区分阈值兴奋求和与绝对抑制否决的不可约性，并指出方法论失败可能伪装成生理学缺失这一认识论陷阱。摘要未突出说明其与当代凝聚态物理的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 对 1943—1959 年间 McCulloch-Pitts 系列论文进行数学重构，使用有限状态动力学、阈值逻辑、线性可分性分析、群平均与反馈规范化、spike-triggered 统计等工具，但不将现代符号强加于历史文本。

papers.title: Multidimensional Light Detection with Symmetry-engineered Heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Miniaturised multidimensional light detection, encompassing full-Stokes polarimetry and spectroscopy in ultracompact footprints, is attracting growing interest for its potential to capture a comprehensive set of light properties in portable platforms. Although significant progress has been made in miniaturised schemes for independent polarisation and spectral detection, achieving simultaneous high-dimensional light detection remains an outstanding challenge that limits their development toward full integration. We overcome this limitation by breaking the rotational and inversion symmetries in a symmetry-engineered van der Waals heterojunction to realise an ultracompact multidimensional photodetector. The dual symmetry breaking gives rise to non-trivial quantum geometric and topological features, enabling simultaneous broadband polarisation- and spectrum-resolved light detection, in contrast to previous van der Waals material-based devices, which could detect only one of these modalities. Our device, with an effective area of only 10 micron x 10 micron, reconstructs full-Stokes polarisation with overall root-mean-square errors below 0.05 and resolves spectral peaks separated by 0.4 nm, capabilities not previously achieved in single-pixel detectors. By unifying high-fidelity polarimetry and sub-nanometre spectroscopy in a single electrically tunable junction, our work eliminates the need for cascaded detection architectures and establishes a foundation for multidimensional detector arrays for integrated photonics, quantum information processing, and precision imaging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了实际器件制备（van der Waals异质结）、器件尺寸（10 μm × 10 μm）、性能测量（偏振重构误差、光谱分辨）等实验内容。；研究对象：对称性工程化的范德华异质结光电探测器，用于同时实现全斯托克斯偏振探测与光谱分辨的多维光检测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时打破旋转对称性和反演对称性，在单个超紧凑范德华异质结中实现了宽带偏振分辨与光谱分辨的同步光检测，克服了以往器件只能检测单一模态的限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时打破旋转对称性和反演对称性，在单个超紧凑范德华异质结中实现了宽带偏振分辨与光谱分辨的同步光检测，克服了以往器件只能检测单一模态的限制。；创新点：首次在单个单像素范德华器件中同时实现全斯托克斯偏振测量（RMS误差<0.05）与亚纳米光谱分辨（0.4 nm峰间距），无需级联探测架构；其物理机制源于对称性破缺诱导的非平凡量子几何与拓扑特性。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体制备与表征手段，但涉及对称性工程化的异质结器件构建、电学调控（电可调结）、偏振测量（全斯托克斯重构）与光谱分辨测量。具体实验技术细节（如材料体系、生长方法、测量装置）摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Renormalization group and long-range conditional mutual information in hierarchical models
papers.abstract: A departure of a mixed quantum state from a local Gibbs description is generally invisible to local observables but can be detected by the conditional mutual information (CMI). Here we study the relationship between the renormalization group (RG) and CMI, and in particular, how RG constrains CMI. We first show that the CMI between nonadjacent regions $A$ and $C$, conditioned on the buffer region $B$, is UV-finite whenever the state admits a locally reversible RG with a fixed on-site Hilbert space dimension. We then study two hierarchical models that have long-range CMI and yet admit a simple RG description. The first model has a divergent Markov length at every temperature $0<T<\infty$ but nevertheless flows to an infinite-temperature product state under RG. The second model satisfies the local Markov condition while violating the global one and is stable against weak noise. At the critical noise strength, the two-point CMI decays only polynomially as a function of the system size, while the two-point mutual information vanishes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization group (RG)、conditional mutual information (CMI)、hierarchical models、理论分析。；研究对象：混合量子态（mixed quantum state）与局域 Gibbs 描述的偏离，以及重整化群（RG）与条件互信息（CMI）之间的关系；具体研究两个具有长程 CMI 的分层模型（hierarchical models）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RG 过程对 CMI 有约束作用：当态具有局域可逆 RG 且局域希尔伯特空间维度固定时，非相邻区域间的 CMI 是紫外有限的；同时，存在两个分层模型，它们具有长程 CMI 但仍允许简单的 RG 描述——一个模型在所有温度下 Markov 长度发散但 RG 流向无限温度乘积态，另一个模型满足局域 Markov 条件但违反全局 Markov 条件，且在临界噪声强度下两点 CMI 随系统尺寸多项式衰减而两点互信息为零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RG 过程对 CMI 有约束作用：当态具有局域可逆 RG 且局域希尔伯特空间维度固定时，非相邻区域间的 CMI 是紫外有限的；同时，存在两个分层模型，它们具有长程 CMI 但仍允许简单的 RG 描述——一个模型在所有温度下 Markov 长度发散但 RG 流向无限温度乘积态，另一个模型满足局域 Markov 条件但违反全局 Markov 条件，且在临界噪声强度下两点 CMI 随系统尺寸多项式衰减而两点互信息为零。；创新点：首次系统研究 RG 如何约束 CMI，并展示了长程 CMI 与简单 RG 描述可以共存；揭示了局域 Markov 条件与全局 Markov 条件可分离成立，以及临界噪声下 CMI 与互信息衰减行为的截然不同。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：重整化群（RG）分析、条件互信息（CMI）与 Markov 条件的数学刻画、分层模型（hierarchical models）的构造与解析求解、噪声强度下的稳定性分析。

papers.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization of Composite Functions for Image-Based Inverse Problems in Materials Characterization
papers.abstract: Estimating physical parameters from scientific images is a common inverse problem in materials characterization that often relies on expensive physics-based simulations. In electron microscopy, specimen thickness and crystal mistilt are critical parameters that govern how electrons scatter through the sample, and therefore the accuracy of any atomic-scale structure recovered from it. They are commonly inferred by matching experimental position-averaged convergent-beam electron diffraction (PACBED) patterns to simulated ones, but grid searches scale poorly and neural-network methods require extensive pretraining that may not transfer to new conditions. Here, we propose scalable Bayesian optimization of composite functions (SBOCF), a simulation-efficient method that exploits the known composite structure of the image-matching objective and the intermediate information contained in simulated images. By representing PACBED images with patch-level summaries and two correction terms, SBOCF preserves the original pixel-wise objective while reducing the number of modeled outputs from 24,649 to 11. Under a budget of 50 simulator evaluations, SBOCF outperformed standard Bayesian optimization with expected improvement on synthetic SrTiO3 benchmarks with thick and thin specimens, reducing the median final SSE by up to 290x in the thick-sample case. On experimental data, SBOCF produced parameter estimates consistent with previously reported values without task-specific pretraining. For a simulated mistilted specimen, using the SBOCF estimates in a downstream ptychographic reconstruction recovered sharp atoms that were otherwise blurred. These results establish SBOCF as a promising approach for inverse problems involving expensive simulators and high-dimensional structured outputs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：提出“可扩展复合函数贝叶斯优化（SBOCF）”这一计算方法，并基于合成与实验数据验证，未涉及新实验测量。；研究对象：电子显微学中的图像反问题，具体为从位置平均会聚束电子衍射（PACBED）图像中估计样品厚度和晶体倾转角（mistilt），研究对象为SrTiO₃合成基准及实验样品。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SBOCF在仅50次模拟器评估预算下，显著优于标准贝叶斯优化（厚样品中位最终SSE降低最高达290倍），且无需任务特定预训练即可从实验数据中给出与文献一致的参数估计；在下游叠层衍射重建中，SBOCF估计的参数可恢复原本模糊的原子像。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SBOCF在仅50次模拟器评估预算下，显著优于标准贝叶斯优化（厚样品中位最终SSE降低最高达290倍），且无需任务特定预训练即可从实验数据中给出与文献一致的参数估计；在下游叠层衍射重建中，SBOCF估计的参数可恢复原本模糊的原子像。；创新点：利用复合函数结构及模拟图像的中间信息，大幅降低高维结构化输出下贝叶斯优化的输出维度，实现模拟器高效的反问题求解，避免网格搜索的低效和神经网络预训练的可迁移性问题。
papers.method_zh: 提出SBOCF方法：利用图像匹配目标的已知复合结构，将PACBED图像用块级摘要（patch-level summaries）加两个修正项表示，将建模输出维度从24,649降至11；与标准贝叶斯优化（期望改进）对比，在合成SrTiO₃厚/薄样品基准及实验数据上验证，并用于模拟倾转样品的叠层衍射重建下游任务。

papers.title: Maximal-velocity deficit under a finite-support constraint in hard-wall half-line continuous-time quantum walk
papers.abstract: Continuous-time quantum walks on a lattice spread ballistically and converge to a limiting distribution for the rescaled position. On the hard-wall half line the boundary reflects the walker but does not change the bulk dispersion, so the ballistic front remains set by the maximal group velocity. We ask how close one can get to this front when the initial state is constrained to occupy only the first $M$ sites. We show that optimizing the moment-generating function of the limiting-velocity distribution over this finite-support class reduces to the principal eigenvalue of an explicit $M\times M$ Hermitian matrix, which yields the optimal state by direct diagonalization. For large $M$, a near-front scaling limit produces a continuum description that controls the entire peak region. In particular, the maximal mean drift approaches the front with an inverse-square deficit in $M$ and a constant prefactor $π^2/4$. Numerical results verify both the finite-$M$ spectral formulation and the predicted scaling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：continuous-time quantum walk、limiting distribution、spectral formulation、scaling limit。；研究对象：硬墙半直线（hard-wall half-line）上的一维连续时间量子行走，具体关注晶格上量子行走的弹道传播、边界反射以及有限支撑初始态下的速度前沿逼近问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在初始态仅占据前 M 个格点的有限支撑约束下，优化极限速度分布的矩生成函数可归结为一个显式 M×M 厄米矩阵的主特征值问题；当 M 很大时，最大平均漂移逼近弹道前沿，其亏缺按 M 的平方反比衰减，前置因子为 π²/4。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在初始态仅占据前 M 个格点的有限支撑约束下，优化极限速度分布的矩生成函数可归结为一个显式 M×M 厄米矩阵的主特征值问题；当 M 很大时，最大平均漂移逼近弹道前沿，其亏缺按 M 的平方反比衰减，前置因子为 π²/4。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合。采用矩生成函数优化方法，将有限支撑类上的变分问题转化为有限维厄米矩阵的特征值问题；对大 M 情形引入近前沿标度极限，得到连续统描述；并用数值结果验证有限 M 谱公式和标度律。

papers.title: Universal scaling and protocol-dependent amplitude in hybrid quantum walks
papers.abstract: Quantum walks spread ballistically but become diffusive with classical admixture. We compare two hybrid walks using identical quantum and classical steps at the same classical-step rate but ordered differently in time. Any nonzero admixture yields diffusion. Near the quantum limit, both diffusion coefficients have first-order poles, but their amplitudes differ by about a factor of two. The coherence timescale sets the pole order, while temporal organization sets the amplitude. We expect our analytical framework to apply broadly to quantum--classical hybrid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论解析框架（analytical framework）、扩散系数（diffusion coefficients）的极点行为，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：量子行走（quantum walks）体系，具体为混合量子行走（hybrid quantum walks）——即量子步与经典步以相同比例但不同时间顺序混合的随机行走过程，关注其从弹道输运到扩散输运的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 任何非零的经典混合比例都会使量子行走从弹道扩散变为普通扩散；在接近纯量子极限时，两种不同时间排序的混合行走的扩散系数均呈现一阶极点，但极点振幅相差约两倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：任何非零的经典混合比例都会使量子行走从弹道扩散变为普通扩散；在接近纯量子极限时，两种不同时间排序的混合行走的扩散系数均呈现一阶极点，但极点振幅相差约两倍。；创新点：揭示了混合量子行走中扩散系数的普适标度行为（极点阶数由相干时间决定），同时指出时间排序（temporal organization）这一非普适因素决定极点振幅，并预期该解析框架可推广至更广泛的量子-经典混合系统。摘要未突出说明与具体实验或数值方法的关联。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论框架。通过对比两种“量子步与经典步比例相同但时间排序不同”的混合行走，分析其扩散系数在量子极限附近的极点结构，并引入相干时间尺度（coherence timescale）来标度极点阶数。

papers.title: Yielded-region connectivity governs the onset of gravity-driven spreading in elastoviscoplastic drops
papers.abstract: The physical mechanisms controlling the onset of gravity-driven spreading of elastoviscoplastic drops remain unclear because yielding, elastic deformation, and viscous dissipation can occur simultaneously in different regions of the material. To isolate these mechanisms, we perform direct numerical simulations of large axisymmetric drops resting on a thin precursor layer of the same material. Each drop is first equilibrated under gravity, $g$, before being subjected to an additional constant downward acceleration of varying magnitude. The drop rheology is described by the Saramito--Herschel--Bulkley model. Once the rate of deformation becomes negligible under the enhanced forcing, the additional acceleration is removed and the drop is allowed to relax again under gravity alone, enabling the global deformation to be separated into recoverable and unrecoverable components. We find that spreading does not occur simply because some portion of the material yields locally. At low imposed accelerations, yielded regions remain confined within a predominantly solid-like viscoelastic matrix, and the resulting deformation is mostly recoverable. Appreciable spreading is observed when these yielded regions connect to form a continuous fluidised pathway from the drop interior to the free surface, allowing radial material transport. The acceleration required for this transition is governed primarily by the yield stress, whereas elasticity controls the partition between recoverable deformation and spreading by regulating the extent and spatial distribution of yielded regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“perform direct numerical simulations”。；研究对象：弹黏塑性液滴在重力驱动下的铺展行为，具体为置于同种材料薄 precursor 层上的轴对称大液滴，其流变学由 Saramito–Herschel–Bulkley 模型描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴铺展并非仅由局部屈服触发，而是需要屈服区域在材料内部连通形成从液滴内部到自由表面的连续流化通道，才能实现显著的径向物质输运；屈服应力决定触发该转变所需的加速度，而弹性通过调控屈服区域的范围与空间分布，控制可恢复变形与铺展之间的分配。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴铺展并非仅由局部屈服触发，而是需要屈服区域在材料内部连通形成从液滴内部到自由表面的连续流化通道，才能实现显著的径向物质输运；屈服应力决定触发该转变所需的加速度，而弹性通过调控屈服区域的范围与空间分布，控制可恢复变形与铺展之间的分配。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但核心新意在于揭示了“屈服区域连通性”而非“局部屈服”是重力驱动铺展的关键判据，并阐明了弹性在控制屈服区域空间分布中的作用。
papers.method_zh: 直接数值模拟（DNS），采用轴对称几何，模拟液滴在重力下平衡后再施加额外恒定向下加速度的过程，并分阶段移除加速度以分离可恢复与不可恢复变形；流变模型为 Saramito–Herschel–Bulkley 模型。

papers.title: Quantum Circuit and Tensor Network Implementation of the 2D Acoustic Wave Equation
papers.abstract: We present a cohesive framework for simulating seismic wave propagation utilizing quantum computing paradigms and their classical tensor network equivalents. We detail a quantum circuit-based formulation for the explicit finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solution of the two-dimensional acoustic wave equation and map this quantum architecture onto a tensor train representation, namely for Matrix Product State (MPS). The MPS solver enables deterministic simulation of large-scale wavefield dynamics on classical high-performance computing systems. We demonstrate the MPS representation by computing 2D seismic wavefields on the Marmousi model. Our results indicate that the MPS representation is a viable direction for computing and scaling wavefield propagation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“quantum circuit-based formulation”“tensor train representation”“MPS solver”“classical high-performance computing systems”，属于数值模拟与算法实现。；研究对象：二维声波方程（地震波传播）的数值模拟，具体在Marmousi模型上计算二维地震波场。属于经典波动现象在量子计算与张量网络框架下的重新表述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络求解器能够在大规模经典高性能计算系统上确定性模拟二维地震波场，且该表示在波场传播的计算与扩展方面是可行的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于矩阵乘积态（MPS）的张量网络求解器能够在大规模经典高性能计算系统上确定性模拟二维地震波场，且该表示在波场传播的计算与扩展方面是可行的方向。；创新点：将量子计算范式（量子电路FDTD）与经典张量网络（MPS）统一在一个框架中，用于地震波场模拟，并首次在Marmousi模型上验证MPS表示的可扩展性。摘要未突出说明与已有地震波数值模拟方法（如常规有限差分）的定量对比或加速比。
papers.method_zh: 采用量子电路显式有限差分时域（FDTD）格式求解二维声波方程，并将该量子架构映射为张量列（tensor train）表示，即矩阵乘积态（MPS）。利用MPS求解器在经典HPC系统上进行确定性模拟，并在Marmousi模型上演示。

papers.title: RAFT-DVC: Resolution-Aware Machine Learning-Based Digital Volume Correlation
papers.abstract: Digital volume correlation (DVC) provides three-dimensional full-field displacement measurements from volumetric images, but how the internal resolution of a machine-learning-based DVC model affects accuracy and operating range remains poorly understood. Here, we present RAFT-DVC, a resolution-aware family of recurrent all-pairs field transforms (RAFT)-based DVC solvers with encoder downsampling factors s = 2, 4, and 8. Using a matched design, we find that the three solvers localize displacement to approximately 0.017 feature-grid voxel, giving an empirical raw-volume error scaling of approximately 0.017s voxel. The solvers exhibit complementary operating regimes governed jointly by displacement reach and volumetric-texture compatibility. Synthetic benchmarks show that RAFT-DVC achieves errors of the same order as tuned classical DVC under fine-texture, small-to-moderate-displacement conditions and becomes competitive or advantageous under coarse-texture, large-displacement conditions. Frequency-swept tests quantify deformation spatial resolution, while tiled inference enables dense estimation on large volumes. Evaluation on confocal volumetric images acquired during indentation illustrates the importance of matching solver operating regime to deformation magnitude and image texture. Tests on micro-CT images of elastomeric foam, despite training only on particle-labeled synthetic data, provide evidence of cross-texture transfer. We also identify coordinate-order inconsistencies in three-dimensional RAFT correlation sampling and introduce a non-cubic impulse test to verify sampler geometry independently of network training. Correcting the sampler improves native-input accuracy and generalization to unseen volume dimensions. Together, these results establish RAFT-DVC as a fast, resolution-aware framework for dense DVC with characterized accuracy and operating regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于机器学习模型（RAFT-DVC）的设计、数值基准测试与算法改进，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：数字体相关（DVC）技术中的三维位移场测量问题，具体针对机器学习求解器在不同图像分辨率、纹理特征和变形幅度下的精度与适用范围。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RAFT-DVC系列求解器（下采样因子s=2,4,8）在特征网格上定位位移误差约为0.017体素，原始体素误差随s线性缩放（约0.017s体素）；不同分辨率求解器在位移范围与体纹理兼容性上呈现互补工作区间，且修正采样器坐标顺序可提升对未见体积尺寸的泛化能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RAFT-DVC系列求解器（下采样因子s=2,4,8）在特征网格上定位位移误差约为0.017体素，原始体素误差随s线性缩放（约0.017s体素）；不同分辨率求解器在位移范围与体纹理兼容性上呈现互补工作区间，且修正采样器坐标顺序可提升对未见体积尺寸的泛化能力。；创新点：首次系统研究机器学习DVC模型内部分辨率（下采样因子）对精度和适用范围的影响，建立分辨率感知的求解器家族；发现并修正三维RAFT相关采样中的坐标顺序不一致问题，并提出非立方脉冲测试作为采样器几何的独立验证手段；展示跨纹理迁移能力（仅用粒子标记合成数据训练即可处理micro-CT泡沫图像）。
papers.method_zh: 基于RAFT（循环全对场变换）架构的机器学习DVC求解器，采用编码器下采样因子s=2/4/8的匹配设计；合成基准测试、频率扫描测试（量化变形空间分辨率）、分块推理（tile inference）用于大体积密集估计；实验验证包括压痕过程中的共聚焦体图像和弹性体泡沫的micro-CT图像；提出非立方脉冲测试以独立于网络训练验证采样器几何。

papers.title: A greedy nearest-neighbor approach to quantify site revisitation: comparing two sympatric raven species
